translations.translation: Sha sov k'inkhetame a, k'inkhetame a volchu Delan tsIartsa.
Khastambu Dalla- IalamiinDena,
Sha sov k'inkhetame, k'inkhetame volchu,
Shen dolakh' bekkhaman dedolchu.
Kh'una Iibadat do okha, Kh'o'ga gIo a do'khu.
Nisde Akh' tkho niisachu novk'a,
Akh' shaina niImat dellacherannovk'a, Kh'o shaina o'gIaztsa vakhancheran a, tilatsa bellacheran a novk'a.
Alif-lam-mum.
KhIara zhaina, tsu chokh' sheko iats, niisa nek' bu /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna.
U'sh bu kh'ulamekh dolchukhteshash bersh, lamaz khIottoshbersh, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anna tIera /dikachu ag1or/ kharzhash a esh bersh.
Ishttanash a bu u'sh, teshash, kh'o'ga dossiinachukh (K'ur'anakh) a, kh'o'ga dossiinachul kh'alkha dissiinachekha, ekhartakh a u'sh ch1og1a teshash bu.
U'sh bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara niisachu novk'akh', u'sh bu bakkkhiibiirash.
Bakk'alla a, tsa teshash bersh - tsarna ben dats akh' shaina kkheram tescha a, tsa tescha a, u'sh teshar bats.
Tseran degnash a, lergash a, mukhIar a to'khna, dIak'evlina, tseran bIa'rgashna du'kh'al kirkh'a du, tsarna khir du deza dokkkha Iazap.
Nakhakh bu tskh'abersh, sha'sh olush: "Teshna tkho Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a"- u'sh ma bats teshash.
Iekho gIerta u'sh Dela a, iiman dillinarsh a, amma tsara tsa Iekhabo sha'sh ben, - /i/ tsa khaalo-kkh tsarna.
Tseran degnashkakh' tsamgar iu, Dala alsam'ia'kkkhi i kkhin t1e a tsamgartsa, tsarna ma du lazosh dolu Iazap, sha'sh khilarna khartslu'ish.
Tsa'rga a'lcha: " Ma lelade la'tta t1ekh' bo'khanig", tsara olu: "Tkho-m dikanig lelosh dersh ma du!"
U'sh bats, tk'a, bo'khanig lelosh bersh? Delakh' a, khaa tsa lo-kkh tsarna.
Tsa'rga a'lcha: "Teshiisha, nakh ma teshshar", tsara olu: "Tkho teshar du tk'a, Iovdalsh sanna?" Bakk'alla a, u'sh bats tk'a, Iovdalsh? Amma, tsa kha'a-kkh tsarna.

Iiman dillincharna du'kh'alkkhetcha, tsara olu: "Tkho iiman dillina du." Shain shaitIanashtsa ts'anabischa, tsara olu: "Bakk'alla a, tkho shu'tsa ma du, tkho-m u'sh (iiman dillinarsh) kh'iizosh darii".
.Dala siisaza biir bu u'sh, ch1ag1biir bu shain tilarchokh' d1a-skh'a kh'iizash.
U'sh bu niisachu nek'akh tilar etsnarsh, ma sa tsa khili-kkh tseran iokhka-etsarkh, u'sh tsa khili-kkh niisachu novk'akh'.
U'sh tera bu, tsIe a latiina, tIakkkha tso shena gonakha derg serlada'kkkhicha, Dala shain nur dIa a da'kh'na, bodanekh' bisincharekh, shaina kh1umma tsa gush.
K'ora a, mott a tsa khuush a, bIa'rzea khilla, u'sh iukha tsa bo'rzu-kkh/niisachu novk'a/.

Ia stiglarchu dogIanan markhanakh tera, shena chokh' boda bolush, k'ovk'ar dolush, tk'es tokhar dolush - tsara lergash chu pIelgash du'khku, tk'es kkhetna balarkh larlush. I Dela ma vu gone lotsur bolush i tsa teshash bersh.

Tk'es gerga du tseran bIa'rsa dIaetsa, shaina tso serlo ma ellinekh', dIabo'lkhu u'sh tsu'ntsa, shaina Iarzh ma ellinekh', sovtsu. Dalla li'nekh'ara, khazar a, bIa'rsa a dIakh'ur dara tseran: Dela masso a khIumanna t1ekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.
KhIai nakh! Sha'sh a, shail kh'alkharnash a kkho'llinchu sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunnaIibadat de, shu khila tarlo-kkh /Delakh/ kkho'rush.
I vu shuna lattanakh mott bina, stiglanakh tkhov bina, stiglara khi a daiitina, tsu'ntsa sto'mash a kkhiina shuna ritsk'ana. T1akkkha ma nisve Delatsa tskh'a a, shaina khu'ushekh'.

Nagakh' shu shekonekh' delakh', OkhaTkhan lega /Mukh'ammad paikhamare/ dossosh khillachukh, t1akkkha skh'adalade tsunakh tera tskh'a surat, skh'akkhaikkha shain teshash (g1o'nchii), Dela votsurg, sha'sh bak'lu'ish delakh'.
Nagakh' shu'ga i tsa dalakh' - tk'a i shu'ga tsk'a a dalur dats - kkheriisha tsIarakh, shen iagorig adamash a, tIulgasha dolchu. Iza kechiina tsateshacharna.

Akh' /khIai Mukh'ammad/ kkha' bakkkha iiman dillincharga a,dika Iamalsh iinacha'rga a shaina /ialsamanin/ boshmash khirg khilartsa, bukhakhula o'khush khish a dolush. Kh1orazza shaina tsu chu'ra sto'mekh ritsk' mel deli, tsara er du: "KhIarra dara kh'alkha a vaina lush khillarg" - tsarna kh'alkha a dellera tsunakh teranig /delakh' a kh1ara kkhin dara chamatsa a, kh'ozhatsa a, kuts tera khillekh' a/. Tsarna tsu chokh' tsIena zudarii a khir bu, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar a la'ttar bu.

Bakk'alla a, Dela iiza tsa lo masal daladan: chu'rkkal khIumanakh a, tsul lakkharchekh a (to'lush dolchekh ia tsul o'shush dolchekh a). Iiman dillincharna kha'a i shain Delera bak'derg duila, tk'a tsateshachara olu: "KhIun li'na-te Dalla tsu masaltsa?" Tso tilabo tsu'ntsa dukkkha a bersh, Tso nisbo tsu'ntsa dukkkha a bersh. Tsu'ntsa tila-m tsa bo Tso pesakkhbersh ben.
U'sh ma bu iokhosh Delatsa khilla vaIdabart khillachul tIa'kh'a, tsara khedado Dala khottaa'lla omra dinarg, lelado la'tta tIekh' bo'khanig, - u'sh ma bu eshnarsh.
Shu mukha tsa tesha Delakh? Shu della ma dara. TIakkkha Tso shu den ma dira. Iukha Tso dolu'itur du shu, iukha a dendiir du, tIakkkha Tsunna tIe dIaderzor du shu.
Iza vu la'tta tIekh' mel derg shuna kkho'llinarg, tIakkkha tIevirzira I stiglanna- Tso dIanisiira i vorkhI stigaltsa, - I masso a khIumanakh derg Shena khuush verg ma vu.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho a'llera malikashka: "So vollu la'tta tIekh' t1a'kh'e khiliita". Tsara elira: "Akh' kkhullu tk'a tsu tIekh' bo'khanig den derg a, tsIii Ieno derg a? Okha biir bara Kh'una khastam a, okha vazviir a ma vara Kh'o". Tso elira: "So khuush ma vu shuna tsakhuurg a".
Tso Iamiira Adamna masso a khIumaniin tsIersh, tIakkkha u'shmalikashna a gaitina, elira: "Iiitsa Suna tseran tsIersh, sha'sh delakh' bak'lu'ish".
Tsara elira: "Masso a vochukh tsIena vu Kh'o. Tkho'gakh' ma dats Akh' tkhaina 1amiina dolu 1ilma ben. Kh'o vu-kkh khuush verg a, kh'ek'ale verg a".

/Dala/ elira: "KhIai Adam, akh' iiitsal tsa'rga tseran tsIersh". TIakkkha tso tsa'rga tseran tsIersh iiitsicha, elira /Dala/: "As shu'ga tsa a'llera tk'a: So khuush vu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a k'aile, So khuush vu ash guchudokkkhush derg a, ash kh'uldesh khillarg a?"
Okha a'llera malikashka: "Suzhudde Adamna". TIakkkha tsara suzhud dira, Iblis dotscho. Iza du'kh'al a delira, tso kuralla a iira, - i khilira tsateshacharakh.

/D1aala kh'ain k'ome, kh1ai Mukh'ammad/: Okha elira: "KhIai, Adam, vakha kh'o a, kh'an zuda a /ialsamanin/ beshakh', daa tsu chokh' dolchukh ma-dezza shaina lu'urg. Amma shu gerga ma gIolash khIokkhu dittana- /dodakh'/, shu'-shi' khir du zulam dinacharakh".

Galaba'khira shait1ano i shi' tsu'ntsa (dittatsa - marzdira tsarna i stom kkhalla). TIakkkha Tso i shi' arada'kkkhira sha'sh khillachu'ra (ialsamanera). Okha elira /Adame a, Kh'avaga a, Iblise a/: "Okh'adissa /la'tta t1e/, vovshiin mostagIiia dolchu kh'olekh'. Shuna la'ttakh' khir iu dakharan mettig a, tskh'a khan tIekkhachchalts bakham a".
Adama Iamiira sha Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nan deshnash, Tso (Dala) tsu'nan toba k'obaldira. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu /t1ett1a/ toba k'obaldiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Okha (Dala) elira: "Chudissa tsigara (ialsamanera) masso a. Nagakh' shu'ga San niisonan nek' kkhachakh' (i kkhacha a kkhochur bu), tsunna t1a'kh'aba'znacharna kkheram a khir bats (shaina du'kh'alkkhetar dolchu ekhartan g1ullakkhekh), u'sh singattame a khir bats (du'nenakh' shaikh d1atilna disina g1ullakkhash bakh'anekh', Dala shaina mela tsabalarna kkho'rush).
Tsateshnarsh a, Tkhan aiatash khartsdina bersh a - u'sh ma bu /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai, u'sh tsu chokh' guttarenna a bu'sur ma bu".

KhIai, IsrailankIentii, Ash dagadaiita San niImat, As shaina della khilla dolu, ash kkhochush'e So'tsa /sha'sh Suna a ben 1ibadat diir dats, a'lla/ khilla vaIda, As kkhochushiiir iu shu'tsa /Aisa shuna khaza mela lur bu, a'lla/ khilla vaIda, Sokh tskh'annakh kkheralash.

Shu teshalash As okh'adossiinachukh (K'ur'anakh), shu'gakh' dolchu'ntsa (Tavratatsa) niisa dogIush a dolchu, - shu ma khila tsunakh kh'alkhara tsatesharsh. San aiatekh kIezzig bolu makh ma etsa, Sokh kkheralash.
Ma iede ash bak'derg kharts dolchu'ntsa, bak'derg kh'ul ma de, shaina khu'ushekh' (Tavrata chokh' dolu Mukh'ammadan sibat).
Lamaz khIottade, lo zakat, suzhudane gIo suzhud decha'rtsa.
Ash kh'o'khu nakhana dikanig? Tk'a ditsdesh ma du shain dog1mash! Shu ma du zhaina (Tavrat) do'shush - shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?
Ash gIo lakha sobartsa a, lamaztsa a. Bakk'alla a, iza deza (khala) ma du/Delakh/ch1og1a kkho'rush bersh botsucharna. (Iza kkhochushdalur dolush dats /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' bolcha'rga ben).
U'sh bu sha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchunna du'kh'alkkhetarg khilarkh a, sha'sh Tsunna tIe dIado'rzurg khilarkh a teshash.
KhIai Israilan kIentii! Ash /Suna shukur dartsa/ dagadaiita San niImat, As shuna della khilla dolu, - As shu dazdina khilar Ialamal (shukh elchanash bakhkiitartsa, zhainash dissortsa).
Shu kkhera diinakh, sino sinna paida biir botschu, tsu'ngara gIo k'obaldiir dotschu, tsu'ngara makh o'tsur botschu, shaina /Delan Iazapakh/ gIo khir dotschu.

Dagadaita /khIai Israilan kIentii/! Okha kIelkh'ardekhira shu FirIavnan nakhakh: von Iazap shuna tIekh' khIottadora tsara, boiura shun kIentii, diina bu'tura shun zudarii - tsu chokh' shun siilakh'-veza volchu Kkhiosh-kkhobucho zer ma du.
Okha shuna khIord biik'ira - shu k1elkh'aradekhira, FirIavnan nakh bukha bakhiitira, shu kh'o'zhush dollushekh'.
Okha Musatsa shovztk'a de-bu'isakhan bilgal'ia'kkkhira (tsu'nga Tavrat dala), tIakkkha tsul t1a'kh'a shu esanna 1ibadat dan du'iladelira, ishtta shukh zulamkhoi khilira.
TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a a Okha gechdira shuna, shu barkalle khir datsara tekh'a, a'lla.
Dagadaiita! Okha delira Musaga zhaina, bak'derg khartsdolchukh a, kh'anal derg kh'aram dolchukh a k'astosh dolu, shu nislur datsara tekh'a, a'lla.

Musas a'llera shen k'ome: "KhIai san k'am, ash shaina zulam dina, sha'sh esanna 1ibadat dartsa. Tobanash de sha'sh Kkho'llinchu'nga, tIakkkha sha'sh-shain daia. I dika du shuna shu Kkho'llinchunna (Dalla) gergakh'. TIakkkha Tso shun tobanash k'obaldira. Bakk'alla a, I ma vu /t1ett1a/ tobanash k'obaldiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Ash ma elira: "KhIai Musa, tkho teshar ma dats kh'okh, i Dela tkhaina k'a'sttash tsa gakh'". TIakkkha shu letsira tk'eso (stelakha'shtigo shu daiira), shu kh'o'zhush la'ttashekh'.
TIakkkha Okha dendira shu /tskh'ana diinakh'-busa/ della la'ttinchul tIa'kh'a - shu barkalle khir datsara tekh'a a'lla.

Okha shuna tIekhula markha khIottiira /shu ma'lkhan iovkhonakh lardesh/, daiitira shuna manna a, salva a. Daa Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh tsIenaderg (kh'analderg). Tkhuna zulam-m tsa dira tsara, amma u'sh khilira shaina zulam desh-m.

Dagadaiita! Okha elira: "ChugIo tsu shakh'ara, daa tsu chu'ra shaina lu'urg shortta. Kevnekhula cho'kh'adovla, suzhud a desh. Ash ala: "Gechde tkhuna!"- Okha gechdiir du shun gIalatashna, tIakkkha alsambokhur bu dikanig desh bersh.
Zulamkhosha khiitsira shaiga a'lla dolu dosh a'lla dotschu'ntsa, tIakkkha zulamkhoshna Okha stiglara rizhsdossiira, u'sh pesak'khilarna.

Dagadaiita! Musas ma diikhira /Dele/ shen k'omana mala khi / u'sh, kh'agbella, "Tikh1"oluchu bo'rakh' bolush/. TIakkkha Okha elira: "DIatokha kh'ain Iasa tIulgakh". TIakkkha tsunakh delira shiitta kh'osta. Berrige a nakhana evzira shain-shain khi molu mettig. Daa a daa, mala a mala Delan ritsk'anakh - ma de la'tta tIekh' vonig, bo'khanig darzhosh.

Ash a'llera: "KhIai Musa, okha toam biir ma bats tskh'ana taipanadaarkh. Kh'ain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga dekha, Tso ioliitu'ila tkhuna la'tta tIekh' kkhu'ush bolchu khassto'mekh, ekhachu na'rsekh, sa'rmasekkhekh, kh'oziin kkho'ekh, khokhekh tskh'atstsa khIuma. Tso elira: "Tk'a ash khu'itsu dikanig /tsul/ lakharchukh? Okh'adissa Misra, shuna khir du ash dekhnarg". Tsarna tIetu'ikhira sii daiar a, miskalla a, Delera o'gIazlo khilira tsarna. Iza - u'sh Delan aiatekh tsa teshash khilarna a, niisa dotsush paikhamarsh boiush khilarna a du. Iza - tsara du'kh'alo iarna a, u'sh dozanakh bovlush khilarna a du.

Bakk'alla a, /Mukh'ammadna tIa'kh'akh1ittina/ iiman dillinarsh a, /Musana tIa'akh'akh1ittina khilla /zhu'gtii a, /Iiisana ta'akh'akh1ittina khilla/ nasarash a, sabiash a- /tsarakh/ Delakh a, t1a'khkh'archu diinakh a teshash bersh a, dika 1amal iinarsh a - tsarna shain ial khir iu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh', kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna /ekhartan ta1zarkh/, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats /mela tsakhilarkh kkho'rush/.

Dagadaita! Okha shu'ga chIagIo iaitira, shuna tIekhula lam kh1ottiina. Ch1og1a skh'alatsa Okha shaina dellarg, tsu chokh' derg a dagadaita shu khir datsara-te /du'nenakh' kh1allakkhilarkh a, ekhartakh' 1azab khilarkh a/ kkho'rush.
TIakkkha, tsul tIa'kh'a, shu iukhadevlira /Tavratatsa Iamal iarakh/. Delan dozalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a shuna tsa khillekh'ara - shu khilla khir dara eshnacharekh (shu khIallakkhir dara).
Shuna bevzira shaikh shotdiinan bak'o talkhiinarsh. Okha tsa'rga elira: "Khila shukh siisazdina maimalash!".
Okha izakhiliitira tsu zamanna a, tIa'kh'a iogIur iolchu zamanna a masalna a, /Delakh/ kkho'ru-charna kkhetamna a.

Dagadaiita! Musas a'llera shen k'ome: "Bakk'alla a, Dala omra do shu'ga attana urs kh'akkha, a'lla". Tsara elira: "Akh' kh'iizor dara tkho?" Tso (Musas) elira: "Dala larvoila so zhekhIal nakhakh khilarkh".

Tsara elira: "Dekha kh'ain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, bilgalbe tkhuna i khIun ett bu, alii". Tso elira: "Tso (Dala) bokhu: "I ett bu, k'ena a botsush, zhima a botsush, iukk'era. Shaiga bokhurg kkhochushde".
Tsara elira: "Dekha kh'ain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, bilgalde tkhuna, bos khIun bu tsu'nan, alii". Tso elira: "Tso bokhu: "I ett bu, sirla-mozhachu basakh', shega kh'o'zhursh chIogIa tsetsbokhush".
Tsara elira: "Dekha kh'ain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, bilgalde tkhuna, i mukha bu, alii. Bezhnash derrige a vovshekh tera du tkhuna. Tkho, Dalla laakh', dIanislur dolush du".

Tso elira: "Tso (Dala) bokhu: "I ett bu okhana dan ia ialtanan arenna khi dilla Iamiina a botsush, aipekh tsIena a bolush. ChIama botsush a bu iza". Tsara elira: "KhIintsa deana akh' bak'derg". TIakkkha tsara tsunna urs kh'a'kkhira, sha'sh gerga khillekh' a /i/ tsa dan.
Dagadaiita /kh1ai Israilan k1entii/: "Ash sa (adam) ma diira. Tsu tIekh' vovshashtsa devne devlira shu". Dela ma vu guchudokkkhurg ash dIakh'uldesh derg.
TIakkkha Okha elira: "Tsu dok'akh tokha /a'ttan/ tskh'a mezhe". Ishtta denvo Dala vellarg, goitu shuna Shen Ialamatash, shu khiliitarkh'ama kkhetash.

TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a shun degnash k'iza khilira, tIulg sanna ia tsul a chIogIa shain k'izallitsa. Bakk'alla a, tIulgash iukk'era skh'adu'ilu shovdanash. Tsarekh (t1ulgekh) du, sha'sh lelkha a lelkhash, shaikh khi dolursh a. Bakk'alla a, tsarekh du Delakh kkherartsa o'gush dersh. Dela ma vats tergal tsa desh ash diirig.

Shu dog dokhush du /khIai busalbanash/ u'sh (zhu'gtii) shaikh teshash khilare? Khilla tsarakh tskh'abersh Delan dosh khezash, tIakkkha, sha'sh tsunakh kkhettachul tIa'kh'a, i khartskh'adokkkhush, shaina khu'ushekh'.

Sha'sh iiman dillincharna du'kh'alkkhetcha, tsara olu: "Iiman dillina du tkho",- tk'a sha'sh vovshashtsa bischa, olu: "Ash tsa'rga du'itsur du tk'a shaina Dala khaiitinargtsa'rga /busulbanashka/ shaitsa shain Dalla gergakh' dolchu'ntsa k'iisiita. Shu khIunda tsa khu'lu kh'ek'ale?"
Tsarna (zhu'gtashna) tsa kha'a-te, i Dela tsara kh'uldiirig a, tsara guchudokkkhurg a khuush vuila?
Tsarakh bu bodane bersh, shaina zhaina (Tavrat) tsa khuush, bekk'a besa satiisamash ben - u'sh ma bats shaina khetarsh desh ben.

Balabu shain ku'igashtsa zhaina iazdecharna, tIakkkha tsara olu: "KhIara du Delera",- shaina tsunakh paidabotstsu makh etsarkh'ama. TIakkkha bala bu tsarna shain ku'igasha iazdinchukh, bala bu tsarna sha'sh karaderzochukh.

Tsara elira: "Tkhokh kkhetanne a kkhetar iats /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe, tskh'a masiitta diinakh' ben". Akh' ala /ia Mukh'ammad/: "Delera vaIda etsna ash? - Dala tsk'a a tsa iokhaio Shen vaIda - ia shu Delakh la'tsna du'itsush du shaina tsakhuurg?"
Kh1a', vonig dinarsh a, shain g1alatash shaikh kh'a'rchinarsh a - u'sh bu zho'zhakhatin dai, sha'sh tsu chokh' guttar khir bolush.
Tk'a iiman dillinarsh a, dikanig dinarsh a - u'sh bu ialsamanin dai, sha'sh tsu chokh' guttar khir bolush.

/Dagadaiita tsarna, khIai Mukh'ammad/ Israilan kIentashtsachIagIo iira Okha: "Dalla ben Iibadat diir dats ash, detsa-nenatsa a dika khir du shu, gergarcha'rtsa a, boberashtsa a /zhimallekh' dai bella bisinchu/, miskacha'rtsa a /dika khir du/, a'lla; ash ala nakhe dikanig, lamaz de, zakat lo". TIakkkha shu iukhadevlira, shukh tskh'a kIezzig bersh botsursh, sha'sh du'kh'al a khu'lush.
Bart binera Okha shu'tsa: "Ash vovshiin tsIii Ienor dats, sha'sh vovshiin tsIenoshkara ara a dokhur dats", - a'lla, tIakkkha ash chIagIdira /i/, sha'sh teshash a dolush.

TIakkkha, tsul t1a'kh'a, shu du khIorsh: sha'sh shain doiush, shaikh tskh'abersh shain kh1usamashkara arabokhush, k'a latortsa a, mostagIallitsa a tsarna (mushrikunashna) gIo a desh. U'sh iiisarsh khilcha, mekhakhpargIatbokhu ash. Shuna kh'aram du u'sh ( shain zhu'gtiin vezharii shain ts1enoshkara) arabakhar. Tk'a zhainantskh'adolchekh shu tesha, vazha khartsdo ash? Shukh i lelochunna bekkham bats du'nenan dakharekh' sisazalla ben, tk'a k'ematdiinakh' u'sh dIaberzor ma bu uggar chIogIachu Iazape, ma vats i Dela tergal tsa desh ash diirig.
U'sh ma bu ekhartakh du'nenan dakhar etsnarsh. Tsarna Iazap daidiir ma dats, tsarna gIo a diir ma dats.

Okha dellera Musaga zhaina, tsul tIa'kh'a a bakhiitira elchanash, Mar'iaman kIante Iiisaga delira kkhochchush teshallash (Inzhil), chIagIvira i Dezachu sitsa, tk'a mella a shain dogImashna tsadezarg dokh'ush shu'ga elcha ve'cha, shu kuradovlura /kh1ai Israilan k1entii/, /elchanekh/ tskh'abersh khartsbora ash, tskh'abersh boiura ash.
Tsara (Israilan kIentasha) elira: "Tkhan degnash muzhalt du (dIak'evlina du)". KhIa', Dala neIalt elira tsarna, u'sh (Delakh) tsateshar bakh'anekh'. Ma kIezzig du-kkh i, u'sh shekh teshash berg.

Tsa'rgakh' derg (Tavrat) bak'desh dolu zhaina (K'ur'an) Delera shaiga de'nachul tIa'kh'a...- kh'alkha u'sh ma khillera tsateshacharna tIekh' shaina gIo a do'khush...- shaiga i shaina khuush derg de'cha (Mukh'ammad paikhamar), tsunakh tsa tiishira u'sh. Delan neIalt khu'lda tsateshacharna.

Ma vondo'khki tsara shain dogImash Dala Shen lekh Shena luuchu'nga Shen k'inkhetamakh dossiinarg kh'og1atsa kharts a desh. O'gIazallinatIe a o'gIazallina kh'ak' khilira u'sh. Tsateshnacharna du siisaza dolu Iazap.

Tsa'rgaa'lcha: "Tesha Dala dossiinachukh (K'ur'anakh)",- tsara olu: "Tkho tesha tkhaiga dossiinachukh". U'sh ma teshats tsul t1a'kh'a do'ssinchukh. Tk'a i ma du bak'derg, tsa'rgakh' dolchu'ntsaniisa a dogIush. Akh' ala /zhu'gtashka/: "Tk'a kh'alkha Delan paikhamarsh khIunda boiura ash, sha'sh teshash khillekh'?"
Shu'ga ma ve'nera kkhochchush teshallashtsa Musa, tIakkkha a, tsul tIa'kh'a, ash tIeletsira esa, sha'sh zulamkhoi a khu'lush.

Dagadaiita! Okha ma bira shu'tsa bart, shuna tIekhula aibira lam. "Ch1og1a dIaetsa Okha shaina dellarg, la a dogIa". Tsara elira: "Lado'gIna okha, Iesa khilla tkho". Tseran degnashkakh' kkhollabelira ese bezam u'sh tsatesharna. Akh' ala: "Ma von khIuma du-kkh shun iimano shuna kh'o'khush derg, shu teshash khillekh'."
Akh' ala: "TIa'khkh'ara kh1usamDalla gergakh', nakhana a iotsush, ekk'a shuna khilakh', dala laa, sha'sh bak'lu'ish delakh'".
Tsarna tsk'a a dezanne a dezar dats shaina iza shain ku'igashtsa kh'alkhada'kkkhinchu'ntsa. Dela ma vu bevzash i zulamkhoi.

Kh'una karanne a karor ma bu u'sh (zhu'gtii) masso a nakhal /du'nenan/ dakharna sutara, Delatsa nak'ost la'tsnacharel a. Tsarakh khIoranna a luur dara ezar sharakh' vakha. Ma vats-kkha i Iazapakh gena valalur volush sha /mel dukkha/ vakharkh. Dela gush ma vu tsara diirig.
Akh' ala: "Mila khilla DzhibrilanamostagI? Tso ma dossadora i /K'ur'an/ kh'an dag chu Delan purbantsa, tsul kh'alkha khillachu'ntsaniisa a dogIush, teshacharna sha niisa nek' a, kkha' a khilla dolu".
Mila khilla mostagI Dalla a, Tsu'nan malikashna a, Tsu'nan elchanashna a, Dzhibrilana a, Miikalnaa..? Tk'a Dela a ma vu mostagI tsateshacheran.
Okha dossiina kh'o'ga bilggala dolu aiatash, u'sh kerstdiir ma dats pesak' nakha a ben.
Sha'sh vaIda mel ii a, tsarakh (zhu'gtekh) tskh'ana tobano i iokhaio, melkho a tsarakh dukkhakhbersh teshash ma bats /Tavratakh/.
Shaiga Delera elcha ve'cha, shaigakh' dergbak'desh khilla volu, zhaina dellacharekhtskh'ana tobano dIatesira Delan zhainashain bakk'ashna tIekh'a, shaina tsa khuush sanna.

U'sh tIa'kh'a ma khIittira Suleimanan pachchakh'allekh' shaitIanasha shaina du'itsash dolchu bozbuunchallina. Suleimana kersta tsa dira, amma shaitIanasha kerstadira, tsara nakhana Iamadora bozbuunchalla a, Babilekh'shina malike KhIarute a, Marute a dossiinarg a. Tk'a tsara shimmo tskh'anna a Iama tsa dora, sha'sh olush ben: "Bakk'alla a, tkho tskh'a pitana du - kh'o tsa teshash ma khilalakh'". TIakkkha tsara tsu shingara (KhIarutera a, Marutera a) Iama ma dora mar a, zuda a vovshakhdakkkhar. Tsara ma tsa do tsu'ntsa (bozbuunchallitsa) zen tskh'anna a, Delan purbantsa ben. Tsara Iamado tsarna zen den khIuma, tsa Iamado tsarna paida ben khIuma. Tsarna (zhu'gtashna) khiira ietsnacharna ekhartakh' tskh'a a dak'a tsakhilar. Ma von khIuma du-kkh i, tsara shain sinoikh etsnarg, tsarna khuush khillekh'ara.
U'sh teshna a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush a khillekh'ara - Delera mela to'lush khir bara, tsarna khuush khillekh'ara.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash ma ala /paikhamare/: "Tkhan g1aig1a be". Ash ala: "Tkho'ga kh'azha", la a dogIa. Tsateshacharna lazosh dolu Iazap /khir/ du.

Zhainan okh1lakha, mushrikekh a bolchu tsateshnacharna ma tsa deza shuna sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara /tskh'a a/ dikanig dossa. Dala k'astavo /paikhamar khila a, kkhin dikanig dala a/ Shen k'inkhetamtsa Shena luurg. I Dela siilakh' - dokkkha dozalla dolush vu.
Okha tskh'a aiat dIada'kkkhicha ia ditsdaliiticha, dou'itu tsul dikanig ia tsunakh teranig. Kh'una tsa kha'a, i Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush khilar?
Kh'una tsa kha'a, stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla Delekh' khilar? Shuna ma vats-kkha i Dela votsurg tskh'a a doladiirig a, tskh'a a gIo'ncha a.
Ia shuna la'a shain elchane (Mukh'ammade) dekha, kh'alkha Musaga /zhu'gtasha shaina Dela gaita, a'lla/ dekhna ma-khillara? Iiman tsateshartsa khu'itsush verg ma vu-kkh tilavella niisachu nek'akh.

Bak'derg shaina guchuda'llachul tIa'kh'a a liira zhainan okhIlanakh dukkhabolcharna, shaigara kh'agI bakh'anekh', iiman dillinchul tIa'kh'a shu iimanakh iukhadakha. K'int1era dovla /tsarna/, bita ma'rsha u'sh Dala Shen omra daiittalts. Bakk'alla a, i Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.
Lamaz khIottadelash, zakat lolash, ash shain dogImashna kh'alkha mel da'kkkhina dikanig karor ma du shuna Dalla gergakh'. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ash diirig gush ma vu.
Tsara elira: "Vakhanne a ialsamane gIur ma vats sha zhu'gtekh ia nasarekhverg ben". Iza tseran dagakh' derg du. Akh' ala: "Dalade shain delil, sha'sh bak'lu'ish khillekh'".

KhIa'! /GIur vu ialsamane/ shen iu'kh' Dalla mu'tIakh' iinarg, sha dika Iamal iinarg - tsunna shen ial khir ma iu shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh'. Kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats.

Zhu'gtasha elira: "Nasarash tskh'anna a khIumanna tIekh' bats". Nasarasha elira: "Zhu'gtii tskh'anna a khIumanna tIekh' bats". Tk'a u'sh ma bu zhainado'shush. Ishtta elira khIumma tsa khuush bolchara, tseran dashakh terra. I Dela ma vu kh'ukma diir dolush tsarna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh' tsara khilpalo echu khIumanekh'.

Tk'a mila vu zulame Delan ma'zhdigashna chokh' Tsu'nan tsIe iakkkhar tsa magosh volchul, u'sh dokho sikhlush volchul? U'sh (i nakh, ma'zhdigash dokhosh bolu) - tsarna bakha megar ma datsara tsu /ma'zhdigashna/ chu, /Delakh/ kkho'rush ben. Tsarna iu du'nenakh' siisazalla, tk'a ekhartakh'-m tsarna ma du deza dokkkha Iazap.
Delan iu malkhbale a, malkhbuze a. Shu michchakh'a dirzicha a - tsigakh' iu Delan iu'kh'. I Dela ma vu derrige a chulotsush verg a, dika khuush verg a.
Tsara elira: "Dala do'zalkho la'tsna". Vonakh tsIena vu Iza. Tk'a Tsu'nan ma du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Masso a Tsunna mu'tIakh' ma vu.
Sha stiglanash a, latta a iu'kh'antsa kkho'llinarg vu I. Tskh'ana gIullakkha tIekh' Sha tskh'a satsam bicha, Tso olu tsu'nga /Shena khila luuchu kh1umane/: "Khila!" - i khu'lu.

Shaigakh' 1ilma dotschara elira: "Tkho'ga vistkhilla velakh'ara Dela, ia tkho'ga tskh'a delil deana khillekh'ara". Ishtta olura tsaral kh'alkha bakhanchara a, tsara bokhuchu'nga terra, tskh'aterra khilira tseran degnash. Bilgalda'khna Okha aiatash ch1og1a teshash bolchu nakhana.
Bakk'alla a, Okha kh'ovaiitina bak'dolchu'ntsa /kkha' bakkkha/ khaamchakhilla a, /Iazapan/ kkheramchakhilla a, kh'o'ga khottur ma dats zho'zhakhatin okhIlanna tIera.

Khilanne a reza khir ma bats kh'una zhu'gtii a, nasarash a, kh'o tseran dinna t1a'kh'akh1o'tticha ben. Akh' ala: "Delan niisa nek' - i ma bu niisa nek'", kh'o nagakh' tseran laamashna tIa'kh'akhIottakh', kh'aiga Iilma (bak'dolu din - islam) de'nachul tIa'kh'a, Delera kh'una khir ma vats tskh'a a valia, tskh'a a gIo'ncha a.
Okha shaiga zhaina dellacharekh i /K'ur'an/ desha ma-dezzara do'shush bersh bu,- u'sh ma bu tsunakh/kh'ak'-bak'/ teshash. Tsunakh tsa teshash bersh - u'sh ma bu eshamekh'.
KhIai Israilan kIentii! Ash dagadaiita San niImat, As shuna della khilla dolu, As daz ma dira shu Ialamal.

Kkheralash diinakh, tskh'ana sino kkhechunna paida biir botschu, shegara /Delan 1azapakh l1elkh'ara vala belcha a/ makh k'obalbiir botschu, gIodakkkharo (shapaIato) shena paida biir botschu a. Tsarna (tsateshacharna) g1o diir dats.

/Akh' kh'akhade tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: IbrakhIim ma ziira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobucho deshnashtsa, tso u'sh kkhochush ma dira. Tso (Dala) elira: "As kh'okh nakhana imam vesh vu". Tso (IbrakhIima) elira: "Tk'a san tIa'kh'enakh?". Elira /Dala/: "San vaIda tsa kh'akkhalo zulamkhoikh".

Kh'akhade! Okha i tsIadira nakhana t1ebo'rzu a, ma'rsha a mettig khiliita: "E IbrakhIiman mettig lamaz den mettig". Okha omra dira IbrakhIime a, IsmaIile a: "Ash shimmo tsIande San tsIa (KaIba) go bokkkhucharna a /tIavap desh/, chokh' khevshina Iibadat (i1tikaf) decharna a, gorabakhana lamaz decharna a".

IbrkhIima a'llera: "KhIai san Kkhiosh-kkhobu/Dela/, Akh' khiliitakh' khIara/mettig/ ma'rsha mokhk, Akh' ritsk' lolakh' tsu'nan okhIlanna sto'mashtsa, tsarakh Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakha teshnacharna". Tso elira: "Tk'a /Delan ts1en din/ kerstadinacha'rga Asa paidao'tsu'itur bu ni1matekh tskh'a k1ezzig, tIakkkha dIakh'avsor ma bu u'sh tsIeranIazape". Ma von iu-kkh u'sh kkhochu bolu mettig!

IbrakhIima a, IsmaIila a kh'alaoibu tsu tsIiinan bukh/ Dele do'khush/: "KhIai, tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! K'obalde Akh' /khIara g1ullakkh/ tkho'gara. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu khezash verg a, khuush verg a.

KhIai tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Tkhoishi' khiliita Akh' Kh'aina mu'tIakh', tkhan tIa'kh'enakh a Kh'aina mu'tIakh' ummat de Akh', gaitakh'a tkhuna tkhan Iibadat den mettigash, Akh' gechdelakh' tkhuna. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu t1ekh gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

KhIai tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Akh' vaiitalakh' tsarna elcha, tsarakh a volush, sha tsarna do'shush Kh'an aiatash, tsarna Iamosh zhaina a, kh'ek'alalla a, u'sh tsIanbesh. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu veza verg a, kh'ukame verga".

Tk'a mila vu IbrakhIiman millatakh /buk' to'khna/ d1avo'rzush verg? - Ma vats iza shen Iovdallalitsa sha vaivesh verg ben. Okha kha'rzhina i /IbrakhIim/ du'nenakh', tk'a ekhartakh' i khir ma vu dikacharekh.
Kh'akhade! A'llera tsu'nga i Kkhiosh-kkhobucho: "Mu'tIakh'khila!" Tso elira: "Mu'tIakh' vu so Ialamiin Dena (Dalla)".
Tsu'ntsa (islamatsa) veset dira IbrakhIima shen kIentashka, Ia1k'uba a dira: "KhIai san kIentii! Dala kha'rzhina shuna din, shu dala ma loila /tsu Dalla/ mu'tIakh' dolush a ben".

Tk'a shu darii ullokh' la'ttash IaIk'ubana tIe Iozhalla e'cha, tso shen kIentashka olush: "Kh'anna Iibadat diir du ash sol tIa'kh'a?" Tsara ma elira: "Okha Iibadat diir ma du kh'an Delana, kh'an dain - IbrakhIiman, IsmaIilan, Iskh'ak'an - Delana, sha tskh'a' volchu tsu Delana, Tsunna mu'tIakh' ma du tkho".
I d1adakhna ummat du. Tsunna tso shena lekhnarg kariina, shuna ash shaina lekhnarg kariina. Shu'ga zhop do'khur ma dats tsara desh khillachukh.

Tsara (zhainan okh1lakh bolchara) elira: "Khila zhu'gtiin dinekh' ia nasarash, tIakkkha khir du shu niisachu novk'akh'". Akh' ala: "KhIan-khIa! Sha tsIena Delakh teshash khillachu IbrakhIiman din du san, tsa khilla iza mushrikekh".

Ash ala: "Teshna tkho Delakh a, tkhaiga dossiinachukh (K'ur'anakh) a, IbrakhIime, IsmaIile, Iskh'ak'e, IaIk'ube, tsu'nan tIa'kh'ene dossiinachukh a, Musaga a, Iiisaga a dellachukh a, sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu Delera paikhamarshka daiitinchukh a. Okha tsarakh tskh'a a tsa k'astavo. Tkho tsunna (Dalla) mu'tIakh' ma du".

Nagakh' sanna u'sh teshna belakh', shu ma teshshara - tIakkkha u'sh khir bu niisachu novk'akh'. Nagakh' sanna u'sh dIaberzakh' /tsu teshamakh/ - bakk'alla a, u'sh (zhu'gtii a, nasarash a) ma bu /kh'o'gakh' dolchunna/ du'kh'ala. Dala / tseran zenakh a, bokhamakh a 1alashvartsa/ kkhacho iiir iu kh'una. I ma vu sha khezash verg a, khuush verg a.
/Ala zhu'gtashka a, nasarashka a: tkho k'astiina/Delan dinan khazallin basartsa. Mila vu tk'a Delachul din khaza dolush? /Ash ala/: "Tsunna Iibadat do okha."
Akh' ala: "Tkho'tsa k'u'isu ash Delan kh'ok'ekh'? I ma vu tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a, tkhuna tkhan Iamalsh iu, shuna shun Iamalsh iu, tkho tsunna (Dalla) teshame du".

Ia ash bokhu: IbrakhIim, IsmaIil, Iskh'ak', IaIk'ub, tsu'nan (Ia1k'uban) tIa'kh'e a khilla zhu'gtii ia nasarash? Akh' ala: "Shuna dika kha'a ia Dalla dika kha'a? Mila vu zulame shena gergakh' Delera khilla dolu teshallakh'uldesh volchul? Ma vats i Dela tergo tsa esh ash diirig".
I d1adakhna ummat du. Tsunna tso shena lekhnarg kariina, shuna ash shaina lekhnarg kariina. Shu'ga zhop do'khur ma dats tsara desh khillachukh.

Nakhakh kh'ek'ale botsuchara er ma du: "Sten dIaberziina tekh'a u'sh sha'sh tIebo'rzush khillachu k'ilbanna tIera?" Akh' ala: "Delan iu malkhbale a, malkhbuze a, nisvesh vu I Shena luurg niisachu novk'a".

Ishtta Okha dira shukh iuk'arallin ummat, shu khiliita nakhana tIekh' teshash, elcha a khiliita shuna tIekh' tesh. Okha ma tsa dira kh'o shena tIevo'rzush khilla k'ilba /Baitul-Muk'addis/ k'asto ben elchanna tIa'kh'avozurg sha /kerstanallina t1e/ vukhavo'rzuchukh. Bakk'alla a, khillera iza khala khIuma Dala nisbinacharna dotsush. Dela tsa khilla shun iiman eshor dolush. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ma vu nakhakh dog lozush a, k'inkhetame a.

Gira Tkhuna /khIai Mukh'ammad/ kh'an iu'kh' stiglakh'a kh'iizar. Okha kh'o tIevo'rzor ma vu kh'o reza volchu k'ilbanna. DIaerzae kh'an iu'kh' Dezchu Ma'zhdiganagIor. Sha'sh michchakh'a delakh' a, dIaerzae shain iakhkh'ash tsu agIor. Zhainan okhIlanna khuush ma du i shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bak'derg khilar. Ma vats i Dela tsara diirig tidamekh' dotsush.

Zhainan okhIlanna mu'lkhkha delil akh' daliicha a, u'sh tIebo'rzur bats kh'an k'ilbanna, kh'o a vo'rzur vats tseran k'ilbanna tIe. Tsarakh tskh'abersh bo'rzur ma bats kkhecheran k'ilbanna tIe. Kh'o tseran dezarshna tIa'kh'akhIottakh', kh'aiga Iilma de'nachul tIa'kh'a, kh'o khir ma vu zulamkhoikh.
Okha shaiga zhaina dellacharnai /Mukh'ammad paikhamar/ vevza, shain kIentii shaina ma bovzarra. Bakk'alla a, tsarakh tskh'a toba kh'uldesh ma iu bak'derg, shaina khuush dollushekh'.
Bak'derg du / iza/ kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara. Khilanne a kh'o ma khilalakh' sheko iolush bolcharakh.

KhIoranna a - shen agIo iu, i tsunna tIevo'rzush. Asha sikhoe dikachu g1ullakkhashkakh' kh'alkhe iakkkharekh'. Michchakh'a a shu delakh' a, - Dala shu derrige a tskh'a'na guldiir du /k'ematdiinakh'/. Bakk'alla a, i Dela masso a khIumanna t1ekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.
Michchakh'ara kh'o arava'lcha a, dIaerzae kh'an iu'kh' Dezachu Ma'zhdigan agIor. Bakk'alla a, i bak'derg ma du kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara. Ma vats i Dela asha diirig tidamekh' dotsush.

Michchakh'ara kh'o arava'lcha a, dIaerzae kh'an iu'kh' Dezachu Ma'zhdigan agIor. Sha'sh michchakh'a khilcha a, dIaerzae shain ia'khkh'ash tsu agIor, nakhana shuna tIekh' bekhk billa bakh'ana tsa khiliita, tsarakh zulamkhoi botsucharna, - shu tsarakh ma kkheralash, Sokh kkheralash, - So'ga shuna tIekh' Sain niImat chekkhdakkkhiita - shu niisachu novk'a t1ekh' khila tarlora-kkh.
Okha shuna elcha vaiitarkh terra, shukh shaikh volu, sha du'itsush volu shuna Tkhan aiatash, tso shu tsIandesh, shuna zhaina a, kh'ek'alalla a Iamadesh, shuna tso Iamadesh, shuna tsa khuush khillarg.
Ash So dagavaiita / Suna mu't1akh' khilartsa/ - Asa shu a dagadou'itur du /shuna gechdartsa/, Suna shukar de, Suna inkarlo eshma khila.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash gIo lakha sobartsa a, lamaztsa a. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ma vu sobare bolcha'rtsa.
Ash ma ala Delan novk'akh'boiucharakh "bella". - Diina bu u'sh. - Amma shuna tsa khaalo.
Okha ditanne a tsa zu'ish du'tur dats shu kkheram tasartsa a, matsalla iaiitartsa a, da'khni a, sinosh a, sto'mash a eshiitartsa a, - akh' kkha' bakkkha sobare bolcharna, -
Ishtannash bu u'sh shaina tIe tskh'a bokkkha bala be'cha, olush: "Vai Delan du, Tsu'nga dIado'rzur dolush a du".
Tsarna shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara gechdar a ma du, k'inkhetam a ma bu, u'sh ma bu niisachu novk'a t1ekh' bersh.

Bakk'alla a, Safa a, Marvata Delan dinan bilgalonekh du. Kh'a'zh do'khkuchunna a, Iumratdechunna a k'a dats tsarna go ba'kkkhicha. Laa a luush, /Shena/ dikanig dinachunna - i Dela barkalla olush a, khuush a vu.

Bakk'alla a, Okha iaiitina bilgalonash a, niisa nek' a, Okha sha'sh nakhana Zhainin chokh'bilgal'ia'khnachul tIa'kh'a, kh'uldesh bersh - u'sh ma bu Dala shaina neIalt er dersh a, neIalt oluchara a shaina neIalt er dersh a.

Bats /neIaltan kIel/ sha'sh dechunna tIera /toba dartsa/ iukhabevlla, dika a lella, /sha'sh kh'uldesh khillarg/ bilgala da'kkkhinarsh-m - tseran toba As k'obaldiir du - So toba /dukkha/ k'obaldiirig a vu /Sain leshna/, /Saigakh'/ shortta k'inkhetam berg a vu.
Bakk'alla a, sha'sh /din/ kerstadinarsh, / otsu/ kersta kh'olekh' bellarsh - tsarna khir du Delan a, malikiin a, masso a nekhan a neIalt.
Sha'sh tsu chokh' (tsIergakh') guttar a la'ttash, Iazap daidiir ma dats tsarna, tIa'kh'atottur a ma bats u'sh.
Shun Dela - Sha tskh'a' volu Dela vu. Kkhin Dela vats I ben, sov k'inkhetame a, k'inkhetame a verg vu Iza.

Bakk'alla a, stiglanash a, latta a kkhollarekh' a, bu'isa-de khiitsadalarekh' a, khIorda chokh' nakhana paidanna dIasalelash dolchu kemanekh' a, Dala stiglara okh'adou'ituchu, dellachul tIa'kh'a shetsa latta dendesh a, tsu /la'tta/ tIekh' masso a diinat darzhadesh a dolchu khinekh' /dog1anekh'/ a, mokh kh'ekkharekh' a, sha'sh /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' khilla stiglanna a, la'ttana a iukk'ekh' dIasalelachu markhashkakh' a - bilgalonash ma iu sha'sh oila ian khuuchu nakhana.

Nakhakh bu Allakh1-Dela vitina kkhibersh /delii/ lo'tsush bersh, u'sh Tsu'ntsa nisbesh, shaina u'sh bezash, /mu'manakhana/ Dela vezarkh terra. Tk'a /Delakh/ teshash bersh Dela chIogIa dukkhavezash ma bu. Gush belkh'ara i zulam desh bersh - tsarna gur ma dara Iazap - tsarna khuur ma dara nitsk' berrige a Delan buila a, i Dela Iazap darekh' ch1og1a vuila a.
Shaina nakh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush khilla bersh tsIanlur ma bu shaina tIa'kh'a khIittina khillacharekh, tsarna gur du Iazap, khedar iu tseran iuk'amettigash.

Sha'sh kkhecharnatIa'kh'akhIu'ttush khillachara er du: "Tkhan iukha du'nena do'rziila delakh'ara, tkho a tsIanlur ma dara tsarakh, u'sh tkhokh tsIanbalarkh terra". Ishtta goitur iu Dala tseran Iamalsh tsarna bala khilla. U'sh arabevra ma bats tsIergara.
KhIai nakh! Daa la'ttakh' dolchukh kh'anal derg a, tsIena derg a. Shu ma khIittalash shaitIanan lar t1e - i shuna bilggala mostagI ma du.
Bakk'alla a, tso shuna kh'o'khu vonig a, irchanigdar a, ash Delakh la'tsna shaina tsakhuurg alar a.

Tsa'rga a'lcha: "TIa'kh'akhIitta Dala shaiga dossiinachunna (K'ur'anna)", tsara olu: "KhIan-khIa! Tkho tIa'kh'akhIu'ttur du tkhaina tkheshan dai shena tIekh' kariinachunna>>. - I shain dai tskh'anna khIumanakh kkhetash a, niisachu novk'akh' a khilla batsakh' a? /T1akkkha a kh1u'ttu u'sh tsarna t1a'kh'a??/
Kerstanalla decheran masal du shega mokh' bitticha a, ts1og1a kh'ekkhcha a ben tsa khezachu'nga kkhaikkharan masalakh tera: k'ora, mott tsa khuush, b1a'rze khilla, u'sh kkhetar bats.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Daa Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh tsIena derg, tsu Dalla shukar a de, sha'sh Tsunna Iibadat desh delakh'.

Tso shuna kh'aram iina k'eella khIuma a, tsIii a, kh'akkhin zhizhig a, Dalla dotsush, kkhechunna lerina iiina khIuma a. Nagakh' sanna /i kh'aram iinarg/ tsa ii'cha tsa valakh', /bekhkamna/ du'kh'al a votsush, dozanal t1ekh a tsa volush, tso i /kh'aramnig daarkh/ tsunna k'a dats - bakk'alla, i Dela ma vu gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Bakk'alla a, Dala Sha dossiinachu zhainakh /tskh'aderg nakhakh/ kh'uldesh bersh, tsunakh shaina kIezzig makh o'tsush bersh- u'sh ma bu shain kiirakh' tsIe ben iuur iotsursh. Vistkhir ma vats i Dela tsa'rga /reza khilartsa/ k'ematdiinakh', tsIanbiir ma bats Tso u'sh. Tsarna khir ma du lazosh dolu Iazap.
U'sh ma bu sha'sh niisa nek' bo'khkina tilar etsnarsh, sha'sh gechdar do'khkina Iazap etsnarsh. Ma sobare bu u'sh zho'zhakhatin tsIe la(v)rekh'!?
Iza du Dala i zhaina (Tavrat) dossosh khilarna bak'dolchu'ntsa. Bakk'alla a, tsu zhainitsa tskh'a'na tsa bogIursh (i dokhosh, kharts tu'dush bersh) bu'zzina /bart/ egIarekh' ma bu.

Mela khir bats ash shain ia'khkh'ash malkhbalekh'a a, malkhbuzekh'a a erzaiarekh'. Tk'a mela khir bu i /nakh/ Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a, malikekh a, zhainakh a, paikhamarekh a teshash belakh', shena a dezachu da'khnikh /sagIina/ delcha gergarcharna a, boberashna a, miskachu nakhana a, nek'khochunna a, do'khuchunna a, lai pargIatvakkkharna a, lamaz a tso khIottiicha, zakat a delcha, sha'sh della dosh kkhochush a dicha, iakkkhiichu khalonashkakh' a, balanashkakh' a, tIamekh' a sobare a khilcha. U'sh bu bak'lu'ish bersh. U'sh bu /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shuna tIedillina bai'inchareran chIir ekkhar: ma'rshanig /vu'ir vu/ - /tso/ ma'rshanig /ver/ bakh'anekh', lai /vu'ir vu/ - /tso/ lai /ver/ bakh'ane', zuda /iu'ir iu/ - /tso/ zuda /er/ bakh'anekh'. /Busalba/ vashas tskh'anna gechdicha - dikantsa tsunna tIa'kh'akhIotta veza. Niisa kkhochushdan deza diiat. I shuna Delera attalla iu, k'inkhetam a ma bu. Tsul tIa'kh'adozanakh va'llachunna (ch1ir ekkha g1irtinachunna) khir ma du lazosh dolu Iazap.
Shuna chIir ekkharekh' dakhar du, khIai kh'ek'al dersh, shu khiliitarkh'ama kkho'rush /bekhk botsush stag verakh/.

Shuna tIedillina tskh'anna tIe valar de'cha, nagakh' tsu'nan bukhadu'sush khIuma delakh', tso i niisontsa dena-nanna, gergarcharna dala veset dar- bakk'alla a t1ekh' du i /veset dar Delakh/ kkho'rucharna.
Nagakh' sanna tskh'ammo i /vesetan chulatsam/ shena kheznachul tIa'kh'a khiitsakh' - k'a i khiitsinchunna khir du. I Dela ma vu Sha khezash verg a, khuush verg a.
Nagakh' sanna tskh'a' veset dechu'ngara niiso tsa iarakh ia k'a darakh kkherakh', tso maslakh'at dakh' tsarnaiukk'ekh', tsunnak'a khir dats. I Dela ma vu gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shuna tIedillina markha kkhabar, shul kh'alkharcharna tIedillarkh terra, shu khiliitarkh'ama /Delakh/ kkho'rush.

/I markha kkhobur du/tskh'a k1ezzig denoshkakh'; shukh tskh'a' tsomgush velakh' ia novk'akh' nislakh' - kkhechu khenakh'/markha kkhobur du tso/ disinchu denoin metta. Markha tsakkhabalucharna tIekh' du miskachu stagana daar dalar. Dikanig tso sovda'kkkhicha (shen daggara sagIa sovlush) - i tsunna dika du. Ash markha kkha'bcha - shuna dika du, shu khuush khillekh'.

/I markha kkhaba deza denosh/ Ramazan butt bu, shena chokh' nakhana niisa nek' a bolu, niisachu nek'an a, /bak'derg-khartsderg, kh'anal-kh'aram/ k'astoran a bilgalonash a iolu K'ur'an dossiina bolu. Shukh i /ramazan butt/ lerincho markha kkhobiila. Tskh'a' tsomgush velakh', ia novk'akh' velakh' - kkhechu denoikh tskh'a dak'a /kkhochushder tso/. I Dela luush vu shuna atto khilar, luush vats I shuna khalo khilar. Kkhochushder ash i denosh /markhanash kkhobush/, vazver ash i Dela /AllakhIu akbar alartsa/, Tso sha'sh niisachu novk'a nisdarna, shu khilakh'ara barkalla olush.

San lesha kh'o'ga khattakh' Sokh la'tsna - So gergakh' vu, zhop lush vu do'khuchu'nan dekharna - tso dekhcha. Suna zhop loila tsara (Suna mu't1akh' khilartsa), Sokh teshiila u'sh - u'sh khila tam bara niisachu novk'akh'.

Magosh du shuna markhiin battakh' busa shain zudarshna gergadakhar - u'sh shun dukhar du, shu - tseran dukhar du. Dalla khiira shu khilla khilar sha'sh shain Iekhadesh. Shun toba k'obaldira Tso, shuna gechdira. KhIintsa /busa/ gergag1o shaina tsarna, lakha Dala shaina iazdinarg. Daa, mala shaina satasaran kIain tai Ia'rzhachu taikh k'astadallalts. TIakkkha kkhochushde markha kkhabar bu'isa t1eiallalts. Gerga ma g1o tsarna (zudarshna) sha'sh ma'zhdigash chokh' la'ttash dolush /iItikaf desh/. U'sh Delan dozanash du. Gerga ma gIo tsarna (dozanashna - u'sh dokho). Ishtta bilgaldokhu Dala shen aiatash nakhana, u'sh khiliitarkh'ama larlush /Delan dozanekh/.
Ash ma daa vovshiin da'khni khartsontsakh'a'kamashtsa berta a dakhana, k'a dartsa nekhan da'khni daarkh'ama, shaina khu'ushekh' /i shain dotsiila/.

Kh'o'ga /khIai Mukh'ammad/ kho'ttu tsara bettan ku'tsash khiitsadalarakh la'tsna, akh' ala: "Iza nakhana khan bilgal'iakkkharkh'ama a, kh'a'zhdekhkarna a du". Mela khir bats shu kh1usamash chu tIekh'akhula dakharkh. Mela bu /shu Delakh/ kkho'rush khilar. Kh1usamash chu g1o neIarshkakhula! Delakh kkhera - shu dakkkhiider du.
TIom be Delan novk'akh' shaitsa tIom besh bolcha'rtsa, amma dozanal sov ma dovla. Dalla tsa beza dozanal sov bu'ilursh.

Baia u'sh shaina karaba'khkkinchokh', arabakha u'sh sha'sh arada'khnachu'ra. PitanachIogIa du stag veral a. TIom ma be tsa'rtsa Deza Ma'zhdigana ullokh', tsara shaitsa t1om tsa bakh'. Tsara shaitsa bakh' /tIom/ - baia u'sh! Ishtta bu tsateshacharna bekkham.
U'sh sovtsakh'- Dela gechdesh a, k'inkhetame a vu.
TIom be tsa'rtsa pitanasatstsalts, din / desh dolu 1ibadat dekk'a tskh'ana Dalla khillalts/. U'sh sovtsakh'/t1om bechu'ra/ - tIelatarma de zulam decharna ben.

Lerame butt - lerame battatsa, kh'urmatash a - ch1ir etsa dezash du. Shaina tskh'a' tIelatakh' - shu a tIelata tsunna, i shaina tIe ma letta. Delakh kkhera, shuna khaa i Dela Shekh kkho'rucha'rtsa vuila.
Kharzhash e Delan novk'akh'. Shain ku'igashtsa sha'sh khIallak ma de. Dikanig de. Dalla dukkhabeza dikanig desh bersh.

Kkhochushde kh'a'zhdekhkar a, Iumrata Dela du'kh'a. Shun a'tto bo'khnekh' /tskh'ana kh1umano novk'arlo iina/, shain nitsk' kkhochu bezhanade sagIiina. Shain kortosh ma dasha i sagIina diina bezhana shen mettige dIakkhachchalts. Shukh tskh'a' tsomgush velakh' ia ko'rtan tsamgar iolush velakh'- /korta boshur bats, amma/ tsunna du'kh'al markha kkhobur du /kkhaa diinakh'/, sagIa lur du /ialkh miskachu stagana, tskh'anna akh sakh' lush/, ia u'stagI bu'ir bu. Shu kkheramakh pargIatdevlacha, shukh tskh'ammo Iumrat kh'alkhadakkkhakh' kh'a'zhdekhkaral - shena nitsk' kkhochu bolu bezhanna urs kh'akkha sagIiina. I tsa karadakh' - markha kkhobur du kkhaa diinakh' kh'a'zhdo'khkuchu khenakh', vorkhI diinakh' - tsIa iukhavirzicha. U'sh kkhochchush itt de du. I du shen nakh Deza Ma'zhdigana gonakh' botscharna. Shu kkhera Delakh, shuna khaa i Dela taIzar darekh' chIogIa vuila.

Kh'a'zhdekhkaran bilgalda'khna bettanashdu. Tsu khenakh'kh'a'zh- dikhkinchunna - zudchu'ntsa /gergara/ iuk'amettig khilar a, Iesalla a, k'iisar a tsa mega kh'a'zhdekhkarekh'. Ash mu'lkhkha a dina dika Sha khuush ma vu i Dela. Shaitsa sursatash etsa nek'ana (kh'a'zhdekhka do'lkhush). Tk'a uggar dika sursat - Delakh kkherar du. Sokh kkhera, khIai kh'ek'al dersh.

Shuna k'a dats, ash shain Delera dikanashlekhcha. Sha'sh Iarafateraokh'ada'khkicha, Dela kh'akhavesiidolchu mashIarekh'. Kh'akhave I /dika/, Tso shu /niisachu novk'a/ nisdare terra, shu khillekh' a tsul kh'alkha tillabelllacharekh.
TIakkkha lela nakh lelachukhula, Dele gechdar a dekha. I Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

Sha'sh kh'a'zhdekhkar kkhochushdina devlcha, kh'ekhave i Dela, sha'sh shain dai kh'ekhabarakh terra, ia kkhin a chIogIa. Nakhakh ma bu olursh: "KhIai tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, lo tkhuna du'nenakh'" /dikanash/ - ma dats tsarna ekhartakh' dak'a.
Tsarakh bu olursh a: "KhIai tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Akh' tkhuna lolakh' du'nenakh' a dikanash, ekhartakh' a dikanash, Akh' tkho lardelakh' tsIeran Iazapakh".
Tsarna ma du dak'a shaina karadinchukh. I Dela ma vu kh'esap darekh' sikhanig.

Dela kh'ekhave masiitta diinakh'. Shina diinakh' /ba'rzanashna t1e tIulgash kkhissina dIavakha/ sikhvellachunna k'a dats, (kkhoalgIachu denna) tIa'kh'avisinchunna a k'a dats - k'a dats /Delakh/ kkho'rush volchunna. Delakh kkheralash, shuna khaalash sha'sh Tsunna tIe dIaguldiir duila.
Admashna iukk'ekh' ishttanig a vu, sha du'nenan dakharekh' shen k'amelatsa kh'o tsetsvokkkhush verg, dag chokh' dolchunna Dela tesh khIottosh - i ma vu lu'ra mostagI.
/Kh'okh/ dIa ma k'a'sttinekh', sikhlo iza (munepik') la'tta tIekh' pasadkhIumanash dan, khIallakdo tso okhana a, da'khni a,- Dalla tsa deza pasad khIuma.
Shega a'lcha: "Kkhera Delakh!" -kurallo skh'alotsu iza k'a latortsa. Tsunna kkhacho iiir iu zho'zhakhatino, -ma von iu-kkh /i sannacharna/ nisiina mettig.
Nakhakh ishttanig a ma vu, Dela reza khilar lo'khush shen sa dukhkush verg. Dela ma vu k'akhetash /Shen/ lekh.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! ChugIo islamna kkhochchush. Shu ma khIitta shaitIanan larashna tIa'kh'a - i shuna bilggala mostagI ma du.
Shaiga khIara bilgalonash kkha'chnachul tIa'kh'a shu galdovlakh'- shuna khaalash: i Dela veza vu /bekkham barekh'/, kh'ek'ale vu /gIullakkhash dIadakh'arekh'/.

U'sh /islam din tIe tsa lotsursh/ kh'o'zhush bu-tekh'a Dela shaiga vare markhashna iukk'ekhula, ishtta malikash a /shaiga dakhkare Iazap dokh'ush/, tIakkkha /Iazapan/ gIullakkh kkhochushkhilare? Dele dIado'rzush ma du gIullakkhash.
Akh' khatta Israilan kIentashka, mel dakhkiitina Okha tsa'rga bilgala dolu delilash. Delan niImat khu'itsuchunna, shega i de'nachul tIa'kh'a - i Dela ma vu taIzar darekh' chIogIa verg.
Tsateshacharna khazdina du'nenan dakhar, u'sh bo'lush bu teshacharekh. Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rursh tsarna tIekh'khir bu k'ematdiinakh'. Dala ritsk' ma lo Shena luuchunna kh'esap a dotsush.

Nakh khilla tskh'ana ummatekh', tIakkkha /u'sh tilarchu bakhcha/ Dala bakhkiitira, sha'sh kkha' bokkkhush khilla bolu, kkheram tosush khilla bolu paikhamarsh, tsa'rtsa dossiira bak'dolchu'ntsa zhaina, tsa'rga nakhana iukk'ekh' kh'ukam daita tseran khilpalokhillachokh'. Tsu chokh' khilpalo-m tsa khili i /Delan zhaina/ shaiga dellacheran ben, shaiga bilgalonash kkha'chnachul tIa'kh'a vovshashna iukk'ekh' kh'agI khilarna. Dala Shen purbantsa nisbira iiman dillinarsh (zhainan okh1la) bersh shetsa khilpalonekh' khillachu bak'dolchunna tIe. I Dela ma vu nisvesh Shena luurg niisachu novk'a.

Shuna mo'ttu sha'sh ialsamane gIur du/khIai busalbanash/ shul kh'alkha bakhancharna (busalbanashna) tIede'narg shaina t1e a tsa dog1ush? Letsna khilla u'sh balanasha a, tsamgarsha a, degnash Iiizhira tseran, elchano a, tsu'ntsa tskh'ana iiman dillinchara a olush: "Matsa khir du Delera gIo?" - Kh1a'! Bakk'alla a, Delera gIo gerga ma du!

Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu: "KhIun lur iu sagIina?" Akh' ala: "Ash sagIina dokkkhush dolu dika kh1uma - /dakkkha/ dena-nanna a, gergarcharna a, boberashna a, miskachu nakhana a, nek'akhochunna a. Ash desh dolu dika Dela khuush vu".

Shuna tIedillina tIom bar. Iza shuna tsa deza khIuma du. Shuna tsa deza tarlo tskh'a khIuma, i shuna dika a dolush. Shuna deza tarlo tskh'a khIuma, i shuna von a dolush. I Dela khuush vu, shu khuush dats.

Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu bezachu battakh la'tsna, tsu chokh' tIom barkh. Akh' ala: "Tsu chokh' tIom bar - dokkkha k'a du. Tk'a Delan nek'akh /nakh/ dukhatokhar a, Tsunakh tsateshar a, Deza Ma'zhdigakh/nakh dukhtokhar/ a, tsu'nan nakh tsu chu'ra arabakhar kkhin dokkkha du Dalla gergakh'". Pitanadokkkha du tIom baral a. U'sh (kerstanash) sovtsur bats tIom bechu'ra shu shain dinakh dIaderziicha ben, shain nitsk' kkhachakh'. Shukh shen dinakh dIavirzina kersta kh'olekh' vellarg - u'sh bu shain Iamalsh iainarsh du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a. U'sh bu zho'zhakhatin dai, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bu.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, khIizhardinarsh a, Delan novk'akh' k'iisam lattiinarsha - u'sh dogdokhur dolush bu Delan k'inkhetame. I Dela ma vu gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu chagIarkh a, maisirkha la'tsna, akh' ala: "Tsarna chokh' dokkkha k'a a du, nakhana paidanash a bu. Tsarna chokh' dolu k'a dokkkha du tsarna chokh' bolchu paidanal". Iukha a kho'ttu tsara kh'o'ga: "KhIun dokkkhur du sha'sh sagIina?" Akh' ala: "Sovda'llarg". Ishtta Dala bilgaliokhu shuna bilgalonash, shu khiliitarkh'ama oila esh

Du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a /dolchu gIullakkhekh/. Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu boberekh la'tsna. Akh' ala: "Maslakh'at dardika du tsarna". Ash u'sh vovshakhto'khcha- u'sh shun vezharii bu. I Dela khuush ma vu khartso iiirig a, niiso iiirig a. Dalla li'nekh'ara, Tso khalo iiir iara shuna. Bakk'alla a, Dela ma vu veza verg a, kh'ek'ale verg a.

Ash ma balabe Delatsa nak'ost lu'itsu zudariitsara iiman dillalts. Teshash iolu lai to'lush iu Delatsa nak'ost lotsuchu zudchul, tso (Delatsa nak'ost lotsush iolcho) shu'ga tamasha baitakh' a. Delatsa nak'ost lo'tsuchu bozharshka a ma bakhiita /busalba/ zudarii tsara iiman dillalts. Teshash volu lai to'lush vu Delatsa nak'ost lotsuchu stagal, tso shu'ga tamasha baitakh' a. Tsara kkhoikkhu zho'zhakhate, Dala kkhoikkhu ialsamane a, Shen laamtsa gechdare a. Tso bilgaliokhu Shen bilgalonash nakhana, u'sh khiliitarkh'ama oila esh.

Kh'o'ga kho'ttu tsara zudariin tsIano iokharkh, akh' ala: "Iza bala kh'egar du". TsIano io'khnachu khenakh' zudarekh dIak'asta, tsarna gerga ma gIo, u'sh tsIanballalts. U'sh tsIanbelcha, gIuo tsarna ullo, Dala shaina ma kh'ekhkhara. Bakk'alla a, tsu Dalla ma beza toba dinarsh, Tsunna ma beza tsIena bersh.

Shun zudarii - shun /okhanan/ aresanna bu /shuna/. Shain /okhanan/ arenga g1o shaina ma lu'u. /Dikanig/ kh'alkha dakkkha shaina. Delakh kkhera, shuna khaa, shu Tsunna du'kh'alkkhetarg khilar. Akh' kkha' bakkkha iiman dillincharna.
I Dela shain duiniin Ialasho ma khiliita dikanig tsa dan a, /Delakh/ tsa kkhera a /vonig desh/, nakhana iukk'ekh' maslakh'at tsa dan a. I Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.

Dala bekhke tsa lotsu shu da'ssa duinekh, shun dagakh' dotsushi khillekh', amma Tso bekhke lotsu shu shun degnasha dinchunna. I Dela gechdesh a, sobare a ma vu /Shen leshna k'inosh ma dinnekh' 1azap tsa desh, tsarna toba dan (dokhko dovla) khan lush/.
Shain zudarshna gerga gIur dats a'lla dui biincharna tIekh' du bea battakh' larvalar. TIakkkha u'sh dokhkobovlakh'- i Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Nagakh' sanna zudarii bita satsam tseran khilakh' - i Dela khezash a, khuush a vu.

Bitina bolu zudarii kh'ovsur bukkhuzza <<k'ir'>>chekkh'ialare. Megash dats tsarna shain kiirakh' Dala kkho'llinargkh'uldan, sha'sh Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a teshash belakh'. Tseran maroin bak'o iu u'sh iukhaberzo tsu chokh', u'sh luush belakh' maslakh'at dan, tseran (zudariin) bak'onekh terra dekkharsh a du dikantsa iuk'amettig lelaiartsa.. Maroi darzhekh' tsaral lakkhara bu. I Dela sha veza verg a, kh'ek'ale verg a vu.

K'astar shozza du, tsul tIa'kh'a - niisontsa iukhaerzor iu /zuda/, ia dikantsa dIaiokhu'itur iu. Shuna kh'anal dats ash dIadellachukh khIumma iukhaetsa. Megar du u'shkkho'rush khilakh' Delan dozanash tsa lardarna. Shu kkho'rush delakh' tsara shimmo a Delan dozanash tsa lardarna, tsarna shinna a k'a dats zuda mekhakh pargIat ia'lcha. U'sh du Delan dozanash, u'sh dokha ma delash. Delan dozanash dokhosh bersh - u'sh zulam desh bersh bu.

Nagakh' sanna zuda iitakh' /kkhuzza/, tsul tIa'kh'a tsunna i kh'anal iats, kkhechu'nga i mare iodakh' ben. TIakkkha tso (i sholg1a iakhancho) i iiticha, tsu shinnaa k'a dats sha'sh tskh'anakkhetcha, shaina Delan dozanash larlur du a'lla khetakh'. U'sh du Delan dozanash, Tso bilgaldesh dolu khuush dolchu k'omana.

Ash zudarii /tsk'a ia shozza/ bitina bolush, tseran khantIekkha'chcha - sovtsabe u'sh dikachu ag1ontsa, ia dIabakhiita u'sh dikachu ag1ontsa. Ash ma sovtsabe u'sh zulamtsa - tIakkkha ash dozanash talkhor du. I decho shena zulam do. Delan aiatash zabare ma lera. Ash dagadaiita shaina khilla dolu Delan niImat a, Tso shetsa shuna kh'ekham besh dolu Sha shu'ga dossiina dolu Zhaina a, /shuna della dolu/ kh'ek'alalla a. Shu Delakh kkhera, shuna khaalash i Dela masso a khIuma khuush vuila.

Ash zudarii bitina, tseran khan gergakkha'chcha, ashnovk'arlo ma elash tsarna shain maroshka iukhaberzan, u'sh vovshashna reza khillekh' dikachu ag1ontsa. I kh'ekham besh bu shuna, shukh Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a teshash volchunna. Iza kh'ek'ale a du shuna, tsIena a du. I Dela khuush vu, shu khuush dats.

Nanosha dakkhadoila shain berash du'zzina shina sharakh' i dakkhadar kkhochushdan luush volchunna (marana). Shena ber dinchunnatIekh' du - zudarshnadaa khIuma a, tIedukha khIuma lattor niisontsa. Tskh'anna adamna tIedu'llush dats shen nitsk' tsa kkhochurg. Nanna zen ma doila shen ber bakh'anekh', shena ber dinchunna (beran dena) a zen ma doila shen ber bakh'anekh'. /Den/ irs o'tsuchunna - tsu'nga terra (da vellekh', tsu bero tsu'ngara etsnachu irsana iukk'era vakkhochunna makh loila beran veraso). Tsarna shinna alaakh' dakkhor iuk'akhdakkkha vovshiin reza khilartsa a, dagabovlartsa a - k'a dats tsarna. Shuna laakh' shain berash dakkho kkhin zuda lakha, shuna k'a dats ash tsunna makh belcha daggara. Shu Delakh kkheralash, shuna khaalash i Dela ash diirig gush vuila.

Shukh dIakkhelkhina shail bukha zudarii bitinarsh - tseran zudarii kh'ovsur bubea battakh' a, itt diinakh' a. I khan tIekkha'chcha, shunak'a dats tsara shaikh dinarg bakh'anekh' dikantsa. I Dela ash diirig dika khuush vu.

K'a dats shuna /khIai bozharii/ ash shain zakhalo tsu zudarshka dIakh'edicha a, ia k'ailada'kkkhina shaigakh' diticha a. Dalla kha'a, bakk'alla a, shuna u'sh (zudarii) dagabogIur buila. Mukhkha delakh' a, vaIdama e tsarna k'ailakha, niisa dosh olush ben. I ialor chIagI ma de iazdinargshen khanna tIekkhachchalts. Shuna khaalash, i Dela khuush vuila shun dagakh' derg. Tsunakh larloila shu. Shuna khaalash, i Dela gechdesh a, sobare (k'a dicha, ta1zar dar t1a'kh'atottush) a vuila.

K'a dats shuna ash zudarii biticha /tsa'rtsa makhkh'akhiinachul tIa'kh'a/ sha'sh tsarna gergadakhanaa dotsush, ia urdon makh khadiina dIabella a botsush. /Ishttachu kh'olekh' i zudarii bitincho/ luo tsarna shaina paidenna tskh'atstsa khIuma: kh'al dolcho - shen tarone kh'a'zhzhina, kh'al dotscho - shen tarone kh'a'zhzhina, gIillakkhtsapaidenna khIuma. Iza kh'ak' du khIor shen Iamal dika khiliita luuchu stagana tIekh'.

Ash u'sh (zudarii) bitakh', shain tsa'rtsa gergaradakhar a khilla dotsu, tk'a shaina urdon makh khadiina bolu - sha'sh khadiinachul akh urdon makh lur bu ash tsarna. Lur bats, nagakh' tsara (zudarsha), ia zuda ialor-iitar shain karakh' dolchara /tsa bo'khush/ bitakh'. Ash makh tsa o'tsush bitar (urdokh khIumma iukha tsadakkkhar) gerga du /Delakh/ kkho'rush khilarna. Ash dits ma de vovshii iukk'ekh' dolu dozalla. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ash diirig gush vu.
Larde lamazash a, iukk'eralamaz a, dIakhIitta Dalla mu'tIakh' khilla.

Shaina kkheram khilakh' - lamazash de sha'sh /kogasht1akh'/ gIash do'lkhushshekh' ia /tskh'ana kh1umanna t1e/khevshina do'lkhushshekh'. Sha'sh kkheramakh kh'alkhadevlcha, Dela kh'ekhavelash, Tso shaina Iamadesh ma-khillara shuna tsa khuush khillarg.

Shukh dIakkhelkhinchara shail bukha zudarii a bitina, shain zudarshna veset dina tsarna o'shush dolu kh1uma du'tiila tskh'a sho duzzalts. U'sh arabovlakh', shuna k'a dats tsara shailakh' dinchunna dikantsa. I Dela veza verg a, kh'ek'ale verg a vu.
Bitinchu zudarshna sovg1atlur du khazachu g1illakkhekh', Delakh kkho'rucharna i dalar kh'ak' dolush.
Ishtta bilgaldokhu Dala shuna Shen aiatash shu kh'ek'ale khiliitarkh'ama.

Kh'una tsa kha'a /khIai Mukh'ammad/ balarkh kkherabella shain tsIenoshkara bevdda arabevlachu ezarnashnakhillarg? Dala tsa'rga elira: "Le shu!" /U'sh belira/, tIakkkha Tso u'sh denbira. Bakk'alla a, i Dela k'inkhetam bolush ma vu nakhakh, amma dukkhakhbolchu nakha barkalla tsa olu.
K'iisam lattabe Delan novk'akh'. Shuna khaa, i Dela sha khezash verg a, khuush verg a vuila.
Dalla khaza dekkhar dellargmilla velakh' a, Tso masiittaza alsamdokkkhur du tsunna i. I Dela sha ritsk' dIak'ovlush verg a vu, dIakho'tsush verg a vu, Tsu'nga shu dIaderzor dolush a du.

Kh'o'ga tsa kkha'chna Israilan kIentekh /tskh'ana/ elasha Musal tIa'kh'a shain paikhamare a'llarg? "Vaiita tkhuna pachchakh', okha Delan novk'akh' tIom biir bu"-ma elira tsara. Tso elira: "Shu khila tarlo-te, shaina tIe tIom bar dillicha, i tsa ban dokhkush?" Tsara elira: "Okha khIunda tsa bo Delan novk'akh' tIom, tkho tkheshan tsIenoshkara a, tkheshan do'zalekh a arada'khna khilcha?" Tsarna tIom bar tIedillicha, iukhabevlira u'sh, tsarakh tskh'a kIezzig bersh botsursh. I Dela bevzash ma vu zulam desh bersh.

Tseran paikhamara tsa'rga elira: "Dala vaiitina shuna TIalut, pachchakh' khilla". Tsara elira: "Tso kh1unda dan deza tkhuna tIekh' pachchakh'alla? Tkho kh'ak' du tsul pachchakh'alla dan. Shortta da'khni a tsa della tsunna". Tso elira: "Dala i kha'rzhina shuna tIekh', Tso i sovva'kkkhina Iilmanekh' a, degIekh' a. Dala pachchakh'alla lush du Shena luuchunna. I Dela /Shen k'inkhetamtsa masso a/ chulotsush vu, Sha khuush a vu /i k'inkhetam kh'anakh ban beza/".

Tseran paikhamara tsa'rga elira: "Tsu'ngakh' pachchakh'alla khilaran bilgalo iu shuna tIorkaz dartsa, shena chokh' shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara sakinatdolush, Musan a, KhIarunan a do'zalo bukhaiitina tskh'atstsa khIumanash iolush- malikasha dakh'ar du iza". Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du shuna, shu mu'manakh khillekh'.

TIalut shen eskartsa arava'lcha, tso elira: "Dala shu zu'ir dolush du khitsa: tsunakh khi mellarg sokh vats (san eskartsa gIazote gIur vats). Tsunakh cham tsa ba'kkkhinarg, shen ku'iga etsna tskh'a kana dotsurg, i sokh vu (i gIur vu gIazote)". Tsara tsunakh khi melira, tskh'a kIezzig bersh botsuchara. Iza (TIalut) a, tsu'ntsa /Delakh/ teshash khillarsh a dIabakhcha, tsara elira: "Vain nitsk' kkhochur bats takhana Dzhalutanaa, tsu'nan eskarna a tIekh'". Sha'sh Dalla du'kh'alkkhetarg khilarkh teshnabolchara elira: "Mosazza zhimachu tobano iokkkha toba eshiina Delan laamtsa. Bakk'alla a, Dela ma vu sobare bolcha'rtsa".

Dzhalutana a, tsu'nan eskarna a u'shguchubevlcha, tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobush verg! Akh' sobar lolakh' tkhuna, chIagIbelakh' tkhan kogash, gIo delakh' tkhuna tsa teshash dolchu k'omana tIekh' tolam bakkkha".

Delan laamtsa tsara u'sheshiira. Davuda viira Dzhalut. Dala tsunna pachchakh'alla a, kh'ek'alalla a delira, Iamiira tsunna Shena luurg. Dala nakh tskh'abersh vovshashtsa larbesh batsakh'ara, latta galderadara (kerstanash tolartsa, busalbanash baiartsa, ma'zhdigash dokhortsa), delakh' a, i Dela vu koma'rshallin da derrige a Ialamashna t1ekh'.
U'sh Delan aiatash du, Okha kh'una do'shush bak'ontsa. Bakk'alla a, kh'o ma vu /Dala/ bakhkiitincharekh.

U'sh bu elchanash. Okha tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharal bazbina. Tsarakh vu Dala shetsa k'amel dinarg a, Tso aibina tsarakh tskh'abersh darzhashkakh'. Okha elira Mar'iaman kIante Iiisaga a bilgalonash, chIagI a vira Okha i siidolchu sitsa. Dalla li'na khillekh'ara, tIom biir batsara tsaral (elchanel) tIa'kh'a khillacharashaiga bilgalonash dIakkha'chnachul tIa'kh'a. Delakh' a, tskh'a bart tsa khilla tseran - tsarakh bu tesharsh a, tsarakh bu tsatesharsh a. Dalla li'na khillekh'ara, tIom biir batsara tsara, amma Dala do Shena lu'urg.

KhIai iman dillinarsh! Kharzhash e /Delan novk'akh'/ Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh, shena chokh' iokhka-etsar a, dottagIalla a, shapaIat a khir dotsu detIekkhachale. Tsatesharsh - u'sh bu-kkh zulamkhoi.

AllakhI (Shen ts1e iolu tskh'a Dela) vu - kkhin Dela vats I votsurg, diina vu I, Sha dIakhIo'ttina vu, nab ozor a nab iar a dotsush. Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' derg a, la'ttakh' derg a. Tskh'a a ma vats Tsunna gergakh' shapaIat diir dolush, Tsu'nan laamtsa ben. Tsaral kh'alkha khillarg khuush vu I, tIa'kh'a khinderg a /khuush/ vu. Tsu'nan Iilmanan khIumanna a tIekkhu'ur ma bats u'sh, Tsunna luuchul ben. Shu'ira khilla Tsu'nan kursiistiglanash a, latta a chu lotsush. U'sh Ialash'iarekh' khIumma a khalo tsa khu'lu Tsunna, I lekkha verg a, siilakh' - veza verg a vu.

Nitsk' biir bats dinekh'; niisa nek' k'astabella kharts nek'akh. TIagIutakhtsa teshash, Delakh teshnarg - i la'ttash vu sha khedar iotschu chIogIachu u'iratsa. I Dela sha khezash verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.

Dela vu teshash bolcheran vali. Tso u'sh arabokhu bodanera serlonga. Tsa teshash bersh - tseran avliiaash tIagIutash du, tsara bokhu u'sh serlongara bodane. u'sh ma bu tsIeran dai, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar a la'ttar ma bu.

Kh'una khaii IbrakhIimtsa i Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh la'tsna k'u'isush khillachukh, Dala shena pachchakh'alla della khillachu? IbrakhIima a'llera: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu Sha dendesh a, dolu'itush a verg". Tso (Namruz pachchakh'a) elira: "As den a do, dala a dolu'itu". IbrakhIima elira: "Dala malkh bou'itu malkhbalekh'akhula, akh' baiital i malkhbuzekh'akhula". TIakkkha vu'ikhira tsatesharg. Dala nis tsa do zulame dolu k'am.

Ia /kha'ii kh'una/ tskh'ana evlana ullokhula vo'duchukh khillarg, tkhevnash t1e a khirtsina, iokhiina khillachu? Tso elira: "Mukha deniiir iu khIara Dala ellachul tIa'kh'a!?" Dala i valiitira bIesharna, tIakkkha denvira. Elira /Dala/: "Mel la'ttira kh'o?" Tso elira: "So la'ttira /vella/ tskh'ana diinakh' ia ekha diinakh'". Tso (Dala) elira: "KhIan-khIa, kh'o la'ttira bIesharakh', kh'o kh'azhal kh'ain kkhachane a, malare a - khiitsa tsa della u'sh, kh'o kh'azhal kh'ain vire, Okha tskh'a delil khu'lu'itur du kh'okh nakhana. Kh'azhal khIintsa da'Iakhkashka, Okha u'sh mukha denio, tIakkkha tsarna tIe dilkha du'llu". I shena bilgalda'llachul tIa'kh'a, tso elira: "Suna kha'a Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush vuila".

IbrakhIima a'llera: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, gaitakh' suna, Akh' mukha denbo bellarsh". Tso (Dala) elira: "Kh'o tsa tesha tk'a?" Elira /IbrakhIima/: "Tesha, delakh' a, dog chIagIdaliitarkh'ama". /Dala/ elira: "KhIeta, skh'aetsa di' kh'oza, kh'aina tIedaladai, dak'osh de tsarakh. TIakkkha khIor lamanna tIe tskh'atstsa dak'a dilla tsarakh, tIakkkha u'sh tIekkhaikkha kh'aina - sikhkha tIedogIur du kh'una u'sh, kh'o khuush khilalakh' i Dela Sha veza verg a, kh'ek'ale verg a vuila".

Shen dolakh'derg Delan novk'akh' da'kkkhinchun masal du, bu'rtigan masalkh tera: tso skh'abaliitina vorkhI kan, khIor kena chokh' bIe bu'rtig bolush. Tsu Dala alsam ma dokkkhu Shena luuchunna, i Dela shorto iolush verg a, khuush verg a ma vu.

Shain dolakh'derg Delan novk'akh' dokkkhush bersh, tIakkkha sha'sh da'kkkhinchunna tIa'kh'a tIekhdettarsh a, bekhkash a tsa dokhush, tsarna shain mela ma bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh'. Kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats.
Khaza dosh a, gechdar a to'lush du shena tIa'kh'a bekhk bokkkhush dolchu sagIanal, i Dela kh'al dolush a, sobarea ma vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! KhIallak ma de shain sagIanash tIekhdettarshtsii, bekhkashtsii, sha Delakh a, t1a'khkh'archu /k'emat/diinakh a teshash a votsush, shen dolakh'derg nakhana gaitarkh'ama /sag1ina/ dokkkhuchukh tera. Tsu'nan masal du shena tIekh' latta dolchu sherachu tIulgakh tera: shena tIe chIogIa dogIa dilkhicha - i bisira sherra /shena tIera latta dIada'lla/. Nitsk' kkhochur bats tsarna sha'sh guldinchukh /tskh'a a/ khIumanakh /paidaetsa/. Dala nis tsa do tsa teshash dolu k'am.

Dela reza khilare dogdokhush, /iimana tIekh'/ sha'sh chIagIdalarkh'ama shain dolakh'derg /sagIina/ dokkkhucheran masal tera du basakh' iolchu beshakh: shena tIe chIogIa dogIa dilkhicha, sto'mash dukkkha alsambu'ilush. ChIogIa dogIa tsa dagIakh' a, dogIa sersash, /tsunakh a toam khu'lush/. I Dela tsara lelorig gush ma vu.

Shuna tskh'anna a luur darii shen khurmaniin a, kemsiin a besh khila, shena bukhakhula khish a lelash, masso a stom shena chokh' a bolush, tIakkkha shen kegii do'zal a bolush i vokkkha khilcha, chokh' tsIe iolu chIogIa mokh ba'lla, tso i iagaian? Ishtta bilgaldokhu Dala shuna aiatash, shu khiliitarkh'ama oila esh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! SagIina lo, shaina karadeanachu tsIenchukh, Okha shaina la'ttakh skh'adaliitinchukh a. Ash sagIa dokkkhush shun Ialasho ma khu'liila bo'khanig, asha a o'tsur ma iatsara i /shaina elcha/ bIa'rgash kh'abbiina ben. Shuna khaalash, i Dela vuila kh'al dolush a /Shena shun sag1anash tsa o'shush /, khastame a /dika 1amal iinchunna khaza ial lush/.
ShaitIano kkheramash tu'isu shuna k'o'lallitsa, kh'o'khu shuna irchanig. Dala vaIda io shuna Shegara gechdar a, koma'rshalla a. I Dela /Shegakh'/ shorto iolush a vu, khuush a vu.
Shena luuchunna kh'ek'alalla lush vu I, (Tso) shena kh'ek'alalla dellarg - shena dukkkha a dikanash dellarg vu-kkh. Otsunakh oila-m tsa io khek'aldolchara a ben.
Ash khIuma sagIiina elcha, ia mu'lkha nuzardicha - bakk'alla a, Dela i dika khuush ma vu. Ma khir bats zulamkhoshna gIo'nchii.
Ash sagIanash /nakhana/ gush dakhakh' - dika du iza. Ash u'sh k'ailakha dakhakh', pek'arshna lakh' - i du shuna to'lush derg, tsodoiur du shuna shun vonash. I Dela ash diirig dika khuush ma vu.

Kh'una tIekh' dats u'sh niisachu novk'akh' khilar, amma Dala nisvo Shena luurg. Ash sag1iina mel da'kkkhinarg- shuna shaina du. Ash tsa dokkkhu i Delan iu'kh'e satu'isusha ben. Ash mel da'kkkhinchu sag1inia bekkham khir bu shuna, zulam diir dats shuna.

Pek'arashna /lo sagIanash/, sha'sh Delan novk'akh' /shain ch1ag1onasha/ sovtsiina bolchu, tsa kkhu'u u'sh la'ttakhula kkhersta. Tsakhuuchunna mo'ttu u'sh kh'al dolush bu, u'sh /sagIa/ tsa do'khush bolu dela. Kh'una bevzar bu u'sh shain Ialamatashtsa, tIekhIo'ttina /sagIa/ tsa do'khu tsara nakhe. Mu'lkhkha a dikanig ash /sagIinia/ da'kkkhicha - bakk'alla a, Dela i dika khuush ma vu shuna.

Sha'sh shain dolakh'derg /sagIiina/ dokkkhush bersh busa a, diinakh' a, k'ailakha a, gush a - tsarna shain mela khir bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh', tsarna kkheram a khir ma bats, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats.

Sha'sh ribaduush bersh gIovtur ma bats sha shaitIano 1a'vdinarg gIottush sanna a ben. Iza du tsara alarna: "Iokhka-etsar ribakh tera du". Iokhka-etsar kh'anal dina Dala, riba kh'aram dina. Shega shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara kh'ekham a be'na, setsnarg- tsunna kh'alkha d1adakhnargdu, tsu'nan gIullakkh Dele dIado'rzu. Iukha a tsunnatIevirzinarg - u'sh tsIeran dai bu, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttar bu.
DIadoiu Dala riba, kkhiado sagIanash. Tsu Dalla tsa veza masso a t1ekh tsatesharg a, k'inosh diirig a.

Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh, /t1akkkha/ dika Iamalsh iinarsh, lamaz khIottadesh bersh, zakat lush bersh - tsarna mela bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh', kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Kkhera Delakh, dita sha'sh /iukhalurg dellachunna/ t1e dokkkhu riba, sha'sh /Delakh/ teshash khillekh'.

I ash tsa dakh' - Delera a, Tsu'nan elchanera a tIom kkhaikkhabe. Ash toba dakh'- shuna shain dolakh'dolchun ko'rtekh' khillarg du: ash zulam diir dats /riba do'khush/ - shuna a zulam diir dats /ash dellarg eshosh/.
Tsu'ngakh' khalo khilakh'- atta khillalts tIa'kh'atottur du /dekkhar skh'adekhar/, ash i /derrig ia tsunakh tskh'aderg/ sagIina ditakh' - dika du shuna, shu khuush khillekh'.
Shu kkhera diinakh, shena chokh' shu Dalla tIe dIadu'gur dolchu, tIakkkha masso a sina sha karadinachu'ntsa bekkham biir bu, tsarna zulam diir dats.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Sha'sh vovshashkara dekkharsh o'tsush tsIe to'khnachu khanna - dIaiazde u'sh. Iazdoila shuna iukk'ekh' iazdecho niisontsa. Iazdiirig du'kh'al ma khu'liila iazdan, Dala sha Iamiina ma khillara. Tso iazdoila, shena tIekh' dekkhar dolcho dIadu'itsiila. Delakh - shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkho'riila i /kharts diitsa/, khIumma a ma eshadoila tso tsunakh. Nagakh' sanna i shena tIekh' dekkhar derg khilakh' tIalam botsush ia za'Iap, sha dIadiitsa tsa lush, - tsu'nan veraso du'itsiila niisontsa. Shain bozharekh shina teshe teshalla a daita, shi bo'rsha stag tsa khilakh' - tskh'a bo'rsha stag a, shi zuda a, sha'sh tsarna teshash khila reza dolchu, tsarakh (zudarekh) tskh'a' tilalakh' a - vukkho tsunna dagadou'itur du. Teshasha du'kh'alo ma ioila /teshalla dan/ sha'sh kkhaikkhinchu khenakh'. Ash malo ma ioila i /dekkhar/ dIaiazdan, zhima delakh' a, dokkkha delakh' a shen khan tIekkhachchalts. Iza melkho a niisa du Dalla gergakh', chIogIa du teshallina, gerga du shuna sheko tsa khilarekh'. Nagakh' i khilakh' la'ttash iolu iokhka-etsar, ash vovshii iukk'ekh' dIakh'osh iolu, - i tsa iazdarkh k'a dats shuna. Teshash khIittabe sha'sh iokhka-etsar esh. Iazdesh volchunna a zen ma doila, teshana a. Ash i dakh' - i shu'tsa pesak'allakhilar du. Shu kkhera Delakh, Dela shu Iamadesh vu. I Dela masso a khIuma Sha khuush vu.

Shu novk'akh' khilla, shuna iazdan stag tsa karavakh' - kara khIuma lo zak'altana. Shukh tskh'abolchara vukkharna teshamna khIuma elcha- shena teshamna ella khIuma iukhaerzaioila tso, shen Delakh - shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh - kkho'riila iza /i iukha tsa erzaian/. Ash ma kh'uldelash teshalla, i kh'uldiinarg - shen dago k'inosh diinarg vu. I Dela ash diirig khuush ma vu.

Delan du stiglanashkakh' derg a, la'ttakh' derg a, ash guchuda'kkkhicha a shaigakh' derg, ia kh'uldicha a - i kh'esap diir du shuna Dala. Shena luuchunna gechdiir du Tso, Shena luuchunna Iazap diir du. I Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.

Elcha tiishira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara shega dossiinchukh, mu'manakh a tiishira. Masso a tiishira Delakh a, Tsu'nan malikekh a, Tsu'nan zhainekh a, Tsu'nan elchanekh a. /Olu mu'manakha/: "Tsu'nan elchanii iukk'era tskh'a a k'asta tsa vo okha". TIakkkha tsara elira: "Lado'gIna okha, mu'tIakh' khilla tkho. Akh' gechdelakh' tkhuna, tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Kh'o'ga du-kkh dIaderzar".

Sina tIe tsa du'llu Dala tsunna nitsk' kkhochurg ben. Tsunna - sha karadiinarg du, tsunna du'khal a - sha karadiinarg du. "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' tkho bekhke ma latsalakh' tkho ditsdelcha a, ia gIalatda'lcha a. Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' tkhuna tIe ma iillalakh' khalo, Akh' tkhol kh'alkhabakhancharna tIe iillarkh terra. Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' tkhuna tIe ma dillalakh' tkhuna shena tIekh' nitsk' tsakkhochurg, kh'alkhadakhalakh' tkho, gechdelakh' tkhuna, k'inkhetam a belakh' tkhokh, Kh'o vu tkhan veras, gIo delakh' tkhuna tsa teshachu k'omana tIekh'". (Ishtta dekha bokhu Dala mu'manakhe).
Alif-lam-mim.
Allakh1 /tskh'a Dela/ vu, kkhin dela vats I ben, Sha diina vu, guttar la'ttash vu /Shen lein gIullakkhash kkhochushdesh/.
Tso kh'o'ga dissiina kh'ak'-bak' a dolush, shel kh'alkha khillarg bak'desh a dolu zhaina (K'ur'an). Tso dossiina/Musaga/ Tavrat a, / Iiisaga / Inzhil a
Kh'alkha niisa nek' khilla dolu nakhana, Tso dossiina Furk'an. Bakk'alla a, Delan aiatekh tsa teshash bersh - tsarna ma du chIoIa Iazap. I Dela ma vu sha veza verg- bekkhaman da.
Bakk'alla a, i Dela ma vu Shekh khIumma a k'ailaer iotsush, la'ttakh' a, stiglakh' a.
I vu shu kepe derziina beran tsIa chokh' (nenan kiirakh') Shena ma lu'u, kkhin dela vats I ben, Sha veza verg a, kh'ek'aleverg a vu I.

I vu kh'o'ga zhaina dossiinarg, tsu'nakh du kh'ikmate aiatash - u'sh (kh'ikmatenash) zhainin nana iu, kkhidersh - tskh'aterranash du. Amma shain degnashkakh' dIatovzhar dersh- u'sh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttu tsu chu'ra (Delan sibat) tskh'ana kh1umanekh tardesh dolcharna pitana lo'khush a, u'sh dasta gIertash a. U'sh dasta ma tsa kha'a Dalla Shena ben. Sha'sh Iilmanchokh' kIargbellachara olu: "Teshna tkho tsunakh, derrige a du tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara". Oila-m tsa io shain kh'ek'al dolchara ben.

/Olu iiman dillinchara/: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' tkhan degnash dIa ma tovzhadelakh', Aikh'a tkho nisdinchul tIa'kh'a, Kh'aigara k'inkhetam lolakh' tkhuna, bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu /shortta/ lush verg,
Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Kh'o ma vu nakh gulbiir berg shegakh' sheko iotschu /k'emat/ denna, bakk'alla a, Dala tsa iokhaio vaIda".
Bakk'alla a, tsateshnarsh - tseran bakhamo a, tseran do'zalo a Delera (Tsu'nan Iazapakh) kh1umma a kh'alkhabokhur ma bats u'sh. U'sh ma bu /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran iagorig.
FirIavnan do'zalan Iadatakh terra, tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran Iadatakh terra: khartsdira tsaraTkhan aiatash - Dala skh'aletsira u'sh shain k'inosh bakh'anekh'. I Dela taIzar darekh' chIogIa ma vu.
Akh' ala tsateshnacha'rga: "Eshor a du shu, zho'zhakhatina chu lokhkur a du shu". - Ma von mottbu-kkh iza.

Shuna delil dara-kkh vovshashna du'kh'-du'kh'al iakhna khillachu shina tobanekh': tskh'a toba tIom besh Delan novk'akh', vazha - tsateshash erg. Tsarna u'sh guora shail shozza alsam bIa'rgatsa. Dala chIagIvo Shen gIo'ntsa Shena luurg. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' kh'ekham ma bu bIa'rsadolcharna.

Nakhana khazbina bezam zudarshka a, kIentashka a, tIettIa guldinchu deshiga a, detiga a, vast dolchu govrashka a, da'khniga a, ialtiga a - iza du'nenan dakharan bakham bu, tk'a Dalla gergakh' ma iu khaza dIavo'rziila.

Akh' ala: "As diitsii shuna tsul dikanig?" /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' boshmash iu, bukhakhula khish a o'khush, gutarenna a tsu chokh' khir bu u'sh, tsIena zudarii a bu, Delera reza khilar a du. I Dela gush ma vu Shen lesh,
Sha'sh olush bolu: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Okha, bakk'alla a, iiman dillina, Akh' gechdelakh' tkhan k'inosh, Akh' kh'alkhadakhalakh' tkho tsIeran Iazapakh", -
Sha'sh sobare bolush, bak'derg du'itsush, Dalla mu'tIakh' bolush, /dikchu ag1or/ kharzhash esh, gechdar do'khush satasale.

Dala teshalla dina tskh'a a dela tsakhilarna, I Sha ben, malikasha a, Iilma dolchu nakha a dina /teshalla/, niisonna tIekhIo'ttina vollush vu Iza, kkhin dela vats I ben, Sha veza verg a, kh'ek'ale verg a vu Iza.

Bakk'alla a, din Dalla gergakh' islamdu. Shaiga zhaina dellarsh bek'a tsa belira shaiga Iilma de'nachul tIa'kh'a ben vovshashna iukk'ekh' kh'agI kkhollaialartsa. Delan aiatash khartsdesh milla velakh' - Dela ma vu kh'esap darekh' sikhanig.

Tsara kh'aitsa k'iisakh', akh' ala: "As mu'tIakh' iina sain iu'kh' Dalla, suna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttincho a iina". Akh' ala shaiga zhaina dellacha'rgaa, bodane bolcha'rgaa: "Shu khillii mu'tIakh'?" U'sh mu'tIakh' belakh', tIakkkha u'sh niisachu novk'akh' bu, u'sh dIaberzakh' - kh'una tIekh' dIakkhachorben dats. I Dela ma vu Shen lesh gush verg.
Bakk'alla a, Delan aiatash khartsdesh bersh, tskh'a a bak'o iotsush paikhamarsh boiush bersh, nakhakh shaiga niiso e olursh boiush bersh - tsarna akh' kkheram tasalakh' lazosh dolchu Iazaptsa.
U'sh ma bu shain Iamalsh iainarsh du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a - tsarna gIo'nchii /khir/ ma bats!
Kh'una tsa gina i shaiga Zhainan tskh'a dak'a dellarsh- u'sh Delan Zhaine kkhaikkhicha vovshashna iukk'ekh' kh'ukam dan, tsarakh tskh'a toba dIaio'rzu, du'kh'al a khu'lush.
Iza du, tsara olu dela: "/Zho'zhakhatin/tsIaro skh'alotsur dats tkho tskh'a masiitta denna ben". Sha'sh shain dinekh' kharts kkhullush dolchochIogIa tiliina u'sh.
Okha u'sh gulbinchu khenakh' shegakh' sheko iotschu /k'emat/ denna, masso a sinna sha karadinachu'ntsa bekkham bicha, tsarna zulam mukha diir dats?

Akh' ala: "KhIai Dela, pachchakh'alla Kh'ain dolakh' dolush volu, Kh'aina luuchunna lo-kkh Akh' pachchakh'alla, Kh'aina luuchu'ngara skh'adokkkhu Akh' pachchakh'alla, Kh'aina luurg vazvo Akh', Kh'aina luurg siisazvo. Kh'an karakh' du-kkh dikanash. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu masso a khIumanna t1ekh' nitsk' berg.

Bu'isa denna chu iokhu'itu Akh', de bu'isanna chu dokhu'ituAkh', vellachukh diinaverg skh'avokkkhu Akh', diinavolchukh vellarg skh'avokkkhuAkh', ritsk' lo Akh' Kh'aina luuchunna tskh'a a kh'esap tsa desh ".

Mu'mina nakha ma lo'tsiila tsatesharsh g1o'nchii /kkhechu/ mu'mina nakhana du'kh'al. I dinarg vats Delera /tskh'anna a/ khIumanna tIekh', shu tsarakh (kerstanekh) kkheranne a kkho'rush datsakh'. (Shaina kkherame delakh' - latsa). Dala shu lardo Shetsa. Dele ma du dIaderzar.
Akh' ala: "Ash kh'uldakh' a shain degnashkakh' derg, guchudakkkhakh' i - Dela i khuush vu. I khuush vu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a derg. I Dela masso a khIumanna t1ekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.

Otsu diinakh' masso a sinna shena kh'alkhakh' karor du sha dina dikanig. Sha dinchu vochunna a, shena a iukk'ekh' genara khan (iokkkha iuk') khu'liila luur dara tsunna. Dala lardo shu Shetsa. I Dela k'inkhetame vu leshtsa".
Akh' ala: "Shu Dela vezash delakh', suna tIa'kh'akhIitta - Dalla dezar du shu, shuna gechdiir du Tso shun k'inosh", - i Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Akh' ala: "Mu'tIakh' khila Dalla a, elchanna a". U'sh dIaberzakh' (akh' shaiga kkhoikkhuchu'ngara) - Dalla tsa beza tsatesharsh.
Bakk'alla a, Dala kha'rzhira Adam a, Nukh' a, IbrakhIiman do'zal a, Iimranan do'zal a Ialamel,
Tskh'abersh vokkheran zu'rret a dolush, i Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.

/Akh' kh'akhade tsa'rga, kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ Iimranan zudcho a'llera: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, as Kh'una nuzar (nigat) dina-kkh, sain kiirakh' derg masso a khIumanakh pargIat a dakkkhii, k'obaldekh'a so'gara. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu-kkh".

Sha ber dina ia'lcha /tso/, elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg, asa-m ioI iina".- I Dela dika khuush ma vu, tso mila iina.- "Bo'rshanig ma tsa khu'lu stenig sanna. As tsunna tsIe tillina Mar'iam, as iza a, tsu'nan zu'rret a Kh'o'tsa lardo, t1ulgash dettash, ekkkhosh dolchu shaitIanakh".

Dala t1eiitsira tsu'nan i khazchu k'obaldartsa. Khaza a, tsIena a kkhiira Tso i (Mar'iam), tsu'nan doladar tIedillira Zakariina. I iolchu mikh'rabachu ma-velli, Zakariina tsunna (Mar'iamna) kh'alkhakh' ritsk' karadora. Tso olura: "Mar'iam, khIara michakh'ara du kh'una?" Tso (Mar'iama) olura: "KhIara Delera du. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ritsk' lush ma vu Shena luuchunna, kh'esap dotsush".
Tsigakh' diikhira Zakariis shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga. Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg, lokh'a suna Kh'aigara tsIena zu'rret, bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu (Kh'aiga) dekhar khezash".

Tsu'nga kkhaikkhira malikasha, i lamazna khIo'ttina volchu mikh'raba chokh': "Dala kkha' bokkkhu kh'o'ga Iakh''iatsa (i ts1e iolu k1ant valartsa), sha Delan Dosh bak'desh, sha ela a, sha vochukh larlush volu k'onakh a, sha dikacharekh paikhamar a khir volchu".
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg, michara khir vu suna kIant? So vokkkha a ma khilla, san zuda a ma iu ber tsa khu'lush". Tso (Dala) elira: "Ishtta, Allakh1a do Shena luurg".

Tso (Zakariis) elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg, tskh'a delil khiliitakh' suna". /Dala/ elira: "Kh'an delil du kh'o nakhe kkhaa diinakh' vist tsakhilar ishartsa ben, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg kh'ekhave dukkkha a, khastave I sarakh' a, Iu'iranna a".
Malikasha a'llera: "KhIai Mar'iam, bakk'alla a, Dala kha'rzhina kh'o, Tso tsIaniina kh'o, Tso kh'o kha'rzhina (masso a) Ialamiin zudarshna t1ekh'.
KhIai Mar'iam, mu'tIakh' khila kh'ain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, suzhud a de, gor a kh1otta gorkh1u'ttucha'rtsa".

Iza du kh'ulaman khabarekh, sha'sh kh'una khou'itush dolchu. Kh'o vatsara u'sh bolchokh', tsara shain k'olamashkkhu'ssush, mu'lkhacho dola diir du Mar'iaman, kh'o vatsara u'sh bolchokh' tsara k'u'isuchu khenakh'.

Malikasha a'llera: "KhIai Mar'iam, bakk'alla a, Dala kkha' bokkkhush bu kh'una Shegara Dashtsa, shen tsIe Kh'a'khnarg, Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa a volush, sha du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a sii dolush khinverg, sha /Dalla/ gergarcharekh khinverg.
Nakhatsa khabar du'itsur du tso agana chokh' a, vokkkha khilcha a, dikacharekh khir vu iza".

Tso )Mar'iama( elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, michara khir vu san do'zalkho, sokh /tskh'a a/ adam kh'akkha della a tsa khilcha?" Elira /malikasha/: "Ishtta Dala kkhullu Shena luurg. Shena tskh'a gIullakkh t1ekh' satsam khilcha, Tso olu tsu'nga: "Khila!" - I khu'lu".
Tso 1amor du tsunna )Iiisana( ioza a, kh'ek'alalla a, Tavrat a, Inzhil a.

Elcha (viir vu Dala tsunakh) Israilan kIentashka", /sha olush:/ "So veana shu'ga shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara delilatsa, as kkhullu shuna popparkh kh'ozan su'rtekh' khIuma, kh1up olu tsu chu - khu'lu kh'oza Delan purbantsa, as taviir vu bIa'rsa dotsurg, burstsamgar erg a, bellarsh a denbiir bu Delan purbantsa, as du'itsur du shuna ash iuuchukh a, ash shain tsIenoshkakh' Ialashdesh dolchukh a la'tsna. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil du shuna, shu mu'mina nakh delakh'.
