Bak'dan /veana so/ sol kh'alkha khilla Tavrat, kh'anal dan shuna /Tavrata chokh'/ kh'aram khilla dolchekh tskh'adersh, - so veana shu'ga shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara delilashtsa - Delakh kkhera, suna mu'tIakh' khila.
Bakk'alla a, i Dela san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a vu, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a vu, Tsunna Iibadat deisha - i bu niisa nek'", /Iiisas er du i deshnash/.

Iiisas shena tsa'rgara tsateshar khaadelcha, elira: "Mu'lsh bu san gIo'nchii Delekh'a?" Kh'avariishaelira: "Tkho du Delan gIo'nchii, Delakh teshna tkho, akh' teshalla de tkho mu'tIakh' dersh (busalbanash) du, alii.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Tkho teshna-kkh Akh' dossiinachukh, tkho tIa'kh'akhIittina elchanna - Akh' dIaiazde tkho teshalladincha'rtsa".
/Tsateshachara/ mekarloiira, /tseran mekarlonna du'kh'al/ Dala a iira mekarlo. /Mekarlona du'kh'al/ Dela mekarlo dika esh vu.

Dala a'llera: "KhIai Iiisa, As kh'o d1akkhalkho, Saina gerga kh'alavokkkhu, tsIanvo kh'o tsateshacharekh. So latto vollu kh'una tIa'kh'akhIittinarsh tsateshacharna tIekh' k'ematde dallalts. TIakkkha Suna tIe khir du shun d1aderzar. As kkhel iiir iu shuna iuk'akh', ash khilpalo esh khillachunna tIekh'.
Tk'a tsateshnarsh - As tsarna Iazap diir du chIogIachu Iazaptsa du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a - ma khir bats-kkh tsarna gIo'nchii".
Amma iiman dillinarsh a, dikanash dinarsh a - tsarna shain kkhochchush ial dIalur iu Tso. Dalla tsa beza zulamkhoi.
I du Okha kh'una do'shush derg aiatekh a, kh'ek'ale kh'ekhamakh a.
Bakk'alla a, Iiisan masal Dalla gergakh' Adaman masalkh tera du: Tso i kkho'llira la'ttakh, tIakkkha elira tsu'nga "Khila!" - i khilira.
Bak'derg du i kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara - kh'o ma khilalakh' sheko echarakh.

Kh'aiga khaam be'nachul tIa'kh'a tsunakh la'tsna kh'aitsa k'u'isush bolcha'rga ala: "Du'lo, kkhoikkhu vai tkhan kIentashka a, shun kIentashka a, tkhan zudarshka a, shun zudarshka a, tkho'ga tkhaiga a, shu'ga shaiga a, tIakkkhadoIanash der vai, Delan neIalt a'r vai khartslu'icharna".
Bakk'alla a, khIara du bak'dolu khabar. Vats tskh'a a dela, sha AllakhI (tsIe iolu i tskh'a Dela) a ben. Bakk'alla a, i Dela sha veza verg a, sha kh'ek'aleverg a vu.
U'sh dIaberzakh' (akh' du'itsurg k'obal tsa desh) - i Dela khuush (gush) vu bo'khanig lelosh bersh.

Akh' ala: "KhIai zhainan okhIla, du'ila tkhuna iuk'akh' a, shuna iuk'akh' a tskh'a' dolchu dashna tIe: "Iibadat diir dats vai tskh'ana Dalla ben, Tsu'ntsa nak'ost lotsur vats vai tskh'ana a khIumantsa, i Dela a vitina, vaikh tskh'abolchara vukkharakh delii lo'tsur bats". U'sh dIaberzakh', ash ala: "Ash teshalla de tkho /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' dersh khilarna".
KhIai zhainan okhIla, ash khIunda k'u'isu IbrakhIiman kh'ok'ekh'? Tavrat a, Inzhil a ma tsa dossiina tsul tIa'kh'a a ben - ash oila tsa io?

KhIai shu, ma du k'iisamekh' khillarsh shaigakh' Iilma dolchokh' a /Musan a, Iiisan a gIullakkhashkakh'/. KhIunda k'u'isu ash shaigakh' Iilma dotsuchukh mukhkhale a? I Dela khuush vu, shu tsa khuush du.
Tsa khilla IbrakhIim zhu'gti a, nasari a- i khilla tsIena teshash verg a, mu'tIakh' verg a, i tsa khilla mushrikekha.
Bakk'alla a, IbrakhIimtsa tam bolu nakh bu - tsunna tIa'kh'akhIittina khilla bersh a, khIara paikhamar a, teshash bersh a. I Dela ma vu teshash bolcheran vali (dottag1).
Liira zhainan okhIlanakh tskh'ana tobanna shu tilo (niisachu nek'akh), tilor-m dats tsara sha'sh ben - am tsarna i tsa khaalo-kkh.
KhIai zhainan okhIla, ash khIunda khartsdo Delan aiatash, shaina khuushekh' /u'sh bak' duila/?
KhIai zhainan okhIla, khIunda vovshakh'edo ash bak'derg khartsdolchu'ntsa, bak'derg kh'uldesh du shu, shaina khu'ushekh'.

Zhainan okhIlanan tskh'ana tobano elira: "Shu tesha teshnacha'rga dossiina dolchukh diinan iu'khkh'ekh', khartsde tsu'nan /diinan/ chakkhengakh' /dissinarsh/, u'sh /busalbanash/ dIaberza tarlo /shain dinakh/.

Shu ma teshalash shain dinna tIa'kh'akhIuttush volchukh ben". Akh' ala: "Niisa nek' bu Delan niisa nek'" - "Shu'ga dellachukh teranig kkhechu'nga dala /tam bats Dala/, ia shu'tsa k'u'isu tsara shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh'?" Ala: "Bakk'alla a, dozalla Delan karakh' du, I lush vu i Shena luuchunna". I Dela Shegakh' shortta /dollu kh1uma/ dolush a vu, khuush a vu.
Shen k'inkhetamtsa k'astavo Tso Shena luurg, i Dela Shen siilakh'-dokkkha dozalla dolush vu!

Zhainan okhIlanakh vu akh' shena tskh'a k'intIardelcha, shekh teshna, iza kh'o'ga iukhaderzosh verg, tsarakh vu akh' shekh teshna, shega tskh'a dinardelcha a, iza kh'o'ga iukha tsa derzosh verg a, kh'o shena tIekhIo'ttina la'tticha ben. Iza du tsara olu dela: "Tkhuna bodane nakhalakh'nek' bats". Dalla t1ekh' khartsderg olu tsara, shaina khu'ushekh'.
KhIa', sha della dosh kkhochushdinarg a, sha /Delakh/ kkhiirinarg a (shekh bina teshamna iamart tsakhillarg a - u'sh bu niisachu novk'akh') - bakk'alla a, tsu Dalla ma beza /Shekh/ kkho'rush bersh.

Bakk'alla a, Delan vaIdanakh a, shain duinekh a kIezzig makh etsnarsh (du'nenan bakham bakh'anekh' u'sh dokhadesh), ekhartakh' dak'a ma dats tsarna, Dela tsa'rga vistkhir ma vats, tsa'rga kh'ozhur ma vats Iza k'ematdiinakh', tsIanbiir ma bats Tso u'sh, tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap a ma du.

Bakk'alla a, tsarakh ma iu tskh'a toba shain mettanashtsa khu'itsush /Delan/ zhaina, izashuna /Delan/ zhainakh du mottiita. Ma dats i /Delan/ zhainakh. Tsara olu: "I Delera du", ma dats i Delera. U'sh olush bu-kkh Dalla t1ekh' khartsderg, shaina khu'ushekh'.

Adamna tam bats Dala shega zhaina a, kh'ukam a, paikhamaralla a delcha, ala nakhe: "Shu khila san lesh, Dela a vitii". Mukhkha delakh' a, tam bu tsara ala: "Shu khila sha'sh zhaina /nakhana/ Iamosh khilartsa, sha'sh iza /shaina/ 1amadesh khilartsa kIorggera Ielamnakh".
Tsoshu'ga omra dan tam bats malikekh a, paikhamarekh a delanash letsa, a'lla. Tk'a tso shu'ga omra diir du, ma tesha, a'lla, shu mu'tIakh'khillachul tIa'kh'a?

Dala bart bira paikhamarshtsa: "KhIara As shu'ga dellarg du zhainakh a, kh'ek'alallakh a. TIakkkha vogIur vu shu'ga elcha, shu'gakh' derg bak'desh volu. Shu bilggala teshar du tsunakh, ash tsunna gIo a diir du". /Dala/ elira: "Ash chIagIdirii, iitsirii ash tsunna tIekh' San vaIda?" Tsara elira: "ChIagIdina okha". Elira /Dala/: "Teshalla de, So a vu shu'tsa teshalla desh bolcharekh".
Tsul tIa'kh'a iukhabevllarsh - u'sh ma bu fasik'ash.

Tk'a Delan din /Islam/ du'tii, kkhin din lo'khu tsara (zhainan okh1lano)? Tsunna (Dalla) mu'tIakh' ma vu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel verg, shena luush a, tsa luush a, Tsu'nga u'sh dIaberzor bolush a ma bu.

Akh' ala: "Teshna du tkho Delakh a, tkho'ga dossiinchukh a, IbrakhIime a, IsmaIile a, Iskh'ak'e a, Ia1k'ube a, tsu'nan berashkadossiinachukh a, Musaga a, Iiisaga a, /kkhechu/ paikhamarshka a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara dellachukh a. Tsarakh tskh'a a k'asta tsa vo okha, tkho Tsunna (Dalla) mu'tIakh' du".
Islamdotsurg /kkhin/ din dezash verg - k'obaldiir dats iza tsu'ngara, ekhartakh' iza eshnacharekh ma vu.

Mukha nisdiir du Dala sha'sh iiman dillinchul tIa'kh'a a, /Mukh'ammad/ elcha bak'khilaran teshallash ginchul t1a'kh'a a, shaiga bilgalonash e'nachul t1a'kh'a a kerstanalla dina dolu k'am? Tsu Dala nis ma tsa do zulame k'am.
U'sh bu shaina bekkham Delan a, malikiin a, masso a nekhan a neIalt dersh.
Guttar la'ttar bolush bu u'sh tsu /ne1alta/ chokh'. Oiur dats tsarna tIera Iazap, tIa'kh'a a tottur bats u'sh, -
Tsul tIa'kh'a toba dinarsh a, tIakkkha dika Iamalsh iinarsh a ben. Bakk'alla a, i Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, sha'sh iiman dillinchul tIa'kh'a tsa teshash khillarsh, tIakkkha tsateshartsa sovbu'ilush bersh- tseran toba k'obaldiir ma dats. U'sh ma bu tilbellarsh.

Bakk'alla a, /Mukh'ammad elcha khilarna/ inkarlo iinarsh, /t1akkkha otsu/ kerstanallina t1ekh' bellarsh - tsarakh tskh'a'ngara a d1ao'tsur ma dats latta du'zzina deshi, nagakh' sanna tsara delcha a. Tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap ma du. Ma bats tsarna gIo'nchii.
Tsk'a a mela kkhochur bats shuna, ash sagIina lush iolu kh1uma shaina ezachukh elcha a ben. Ash sagIina lush iolu khIuma - bakk'alla a, Dela i khuush ma vu.
Masso a kkhacha kh'anal khilla Israilan kIentashna, Israila shen degIana sha kh'aram bina botsurg, Tavratdossale kh'alkha. Akh' ala: "Tavrat dokh'ush du'ila, desha i, sha'sh bak'lu'ish delakh'".
Tsul tIa'kh'a Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkho'llinarsh - u'sh bu zulamkhoi.
Akh' ala: "Bak'liina Dela, shu tIa'kh'akhIitta IbrakhIiman millatana, sha bak'-tsIena teshash khilla volchu. Tsa khilla i /Delatsa/ nak'ost lo'tsucharekh".
Bakk'alla a, nakhana /1ibadat dan/ khIottiina khilla dolu du'khkh'arlera tsIa- du Bakkatekh'derg: berkate a, niisa nek' a laralush masso a Ialamashna.

Tsu chokh' bilggala aiatash du: IbrakhIiman mettig. Tsunna cho'kh'a va'llarg ma'rsha khilla. Nakh Dalla dekkhar bu kh'a'zhalla dikhka, shain nek'atsa nitsk' kkhachakh'. Milla a teshash vatsakh'- i Dela tskh'a a 1alam tsa khilcha a volu.
Akh' ala: "KhIai zhainan okhIla, shu khIunda tsa tesha Delan aiatekh, i Dela tesh ma vu ash desh dolchunna tIekh'?"

Akh' ala: "KhIai zhainan okhIla, ash khIunda dIato'ttu Delan nek'a tIera iiman dillinarg? Shu du luush i gamban, shu sha'sh ma dui /tsunna tIekh'/ teshash". Ma vats i Dela tergal tsa desh ash desh derg.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh, shu shaiga zhaina dellacheran /tskh'ana/ tobanna mu'tIakh' khilakh', tsara d1aderzor du shu kerstanallina tIe, ash iiman dillinchul tIa'kh'a.
Shu mukha khu'lu tsa teshash - shuna tIekh' do'shush Delan aiatash ma du, shuna iukk'ekh' Tsu'nan elcha ma vu? Milla velakh' a, Delatsa chIagIvellarg - nisvella i niisachu novk'a.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh, kkhera Delakh khak'-bak' kkherartsa, shu dala ma loila Tsunna mu'tIakh'dolush ben.

ChIagIlo Delan mu'shtsamasso a. Shu dek'a ma lo. Dagadaiita shaina khilla Delan niImat: shu ma dara mostagIii - shun degnash kIaddiira Tso, shukh khilira Tsu'nan niImattsa vezharii. Shu ma dara tsIeran ora iisttekh' - Tso shu tsunakh kIelkh'aradekhira. Ishtta bilgaldo Dala shuna Shen aiatash - shu nisdala tarlora.
Shukh khu'liila ummat, sha dikane kkhoikkhush, dikanig kh'o'khush, vochukh /nakh/ dukhatukhush. U'sh bu bakkkhiibiir bersh.
Shu ma khilalash shaiga bilgalonash e'nachul tIa'kh'a bek'abellacharekh a, shain bart tsakhillacharekh a tera. Tsarna - deza-dokkkha Iazap du.

Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' /Dalla mu't1akh' khillachu mu'min nekhan/ iakhkh'ash kIailur iu, /Dalla inkarlo iinchu kersta nekhan/ iakhkh'ash Iarzhlur iu. Amma shain iakhkh'ash Iarzh'ellarsh /kkhu'ssur bu zho'zhakhati chu, tsa'rga khottur du/: "Tk'a shu tsa tiishi shaiga iiman /iimanan 1alamatash/ de'nachul tIa'kh'a a? Iovsha Iazap, sha'sh tsa teshash khilarna!"
Tk'a shain iakhkh'ash kIai'ellarsh - Delan k'inkhetamna chokh' (ialsamanekh') khir bu. U'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bu.
U'sh Delan aiatash du, Okha du'itsu kh'una u'sh bak'dolchu'ntsa. I Dela ma vats zulam luush Ialamna (sha kkho'llinchu tskh'anna khIumanna).
Delan dolakh' du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Dele dIado'rzu gIullakkhash.

Shu khilla nakhana iuk'ada'llachekh uggar dika ummat: dikanig kh'o'khush, vochukh /nakh/ dukhatukhush, Delakh teshash. Zhainan okhIla teshna khillekh'ara, tsarna dika khir dara. Tsarakh tesharsh a bu, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh fasik'ash ma bu.
Tsara shuna danne a zen diir dats, tsatam bakh' ben. Shukh latakh' a - shain bakk'ash berzor bu tsara shuna (eshna bukhabevr bu u'sh), tIakkkha tsarna gIo diir dats.

Tsarna tIekkho'ssina siisazalla, u'sh michchakh'a khillekh' a, Delera va1diitsa a, nakhera va1diitsa au'sh batsakh'. Delera o'gIazallina tIekkhiira u'sh, tIekkho'ssira tsarna miskalalla. Iza - u'sh khilla khilarna Delan aiatekh tsa teshash, baia kh'ak' botsush, paikhamarsh boiush. Iza - tsara Iesalla iarna a, u'sh dozanekh bevlla khilarna a du.
Tskh'aterra bats u'sh. Zhainan okhIlanakh iu tskh'a/niisa/ khIo'ttina iolu toba: tsara Delan aiatash do'shu bu'sanan zamanchokh', tsara suzhud do /Dalla/.
U'sh teshash bu Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a, dikanig kh'o'khush bu, vochukh /nakh/ dukhatukhush bu, sikhlush bu u'sh dika khIumanash dan - u'sh bu dikacharekh.
Tsara dina dikanig - kerstadiir dats i tsarna (k'obal tsa desh du'tur dats), i Dela ma vu bevzash /Shekh/ kkho'rush bersh.
Bakk'alla a, tsateshnarsh - tseran bakhamo a, tseran do'zalsha a tsarakh khIumma a dukhatukhur dats Delera. U'sh bu /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai, u'sh tsu chokh' daima la'ttar bu.

Gergarchu /du'nenan/ dakharekh' tsara (kerstanasha) iina kharzh tera iu shetsa chIogIa shelo iolchu makhakh, shaina zulam dinchu nekhan ialtina kh'ekkhna bolchu - tso i khIallakdina. Dala zulam tsa dina tsarna, mukhkha delakh' a, sha'sh zulam desh bu u'sh shaina.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash ma letsa shain /daggara/ dottagIii, sha'sh dotsursh. Shun gIullakkhash dokho zhigara khu'lu u'sh, shuna khalonash khu'liila la'a tsarna. O'gIazalla guchuia'lla tseran bagakhula, tseran degnasha kh'uldinarg kkhin a dokkkha du. Aiatash bilgalda'khna Okha shuna, shu kh'ek'ale khillekh'.

KhIai shu! U'sh bezash du shu, tsarna shu tsa deza. Shu tesha masso a zhainakh. Shuna du'kh'alkkhetcha, tsara olu: "Tkho iiman dillina du ". /Sha'sh shukh/ dIatilcha, shain pIelgekh tsergash iu'khku tsara o'gIazlontsa. Akh' ala: "Sa dala shu shain o'gIazallitsa. I Dela khuush ma vu degnashkakh' derg".

Shukh dikanig kkhetcha, tso von do tsarna, shuna von khilcha, tsunakh bakkkhiibe u'sh. Ash sobar dakh', shu Delakh kkherakh', tseran mekarlono khIumma a zen diir dats shuna. I Dela tsara desh derg derrige a chulotsush ma vu.
/Akh' dagadaita, kh1ai Mukh'ammad/: kh'o 1u'irana ara ma velira kh'ain do'zal bolchura /t1eman kechamna/, mu'mina nakh tIamna dIanisbesh, tk'a Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a ma vu.
Shukh shina tobanna dagchu eara osalalla (kkherabevlla tIamakh iukhabovla oila khilira tseran), liira dIasadarzha. I Dela ma vu tseran gIo'ncha. Dalla tIetevzhiila mu'mina nakh.
Dala gIo ma dira shuna Badrekh', shu ledara dolush. Delakh kkhera, shu khila megara shukurdesh.
Akh' olura mu'mina nakhe: "Shuna toam tsa khu'lu shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho sha'sh chIagIdicha okh'adossiinachu kkhaa ezar malikatsa?"
KhIan-khIa! Ash sobar dakh', shu /Delakh/ kkherakh', shuna tIe sikhontsa u'sh (mostagIii) letacha, shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho chIagIdiir du shu pkhea ezar malikatsa, Ialamatash dolchu.
I tsa dina Dala shuna kkha' khilla ben, shun degnash iimantsa chIagIdarkh'ama a ben. Tolam bats sha veza volchu, kh'ukam niisa desh volchu Delan gergara ben.
/I dina Dala/ tsa teshash bolcheran tskh'a agIo khadorkh'ama ia u'sh siisazbarkh'ama - dog dillina bukhbevr bu u'sh.
/Otsu/ gIullakkhakh khIumma dats kh'una: ia gechder Tso tsarna, ia Iazap der - u'sh zulamkhoi bu.
Delan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a, Shena luuchunna gechdo Tso, shena luuchunna Iazap do. I Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ma daa riba t1ekh alsamdakkkhartsa. Delakh kkhera - shu dakkkhiide tarlo.
Shu kkhera tsIerakh, tsateshacharna kechiina iolchu.
Shu mu'tIakh' khila Dalla a, elchanna a- shukh k'inkhetam ban tarlo.
Shu sikhlo shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara gechdare a, ialsamane a, shen shoralla stiglanash a, latta a /sanna/ iolchu, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna sha kechiina iolchu.
Ishttanash bu u'sh, sha'sh sagIa dokkkhush a'ttonekh' a, khalonekh'a, o'gIazlo iukhatukhush, nakhana k'intIerabovlush. Tsu Dalla beza dika bersh.

Ishttanash a bu u'sh, sha'sh tskh'a von k'a dicha ia sha'sh shaina zulam dicha, Dela dagavogIush, shain k'inoshna gechdar do'khush. Mila vu tk'a gechdiir dolush k'inosh sha Dela votsurg? Sha'sh dinchunna (k'ina) tIe iukha tsa bo'rzu u'sh khaa a khuush.
U'sh bu shain bekkham shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara gechdar a, boshmasha bersh, shain bukhakh' khish o'khush iolchu, tsarna chokh' u'sh guttar a khir bolush. Ma khaza ial iu i Iamal echarna!
Shul kh'alkha a dIadakhna /shuna t1ekh1u'ttush dersh sanna dolu/ khillarsh. Shu lela la'ttakhula, kh'ovsa, mukha khilla /din/ khartsdincheran chakkkhe.
KhIara khaam bu nakhana, niisa nek' a bu, kh'ekham a bu /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna.
Shu ledara ma dovla /gIazot dan/, shu singattame ma khila /Ukh'udekh' esharna/ - shu lakkhakh' khir du /kerstanashna tIekh' tolam bakkkhartsa/, shu /bakk'alla a, /mu'mina nakh khillekh'.

Shuna chov khilcha - nakhana akhilla chov, tsunakh terra. I denosh Okha kh'iizado nakhana iukk'ekh', Dalla bovzarkh'ama (nakhana guchubokhush) iiman dillinarsh, shun iukk'era gIazotan ial ersh khiliitarkh'ama a. Tsu Dalla tsa beza zulamkhoi.
Dala /k'inoikh/ tsIanbarkh'amaiiman dillinarsh, khIallakbarkh'ama tsatesharsh.
Shuna mo'ttira sha'sh ialsamane gIur du Dalla bovzaleshukh k'akh'egnarsha, Tsunna bovzale sobar dinarsh a?
Shu ma darii dala luush /gIazotekh'/ tsunna (g1azotana) du'kh'alkkhetale kh'alkha, i /dalar/ gira shuna, shu kh'o'zhush dolush (tk'a khIintsa iukhadovlu shu?).

I Mukh'ammad ma vats elcha ben. DIabakhana tsul kh'alkha a elchanash. Iza velcha ia viicha - sha'sh khillachu /tsateshare/ iukhado'rzur du shu? Iukhavirzinarg milla velakh' a, tskh'ana a khIumantsa Dalla zen tsa do tso. TIakkkha mela lur bu Dala barkalle bolcharna.

Tsa khilla sinna dalar Delan laamtsa ben, shen iozantsa to'khna khan iolush ben. Milla velakh' a du'nenan ial ezash - Okha lo tsunna tsunakh, milla velakh' a ekhartan ial ezash - Okha lo tsunna tsunakh. TIakkkha mela lur bu Okha barkalle bolcharna.

Mel dukkha paikhamarshtsa tskh'a'na tIemash bina /Delan novk'akh'/ ch1og1a Dalla teshame khillachu mu'min nakha. Khalchu tsa da'kkkhira tsarashaina Delan novk'akh' khilla dolu tsatame derg, ledara tsa bevlira u'sh, k1el tsa bisira /mostagIchunna/. Tsu Dalla beza sobare bersh

Tseran dosh tsa khilla dekk'a alar ben: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg,tkhuna gechdelakh' tkhan k'inosh, tkhan gIullakkhekh' /tkho'gara ia'lla/ tkhan tIalamazalla a, chIagIbelakh' tkhan kogash, tolam lolakh' tkhuna tsa teshash dolchu k'omana tIekh'" /tkho'tsa k'iisamekh' dolchu k'omana t1ekh'/.
Dala ella tsarna du'nenan ial, tk'a ma khaza iu ekhartan ial. Tsu Dalla beza dikanig desh bersh.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Tsateshacharna shu mu'tIakh' khilakh', tsara shu iukhaderzor du /shain dine/ - tIakkkha shu dIado'rzur du /iimanakh/ eshna.
KhIa'! Dela vu shun gIodokkkhurg. I vu g1odokkkhucharakh uggare a dikanig.

Okha kkhu'ssur ma bu tsateshacheran degnashka kkheram, tsara shaiga iossiina /tskh'a a/ bak'o iotsush, Delatsa nak'ost latsarna. Tseran khIusam - /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe ma iu. Ma von iu-kkh zulamkhoin chugIoila!

Dala bak'iina shuna Shen vaIda, ash i /tsatesharsh/ boiush Tsu'nan purbantsa, shu ledara dovllalts, gIullakkhekh' vovshashtsa k'iissalts, shu Iesa khillalts, shuna dezash khillarg (tolam) Tso shu'ga gaitinchul tIa'kh'a. Shukh du'ne dezash verg a vu, shukh ekhart dezash verg a vu. TIakkkha shu dIatettira Tso tsarakh, shu zerkh'ama. Shuna k'intIeravelira Iza. I Dela Shen koma'rshalla iolush ma vu mu'min nakhana t1ekh'.

Shu kh'ala devdira tskh'a'nge a iukha tsa kh'ovsush, kkhecharna iukk'ekh' elcha shu'ga kkhoikkhush volush.Singattamna t1e a singattam belira Tso shuna, shu g1aig1ane tsa khiliitarkh'ama shaina tsa khillachunna (khIonsana) a, shuna /nakh baiartsa a, eshartsa a/ khillachu bokhamna a. I Dela sov dika khuush vu ash diirig.

TIakkkha Tso iossiira shuna gIaigIanal tIa'kh'a pargIato - nab ozor. Shukh tskh'a /iimana t1ekh' ch1ag1'ella/ toba kh'uliira tso. Vukkhu /munepik'iin/ tobanan sintem baiira shain sinosha: tsarna khetara Delakh la'tsna bak'dotsurg, zhekhIal zamananchokh' khetash khillarg /khetara tsarna/. Tsara olura: "Otsu gIullakkha t1ekh' khIummaa dui vaina?" Akh' ala: "GIullakkh derrig Delan du". Kh'uldesh bu u'sh shaigakh' kh'una sha'sh guchu tsa dokkkhurg. Olu tsara /shaiga/: "Tkhuna khillekh' gIullakkhakh /tskh'a/ khIuma, kkhuzakh' doiur datsara tkho". Akh' ala: "Shu 1iina khillekh'ara shain tsIenosh chokh', /shukh/ biishina Iokhkkucharna /tseran Dala to'khna 1ozhalla t1ekkha'chnekh'/ tIebogIur bara shaina tIom bar iazdina bersh, Dala zerkh'ama shun kiirakh' derg, /k'inoikh/ tsIandarkh'ama shun degnashkakh' derg. I Dela khuush ma vu kiirakh' derg".

Bakk'alla a, shukh /Ukh'udekh' tIamakh/ iukhabevllarsh /busalbaniin a kerstaniin a/ shi toba du'kh'alkkhettachu diinakh', - shaitIano tiliina u'sh tskh'adolchu tsara dinchu /von/ khIumantsa. Dela k'intIeravelira tsarna. Dela sha gechdesh a, /Shena 1esa khillachunna ta1zar dan sikh tsa lush/ sobare a vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu ma khila tsateshacha'rga tera, sha'sh olush khilla bolchu shain vezharshka, u'sh iokhk-etsarna ia gIazotana arabevlcha: "Tkhuna gergakh' la'ttinekh' liir a batsara, boiur a batsara u'sh". Tsunakh Dala tseran degnashkakh' bokkkha singattam biir bu. I Dela denbesh a vu, bolu'itush a vu. I Dela ash diirig gush ma a vu.
Shu daiakh' Delan novk'akh', ia /tsigakh' kkhechu bakh'anitsa/ lakh' - Delera gechdar a, k'inkhetam a beza khir bu tsara guldesh dolchul /du'nenan bakhamal/.
Shu lakh' a, ia daiakh' a - Dalla tIe guldiir dolush du shu.

Delera k'inkhetamtsa khilira kh'o /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ tsa'rtsa kIeda. Kh'o kIorshame, dog dera khillekh'ara, kh'una gonakh'ara dIasaba'rzhira bara u'sh /kh'an nak'ostii/. K'intIeravala tsarna, gechdar a dekha tsarna, dagavala tsarakh gIullakkhekh'. Akh' aikh'a satsam bicha, Dalla tIetovzha. Dalla beza /Shena/ tIetevzhinarsh.
Dala shuna gIo dakh' - shuna tIekh' tolamkho vats. Tso shu gIo tsa desh ditakh' - mila vu Tsul tIa'kh'a shuna gIo diir derg? Dalla tIetovzhiila mu'mina nakh!

Tsa khilla paikhamar khIons k'ailaiokkkhur iolush. I k'ailaia'kkkhinarg sha k'ailaia'kkkhinchu'ntsa vogIur vu k'ematdiinakh'. TIakkkha khIor sinna shena karade'nachu'ntsa bekkham biir bu - tsarna zulam diir dats.
Dela rezakhilarna tIa'kh'akhIva'znarg tera vui tekh'a Delan o'gIazallina k1elnisvellachukh, shen d1averzar zho'zhakhati khir iolchu?! Ma ircha iu i kkhochu iolu mettig!
U'sh taip-taipana bu Dalla gergakh' /ialsamane gIur bersh a, zho'zhakhate gIur bersh a/. I Dela gush vu tsara desh derg.

Dala bokkkha kkhinkhetam ma bi mu'minan nakhakh tsaralakh' shaina iukk'era elcha a vakhiitina, tso tsarna Tsu'nan aiatash du'itsush, u'sh tsIanbesh, zhaina a, kh'ek'alalla a tsarna Iama a desh, kh'alkha u'sh bilggalchu tilarchokh' khillekh' a.

Ia shaina esham khilcha, ash a ma bira esham/Badrekh' mostagIchunna/ shozza alssam, ash elira: "KhIara michara du?" Akh' ala: "Iza shu'gara shaigara du". Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.
Shi toba du'kh'-du'kh'al kkhettachu diinakh' shuna khilla bolu eshamDelan laamtsa bu, tsu Dalla /Shekh/ teshna khillarsh /nakhana guchubokhush/ bovzarkh'ama.

Tsunna bovzarkh'ama shalkholelorasha, shaiga a'lcha: "Skh'adu'ila, tIom be Delan novk'akh', ia dIalelkhabe /mostagIii/", a'llarsh: "Tkhuna tIom ban khuush khillekh'ara, tkho shuna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttur dara". U'sh tsatesharna gerga bara otsu diinakh' iimanna /gerga/ khillachul, mettanashtsa du'itsush shain degnashkakh' dotsurg. I Dela dika khuush vu tsara kh'uldesh derg.

U'sh bu sha'sh /gIazote tsa bo'lkhush/, chokh' khevshina a 1iina shain vezharekh la'tsna a'lla khillarsh: "Okha bokhurg dinekh'ara, boiur batsara u'sh". Akh' ala: "Dukhatokha shaikh dalar (Iozhalla), shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'".
Akh' larrane a ma laralakh' Delan novk'akh' bellarsh bella. Diina bu u'sh - shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh' /Tso shaina/ ritsk' a lush.

Dala Shen koma'rshallakh shaina dellachu'ntsa bakkkhiibesh bu u'sh, shaikh tsa kkhu'ush /g1azotekh' tsa lesh/ tIa'kh'a bisincharna kkha' bo'khush bu u'sh tsarna kkheram tsa khiliita /ekhartakh'/ a, u'sh singattame tsa khiliita a /du'nenakh' bukhadu'suchukh/.
Kkha' bo'khush bu u'sh Delera niImattsa a, koma'rshallitsa a, Dala tsaiai'are mu'min nekhan ial /dog dokhush bu u'sh/.
U'sh bu Dalla a, elchanna a zhop dellarsh, shaina chovkhillachul tIa'kh'a. Tsarakh dikanig dinacharna a, /Delakh/ kkhiirincharna a siilakh'-iokkkha ial iu.
Ishttanash bu u'sh, shaiga nakhaa'lla: "Nakh bu shuna go billina, tsarakh kkhera". Tso u'sh alsambekhira iimantsa. Tsara elira: "Tkhan kkhacho iu - Dela, dika vekal a vu I".
Delera niImattsa a, dozallitsa a iukhabirzira u'sh, zeno tsa letsira u'sh, Dela reza khilarna tIa'kh'akhIittira u'sh. I Dela Shegakh' siilakh'-dokkkha dozalla dolush vu.
I shaitIa dara shen dottagIashka /kerstanashka/ shuna kkheram tu'ssu'itush, ma kkhera tsarakh, Sokh kkhera, sha'sh teshash khillekh'.

Kh'o singattame ma voila tsatesharekh' sikhbevllachara. Tsara danne a tskh'ana a khIumantsa zen diir dats Dalla. Dela luush vu tsarna /ialsamanin/ dak'a tsa dan ekhartakh'. Tsarna deza dokkkha Iazap khir du.
Iiman a do'khkina, tsateshar etsnachara danne a Dalla /tskh'ana a/ khIumantsa zen tsa do. Tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap khir du.
Tsateshacharna ma mo'ttiila Okha sha'sh lattorshaina dikanna du, Okha u'sh lattosh bu k'inoshtsa alsambovliitar- kh'ama. Tsarna siisaza dolu Iazap khir du.

Tsa khilira i Dela mu'min nakh bu'tush shu dolchu kh'olekh' /teshamenig a, munepik' a ievella/, bo'khanig tsIenchukh k'asta tsa vesh. Tsa khillera i Dela shu kkhiadesh k'ailenna tIe, mukhkha delakh' a, Dala khorzhu elchanekh Shena lu'urg. Teshalash Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanekh a. Shu teshakh' a, shu /Delakh/ kkherakh' a - shuna siilakh'-iokkkha ial iu.

Dala Shen koma'rshallekh /shaina/ dellachunna tIekh' pisallalelocharna ma mo'ttiila i shaina dika du. I melkho a tsarna von du, k'ematdiinakh' i tsara kkhoiinargtseran logakh kh'archor du. Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a irs. I Dela ash diirig dika khuush vu.
Dalla khezira oluchara a'lla dolu dosh: "Dela pek'ar vu, tkho kh'ole du". Okha dIaiazdiir du tsara a'llarg a, tsara, kh'ak' dotsush, paikhamarsh baiar a. Okha er du: "Iovsha zho'zhakhatin Iazap".
Shun ku'igasha kechdinarg bakh'anekh' du iza /Iazap/. I Dela zulamdesh ma vats leshna.

Ishttanash a bu u'sh, sha'sh a'lla: "Dala bart bina tkho'tsa, tkho elchanakh teshar dats a'lla, tso sag1a daiittalts, sha duush tsIaro". Akh' ala: "Shu'ga ba'khkirasol kh'alkha bilgalonashtsa elchanash, ash a'lla dolchu'ntsa a - u'sh khIunda baiira ash, sha'sh bak'lu'ish delakh'?"
Kh'uo tsara khartsvicha /i tidame ma etsa/, kh'ol kh'alkha a elchanash khartsbina. Bilgalonashtsa ba'khkina bara u'sh: zuburshtsaa, nu're dolchu zhainatsaa.

Masso a sino Iovshur ma du dalar (1ozhalla). Shuna /kkhochchush/ lur iu shun ial k'ematdiinakh'. T1akkkha zho'zhakhatina, gena a va'kkkhina, ialsamane vakhiitinarg - i vu tolam ba'kkkhinarg. Du'nenan dakhar ma dats Iekhavaran khIuma ben.

Shu danne zu'ir ma du shun bakhamekh' a, sha'shkakh' a, shuna khazzane a khezar ma du shul kh'alkha shaiga zhaina dellacha'rgaraa, mushrikunashkarakhalakhetarsh. Ash sobar dakh', shu /Delakh/ kkherakh' - bakk'alla a, i du-kkh chIogIachu gIullakkhekh.

Dala bart bira zhaina dellacha'rtsa: ash bilgaldokkkhur du nakhana, ash kh'uldiir dats i a'lla. IdIatesira tsara shaina tIekh'a, tsunakh kIezzig makh iitsira tsara. Ma von khIuma iu-kkh tsara o'tsurg!

Kh'una ma mottalakh' i sha'sh de'nachu'ntsa (dinchu'ntsa - Delan nek'akh nakh d1atilosh) bakkkhiibesh bersh, sha'sh dina dotsuchu'ntsa nakha sha'sh khesto luush bersh, kh'una ma mottalakh' u'sh Iazapakh kIelkh'arabevr bu, - tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap du.
Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dolalla, i Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, stiglanash a, latta a kkhollarekh', bu'isa-de khiitsadalarekh' bilgalonash ma iu kh'ek'al dolcharna.

Ishttanash bu u'sh sha'sh Dela kh'ekhavesh dIakhIittina a, okh'khevshina a, shain agIonashna tIekh' a, oila esh bu u'sh stiglanash a, latta a kkhollaran: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' kkho'llina ma dats khIara erna, Kh'o khastavo okha, lardelakh' tkho /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran Iazapakh.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, bakk'alla a, Akh' tsIerga vo'llinarg, Akh' siisazvinarg vu-kkh iza. Zulamkhoshna ma bats gIo'nchii.

Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, tkhuna khezira tskh'a kkhoikkhush verg, sha /nakh/ iimane kkhoikkhush: iiman dilla shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, bokhush, tIakkkha Okha iiman dillira. Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' gechdelakh' tkhuna tkhan k'inoshna, tsIandelakh' tkho tkhan vochu Iamalekh, tkho daliitalakh' dikacha'rtsa.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' tkhuna daiitalakh' Aikh'a kh'ain elchanashka dou'itur du a'llarg, siisaza ma delakh' tkho k'ematdiinakh', bakk'alla a, Akh' tsa iokhaio - kkh vaIda."

Zhop delira tsarna sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobucho: "As eshor ma iats iinchun Iamal, i stag velakh' a, ia zuda elakh' a, - shu vovshekh du. DIakkhelkhinarsh, shain tsIenoshkara araba'khnarsh, San novk'akh' shaina khalonash khillarsh, sha'sh tIom binarsh, sha'sh tIam tIekh' bellarsh - tsIanbiir bu As u'sh shain vochu Iamalekh, bukhakhula khish lelash dolchu boshmashka bokhu'itur bu As u'sh, - mela bu i Delera. I Dela Shegakh' khaza mela bolush vu".
Kh'o Iekha ma voila i tsateshnarsh makhkakh' dIai-skh'ai lelaro.
KIezzig khIuma du iza. TIakkkha u'sh chug1on bolu mettig zho'zhakhati iu. Ma von tovzhiilaiu iza.

Mukhkha delakh' a, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkho'rush bolcharna boshmash iu, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush, guttar a khir bu u'sh tsu chokh', - Delan gergara kh'eshashna /khaza/ kechdar du iza. Dalla gergakh' derg dika du dika Iamal iinacharna.

Bakk'alla a, zhainan okhIlekh vu Delakh teshash verg, shu'ga dossiinachukh a, shaiga dossiinachukh a teshash verg, Dalla mu'tIakh' a volush. Delan aiatash tsa dukhku tsara kIezzigchu mekhakh. Tsarna shain ial ma iu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh'. I Dela sikha ma vu kh'esap darekh'.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu sobare khilalash, shu sobarekh' iakh'e dovlalash, chIagIlolash vovshashtsa, Delakh kkheralash - dek'alkhila tarlo shu.

KhIai nakh! Shu kkhera sha'sh tskh'ana sinakh (Adamakh) kkho'llina volchu shu Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh. Tso kkho'llina tsunakh tsu'nan zuda (Kh'ava), tsa'rshinnakh Tso barzhiira dukkkha bozharii a, zudarii a. Shu kkhera Delakh, ash Shetsa vovshashka dekharsh desh volchu. Gergarlonashkakh'a /kkhera Delakh/. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khillashuna tIekh' tergamkho.
DIalo boberashna tseran da'khni /u'sh bakkkhii khilcha/. Ma khiitsa bo'khanig tsIenchu'ntsa, ma daa tseran da'khni, shaichukh tokhii. I khilla dokkkha k'a (iza dakkkhiichu k'inoikh du).

Shu kkho'rush delakh' boberashkakh' niiso tsaiarkh, ash balabe shaina dika khetta bolu zudarii: shishsha, kkhokkhkha, ii'-ii'. Sha'sh niiso tsaiarkh kkherakh' - tskh'a', ia shain a'ttu ku'igasha doladiinarg(ialae). I gerga du ash khartso tsaiarna (ia shu pek'ar tsakhilarna (dukkha do'zalsh khilla).
DIalo /sha'sh balosh bolchu/ zudarshna tseran urdo sovgIatana. Tsara shuna tsunakh khIuma ts1enchu daggara iukhalakh', gIoza doiila i ash.
DIa ma lo tIalamban tsakhuucha'rga shain da'khni, Dala shun dakharan bukh bina dolu. Tsunakh daa a, tIe dukha a lo tsarna (boberashna), tsa'rga khaza dosh a ala.

Zie (1alashde) boberash zuda ialorig khillalts. U'sh kkhi'na buila shaina khaadelcha, dIalo tsa'rga tseran da'khni. Ash ma daa i kkhoam tsa besh a, tIalam botsush a, u'sh bakkkhii khilale. Kh'al dolush verg ozaloila /otsu boberiin da'khni daarkh/, miskanig - tso zhimma doiila. Sha'sh tsa'rga tseran da'khni dIalush, tsu tIekh' teshalla khIottade.Dala kkhacho iina kh'esaptsa.

Bozharshna dak'a du das-nanas a, gergarchara a /sha'sh dIakkhelkhina/ bukhaditinchukh, zudarshna a du dak'a das-nanas a, gergarchara a bukhaditinchukh, kIezzig delakh' a i, dukkkha delakh' a - dak'a du farz khilla.
Irsdo'k'uchokh' khilakh' pek'arsh a, /shaina tsunakh irs tsa kkhochu/ gergarnash a, boberash a, miskanash a khilakh' - ritsk' lo tsarna tsunakh, khaza dosh ala tsa'rga.

Kkho'riilau'sh shail tIa'kh'a shain za'1ape do'zal bischa, u'sh g1elonekh' khilarna kkho'rush. U'sh kkho'riila Delakh /shen do'zalna ia boberashna esham khilarkh/, tsara oliila niisa dosh /vala gerga vakhanchu'nga veset niisa de, olii/.
Bakk'alla a, zulamtsa boberiin da'khni duush bersh - u'sh ma bu shain gaish chokh' tsIe iuush, u'sh gIur ma bu /zho'zhakhatin/ ts1erga.

Dala veset do shu'ga shain do'zalshkakh' (tsarna irs dek'arekh'): tskh'ana bozhaberana lo shinna zudaberana kkhochu dak'a. Nagakh' sanna zudariibelakh' /shi' a/ shinnal sov a, tsarna bukhaditina dolchukh kkho dak'a dicha, shi dak'a du. Nagakh' sanna tskh'a' elakh' - tsunna /bukhadisinchukh/ akh du. Dena-nanna - khIoranna tsarakh - ialkhalgIa dak'a du bukhaditinchukh, nagakh' sanna tsu'nan do'zalkho velakh'. Tsu'nan do'zalkho vatsakh' - tsu'nan irs kkhochu tsu'nan dena-nanna, nanna - kkho dak'a dicha, tskh'a dak'a (disinarg das skh'ao'tsu). Nagakh' sanna tsu'nan vezharii belakh', nanna ialkh dak'a dicha, tskh'a dak'a du, /kh'ak'bolcharna irs do'k'ur du/ tso dina vesetkkhochushdinchul tIa'kh'a, dekkharal tIa'kh'a. Shun dai, shun kIentii - shuna tsa kha'a tsarakh mila vu shuna gerga paidekh'. Delera farz du iza. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla Sha khuush a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh a

Shuna a kkhochu akh shun zudarsha bukhaditinchukh, nagakh' sanna tseran do'zalkho vatsakh' (kkhechunna vina, ia shuna vina). Tseran do'zalkho (kkhechunna vina volu, ia shuna vina volu) velakh' - shuna tsara bukhaditinchukh do'alg1a dak'a kkhochu tseran veset kkhochushdinchul tIa'kh'a, dekkharel tIa'kh'a. Tsarna (shu della bukhabisina bolu shun zudarshna) - ash bukhaditinchukh do'alg1a dak'a kkhochu, nagakh' sanna shun do'zalkho (kkhechu zudcho vina, ia tso vina) vatsakh'. Shun do'zalkho velakh' - tsarna ash bukhaditinchukh, borkhIalg1a dak'a kkhochu dina, shun veset kkhochushdinchul tIa'kh'a, dekkharel tIa'kh'a. Nagakh' sanna shegara irs kkhochush volu stag, ia zuda shen da ia do'zalkho votsush velakh' - tsu'nan vasha, ia iishaelakh' - tsu shinnakh khIoranna a, iolkhalg1a dak'a lur du. Nagakh' u'sh tsaral alsam belakh' - u'sh dek'ashkhoi khir bu kkhoalg1achu dek'an, tsu'nan veset kkhochushdinchul tIa'kh'a, dekkharal tIa'kh'a, sha zen tsa desh (tskh'anna sovdokkkhush, vukkhunna eshosh). Delera veset du iza. I Dela ma vu khuush a, sobare a (du'nenakh' sikha taIzar tsa desh k'inosh dincharna).

U'sh du Delan dozanash. Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' verg - i vokhu'itur vu Tso ialsamane, shena bukhakhula khish o'khush iolchu, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar a khir bu. I siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu-kkh.
Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a Iesa verg a, Tsu'nan dozanekh va'llarg a - i vkhiitur vu Tso /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIerga, guttar a tsu chokh' khir volush. Tsunna - siisaza dolu Iazap du.
Shun zudarekh bo'khanigdinarg - shukh veammo teshalla doila tsunna tIekh'. Tsara teshalla dakh' - tsIakh' satsabe u'sh ballalts, ia Dala tskh'a nek' khIottolts.

Shukh shimmo dakh' i (bo'khanig - zina) - ta1zar de tsarna (chovkhortsa a, bekhk bakkkhartsa a, iekh' khetiitartsa a,macha tokhartsa a). Tsara shimmo a toba dakh', dika Iamal iakh', iu'stakhdovlatsarakh. Bakk'alla a, Dela ma khilla sha toba k'obaldesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a

Bakk'alla a, toba k'obaldar du Dalla t1ekh', sha'sh tsa khuush vonash a desh, t1akkkha sikhontsa toba desh bolcharna. Bakk'alla a, tseran toba k'obaldiir du Dala. I Dela khilla khuush verg a, kh'ikmate verg a.
Toba k'obaldiir dats sha'sh vonig decharna, sha'sh bala gerga bakhcha olush bolchu: "KhIintsa as toba di", sha'sh tsa teshash a bolush, bellacharna a. Tsarna Okha kechdina lazosh dolu Iazap.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Kh'anal dats shuna ash zudarii nitsk'atsa irse bitar, khalo ma e tsarna sha'sh tsarna dellachukh (urdokh) tskh'aderg iukhaetsarkh'ama, nagakh' sanna bilggala bo'khanig tsara tIedaiitina datsakh'. Khaza dakha tsa'rtsa. Shuna u'sh bezash tsa khilakh' a /sobare khila tsa'rtsa/. Shuna tskh'a khIuma tsa eza tarlo, Dala tsu chokh' dukkkha dikanash khiliita tarlo.

Shu luush delakh' zudchun metta zuda khiitsa, ash tsarakh tskh'anna dukkkha da'khni della delakh', tsunakh khIumma a iukha ma etsalash. - Ash skh'ao'tsur du iza tk'a dokkkha zulam a, bilgala k'a a desh?
Ash i skh'a mukha o'tsu, shu (maira a, zuda a khilla) vovshashna iuk'adakhana ma khillii? Shu'gara chIogIa vaIdaetsna ma iarii tsara.
Ash ma balabe shun daisha baliina khilla bolu zudarii, kh'alkha dIadakhanarg dotsurg. I khilla bo'khanig, chIogIa irchanig, vuno bo'kha Iadat a.

Shuna (balo) kh'aram bina shun nanoi a, shun io1arii a, shun iizharii a, shun den iizharii a, shun nenan iizharii a, shun veshin io1arii a, shun iishin io1arii a, shu dakkhiina khilla bolu shun nanoia, shun shuriniizharii a, shun zudariin nanoi a, shun tsIenoshkakh' Iesh bolu shun tsa'rtsa gergara iuk'amettig a khilla bolchu zudariin kkhecharna bina bolu mekhkarii a. Shun tsa'rtsa gergara iuk'amettig tsa khillekh' - k'a dats shuna /tseran mekhkarii balo/. Shun chIurakh skh'abevlla bolu shun kIentiin zudarii a, shi iisha vovshakhtokha (tskh'ana ialo) a /kh'aram du shuna/, kh'alkha d1adakhna khillarg dotsurg. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Zudarekh marekh' bersh (kh'aram bina shuna balo), shun a'ttu ku'igasha doladiina botsursh, i tIedillina Dala shuna. Kh'anal bina shuna tsul dekh'akh' bersh, shain bakhamtsa ash lekhcha, shain dogIu urdo dIalush, sharIatsa balosh dolush, zina lelortsa dotsush. Sha'sh tsa'rgara marzo iitsicha- tsarna bogIu makh dIalo farz khilla bolu. Farz kkhochushdina (tsarna dogIu urdo dIadella), shu vovshashtsa reza dolush dinchunna tIekh' (tsara shuna tskh'adolu urdo iukhalush) k'a dats shuna. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ma khilla khuush a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh a.

Shukh mu'lkhachunna tsa magakh' shen tarontsa tsIenabolu mu'min zudarii balo - shain a'ttu ku'igasha doladiinachu shain mu'min mekhkarekh (lekh) balabe. Dalla dika kha'a shun iiman, shu vovshakh /skh'adevlla/ du. Balabe u'sh tseran okhIlan purbantsa, dIalo tseran makh dikantsa, tsIena khillabolu, lelar bo'kha dotsush bolu, dottagI la'tsnabotsush bolu - (zudarii). TIakkkha marekh' bolush tsara bo'khanig daliitakh', tsarna o'zdachu zudarshna dogIuchukh akh Iazap du. I derrige du shukh k'inakh (zinakh) kkho'rush volchunna. Ash sobar dakh' (i zuda tsa ialosh) - i shuna dika du. I Dela gechdesh verg a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Dalla la'a shuna bilgaldakkkha, shul kh'alkha khillachiin novk'a shu nisdan, shun toba k'obaldan. I Dela khuush a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh a vu.
Tsu Dalla la'a shun toba k'obaldan. /Shain/ dezarshna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush bolcharna la'a shu /tsIenchukh/ dukkkha genadovla.
Shuna tIera /khalonash/ iai'ian la'a Dalla. Adam kkho'llina za'Iap.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Vovshiin da'khni ma daalash khartsontsa, shun vovshiin rezallitsa iokhka-etsar iatsakh'. Sha'sh ma daia. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla shu'tsa k'inkhetame.
MostagIallitsa, zulamtsa i dinarg, t1a'kh'a Okha chuverzor vu tsIerga. I khilla Dalla atta (i Dalla atta du).
Shaina nekhIadina dolu dakkkhii k'inosh ash iu'stakhtattakh', kegiicharna (kegiichu k'inoshna) Okha gechdiir du shuna, chudokhu'itur du shu siilakh'chu chugIoilina (ialsamane).

Shuna ma deziila Dala shukh tskh'abolcharna vukkharal bazbina dellarg. Bozharshna dak'a du sha'sh karadiinachukh, zudarshna a dak'a du tsara sha'sh karadiinachukh. Ash Dele dekha Tsu'nan koma'rshallakh. I Dela khilla (vu) masso a khIuma Sha khuush.

KhIoranna Okha khiliitina das-nanas a, gergarchara a bukhaditinchukh irso'tsurg. Shun duinasha chIagIbinacharna (kh'alkha ash shaina irs lur du, a'lla, vaIda iina khilla bolu dottagIii), - dIalo tsarna tseran dak'a. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla masso a khIumanna t1ekh' tesh.

Bozharii tIekhIittinabu zudarshna, Dala tskh'abersh vukkharal bazbartsa a, tsara shain bakhamakh kharzh iartsa a. Dika zudarii bu - / Dalla a, shain maroshna a/ mu'tIakh' bersh, sha'sh lardeshbersh /maroshna/ guchakh' dotsurg Dala larde alarna. Shu - tseran Iesallekh kkho'rush dersh - kh'ekham be tsarna, /tsunakh paida tsa khilakh'/ bita u'sh mettakh', /tsunakh a paida tsa khilakh'/ tokha tsarna (kh'ekham khiliitarna, lazorna dotsush). TIakkkha u'sh shuna mu'tIakh' khilakh' - nek' ma bokhabe tsarna. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla lekkha verg a, vokkkha verg a

Shu kkherakh' (maran a (mairachun), zudchun a) iukk'ekh' bart bokharkh, kkhaikkha kh'ek'ale bersh tsu'nan (maran) nakhana iukk'era a, zudchun nakhana iukk'era a. Maslakh'atluush i shi' delakh', Dala a'tto biir bu tsarna iukk'ekh'. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla (masso a khIuma) khuush verg a, /k'ailakha derg/ dika khuush verg a.

Dalla Iibadat de, nak'ost ma latsa Tsunna tskh'ana a khIumantsa, dena-nanna a dika khila, gergarcharna a, boberashna a, miskacharna a, gergara volchu lulakhochunna a, gergara votschu (khiirachu) lulakhochunna a, ag1or nak'ostanaa, nek'an nak'ostanaa, shain a'ttu ku'igasha doladiinacharnaa /dika khila/. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa veza dekk'a shetsa tamash besh verg a, kura verg a.
Pis bersh a, nakhana piskhila, a'lla, omra desh bersh a, Dala shaiga daiitina dolchu koma'rshallakhkh'uldesh bersh a /tsa beza Dala/ - Okha kechdina tsateshacharna siisaza dolu Iazap.
Shain da'khni nakhana gaitarkh'ama sagIina dokkkhush bersh a, sha'sh Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a teshash botsush /tsa beza Dalla/, shena shaitIa dottagI khillarg - von dottagI khilla tsunakh.
KhIun dara tsarna Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a teshcha, Dala shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh sagIa delcha? I Dela u'sh bevzash ma khilla.
Bakk'alla a, i Dela misk'ala zarratal, zulam desh ma vats. I (misk'ala zarrat) dika khilakh' - i t1ett1a alsamdokkkhu Tso, Shegara iokkkha ial lo.
Mukha khir du Okha masso a ummatakh /tskh'atstsa/ tesh valiina, kh'o khIokkharna tIekh' tesh valiicha?
Tsu diinakh' tsateshacharna a, elchanna Iesalla iinacharna a luur du latta sha'shtsa nisdalar. Kh'uldiir dats tsara Delakh /tskh'azhimma a du'nenakh' sha'shtsa/ khillarg.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu lamazna gerga ma gIolash, shu dekhna a dolush, sha'sh du'itsurg shaina tsa khaakh'; shaitsa bo'kha khi delakh'a - tsa lu'ichush, sha'sh novk'akhula /khi dotsuchukhula/ lelash datsakh', ia /ma'zhdiga chokh' tsa sovtsush/ chekkhdovlush datsakh'. Shu khillekh' tsomgush, ia novk'akh', ia shukh tskh'a' kh'ashtag1anera (khinarara) veana velakh', ia shu zudarekh kh'akkhadelladelakh' - tIakkkha shuna khi tsa karadakh' - temade tsIenchu la'ttatsa /ia gIamartsa/. Shain iakhkh'ekh a, ku'igekh kh'akkha i. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla k'inkhetame a, gechdesh a.
Kh'una tsa go i shaina zhainakh /tskh'a/ dak'a dellarsh? Sha'sh tiladalar o'tsu tsara, shu a nek'akh tiladala la'a tsarna.
Dalla dika bevza shun mostagIii. Dala kkhacho iina /shun/ valikhilartsa, Dala kkhacho iina /shun/ gIo'ncha khilartsa.

Zhu'gtiin dinekh' khillacharekh bu sha'sh doshshen mettigera dIadokkkhush bersh. Tsara olu: "Khezna tkhuna /kh'an dosh/, Iesa du tkho /kh'an omrana/", "LadogIa akh' - khozu'itur dats kh'una /vonig/", "RaIina"mattatsa k1eda olush, /islam/ dinna 1ittarsh esh. Tsara a'llekh'ara: "Khezna tkhuna, mu'tIakh' khilla tkho, ladogIa, kh'azha tkho'ga (tkhan gIaigIa be)"- tsarna dika khir dara, chIogIa a /khir dara/. Mukhkha delakh' a, Dala neIalt a'lla tsarna u'sh tsatesharna. Ma teshash bats u'sh tskh'a kIezzig(bersh) ben.

KhIai shaiga zhaina dellarsh! Shu tesha Okha dossosh khillachukh (K'ur'anakh), sha bak'desh dolu shu'tsa derg (Tavrat a, Inzhil a) Okha iakhkh'ash nisiina tIekh'a erzaiale, ia neIalt alale, sho'tan diinan daishnama-allara. Delan gIullakkh kkhochushkhilla.
Bakk'alla a, Dala gech tsa do Shetsa nak'ost latsarna, Tso gech ma do i dotsurg Shena lu'chunna. Milla a velakh' a, Delatsa nak'ost lotsush - deza-dokkkha k'a kkho'llina (dina) tso.
Kh'una tsa go i sha'sh tsIanbesh bersh? Dala tsIanviir ma vu Shena luurg. Tsu'rrig a zulam diir ma dats tsarna.
Kh'azhal kh'o, mukha kkhullu tsara Dalla tIekh' khartsderg! Kkhacho khili tsunakh bilggala k'a khilartsa.
Kh'una tsa go shaina zhainakh dak'a dellarsh - u'sh teshash bu dzhibtekha, tIagIutakha, tsara olu tsateshacha'rga: "Shu du niisachu novk'akh' /Mukh'ammadan Dele/ iiman dillincharal"
U'sh ma bu Dala shaina neIalt a'llarsh. Dala neIalt a'llachunna kh'una tsk'a a karor ma vats gIo'ncha.
Ia shaina mulkakh dak'a dolush bu u'sh? Tsara lur ma dats nakhana chamkhalg a.
Ia nakhana kh'agI io-te tsara, Dala tsarna Shen koma'rshallakh dellachunna tIekh'? Okha delira IbrakhIiman do'zalna zhaina a, kh'ek'alalla a. Deza-dokkkha mulk (da'khni) dellera Okha tsarna.
Tsarakh (zhu'gtekh) tsunakh (tsu Dala dossiinachu zhainakh - K'ur'anakh) teshnarg a vu. Tsarakh tsunna du'kh'alva'llarg a vu. Kkhacho khilla zho'zhakhatitsa /u'sh bago/ tsIe khilar.

Bakk'alla a, i Tkhan aiatekh tsatesharsh - tIakkkha bokhu'itur bu Okha u'sh tsIerga. Tseran chk'o'rnash da'gna mel deli Okha u'sh khiitsor du kkhechu chk'o'rnashtsa tsa'rga Iazap Iovshiitarkh'ama. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla nu'tsk'ala a, kh'ukam /niisa / desh a.

Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a - tIakkkha u'sh chubokhu'itur bu Okha boshmashka (ialsamane), shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu. U'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bu. Tsu chokh' tsarna tsIena zudarii khir bu. Okha chubokhu'itur bu u'sh du'k'achu IindagIe.

Dala omra do shu'ga, shaiga teshame ella khIumanash dIaerzor shain daishka, nakhana iukk'ekh' sha'sh kh'ukam desh, i kh'ukam dar niisontsa. Bakk'alla a, i Dela - ma khaza du Tso shu'ga shetsa kh'ekham besh derg! Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla khezash verg a, gush verg a.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu mu'tIakh' khilalash Dalla, shu mu'tIakh' khilalash elchanna a, shukh gIullakkh karakh' dolcharnaa. Tskh'ana khIumanna tIekh' shun k'iisam khilakh', ash i d1aderzadelash Dele a, elchane a, sha'sh Delakh a, tIa'kh'archu diinakh a teshash delakh'. I dika a du, khazachu kepara dastar a du.

Kh'una tsa go i sha'sh kh'o'ga dossiinachukh a, kh'ol kh'alkha dossiinachukh a teshash bu mo'ttush bersh? U'sh luush ma bu shaina iukk'ekh' kh'ukam doila tIagIuta. Tsa'rga omra ma dina tsunakh (tIagIutakh) ma tesha, a'lla. ShaitIa ma du luush u'sh tilo gennarchu tilartsa.
Tsa'rga a'lcha: "TIedu'ila Dala dossiinachu'nga a, elchanna a (skh'adu'ila, kh'ukam doitu vai K'ur'ane a, elchane a)", kh'una ma go i munepik'ashdIabo'rzush kh'o volchura /sikhachu/ berzartsa.

Mukha khir du tsarna tIe tskh'a bala be'cha, shain ku'igasha kechbina bolu, t1akkkha u'sh kh'una tIe ba'khkicha, sha'sh Delatsa duinash buush: "Tkho ma datsara luush dikanig a, kkhiam khilar a ben", - olush?
U'sh ma bu Dalla shain degnashkakh' derg khuush bersh. Iu'stakhvala kh'o tsarakh, kh'ekham be tsarna, ala tsa'rga /u'sh/ k1orgga kkhetosh dolu dosh.

Tskh'a a elcha tsa vaiitina Okha tsunna /nakh/ mu'tIakh' khilarkh'ama ben, Delan laamtsa. U'sh khillekh'ara sha'sh shaina zulam dicha, kh'una tIe bogIush, t1akkkha Dele gechdar do'khush, elchano a gechdar dekhcha, tsarna i Dela karor ma vara shain toba k'obaldiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu (Delora) ma bats u'sh /Delakh/ teshash shaina iuk'ado'zhnachunna tIera kh'ukam kh'o'ga doitush batsakh', tIakkkha a akh' iinchu kkhielana shaigakh' khIumma novk'arlo tsa karosh, sha'sh tsunna mu'tIakh' khu'lush batsakh'.

Okha tsarna tIedillina khillekh'ara, sha'sh daia a'lla ia aradovla shain tsIenoshkara a'lla, tsarakh kIezzig bolchara ben i diir ma datsara. Shaina kh'o'khush derg tsara dakh'ara - i dika a, deliltsa chIogIa a ma dara.
TIakkkha Tkhaina gergara siilakh'-iokkkha ial lur ma iara tsarna Okha.
Niisachu novk'a bikhkina khir ma bara Okha u'sh.

Dalla a, elchanna a mu'tIakh' bersh - u'sh khir bu Dala shaina niImat dellacha'rtsa tskh'ana: paikhamarshtsa, uggar bak'lu'icha'rtsa, gIazotekh' bellacha'rtsa, dikacha'rtsa. Ma khaza khili u'sh shaina nak'ost khilartsa!
I dozalla Delera du, kkhacho khilla Dela khuush verg khilar.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Larlush khilalash, gIazotana aradovlalash tobanashtsa a, ia derrige a.

Bakk'alla a, shukh ma vu sha /gIazotana/ tIa'kh'avu'sush verg. Shuna tskh'a bokham khilcha, olu tso: "Ma niImat della suna Dala so tsarna iukk'ekh' (gIazotekh') tsakhilarna" (khillekh'ara, so laziina ia vella khir vara).

Shuna Delera siilalla khilcha, bilggala olu tso, shuna a, shena a iukk'ekh' bezam botsush sanna: "Ma dek'aza khili-kkh so, tsa'rtsa khila tsa megara so - beza - bokkkha tolam as a bokkkhur ma barii tIakkkha".
Delan novk'akh' tIomboila sha'sh ekhartakh gergara (du'nenan) dakhar dukhkuchara. Delan novk'akh' tIom bina vellarg a, ia tolam ba'kkkhinarg a - tIakkkha lur iu Okha tsunna siilakh'-iokkkha ial.

Ash khIunda tsa bo t1om Delan novk'akh' a, bozharekh a, zudarekh a, berekh a za'Iap bolchu nekhan du'kh'a a? U'sh ma bui olush: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Aradakha tkho khIokkkhu iu'rtara, shena chu'ra nakh zulame bolchu, kh'an gergara veras (gIolotsurg) vaiitakh'a tkhuna, kh'an gergara gIo'ncha vaiitakh'a tkhuna"
Iiman dillinchara tIom bo Delan novk'akh', tsateshachara tIom bo tIagIutan (shaitIanan) novk'akh'. ShaitIanan verasash khIallakbe. Bakk'alla a, i shaitIanan mekarlo ledara ma khilla.

Kh'una tsa go i shaiga a'llarsh: "Iukhadakha shain ku'igash (tIamakh: tIom bar ma dekha khIintsa a - tsu'nan khan tIe tsa kkha'chna), lamaz khIottade, zakat lo", shaina tIom bar tIedillicha, tsarakh tskh'a toba kkhiirira nakhakh, Delakh kkherarkh sanna, ia kkhin a chIogIa. Tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, khIunda tIedillina Akh' tkhuna tIom bar. Tskh'a gergara zamane tIa'kh'ata'ttina khillekh'ara Akh' tkho". Akh' ala: "Du'nenan khIuma - kIezzig khIuma iu. Ekhart du dika sha /Delakh/ kkho'ruchunna. Tskh'a tsu'rrig a zulam diir ma dats shuna".

Shu michchakh'a khilakh' a, dalar tIekkhu'ur du shukh, chIogIa khIittiina bIa'vnash chokh' shu khilcha a. Shaiga dikanig de'cha, tsara olu: "KhIara Delera du", nagakh' sanna shaiga vonig de'cha, tsara olu: "KhIara kh'o'gara du / kh1ai paikhamar, akh'a du'itsu kh1umanash bakh'anekh'/". Akh' ala: "Masso a du Delera". KhIun du-te tsu k'omana? - Kkheta tsa tu'gu-kkh iza khu'luchukh.

Kh'una tIedeana dolu dikanig - Delera du kh'una /khIai adam/, kh'una tIedeana dolu vonig - kh'o'gara du kh'una /akh' desh dolu vonig bakh'anekh'/. Okha vaiitina kh'o /khIai Mukh'ammad/ nakhana tIe elcha khilla. Kkhacho khilla Delatsa tesh khilar.
Elchanna mu'tIakh' khillarg - Dalla mu'tIakh' khilla, iukhava'llarg- kh'o tsa vaiitina Okha tsarna tIekh' tergo esh vergkhilla.

Olu tsara: "Mu'tIakh' khir du". Kh'o volchu'ra dIaiirzicha, tsarakh tskh'ana tobano busa lelado akh' ma de a'llarg. I Dela d1aiazdesh ma vu i tsara busa lelosh derg. Bita u'sh (dIak'asta tsarakh), Dalla tIetovzha. Delatsa kkhacho khilla sha tIetevzhash volchunna.
K'ur'anakh oila tsa io-te tsara? Iza Dela votschu'ngara khilcha, tsu chokh' dukkkha khilpalonashkaror ma iarii tsarna.

Kkheramtsakhilarkh a, ia kkheramakh a tskh'a gIullakkh shaiga de'cha - i darzhado tsara. Tsara i derzadakh'ara elchane a, shaina iukk'era gIullakkh karakh' dolcha'rga a - tIakkkha tsarakh tsu'nan bukha tIekkhu'ucharna khuur dara /bak'derg/. Delan koma'rshalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a shaina tsa khillekh', tskh'a kIezzig bersh botsursh shaitIanna tIekh'akhIu'ttur ma dara shu.

TIom be /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ Delan novk'akh'. Akh' zhop lur dats dekk'a kh'aikha ben. Mu'min nekhan degnash aide /tIamna/, Dala satso tarlo tsateshacheran nitsk'. I Dela chIogIa ma vu nitsk'atsa a, i chIogIa ma vu bekkhamtsa a.
Khazchu gIillakkhan agIo la'tsnachunna - tsunakh dak'a du, vochu gIillakkhan agIo la'tsnachunna - tsunakh mokh' khir bu. I Dela khilla masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush.
Shaiga salam delcha, tsul khazchu'ntsa salam lo ash ia iukhaderzade i. Bakk'alla a, i Dela ma khilla masso a khIumanna tergo esh.
AllakhI tsIe iolu tskh'a Dela vu - kkhin dela vats I ben. Tso derrige a guldiir du shu k'ematdiinakh', tsu chokh' sheko iats. Mila vu tk'a Delal khabar bak'du'itsush?

KhIunda khilla shu munepik'ashkakh' shi toba? Dala /shu shena t1ekh' dolchu bak'dolchukh/ dIaberzina u'sh sha'sh dinarg bakh'anekh'. Shu luush du nisvan Dala tilavala vitinarg? Dala tilavala vitinarg - kh'una karor ma bats tsunna nek' /i nisvan/.

Tsarna diizira shu iimanakh iukhadovlar, sha'sh iukhadovlarkh terra, tIakkkha shu khir dara tskh'aniisa. Ma letsa tsarakh dottagIii, u'sh Delan novk'akh' dIakkhalkhkhalts. Nagakh' sanna u'sh du'kh'albovlakh', skh'aletsa u'sh, khIallakbe u'sh shaina karaba'khkkinchokh'. Tsarakh dottagI a, gIo'ncha a ma latsa.

Sha'sh shuna a, shaina iukk'ekh' a bart bolchu k'omana tIeba'khkinarsh botsursh; ia shuna tIeba'khkinarsh a, shain dagakh' dotsush shu'tsa ia /shuna du'kh'al dolchu shain/ k'omatsa tIom ban g1ertash botsursh a. /Shu'tsa a, shuna du'kh'al a botsursh/. Dalla li'na khillekh'ara, Tso shuna tIekhIittor bara u'sh - tsara shu'tsa tIom biir bara. U'sh shukh dIak'astakh' - tsara shu'tsa tIom biir bats, shu'tsa mashar biir bu tsara. Shuna tsa bina Dala tsarna tIekh' nek' (tsa'rtsa t1om ban bak'o iats shun).

Kkhin tskh'abersh karor bu shuna, sha'sh luush shu'tsa teshame khila a, shain k'omatsa (kerstanashtsa) teshame khila a, sha'sh pitanema-kkhaikkkhina, tsu chu bulush. U'sh shukh dIa tsa berzakh' (shu'tsa t1om tsa besh), shu'tsa mashar tsa bakh', shain ku'igash shuna /tIekkhiidochukh/ tsa sovtsadakh', skh'aletsa u'sh, khIallakbe u'sh shaina karaba'khkkinchokh'. Tsarna tIekh' Okha shuna bilggala nek'bina (tsa'rtsa tIom ban mega shuna).

Tsa khilla /tsk'a a megash/ mu'min stagana mu'min stag ver, gIalatva'lla ben. Tskh'ammo gIalatva'lla mu'min stag vekh', mu'min lai pargIatvokkkhur vu (iokkkhur iu) tso, tsu'nan okhIlanna d1alush dolu diiatlur du tso, tsara /tsunna gechdina/ sagIina tsa ditakh'. Nagakh' sanna i (i tsa khuush vellarg) khillekh' shu'tsa mostagIalla dolchu k'omakh, sha mu'mina volush - mu'min lai pargIatvokkkhur vu (iokkkhur iu). I khilakh' shena a, shuna a iukk'ekh' bart (mashar) bolchu k'omakh-d1alush dolu diiat lur du tsu'nan okhIlanna, mu'min lai pargIatvokkkhur vu. I tsa karadakh', tIettIa shina battakh' markhanash kkhobur du, Delera gechdar do'khush. I Dela Sha khuush a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh a khilla.

Tskh'ammo shena khu'ushekh' mu'min stag vekh', tsunna bekkham - zho'zhakhati iu, tsu chokh' i guttar la'ttar volush, Dela o'gIaz a vakhana tsunna, neIalt a a'lla, Tso kechdina tsunna deza-dokkkha Iazap.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Sha'sh Delan novk'akh' aradevlla dolush, ash bilgaldakkkha: shaiga salam dellachu'nga ma ala: "Kh'o mu'min vats", du'nenan dakharan bakhame dogdokhush - Dalla gergakh' iokkkha khIons iu. Ishtta khilla shu kh'alkha - Dala shuna niImat della. Ash bilgaldakkkha. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khilla ash diirig dika khuush.

Tskh'aterra bats mu'min nakhakh sha'sh gIazotakh tskh'a a bakh'ana dotsush bukhabu'sursh a, sha'sh shain kh'olatsa a, shain sinoshtsa a, Delan novk'akh' gIazot desh bersh a. Shain kh'olatsa a, shain sinoshtsa a gIazot desh bersh darzhatsa bazbina Dala bukhabu'sucharal. KhIoranna Dala vaIda iina khazanig (ialsamane) iala. GIazot desh bersh bazbina Dala bukhabu'sucharal siilakh' - iokkkhachu iolatsa (bokkkha mela balartsa).
Shegarchu darzhashtsa, gechdartsa, k'inkhetamtsa /bazbina Tso u'sh/. Dela khilla Sha gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Bakk'alla a, shaina zulamash dina, malikasha dIaetsna bolcha'rgaer ma du: "Shu michakh' khillera?" Tsara er du: "Tkho khillera la'ttakh' (du'nenakh') dolush kkhechara tkhuna tIekh' nitsk' besh". Er du: "Tk'a Delan latta shortta datsara shu kkhechukh'a dIakkhalkha?" U'sh ma bu shain chugIoila zho'zhakhati ersh. Ma von khilla-kkh /tseran/ kkhollam!
Bozharekh a, zudarekh a, berekh a shaina nitsk' khilla /dIabakha/, taro tsa khillarsh a, kIelkh'arbovla nek' tsa kariinarsh a botsursh (tsarna gechdan tam bu Dala).
Tsarna bekhk tsa billa a, gechdan a tarlo Dala. I Dela khilla k'inkhetame a, gechdesh verg a.

Delan du'kh'a dIakkhelkhinchunna la'ttakh' karor ma iu dukkkha tIetovzhiilash a, shorto a. Dalla a, elchanna a du'kh'alvo'dush shen tsIera arava'lcha, tsunakh valar khilcha (i novk'akh' velcha) - tsu'nan ialDalla tIeio'zhna. I Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a khilla.

Shu la'ttakhula devlla lelash, shuna k'a dats ash lamaz dotstsa dicha, nagakh' shu kkho'rush delakh' tsateshachara shaina pitana darna (tIelatarna). Bakk'alla a, tsatesharsh khilla shuna bilggala mostagIii.

Kh'o (paikhamar) tsarna iukk'ekh' volush, tsarna lamazna kh'alkha khIo'tticha, tsarakh tskh'a toba kh'o'tsa khIuttiila, shain gerz skh'ao'tsiila. U'sh suzhude bakhcha (tseran rakaIat chekkhda'lcha), shuna tIekh'a kkhibersh khIu'ttiila. TIakkkha lamaz daza toba iogIiila (kh'una tIekh'akh' lamaz dan). Tsara lamaz doila kh'o'tsa larlush, gerz a skh'ao'tsiila tsara. Tsa tesharsh luush bara shu shain gerzakh a, khIumanekh gIopal (tergo tsa esh) khu'liila - tIakkkha u'sh shuna tIekkhu'ur bara tskh'a gIulch. Shuna k'a dats, nagakh' sanna shuna tsatam belakh' dogIa bakh'anekh', ia shu tsomgush delakh', ash shain gerz okh'adillarkh. Shu larlush khila. Bakk'alla a, Dala kech ma dina tsateshacharna siisaza dolu Iazap.

Sha'sh lamaz kkhochushdicha, Dela kh'akhave irakh' a, okh'akhi'na a, shain agIoshna tIetevzhina a. Sha'sh kkheramakh kh'alkhadevlcha, lamaz khIottade (kkhochchush). Bakk'alla a, lamaz khilla mu'min nakhana khan to'khna tIedillina.

Shu ledara ma khilalash /sha'shtsa mostagIalla iolu/ nakh lakha (gIazot dan). Shu lazosh khilarkh, u'sh a lazosh ma bu, shu lazosh sanna. Shu-m Delera tsara dog tsa dokhuchu khIumanedogdokhush a du. I Dela khilla Sha khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossiina kh'o'ga zhaina, bak'ontsa akh' nakhana iukk'ekh' kh'ukam darkh'ama Dala kh'aina gaitinchu'ntsa. Kh'o ma khilalakh' iamartkhoin du'kh'a k'u'isush.
Dele gechdar dekha. Bakk'alla a, Dela khilla gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Akh' ma k'iisalakh' sha'sh iamartlo esh bolcheran du'kh'a. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa veza k'inosh dartsa iamartlo esh verg.
U'sh dIakh'ullush bu nakhakh, dIakh'ullush bats Delakh, tk'a Iza u'sh gush vu, tsara busa I reza votsu deshnash du'itsush. Dela khilla tsara dinchunna go lotsush verg.
KhIai, shu ma du tseran du'kh'a du'nenan dakharekh' k'u'isush. Kh'an k'u'isur du Delatsa tseran dukh'a k'ematdiinakh'? Ia mila khir vu tsarna tIekh' vekal /tseran g1arolkho/?
Milla velakh' a vonig desh, ia shena zulam desh, tIakkkha tso Dele gechdar dekhcha, tsunna i Dela karor ma vu gechdesh a, k'inkhetame a.
Milla velakh' a k'a desh - i desh du tso shena. Dela khilla khuush verg a, kh'ukam/niisa/ desh verg a.
Milla velakh' a gIalat ia k'a desh, tIakkkha i tsIenavolchunna tIeto'ttush - i ma vu ircha khartsderg a, bilggala k'a a shena tIelotsush.

Delan koma'rshalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a kh'una tsa khillekh'ara - tsarakh tskh'a toba ma iara kh'o tilo luush. Tsara-m tilor batsara sha'sh ben. Tskh'a khIumma a tsara zen diir dats kh'una. Dala kh'o'ga dossiina zhaina a, kh'ek'alalla a, Tso Iamiira kh'una kh'una tsa khuush khillarg. Iokkkha khilla kh'una t1ekh' Delan koma'rshalla.

Dukkhadolchu tseran k'ailakhchu k'amelekh paida bats, nagakh' sanna sag1itsa, dikanig dartsa, nakhana iukk'ekh' bart bartsa omra desh u'sh batsakh'. I desh verg milla a velakh' a, Dela reza khilare dog a dokhush, tIakkkha Okha tsunna lur ma iu siilakh'- iokkkha ial.

Milla velakh' a, elchanna du'kh'alva'llarg, shena niisa nek' bilgalba'llachul tIa'kh'a, mu'min botsu nekhan nek'ana tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg - i vu'tur vu Okha sha kha'rzhinchu novk'akh', vokhu'itur vu zho'zhakhati chu. Ma von khilla i tsu'nan kkhollam!
Bakk'alla a, Dala gechdesh dats Shetsa nak'ost latsar, gechdiir du i dotsurg /kkhin k'inosh/ Shena luuchunna. Milla velakh' a Delatsa nak'ost lotsush - tilavella i genarchu tilavalartsa.
Iza a vitina, u'sh kkhoikkhush ma bu stechu khIumanashka, u'sh kkhoikkhush ma bu du'kh'alda'llachushaitIane.
Dala neIalt a'lla tsunna. Tso (ibliso Dele) a'llera: "Kh'an lekh tskh'a bilggala dak'a saigakh'a dokkkhur du as.

Tillanne a tilor bu as u'sh, khazanne - oibur bu as tseran /kharts/ laamash, omra diir ma du as tsarna - bezhniin lergash khedor ma du tsara, omra diir ma du as tsarna - khu'itsur ma du tsara Delan din" (kkhollar). Dela a vitina, i shaitIa shena dottagI la'tsnarg - eshna i k'a'stinchu eshamtsa.
VaIda io tso tsarna, kharts laamash daga kkhu'ssu tsarna. ShaitIano tsarna vaIda esh ma iats khartsderg ben.
U'sh bu shaina chugIoila zho'zhakhati khir ersh, karor dats tsarna tsunakh kIelkh'ardovlar.

Tk'a iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalash iinarsh a - Okha chubokhu'itur bu u'sh /ialsamanin/ boshmashka, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush iolchu. Tsigakh' u'sh guttar khir bu - Delan vaIda bak' khilartsa. Tk'a mila vu Delal dosh bak' olush? (Kh'enan dosh du Delan dashal bak'?) - /tskh'a a vats/.
Shun laamashtsa a, zhainan okhIlananlaamashtsa a dats iza. Milla velakh' a, vonig desh - tsu'ntsa bekkham biir bu tsunna. Karor vats tsunna Dela votsurg verasa, gIo'ncha a.
Milla velakh' a, dika Iamalsh esh, bo'rsha i velakh' a, ia zuda elakh' a, sha mu'min (iiman dillinarg) volush - u'sh chu gIur bu /ialsamanin/ besha. Tskh'a- tsu'rrig zulam diir dats tsarna.

Mila vu khaza dintsa, sha dika 1amal a esh, shen iu'kh' Dalla mu't1akh' a iina, sha bak'dolchunna tIetevzhina khillachu IbrakhIiman millatana tIa'kh'a khIo'ttina khillachul sov? Dala dottagI letsira IbrakhIim.
Delan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Dela khilla masso a khIuma chulotsush /Shen 1ilmantsa/.

Kh'o'ga kh'ekham bo'khush bu u'sh zudariin kh'ok'ekh'. Akh' ala: "Dala kh'ekham biir bu shuna tseran kh'ok'ekh' a, /dovziitur du shuna/ zudarii ash shaina irsanakkhachorakh la'tsna, K'ur'ana chokh' do'shush derg a, /ishtta dovziitur du shuna/ bailakh' disinchu zudaberekh a, shu shaina u'sh balo luush, tsarna dogIu urdo kkhochchush dala tsa luush bolchu, za'Iap khilla kIelbisinchiin beriin kh'ok'ekh' a /kh'ekham biir bu Dala/: ash niiso lattae boberashkakh'. Ash dikanig dakh' - i Dela i khuush khilla".

Nagakh' sanna zuda kkho'rush khilakh', maira shekh khervala gIertarkh, shega tidam tsakhilarkh - tsarna shinna (mairachunna a, zudchunna a) a k'a dats vovshii iukk'ekh' maslakh'at darkh, maslakh'at to'lush du. BIa'rmetsigalla la'ttash iu sinoshtsa. Shu dika khilakh', shu Delakh kkho'rush khilakh' - i Dela ma khilla ash diirig dika khuush.

Shuna tsk'a a nitsk' kkhochur bats zudarshna iukk'ekh' niiso ian, shuna mel li'cha a. DIa ma derza /shaina tsa ezachu zudchukh/ kkhochchush, ash i iu'tush /khIavaekh'/ kkhazaellarg sanna. Ash maslakh'at dakh', shu Delakh kkherakh' - i Dela khilla gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
I shi' (maira a, zuda a) k'astakh' - Dala lur du /tsarakh/ khIoranna Shen shortta dolchukh. I Dela khilla shortta (niImat) dolush a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh a.

Tsu Delan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Okha veset dina shul kh'alkha zhaina daiitincha'rga a, shu'ga a Delakh kkhera, a'lla. Ash kerstadakh'- tsu Delan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. I Dela khilla kh'al dolush verg a, Shena khastam besh verg a.
Delan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Delatsa kkhacho khilla /Shen lain Iamalsh/ Ialash esh verg khilar.
Shena li'cha, shu dIadokhur du Tso, khIai nakh, kkhibersh balor bu. Khilla Dela tsunna tIekh' nitsk' bolush.
Du'nenan mela bezash milla velakh' a, Delan bu du'nenan mela a, ekhartan mela a. Dela khilla khezash verg a, gush verg a.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu khilalash chIogIa dIakhIittina niisontsa teshalla desh Dalla - shena tIekh' delakh' a, ia shain dena-nanna tIekh' delakh' a, ia gergarcharna tIekh' delakh' a. I /shena t1ekh' teshalla desh verg/ kh'al dolush velakh' a, ia pek'ar velakh' a - Dela vu tsu shinnal /leram ban/ kh'ak' verg (dika khuush vu tsarna shinna paidane derg; u'sh shi' a Ialashbiirig Dela vu). Shu tIa'kh'a ma khIittalash degan dezarshna - shu /bak'dolchukh/ dIatovzha kkheramna. Ash /teshalla/ khiitsadakh' ia /i teshalla dan shu/ du'kh'al khilakh' - bakk'alla a, i Dela ma khilla ash diirig dika khuush.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu tesha Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a, Tso shen elchane dossosh khillachu zhainakh a, Tso kh'alkha dossiinachu zhainakh a. Delakh a, Tsu'nan malikekh a, Tsu'nan zhainekh a, Tsu'nan elchanekh a, TIa'kh'archu diinakh a tsateshnarg - i tila ma vella genarchu (k1orggerachu) tilartsa.

Bakk'alla a, i teshash khillarsh, tIakkkha kerstadesh, iukha a teshash, iukha a kerstadesh, tIakkkha kerstadartsa sovbu'ilush bersh - Dela vats tsarna gechdiir dolush a, u'sh nisbiir bolush a niisachu novk'a.
Akh' kkha' bakkkha munepik'ashka tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap khilartsa.
Ishttanash bu u'sh, mu'min nakh bitina, tsa teshash bersh shaina dottagIii liitsinarsh. Siilalla lo'khu-te tsara tsa'rgakh'? Bakk'alla a, siilalla errige a Delan ma iu!

Tso (Dala) shu'ga zhaini chokh' masiittaza dossosh khilla: nagakh' sanna shuna Delan aiatash khartsdesh a, siisazdesh a khazakh', tsa'rtsa okh'a ma khovsha, a'lla, - u'sh kkhechu khabarna tIeberzzalts. Vu'shta, - shu, bakk'alla a, u'sh sanna du. Bakk'alla a, tsu Dala gulbiir bolush ma bu munepik'ash a, tsatesharsh a zho'zhakhati chokh' - berrige a.

U'sh bu shu tergaldesh Iash. Shuna Delera tolam khilcha, tsara olu: "Tk'a tkho a datsara shu'tsa?" Nagakh' sanna tsateshacharna dak'a khilcha, olu: "Tkho datsara shuna gIo dan gIertash, shu Ialashdesh mu'min nakhakh?" Dala kh'ukam diir du shuna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh'. Tsk'a a tsateshacharna mu'min nakhana tIekh' nek' lur bats Dala.
Bakk'alla a, i munepik'ash Dela Iekho gIerta. I vu u'sh Iekhosh. Sha'sh lamazna khIitticha, u'sh khIu'ttu malloi (tsa luush), nakhana sha'sh gaitarkh'ama, kIezzig ben Dela tsa kh'ekhavo tsara.

U'sh lestash (d1asakh'iizash) bu otsunna (iimanna a, kerstanallina a) iukk'ekh': khIokkharakh a (mu'min nakhakh a) tsa kkheta, vukkharakh a (kerstanekh a) tsa kkheta. Sha Dala tilvala vitinchunna kh'una karronne a karor ma bats /i nisvan/ nek'.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash ma letsa tsatesharsh, dottagIii bai, mu'min nakh bitii. Shu luush du Dala shaina tIekh' bilggala delildan?
Bakk'alla a, munepik'ash khir ma bu /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran uggar bukharchu t1eg1anna (g1ata) t1ekh', kh'una karonne a karor ma vats tsarna gIo'ncha.
Sha'sh toba a dina, dikanash a dina, Delatsa chIagIbella, shain din Dalla tsIandina bersh botsursh. U'sh mu'min nakhatsa bu. TIa'kh'a lur iu Dala mu'min nakhana siilakh'-iokkkha ial.
KhIun diir du Dala shuna Iazap dina, barkalla olush a, teshash a shu khilcha? I Dela khilla barkalleverg a, khuush verg a.
Dalla tsa deza von khabarsh darzhadar, shena zulam dincho ben. I Dela khilla khezash verg a, khuush verg a.
Ash guchudakkkhakh' dikanig, ia kh'uldakh' i, ia gechdakh' /shena von dinchunna/ vonig, - /mela bu shuna/. Bakk'alla a, i Dela Sha ma khilla gechdesh verg a, nitsk' kkhochush verg a.

Bakk'alla a, Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanekh a tsa teshash bersh, sha'sh luush bersh Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchaniin a iuk' egIo, sha'sh olush bersh: "Tesha tkho tskh'abolcharakh, tsa tesha tkho vukkharakh", sha'sh luush bersh tsu iukk'ekh' nek' latsa (karaban) -
Bakk'alla a, u'sh ma bu kh'ak'bolu kerstanash. Tsu kerstanashna Okha kech ma dina siisaza dolu Iazap.
Sha'sh Delakh a, tsu'nan elchanekh a teshnarsh, tsarakh tskh'a a tsa k'estosh bersh - u'sh bu Okha shaina tIa'kh'a ial lur ersh. I Dela khilla gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Kh'o'ga do'khu zhainan okhIlano shaiga stiglara zhaina dossade, bokhush. Musaga tsul dokkkhanig diikhira tsara, elira: "Dela gaita tkho'ga guchchakh'". TIakkkha stiglara tsIaro skh'aletsira u'sh shain zulam bakh'anekh'. TIakkkha esaskh'aletsira tsara (1ibadat dan) shaiga bilgalonash skh'ae'nachul tIa'kh'a. Tsunna a gechdira Okha. Musaga delira Okha bilggal delil.

Tseran tIekhula lam aibira Okha, tsa'rtsa bartbesh /i tIelatsiitarkh'ama/, Okha elira tsa'rga: "NeIarekhula cho'kh'adovla, suzhud desh". Elira Okha tsa'rga: "/Delan/ dozanekh ma dovlalash sho'tdiinakh'". Tsa'rgara nu'tsk'ala vaIda iitsira Okha.

Tsara i shain bart bokhorna, u'sh Delan aiatekh tsatesharna, tsara tskh'a a bekhk botsush paikhamarsh baiarna, tseran "tkhan degnash muzhult (kh'archiina)du", a'lla, dosh bakh'anekh' /Dala neIalt a'lla tsarna/. Dala mukhIar to'khna tseran /degnashna/ u'sh tsateshar bakh'anekh'. Tskh'a Iezzig bersh ben /tsarakh/ teshar bolush bats.
U'sh tsateshar bakh'anekh', tseran Mar'iamakhla'tsna a'lla dolu dosh - deza-dokkkha eladita bakh'anekh' /neIalt a'lla tsarna/.

Tseran: "Bakk'alla a, Okha viina Masikh' - Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa Delan elcha", - a'lla, dosh bakh'anekh' a (i derrige a bakh'anekh' Iazap dina Okha tsarna). Viina vats tsara i, irkh o'llina a vats tsara i. Mukhkha delakh' a, tsarna /tskh'a kkhin/ tarvellera tsunakh. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' khilpalo iinarsh - tsunakh shekonekh' bu-kkh u'sh. Tsu'nan tskh'a a Iilma dats tsa'rgakh' - shaina mottalush dolchunna tIa'kh'akhIottar ben. Tsa viina tsara i, bakk'alla a,
Dala Shena gerga kh'alava'kkkhina i. I Dela khilla veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Zhainin okhIlanakh tskh'a a vats tsunakh teshar volush ben ivalale, k'ematdiinakh' i khir vu tsarna du'kh'al tesh.
Zhu'gtashkara da'lla zulam bakh'anekh' kh'aram dira Okha tsarna dikanash, kh'alkha shaina kh'anal khilla dolu, Delan nek'akh tsara dukkkhannash dIatovzhor bakh'anekh' a.
Tsara ribaetsar bakh'anekh', shaina dikhkina khilla dolu, tsara khartsontsa nekhan da'khni daar bakh'anekh' a. Tsarakh kerstanashna lazosh dolu Iazap kechdina Okha.

Mukhkha delakh' a, tsarakh kIorga Iilma khuush bersh a, mu'minasha iiman dillina bu kh'o'ga do'ssinchu'nga a (K'ur'ane), kh'o'l kh'alkha do'ssinchu'nga a, khIottosh bu lamaz, lush bu zakat, Delakh a, ekhart diinakh a teshash bu. Tsarna tIa'kh'a Okha lur ma iu siilakh' - iokkkha ial.

Bakk'alla a, Okha vekh'iidaiitira kh'o'ga, Nukh'e a, tsul tIa'kh'a paikhamarshka daiitarkh terra. Vekh'ii daiitira Okha IbrakhIime a, IsmaIile a, Iskh'ak'e a, IaIk'ube a, IaIk'uban tIa'kh'ene a, Iiisaga a, Aiube a, Iunuse a, KhIarune a, Suleimane a. Davude delira Okha Zabur.
Elchanashka, Okha kh'aiga kh'alkha biitsina bolchu, Okha kh'aiga biitsina botschu a /elchanashka vekh'ii daiitira Okha/. Musaga khabar diitsira Dala /skh'adillinchu/ diitsartsa.

Elchanashka, sha'sh kkha' bokkkhush khilla bolchu a, kkheram tu'isush khilla bolchu a /daiitira Okha vekh'ii/ nakhana Dalla tIekh' delil tsakhiliitarkh'ama elchanel tIa'kh'a. Dela veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a khilla.
Mukhkha delakh' a, Dala teshalla do kh'o'ga dossinchu'ntsa - Tso dossiina i Shen Iilmantsa. Malikasha a do teshalla. Kkhacho khilla Delatsa tesh khilar.
Bakk'alla a, i tsateshashnarsh, Delan novk'ara /nakh/ iu'stakhbokhush bersh - u'sh tilabella genarchu tilartsa.
Bakk'alla a, i tsateshnarsh, zulam dinarsh - ma vats Dela tsarna gechdan vollush, u'sh nisban /vollush niisachu/ novk'a,
Zho'zhakhatin novk'a ben, u'sh tsu chokh' daima la'ttash. I khilla Dalla atta.

KhIai nakh! Shu'ga veana elcha bak'ontsa shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara, ash iiman dilla - iza dika du shuna. Ash kerstadakh' - Delan ma du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Dela khilla khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ deshverg a.

KhIai zhainan okhIla! Dukkha tIekh ma dovla shain dinekh'. Ma ala Dalla tIekh' bak'derg ben. Bakk'alla a, Masukh', Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa - Delan elcha vu, Tsu'nan dosh du, Tso sha della khilla dolu Mar'iame, Tsunakh sa a du - iiman dilla Dele a, Tsu'nan elchanashka a. Ash ma ala: "Kkho'". Sovtsa - shuna dika khir du. AllakhI - tskh'a Dela vu, tsIena vu i Shen do'zalkho khilarkh. Tsu'nan ma du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Kkhacho khilla Delatsa vekalkhilar.
Kuralla ianne a iiir iatsara Masukh'a Delan lai khila, gerga dolchu malikasha a iiir iatsara. Tsu'nan Iibadatna kuralla iinarg, dozalladinarg - tIakkkha Shena tIe gulviir volush vu Tso masso a.

Iiman dillinarsh a, dikanash dinarsh a - tsarna bekkhamna lur iu shain ial, Shen koma'rshallitsa Tso sovbokhur bu u'sh. Amma kuralla iinarsh a, dozalladinarsh a - Iazap diir du tsarna lazosh dolchu Iazaptsa, tsarna karor vats Dela votsurg doladiirig a, gIo'ncha a.
KhIai nakh! Eana shu'ga shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchungara bilgalo. K'egina nur dossiina Okha shu'ga.
Dele iiman dillinarsh, Tsu'ntsa chIagIbellarsh - tIakkkha kkhachor bu Tso u'sh Shegara k'inkhetame a, koma'rshalle a, nisbiir bu Tso u'sh Shena tIe niisachu novk'a.

Kh'o'ga zhop do'khush bu u'sh tskh'atstsa khattarshna. Akh' ala: "Dala kkhetor du shu shen do'zalkho ia da, bukha a tsa vu'sush, vellachun kh'ok'ekh': nagakh' sanna tskh'a stag lakh', bukhavu'sush shen do'zalkho a, /da a/ votsush, bukhaiu'sush iu tskh'a iisha - tsunna tso bukhaditinchukh niissa akh lur du. Vashas o'tsu iishin derrig irs, nagakh' sanna tsu'nan (iishin) do'zalkho vatsakh'. Nagakh' sanna shi iisha bukha iisina elakh' - tsu shinna, kkho dak'a dina, shi dak'a lur du tso bukhaditinchukh. Nagakh' sanna bukhabisina belakh' vezharii a, iizharii a - bo'rshachunna shina zudchunna kkhochu dak'a lur du. Shuna i bilgaldesh vu Dela shu tila tsadalarkh'ama. I Dela masso a khIuma khuush vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Kkhochushbe chIagIamash. Kh'anal dina shuna kh'aibanash, shuna /kh'aram du a'lla/ diitsina khilla dotsursh a, shu ikh'ramdikhkina dolush, tallar dina ekkha dotsurg a. Bakk'alla a, Dela kh'ukam desh vu Shena lu'urg.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash kh'anal ma de Delan Iadatash (Dala kh'aram dinarg kh'anal ma de), kh'aram bettanasha, kh'a'zhtsIa chu gIurbanna daliina dolu bezhana a /ma die i/, shain logakh tu'tesh kkhaziina dolu kh'aibanash a, Kh'armeba'khkina nakh, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara dozalle a, rezakhilare a dogdokhush bolchu /lara u'sh, tergal de i kh'urmatash/. Sha'sh kh'a'zhalla da'sticha, tallar de shaina akkharoshna. /Kh'alkha/ shu Deza Ma'zhdigetsa du'tush khilla bolcha'rga shun khillachu tsabezamo shu ma du'giila /khIintsa/ tsarna tIelata (Delan dozanekh dovlarna tIe). Ash vovshiin gIo latsa dikanna tIekh', Delakh kkherarna tIekh'. Ash vovshiin gIo ma latsa k'inna tIekh', tIelatarna tIekh'. Shu Delakh kkhera /i tsa dan/. Bakk'alla a, i Dela chIogIa vu bekkham barekh'.

Shuna kh'aram iina k'en ella khIuma a, tsIii a, kh'akkhin zhizhig a, Dela votschun tsIe iokkkhush diina /bezhana/ a, lag taIiina (sa du'k'na) diinarg a, shena khIuma to'khna diinarg a, lakkhara okh'ado'zhna dellarg a, kkhecho maIa to'khna diinarg a, ekkhano diinarg a, ash tsIandina dotsurg (ekkhano la'tsnachul ta'kh'a ash kh'akkha dezzachu kepara urs kha'kkhna delakh' - megar du daa), t1ulgana (ts1ushna)lerina urs kh'a'kkhnarg a, ash pkherchashtsapal tesna dek'na khillarg a. I fasik' khIuma du (Dalla mu't1akh' khilarkh d1avalar). Takhana dog dillina kerstanasha shun dinakh. Shu tsarakh ma kkhera. Shu Sokh kkhera. Takhana chekkhda'kkkhina As shuna shun din, kkhochushdina shuna Sain niImat. Reza khilla So Islam shuna din khilartsa. Nagakh' sanna tskh'anna chIogIachu matsallekh' /tsarakh khIuma/ tsa va'lla iaakh', sha k'a darna tIegIertash votsush,- bakk'alla a, Dela gechdesh a, k'inkhetame a ma vu (tsu kh'aram iolchukh kIezzig khIuma iaa megar du tsunna matsalla tsa vala).

Kh'o'ga kho'ttu tsara: "KhIun kh'anal iina iu shaina /iaa/?" bokhush. Akh' ala: "Kh'anal iina shuna tsIena khIumanash a, Dala shaina Iamiinchukh - ash Iamiina khilla dolchu diinato la'tsnarga. Ash daa tso shaina la'tsnachukh, Delan tsIe iakkkha tsunna tIekh', Delakh kkhera shu. Bakk'alla a, i Dela sikha vu kh'esap darekh' ".

Takhana kh'anal iina shuna tsIena khIumanash, zhainan okhIlan kkhacha a kh'anal bu shuna, shun kkhacha kh'anal bu tsarna a. Mu'min zudarekhtsIena gIillakkhe bersh (nakhatsa tsa lelash bersh), shul kh'alkha shaiga zhaina dossiinacharekhtsIena gIillakkhe zudarii (nakhatsa tsa lelash bersh) kh'anal bu shuna /mare balo/, ash tseran makh belcha, shu bo'khanig dan gIertash tsa khilcha, dottagI latsagIertash datsakh'. Iiman khartsdesh milla velakh' a - tsu'nan Iamal iaina, ekhartakh' i khir vu eshnacharekh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Sha'sh lamazna t1ekhIu'ttush (lamazna kechlush), shain iakhkh'ash iila, ku'igash a dila golashka kkhachchalts, shain ko'rtakh /kh'azh t1era k1esark1agchu kkhachchalts khitsa t1adiina shina ku'igan p1elgash d1a-skh'a/ kh'akkha, kogash bila kh'orkanashka kkhachchalts. Shaina t1ekh' khidelakh' - liicha. Nagakh' sanna shu tsomgush delakh', ia novk'akh' delakh', ia shukh tskh'a' ts1anonna vakhanchu'ra ve'nekh', ia shu zudarekh kh'akkhadellekh', shuna khi tsa karadakh' - temade tsIenchu lattatsa. Ash kh'akkha tsunakh (lattakh) shain iakhkh'ekh a, ku'igekh a. Shuna khalo ian luush vats Dela, mukhkha delakh' a, shu tsIandan luush vu I Shen niImat shuna kkhochushkhiliitarkh'ama, shu khilakh'ara barkalla olush.

Ash dagadaiita shaina khilla Delan niImat, Tsu'nan bart Sha shu'tsa bina khilla bolu, sha'sh alar /dagadaiita/: "Ladug1ush a du, mu'tIakh' a du",- a'lla. Shu Delakh kkheralash. Bakk'alla a, i Dela Sha khuush ma vu degnashkakh' derg.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu khilalash khIittina Dalla teshash khilla niisontsa. Tskh'ana nakhe bolchu tsabezamo shu diggane a ma du'giila niiso tsaiarna tIe. Niiso elash, i gerga iu Delakh kkherarna, shu Delakh kkheralash. Bakk'alla a, i Dela sov dika khuush vu ash diirig.
Dala vaIda iina iiman dillincharna a, dika Iamalsh iinacharna a - tsarna khir du gechdar a, siilakh'-iokkkha ial a.
/Din/ kerstadina, Tkhan aiatash khartsdinarsh - u'sh bu zho'zhakhatin dai.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash dagadaiita shaina tIekh' khilla dolu Delan niImat. Tskh'a k'am ma darii bala kkha'chna shuna tIe ku'igash kkhovdo- Tso dukhatettira shukh tseran ku'igash. Shu Delakh kkheralash, Dalla tIetevzhiila mu'min nakh.

Dala bart bira Israilan kIentashtsa, tsarakh shiitta teshame stag vakhiitira Okha, Dala elira: "So shu'tsa vu." Ash lamaz khIottadakh', zakat lakh', San elchanekh teshakh', ash tsa'rgakh'a gIo dakkkhakh', ash Dalla /iukhalurg/ khaza dekkhar lakh' - shun vonash doiur ma du As, boshmashna chu (ialsamane) dokhu'itur ma du shu, shena bukhakhula khish o'khush iolchu. Tsul tIa'kh'a shukh kerstanalla dinarg - niisa nek' tiliinarg ma vu i.

Tsara i shain vaIda (bart) iokhorna neIalt a'lla Okha tsarna, tseran degnash dina k'iza, dosh khu'itsush bu u'sh shen mettigera. Ditsdina tsara /Dala/ shaiga /kh'ekhamtsa/ dossiina khillachukh tskh'a dak'a. Kh'o (khIai Mukh'ammad) dIatu'lur ma vats tsa'rgara teshnabekhkana tIenisvlarkh, tsarakh tskh'a kIezzig botschucharakhben. K'intIera vala tsarna, gechde tsarna. Bakk'alla a, Dalla dukkhabeza dikanig desh bersh.

Okha vaIda iitsira tkho nasarash (khristianash) du a'llacha'rgara, tsara a ditsdira tskh'a dak'a shetsa shaina kh'ekham bina khilla dolchukh. Tsarna iuk'atesira Okha mostagIalla a, o'gIazlo a k'ematde khIottalts, tIakkkha du'itsur du Dala, u'sh khIun desh khilla, a'lla.

KhIai zhainan okhIla! Veana shu'ga Tkhan elcha, ash zhainakh kh'uldesh khilla dolu dukkkhanig shuna bilgaldesh volu, dukkhanig guchu tsa dokkkhush a du'tu tso. Deana shu'ga Delera nur a, bilgala zhaina a.
Tsu'ntsa nisvo Dala Sha rezakhilarna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg masharan nek'ashka, bodanashkara nu're arabokhu Tso u'sh Shen laamtsa, nisbo Tso u'sh niisachu novk'a.

Kerstanalla dina sha'sh a'llachara: "Bakk'alla a, Dela - I ma vu Mar'iaman kIant Masukh'". Akh' ala: "Delera tskh'anna khIumanna doladalush mila vu, Tsunna li'cha khIallakvan Mar'iaman kIant Masukh' a, tsu'nan nana a, la'ttakh' mel derg a?" Delan ma du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dolalla, tsarna iukk'ekh' derg a. Shena luurg kkhullush vu I. I Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.

Zhu'gtasha a, nasarashaa elira: "Tkho du Delan kIentii a, Tsu'nan dukkhadezarsh a". Akh' ala: "Tk'a shuna Iazap khIunda do Tso shun k'inosh bakh'anekh'? KhIan-khIa, shu adamash du Tso kkho'llincharakh. Shena luuchunna gechdiir du Tso, Shena luuchunna Iazap diir du. Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dolalla, tsarna iukk'ekh' derg a, Tsu'nga du /masseran a tIa'khkh'ara/ dIaderzar".

KhIai zhainan okhIla! Veana shu'ga Tkhan elcha /Mukh'ammad/, bilgaladokkkhush shuna /khIumanash/ elchanash bakhkar satsadella khillachu mu'rekh', shu'ga tsa aliitarkh'ama: "Tsa veana tkho'ga kkha' bokkkhurg, tsa veana tkho'ga kkheram tosurg". Veana shu'ga kkha' bokkkhurg a, veana shu'ga kkheram tosurga. Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.

/Kh'akhade/ Musas ma a'llera shen k'ome: "KhIai san k'am, dagadaiita shaina tIekh' khilla dolu Delan niImat: Tso shuna iukk'ekh' paikhamarsh khiliitira, shukh bira pachchakh'ash, shuna delira Ialamekh tskh'anna tsa dellarg.
KhIai san k'am! Chu gIo Dala shaina /khila/ iazdina dolchu dezachu la'tta (makhka), iukha ma dovla - tIakkkha shu eshnacha'rga d1ado'rzur du".
Tsara elira: "KhIai Musa, tsu chokh' tskh'a nu'tsk'ala k'am du, tkho dakhanne a tsu chu gIur ma dats u'sh arabovlalts tsu chu'ra. U'sh arabevlcha tsu chu'ra - tkho chu gIur du".
Kkho'rush bolcharakh Dala shaina niImat (bak' din) della volchu shina staga elira: "Chu gIo tsarnaneIarekhula, shu tsu chu dakhcha - shu to'lla du. Dalla tIetovzha, sha'sh teshash delakh'".
Tsara elira: "KhIai Musa, tkho tsk'a a tsu chu gIur ma dats, u'sh tsu chokh' mel bu, kh'ada kh'o a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a gIo, lata shu shi', tkho kkhuzakh' khevshina Iiir du".
