Tso (Musas) elira /Dele do1a desh/: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu (Dela), so doladesh ma vats san sin a, san veshin a ben, dIak'astade tkho khIokkhu fasik' k'omakh /Kh'an niisachu kh'ukamtsa/".
Elira /Dala/: "Tsarna kh'aram iu iza. Shovztk'a sharakh' bevlla lelar bu u'sh la'ttakhula. Akh' gIaigIa ma e fasik' k'omakh".

Diitsa tsarna Adaman shina kIantakh (K'abilakh a, KhIabilakh a) la'tsna bak'derg. Kh'akhade: tsara shimmo a gIurba diinera, tskh'annan (KhIabilan) i k'obal khilira, vukkhu'nan (K'abilan) i k'obal tsa khilira. Tso (K'abila) elira: "As vu'ir vu kh'o". Tso (KhIabila) elira: "Dala k'obaldo /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcheran.
Akh' suna kh'an ku'g aidakh' so ven, as aidiir ma dats san ku'g kh'o ven. Bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru Delakh, Ialamiin Dekh.
Suna la'a kh'o verza /Dalla tIe/ san k'itsa a, kh'an k'itsa a - tIakkkha kh'o khir vu (zho'zhakhatin) tsIeran daikh (tskh'a'). I bu bekkham zulamkhoshna".
Khazdira tsunna shen sino shen vasha ven, tso (K'abila) i (KhIabil) viira, - i khilira eshnacharekh.

Dala k'ig iakhiitira latta okhkush tsunna gaita, mukha kh'uldo shen veshin dak'a. Tso elira: "OkhI, ma dak'azva'lla so, tsu k'iigakh tarvallal, kh'uldan /tsa khuush/ sain veshin dak'a". I khilira dokhkobevllacharekh.

Tsu'nan du'kh'a iazdira Okha Israilan kIentashka: sa diinarg, sina du'kh'al a ia la'ttakh' lelochu vochu khIumanna du'kh'al a dotsush, masso a nakh baiinarg sanna vu. I dendinarg - masso a nakh denbinarg sanna vu. Tsa'rga ba'khkina Tkhan elchanash bilgalonashtsa (Delan aiatashtsa), tIakkkha, bakk'alla a, dukkhabersh tsarakh tsul tIa'kh'a a la'ttakh' tIalamza (Delan dozanal t1ekhbovlursh) ma bu.

Delatsa a, Tsu'nan elchantsa a tIom besh bolcheran a, la'ttakh' bo'khanig darzho gIertacheran a bekkham bu u'sh baiar, ia irkh'okhkar, ia tseran ku'igash a, kogash a khedor du'kh'-du'kh'al dersh, ia makhkara arabakhar. Iza tsarna du'nenakh' a siisaza khilar du, ekhartakh' tsarna deza-dokkkha dolu Iazap du.
Shushaina tIederzale (sha'sh zho'pe ozadale) toba dina botsursh. Shuna khaalash, Dela gechdesh a, k'inkhetame a vuila.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Delakh kkheralash, Tsunna /mu'tIakh' khilartsa, Iibadat dartsa/ gergadalo nek'ash lekhalash, Tsu'nan du'kh'a k'iisam lattabelash - shu dakkkhiideda tam bu.

Bakk'alla a, kerstanashna la'ttakh' mel derg a, tsu'ntsa kkhin i sannarg khilcha a k'ematdiinan Iazapna du'kh'al dala /tsunakh kIelkh'ardovlarkh'ama/ - k'obaldiir datsara tsa'rgara. Tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap du.
Luur dolush bu u'sh tsIergara arabovla, bevr bats u'sh tsu chu'ra ara. Tsarna /guttar/ la'ttash dolu Iazap khir du.
K'u, bo'rsha stegan a, k'u zudchun a, - dIakhedade tseran shinnan a ku'igash tsara lachk'iinachunna du'kh'al bekkhamna, Delera taIzarna. I Dela veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Shen zulamal tIa'kh'a toba dinarg a, tIakkkha dika Iamalsh iinarg a, - bakk'alla a, Dala toba k'obaldiir du tsu'nan. Bakk'alla a, Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Kh'una tsa kha'a, i Dela khilar stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dolalla Shegakh' dolush? Shena luuchunna Iazap do Tso, Shena luuchunna gechdo. I Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush vu.

KhIai elcha! Kh'o singattame ma voila kerstanallekh' sikhbellachara, u'sh khillekh' a sha'sh bagakh' a'llacharakh: "Teshna tkho" - teshna dats tseran degnash; u'sh khillekh' a sha'sh khartsdolchu'nga lado'g1ush khillachu, sha'sh kh'o volchu /kuralla esh, tsa beshash / tsa ba'khkinchu kkhechu nakhelado'g1ush khillachu zhu'gtekh. U'sh bu dosh shen mettigera dIadokkkhush, kkhechukh'a khIittosh. Tsara olu: "I shaiga dellekh' - skh'alatsa, shaiga tsa dellekh' - larlo". Dala shena pitanaluush volchunna - tsunna Delera tskh'anna khIumanna doladiir dats akh'. U'sh bu Dalla shain degnash tsIandan tsa luush bersh. Tsarna du'nenakh' siisazalla iu, ekhartakh' tsarna deza-dokkkha Iazap du.

Lado'gIursh bu u'sh khartsdolchu'nga, iuursh bu u'sh kh'aram mel erg. U'sh kh'o volchu bagIakh', kh'ukam de tsarna iukk'ekh', ia dIaverza tsarakh. Kh'o tsarakh dIavirzicha, khIumma zen diir dats tsara kh'una. Aikh'a kh'ukam desh, niisontsa kh'ukam de tsarna iukk'ekh'. Bakk'alla a, Dalla beza niiso lelorash.
Kh'o'ga kh'ukam mukha doitu tsara? Tsa'rgakh' Tavrat ma dui, shena chokh' Delan kh'ukam dolush! TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a a dIabo'rzu u'sh /Delan nek'akh/ - bats u'sh mu'min nakh.

Bakk'alla a, Okha okh'adossiina Tavrat /Musaga/, shena chokh' niisa nek' a, nur a dolush. Tsu'ntsa kh'ukam do zhu'gtashna /Delan gIullakkhna/ mu'tIakh' khilla bolchu paikhamarasha a, /tsu'ntsa kh'ukam do/ rabbanashaa, akh'barashaa Delan zhainakh shaina Ialashdina khillachu'ntsa, u'sh khilira tsu tIekh' teshash. Shu nakhakh ma kkhera, shu kkhera Sokh, ma dokhka San aiatash kIezzigchu mekhakh. Dala dossiinachu'ntsa kh'ukam tsa desh bersh -u'sh kerstanash bu (i Delan kh'ukam tsa dezash ia niisa tsa lorush belakh').

Okha tIedillina tsarna tsu (Tavrata) chokh': sa - sitsa, bIa'rg - bIa'rgatsa, mara - mertsa, lerg - lergatsa, tserg - tsergatsa, chevnash io'kkhur iu (chIir o'tsur iu), a'lla. Tskh'ammo gechdakh', i tsunna kafarat (k'inoikh tsIanvalar) du. Dala dossiinachu'ntsa (niisa) kh'ukam tsa desh bersh - u'sh zulamkhoi bu.

Tsarna tIa'khkh'e vaiitira Okha Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa, bak'desh shel kh'alkha khilla Tavrat. Tsu'nga delira Okha Inzhil, shena chokh' niisa nek' a, nur a dolush, sha bak'desh dolu shel kh'alkha khilla Tavrat, sha niisa nek' a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna kh'ekham a khilla dolu.
Inzhilan okhIlano kh'ukam doila shaiga tsu chokh' dossiinachu'ntsa. Dala dossiinachu'ntsa kh'ukam tsa desh bersh - u'sh fasik'ash bu (Dalla mu't1akh' tsa khillarsh).

Kh'o'ga /khIai Mukh'ammad/ dossiina Okha zhaina bak'dolchu'ntsa, sha bak'desh shel kh'alkha khilla zhaina, sha iza 1alashdesh a dolu. Akh' kh'ukam de tsarna iukk'ekh' Dala kh'aiga dossiinachu'ntsa, tseran sinlaamashna tIa'kh'a ma khIotta kh'aiga deana dolchu bak'dolchukh. Shukh khIoranna Okha sharI dina, /dinekh'/ bilgala nek' bina (minkhIazh). Dalla li'na khillekh'ara, tskh'ana ummatakh diir dara shu, mukhkha delakh' a, shu zerkh'ama Sha shuna dellachu'ngakh' (khiliitina Tso dukkkha dinash). Dikanashna tIekh' kh'alkhe iakkkha k'ovsa (vovshashtsa), Dele du shun masseran a dIaderzar, tIakkkha du'itsur du Tso shu'ga shun khilpalonashshegakh' khillarg.

/I dossiina Okha kh'o'ga omra desh/: kh'ukam de tsarna iukk'ekh' Dala dossiinachu'ntsa, tseran sinlaamashna tIa'kh'a ma vaza, larlo tsarakh, kh'o tsara dIatilavarakh tskh'adolchu Dala kh'o'ga dossiinachukh. U'sh dIaberzakh', kh'una khaalakh', Dela luush khilar u'sh balane latsa tseran tskh'adolchu k'inosh bakh'anekh'. Bakk'alla a, nakhakh dukkhabersh fasik'ash ma bu.
ZhekhIallin kh'ukamna tIetiizha u'sh tk'a? Mila vu tk'a Delal kh'ukam khaza desh teshash dolchu k'omana?

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash ma letsa zhu'gtii a, nasarash a shaina dottagIii. Tsarakh tskh'abersh dottagIii bu vukkharna. Shukh tsarakh shena dottagIii letsnarg, - bakk'alla a, i tsarakh vu. Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa nisdo zulame k'am.

Kh'una gush bu i shain degnashkakh' tsamgar ersh (fasik'ash ia munepik'ash) sikhlush tsa'rgakh', olush: "Tkho kkho'rush du tkhuna /khIara/ gIullakkh tskh'ana balane d1akh'ovza". Dala tarlo Shegara tolambala, ia tskh'a gIullakkh dan- tIakkkha u'sh ma bu'su sha'sh kh'uldinchukh shailakh' dokhkobevlla.

Iiman dillinchara olu /zhu'gtashka, munepik'iin kh'olakh tsetsbovlii/: khIorsh bu i shain chIogIa duinash Delatsa bi'narsh, sha'sh bakk'alla a, shu'tsa du, bokhush? Io'khna tseran Iamalsh. Eshnarsh khili u'sh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shukh milla shen (islam) dinera dIava'lcha - tIakkkha dou'itur du Dala tskh'a k'am, Tsunna (Dalla) u'sh bezash, tsarna Iza vezash, mu'min nakhana sha'sh atta a bolush, kerstanashna khala a bolush, Delan novk'akh' k'u'isush, tIekhtokham bechun tIekhtokhamakh tsa kkho'rush. I Delan dozalla du, Shena luuchunna i dou'itu Tso. I Dela shorto iolush a vu, Iilma dolush a vu.
Bakk'alla a, shun dottagI Dela vu, Tsu'nan elcha vu, iiman dillinarsh a bu, sha'sh lamaz khIottadesh bolu, sha'sh zakat a lush bolu, sha'sh/Tsunna/ guorakh1u'ttush a bolu.
Dela a, Tsu'nan elcha a, iiman dillinarsh a dottagIii la'tsnarg - bakk'alla a, Delan tobanan /nakh bu u'sh/ - u'sh bu tolam bokkkhur bersh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash ma letsa, shun din belame a, lovzare a da'kkkhina, shul kh'alkha shaiga zhaina daiitincharakh bersh a, kerstanash a dottagIii. Shu Delakh kkhera, sha'sh iiman dillina delakh'.
Ash lamaze kkhaikkhicha, i belame a, lovzare a o'tsu tsara. I du u'sh khilarna, sha'sh oila tsa esh dolu k'am.
Akh' ala: "KhIai zhainan okhIla! Ash bekkham bo tkhuna dekk'a Okha iiman dillina khilarna Dele, tkhaiga dossiinachu'nga a, kh'alkha dossiinachu'nga a, shukh dukkhakhbersh fasik'ash khilarna a".

Akh' ala: "As dIakhou'itii shu'ga tsul a vonig bekkham khilartsa Delan gergakh'ara? U'sh bu Dala shaina neIalt a'llarsh, I shaina o'gIazvakhnarsh, Tso shaikh maimalsh a, kh'akkharchii a iinarsh a, tIagIutana sha'sh Iibadat dinarsh a. U'sh bu vonash (shaina khir iolchu) mettigtsa, uggar tilabella bersh niisachu nek'akh".

Shu dolchu ba'khkicha /zhu'gtiin munepik'ash/, tsara olu: "Tkho iiman dillina du", u'sh-m /shu dolchu/ ba'khkina ma bara kerstanallitsa, - u'sh /shu dolchu'ra/ ara ma bevli tsu'ntsa. I Dela dika khuush vu-kkh tsara kh'uldesh khillarg.
Kh'una go tsarakh dukkhabersh sikhlush k'a darekh' a, mostagIalla lelorekh' a, kh'aram khIuma daarekh' a. Ma von khIuma du-kkh tsara desh khillarg!
U'sh dukha khIunda tsa tukhu rabbanasha a, akh'barashaa k'akhilaran dashakh a, kh'aram mel derg a tsara daarkh a? Ma von du tsara desh khillarg!

Zhu'gtasha elira: "Delan ku'g dikhkina du". Ku'igash dikhkina-kkh tseran. NeIalt a'lla tsarna sha'sh du'itsurg bakh'anekh'. Tsu'nan (Delan) shi ku'g darzhiina du, Shena luuchunna ritsk' lush vu I. Tsarakh dukkhabersh sovbokhur bu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara kh'o'ga dossiinacho /Delan / dozanekh bovlartsa a, kerstanallitsa a. Tsarna iuk'a mostagIalla a, o'gIazlo a kkho'ssina Okha k'ematde kkhachchalts. Tsara tsIe mel latii tIamna, Dala iaiira i. La'ttakh' bo'khaderg darzhado tsara. Dalla bezats bo'khanig desh bersh.
Zhainan okhIlano iiman dillina khillekh'ara, /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillekh'ara, tseran vonash (k'inosh) dIadokhur dara Okha tsarakh, niImatan ialsamanichu bokhiitur bara u'sh.

Tavrat a, Inzhil a, /kkhin/ shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara shaiga okh'adossiinarg (kh1ara siilakh' dolu K'ur'an) khIottadesh u'sh belakh'ara, shaina lakkhakh' a, kogii bukhakh' a derg duur dara tsara. Tsarakh niisa ummata du. Tsarakh dukkhabersh von khilla sha'sh dechu'ntsa.

KhIai elcha! DIakkhachade kh'aiga kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara okh'adossiinarg. Akh' i tsa dakh' - akh' kkhochush tsa dina Tsu'nan elchalla. Dala larviir vu kh'o nakhakh. Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa nisdo kersta k'am.

Akh' ala: "KhIai zhainan okhIla! Shu tskh'anna a khIumanna dek'akh' dats ash Tavrat a, Inzhil a, kkhin shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara shaiga dossinarg a khIottadalts". Kh'o'ga kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara do'ssincho alsambakhaza bu'tur ma bats tsarakh dukkhabersh /Delan / dozanekh bovlarekh' a, kerstanallekh' a. Kh'o singattame ma khila kersta k'am bakh'anekh'.

Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh (busalbanash) a, zhu'gtii a, sabiunasha, nasarash a - /tsarakh/ Dele a, tIa'kh'archu diine a iiman a dillinarsh, dika Iamal a iinarsh /mu'lsh belakh' a/ -/k'ematdiinan irchallin/ kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna, u'sh /du'nenakh' bukhadisnarg bakh'anekh'/ singattame a khir ma bats.

Israilan kIentashtsa bart bira Okha /tsara Dele a, tsu'nan elchanashka a iiman du'llur du, a'lla/, tsa'rga elchanash a bakhkiitira. Shaiga elcha mosazza ve'cha a, shain sinoshna dezarg tsa dokh'ush, tskh'abersh khartsbora tsara, tskh'abersh boiu tsara.
Tsarna mo'tttura pitana khir dats, bIa'rze a, k'ora a khilira u'sh, tIakkkha Dala tsarna gechdira. TIakkkha tsarakh dukkhabersh /iukha a/ bIa'rze a, k'ora a khilira. Dela gush ma vu tsara diirig.

Kerstanalla dina sha'sh a'lla bolchara: "Bakk'alla a, Dela - Mar'iaman kIant Masukh' vu" (Iiisa). Masukh'a a'lla: "KhIai Israilan kIentii! AllakhIana Iibadat de - san Dalla a, shain Dalla a. Bakk'alla a, milla velakh' a, Delatsa nak'ost la'tsna, Dala tsunna kh'aram iina ialsamani, tsu'nan chugIoila (zho'zhakhatin) tsIe iu. Zulamkhoshna gIo'nchii ma bats".

Kerstanalla dina sha'sh a'lla bolchara: "Bakk'alla a, Dela vu kkhaannakh kkhoalgIanig". Tskh'a a kkhin Dela vats I Sha tskh'a Dela votsurg. Sha'sh oluchukh u'sh tsa sovtsakh' - tsarakh sha'sh kerstanash khillacharakh lazosh dolu Iazap kh'akkhalur ma du.
Dele toba khIunda tsa do tsara, Tsu'nga gechdar a khIunda tsa do'khu? I Dela gechdesh a, k'inkhetame a ma vu.

Mar'iaman kIant Masukh' ma vats elcha ben, tsul kh'alkha a dIabakhana elchanash, tsu'nan nana iu uggar bak'lu'ish erg. U'sh shii a khilla kkhachabuush. Kh'azhal, mukha bilgaldesh du Tkho tsarna aiatash, tIakkkha a kh'azhal, mukha Iekhiina u'sh (shaitIano).
Akh' ala: "Ash Iibadat do tk'a, Dela a vu'tii, shen dolakh' shaina zen a, ia paida a botsuchunna? I Dela Sha khezash a, khuush a ma vu".

Akh' ala: "KhIai zhainan okhIla, shain dinekh' dukkha tIekh ma dovla bak'derg dotsuchokh', shu tIa'kh'a ma khIitta tskh'ana k'oman dezarshna, sha kh'alkha tiladella dolchu k'omanna, tso dukkhabersh tiliina, niisachu novk'akh sha a tiladella".
Israilan kIentekh kerstanalla dinacharna neIalt a'lla Davudan a, Mar'iaman kIentan Iiisan a bagakhula. I - tsara iinchu Iesallina a, u'sh dozanekh bovlush khilarna a du.
U'sh khilla sha'sh dinchu vochunna vovshashka nekhIitsa desh. Ma von du-kkh tsara desh khillarg!
Kh'una go tsarakh (zhu'gtekh) dukkhabersh bu kerstanalla dinacharakh dottagIii besh. Ma von du-kkh tsara shaina kh'alkhada'kkkhinarg - Dela shaina o'gIazvakhiitar. Iazabekh' u'sh guttar bu'sur ma bu.
Delakh a, paikhamarakh a, tsu'nga dossinchukh a u'sh teshash khillekh'ara, u'sh dottagIii bina lu'itsur batsara tsara, mukhkha delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhabersh fasik'ash bu.

Kh'una karanne a karor ma bu iiman dillincharna mostagIallitsa nakhakh uggare chIogIa bersh zhu'gtii a, sha'sh shirk dinarsh a. Kh'una karanne a karor ma bu tsarakh iiman dillincharna bezamtsa uggare gergara bersh sha'sh a'llarsh: "Bakk'alla a, tkho nasarash du". Iza tsarakh k'issisash a, rukhIbanasha khilarna a, tsara kuralla tsa iarna a du.

Shaina khezcha elchane dossiinarg, kh'una go tseran bIa'rgash bIa'rkhiikh bu'zna shaina devzinchu bak'dolchukh. Tsara olu: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Okha iiman dillina. Akh' dIaiazdelakh' tkho shakhIadat dalocha'rtsa.
Tkhuna khIun du tsa tesha Dele a, Tso tkho'ga de'nachu bak'dolchu'nga a, tkho chIogIa luush du tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobucho tkho chudokhu'itiila dikachu k'omatsa /ialsamanichu/ ".
Dala mela belira tsarna tsara a'llachunna du'kh'al - (ialsamanin) boshmash, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush iolu, guttar la'ttar bu u'sh tsu chokh'. I bu dikacheran bekkham.
Tsateshnarsh a, Tkhan aiatash kharts dinarsh a - u'sh bu zho'zhakhatin dai.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash kh'aram ma elash Dala shain kh'anal iina tsIena khIumanash, shu /Delan/ dozanekh ma dovlalash. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa beza /Shen/ dozanekh bovlursh.
Ash daa Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh kh'anal a, tsIena a derg, shu Delakh kkheralush, shu Shekh teshash volchu.

Dala tsa lotsu shu (bekhke) shun duinashkakh' (tsa khuush) bagakh da'llachu'ntsa, amma Tso lotsu shu (bekhke) duinashtsa ash chIagIdina khillachu'ntsa. Tsu'nan kaffaratdu itt miskachunna kkhacha baor, iuk'ara ash shain okhIlanna baosh ma khu'lu, ia tsarna dukhar dalar a, ia lai azatvakkkhar (parg1atvakkkhar)a. I tsa kariinachunna - kkhaa diinakh' markha kkhabar. I du, ash bi'cha, shun duiniin kaffarat. Larde shain duinash. Ishtta bilgaldokhu shuna Dala Shen aiatash, shu khilarkh'ama barkalla olush.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! ChagIar a, maisira, tsIusha, pkherchiia - shaitIanan belkhan rizhs (bo'kha kh1uma) iu, genadovla tsunna - shu dakkkhiide tarlo.
ShaitIanna la'a chagIartsa a, maisirtsa a shuna iukk'e mostagIalla a, o'gIazlo a iozho, Delan tsIe iakkkharkh a, lamazakh a shu dukhatokha a. Ash tsa sotsu'itu?!
Shu mu'tIakh' khilalash Dalla, shu mu'tIakh' khilalash elchanna, larlolash /vochukh/. Shu dIaderzakh', shuna khaalash: Tkhan elchanna tIekh' du bilgala dIakkhachor.

Iiman dillincharna, dika Iamalsh iinacharna k'a dats tsara /kh'alkha/ di'nachunnau'sh kkho'rush khilcha, iiman a dillicha, dika Iamalsh a iicha, tIakkkha a kkho'rush khilcha, iiman dillicha, iukha a /vochukh/ kkho'rush khilcha, dikanig desh khilcha. Dalla beza dikanig desh bersh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Zenne a zu'ir ma du shu Dala tallar dechu khIumantsa (kh'oza ia kkhin akkha delakh') shena shun ku'igash a, cho'muk'ash a tIekkhi'na dolchu, Dalla vovzarkh'ama Sha gush votstsushekh' Shekh kkho'rush verg. Tsul tIa'kh'a dozanakh va'llarg - tsunna lazosh dolu Iazap du.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash diinatash (akkharoi) ma daialash sha'sh kh'a'zhdikhkina dolush. Shukh shena khu'ushekh' tskh'ammo i diekh' - tsu'nan bekkham bu da'khnekh tso daiinchun baram/sagIina dakkkhar/, tsu'ntsa kh'ukam diir du shukh shina Iedale volchu staga i gIurbanna kechdina bezhana KaIbe kkhochu'itush, ia /tsu'nan bekkham bu/ kaffarat dar - miskachu nakhana daa khIuma dalar, ia tsu'nan metta (miskacharna dala khIuma datsakh') markha kkhabar, shen gIullakkhan bala Iovsharkh'ama. Gechdina Dala kh'alkha da'llarg. Iukha a tsunna tIeverzakh' (i k'a dan) tsu'ngara bekkham o'tsur bu Dala. Dela veza verg a vu, bekkham o'tsush a vu.

Kh'anal du shuna tallar dan khIordan diinatashna, tsu'nan (khIordan diinatiin) kkhacha a shuna a, /novk'akh'/ bo'lkhuchu nakhana a /kh'anal bu/ paidaetsa. Kh'aram du shuna tallar dan arenan diinatashkakh' shu kh'azh (ia 1umrat) dikhkina mel du. Shu kkheralash Delakh, shu Shena tIe guldiir dolchu.

Dala dina KaIba - kh'urman tsIa- nakhana gIo'nna a, paidenna a, /ishtta khiliitina Dala/ kh'urmanbutt a, gIurbanan bezhana a, tu'tesh a (bezhanan logakh tosu khIumanash, i bilgaldarkh'ama). Iza du shuna khaiitarkh'ama Dela stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a derg khuush vuila, Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vuila.
Khaalash, Dela taIzarekh' chIogIanig vuila a, Dela gechdiirig a, k'inkhetam biirig a vuila a.
Elchanna tIekh' dIakkhachor a ben dats, Dela khuush ma vu ash guchudokkkhurg a, ash k'ailadokkkhurg a.

Akh' ala: "Bo'khanig a, tsIenanig a tskh'aterra dats, bo'khanig dukkkha khilaro kh'o'ga tamash baitinekh' a (kh'o tsetsva'kkkhinekh' a). Delakh kkheralash, khIai kh'ek'al dersh, shu dakkkhiiden mega!"

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ma khettalash tskh'atstsa (paida botsu) khIumanekh la'tsna, u'sh shuna guchuialakh' - shuna tsatam biir bu tsara. Ash tsarakh K'ur'an dussuchu khenakh' khettakh', u'sh shuna guchuevr iu - Dala gechdina tsarakh. I Dela gechdesh verg a vu, dukkha sobareverg a vu (shun taIzar tsa desh).
Tsarakh kha'ttira shul kh'alkha tskh'ana k'omo - tIakkkha tsara kerstanalla dira tsu'ntsa.
Dala tsa khiliitina (Dala tergal e tsa bokhu) bakh'irat a, saibat a, vasilat a, kh'am a, amma kerstanasha Dalla tIekkhullush du khartsderg, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh kkhetash ma bats.

Tsa'rga elcha: "Skh'adu'ila Dala dossiinachunna tIe a, elchanna tIe a", tsara olu: "Toam bu tkhuna tkhan dai shena tIekh' kariinarg". Tseran dai khIumma khuush tsa khillekh' a, niisachu novk'akh' tsa khillekh' a? /TIakkkha a tIa'kh'akhIuttu u'sh tsarna?/

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shuna t1ekh' du ash shain sinosh sha'sh 1alashdar. Shuna zen diir ma dats sha tilavellacho, shu niisachu novk'akh' khillekh'. Shun masseran a dIaderzar Dele du, tIakkkha Tso du'itsur du shu'ga ash desh khillarg.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shukh tskh'anna, valar tIe a deana, veset desh, shuna iukk'ekh' teshalla dan deza shukhIedale volchu shimmo, ia shukh votschukkhechu shimmo, nagakh' sanna shu novk'akh' dolush, shu 1ozhallin balano skh'ala'tsnekh'. U'sh shi' satsor vu /malkhbuzen/ lamaz dinchul tIa'kh'a, tIakkkha tsu shimmo Delatsa dui buur bu, shu sheko esh delakh': <<Tsu'ntsa makh tsa o'tsu okha, i /shena okha teshalla desh verg / gergara velakh' a. Okha kh'ul tsa do Delan teshalla, i dinekh' - tkho khir ma du k'inosh decharakh", a'lla.

Nagakh' sanna guchudalakh' i shi' k'ina kh'ak' khilar- kkhin shi' khIuttur vu tseran mettana, kh'alkhalerachu shinnal /irs etsarekh'/ gergara volu. Tsara shimmo dui buur bu Delatsa: "Tkhan teshalla bak' ma du tsu shinnan teshallal, tkho dozanakh devlla ma dats, devllekh' - tkho zulam dinacharakh khir ma dara".

I gerga du tsara teshalla darna /niisachu/ ku'tsekh', ia u'sh kkho'rush khilarna /kkhin/ duinash baiitarkh shain duinel tIa'kh'a /t1akkkha sha'sh siisaza khilarna/. Shu Delakh kkheralash, ladugIush a khilalash, Dala nis tsa do fasik' k'am.
Otsu (k'emat)diinakh' Dala gulbiir bu elchanash, Tso er du: "KhIun zhopdella shu'ga". Tsara (elchanash) er: "Iilma dats tkhan (tkhuna khaats), bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu k'ailenash dika khuurg".

Dala a'llera: "KhIai Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa, akh' dagadaiita kh'aina a, kh'an nanna a khilla dolu San niImat. As chIagI ma vira kh'o Dezachu Sitsa, agana chokh' volush nakhatsa khabar du'itsura akh', vokkkha khilcha a, As kh'una ma Iamiira zhaina a, kh'ek'alalla a, Tavrat a, Inzhil a, akh' ma kkhullura popparkh kh'ozanan ku'tsakh tera kh1uma, San purbantsa, tsu chu sa doIura akh' - i kh'oza khu'lura San purbantsa. Akh' tavora bIa'rsa dotsurg a, barstsamgar erg a San purbantsa. Vellarg denvora akh' San purbantsa; kh'o lar ma vira As banu Israilekh, kh'o tsarna tIe bilgalonashtsa ve'cha. TIakkkha tsarakh kerstanasha ma elira: "Iza bilggala kholmachalla (bozbuunchalla) a ben ma dats ",
As dagchu ma dillira kh'avareshnaSo'ga a, San elchane a iiman dilla, a'lla. Tsara elira: "Okha iiman dillina, akh' teshalla de tkho busulbanashkhilar ".
Kh'avaresha ma elira: "KhIai Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa, kh'an Elan (Delan) nitsk' kkhochur barii tkhuna stiglara /daariin/ shun okh'adosso?" Tso elira: "Delakh kkhera, shu iiman dolush khillekh' ".

Tsara elira: "Tkhuna la'a tsu chu'ra khIuma iaa, tkhan degnash chIagIdan /teshartsa/, khaa la'a tkhuna kh'o tkho'ga bak'liina khilar (iimanakh a, Delakh a la'tsna diitsarekh'), tkho tsunna tIekh' teshash khila a".

Mar'iaman kIanta Iiisas elira: "Tkhan Dela - tkhan Ela (Dela), okh'adossadekh'a tkhuna stiglara shun, tkhuna dezde (Iiid) khir dara tsunakh tkhan kh'alkharchunna a, tkhan tIa'kh'archunna a, Kh'o'gara delil a khir dara. Ritsk' lolakh' tkhuna. Kh'o ritsk' lucharakh uggar dikanig ma vu".
Dala elira: "As okh'adossor du shuna i (shun, daarkh du'zzina). TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a shukh kerstanalla dinchunna - as Iazap diir ma du tsunna Iazaptsa, Ialamashkakh' tskh'anna tsa dinchu keppara".

Dala er: "KhIai Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa, akh' a'llera nakhe kh'uo a, kh'an nana a shi dela vu alii tIelatsa, AllakhI vitii, a'lla?" Tso er: "Kh'o tsIanvo as, ma dats suna /tome/ as alar aisa ala kh'ak' dotsurg. As i a'lla khillekh'ara - Kh'una i khuush khir ma dara. Kh'una ma khaa so'gakh' derg, suna ma tsa khaa Kh'o'gakh' derg. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o ma vu k'ailenash t1ekh dika khuurg.

Tsa elira as tsa'rga Akh' so'ga shetsa omra dinarg ben - "Iibadat delash Dalla, san Ela, shun Ela khilla volchu". So tsarna tIekh' tesh vara, so tsa'rtsa mel volu, Akh' so Kh'aiga kh'alava'kkkhinchul tIa'kh'a Kh'o vu-kkh tsarna tIekh'ozhurg. Kh'o masso a khIumanan tesh ma vu.
Akh' tsarna Iazap dakh' a - u'sh Kh'an lesh bu-kkh, Akh' tsarna gechdakh', bakk'alla a, Kh'o veza verg a, kh'ukam niisa desh verg a vu-kkh".

Dala er: "KhIara de du bak'liinacharna shain bak'khilaro paida biir bolush, tsarna boshmash (ialsamane) khir iu, shain bukhakhula o'khush khish dolush, tsu chokh' la'ttar bu u'sh guttar a. Dela reza khu'lda tsarna, u'sh a reza khu'lda Tsunna - iza siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu-kkh".
Delan du-kkh stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsu chokh' dolchun a dolalla, I vu-kkh masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' berg.
Khastam bu Dalla, Sha stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llinchu, Sha boda a, nur a dinchu. TIakkkha a kerstanasha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa nisbo /kkhibersh/.
I vu shu kkho'llinarg popparkh, tIakkkha 1ozhalla khIottiina /shuna dala/. /Kkhin/ 1ozhalla iu khan to'khna Tsunna gergakh' /shu gIovto/. TIakkkha a shu sheko esh du.
I - AllakhI (ts1e iolu tskh'a Dela) vu, Sha stiglanashkakh' a vu, la'ttakh' a vu. Tsunna kha'a shun k'ailakh derg a, shun gush derg a. Tsunna kha'a ash karadesh derg a.
Shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatekh tskh'a a aiat tsa deana tsa'rga, u'sh tsunakh dIabo'rzush ben.
Khartsdira tsara bak'derg, i shaiga de'nachul tIa'kh'a. TIa'kh'a dogIur du tsa'rga khabarsh, u'sh shaikh tsa beshash khilla dolu.

Tsarna tsa go-tekh'a: mel dukkha t1a'kh'enash khIallakiina Okha tsaral kh'alkha, Okha chIagIbina bara u'sh la'ttakh', shu tsa chIagIdinchu kepara, stigal iossiira Okha tsarna tIe dogIitsa, tseran bukhakhula lelash khish khiliitira Okha, tIakkkha Okha khIallakbira u'sh shain k'inosh bakh'anekh', tsaral tIa'kh'a kkhecharan t1a'kh'e kkhiiira Okha.
Okha dossosh delkh'ara zhaina kh'o'ga kekhata tIekh', shain ku'igashtsa tsunakh kh'akkhalur bara u'sh - kerstanasha er ma dara: "Bilggala bozbuunchalla du-kkh khIara".
Ma elira tsara: "Malik dossiina khillekh'ara tsunna tIe". Okha malik dossiina khillekh'ara - kkhochushkhir dara gIullakkh, tIakkkha a u'sh kh'o'zhush lottu'itur batsara.
Okha i khiliitinekh'ara malik - i dakhiitina khir dara Okha adaman kh'esapekh', tsu tIekh' a kegari (khalo) iiir iara Okha, tsara sha'sh esh erg.
Kh'ol kh'alkha a elchanash siisazbina. Tsarakh tsa beshash bolcharakh kh'akkha ma delira tsara sha siisazdesh khillarg.
Akh' ala: "DIasaida la'ttakhula, tIakkkha kh'ovsal shu, mukha khilla /din/ khartsdecharan tIa'kh'e".

Akh' alal: "Kh'enan du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a derg?" Akh' ala: "Delan du". Shena tIedillina Tso k'inkhetam bar. Guldanne a guldiir ma du Tso shu k'ematdiine, shena chokh' sheko iotschu. Shaina ieshar dinarsh - tsara iiman du'llur dats.
Tsu'nan du bu'isanna a, diinakh' a tiina (ia lelash) khillarg. I khezash verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.

Akh' ala: "Sha stiglaniin a, la'ttan a kkhollarkho volu Dela votsurg /kkhin/ lotsu tk'a as doladiirig? I vu ritsk' lush, Tsunna tsa lo ritsk'". Akh' ala: "Suna omra dina so khila /Dalla/ mu't1akh' khillacharekh kh'alkharnig, a'lla, kh'o khilanne a ma khilalakh' mushrikunekh ", a'lla.
Akh' ala: "So kkho'ru sain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna so Iesa khilakh' deza-dokkkhachu diinan Iazapakh".
Tsu diinakh' sha tsunakh kh'alkhava'kkkhinarg - Tso tsunakh k'inkhetam bina. I bilggala tolam bu-kkh.
Dala kh'o tskh'ana zene latsakh' - vats kh'una i t1eradokkkhuverg I sha ben. Tso kh'o tskh'ana dikane latsakh' - I masso a khIumanna nitsk' kkhochush vu.
I nitsk' bolush vu Shen leshna tIekh'. I sha kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu, sov dika khuush verg a vu.

Alal /khIai Mukh'ammad/: "KhIun du uggar dokkkha kh1uma teshalla dartsa?" Ala: "Dela vu tesh suna a, shuna a iukk'ekh', so'ga va'kh'itsa daiitina khIara K'ur'an, as shetsa kkheram tasarkh'ama shuna a, i /shega/ kkha'chnachu'nga a. Shu du teshalla desh Delatsa kkhin delii bu, bokhush?" Ala: "As teshalla dats". Ala: "Bakk'alla a, i - tskh'a Dela vu, so tsIena vu ash Delatsa nak'ost latsarkh".
Okha shaina zhaina dellacharna vevza i, shain kIentii bovzare terra, shaina iesham binarsh- u'sh bu tsa teshash,
Mila vu zulame Dalla tIe khartsderg kkho'llinchul, ia Tsu'nan aiatash khartsdinchul? Bakk'alla a, bakkhiibiir ma bats zulamkhoi.
Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' Okha gulbiir ma bu u'sh masso a, tIakkkha Okha er du shirk dinacha'rga: "Michakh' bu shun nak'ostii, shuna sha'sh /delii bu / mo'ttush khilla bolu?"
TIakkkha tseran /kkhin/ bekhkazlo ma tsa khilira, tsara alar ben: "VallakhIi, tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh dui ma bou okha: tkho ma tsa khilira /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsursh ".
Kh'azhal! Mukha khartsliina u'sh sha'sh shaina tIekh'! DIatilira tsarakh sha'sh kkhullush khilla dolu khartsderg.

Tsarakh kh'o'ga ladugIush verg vu. Tseran degnashka kirkh'a dillina Okha, u'sh tsunakhtsa kkhetiita, tseran lergash chokh' k'oralla iina. Masso a delil shaina daicha a, tsa tesha u'sh tsunakh, mel dukkkha kh'o volchu ba'khkicha a, kh'o'tsa k'u'isu tsara, tsateshachara olu: "U'sh-m kh'alkhalerachiin tu'iranash dara".
U'sh otsunakh /nakh/ bukhatukhush bu, sha'sh a genabovlush bu tsunakh. Tsara khIallakdesh-m dats shain dogImash ben. Tsa khaalo-kkh tsarna.

Kh'una gicha u'sh zho'zhakhatina tIekhIittiina, tsara olush: "Ma dek'aza khili tkho! Iukhadakhiitakh'ara tkho- ma khartsdiir datsara Okha tkhain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatash, teshacharekh khir dara tkho".
Kh1a', guchuda'lla tsarna sha'sh kh'alkha kh'uldesh khillarg. U'sh iukhabakhiiticha a, shaiga ma de a'llachunna tIebo'rzur ma bara u'sh, bakk'alla a, u'sh khartslu'ish ma bu.
Tsara ma olura: "KhIara vain du'nenan dakhar ben kkhin dakhar ma dats, vai dendiir dolush ma dats".

Kh'una u'sh gicha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun kh'alkha khIittiina! Tso olush: "Bak' dats tk'a khIara?" Tsara olush: "KhIa', du tkho Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu Delora". Tso olush: "Iovsha shaina Iazap, sha'sh tsa teshash khilarna!"

Iishira sha'sh Delatsa tskh'a'nakkhetar khartsdinarsh - tsIekhkh'ana shaina sakh'tkhIo'tticha, elira tsara: "Ma bala bu-kkh vaina vai sha tergal tsa dinarg bakh'anekh'". Tsara dIakh'ur du shain k'inosh shain bakk'ash tIekh'. Ma von khIuma du-kkh tsara shaina mokh' binarg!
Du'nenan dakhar ma dats lovzar a, erna khan iaiar a ben. Bakk'alla a, ekhartan tsIa dika du /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna. Shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?
Tkho khuush du, bakk'alla a, tsara du'itsucho kh'o vanne a singattame ma vo. Bakk'alla a, kh'o khartsvesh bats u'sh - sha'sh zulamkhoi bu, Delan aiatash kerstadesh.

Kh'ol kh'alkha a khartsbina elchanash - sobar dira tsara sha'sh khartsdinchunna tIekh', sha'sh lazorna tIekh' shaiga Tkhan gIo kkhachchalts. Delan deshnash khiitsa tskh'a a vats. Kh'o'ga ma de'na elchaniin khabar.

U'sh dIaberzarkh'una dokkkha khetash delakh', kh'una magakh' la'ttakh' kheralla, ia stigla vala lami karo, tIakkkha akh' dakh'ar dara tsa'rga tskh'a aiat (delil). Dalla li'nekh'ara, Tso gulbiir bara u'sh niisachu novk'a. Kh'o khilanne a ma khilalakh' zhekhIalchu nakhakh.
/Kh'an kkhaikkharna/ zhop lur du, bakk'alla a, khezash bolchara. Tk'a bellarsh - Dala denbiir bu u'sh, tIakkkha Tsu'nga dIaberzor bu.
Tsara elira: "Shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara aiatdossosh khillekh'ara tsu'nga". Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, Dela nitsk' kkhochush vu aiat dosso, delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh tsa khuush bu".

Tskh'a a diinat ma dats la'ttakh', tskh'a a kh'oza ma dats tIema dolush shen tIemashtsa - sha'sh shu sanna ummatashdolush ben. KhIumma a dits tsa dina Okha kkhu zhaini chokh'. TIakkkha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga u'sh dIagulbiir bu.
I Tkhan aiatash khartsdesh bersh bu k'ora, mott tsa khuush, bodanekh' Iokhkush. Shena luurg tilavala vu'tu Dala, Shena luurg niisachu novk'a vu'llu Tso.
Akh' ala: "Shuna goi! Tk'a Delan Iazap shaiga de'cha, ia sakh'tshaina tIekhIo'tticha, Dela votsuchu'nga kkhoikkhur dara Ash, shu khillekh' bak'lu'ish?"
KhIan-khIa! Tsu'nga kkhoikkhur dara ash. Aidiir daraTso ash shega kkhaikkhinarg, Shena laakh'. Ash ditsdiir dara sha'sh /Delatsa/ nak'ost latsar.
Kh'ol kh'alkha a bakhkiitira Okha khalk'ashka /elchanash/, i khalk'ash balanashtsa (miskallitsa), khalonashtsa (tsamgarshtsa) skh'aliitsira Okha, u'sh /Tkho'ga/ kh'astalur batsara-te?
Tkhan nitsk' shaiga be'cha, kh'asta khIunda tsa belira u'sh /Dalla/? Delakh' a, k'iza khilira tseran degnash. Khazdora tsarna shaitIano sha'sh desh khillarg.

Tsara shaiga shetsa kh'ekham bina khillarg (kkheram tesna khillarg) ditsdicha, Okha dIaiillira tsarna masso a /dikachu/ khIumanan neIarsh (shain k'inoshkakh' u'sh dukkkha lattiitarkh'ama), u'sh bakkhiibesh bolush shaiga de'nachukh, /tIakkkha/ tsIekhkh'ana skh'aliitsira Okha u'sh - tIakkkha tsara dog dillira masso a dikanakh.
Khadiira sha zulam desh khillachu khalk'an tIa'kh'e. Khastam bu Dalla - Ialamiin Dena.

Akh' ala: "Shu kh'ovsal, Dala shun lersa a, bIa'rsa a skh'aetscha, shun degnashna Tso mukhIar to'khcha, AllakhI votschu mu'lkhachu Dala shuna i lur dara? Kh'azhal! Mukha bilgaldokhu Okha aiatash - tIakkkha a u'sh /bak'dolchukh/ dIabo'rzu".
Akh' ala: "Kh'ovsal! Diitsiisha suna, Delan Iazap shaiga tsIekhkh'ana de'cha ia gush de'cha, zulame k'am ben khIallak'khir dui?"

Okha bokhu'itush ma bats elchanash tsara /dika Iamal iinacharna/ kkha' bokkkhush, /von Iamal iinacharna/ kkheram tosush ben. Iiman dillinarg a, dikanig dinarg a - /ekhartakh'/ kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats /du'nenakh' bukhadu'sachukh/.
Tkhan aiatash khartsdinarsh - tsarakh kh'akkhalur du Iazap u'sh fasik'khilarna.

Akh' ala: "As tsa bokhu shu'ga: "San gergakh' Delan khaznash du", suna tsa kha'a k'aile a, as tsa bokhu shu'ga: "So malik du". So tIa'kh'akhIuttush vu saiga lush dolchu va'kh'ashna". Akh' ala: "Tk'a tskh'abossa vui-te bIa'rsa dotsurg a, bIa'rsa derg a. Ash oila tsa io-te?"
Akh' tsu'ntsakh'ekhambesha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kh'alkha guldiirig khilarkh kkho'rush bolcharna, tsarna vats I votsurg doladiirig a, gIodakkkharkho a - u'sh khila megara kkho'rush.

Akh' dIa ma lelkhabe Iu'irentsa a, su'irentsa a shain Dele kkhoikkhush bersh, Tsu'nan iu'kh' luush/miska bu alii, kh'aldolcharna tambarkh'ama/. Tseran kh'esap tskh'ana a khIumantsa kh'una tIekh' dats, kh'an kh'esapan khIumma a tsarna tIekh' a dats (kh'o'ga khottur dats tseran k'inoikh ia dagchokh' derg bakh'anekh', ishtta tsa'rga a - kh'o bakh'anekh'). Akh' u'sh dIalelkhaboi - kh'o zulamkhoikh khu'lu.
Ishtta Okha ziira u'sh vovshashtsa, tsa'rga aliitarkh'ama: "KhIorsh bu u'sh Dala vaina iukk'era shaina dikanash dellarsh". Tk'a Dela vats dika bevzash shukur diirash (barkalla olursh)?

Kh'o volchu ba'khkicha Tkhan aiatekh teshash bersh, akh' ala: "Mashar shuna". Shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho Sha Shena tIedillina /shen khalk'akh/ k'inkhetam bar: nagakh' shukh tskh'ammo von dakh'tsa khuush, tIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a toba dakh', dika Iamal iakh' - bakk'alla a, I vu-kkh /tsunna/ gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Ishtta ma-darra dIadu'itsu Okha aiatash, k'inosh letocheran nek' bilgalbaliitarkh'ama a.

Akh' ala: "Suna tsa magiina Iibadan dan Dela votschu ash shega kkhoikkhuchu'nga". Ala: "So tIa'kh'akh1uttur ma vats shun dezarshna, /kh1o'ttinekh'/ - so tillavella khir ma vara t1akkkha, niisachu novk'akh' bolcharakh khir ma vatsara so".

Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, so san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun bilgalonna tIekh' vu, ash i khartsdina (Delera bak'derg). So'gakh' dats shu shetsa sikhlush derg, kh'ukma Delan ben dats - Tso du'itsu bak'derg, Iza dika k'astambiirig ma vu".
Akh' ala: "So'gakh' delkh'ara shu shetsa sikhlush derg,- san a, shun a iukk'era gIullakkh (k'ovsam) chekkhda'lla khir dara. Dela dika bevzash vu-kkh zulamkhoi".

Tsu'ngakh' du-kkh k'ailenan /khazniin/ dogIanash. Tsunna Shena ben tsa kha'a u'sh. Arengakh' derg a, khIorda chokh' derg a khuush vu-kkh I, gIa okh'a- duzhur ma dats Tsunna khuush ben, bu'rtig /kkhu'ur/ ma bats la'ttan bodanashkakh', ia tIunalla a, ia iok'alla a /iuzhur/ ma iats, sha bilgalchu zhainachokh' iolush ben.

Shu busa dolu'iturgvu Iza, ash diinakh' desh derg khuush vu I - tIakkkha tsu chokh' (diinakh') shu dendo Tso - tsIe to'khna iolu khankkhochushkhiliitarkh'ama. Tsunna tIe du shun dIaderzar, tIakkkha Tso du'itsur du shu'ga ash lelosh khillarg.
Iza nitsk' kkhochush vu Shen leshna tIekh'. Shuna tIe bou'itu Tso khekhoi. Shukh tskh'anna tIe valar de'cha - Tkhan elchanash (malikash) kkhochushdoi - tsara ledarlo tsa iolu'itu.
TIakkkha berzabo u'sh Dalla tIe, tseran bak' Doladiirig volchu.Tk'a kh'ukma Tsu'nan dats? Uggar sikha vu I kh'esap darekh'.

Akh' ala: "Mila vu i shu arenan a, khIordan a bodanakh larden verg, ash Shega kh'astadella a, k'ailakha a kkhoikkhush verg: "KhIokkhunakh Tso tkho kIelkh'ardakhakh', tkho khilanne a khir ma du barkalla olucharakh!?" /olush/.
Akh' ala: "Dala kIelkh'ardokhur du shu tsunakh a, masso a balekh a - tIakkkha a ash Tsu'ntsa nak'ost ma lotsu".

Ala: "Iza /Dela/ nitsk' kkhochush vu shuna tIekhula a, shun kogii bukhakhula a shuna Iazap dosso, ia shu tobanashka dek'a, tskh'abolchara vukkha'rga bala kh'egabaita a". Kh'azhal, mukha ma-darra du'itsu Okha aiatash, u'sh khiliita kkhetash.
Khartsdina kh'an k'omo i (K'ur'an), i bak'derg dollushekh'. Akh' ala: "So tsa khili shuna tIekh' vekal" (shun gIullakkhash kkhochushdan).
KhIor /Delera/ khabaran shen khan iu /i t1ekh1o'tticha, i kkhochushkhir dolush/ - tIa'kh'a khuur du shuna.

Kh'una gicha, Tkhan aiatash, siisaz a desh, kh'ekhosh bersh - genavala tsarakh, u'sh kkhechu khabarna tIebovllalts. Ia kh'o vanne a vitsvolu'itur vu shaitIano - tIakkkha dagade'nachul tIa'kh'a kkhin zulam dechu k'omatsa okh'a ma khaalakh'.
/Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna tseran (Delan aiatash siisaza desh bolcheran) kh'esapakhkhIumma khir dats, delakh' a, kh'ekham bar du-kkh /tsarna tIekh'/ - u'shkkho'rush khir batsara-te?

Bita i shain din lovzare a, erna khan iaiare a da'kkkhinarsh, sha'sh du'nenan dakharo Iekhiinarsh. Akh' kh'ekham be /nakhana/ tsu'ntsa (K'ur'antsa) adam sha karadaiitincho khIallak tsadaitarkh'ama - vats tsunna Dela votsurg doladiirig a, gIolotsurg a. Mella a /zho'zhakhatina/ du'kh'al makh belcha a - o'tsur bats tsu'ngara i. U'sh bu sha'sh dinchu'ntsa sha'sh khIallak'khillarsh, tsarna du tsIiidina khinan malar a, lazosh dolu Iazap a - u'sh khilarna tsa teshash.

Akh' ala: "Vai kkhoikkhu tk'a, Dela a vu'tii, va'shna paida a, zen a tsa dechu'nga? Vai iukhaderzina khir ma du (kerstanalle) Dala vai nisdinchul tIa'kh'a, la'ttakh' shaitIano sha Iekhiinchukh tera kh'ere a khilla, shen nak'ostii bolush shega niisachu novk'a kkhoikkhush: "Skh'avola tkhuna tIe", bokhush. Akh' ala: "Delan niisa nek' - i bu niisa nek', tkhuna omra dina Ialamiin Dena mu'tIakh' khila,
Lamaz khIottade, Tsunakh (Delakh) kkhera",-a'lla. I vu shu Shena tIe dIaguldiir derg.

I vu stiglanash a, latta a Sha kkho'llinarg bak'ontsa. Tso "Khila!" a'llachu diinakh' - khu'lu. Tsu'nan dosh bak'derg du. Ma1a (zurma) lokkhuchu diinakh'pachchakh'lla Tsu'nan du, k'ailakh' derg, gushderg khuurg I vu. I Sha kh'ek'ale verg vu, sov dika khuush verg vu.
IbrakhIima a'llerashen dega Azare: "Akh' tsIunash lo'tsu delii boi? Kh'o a, kh'an k'am a bilggalchu tilar chokh' gush vu-kkh so".
Ishtta goitu Okha IbrakhIimna stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla, i khiliitarkh'ama a /Delakh/ ch1og1a teshacharakh.
Shena tIe bu'isa io'lcha, tsunna (IbrakhIimna) gira seda. Tso elira: "I vu san Dela". I dIatilcha, tso elira: "Suna tsa beza dIatu'lush bersh".
Shena butt baicha kkhetash, tso elira: "I vu san Dela". Iza a dIabu'zcha, tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobucho so tsa nisvakh', so bilggala khir ma vu tiladellachu k'omakh".
Shena malkh gicha kkhetash, tso elira: "Iza vu san Dela, iza uggar vokkkha vu". Iza a dIabu'zcha, tso elira: "KhIai san k'am, so tsIena vu-kkh ash /Delatsa/ nak'ost latsarkh.
As d1aerzi sain iu'kh' stiglanash a, la'tta a Kkho'llinchu'nga, doggakh /masso a khartsdinakh bak'dolchu dinna / tIe a virzina, so vats mushrikekh".

Tsu'nan k'omo k'iisira tsu'ntsa. Tso elira: "So'tsa k'u'isu ash Dela bakh'anekh'? Tso so niisachu novk'a ma va'kkkhina. So tsa kkho'ru ash shetsa shirkdechukh, san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna luush dolchu khIumanakh ben. Masso a khIuma chula'tsna san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho Iilmantsa. Ash oila tsa io?

So mukha kkho'ru ash shirk dinchukh? Shu a ma tsa kkho'ru sha'sh Delatsa nak'ost la'tsna khilarkh, shetsa shu'ga dossosh khilla tskh'a a delil dotstsushekh'. /Tsu/ shinna tobanekh mu'lkhanig iu uggar kh'ak' kkheram tsakhilarna, shu khuush khillekh'?"
Iiman dillinarsh, shain iiman zulamekh tsa edinarsh - u'sh bu shaina kkheram botsursh, u'sh bu niisachu novk'akh'.
I du Tkhan delil, Okha della i IbrakhIimna shen k'omana du'kh'al. Tkhaina luurg darzhashkakh' kh'alavokkkhu Okha. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg ma vu kh'ek'ale verg a, khuush verg a.

Okha tsunnasovgIatna velira Iskh'ak' a, IaIk'ub a. Berrige a niisachu novk'a nisbira. Nukh' a nisvira Okha niisachu novk'a /tsaral/ kh'alkha. Tsu'nan (IbrakhIiman) zu'rretakhvu Davud a, Sulaiman a, Aiub a, Iusuf a, Musa a, KhIarun a. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha dikacharna.
Zakariia a, Iakh''ia a, Iiisa a, Il'ias a - masso a dikacharakh vu.
TIakkkha IsmaIil a, Al- IasaI a, Iunus a, LutI a - masso a vazvina Okha Ialamel.
Tseran daikh a, tseran t1a'kh'enekh a, tseran vezharekh a /bevllacharna a della Okha i niImat/, u'sh kha'rzhina Okha, nisbira niisachu novk'a.
Iza - Delan niisa nek' bu, tsu'ntsa nisvo Tso shen lekh Shena luurg. Tsara shirk dinekh'ara, tsara iina khilla Iamalsh iovr ma iara.
U'sh bu Okha shaiga zhaina a, kh'ukma a, paikhamaralla a dellarsh. KhIorsh tsunakhtsa teshakh' - Okha iza t1edu'llur du /kkhechu/ k'omana, sha tsu'ntsa kerstanalla diir dotsush dolchu.
U'sh bu Dala nisbinarsh. Tseran niisachu novk'a tIa'kh'akhIotta kh'o. Akh' ala: "As shu'gara makh tsa bo'khu tsunakh. I ma bats Ialamashna kh'ekham ben".

Dalla kh'ak' bolu makh tsa khadiira tsara, sha'sh olush: "Dala tsa dossiina stage khIumma a". Akh' ala: "Kh'an dossiina zhaina, shetsa Musa veana volu, nur a niisa nek' khilla bolu nakhana? Ash tsunna teptarshdo: tskh'aderg gucha a dokkkhush, dukkhaderg kh'ul a desh. Shuna Iamiina ma du shuna a, shun daishna a tsakhuurg". Akh' ala: "Dala" /dossiina/ TIakkkha bita u'sh shain tilarchokh' lovzush.

KhIara zhainaa, Okha dossiina i, sha berkate a dolush, shel kh'alkharnig bak'desh dolush, iartiin nannaa, tsunna gonakha dolchunna a kkheram tasa. Ekhartakh teshash bersh tesha tsunakh (K'r'anakh). U'sh shain lamazash Ialashdesh bu.

Mila vu Dalla tIe khartsderg kkho'llinchul zulame? Ia a'llachul: "Shega va'kh'ii deana", va'kh'ekh khIumma a tsa deana tsu'nga, a'llachul a: "Asa a dossor du Dala dossiinachukh teranig". Kh'una gicha i zulamkhoi sau'izush, malikash tseran ku'igash darzhosh /olush/: "Aradakha shain sinosh, takhana siisazallin Iazaptsa bekkham bu shuna ash Dalla tIekh' bak'dotsurg olush khilarna, shu Tsu'nan aiatekh kuradovlush khilarna".

Shu da'khkina Tkhuna tIe tskh'atstsa, Okha shu ma du'khkh'ara ma kkhollara. Ash ditira Okha shaina dellarg shain tIekh'akh'. Tkhuna-m tsa go shu'tsa shun gIodakkkharkhoi, shuna mo'ttush khilla bolu sha'sh shun nak'ostii bu. DIakhedira shun iuk', dIatilira shukh shuna mo'ttush khillarg.
Bakk'alla a, Dela vu khIu a, lag a skh'ado'llush verg. Diinaderg dellachukh skh'adokkkhu Tso, dellarg diinachukh skh'adokkkhurg a vu Iza. I vu shun Dela - shu mukha Iekhosh du /khartsdolcho/!?
Satasar k'astadiirig vu I, bu'isa iina Tso tiinalla khilla, malkh a, butt a kkho'llina /khanna-zamanna lerina/ kh'esapna. I bu Sha veza volchun, Sha khuush volchun dIakhIottam.
I vu shuna sedarchii kkho'llinarg, arenan a, khIordan a bodanekh' shuna nek' karaban. Okha bilgaldina aiatash khuush dolchu k'omana.
I vu shu kkhiiina tskh'ana sikh(Adamakh), t1akkkha /shena/ chIagIdalar a, 1alashdalar a khu'lush. Bilgaldina Okha aiatash oila echu k'omana.

I vu stiglara khi dossiinarg, tsu'ntsa kkkhiira Okha masso a taipa oramat, tsunakh khassto'mash a k'astiira Okha, kkhiado tsunakh bu'rtigash tIettIa. Khurmanan ditta t1ekh' kkhu'u khurmanan kenash, /khu'lu'itu Tso/ kemsiin a, zait-dittan a, nariina boshmash, tera ersh a, tera iotsursh a. Kh'ovsal shu sto'mashka, u'sh kkhu'ush a, khu'lush a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash ma du teshash dolchu k'omana.

Dalla nak'ostii khiliitina tsara zhinekh, Tso kkho'llina ma du u'sh, tsara (teshash botschu nakha) tskh'a a Iilma dotsush khartso kkho'llira Tsunna - kIentii a, mekhkarii /bu Tsu'nan, a'lla/. TsIena vu I vonakh, lakkhaveli I tsara dechu (kharts) sibatekh.
Stiglaniin a, la'ttan aiu'kh'antsa kkhollarkho, michara khir vu Tsu'nan do'zalkho? Tsu'nan zuda ma tsa khilla. Tso Sha ma kkho'llina masso a khIuma. Masso a khIuma Sha khuush verg ma vu Iza.
I vu shun Dela - shu Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - kkhin dela vats I votsurg, masso a khIuma Sha kkho'llinarg vu I. Tsunna Iibadat deisha! I ma vu masso a khIumanna tIekh' vekal.
BIa'rsa tsa kkhu'u Tsunakh, I kkhu'u bIa'rsanakh. I tIekh kkhetame a vu, dika khuush a vu.
Shu'ga eana bIa'rserlonashshun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara. BIa'rg billinchunna - tsunna shena du, bIa'rg kh'abbinchunna - tsunna shena du, /akh' ala, Mukh'ammad/: "So ma vats shuna tIekh' khekho".
Ishtta bilgaldokhu Okha aiatash, tsara ala tarlo dela: "Akh' Iamiina", Okha i bilgaldakkkharkh'ama khuush dolchu k'omana.
Kh'o kh'ain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara kh'ain dag chu du'lluchunna tIa'kh'akhIotta, kkhin Dela vats I votsurg, genavala mushrikekh.
Dalla li'nekh'ara /Tsu'ntsa/ nak'ost lotsur vatsara tsara, tsarna tIekh' khekho tsa vina Okha kh'okh, tsarna tIekh' vekala vats kh'o.

Ash siisaza ma be Dela a vitina, tsara shaiga kkhoikkhush bersh (ts1ush) - tIakkkha tsara mostagIallitsa, tskh'a a Iilma dotsush, Dela a siisazviir vu. Ishtta khaziina Okha khIor ummatana shen Iamal, tIakkkha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga du tseran dIaderzar, Tso du'itsur du tsarna tsara desh khillarg.

Delatsa chIogIa duinash biira tsara: shaiga delil de'cha, tsunakh teshanne a teshaza Iiir ma dats sha'sh, a'lla. Akh' ala: "Delilash Dalla gergakh' du", stenkhou'itu shu'ga? - u'sh de'cha a, tsara iiman du'llur dats.
Tseran degnash a, tseran bIa'rsa a kh'iizado Okha, u'sh tsunakh (K'ur'anakh) iu'kh'antsa tsa teshash ma khilla, bu'tu u'sh shain tilarchokh' dIasau'idush.

Okha tsa'rga malikash dossosh khillekh'ara a, bellachara tsa'rga k'amel desh khillekh'ara a, Okha tsarna masso a khIuma shain bIargash kh'alkha guliina khillekh'ara a - tIakkkha a teshna khir batsara u'sh, Dalla li'cha a ben. Delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh tsa khuush bu.

Ishtta masso a paikhamarna mostagI khiliitira Okha adamiin a, zhiniin a shaitIanekh, tskh'abolchara vukkheran degnashka khazdina deshnash kkhu'ssush, u'sh Iekhorkh'ama. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna li'na khillekh'ara, i dina khir datsara tsara. Bita u'sh a, tsara kharts kkhullushderg a.
Tsu tIe ekhartakh tsateshacheran degnash dakhiitarkh'ama a, tsunna reza u'sh khiliitarkh'ama a, tsa'rga guldaitarkh'ama a sha'sh desh khilla dolu k'inosh /bitina u'sh Dala/.

/Akh' ala/: "Dela votschu'ngara lo'khu tk'a as kh'ukma? I ma vu shu'ga k'astosh dolu zhaina dossiinarg". Okha shaina zhaina dellacharna kha'a i kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bak'ontsa dossosh khilar. Kh'o khilanne a ma khilalakh' sheko esh bolcharakh.
Kkhochushkhilla kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun deshnash bak'odlchu'ntsa a, niisontsa a. Tsu'nan deshnash khiitsa tskh'a a vats. I sha khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.
Kh'o mu'tIakh' khilakh' la'ttakh' bolcharakh dukkkhakhbolcharna, Delan nek'akh tilor vu kh'o tsara. U'sh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma bats shaina mo'ttush dolchunna a ben, u'sh ma bats khartslu'ish ben.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - I ma vu dika khuush (vevzash) Shen nek'akh tilavellarg, I dika khuush (bevzash) ma vu niisachu novk'akh' bersh.
Ash daa /bezhnekh/ shena tIekh' /urs kh'okkhuchu khenakh'/ Delan tsIe ia'kkkhinchukh, sha'sh Tsu'nan aiatekh teshash khilla delakh'.

Ash khIunda tsa duu shena tIekh' Delan tsIe ia'kkkhichukh? Tso shuna k'asta ma dina Sha shuna kh'aram dinarg. Shu i tsa di'cha tsa dovlush derg dotsurg. Bakk'alla a, dukkhabersh /nakh/ niisachu nek'akh tilosh ma bu shain laamashtsa, tskh'a a Iilma dotstsushekh'. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - I ma vu dika bevzash dozanekh bevllarsh.
Dita guchuda'lla k'a a, guchu tsa da'llarg a. Bakk'alla a, sha'sh k'inosh desh bolcharna bekkham khir ma bu sha'sh desh khillachu'ntsa.

Ash ma daalashDelan tsIe shena tIekh' tsa ia'kkkhinchukh. Iza, bakk'alla a, fasik'allaiu. Bakk'alla a, shaitIanasha dagatu'isu shain dottagIashna, tsa'rga shu'tsa k'iisiitarkh'ama. Nagakh' sanna shu tsarna mu'tIakh' khilakh' - /t1akkkha/ shu khir ma du mushrikash.

Ia sha khillarg vella, tIakkkha Okha sha denvina, shena Okha nur khiliitina, tsu'ntsa nakhalakh' lelash verg tera vui sha bodanashkakh' volchukh, tsu chu'ra sha araver votschu? Ishtta khazdina tsateshacharna sha'sh desh khillarg.
Ishtta khiliitina Okha masso a iu'rtakh' k'inosh letocheran tkh'amdanash, tsu chokh' tsa'rga mekarlo iaita. Tsara-m mekarlo tsa io shaina a ben, tsarna khaa tsa lo-kkh.

Shaiga delil (aiat) de'cha, tsara olu: "Tkho teshar ma dats, Delan elchanashka de'narg sannarg tkhaiga tsa dagIakh'". Dalla dika kha'a Sha elchanalla dala kh'ak' verg. K'inosh dinacharakh siisazalla kkhu'ur ma iu Dalla gergakh', chIogIa Iazap a /kkhu'ur du/ sha'sh khilarna mekarlo esh.
Dalla Shena nisvan luuchunna dog pargIatdokkkhuislamana, Tso Shena tilavala vita luuchunna dog chIogIa gatdo, stigla kh'alavoluchukh terra. Ishtta khiliitina Dala rizhstsateshacharna tIekh'.
KhIara bu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun nek', niisa khilla bolu. K'asta ma dina Okha aiatash kh'ekham tIelotsuchu k'omana.
Tsarna masharan tsIadu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh'. I vu tseran dottagI u'sh khilarna /dika/ Iamalsh esh.

/Kh'akhade:/ u'sh berrige a gulbechu diinakh'/kkhoikkhur du/: "KhIai zhiniin toba! Adamekh dokkkha dak'a skh'ala'tsna ash (dukkkha adamash tiliina ash)". Adamekh tseran dottagIasha er du: "Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu, tkhan Dela, okha vovshashkara zovkkh iitsira, Akh' tkhuna khIottiina iolu tkhan Iozhalla tIekkhechira". Tso (Dala) elira: "/Zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu shun chugIoila, daima tsu chokh' la'ttash, Dalla ma li'na". Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg ma vu Sha kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a, khuush verg a.
Ishtta tskh'abolchu zulamkhoshka vukkkheran doladoitu Okha tsara karadesh khilla dolchu'ntsa.

"KhIai zhiniin a, adamiin a toba! Shu'ga tsa ba'khkina elchanash shuna iukk'era, shu'ga du'itsush San aiatash, shuna kh'ekhosh (kkheram tasartsa) khIokkhu shun denna du'kh'alkkhetar?" Tsara a'r: "Tkhaina tIekh' teshalla dina okha". Du'nenan dakharo Iekhiira u'sh, shaina tIekh' teshalla dira tsara, sha'sh tsa teshash khilla, a'lla.
Ishtta (elchanash bokhu'itura Okha) kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tsa khilla dela zulamtsa iartash khIallak'esh, tseran okhIlanna a tsa khuush.
KhIoranna shen-shen darzh du, sha dinchukh. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg ma vats tidame o'tsur dotsush tsara desh derg.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu /tskh'annekh/ tsa vozush (khalk' a, tsu'nan Iibadat a Shena tsa khilcha a megash), k'inkhetam bolush a. Shena laakh', shu kh1allakdiir du Tso. Shul tIa'kh'a Shena luurg vu'tur vu, shu a Tso kkhiiina khilare terra kkhechu k'oman zu'rretakh.
Bakk'alla a, shuna khir du a'llarg dogIur dolush du shuna, shun nitsk' kkhochur ma bats i gIeldan (i dukhatokha).

Akh' ala: "KhIai san k'am! Shain Iamal e ash shain mettigashkakh', asa a iiir iu sain Iamal, tIa'kh'a khuur du shuna, kh'enan khir iu tsIiinan tIa'kh'e (ekhart). Bakk'alla a, bakkkhiibiir ma bats zulamkhoi".

Tsara dira Dalla Tso kkho'llinchu ialtekh a, bezhanekh a dak'a, elira (tsara) "KhIara Dalla du" - tsarna mottarekh' - "khIara vain nak'ostashna du". Tseran nak'ostashna khillarg Dele tsa kkhochu, Dalla khillarg tseran nak'ostashka kkhochu - ma von khilla tsara desh dolu kh'ukma.

Ishtta khazdira dukkhabolchu mushrikashna tseran nak'ostasha - zhinasha shain berash daiar (zudaberash, diina dolush, la'ttakh dokhkar), u'sh khIallakbarkh'ama a, tsarna shain (IsmaIilera skh'adogIush khilla dolu) din dokhadaitarkh'ama a. Dalla li'na khillekh'ara, i diir datsara tsara, bita u'sh a, tsara /kharts/ kkhullurg a.

/Mushrikasha/ elira: "KhIara da'khni a, ialta a kh'aram du, i duur dats vaina lu'cho ben", - ishtta dovdora tsara, da'khni du shaina tIekhaar kh'aram dolush /tsarna mottarekh'/, da'khni du tsara shaina tIekh' Delan tsIe tsa iokkkhush Tsunna tIekh' khartsderg kkhollarkh'ama. TIakkkha bekkham biir bu Tso tsarna tsara /khartsderg/ tIekkhullush khilarna.

Tsara elira: "KhIokkhu bezhaniin gai chokh' dergtsIena du vain bozharshna, kh'aram du vain zudarshna. Nagakh' sanna elladu'nena ialakh' - u'sh tsu chokh' /tskh'aniissa/ dek'akhoi bu". Tso (Dala) bekkham biir bu tsarna sha'sh kkhullush dolchunna tIekh'. Bakk'alla a, I kh'ikmate a vu /Sha dechu kh1umanekh'/, devzash a vu /Shen khalk'/.

Eshallekh' bisi Iovdallalitsa, khuush khIuma a dotsush, shain berash khIallakbinarsh, Dala shaina della ritsk' shaina kh'aramdinarsh, Dalla tIe khartsderg kkhollarkh'ama. Tilabella u'sh, niisachu novk'akh' khila a tsa khilla u'sh.

I vu kkhiiinarg boshmash, kkhozush iolu a, kkhozush iotsu a, khurmanash a, oramatash a, shain daar bashkha dolush, zait-ditt a, nara - tera iolu a, tera iotsu a. Baa tseran sto'mash, u'sh kkhi'cha, ialta chuderzochu diinakh' tsu'nan kh'ak' (zakat) dIalo. Kkhoam tsa besh ma daia /shaigakh' derg/. Bakk'alla a, Tsunna tsa beza khIumanan kkhoam tsa besh bersh.
Bezhanekh du - shuna mokh' kkho'kh'ursh a, shuna kIeda mottkhu'lursh a. Daa Dala shaina dellachu ritsk'ekh, tIa'kh'a ma khIitta shaitIanan gIulchashna. Bakk'alla a, i shuna bilggala mostagI ma du.

/Skh'aetsa/ barkhI bo'rshanig a, stenig a: u'stagIekh a shishsha, gezarekh a shisha. Alal (khattal tsa'rga): "Bo'rshanig shi' kh'aram dina Tso (Dala) ia stenig shi' dina, ia shinnan a stechiin kiirakh' derg dina? Diitsal suna Iilmantsa, sha'sh bak'lu'ish khillekh'".

Emkalekh shi', bezhnekh shi' - alal /khIintsa/: shi' bo'rshanig kh'aram dina, ia shi' stenig dina, ia shinnan a stechiin kiirakh' derg dina, ia shu dara teshash (dak'a lotsush) Dala shuna tsu'ntsa veset desh?" Mila khir vu zulame Dalla tIe khartsderg kkhulluchul, nakh tilorkh'ama tskh'a a Iilma dotstsushekh'? Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa nisdo zulame k'am.

Akh' ala: "Suna tsa karado saiga daiitinchu va'kh'ashkakh'duuchunna daa kh'aram dinarg k'edellarg dotsurg, ia Ienash dolu tsIii dotsurg, ia kh'akkhin zhizhig dotsurg, - tIakkkha i rizhs iu, - ia shena tIekh'/urs kh'okkhush/ Dela votschun tsIe ia'kkkhina tsIena iotsu khIumaiotsurg. TIk'a shena nitsk' bakh' /matsallo/, k'inakh larlush, /Delan/ dozanakh a tsa volush - /iuur iu tso kh'aramnig/. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gechdesh verg ma vu, k'inkhetame verg a ma vu.

Zhu'gtashna kh'aram ma dira Okha masso a (ek'aella) berg iolu /diinat/. Kh'elekh a, u'stagIekh a, - Okha kh'aram iira tsarna otseran mokh', shain buk'akh, ia chokokh lett iotsurg, ia da'Iakhkakh iinarg iotsurg. I bekkham bira Okha tsarna u'sh tilbalar bakh'anekh'. Bakk'alla a, tkho bak' du /Tkhan kh'ukmashkakh'./
Kh'o tsara khartsvakh', ala: "Shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu shortta k'inkhetam bolush, bukhatokhalur bats Tsu'nan nitsk' k'inosh dechu k'omakh".

Delatsa nak'ost la'tsnachara er du: "Dalla li'nekh'ara, Delatsa nak'ost lotsur vatsara okha a, tkhan daisha a, khIumma a kh'aram diir datsara okha". Ishtta khartsdira /din/ tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a tkhan nitsk' Iovshshalts. Alal (khattal tsa'rga): "Shu'gakh' dui Iilma? Delakh', ash i tkhuna guchudakkkha. Shu tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma dats mottargIashna a ben, shu ma dats khartslu'ish a ben ".
Ala: "Delekh' du kkhochchush delil. Li'nekh'ara, shu derrige a nisdiir dara Tso".

Ala: "Balabe shain teshash, sha'sh teshalla diir dolu, Dala i kh'aram dina",-a'lla. Tsara teshalla dakh', akh' ma delakh' tsartsa teshalla. Kh'o tIa'kh'a ma khIottalakh' Tkhan aiatash khartsdinacheran a, ekhartakh tsateshacheran a laarshna - u'sh bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa /kkhin nak'ostii/ nisbesh (mushrikash).

Ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Skh'adu'ila, as du'itsur du shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho shuna kh'aram dinarg: ash tsu'ntsa tskh'anna khIumantsa nak'ost tsalatsar a, detsa-nenatsa dika khilar a. Shain do'zalsh ma baia matsallakh /kkho'rush/- Okha kkhobur du shu a, u'sh a. Bo'khachunnagerga ma gIolash - tsunakh guchuda'llachukh a, k'ailakha dolchukh a. Sa ma delash, sha Dala kh'aram dina dolu, bak'ontsa ben. I du Tso shu'ga veset dinarg, shu khillarkh'ama kh'ek'ale.

Boberan da'khnina gerga ma gIolash dikachu'ntsa ben, i kkhi'na dallalts. Terza niisa ozalash. Okha tIe tsa du'llu sina tsunna nitsk' kkhochurg ben. Sha'sh diitsakh', niiso elash (bak'derg diitsalash), gergara velakh' a. Delatsa iina vaIda kkhochush'elash. I du Tso shuna shetsa veset dinarg, shu khiliitarkh'ama oila esh.

KhIara San nek' bu niisa berg - tIa'kh'akhIitta tsunna, tIa'kh'a ma khIitta kkhechu nek'ashna - tsara dIak'astor du shu Tsu'nan nek'akh. I du shuna Tso (Dala) shetsa veset dinarg, shu khiliitarkh'ama /Delakh/ kkho'rush.

TIakkkha Musaga delira Okha zhaina, sha dikanig dinachunna /Tkhan niImat/ kkhochushdesh khilla dolu, khIor khIumanna k'astor khilla dolu, niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a khilla bolu- u'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa tskh'anakkhetarkh teshash khila ma megara.
KhIara a zhaina /K'ur'an/ du. Okha dossiina i sha berkate a dolush, tIa'kh'akhIitta tsunna, /Delakh/ kkhera - shukh k'inkhetam ban megara.
Ash tsa alarkh'ama: "Tkhol kh'alkha khillachu shina tobanedossiina zhaina, tkho khilla u'sh Iamarkh gIopal (tkhuna tsa 1ema u'sh-tkhan mattakh' dats u'sh".

Ia ash tsa alarkh'ama: "Tkho'ga dossiina khillekh'ara zhaina - tsaral a niisa khilla khir dara tkho". Eana shu'ga bilgalo shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara, niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a. Mila vu tk'a zulame Delan aiatash khartsdechul, tsarakh /nakh/ dIatilinchul? Bekkham biir bu Okha Tkhan aiatekh /nakh/ dIatilincharna vochu Iazaptsa tsara u'sh tilosh khilar bakh'anekh'.

Kh'ovsur bui-te u'sh shaiga malikash dakhkare ia shaina Dela vare, ia kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tskh'adolu aiatash dakhkare? Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tskh'adolu aiatash da'khkanchu diinakh' sina paida biir bats tsu'nan iimano, sha kh'alkha teshna khilla datsakh' ia shen iiman chokh' guldina dikanig datsakh'. Akh' ala: "Kh'ovsush Ie shu - tkho a kh'ovsush du".
Bakk'alla a, shain din dek'na khillarsh, tobanash khillarsh- kh'o tsarakh ma vats kh'una tskh'anna khIumanna tIekh', tseran gIullakkh Dele du. TIakkkha Tso du'itsur du tsa'rga tsara desh khillarg.
Dikanig de'nachunna -tsunna itt tsunakh teranig du. Vonig de'nachunna - bekkham khir bats tsunakh terachu'ntsa ben. Tsarna zulam diir dats.

Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, so nisvina san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho niisachu novk'a, mekhala (niisa) din khu'luitush, doggakh /i bak'dina/ tIevirzina khilla volchu IbrakhIiman millatakh khu'lu'itush. I /IbrakhIim/ tsa khilla mushrikekh".
Ala: "San lamaz a, san Iibadat a, san denvalar a, san valar a - Dalla du, Ialamiin Da khilla volchu.
Nak'ost vats tsu'nan. Tsu'ntsa omra dina suna, so kh'alkhara mu'tIakh' verg vu".

Akh' ala: "AllakhI votsurg /kkhin/ lokhu as Kkhiosh-kkhoburg (Dela)? I ma vu masso a khIumanan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg. Karor ma dats khIor sinna shena tIekh' derg ben. Kh'ur ma bats kh'ocho kkhechu'nan mokh'. TIakkkha shun dIaderzar shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga ma du - Tso du'itsur ma du shuna shu shena chokh' khilpalo esh khillarg.

I ma vu shukh khiliitinarg la'ttan tIa'kh'e, shukh tskh'abersh vukkharal darzhatsa aibinarg, shu zerkh'ama Sha shuna dellachu'ngakh'. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg sikha ma vu taIzar darekh', I gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a ma vu.

Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu/khIai Mukh'ammad/ khIonsakh la'tsna, akh' ala: "KhIons Delan a, elchanan a iu". Shu Delakh kkhera, vovshii iukk'ekh' maslakh'at a de, mu'tIakh' khila Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a, sha'sh khillekh' teshash dersh (mu'min nakh).

Bakk'alla a, teshash bersh (mu'min nakh) bu Dela kh'ekhiicha, shain degnash kIadlush bersh, shaina tIekh' Tsu'nan aiatash deshcha, iimantsa sovbu'ilush bersh, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIetevzhash bersh.
Ishttanash bu u'sh sha'sh lamaz a khIottosh, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh /Delan novk'akh'/ kharzhash a esh.
U'sh bu kh'ak'-bak' bolu teshash bersh (mu'min nakh), tsarna shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' darzhash du, gechdar du, shortta ritsk' a du.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kh'o bak'ontsakh'ain tsIa chu'ra aravakkkhare terra, teshash bolchekh (mu'min nakhakh) tskh'a toba chIogIa tsa luush ma iu/gIazot dan/.
Kh'o'tsa k'u'isush bu u'sh bak'dolchu'ngakh'i bilgalda'llachul tIa'kh'a, sha'sh Iozhallina tIe lo'khkush sanna, sha'sh kh'o'zhush a la'ttash.
Dala shu'tsa vaIda io: shina tobanakhtskh'a' shun iu, olii. Shuna dezash du gerz dotsurg shaina khu'liila, Dalla luush du bak'derg chIagIdan a Shen deshnashtsa, tsateshacheran tIa'kh'e khadon a.
Bak'derg chIagIdarkh'ama a, khartsderg dIatilorkh'ama a, k'inosh decharna /i mel/ tsa dezakh' a.
Ash shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga gIo do'khura. Tso shuna zhop delira: "As shu chIagIdiir du ezar vovshashna t1ekh'a-t1ekh'akh' la'ttachu malikashtsa",- a'lla.
I tsa dira Dala kkha' khilla a ben, shetsa shun degnash pargIatdakharkh'ama a ben. GIo dats Delera a ben. Bakk'alla a, Dela veza verg, kh'ukma niisa desh verg vu.

Dagadaiita: Tso shuna tIetesira nab ozor, shuna Shegara sapargIato khilla, dossadora shuna tIe stiglara khi (dogIa), shetsa shu tsIandarkh'ama, shaitIanan vas-vasal shukh dIaiakkkharkh'ama, shun degnash satsorkh'ama (sobartsa a, bak'dolchu'ntsa a), shun kogash tsu'ntsachIagIbarkh'ama.

Dagadaiita: kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho khaiitira malikashka, Sha shu'tsa vu, a'lla, chIagIbe iiman dillinarsh. As tIa'kh'a tsateshnacheran degnashka kkheram tosur bu - tokha legashna t1ekhula /kortosh dakha/, khadaie tseran masso a pIelgan iu'kh'ig.
Iza du u'sh Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a du'kh'al khilla khilarna. Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a du'kh'al khillachunna Dela bekkham etsa chIogIa vu.
Iza (Iazap) du shuna: "Iovsha i shaina - tsateshacharna tsIeran Iazap du".
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Sha'sh tsateshacharna du'kh'alkkhetcha (tIam tIekh' eskarsh vovshakhkkhetcha) mogIarshtsa, /shain/ bakk'ash ma tokha tsarna (tsarakh kkheraloi ma dovda).

Otsu diinakh' tsarna shen buk' to'khnarg, sha tIamna kh'a'vzash vatsakh' ia kkhechu tobanakh dIau'ish vatsakh', Delera o'gIazallina iuk'ava'lla i, tsu'nan chugIoila zho'zhakhati iu, ma von bu i kkhollam!

Ash tsa baiina u'sh, delakh' a, Dala baiina u'sh. Akh' tsa kkho'ssina /gerz/ aikh'a kkhussush, delakh' a, - Dala kkho'ssina (Dela vara i shun gIazot dIakh'osh verg) mu'min nakhana shegara khaza ial (tolam, khIons) ialarkh'ama. Bakk'alla a, Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.
Iza -Dela khilar du tsateshacheran mekarlo eshor iolush.

Ashtolam bekhcha - tolam beana shu'ga. Shu sovtsakh' - i dika du shuna, shu iukha a tIamna iuk'a dagIakh' - Tkho a dogIur du, shun tobano shu tskh'ana a khIumanakh kIelkh'ardokhur dats, i iokkkha khilakh' a. Dela mu'min nakhatsa vu.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Mu'tIakh' khila Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a, i (paikhamar) vitii dIa ma gIo, shu khezash dolush /tso du'itsurg/.
Shu tar ma lo a'llacharakh: "Lado'gIna okha", sha'sh ladugIush a botsush.
Bakk'alla a, Dalla gergakh' uggar bo'kha kh'aiba du k'oranig a, mott tsakhuurg a. U'sh bu kh'ek'ale botsursh (Delakh tsa teshash bolu kerstanash).
Dalla tsa'rgakh' dikanig li'na khillekh'ara, Tso ladogIu'itur dara tsa'rga. Tso shaiga ladogIiiticha a, tIakkkha a dIagIur bara u'sh (gIazotera bovdur bara), /iimanakh/ iu'stakh a bevlla.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Zhop lo Dalla a, elchanna a Tso shaiga kkhaikkhicha Sha shuna dakhar lushdolchu'nga. Shuna khaalash: i Dela stagana a, tsu'nan dagana a iuk'avulu /shena luurg tsu'nga tsa doitush/, shu a Tsunna tIe d1aguldiir du.
Pitanakh kkheralash: k'a'sttina shukh zulam dinacharna zen dina Ianne a tsa Ia iza (massarna a zen do tso). Shuna khaalash, i Dela bekkham bartsa (taIzar dartsa) chIogIa vuila.

Ash dagadaiitalsha'sh, kIezzig a dolush, la'ttakh' za'Iap khilar, sha'sh nakha skh'aletsarna a kkho'rush. TIakkkha Tso tIeletsira shu, Shen gIo'ntsa chIagIdira shu, tsIenchukh ritsk' a delira shuna, - shu khila megar-kkha barkalla olush.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash teshnabekhk ma belash Dalla a, elchanna a, ash teshnabekhk ma belash shaiga khillachu teshamna (dekkhar delakh' a, ia kkhin khIuma delakh' a), sha'sh khuush a dolush.
Shuna khaalash, shain bakham a, shain do'zalsh a pitana duila, bakk'alla a, Dela Shegakh' siilakh'-iokkkha ial iolush vuila.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu Delakh kkherakh', Tso kkhetam biir bu shuna (dovzu'itur du bak'derg, khartsderg), shain k'inoikh tsIandiir du shu, shuna gechdiir du Tso, - i Dela siilakh'-iokkha koma'rshalla iolush ma vu.

Kh'una mekarlo ma iora tsateshachara kh'o latsa, ia ven, ia kh'o aravakkkha /Makki chu'ra/. Mekarlo io tsara, - Dala a io mekarlo /tseran mekarlo iokhosh/. I Dela /mekarlonna du'kh'al/ mekarlo echarekh dikanig vu.
Shaina tIekh' Tkhan aiatash deshcha, tsara olu: "Khezna tkhuna, tkhaina li'cha, tsunakh teranig okha a er dara, u'sh-m kh'alkhalerachiin tu'iranash dara".
Tsara ma elira /dagadaiital, khIai elcha/: "Vezan Dela, khIara khillekh' Kh'o'gara bak'derg, dogIitsa tIulgash delkhiita tkhuna stiglara, ia lazosh dolu Iazap daiita tkhuna".
Dela tsa khilira tsarna Iazap desh, kh'o tsarna iukk'ekh' volush. Tsa khilira Dela tsarna Iazap desh verg, u'sh shaina gechdar do'khush a bolush.

Dala Iazap khIunda tsa do tsarna, u'sh Dezchu Ma'zhdige/ busalba nakh/ tsa bu'tush khilcha? U'sh tsa khilla tsunnadoladesh bersh. Tsu'nan doladan kh'ak' bersh bekk'a /Delakh/ kkho'rursh bu, delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Tseran lamaz (KaIban) tsIiina kh'alkhakh' ma tsa khilira shok ettar a, tIarash dettar a ben. /Tsarna zhop dats/ "Iovsha shaina Iazap, sha'sh tsakhilarna teshash" /alar ben/.

Bakk'alla a, tsateshachara kharzhash io Delan nek'akh /nakh/ dIatilaban. TIa'kh'a a iiir iu tsara u'sh, tIakkkha iu'sur iu kh'una u'sh tsarna shaina dokhkobovlar a, gIaigIa a khilla.TIakkkha u'sh eshor bu. Tsateshash bersh zho'zhakhate gulbiir bu
Dala k'astorkh'ama bo'khanig tsIenchukh, bo'khanig bo'khachunna tIedillarkh'ama, tIakkkha tsarakh massarakh a barz barkh'ama, tIakkkha i zho'zhakhatekh' khiliitarkh'ama. U'sh bu-kkh eshnarsh.

Akh' ala /khIai Mukh'ammad/ tsateshnacha'rga: "U'sh sovtsakh', tsarna gechdiir du kh'alkha da'llachunna, u'sh iukha a bu'ilalakh' /busalbanashtsa tIom ban/ - kh'alkhaleracharna khillarg khir du (khIallakbiir bu)".
TIom be tsa'rtsa pitana tsa khiliita, derrige a din Dalla khiliita. TIakkkha u'sh sovtsakh' (maslakh'ate ba'khkina - sovtsa shu a), - bakk'alla a, Dela tsara diirig gush vu.
U'sh dIaberzakh' (maslakh'te tsa bogIush), shuna khaalash, Dela vuila shun gIo'ncha (tIakkkha tIom be ash) - dika gIo'ncha vu, dika tolam lush verg vu Iza.

Shuna khaalash, sha'sh khIonsakh khIuma ia'kkkhicha, otsunakh pkho'algIadak'a du Dalla a, elchanna a, tsu'nan gergarcharna a, boberashna a, miskacharna a, nek'akhochunna a, shu khillekh' teshash Delakh a, Okha Tkhain lega, k'astaman diinakh'shi tobavovshashna du'kh'-du'kh'al nis'ellachu diinakh', dossiinachukh a (malikashka a, kkhin Delan bilgalonashka a). Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush vu.

Dagadaiita, shu /Madinatan/ gergarchu ag1or a dolush, u'sh genarchu ag1or a bolush, i k'epalshuna lakhakh' a iolush ma dara. Ash vovshashtsa vaIda iina khillekh'ara, galdevr dara shu to'khnachu khenatsa (mettigtsa) delakh' a, Dala kkhochushkhiliitarkh'ama i khilla da'lla gIullakkh, khIallakvan sha bilggal khIallakkhillarg, vakhiita sha bilggal diina visnarg. Bakk'alla a, Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a ma vu.

Dagadaiita: kh'o'ga gaitira Dala u'sh gIenakh kIezzig khilartsa /akh' diitsira i g1an kh'an nak'ostashka/, Tso kh'o'ga u'sh gaitinekh'ara dukkha khilartsa - dykhur dara shu, gIullakkhekh' k'u'isur dara ash, delakh' a, Dala lardina /shu iesharakh/. Bakk'alla a, Iza khuush vu degnashkakh' derg.

Dagadaiita! Shuna gaitira Tso u'sh, shu /tsarna/ du'kh'alkkhetcha, shun bIa'rgashkakhula u'sh kIezzig bolush, shu kIezzig dolush gaitira tseran bIa'rgashkakhula, Dala kkhochushdarkh'ama khilla da'lla dolu gIullakkh. Dele dIado'rzu gIullakkhash.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shaina /mostag1iin/toba du'kh'alkkhetcha, chIagIlolash, Dela kh'ekhavelash dukkkha, shu dakkkhiiden tarlo.

Mu'tIakh' khilalash Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a, vovshashtsa ma k'iisalash - tIakkkha ozalur du shu /mostagIchukh/, shun nitsk' dIaber bu. Sobare khilalash. Bakk'alla a, Dela sobare bolcha'rtsa vu (tsarna gIodartsa).
Shu ma khilalash shain tsIenoshkara arabevllacharakhtera kurallitsa, nakhana gaitarkh'ama, Delan nek'akh /nakh/ dIatilabesh. I Dela ash dechunna guo besh ma vu /khaartsa/.

Dagadaiita, shaitIano khaziira tsarna shain Iamalsh, elira: "Takhana nakhakh tskh'a a vats shu esho, so shuna lulakhodu". TIakkkha, shena shi toba gicha, dIadedira iza, elira: "Bakk'alla a, so tsIena du shukh, bakk'alla a, so gush du (tsunna malikash gush dara busalbanashna gIo desh) shuna tsagurg, so kkho'ru Delakh - i Dela taIzar dartsa chIogIa vu".

Dagadaiita! Munepik'asha a, shain degnashkakh' tsamgar iolchara a olura: "KhIorsh shain dino Iekhiina". Dalla tIetevzhinarg - /Delan kh'esapekh' vu/. Bakk'alla a, i Dela veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Kh'una ginekh'ara i tsateshnarsh malikasha shain sinosh skh'adokhush, shain iakhkh'ekh a, tIekh'ashkha a ettash: "Iovsha shaina zho'zhakhatin Iazap,- olush.-
Iza du shun ku'igasha kh'alkha -da'kkhinarg bakh'anekh', Dela leshna zulame vats".

FirIavnan do'zalan a, tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran a Iadatakh terra, tsa tiishira u'sh Delan aiatekh - tIakkkha Dala shain k'inoshtsa skh'aletsira u'sh. Bakk'alla a, i Dela nu'tsk'ala vu, chIogIa vu taIzar dartsa.
Iza du - Dela tsakhilarna sha tskh'ana a k'omana della khilla dolu niImat khu'itsush verg, tsara sha'sh khiitstsalts shaitsaderg, i du Dela khilarna khezash verg a, khuush verg a.

FirIavnan do'zalan a, tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran a Iadatakh terra, khartsdira tsara shain Delan aiatash - tIakkkha Okha u'sh, shain k'inosh bakh'anekh', khIallakbira. FirIavnan do'zal Okha khIorda bukhabakhiitira - masso a khilira u'sh zulamkhoi.
/Dala mel kkho'llinchu/ la'ttakhula lelachu kh1umanekh uggar bo'khanig Dalla gergakh' - tsatesharsh bu, tsara iiman tsa du'llu.
Akh' shaitsa bart bina (tIom bira bats, a'lla) khillarsh bu u'sh, tIakkkha masso a khenakh' i shain bart bokhabo tsara, u'sh tsa kkho'ru /Delakh i bart bokho/.
Kh'o tsarna tIamekh' du'kh'al nisvelcha, lu'ra ta1zar de tsarna, tsaral tIekh'akh' bolcharna kkheram tasa- tsara oila ian megara /kh'una sha'sh teshnabekhk tsa ban, kh'o'tsa khilla bart tsa bokho /.
Kh'o kkherakh' tskh'ana /kh'an shetsa bart bolchu/ k'oman teshnabekhkakh, bokhabe akh' /bart/ tsa'rtsa niissa. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa beza teshnabekhk biirash.

/Badrekh' tsa boiush kIelkh'arbevllachu/ kerstanashna mattanne a ma mo'ttiila sha'sh /Tkhol/ kh'alkhadevli (Tkhan shaina tIekh' nitsk' kkhochur bats). Bakk'alla a, tsara kIeldu'tur dats /Delan gIullakkh a, busalbanashna gIo khilar a/.

Kechbe tsarna du'kh'al shain tar mallo nitsk': t1eman g1irs a, kiicha govrash shetsa ash kkhero Delan mostagI a, shain mostagI a, u'sh botsursh kkhibersh a, shuna sha'sh tsa bevzash bolu- Dalla bevza u'sh. Ash Delan novk'akh' mel kharzh iakh' a - i /kkhochchush/ iukhaio'rzur iu shuna, shuna zulam diir dats (Dala ash dinarg tidame tsa o'tsush du'tur dats).
Nagakh' sanna u'sh mashare kkhovdakh', - tIakkkha kh'o a kkhovda tsu'nga (mashare), Dalla tIetovzha, bakk'alla a, Iza khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.
Tsarna laakh' kh'o Iekho (teshnabekhk ban) - kh'una kkhachoiiirig Dela vu. I vu Sha Shen gIo'ntsa a, mu'min nakhatsa a kh'o chIagIvina khillarg.

Tso bartadalira tseran degnash (bezam tesira vovshashna iukk'ekh'), akh' la'ttakh' mel derg do'khkicha a, kh'o'ga bartadalalur datsara tseran degnash, delakh' a, Dala bartabaliira u'sh. Bakk'alla a, Iza veza verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
KhIai paikhamar! Kh'una kkhachoen erg Dela vu, mu'min nakhakh kh'una tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg a vu.
KhIai paikhamar! TIamna tIeberzabe mu'min nakh! Shukh sobare tk'a khilcha - eshor vu tsara shi bIe, shukh bIe khilcha - eshor vu tsara tsateshacharakh ezar, khIunda a'lcha, u'sh tsa kkhetash k'am du.

KhIintsa Dala daidira shuna /t1eman kh'al/, Tsunna khiira shu'tsa ledarlo iui (kIezzig khilar, tIamna kiicha tsakhilar), shukh sobare bIe khilcha - shi bIe eshor vu tsara/sobare bolchara/, shukh ezar khilcha - shi ezar eshor vu tsara Delan purbantsa, Dela sobare bolcha'rtsa vu.
Tsa tarlora paikhamarna shen iiisaroi khila la'ttakh' kkhochchush sha chIagIvallalts, shu dezash du du'nenan khIuma, Dalla dezash du ekhart. Dela veza verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Delera iozakh'alkha tsa da'llekh'ara ash etsnachunna, dokkkhachu Iazapo skh'alotsur dara shu.
Iaa sha'sh ia'kkkhinchu khIonsakh kh'anal erg, tsIena erg, Delakh kkhera (kh'aram derg tsa dan). Bakk'alla a, Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

KhIai paikhamar! Ala shain ku'iga kIel bolchu iiisarkhoshka: "Dalla khaakh' shun degnashkakh' dikanig, shu'gara da'kkkhinchul sov dikanig lur du Tso shuna, gechdiir du Tso shuna, i Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu".
Tsarna laakh' kh'una teshnabekhk ban, kh'alkha Dalla a teshnabekhk bina tsara, Tso (kh'una tsarna t1ekh' taIzar dan) nitsk' bella. I Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukma /niisa / desh verg a vu.

Bakk'alla a, iiman a dillina, dIakkhelkhinarsh a (dinan du'kh'a paikhamartsa Makkara Medinate dIabakhanarsh), shain bakhamtsa a, sinoshtsa a Delan novk'akh' k'akh'egnarsh a, sha'sh u'sh tIela'tsnarsha, gIo dinarsh a - u'sh vovshiin verasash (dottagIii, gIo'nchii) bu. Iiman a dillina, dIa tsa kkhelkhinarsh - tskh'anna khIumantsa tsa'rtsa gergarlo dats shun, u'sh dIakkhalkhkhalts. Dinan kh'ok'ekh' tsara shu'ga gIo dekhakh', - shuna tIekh' (tsarna) gIo dar du, shuna a, shaina a iukk'ekh' bart bolchu k'omana du'kh'al datsakh'. I Dela ash diirig gush ma vu.
Tsatesharsh vovshiin gergarnash bu. Ash i (gIo) tsa dakh', la'ttakh' pitana khir du, dokkkha bo'khanig da'rzhar du.
Iiman a dillina, /Madinate/ dIakkhelkhinarsh a, Delan novk'akh' k'akh'egnarsh a, u'sh tIela'tsnarsha, gIo dinarsh a - u'sh bu kh'ak'-bak' mu'min nakh, tsarna gechdar a, shortta ritsk' a khir du.

TIa'kh'a iiman a dillina, /Madinate/ dIakkhelkhinarsh, shu'tsa tskh'ana k'akh'egnarsh - u'sh shukh bu. Gergarlonash dersh - tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharal gerga bu Delan zhaina chokh'. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.
Delera a, Tsu'nan elchanera a, ash sha'sh bart bina khilla bolchu mushrikshtsadek'ekh' tsakhilar, khaam bu.
Lela la'ttakhulabea battakh', tIakkkha shuna khaalash, Dela g1orasiz van shun nitsk' kkhochur botsiila, i Dela vuila tsatesharsh siisazabiir bolush.

Delera a, Tsu'nan elchanera a kkhaikkhar du nakhe Dokkkha kh'azhdo'khkuchu diinakh': I Dela tsIena vu mushrikekh, Tsu'nan elcha a /tsIena/ vu. Ash toba dakh' - i shuna dika du, shu du'kh'aldovlakh', shuna khaalash, Dela g1orasiz van shain nitsk' kkhochur- botsiila. Kkha' bakkkha tsateshacharna lazosh dolchu Iazapatsa,

Ash shaitsa bart bina khilla bersh botscharna, tIakkkha shuna tskh'anna a khIumantsa esham bina khilla botschu, shuna tIekh' tskh'anna a gIo dina khilla botscharna - tsa'rtsa bina bart kkhochushbe shen khan chekkh'iallalts, Dalla beza /Shekh/ kkho'rush bersh.

Deza /kh'azh do'khku/ bettanash chekkhdevlcha /i shaitsa mashare tsa bogIu, teshnabekhk besh bolu/ mushrikash baia, shaina u'sh karaba'kinchokh', skh'aletsa u'sh, guo be tsarna, k1elonna okh'akhovsha tsarna massankh'a a. U'sh dokhkobovlakh', tsara lamaz khIottadakh', zakat lakh' - tseran nek' ma'rsha be. Bakk'alla a, Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

Mushrikekh tskh'ammo kh'o'ga shena marsho ekhakh'- kkhochush'e iza, tsunna Delan dosh khazzalts, tIakkkha dIakkhachave iza kkheram botschu mettige (shen daimakhka, tsunna laakh'), - iza u'sh tsa khuush k'am khilarna du.

Mukha khir bu mushrikashtsa bart Dalla gergakh' a, Tsu'nan elchanna gergakh' a, Deza ma'zhdigan gergakh' ash shaitsa bart binarsh botscha'rtsa? U'sh shaitsa niisa ma khillara, shu tsa'rtsa a niisa khila. Bakk'alla a, Dalla beza /Shekh/ kkho'rursh.

Mukha..? Sha'sh shuna tIekh' tolam ba'kkkhicha, tsara tergal tsa do shuna iukk'ekh' khilla dolu gergarlo a, bart a. Shu reza do tsara shain batoshtsa, tk'a tseran degnash du'kh'al du /sha'sh batoshtsa du'itsachunna/, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh fasik' (Dalla mu't1akh' khilarkh d1akha'dda nakh) bu.
Delan aiatash do'khkina tsara kIezzigchu mekhakh, Tsu'nan nek'akh /dukkkha a nakh/ d1atiliiia tsara. Bakk'alla a, ma von khilla-kkh tsara desh khillarg.
Tergame tsa do tsara mu'min stagatsa gergarlo a, bart a. U'sh dozanekh bevllarsh bu.
Nagakh' sanna tsara toba dakh', lamaz khIottadakh', zakat lakh' - tIakkkha shun vezharii bu u'sh dinekh', /ishtta/ k'astado Okha aiatash khuush dolchu k'omana.

Nagakh' sanna tsara shain duinash k'arbakh', shain bart khillachul tIa'kh'a, Iittarsh iakh' shun dinna - kerstananiinko'rtekh' bolcha'rtsa t1om be, - bakk'alla a, tseran duinash ban a bats, - u'sh sovtsa magara /shain ko'rtekh' bersh baiicha/.

Ash t1om tsa bo sha'sh shain duinash k'arbinchu k'omatsa, elcha aravakkkha gIaigIa besh khilla dolchu, sha'sh iu'kh'antsara shu'tsa i (tIom) boliina khillachu? Tsarakh kkho'ru shu? Dela ma vara shu Shekh kkhera tam bolush, shu mu'min nakh khillekh'!
TIom be tsa'rtsa, Dala shun ku'igashtsa Iazap diir du tsarna, siisazbiir bu u'sh, tsarna tIekh' shuna gIo diir du, todiir du mu'min nekhan degnash.
DIaiokkkhur iu tseran degniin o'gIazlo, Dala gechdo Shena luuchunna. Dela khuush verg a, /niisa/ kh'ukam diirig a vu.

Shu mo'ttush dara sha'sh du'tur du (balane a tsa lu'itsush)? Dalla khIintsa a shukh gIazot dinarsh a, Dela a, elcha a vitina, mu'min nakh a bitina, kkhin dottagIii tsa liitsinarsh a tsa bevzina (nakhana guchubokhush)? Dela sov dika khuush verg vu ash diirig.
O'shush dats mushrikunash Delan ma'zhdigashkakh' Ien, kerstanash sha'sh khilarna teshalla a desh. Tseran Iamalsh dIatili, u'sh /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIergakh' guttar la'ttar bu.
Delan ma'zhdigashkakh' Iiir bu Delakh a, t1a'khkh'archu diinakha teshna bersh, lamaz khIottiinarsh, zakat dellarsh, Dela votschukh tsa kkho'rursh - u'sh khila tam bu nisbellacharakh.

Ash khiliiti kh'a'zhina khi dalar a, Deza ma'zhdigekh' Iar a Delakh a, t1a'khkh'archu diinakh a teshnachukh a, Delan novk'akh' k'akh'egnachukh a tera? Tsa nislo u'sh Dalla gergakh', Dala tsa nisdo zulame k'am.

Iiman dillinarsh, dIakkhelkhinarsh (paikhamartsa Makkara Madinate islam Ialashdarkh'ama), Delan novk'akh' shain bakhamtsa a, shain sinoshtsa a k'akh'egnarsh dukkkha beza bu darzhatsa Dalla gergakh', u'sh bu to'llarsh.

Tsarna shain Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kkha' bokkkhu Shegara k'inkhetam khilartsa a, rezakhilartsa a, (ialsamanin) boshmash khilartsa a, shaina tsunna (ialsamani) chokh' satsadella la'ttash dolu niImat dolush.
Tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttar bu, bakk'alla a, Dela Shegakh' siilakh'-eza ial iolush vu (tsarna iala).

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ma liitsalash shain dai a, shain vezharii a dottagIii, (ma be tsarakh doladiirash) tsarna iimanal kerstanalla dukkhadezakh'. Shukh tsarakh dottagIii binarsh - u'sh bu zulamkhoi.

Akh' ala: /khIai Mukh'ammad/ "Nagakh' sanna shun dai, shun kIentii, shun vezharii, shun zudarii, shun gergarnash, da'khni, ash guldina khilla dolu, iokhka-etsar, sha (sa iotsush) iisarkh shu kkho'rush iolu, tsIenosh, shaina shu reza dolu, shuna /dukkha/ dezakh' Delal a, Tsu'nan elchanal a, Delan novk'akh' t1om baral a, - kh'ovsush Ie Dela valts Shen gIullakkhtsa (tsu'nan Iazap, o'gIazlo iogIur iu shuna). Dala tsa nisdo pesak' k'am.

Dala gIo dira shuna dukkkhachu mettigashkakh', Kh'unaindiinakh' a. Shu tsetsdekhira shun dukkhallo, tso (shu dukkkha khilarna, Delan gIo'nakh oila esh datsara shu) shun khIumma kIelkh'ar tsa da'kkkhira, sel shortta khilla dolu latta gatdelira shuna (dovda mettig iotsush disira shu), tIakkkha shu iukhadevlira.
TIakkkha Dala Shen sintem bossiira Shen elchanna a, mu'min nakhana a; eskar dossiira, shuna gush dotsu; tsateshacharna Iazap dira, tsateshacheran bekkham i bu.
Iukha a toba k'obaldiir du Dala tsul tIa'kh'a a Shena luuchunna. I Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Mushrikunash nazhs (bo'kha khIuma) iu, khIokkhu sharal tIa'kh'a Deza ma'zhdigna gerga ma gIoila u'sh. Shu kkherakh' miskallakh (mushrikunash tsa ba'khkicha iokhka-etsar setsna), - tIa'kh'a Dala kh'ole diir du shu Shen koma'rshallakh, Shena laakh'. Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

TIom be shaiga zhaina dellacharakhDelakh a, t1a'khkh'archu diinakh a tsa teshash bolcha'rtsa, Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a kh'aram dinarg kh'aram tsa desh bolcha'rtsa, kh'ak'-bak' dolu din (Islam) k'obal tsa desh bolcha'rtsa shain ku'igatsa (mukIar khilla) zhiz'iatlush, u'sh /shun ku'iga/ kIel sovtstsalts.

Zhu'gtasha elira: "Iuzair - Delan kIant vu", nasarasha elira: "Masukh' - Delan kIant vu". Iza - tseran dosh du, shain bagara (skh'ada'lla), tardesh bu u'sh kh'alkha /Delan din/ kerstadinacheran dashakh. Dala khIallakboila u'sh! Ma bak'dolchukh dog da'lla bu u'sh!

Shain akh'barasha, rukh1banasha delanash letsira tsara (tsarakh delanash bira tsara), Allakh1-Dela a vitina. Mar'iaman kIant Masukh' a (dela letsira tsara). Tsa'rga omra dina datsara tskh'anna Dalla Iibadat de a'lla ben, kkhin Dela votschu I sha ben - tsIena vu Iza tsara Shetsa nak'ost latsarakh.
