U'sh luush bu Delan nur daia shain baganashtsa, Dela luush vats Shen nur kkhochush khiliitar ben, /mel i/ kerstanashna tsa dezakh' a.
I vu vaiitinarg Shen elcha niisachu nek'atsa a, bak'onan dintsa a, i masso dinna tIekh' toliitarkh'ama, /mel i/ mushrikashna tsa dezakh' a.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Bakk'alla a, akh'barekh a, rukh1banekh a dukkhabersh khartsontsa nekhan da'khni duush bu kh'una, Delan nek'akh (shaina tIa'kh'akhIu'ttu nakh) dIato'ttush a bu. Deshii a, detii a guldesh bolcha'rga, Delan novk'akh' tsu'ntsa kharzh tsa esh - tsarna akh' kkha' bakkkhalakh' shaina lazosh dolu Iazap khirg khilartsa.

Tskh'ana diinakh' (k'ematdiinakh') zho'zhakhatin tsIergakh' lalor du i (tsara du'nenakh' guldina khilla dolu deshi a, deti a), t1akkkha tsu'ntsa kh1ost diirdu tseran kh'a'zhashna a, tseran agIonashna a, tseran bakk'ashna a: "KhIara du ash shaina guldinarg, Iovsha sha'sh guldesh khillarg",-(olush malikasha).

Bakk'alla a, bettaniin dukkhalla Dalla gergakh' - shiitta butt bu /sharna chokh'/ Delan Zhaini chokh' iazbina Tso stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llinchu diinakh', tsarakh bi' beza bu (zul'-k'aIada, zul'-kh'idzha, mukh'arram, radzhab). I du bak' dolu din. Tsu chokh'shaina zulam ma de. TIom be masso mushrikashtsa tsara shu'tsa massa'rtsa a tIom bare terra, shuna khaalash, i Dela (Shekh kkho'rucha'rtsa) vuila.

(Tskh'a beza butt kkhechu battal ) tIa'kh'atattar kerstanallekh' sovdiilar du, shetsa tsatesharsh tilosh, tskh'ana sharakh' kh'anal besh i (beza butt, tsu chokh' tIom ban magosh), vukkhu sharakh' -kh'aram besh, Dala dazdinchiin (bettaniin) dukkhallitsa i tskh'a'nabogIush khiliitarkh'ama - kh'anal do tsara Dala kh'aram dinarsh. Khaziina tsarna shain von 1amalsh. Dala tsa nisdo kersta k'am.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shuna khIun khilla, shaiga Delan novk'akh' (gIazotana) aradovla a'lcha, /la'ttakh'/ dazloi ma Ia shu (gIazote tsa do'lkhush)? Ekhartal du'nenan dakharna reza khilla-te shu? Ma kIezzig khIuma iu-kkh i, du'nenan dakhar, ekhartatsa iu'sticha!

Shu gIazotana ara tsa dovlakh' - Tso shuna lazosh dolu Iazap diir du, khu'itsur du shu kkhechu k'omatsa, ash Tsunna zen diir dats tskh'anna khIumantsa a. Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush vu.

Ash tsunna (vai paikhamarna Mukh'ammadana gIazote khIuttush) gIo tsa dakh' - Dala gIo dira tsunna kerstanasha iza /Makkara/ arava'kkkhinchu khenakh', tsu shinnakh tskh'a' i volush. U'sh shi' kh'ekhakh' volush, tso (paikhamara) elira shen nak'oste (Abu-Bakre): "Kh'o gIaigIane ma vozhalakh', vaitsa Dela vu kh'una". Dala sin-pargIato iossiira tsunna tIe, Tso chIagIvira i eskartsa, shuna sha gush tsa khilla dolchu, tsateshacheran dosh bukhakh' khiliitira. Delan dosh - i du lakkhakh' derg, Dela Sha veza verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Aradovla sha'sh dain dersh a, deza dersh a, k'akh'ega (gIazot de) shain da'khnitsa a, shain sinoshtsa a Delan novk'akh'. I dika du shuna, shu khuush khillekh'.

Ialasho gergakh' khilakh', nek' atta a khilakh' - kh'una tIa'kh'akhIu'ttu u'sh, khIette a (nek') gena khilartsa khilla tsarna /khalo/. Delatsa duinash buur bu tsara: "Shain nitsk' kkhachakh'ara, shu'tsa aradevr dara sha'sh" (gIazotana),-bokhush. Sha'sh- shain khIallakdo tsara. Dalla kha'a u'sh khartslu'ish buila.
Dela k'intIeraver kh'una! Akh' khIunda purbadella tsarna kh'aina bak'lu'ish bersh bilgalbovllalts, khartslu'ish bersh bovzzallts?
Kh'o'ga purba do'khur dats kh'una Delakh a, t1a'khkh'archu diinakh a teshash bolchara shain da'khnitsa a, shain sinoshtsa a gIazot tsa dan. Dela khuush vu (Shekh) kkho'rush bersh.
Kh'o'ga purba do'khu Delakh a, t1a'khkh'archu diinakh a tsateshachara, shain degnasha sheko echara, - u'sh shain shekona chokh' oilanash kerchosh bu.

Sha'sh /gIazotana/ arabovla luush khillekh'ara, tsunna kecham bina khir bara tsara, delakh' a, Dalla tsa deza tseran guchubovlar /gIazotana/. Tso u'sh bukhabu'tush bu /shu'tsa gIazotana arabovlarkh, malo iartsa/, elira /tsa'rga/: "Okh'akhovzhshii Iie okh'akhevshina Iacha'rtsa" (zudarshtsa a, berashtsa a, k'enachu nakhatsa a).

Shu'tsa u'sh arabevllekh'ara a, shu sovdokhur ma datsara tsara nizam dokhortsa a ben, shun iuk'amettig egIor ma iara tsara, shuna pitana lo'khush. Shuna iukk'ekh' ma bu tsa'rga lado'gIush bersh. Dela bevzash vu-kkh zulame bersh.
Kh'alkha a pitana lekhira tsara, kh'una mekarlonash iira bak'derg dallalts. Delan gIullakkh guchudelira, u'sh (i) tsa dezarsh a bolush.
Tsarakh vu sha olush verg: "Purba lokh'a suna /gIazotana ara tsa vala/, pitana ma de suna". Tk'a pitanna chuegna bats u'sh? Bakk'alla a, zho'zhakhati guo biir bolush ma iu kerstanashna.

Kh'una dikanig khilakh', tso von kho'tu'itu tsarna. Kh'una khalo khilakh', tsara olu: "Okha kh'alkha t1eiitsira tkheshan gIullakkh" (gIazote tsa dakha satsam bira okha kh'alkha, tsundela tkhuna von tsa khili). U'sh dIabirzira, sha'sh bakkkhiibesh.
Akh' ala: "Tkhuna khilanne a khir ma dats Dala tkhuna iazdinarg ben. I vu tkhan gIo'ncha", Dalla tIetevzhiila mu'min nakh.

Akh' ala: "Shina dikanakh tskh'annan a ben kh'o'zhiila darii shun tkhuna? Tkho kh'o'zhush du shuna Dala shegara ia tkhan ku'igashtsa Iazap kkhachorig khilare. Kh'o'zhush Ie, tkho a shu'tsa tskh'a'na kh'o'zhush Iiir du".
Ala: "SagIalo shaina laakh' a, tsa laakh' a, shu'gara danne a k'obaldiir dats i. Bakk'alla a, shu khili-kkh fasik' k'am".
Tsa'rgara sagIa k'obaldar dukhato'khna u'sh Delakh a, elchanakh a tsa teshash khilaro, sha'sh malo esh ben tsara lamaz tsadaro, tsa luush, khalla ben tsara sagIa a tsadakkkharo.
Akh' tamasha ma boila tseran da'khnekh a, tseran do'zalekh a. Dalla luush du tsa'rtsa tsarna Iazap dan du'nenan dakharekh', sinosh aradevr du tseran u'sh kersta kh'olekh' a bolush.
Tsara Delatsa duinash buu sha'sh shukh du, bokhush, shukh bats u'sh, khIette a k'a'stash k'am du u'sh.
Shaina lachk'a mettig karaiakh', la'ttakh bola mettig karaiakh' ia chudovla mettig karaiakh' - tsiga sikhlur bu u'sh chekhka /k'a'khkina govr sanna/.
Tsarakh bu kh'una ircha bekhkash bokhush bersh sagIadakkkharekh', tsunakh shaina delcha, reza khu'lu u'sh, tsunakh shaina tsa lakh' - u'sh o'gIaz'o'khu.

U'sh reza khillekh'ara Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a shaina dellachunna, a'llekh'ara tsara: "Tkhuna kkhacham bolush vu-kkh Dela, tIa'kh'a lur du tkhuna Dala Shen koma'rshallakh. Tsu'nan elchano a /lur du tkhuna/, bakk'alla a, tkho Dele dogdokhush du-kkh" /dika khir dara-kkh tsarna/.

SagIanash lo Dala t1edakhkartsa pek'arshnaa, miskacharnaa, tsarna tIekh' bolkh becharnaa, degnash kIaddarkh'amaa, lesh azatbakharekh'a, dekkharshna kIelbisincharnaa, Delan novk'akh'a, nek'an nak'ostanaa. Dela khuush a vu, /niisa/ kh'ukma desh a vu.

Tsarakh bu paikhamarna khalakho'tu'itush bersh, sha'sh olush: "Iza (paikhamar) - lergash du" (masso a khIuma khezash du-kkh tsunna). Akh' ala: "Dikallin lergash du-kkh shuna, teshash vu i (Mukh'ammad paikhamar) Delakh a, teshash vu i mu'min nakhakh a, shukh iiman dillincharna k'inkhetam a bu i". Delan elchanna khalakho'tu'itush bersh - tsarna du lazosh dolu Iazap.
Shuna Delatsa duinash buu tsara shu rezadarkh'ama. Dela a, Tsu'nan elcha a kh'ak' bara-kkh tsara rezaban, sha'sh mu'min nakh khillekh'.
Tsarna tsa kha'a-te Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a du'kh'alo iinchunna zho'zhakhatin tsIe khir iuila, i tsu chokh' guttar la'ttash? Ma eza- iokkkha siisazalla iu-kkh i!

Kkho'rush bu munepik'ash tsa'rga (busalba nakhe) shain degnashkakh' dergdu'itsush surat dossarakh. Akh' ala: "Ma dasha shu" (ma lara ash din a, Dela a, busalbanash a). Bakk'alla a, Dela aradokkkhurg vu shu kkho'rush (larlush) derg.
Akh' tsa'rga kha'tticha, tsara er ma du kh'una: "Tkho-m zabar esh, lovzush darii". Akh' ala: "Delakh a, Tsu'nan aiatekh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a kkha'rdash khilla shu?"
Bekhkazlonash ma e ash. Kerstanalla deana ash shain iimanal tIa'kh'a, shukh tskh'ana tobanna Tkho k'intIera dovlakh' a, kkhechu tobanna Okha Iazap diir du u'sh khilarna k'inosh desh.

Munepik' bozharii a, munepik' zudarii a - u'sh tskh'abersh vukkharakh bu. Vonig omra do tsara, dikanig ma de olu, shain ku'igash dIak'ovlu tsara (sagIa tsa lush, Delan novk'akh' kharzh tsa esh). Dela vitsvina tsara - Tso a bitsbina u'sh /Shen k'inkhetamakh/. Bakk'alla a, munepik'ash -u'sh bu-kkh fasik'ash.

Dala vaIda iina munepik' bozharshna a, munepik' zudarshna a, kerstanashna a zho'zhakhatin tsIartsa, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttar a bolush. I iu tsarna kkhacho iiirig, Dala neIalt a'lla tsarna, tsarna d1akhIo'ttina dolu Iazap du.

Shul kh'alkha khillacharekh tera /du iza, khIai munapik'ash/. Shul chIogIa bara u'sh nitsk'antsa, alsam bara da'khnitsa a, do'zalshtsa a. Shain dek'akh zovkkh kh'iigira tsara, shain dek'akh zovkkh kh'iigira asha a, shul kh'alkha khillachara a zovkkh kh'egarkh terra shain dek'akh, /khartsonna a, tilarna a/ chu dakhara shu, /shul kh'alkha/ u'sh tsu chu bakharkh terra. U'sh bu-kkh shain Iamalsh iainarsh du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a, u'sh bu-kkh sha'sh eshnarsh.

Tsa'rga tsa deana-te shail kh'alkha khillachu Nukh'an, Iadin, Samudan k'a'mniin khabar, IbrakhIiman k'oman, Mad'ianandain, Mu'tafikatiinkhabar? Tsa'rga shain elchanash ma ba'khkira bilgalonashtsa. Dela tsa khilla tsarna zulam desh, khIette a, sha'sh khilla u'sh shaina zulam desh.

Mu'min bozharii, mu'min zudarii - tskh'abersh vovshiin dottagIii (verasash) bu, dikachu'ntsa omra desh, /von derg ma de olush/ vochukh dukhatukhush, lamaz khIottadesh, zakat lush, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' a bolush. Tsarakh tIakkkha k'inkhetam biir bu Dala. Bakk'alla a, Dela ma vu veza verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a.

Dala vaIda iina mu'min bozharshna a, mu'min zudarshna a /ialsamanin/ boshmash, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush iolu, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttash, Iadn (ialsamanin)boshmashkakh' tsIena gIishlosh a. Delera rezakhilar vuno dokkkha du - iza siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu-kkh!
KhIai paikhamar! K'iisam lattabe kerstanashtsa a, munepik'ashtsa a, kIorshame khila tsa'rtsa. Tseran chokh'Ioila zho'zhakhati iu, - von dIaderzar du-kkh iza.

Tsara (munepik'asha) duinash buu Delakh, tsa a'lla /paikhamarna vonig/ sha'sh, bokhush. A'lla tsara kerstanallin dosh, tsarakh kerstanash khilla sha'sh busalbanash khillachul tIa'kh'a, shaina karkh tsa da'llarg dan kh'a'vsira u'sh. Bekkham tsa bira tsara bekk'a Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a shaina Shen (Delan) koma'rshallakh kh'al dalarna a ben. Tsara toba dinekh'ara, dika khir dara tsarna. U'sh dIaberzakh'- lazosh dolchu Iazaptsa Iazap diir du Dala tsarna du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a. Ma vats tsarna la'ttakh' veras a, gIo'ncha a!
Tsarakh bu sha'sh Delatsa vaIda iinarsh: "Tso tkhuna Shen koma'rshallakh /niImat/ lakh', /shortta/ lur ma du sha'sh /dala dezachunna/ sagIa, khillane a khir du sha'sh dikacharakh",-a'lla.
TsoShen koma'rshallakh shaina delcha, u'sh tsu'ntsa b1a'rmatsig khilira, dIabirzira, sha'sh du'kh'al a khu'lush.
Tseran degnashka Tso dossiira munepik'alla, u'sh Tsunna du'kh'alkkhetar bolchu /k'emat/de tIekkhachchalts, tsara sha'sh Delatsa iina vaIda iokhiina khilarna a, u'sh sha'sh khartslu'ish khilarna a.
Tsarna tsa kha'a-te Dalla khuush khilar shain k'aile a, shain k'ailakha khabarsh a, i Dela Sha kh'ulamekh' dolu khIumanash dika khuush verg khilar a?

Mu'min nakhakh sagIanashkakh' mu'tIakh' bolcharakh a, shaina /sag1ina dala/ khalla ben kh1uma tsakariinacharakh alu'ish bersh, tIakkkha tsarakh kkha'rdashbersh, - Dala siisazabiir bu u'sh, tsarna du lazosh dolu Iazap.

Akh' gechdar dekha tsarna ia gechdar ma dekha tsarna. Akh' tsarna kkhuztk'e u'ttazza gechdar dekhcha a - Dala danne a gechdiir dolush dats tsarna. I du tsara Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a kerstanalla darna. Dala nis tsa do fasik' k'am.

Bakkkhiibera sha'sh bukhabitinarshDelan elchanna tIekh'akh' khevshina bisarna (gIazote tsa bo'lkhush), tsarna tsa diizira Delan novk'akh' shain da'khnitsa a, shain sinoshtsa a k'akh'ega (gIazot dan), tsara elira: "Ma dovla /gIazotana ara/ kh1okkhu iovkhonekh'". Akh' ala: "Zho'zhakhatin tsIe iovkha khilartsa kkhin a nu'tsk'ala iu", u'sh kkhetash khillekh'.
Bo'liila u'sh kIezzig, bo'lkhiila u'sh dukkkha a shaina karadesh khillachun /vochun/ bekkhamna.

Dala kh'o iukhaverziicha tsarakh tskh'ana tobanna tIe, kh'o'ga purba do'khu tsara ara dovla / kkhechu gIazotana/. TIakkkha akh' ala: " Tsk'a a so'tsa aradevr dats shu, so'tsa tskh'ammo a mostagItsa tIom biir bats ash. Shu reza khilla du'khkh'ara khevshina Ien - khovshii Iie khIintsa a bukhabisincha'rtsa".

Tsarakh tskh'a' velcha, tsk'a a /dok'a/lamaz ma de /tsunna t1ekh'/, tsu'nan kosha tIe ma khIotta. Bakk'alla a, tsara kerstanalla dina Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a, u'sh bella sha'sh fasik' kh'olekh' a bolush.
Kh'o'ga tamasha ma boitiila tseran bakhamo a, tseran do'zalsha a. Dalla la'a tsu'ntsa tsarna Iazap dan du'nenakh' a, tseran sadala (bala), u'sh kerstanash a bolush.
Surat do'ssicha, Delakh a tesha, Tsu'nan elchantsa gIazot a de, a'lla, tsarakh kh'aldolchara kh'o'ga purba diikhira, tsara elira: "Ditakh' tkho, khevshina 1a'cha'rtsakhir dara tkho".
Reza khilla u'sh bukhabisincha'rtsakhila, tseran degnashna mukhIar to'khna, - u'sh tsa kkheta.
KhIette a, elchano a, tsu'ntsa iiman dillinchara a gIazot dira shain bakhamtsa a, shain sinoshtsa a,-u'sh bu shaina dikanash desh bersh, u'sh bu sha'sh bakkkhiibiir bersh.
Tsarna Dala boshmash kechiina, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttar bu. I bu-kkh siilakh'-bokkkha tolam.

D1asakkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbekhbekhkazlonash esh bersh ba'khkira shaina purba daliitarkh'ama. Bukhabisira sha'sh Delatsa a, Tsu'nan elchantsa a kharts khillarsh, tIa'kh'a kkhochur du tsarakh kerstanalla dinacha'rga lazosh dolu Iazap.

Za'Iapkhoshna a, tsomgush bolcharna a, ian kharzh tsa karocharna a k'a dats /gIazote tsa bakhcha a/, u'sh Delatsa a, Tsu'nan elchantsa a dog tsIena khilcha. Dikanig desh bolcharna nek' bats /bekhk billa/. Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

Kh'o volchu ba'khkincharna a dats /k'a/ akh' sha'sh kechdakh'ara, bokhush, akh' a'lcha: "Shu shetsa kechdan khIuma tsa karado suna", dIabirzina bolchu, shain bIa'rgash khikh a bu'zna, von khetash shaina kharzh'ian khIuma tsa karorna (shaina gIazote bakha taro tsa khilarna/.

Nek' bu /bekhk billa/ kh'o'ga purba do'khucharna, sha'sh kh'aldolush a bolush. U'sh reza khilla bukhabisincha'rtsa (zudarshtsa, berashtsa, za'1apkhoshtsa) khila, tseran degnekh Dala mukhIar to'khna, - tsarna tsa kha'a.

Shu'ga bekhkazlonash io tsara, shu tsarna tIe iukhadirzicha. Akh' ala: "Bekhkazlonash ma e! Teshshane a shukh teshar dats tkho. Dala diitsina tkhuna shun khabarekh. Gur iu Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a shun Iamal, tIakkkha shu d1aderzor du kh'ulamekh' derg a, guchakh' derg a khuush volchunna (Dala) tIe - Tso du'itsur du shu'ga ash desh khillarg".

Shuna Delatsa duinash buur bu tsara, shu tsarna tIedirzicha, shu shaikh d1aderzorkh'ama. D1aderza tsarakh! Bakk'alla a, u'sh rizhsiu, tseran chugIoila zho'zhakhati iu - bekkham a khilla tsarna karadesh khillachunna (du'kh'al).
Duinash buu shuna shu shaina reza khiliitarkh'ama. Shu tsarna reza khilakh' a, - Dela reza khir vats fasik' k'omana.

D1asakkhelkhash lela Ia'rbii kerstanallitsa a, munepik'allitsa a melkho a chIogIa bu (kkhecharal), Dala Shen elchane dossiina dozanash tsakhaarekh' a sov bu. Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
D1asakkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbekh bu sha'sh sagIina lush derg gIuda lorush bersh, shuna balanash khilare kh'o'zhush bersh. Tsarna bu-kkh vochun bala. Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.

D1asakkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbekh bu sha'sh Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a teshash bersh a, sha'sh lush dolu sagIa Dalla gergakh' gIurba a, elchanna /shaina/ doIa dan /nek'/ lorush bersh a. Tsarna gIurba dats tk'a i?! Dala Shen k'inkhetamna chubukhkur bu u'sh. Bakk'alla a, Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

DIakkhelkhincharakha, (tsarna) gIo la'tsnacharakha du'khkh'ara (islam din t1eo'tsush) kh'alkha khillarsh, dikachu'ntsa tsarna tIa'kh'akhIittinarsh - Dela reza khilla tsarna. U'sh a reza khilla Tsunna. Tso tsarna boshmash kechiina, bukhakhula khish o'khush iolu. U'sh tsu chokh' guttar khir bu. I siilakh'- bokkkha tolam bu-kkh!

Shuna gonakh' bolchu d1asakkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbekh munepik'ash a bu, Madinatan bakharkhoikh a bu u'sh (munepik'ash), munepik'allina chu kIorga bakhana u'sh. Kh'una tsa bevza u'sh, Tkhuna bevza u'sh. Okha shozza Iazap diir du tsarna, tIakkkha deza-dokkkhachu Iazape d1aberzor bu.
Kkhibersh k'era khilira shain k'inoshna, tsara ieiira dika Iamal kkhechu vochu'ntsa, Dala toba k'obaldan mega tseran. Bakk'alla a, Dela vu gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Tseran bakhamakh sagIa etsa - tsu'ntsa dogImash a, sinosh a tsIandiir du akh' tseran, /Dele/ doIa a de tsarna, bakk'alla a, kh'an doIa tsarna sintem bu. I Dela khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu.
Tsarna tsa kha'a-te Dala k'obaldesh khilar Shen leshkara toba a, sagIa o'tsush khilara, i Dela sha toba k'obaldesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vuila?

Akh' ala: /khIai Mukh'ammad/ "Iamal e! Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a, mu'min nakhana a tIa'kh'a gur iu shun Iamal, tIa'kh'a d1aderzor du shu kh'ulamekh' derg a, guchakh' derg a khuush volchunna tIe - (Dalla tIe). TIakkkha Tso shu'ga du'itsur du ash desh khillarg".
Tskh'a kkhibersh Delan gIullakkhe dogdokhu'itush khir bu: ia Iazap diir du Tso tsarna, ia tseran toba k'obaldiir du Tso. I Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Tskh'a /kkhin/ bersh bu sha'sh zulamna a, kerstanallina a, mu'min nakhana iukk'ekh' bart egIorna a, kh'alkha Delatsa a, Tsu'nan elchantsa a tIom besh khillacharna kechamna a ma'zhdigdina bersh - ba'anne a duinash tsa buush 1iir bats u'sh shaina dikanig ben luush ma datsara kh'una, bokhush. Dala teshalla do: "Bakk'alla a, u'sh bu khartslu'ish",-a'lla.

Kh'o ma khIottalakh' tsu /ma'zhdiga/ chokh' /lamaz dan/ tsk'a a. Du'khkh'arlerchu diinakh' du'ina /Delakh/ kkherarna tIekh' khIottiina dolu ma'zhdigmelkho a kh'ak' du kh'o shena chokh' (lamazna) khIotta - tsu chokh' bu sha'sh tsIanbala luush bolu bozharii. Dalla beza sha'sh tsIanlush bersh.

Shen gIirs Delera kkherarna a, rezallina a tIekh' khIottiinarg vu dika, ia shen gIirs io'khna, okh'ao'gush iolchu (berdan) iistekh' khIottiinarg vu, tso shetsa zho'zhakhatin tsIerga vozhiina volu? Dala tsa nisdo-kkh zulame dolu k'am.
Tsa bu'su tseran gIirs, tsara sha'sh bina bolu, tseran degnashkakh' sheko khilla a ben, tseran degnash lilkhina kiisakash khillalts. Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Bakk'alla a, Dala etsna mu'min nakhera tseran sinosh a, tseran bakham a tsarna ialsamani ialartsa. U'sh Delan novk'akh' tIom besh bu, tsara a boiu, u'sh a boiu. I Tsu'nan vaIda iu - Tavrata chokh' a, Inzhila chokh' a, K'ur'an chokh' a kh'ak'-bak' khilla iolu va1da. Mila vu shen vaIda Dala echul a dika kkhochush'esh verg? Shu dakkkhiide shain iokhka-etsartsa, sha'sh Tsu'ntsa kkhochushiina iolchu /vaIditsa/. Iza - siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu-kkh!

Toba desh bersh, Iibadat desh bersh, /Dalla/ khastam besh bersh, /la'ttakhula g1azotana ia 1ilma lo'khush/ d1asalelash bersh, rukuIe-suzhude o'khush bersh, dikachu'ntsa omra desh, vochukh /nakh/ bukhatukhush bersh, Delan dozanash Ialashdesh bersh /u'sh bakkhiiber bu shaina ialsamani khilartsa/, - kkha' bakkkha mu'min nakhana.
Tsa khilla /o'shush/ paikhamarna a, iiman dillincharna a mushrikashna gechdar dekhar, u'sh shain gergara khillekh' a, shaina u'sh zho'zhakhatin dai khilar bilgalda'llachul tIa'kh'a.

IbrakhIiman shen dena gechdar dekhar tsa khilla ekk'a tso tsu'ntsa iina vaIdina du'kh'a a ben. Shena i Delan mostagI khilar bilgalda'lcha, tsIanvelira i tsunakh. Bakk'alla a, IbrakhIim ma vu kh'astalush verg a, dukkkha sobare verg a.
Tsa khilla Dela k'am tilosh, Tso Sha nisdinchul tIa'kh'a u'sh Shekh larbala dezarg tsarna bilgaldakkkhalts. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.
Bakk'alla a, Dela stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla Shegakh' dolush vu, dendolu'itush a vu I, dolu'itush a vu - I votsurg veras a vats shuna, gIo'ncha a vats.

Dala toba k'obaldira paikhamaran a, dIakkhelkhincheran a, ansariin a, khalachu sokh'tekh' tsunnatIa'kh'akhIittina khilla bolchu, tsarakh tskh'ana tobanan degnash dIatiladellachul tIa'kh'a, tIakkkha Tso toba k'obaldira tseran. Bakk'alla a, I tsarakh dog lozush a, k'inkhetam bolush a vu.

Kkhaannan a/toba k'obaldira Dala/, sha'sh bukhabisiitina khilla bolchu, (u'sh dukkha poshme khilira) shaina latta gattadallalts, sha shortta khilla dolu, shain sinosh a tsarna gattadelira, tsarna khiira Delakh dovdiila dotsiila, Tsunna Shena tIe a ben. TIakkkha tsarna tIevirzira Iza (tseran toba k'obaldesh), tsa'rga (nakhe) toba daitarkh'ama. Bakk'alla a, Dela toba k'obaldiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Delakh kkheralash, bak'lu'icha'rtsa khilalash.

Tsa dezara Madinatanbakharkhoshna a, tsunna gonakh'ara d1asakkhelkhash lelachu 1a'rbashna a Delan elchanakh bukhabisa a, i (paikhamar) vitina shain sinosh deza a. Iza du - tsarakh tsa kh'akkhaialiita Delan novk'akh' kh'ogalla a, khalo a, matsalla a, u'sh tsa bissiita kerstanashna kkheram tosuchu mettige, u'sh tsa kkhiiita mostagIchu'ngara tskh'anna a kkhiame, tsu'ntsa shaina dika Iamal iaz'esh ben. Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa eshaio dikacheran ial.
Zhima a, iokkha a kharzh iiir ma iats tsara, tskh'a a togIe khador ma iats tsara (nek' besh), i shaina iazdina dolush ben, Dala tsarna bekkham balarkh'ama tsara desh khillachukh khazachu'ntsa.

Tsa khilla /o'shush/ mu'min nakhana masso a /gIazotana/ gIatta. Tsarakh khIora taipanakh tskh'a toba gIa'tticha /to'ar du/, /bisinchara/ dinekh' gIullakkhash k'astor du, nakhana, u'sh shaina tIe bukhabirzicha, kh'ekham a biir bu, - u'sh /vochukh/ larbala /Iama/ megara.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! TIom be kerstanekh shaina gergakh' bolcha'rtsa, shu'gakh' lu'ralla karaioila tsarna, shuna khaalash, Dela /Shekh/ kkho'rush bolcha'rtsa vuila.
Tsarakh bu surat do'ssicha, olursh: "Shukh mila sovvokkkhu khIokkho iimantsa?" Iiman dillinarsh - u'sh sovbokhu tso iimantsa, u'sh bakkkhiibo'.
Shain degnashkakh' tsamgar ersh - u'sh sovbokhu bo'kha lelarna tIe a bo'kha lelartsa, u'sh bella sha'sh kerstanash bolush.
Tsarna tsa go-tekh'a sha'sh khIor sharakh' tsk'a ia shozza pitanelotsush khilar? TIakkkha a toba tsa do tsara, oila a tsa io tsara.

Suratakh khIuma do'ssicha, tskh'abersh vovshashka kh'ovsu, tskh'anna a shu gush dui-te bokhush, tIakkkha dIabo'lkhu /i tsakhazarkh'ama/. Dala tseran degnash dIaderziina /serlonakh/, u'sh tsa kkhetash k'am dolu dela.

Shu'ga veana elcha, shukh shaikh a volu, shuna khala khillarg shena dazlush a volu, shu /iimane dar, shu du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a dek'alkhilar/ sha ch1og1a luush a volu, mu'min nakhakh dog lozush a, k'inkhetame a volu.
U'sh dIaberzakh', akh' ala: "Kkhacho iu san Allakh1, tskh'a Dela, kkhin dela vats I ben, Tsunna tIetevzhina so. I vu siilakh'-iokkkhachu Iarshan Da".
Alif-la-m-ra. Kh'ikmatedolchu zhainan aiatash du khIorsh.

Tamashe khilla-te nakhana, Okha tsarakh tskh'ana stage Tkheshan va'kh'a dossor nakhana kkheram tasa a, iiman dillinacharna kkha' bakkkha a, tsarna shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' sha'sh kh'alkha iina khillachu dika Iamaliin du'kh'a dokkkha dikanig du, alii? Kerstanasha ma elira: "Bakk'alla a, khIara bilggala bozbuuncha ma vu".

Bakk'alla a, shu Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg Dela vu, Sha stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llina volu ialkh diinakh', tIakkkha dIanisvelira I Iarsha tIekh'. Urkhalla do Tso (gIullakkhashna t1ekh'). Tso purba dellachul tIa'kh'a a ben tskh'a a gIodakkkharkho ma vats. I vu shun Dela, shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, Tsunna Iibadat de. Ash oila tsa io?

Tsu'nga du shun masseran dIaderzar Delan bak' iolchu vaIdatsa. Bakk'alla a, Tso kkhollar dolado, tIakkkha i karladokkkhu iiman dillincharna a, dika Iamalsh iinacharna a niisontsa bekkham barkh'ama. Kerstanash-m - tsarna kkhekhkash dolu khikh malar a du, lazosh dolu Iazap a du sha'sh /din/ kerstadesh khilarna.

I vu Sha malkh bina serlo khilla, butt a bina nur khilla, tsu'nan (bettan) baram a khIottiina - manzalash, shuna sheriin terakh' a, kh'esap a khaiitarkh'ama. Bak'ontsa a ben tsa kkho'llina Dala i. K'astado Tso aiatash /oila ian/ khuuchu k'omana.

Bakk'alla a, bu'isa a, de a khiitsadalarekh', Dala stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel kkho'llinchokh' /i Dela tskh'a' khilar, I nu'tsk'alla khilar goitush dolu/ delilash ma du /Delakh/ kkho'ruchu k'omana.
Bakk'alla a, Tkhuna du'kh'alkkhetare dog tsa dokhush bersh a, sha'sh gergarchu dakharna (du'nenna) reza khilla bersh a, tsu'ntsa sa-pargIat bevlla bersh a, Tkhan aiatashna gIopalkhillarsh a,-
U'sh bu shain chugIoila /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe ersh sha'sh karadesh khillachu'ntsa.

Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a - shain Kkhiosh- Kkhobucho (Dala) nisbiir bu u'sh shain /ts1ena/ iiman khilar bakh'anekh' /ialsamanin novk'a/ - tseran bukhakhula khish o'khush, sha'sh Na1im oluchu ialsamanin boshmashkakh' bolush.
Tseran doIa tsu chokh' (ialsamanekh'): "Vezan Dela, vonakh tsIena vu Kh'o" khir du, tseran marshalla tsigakh' "Salam" khir du. Tseran tIa'kh'ara doIa khir du: "Khastam bu Dalla - Ialamiin Dena".

Dala nakhana vonig sikhdinekh'ara dikanetseran sikhbalartsa - shain Iozhalla tsarna tIekkha'chna khir iara. Okha bu'tu Tkhuna du'kh'alkkhetare dog tsa dokhush bersh, shain tillar chokh' b1a'rze dIai-skh'ai u'dush.

Adamo, shekh tskh'a bala kh'akkhabelcha, Tkho'ga kkhoikkhu shen agIonna tIekh' 1u'llush, ia okh'akhi'na, ia kh'alagIa'ttina. Okha sha otsu balekh kh'alkhada'kkkhicha - dIadolalo /shen kh'alakhalerachu novk'a -Dalla 1esalla ian/, shekh kh'akkhabellachu balane Tkho'ga tsa kkhaikkhicha sanna. Ishtta khazdina /Delan/ dozanekh bovlucharnasha'sh desh khillarg.

/ Mel dukkha/tIa'kh'enash khIallakiina Okha shul kh'alkha tsara zulamash dicha, shain elchanash ba'khkira tsarna tIe bilgalonashtsa, - u'sh tsa khilira iiman du'llush. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha k'inosh dechu k'omana.
TIakkkha shu khiliitira Okha tsaral tIa'kh'a la'ttakh' tIa'kh'e, Tkho kh'azharkh'ama, ash mukha 1amal io.

Tkhan bilgala aiatash shaina tIekh' deshcha, Tkhuna du'kh'alkkhetare dog tsa dokhuchara elira: "KhIara dotsurg kkhin desharlo, ia i khiitsa". Akh' ala: "San i khu'itsiila dats saiggara, so dekk'a saiga dussush dolchu va'kh'ina tIa'kh'avozush vu. So kkho'ru san Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna Iesa khila siilakh'-dokkkhachu /k'emat/diinan Iazapakh".
Ala: "Dalla li'nekh'ara, as shuna do'shur ma datsara i, Tso (Dala) shuna Iamora ma datsara i, as shuna iukk'ekh' tsul kh'alkha a tskh'a o'mar ma ekh'na. Ash oila tsa io?"
Mila vu-te zulame sha Dalla tIe khartsderg kkhulluchul, ia Tsu'nan aiatash khartsdechul? Bakk'alla a, k'inosh desh bersh bakkkhiibiir ma bats.

Tsara Iibadat do, Dela a vu'tii, shaina zen a, shaina paida a tsabechunna. Tsara olu: "KhIorsh bu tkhan gIodakkkharkhoi Dalla gergakh'". Akh' ala: "Ash du'itsu Dele Tsunna Shena stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a tsakhuurg?" Vonakh tsIena vu Iza, lakkhaveli I tsara Shetsa nak'ost latsarkh.
Ma tsa khilla nakh tskh'a ummat ben, - tIa'kh'a bek'abelira u'sh. Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara doshkh'alkha tsa da'llekh'ara, tsarna iuk'akh' kkhiel iina khir iara Tso, tsara shetsa khilpaloechokh'.
Tsara olu: "Shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara delildo'ssinekh'ra tsu'nga". Akh' ala: "Kh'ulamekh' derg Delan du, shu kh'ovsush Ie, bakk'alla a, so a shu'tsa tskh'a'na kh'ovsucharakh vu".

Okha nakhek'inkhetamakh cham bakkkhiiticha, u'sh zeno skh'ala'tsnachul tIa'kh'a, - tseran mekarlo khu'lu Tkhan aiatashkakh'. Akh' ala: "Dela melkho a sikha vu /mekarlona du'kh'al/ mekarlo iartsa". Bakk'alla a, Tkhan elchanashadIaiaz'esh iu ash esh iolu mekarlo.

I vu shu dIasalelosh arengakh' a, khIorda tIekh' a. Shu kemana t1ekh' dolush, I dIado'du tsa'rtsa khazchu makhtsa, u'sh bakkkhiibina tsunakh. ChIogIa mokh bogIu tsunnatIe, tsarna iogIu masso a mettigera tulgIe, tsarna mottalo tso sha'sh iuk'akh'archado. Dele kkhoikkhu tsara, Tsu'nan din tsIandesh bersh a khu'lii: "Akh' tkho khIokkhunakh k1elkh'ardakhakh', tkho barkalla olucharakh khir ma du",- bokhush.

Tso u'sh k1elkh'arba'khnachul tIa'kh'a tsara la'ttakh' bo'khanig lelado tskh'a a bak'o iotsush. KhIai nakh! Shun bo'khanig shuna shaina du shuna. Du'nenan dakharan /kIezzig/ khIuma du iza. TIakkkha shun dIaderzar Tkho'ga du - Okha du'itsur du shu'ga ash desh khillarg.

Du'nenan dakharan masal Okha stiglara daiitinchu khikh tera du: tsunakh iira nakha a, bezhanasha a iuuchekh la'ttan oramat. La'tto tsu'nan zaza etscha (i oramat khaza kkhi'cha), khazdicha, tsu'nan daishna sha'sh tsunna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush du (paida etsa), a'lla khaadelcha, busa ia diinakh' Tkhan bolkhkkhochu tsunna tIe - Okha khiliiti tsunakh /kh'a'kkhna okh'adillina/ ialta - selkhana tsakhillarg sanna - ishtta k'astado Okha aiatash oila esh dolchu k'omana.
Dala kkhoikkhu masharan tsIachu, nisvo Shena luurg niisachu novk'a.

Dika khillacharna dika du - /ialsamani/, kkhin sovderg khir du /k'ematdiinakh'-Delan iu'kh' gar/, tseran iakhkh'ekh chan letar iats, siisazalla a /letar iats/. U'sh - ialsamanin dai bu, tsu chokh' sha'sh guttar a khir bolush.

Vonig dinacharna bekkham i sanna vonig du, siisazalla letar iu tsarakh. Ma vats tsarna Delera i dukhatukhur verg. Shain iakhkh'ash bu'isanan bodane kiisigashtsa kh'uliinacharakh tera bu u'sh. U'sh tsIeran dai bu, tsu chokh' guttar a khir bolush.

Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' Okha u'sh berrige a gulbiir bu, /Delatsa/ nak'ost la'tsna khillacha'rga er du: "DIalatsa shain mettig asha a, shun nak'ostasha a". Tseran iuk'amettig khadiira Okha. Tseran nak'ostashaelira: "Shu tsa khilla tkhuna Iibadat desh,
Dala kkhachoiira tesh khilla tkhuna a, shuna a iukk'ekh': bakk'alla a, tkho khilla ash tkhuna Iibadat darkh gIopal".
Tsigakh' bala kkhechira masso a sinan sha kh'alkha dinchu'ntsa. U'sh dIaberziira Dele, shain kh'ak'-bak' veras khilla volchu, tsarakh dIatilira tsara /kharts/ kkhullush khillarg.

Akh' alal: "Mila vu shuna ritsk' lush verg stiglara a, la'ttara a? Ia mila vu doladesh lersikh (khazarkh) a, bIa'rsikh a, mila vu diina verg vellachukh skh'avokkkhush, vellarg diinachukh skh'avokkkhush, mila vu dIakh'osh gIullakkhash?" Tsara er du kh'una: "Dela vu-kkh". TIakkkha akh' ala: "Shu tsa kkho'ru /Tsunakh/?"
I vu Dela - shun kh'ak'-bak' volu Ela. KhIun du tk'a bak'dolchul tIa'kh'a tilar ben? TIakkkha a ma dIaderzosh du shu!
Ishtta bak'khilira kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun dosh fasik' nakhana tIekh', u'sh teshar bolush bats a'lla dolu.

Akh' ala: "Shun nak'ostekh vui sha kkhollar iu'kh'antsa d1adolosh verg, tIakkkha i karladokkkhush verg?" Ala: "Dala d1adolado kkhollar, tIakkkha i karladokkkhu. Ma talkhosh du-kkh shu (bak'dolchukh)!"

Alal: "Shun nak'ostekh vui sha bak'dolchunna tIe nisbesh verg?" Ala: "Dala nisbo bak'dolchunna tIe". Tk'a sha bak'dolchunna tIe /nakh/ nisbesh verg kh'ak' vats shena tIa'kh'akhIotta, ia sha nis tsa besh verg vu, sha /tskh'ammo/ nisvakh' ben? Tk'a shuna khIun khilla? Ash mukha kh'ukma do?!

Tsarakh dukkhakhbersh mottadalarna a ben tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma bats. Bakk'alla a, mottadalaro bak'dolchukh khIumma a kIelkh'ar tsa dokkkhu (bakk'alla a, mottalush derg bak'dolchunna du'kh'al khIumma paidane ma dats). Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush vu tsara desh derg.

KhIara K'ur'an tsa khilla kkholladala /tarlush/ Dela votschu'ngara, delakh' a, niisa dogIush du i shel kh'alkha khillachu'ntsa, shen chokh' sheko iotstsush Ialamiin Degara zhaina (Mukh'ammadan ummatana t1edikhkina dekkharsh) bilgaldakkkhar a du i.
Ia tsara olu: "Tso/sha/ kkho'llina i /K'ur'an/"? Ash daiital tsunakh tera tskh'a surat, kkhaikkha Dela votschu'nga shaiga kkhaikkhaluchu'nga /kkhechu g1o'nchashka/, sha'sh bak'lu'ish khillekh'.

Kh1a', khartsdira tsara (Makkan kerstanasha) i (K'ur'an) sha'sh i dika dovza a kkhiale, shen ta'vil akhIintsale shaiga tsa kkha'chna dolu. Ishtta khartsdira tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a. Kh'azhal, mukha khilla zulamkhoin tIa'kh'e!
Tsarakh tsunakh teshash bersh a bu, tsarakh tsunakh tsa teshash bersh a bu. Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dika bevzash vu kh'una /kh1uma/ talkhosh bersh.
Kh'o tsara khartsvakh', akh' ala: "Suna sain Iamal iu, shuna shain Iamal iu. Shu tsIena du as dechukh, so tsIena vu ash dechukh".
Tsarakh kh'o'ga ladugIush bersh a bu. Akh' khozu'itur dara k'oracharna, tsu tIe a u'sh kh'ek'ale a tsa khilcha?
Tsarakh kh'o'ga kh'o'zhush verg a vu. Akh' nisbiir bara bIa'rsadotsursh, tsu tIe a u'sh sa gush a tsa khilcha?
Bakk'alla a, Dala zulam tsa do nakhana tskh'ana a khIumantsa, delakh' a, nakha sha'sh do shaina zulamash.

Tskh'ana /k'emat/ diinakh' Tso u'sh gulbiir bu, sha'sh /du'nenakh'/ diinan tskh'ana sokh'tekh' a ben tsa 1iinarsh sanna, vovshashna bevzar bu u'sh - tIakkkha iishira sha'sh Dalla du'kh'alkkhetar khartsdinarsh. Tsa khilira u'sh nisbella.

Ia Okha goitur ma du kh'una Tkha'sh tsarna vaIda echukh tskh'aderg (Iazap), ia Okha volu'itur ma vu kh'o /tsarna Iazap dale/. Tkho'ga dutseran dIaderzar - tsul t1a'kh'a Dela tesh ma vu tsara desh dolchunna.
KhIor ummatan elcha vu. Shain elcha ve'cha, kkhiel iiir iu tsarna iukk'ekh' niisontsa, tsarna zulam diir dats.
Tsara olu: "Matsa kkhochushkhir iu i vaIda, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'?"

Akh' ala: "As dola tsa do saina zenna a, paidenna a (san karakh' dats saina ze dar a, paida bar a), Dalla ma lu'u ben. KhIor ummatna to'khna khan iu, i shain khan tIekkha'chcha - tskh'a sakh't tIa'kh'abu'sur a bats u'sh, / tskh'a sakh't/ kh'alkhabevr a bats".
Ala: "Diitsal ash suna: Tsu'nan Iazap shaiga busa ia diinakh' de'cha, otsunakh khIun sikhdan luur dara k'inosh desh bolcharna?
TIakkkha iza khIo'tticha, teshar dara shu tsunakh? KhIintsii? Shu ma darii i sikhdala luush /kh'alkha/."
TIakkkha er du zulam dinacha'rga: "Iovsha shaina guttarenan Iazap. Bekkham khir bui shuna tk'a ash karadesh khillachu'ntsa a ben?"
Kh'o'ga do'khu tsara (tsunakh la'tsna) khaiitar: "Bak' dui i?" Akh' ala: "KhIa', san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa (dui bou as), bak' du-kkh i! Shu'ga daidalur dats iza".

KhIor zulam dinchu sinna (adamna) la'ttakh' mel derg shen khilcha a - i dIalur daratso, kh'uldiir tsara dara dokhkodovlar, shaina Iazap gicha. Tsarna iukk'ekh' niisontsa kkhiel iina. Tsarna zulam diir dats.
Shuna khaiila bakk'alla a, stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg Delan duila! Shuna khaiila Delan vaIda kh'ak'-bak' iuila! Delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Tso dendolu'itu, Tso dolu'itu, Tsunna tIe shu dIaderzor dolush du.
KhIai nakh! Shu'ga beana shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara kh'ekham a, degnashkakh' dolchunna darba a - mu'min nakhana niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a.
Ala: "Delan ko'ma'rshallitsa, Tsu'nan k'inkhetamtsa - Tsu'ntsa bakkkhiiber u'sh - iza melkho a dika du tsarna sha'sh guldechul".
Akh' ala: "Kh'ovsal shu, khIun dossiina Dala shuna (Shen) ritsk'anakh! Ash tsunakh kh'aram derg a, kh'anal derg a dira". Ala: "Dala purba delira shuna, ia shu Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkhullush du?"
KhIun du tekh'a Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkhullucharna mo'tturg k'ematdiinakh'? Bakk'alla a, Dela k'inkhetam bolush vu nakhana tIekh', delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolchara barkalla tsa olu.

Kh'o (paikhamar) khir vats tskh'ana a gIullakkhekh' a, akh' do'shur dats tsunakhtskh'a a deshara, ash iiir iats tskh'a a Iamal a Tkho shaina tIekh' teshash dolush ben, shu tsu chokh' a du'sush. Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchukh k'ailader dats misk'alzarrat(kh1uma) la'ttakh' a, stiglakh' a, tsul zhimanig, dokkkhanig - bilgalchu zhainakh'dolush ben.
Tidame etsa! Bakk'alla a, Delan dottagIii-kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna /ekhartakh' Delan 1azapakh/, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats /shaikh d1atillachu du'nenan kh'olakh/.
U'sh bu iiman dillinarsh, /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillarsh (Tso bokhurg desh, ma de bokhurg tsa desh) -
Tsarna kkha' bu du'nenan dakharekh' a, ekhartakh' a. Delan deshnashna khiitsadalar dats. Iza - siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu.
Tseran /kerstanallin/ dasho singattame ma voila kh'o, - bakk'alla a, errige siilakh'alla Delan iu. I khezash verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.

Tidame etsa! Bakk'alla a, Delan bu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a bersh. Stenna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush bu Dela votschu /kkhechu/ nak'ostashka kkhoikkhush bersh? U'sh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma bats dekk'a mottadalarna ben, u'sh ma bats khartslu'ish a ben.
I vu shuna bu'isa iinarg, tsu chokh' shu'ga sada1iita, de a /dinarg/, tsu chokh' /shuna khIumanash/ gan. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash du khezash dolchu k'omana.

Tsara elira: "Dala do'zalkho la'tsna (vina)". Vochukh tsIena vu Iza! I kh'al dolush verg vu. Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' mel derg. Tsu'ntsa (tsu kh'ok'ekh') tskh'a a delil dats shun! Dalla tIekh' shaina tsakhuurg du'itsu ash?
Akh' ala /khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Bakk'alla a, Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkhullush bersh bakkkhiibiir bats".
Du'nenan (tskh'a k1ezzig) marzo iu /tsara paida o'tsush erg/, tIakkkha tseran dIaderzar Tkhuna tIe du, tIakkkha Okha Iovshu'itur du tsa'rga chIogIa Iazap u'sh tsa teshash khilarna.

Diitsa tsarna Nukh'an khabar, tso shen k'ome ma elira: "KhIai san k'am! Nagakh' sanna shuna khala khillekh' san /shu'tsa/ Iar a, as Delan aiatash kh'ekhadar a - so Dalla tIetevzhina. Vovshakhtokha shain gIullakkh a, shain nak'ostii a, tsul tIa'kh'a shun gIullakkh shuna ma khu'liila singattame. TIakkkha suna shain kkhiel e, khan t1a'kh'a ma tattalash (i tsa esh).
Shu dIaderzakh' /sokh/ - as shu'ga tskh'a a makh tsa bekhna, san makh Delekh' ben bats. Suna omra dina busalbanekhtskh'a' khila",- a'lla.

Tsara i khartsvira, tIakkkha Okha iza a, tsu'ntsa bersh a kIelkh'arbekhira kemanna chokh', Okha khiliitira tsarakh tIa'kh'e, Tkheshan aiatash khartsdinarsh khina bukhabakhiitira Okha. Kh'azhal, mukha khilla shaina /elchanasha/ kkheram tosucheran tIa'kh'e!

TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a Okha bakhiitira elchanash shain k'a'mnashka, u'sh ba'khkira tsarna tIe bilgalonashtsa - u'sh (elchanash shaina t1eba'khkinarsh) tsa khilira (kh1intsa a) teshar bolush sha'sh kh'alkha khartsdinchukh. Ishtta mukhIar to'khna Okha /Delan/ dozanekh bevlacheran degnashna.
TIakkkha tsaral tIa'kh'a Musa a, KhIarun a vakhiitira Okha FirIavnna a, tsu'nan elashna a tIe Tkheshan aiatashtsa - tsara kuralla iira, u'sh khilira k'inosh desh dolu k'am.
Tkho'gara bak'derg shaiga de'cha, tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, khIara bilggala bozbuunchalla ma du".
Musas elira: "Bak'dolchunna, i shaiga de'cha, /ishtta/ olu ash? Bozbuunchalla du khIara? Bozbuunchash bakkkhiibiir ma bats".
Tsara elira: "Kh'o veana tkhuna tkheshan dai shena tIekh' tkhuna kariinachukh tkho dIaderzo /dekk'a/ shu- shinnakhiliitarkh'ama la'ttakh' siilalla? Tkho shushinnakh a teshash ma dats".
FirIavna elira: "Suna tIe valave khIora govza mel volu bozbuuncha".
Bozbuunchash ba'khkicha, Musas tsa'rga elira: "Kkhossa sha'sh kkhussush erg".
Tsara kkho'ssicha, Musas elira: "Ash shaitsa deana derg bozbuunchalla du. Bakk'alla a, Dala doiur du iza. Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa toio /kh1uma/ talkhosh bolcheran Iamal.
Bak'derg bak'khu'lu'itu Dala Shen deshnashtsa, k'inosh decharna i mel tsa dezakh' a".

Musakh tsa tiishira tsu'nan k'omakh tskh'a zu'rrietben, FirIavna a, tsu'nan elasha a sha'sh pitane latsarkhkkherarna. Bakk'alla a, FirIavn lakkhava'lla la'ttakh' /zulamash desh/. Bakk'alla a, i /Delan niImatakh/ kkhoam tsabecharakh vu.
Musas elira: "KhIai san k'am, shu khillekh' Delakh teshna - Tsunna tIetovzha, sha'sh (Tsunna) mu'tIakh' dersh delakh'".
TIakkkha tsara elira: "Dalla tIetevzhina tkho. Veza volu Tkho Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, tkho ma khiliitalakh' zulame k'omana pitana.
KIelkh'ardakhalakh' tkho Kh'ain k'inkhetamtsa kersta k'omakh".

Musaga a, tsu'nan veshe (KhIarune) a Okha khaiitira va'kh'itsaashshimmo a sha'shshinnan k'omana Misrakh' kh1usamash a latsa, shain kh1usamekh k'ilba a khiliita, lamaz a khIottade, kkha' a bakkkha mu'min nakhe, a'lla.

Musas elira: "Veza volu tkho Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, FirIavnna a, tsu'nan elashna a du'nenan dakharekh' khazalla a, bakham a bella Akh', tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, u'sh tilabaliitarkh'ama Kh'ain nek'akh. Veza volu tkho Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, baia tseran bakham a, k'iza de tseran degnash a - u'sh teshar bolush bats shaina lazosh dolu Iazap tsa gicha".
Tso (Dala) elira: "ShushinnandoIina zhop della, niisa khila shushi', tIa'kh'a ma khIittalash tsa khuush bolcheran novk'a".

Okha khIorda dekh'a bekhira Israilan kIentii. Tsarna tIa'kh'a bevlira FirIavn a, tsu'nan bIo a kh'ogIatsii, mostagIallitsii. /KhIorda/ bukhavakhar shena t1ekkhi'cha, tso (FirIavna sha kh'orda bukha vo'dush) elira: "So tiishi kkhin Dela tsakhilarkh, Shekh Israilan kIentii teshnarg ben, so mu'tIakh' bolcharakh (busalba nakhakh) vu-kkh".
KhIintsii? Kh'alkha-m Iesalla ma iira akh', kh'o ma khilira /nakh Delan dinakh/ talkhocharakh.
Takhana Okha kIelkh'arvokkkhur vu kh'o kh'ain degIatsakh'ol tIa'kh'a bogIucharna delil khiliitarkh'ama. Bakk'alla a, nakhakh dukkhabersh Tkhan aiatekh gIopal ma bu.

Okha okh'akhovshiira Israilan kIentii /bakha/ to'lash iolchchu mettige, tsIenchukh ritsk' a delira tsarna, /din bakh'anekh'/ khilpalo tsa iu'izhira tsarna iuk'a shaiga Iilma kkhachchalts. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho kkhiel iiir iu tsarna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh' u'sh shetsa khilpalo esh khillachokh'.

Kh'uo sheko iolush khilakh' Okha kh'aiga dossiinachukh, akh' khattal kh'ail kh'alkha zhaina do'shush bolcha'rga. Kh'o'ga deana kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara bak'derg, kh'o khilanne a ma khilalakh' sheko echarakh.
Kh'o khilanne a ma khilalakh' Delan aiatash khartsdesh bolcharakh - tIakkkha kh'o khir vu eshnacharakh.
Bakk'alla a, shaina tIekh' kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun doshbak' khillarsh teshar bats
Shaiga masso a delil de'cha a, shaina lazosh dolu Iazap gallats.

/Okha khIallakiinchu iartekh/ tskh'a a iurt khillii shena /Iazap ginachul tIa'kh'a/ iiman dillicha - tsu iimano shen paida bina, dekk'a Iunusan /iu'rtan/ k'am ben? Okha d1aaidira tsarakh du'nenan dakharekh' siisazallin Iazap, bakham belira tsarna tskh'ana khanna.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna li'nekh'ara, iiman dillina khir dara masso a la'ttakh' mel volcho. Tk'a kh'o'ga iiman dilliitalur darii nakhe /tsarna tsa luushekh'/?
Tsa khilla sinna (adamna) iiman dillar Delan purbantsa a ben. Oila tsa esh bolcharna rizhs (ta1zar) khu'lu'itu Tso.

Akh' ala /tsu kh'aiga Dela tskh'a' khilaran delilash gaita bokhuchu mushrikashka/: "Kh'ovsal! KhIun du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a?/mel dukkha Dela tskh'a' khilaran delilash du tsigakh' - malkh, butt...!/ Kh'alkhadokkkhur ma dats /Iazapakh/ aiatasha a, kkheramash tu'isuchara ateshash dotsu k'am".
U'sh kh'ovsur bui shail kh'alkha bakhancheran denoshka sanna a ben? Akh' ala: "Kh'ovsa, so a shu'tsa tskh'ana kh'ovsucharakh vu".
TIakkkha Okha kIelkh'arbokhur bu Tkhain elchanash a, iiman dillinarsh a. Ishtta kh'ak'khilla Tkhuna: Okha kIelkh'arbokhur bu mu'min nakh.

Akh' ala /khIai Mukh'ammad/: "KhIai nakh! Shu khillekh' shekonekh' san dinakh, as Iibadat diir dats Dela votschu ash Iibadat decharna, delakh' a, as Iibadat diir du Dalla, shu a dolu'itush volchu. Suna omra dina so mu'min nakhakh khila, a'lla.
Kh'ain iu'kh' khIottae dinna tIe dogtsIena, kh'o khilanne a ma khilalakh' mushrikunekh, a'lla.
Akh' ma kkhaikkhalakh'Dela votschu kh'aina paida a, zen a tsa dechu'nga, akh' i dakh' - tIakkkha, bakk'alla, kh'o khir ma vu zulamkhoikh",- a'lla.

Dala zenatsa kh'o skh'alatsakh' - i d1aidenderg vats kh'una I sha votsurg. Kh'una dikanig Tsunna laakh' - Tsu'nan k'inkhetam bukhatukhurg vats kh'una. I kkhachado Tso Shen lekh Shena luuchunna. I gechdesh verg a vu a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Akh' ala: "KhIai nakh! Shu'ga deana bak'derg shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara: nisvellarg - shena nisvella vu, tilavellarg - shena tilavella vu. So shuna tIekh' vekal a vats".
Kh'aiga va'kh'itsa khaiitinchunna tIa'kh'akhIotta kh'o, sobar de Dala kh'ukma dallats. I - kh'ukma /niisa/ decharakh dikanig vu.
Alif-lam-ra. Shen aiatasha kh'ukam /niisa/ desh dolu, t1akkkha /u'sh khaza/ k'astosh dolu zhaina (K'ur'an) du /kh1ara/ - Sha kh'ukam /niisa/ desh a, sov dika khuush a volchu'ngara (Delera).
Ash Iibadat tsadarkh'ama /tskh'ana/ Dalla a ben. "Bakk'alla a, so shuna Tsu'ngara kkheramcha a, khaamcha avu,-a'lla.

Ash shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga gechdar dekharkh'ama, tIakkkha ash toba de Tsu'nga - Tso shuna khaza bakham lur bu tsIeto'khna khan tIekkhachchalts, masso a dozalla dolchunna shen dozalla a lur du. Shu iukhadovlakh' - so kkho'ru shuna dokkkhachu /k'emat/diinan Iazapakh.
Dele du shun dIaderzar. I masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush vu".

Kh'azhakh'! Bakk'alla a, u'sh bats shain degnash kh'iizosh Tsunakh kh'uldarkh'ama. Kh'azhakh'! Tk'a tsara shain bedar tIeiukhush Tsunna tsa kha'a tsara k'ailadokkkhurg a, tsara dIakh'ediirig a? Bakk'alla a, I khuush ma vu degnashkakh' derg.
Tskh'a a diinatdats la'ttakh' Dalla tIekh' shen ritsk' dolush ben, Tsunna kha'a tseran lattam a, tseran dIagIoila a, - masso a bilgalchu /Lavkh' makh'fuz/ zhaina chokh' du.

I vu Sha kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a ialkh diinakh', Tsu'nan Iarsh khina tIekh' iara, shu zerkh'ama, mu'lkha vu-te shukh Iamaltsa vuno a dikanig. Akh' a'lcha: "Bakk'alla a, shu dendiir dolush du dellachul tIa'kh'a", kerstanasha allane a er ma du: "Iza-m bilggala bozbuunchalla ma dui!"

Okha tsarakh Iazap tIa'kh'atetticha tskh'a iagariinchu khanna, tsara allane a er ma du: "Steno satsiina i (Iazap)?" Kh'azhal! Tk'a i tsa'rga de'nachu diinakh' tsarakh dIatilar ma dats! U'sh shekh tsa beshash khillarg tsarakh dIa ma kh'a'rchira.
Okha adame Tkhaigara k'inkhetam Iovshiiticha, tIakkkha Okha tsunakh i dIaba'kkkhicha - i dogdu'llurg a, /Delan niImatana/ kersta a ma khu'lu.
Okha tsu'nga niImat Iovshiiticha, i skh'ala'tsnachu balanal tIa'kh'a, tso allane a er ma du: "K'inosh dIadakhna suna t1era". Bakk'alla a, i khazakhetash, kuralla esh ma khu'lu.
Sobar dinarsh, dika Iamalsh iinarsh botsursh - tsarna gechdar a, iokkkha ial a iu.

Kh'o khila tarlo kh'aiga della tskh'atstsa vekh'ish du'tush, tsu'ntsa kh'an dog k'iidashtsara olush khilarna: "Khazna io'ssina khillekh'ara tsu'nga, ia malik de'nekh'ara tsu'ntsa". Bakk'alla a, kh'o kkheramcha vu. Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' vekal vu.
Ia tsara alarna: "I tso kkho'llina". Akh' ala: "Ash daladel, delakh', tsunakh tera itt surat, sha'sh kkho'llina dolu. Kkhaikkha Dela votschu shaina mogucha'rga, sha'sh bak'lu'ish khillekh'.
Tsara shaina zhop tsa lakh', shuna khaalash, i Delan Iilmantsa do'ssina duila a, I votsurg kkhin dela votsiila a. Shu busalbanash khu'lii?"
Du'nenan dakhar a, tsu'nan khazalla a ezash khillachunna - tseran /dikchu/ Iamalshna tsu (du'nena) chokh' kkhochchush bekkham biir bu Okha, u'sh tsu (du'nena) chokh' /ritsk'ikh/ eshor bats.

U'sh bu shaina ekhartakh' /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe a ben iotsursh. KhIallakkhili tsara tsu /du'nena/ chokh' dinarg, khartsderg du tsara desh khillarg (paida bats tsara du'nenakh' desh khillachu dikchukh, Delakh kkho'rush u'sh khilla batsakh').

Tk'a shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bilgalonna tIekh' khillarg, shena tIa'kh'avozush Tsu'ngara tesh a volush, tsul kh'alkha /tesh/ - Musan zhaina khilla /nakhana/ imam a, k'inkhetam a - /tera vu dekk'a du'ne dezacha'rga?/ - u'sh tsunakh (K'ur'anakh) teshash bu. Tobanekh tsunna kerstanalla decharna vaIda khillarg /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu. Kh'o tsunakhshekonekh' ma khilalakh'. Bakk'alla a, i kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bak'derg du kh'una, delakh' a, dukkhakhbolu nakh tsa tesha.

Mila vu tk'a zulame sha Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkho'llinchul? U'sh shain Dalla kh'alkha khIottor ma bu, teshasha er ma du: "KhIorsh bu i shain Dela khartsvinarsh, Delan neIalt iats tk'a zulamkhoshna?!
Sha'sh Delan nek'akh /nakh/ dIatilosh khilla bolchu, sha'sh i talkho luush bolchu, - ekhartana u'sh kerstanash ma bu ".
U'sh tsa khilira nitsk' kkhochush la'ttakh' /khIumma khiitso/, Dela votsurg dottagIii tsa khilira tsarna. TIettIa Iazap du tsarna. LadogIa nitsk' kkhochush tsa khilira u'sh, gush tsa khilira u'sh.
U'sh bu sha'sh shaina zen dinarsh, tsarakh dIatilira tsara kkhullush khillarg.
Du'itsiila iotstsush, u'sh bu ekhartakh' sha'sh ch1og1a eshnarsh.
Bakk'alla a, iman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna mukIar khillarsh,- u'sh bu ialsamanin dai, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bu.
Shina tobananmasal tera du bIa'rzechukh a - k'orachukh a, gush volchukh a - khezash volchukh a. Nisloi u'sh shi' masaltsa? Shu tsa kkheta? /Tsa nislo, Dellara!/.
Okha Nukh' vakhiitira tsu'nan k'omana tIe: "Bakk'alla a, so shuna bilggala kkheramcha vu, a'lla.
Dalla ben ash Iibadat tsadarkh'ama, bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru shuna lazosh dolchu diinan Iazapakh",-a'lla.

Tsu'nan k'omakh tsateshnacheran elasha elira: "Tkhuna-m tsa go kh'o, tkha'sh sanna, adam ben, tkhuna tsa go kh'una tIa'kh'akhIittinarsh, iu'kh'antsa kh'azhartsa, tkhan uggar bukhakh' bersh ben, tkhuna tsa go shun tkhuna tIekh' tskh'a a dozalla, khIette a, tkhuna mottalo shu khartslu'ish dersh".

Tso (Nukh'as) elira: "KhIai san k'am, goi shuna so khilcha san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bilgalonna tIekh', Tso Shegara k'inkhetam a belcha suna, tk'a shu tsu'ntsa bIa'rze khilcha, okha shuna tIedu'llur du iza,shuna tsa luushekh'? (Tkhuna mogur dats shu'ga nu'tsk'akh din tIelatsiita).

KhIai san k'am! As shu'ga tsunna tIekh' bakham tsa bo'khu, san ial Dalla tIekh' a ben iats, so vats lelkhorbolush iman dillinarsh. Bakk'alla a, u'sh du'kh'alkkhetar bolush bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, delakh' a, suna shu go tsa kkhetash k'am.
KhIai san k'am! Kh'an gIo diir du suna Dalla du'kh'al as u'sh lelkhiicha? Ash oila tsa io?

As shu'ga tsa bokhu: "San gergakh' Delan khaznash iu", kh'ulamekh' derg a tsa kha'a suna, as tsa bokhu: "So malik du", as tsa olu shun bIa'rgash shaikh tsa beshash bolcharakh: "Dala dikanig lur dats tsarna". Dalla dika kha'a tsa'rgakh' derg - iza dicha, so khir vara, bakk'alla a, zulamkhoikh".
Tsara elira: "KhIai Nukh', tkho'tsa k'iisi akh', tkhan k'iisam a alsamba'kkkhi akh', daiita tkhuna aikh'a tkhuna khir du a'llarg, kh'o bak'lu'icharakh khillekh'".
Tso elira: "I shuna dou'itur du Dala, Shena laakh', shuna nitsk' kkhochur bats /i Iazap dukhatokha/.
San kh'ekhamo a shuna paida biir bats, suna shuna kh'ekham ban li'cha a, Dela luush khillekh' shu tildala dita. I vu shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Tsu'nga shu dIaderzor dolush a du".
Ia tsara olu: "I tso sha kkho'llina". Akh'a ala: "Nagakh' i aisa kkho'llinekh' - suna tIekh' du-kkh san k'inosh, so tsIena vu-kkh ash dechu k'inoikh".
Nukh'e vekh'itsa khaam bira, kh'an k'omakh tskh'ammo a iman du'llur dats kh'una, sha'sh khIintsale iman dillinchara a ben, a'lla, kh'o gIaigIane ma vozhalakh' tsara desh khillarg bakh'anekh'.
Kema de Tkhan tergamtsa a, Tkhan vekh'ishtsa a, vist ma khilalakh' So'ga zulam dinacha'rgakh'a, bakk'alla, u'sh khina bukha bokhu'itur bolush bu.
Tso kema dora, Tsu'nan k'oman elii ullokhula chekkh mel bovlu, tsunakh bo'lura. Tso elira: "Shu tkhokh do'lu, tIakkkha tkho shukh do'lur du, shu ma- du'ilu.
TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna, kh'anna tIe Iazap dogIur du, tso iza siisazvesh dolu, la'ttash dolu Iazap shekh kh'a'rchar derg mila vu".

Tkhan omra de'cha, pesh kkhakhka iolaelcha, Okha elira: "Tsunnat1e khaa e khIora /diinatekh/ shishsha, kh'an do'zalakh a shena tIekh' dosh kh'alkhada'llargvotsurg, /masso a/ iman dillinarg a. Iman tsa dillira tsu'ntsa kIezzigchara ben.
Tso (Nukh'as) elira: "TIekhovsha tsunna, Delan tsIartsa du tsu'nan lelar a, satsar a. Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu".
I (kema) lelara u'sh a tIekh' tulgIenashna chukhula, la'mnash sanna. Nukh'as kkhiikkhira shen kIante, i vara iu'stakh: "KhIai san kIa'tig! TIe khaa tkho'tsa, ma khila kerstanashtsa".

Tso elira: "So vo'rzur vu lamanna tIe - tso larviir vu so khikh". Tso (Nukh'as) elira: "Takhana tskh'ammo a larviir vats Delan gIullakkhakh, Tso shekh k'inkhetam binarg ben". Tsarna shinna iukk'e tulgIe kh'a'vzira - iza khina bukhavakhancharakh khilira.
Elira: "KhIai latta! D1akhuda kh'an khi, va khIai stigal! DIadakkkha /dogIa daiitar/. Khi dIadelira, gIullakkh kkhochushkhilira. Isetsira Dzhudiiakh'. Elira: "Dek'aza khu'lda zulame k'am".

Nukh'as kkhiikkhira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! I san kIant san do'zalakh ma vui, Kh'an vaIda bak' ma iui, Kh'o kh'ukam decharakh uggar kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a ma vui!"
Elira /Dala/: "KhIai Nukh'! I kh'an do'zalakh vats. Iza - dika botsu bolkh bu. So'ga ma dekha kh'aina shetsa Iilma dotsurg. As kh'ekham bo kh'una kh'o tsa khiliita tsakhuucharakh".
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! So larlo Kh'o'tsa saina Iilma shetsa dotsurg Kh'o'ga dekharkh. Akh' suna tsa gechdakh', sokh k'inkhetam tsa bakh' - so khu'lush vu-kkh eshnacharakh".

A'llera: "KhIai Nukh'! Okh'avossa Tkho'gara marshallitsa a, berkattsa a kh'aina a, kh'o'tsa tskh'ana /kemana t1ekh'/ khillachu zu'rretana a. Okha shaina tIa'kh'a bakham a lur bolush /tskh'a kkhin ummatashkhir du/, tIakkkha Tkhaigara lazosh dolchu Iazapatsa skh'alotsur dolush".

U'sh k'ailenan khabarsh du, Okha kh'o'ga du'itsush dolu vekh'ishtsa. U'sh khuush tsa khilira kh'o a /khIai Mukh'ammad/, kh'an k'am a khIokkhul kh'alkha. Akh' sobar de. TIa'kh'e /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna iu.
Iadashka a tseran vasha KhIud /vakhiitira Okha/. Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am, Iibadat de /tskh'ana/ Dalla - Allakh1ana, I votsurg kkhin dela vats shuna, shu ma dats khartsderg kkhullush ben.
KhIai san k'am! Tsunna tIekh' shu'ga saina makh tsa bo'khu as. Suna makh balar Sha so kkho'llina volchunna t1ekh' ben dats. Shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?

KhIai san k'am! Gechdar dekha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, tIakkkha Tsu'nga toba de, Tso stigal iou'itur shuna shortta dogIitsa, shun nitsk'ana tIe a nitsk'atsa sovdokhur du Tso shu, shu dIa ma derzalash k'inosh desh a dolush."
Tsara elira: "KhIai KhIud! Kh'o tsa veana tkho'ga bilgalontsa, tkho ma dats tkhan delii d1atosur dolush kh'an dosh bakh'anekh', tkho khir dats kh'okh tesharsh.
Okha olu: "Tkhan tskh'abolchu delasha zulam dina kh'una". Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, as Dela khIottavo tesh, ash teshalla de so ash /Delatsa/ nak'ost latsarkh tsIena vu alii
I sha /Dela/ votsuchukh. Mekarlo e suna massara a, tsa esh tIa'kh'a ma tattalash so.

Bakk'alla a, so Dalla tIetevzhi, san a, shun a Ela volchu. Tskh'a a diinat ma dats Tso shen chIaba lotsur iolushben. Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg niisachu novk'akh' ma vu (niisa bekkham besh vu).

Shu dukhadovlakh' /as de'nachukh/ - as shu'ga dIakkhachiina shetsa so shu'ga vaiitinarg. San Kkhiosh-kkhobucho tIa'kh'e shu dotschu /kkhechu/ k'omana khu'lu'itur iu, ash Tsunna tskh'ana a khIumantsa zen diir dats. Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - masso a khIumanan lardarkho vu!"
Tkhan gIullakkh de'cha, Okha kIelkh'arbekhira KhIud a, tsu'ntsa bolu iman dillina khillarsh a Tkhaigarchu k'inkhetamtsa, Okha u'sh kIelkh'arbekhira lu'rachu Iazapakh.
Vu'ish Iadash bu - shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatashna inkarlo iira tsara, Tsu'nan elchanashna Iesa khilira, khIor k'arlur votschu, kh1or nitsk' bechu kh'olan den gIullakkhna tIa'kh'akhIittira u'sh.

/Delan a, malikiin a, masso a nekhan a /neIalt kh'a'rchira tsarakh khIokkhu du'nenakh' a, k'ematdiinakh' a. Kh'ovsal! Bakk'alla a, Iadasha kerstanalla ma dina shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna. Kh'ovsal! Bella bovla i Iadash, KhIudin k'am!

Samudashka a tseran vasha Salikh' /vakhiitira Okha/. Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Iibadat deisha /tskh'ana/ Dalla-Allakh1ana, I votsurg kkhin dela ma vats shuna. Tso kkhiiina shu la'ttakh, tsu chokh' dakhiitina shu, Tsu'nga gechdar dekha, tIakkkha Tsu'nga toba de. Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gergakh' a vu, zhop lush a vu".

Tsara elira: "KhIai Salikh'! Kh'o ma varii tkhuna iukk'ekh' khIokkhul kh'alkha kh'okh /tkhaina t1ekh' ela khilare okha/ dogdokhush verg. Akh' tkho dukhatukhu Okha Iibadat darkh tkhan daisha Iibadat dechunna. Bakk'alla, tkho chIogIachu shekonekh' ma du akh' tkho shega kkhoikkhuchukh".

Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Goi shuna, so san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bilgalonna tIekh' khilcha, Tso suna shegara k'inkhetam a belcha, kh'an gIo diir dara suna Dalla du'kh'al, so Tsunna Iesa khilcha? Ash suna sov tsa bokkkhu eshama ben.
KhIai san k'am! KhIara Delan emkal iu shuna delil khilla, iitalash i Delan la'ttakh' iazha. Vonig ma delash tsunna - tIakkkha kesta khir dolchu Iazapo skh'alotsur du shu".
Tsara tsunna (Dala iaiitinchu emkalna) urs kh'a'kkhira. Tso (Salikh'a) elira: "Zovkkh kh'ega shain tsIenoshkakh' kkhaa diinakh'. I kharts iotsu vaIda iu!"

Tkhan gIullakkh de'cha, Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira Salikh' a, tsu'ntsa iman dillina khillarsh a Tkhaigara k'inkhetamtsa a, tsu diinan siisazallakh a. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg nu'tsk'ala verg a, veza verg a ma vu.
Zulam dinarsh mokh'o skh'aletsira - shain tsIenoshkakh' /bella/ bertal begna Iu'iranga bevlira u'sh.
Sha'sh tsarna chokh' tsa la'ttinarsh sanna. Kh'ovsal! Bakk'alla a, samudasha kerstanalla dina shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna. Kh'ovsal! Bella bovla i samudash!
Tkhan elchanash (malikash) ba'khkira IbrakhIime kkha' bokkkhush, tsara elira: "Salam!". Tso elira: "Salam!", kh'e tsa velira i kkha'rzinchu esitsa /kh'eshashna/ tIe van.

Tsunna gicha tseran ku'igash tsunna (esanna) tIe tsa kkhochush, tso tsarna inkarloiira, i tsarakh kkheravelira. Tsara elira: "Ma kkhera! Bakk'alla a, tkho dakhkiitina LutIin k'omana tIe" /u'sh khIallakban/.
Tsu'nan (IbrakhIiman) zuda (Sarat) iara irakhIo'ttina la'ttash, i elaelira. Okha tsunna (Saratana) kkha' ba'kkkhira Iskh'ak'atsa, Iskh'ak'al tIekh'akh' -IaIk'ubatsa.
Tso (Sarata) elira: "Dek'aza ma iala so! Ber do tk'a as, so-kh k'ena zuda ma iui, khIara san maira a k'ena stag ma vui? Ma tamashe khIuma du khIara!"

Tsara (malikasha) elira: "Akh' tamasha bo Delan gIullakkhakh? Delan k'inkhetam a, Tsu'nan berkat a khu'lda shuna tIekh', khIai tsIiinan okhIla! Bakk'alla a, Iza khastame verg a, siilakh' verg a ma vu".

IbrakhIimakh kkheravalar dIada'lcha, tsu'nga kkha' a be'cha, Tkho'tsa (Tkhan malikashtsa) k'iisa volavelira i LutIin k'am bakh'anekh' (tsarna Iazap tIa'kh'atattakh'ara bokhush, iman dilla megara tsara).
Bakk'alla a, IbrakhIim sobare a, "akhI" dukkha ba'khnarg a, dIavirzinarga ma vu".
IbrakhIim! Dita i, Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun omra deana, dukhatokhalur dotsu Iazap tsarna dogIush du.
Tkhan elchanash LutIina tIeba'khkicha, tsarna singattame khilira iza, u'sh bakh'anekh' dog gatdelira tsu'nan (shen k'omo tsarna zen dan kkho'rush), tso elira: "KhIara khala de du!"

Tsunna tIedeara tsu'nan k'am (tsu'nan k'oman nakh), sikhkha tsunna tIebirzira u'sh /kh'eshashtsa irchanig leladaita shaiga, bokhush/, kh'alkha a khilira u'sh k'inosh desh. Tso (LutIas) elira: "KhIai san k'am! Kkhuzakh' san mekhkarii bu, u'sh melkho a tsIena bu shuna /mare biga/. Delakh kkheriisha, siisaza ma veisha so san kh'eshashkakh'! Shukh tskh'a a niisa stag vats?!"
Tsara elira: "Kh'una khuush ma dara, kh'an mekhkarshkakh' tkhan gIullakkh dats, kh'una ma kha'a, tkhuna khIun deza".
Tso elira: "Shu'tsa /k'ovsa/ nitsk' balkh'ara-kkh suna, chIogIa gIortor elakh'ara tIetovzha".

Tsara (malikasha) elira: "KhIai LutI! Tkho kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun elchanash du, tsk'a a kh'una tIekkhochur bats u'sh. Kh'an do'zaltsa bu'isanan dak'oshkakh' novk'a vala, iukha ma vo'rziila shukh tskh'a a, kh'an zuda a ben. Bakk'alla a, tsunakh kkhetar du tsarakh kkhettarg. Tsarna to'khna khan - Iu'ire iu. Gergakh' iats tk'a Iu'ire?"
Tkhan gIullakkh de'cha, Okha tsu'nan (LutIin iu'rtan) lakkhekh lakhe iira, Okha tsarna tIe bek'achu popparkh tIulgash delkhiitira,

Bilgalda'khna khilla dolu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh'. /Masso a/ zulamkhoikh genakh' dats i(ishtta taIzar khila). (Kh'an k'omana genakh' ma iats i tseran Dala iokhiina iartash, khIai Mukh'ammad).

Mad'ianashka a tseran vasha ShuIaib /vakhiitira Okha/. Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! tskh'ana Dalla - Allakh1ana Iibadat de, I votsurg kkhin dela vats shuna. Iustar a, ozar a esha ma e. Suna gush du shu dikanekh', so kkho'ru shuna go biir bolchu diinanIazapakh.
KhIai san k'am! Kkhochush'e iustar a, ozar a niisontsa, ma eshae nakhana shain khIumanash, ma lelalash la'ttakhula, bo'khanig darzhadesh.
Delan bukhadu'surshdika du shuna shu mu'ma/nakh/ khillekh', so ma vats shuna tIekh' lardarkho".

Tsara elira: "KhIai ShuIaib! Kh'an dino omra do kh'o'ga tkhan daisha shena Iibadat diirig tkho'ga dita, olii, ia tkhan bakhamekh' tkhaina luurg dar /dita olii/? Bakk'alla a, kh'o sobare a, niisachu kkhetamekh' a ma vui".

Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Goi shuna, so khillekh' san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bilgalonna tIekh', Tso Shegara khaza ritsk' della suna. Suna tsa la'a shuna khilpalo ian as shuna dikhkinchu'ngakh'. So dekk'a dikanig luush vu saina ma - moggu. San kkhiam Delatsa ben bats. Tsunna tIetevzhina so. Tsunna tIevo'rzu so.
KhIai san k'am! So'tsa egIaro dallane a tIe ma daladoila shuna Nukh'an k'omana a, ia KhIudan k'omana a, ia Salikh'an k'omana a khillarg. LutIin k'am a shuna dukkha genakh' a ma dats.
Shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga gechdar dekha, tIakkkha toba de Tsu'nga. Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg k'inkhetame verg a, Shena /Shen khalk'/ dezash verg a ma vu".

Tsaraelira: "KhIai ShuIaib! Akh' du'itsuchukh dukkkhachukh tkho kkhetash ma dats, tkho kh'o tkhailakh' ledara gush ma du, i kh'an gergarnash batsakh'ara, Okha tIulgash dittina khir ma dara kh'una, kh'o tkhuna veza verg a ma vats".
Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Tk'a san gergarnash beza bu shuna Delal? Ash Iza-m shain buk'a tIekh'akh' ma vitii?! Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg ash diirig /Shen 1ilmatsa/ chulotsush ma vu.
KhIai san k'am! Shaina mogurg de ash, asa a diir du. TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna, mu'lkhachu'nga dogIur du i siisazvesh dolu Iazap, mila vu khartslu'irig! Kh'ezha! So a shu'tsa tskh'ana kh'o'zhur vu".

Tkhan gIullakkh de'cha, Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira ShuIaib a, tsu'ntsa iman dillinarsh a Tkhaigara k'inkhetamtsa. Zulam dinarsh mokh'o skh'aletsira, shain tsIenoshkakh' bertal kkhetta Iu'irenga bevlira u'sh.
Tsigakh' tsa ba'khnarsh sanna /bisira u'sh/. Kh'ovsal! Bella bovla i mad'ianash, Samudash bella bovlare terra.
Musa vakhiitira Okha Tkhan aiatashtsa a, bilgalchu delilatsa a
FirIavne a, tsu'nan elashka a - FirIavnan gIullakkhna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush bara u'sh. FirIavnan gIullakkh niisa ma datsara!
Shen k'omana kh'alkhaver vu i k'ematdiinakh', tso bu'gur bu u'sh tsIerga. Ma von chugIoila iu u'sh /shena/ chulokhkurg!
KhIokkhu chokh' (du'nenakh') a neIalt kh'a'rchira tsarakh, k'ematdiinakh' a. Ma von sovgIat du-kkh i sha lechunna!
U'sh - iartiin khabarekh du, Okha du'itsu u'sh kh'o'ga. Tsarakhla'ttash erg iu, /ialta sanna/ kh'a'kkhnarg a iu.

Okha zulam tsa dina tsarna, khIette a, sha'sh shaina zulam dina tsara. Shain Dela a vitina, shaiga kkhoikkhush bolchu delasha khIumma a kIelkh'ar tsa da'kkkhira tsarakh kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gIullakkh de'nachul tIa'kh'a. Tsara tIetu'ikhira tsarna khIallakkhilar.
Ishtta du kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun /zulamkhoi Iazapatsa/ skh'alatsar, Sha zulame iolu iartash /Iazapatsa/ skh'alotsush. Bakk'alla a, Tsu'nan skh'alatsar- chIogIa lazosh du-kkh.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du sha ekhartan Iazapakh kkhiirinchunna, i de du shena tIe nakh gulbiir dolu, i de du sha gur dolu.
Okha tIa'kh'atottur ma dats i iagariinchu khanna ben.
I de de'cha, sino k'amel diir dats Tsu'nan purbantsa ben. Tsarakh dek'aznig a khir vu, irsenig a khir vu.
Dak'azabevllarsh - u'sh tsIergakh' khir bu, tsarna tsigakh' tiizhamash a, ugIarsh a du.
Guttar la'ttar bolush bu u'sh tsu chokh', stiglanash a, latta a mel du, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna ma lu'u. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg guttar desh ma vu Shena luurg.
Amma irse khillarsh - beshakh'khir bu, tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bolush bu u'sh, stiglanash a, latta a mel du, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna ma lu'u, sha khadalur dotsu sovgIat khilla.

Kh'o shekonekh' ma khilalakh' khIokkhara Iibadat dechukh. Tsara Iibadat desh ma dats kh'una kh'alkha shain daisha ma-darra ben. Bakk'alla a, Okha tsarna kkhachor ma du shain /Iazapan/ dak'a, tsa eshadesh.

Musaga zhaina delira Okha, tsu chokh' a tskh'a'natsadarsh khilira tseran. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara dosh kh'alkha tsa da'llekh'ara, tsarna iukk'ekh' kkhiel iina khir iara. Bakk'alla a, u'sh otsunakh shekonan shekona chokh' ma bu.
Bakk'alla a, khIoranna kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho banne a bekkham biir bu shain Iamalashtsa. Bakk'alla a, Iza tsara diirig dika khuush verg vu.
Nislo, kh'aiga omra ma di, kh'o a, kh'o'tsa tskh'ana sha toba dinarg a, /Delan dozanekh/ tIekh ma dovla. Bakk'alla a, Iza ash diirig gush ma vu.
Zulam dinacharna tIe ma tiizha - tsIaro skh'alotsur du shu, Dela votsurg doladiirash bats shuna, tIakkkha shuna gIo diir dats.
Lamaz khIottade diinan shinna iu'kh'ekh' a, bu'isanakh a diinan gerga dolchu sakh'tashkakh'. Bakk'alla a, dikchu Iamalsha dIaiokhu von Iamalsh. Iza - dagadaiitar du dagadogIucharna.
Sobar de, bakk'alla a, Dala esha tsa io dika Iamalsh echeran ial.

Ma tsa khilira shul kh'alkha khillachu tIa'kh'enakh bukhadu'suchundai, sha'sh /nakh/ dukhatukhush la'ttakh' dechu bo'khachukh, Okha sha'sh tsarakh kIelkh'arba'khnacharakh tskh'a kIezzig bersh ben. Zulam dinarsh tIa'kh'abezira shaina della khillachu /khazchu/ kh'olana, u'sh khilira k'inosh desh bersh.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tsa khilira zulamtsa iartash khIallak'esh, tseran bakharkhoi dika Iamalsh esh a bolush.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna li'nekh'ara, nakh tskh'ana ummatakh khiliitina khir bara Tso. U'sh dIa tsa tila taip-taipana khu'luchukh

Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho shekh k'inkhetam biinarg ben. Otsu'nan (k'inkhetaman)du'kh'a Tso u'sh kkho'llina. Kkhochushkhili kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun dosh: "Iuzzane a iuzur iu As zho'zhakhati /shait1anna t1a'kh'akh1ittinchu/ zhinekh a, nakhakh- massarekh a",-a'lla dolu.
Derrig a du'itsu Okha kh'o'ga elchaniin khabarekh kh'an dog shetsa Okha chIagIdesh derg. Tsu chokh' deana kh'o'ga bak'derg a, kh'ekham a, mu'manakhana dagadaiitar a.
Akh' ala tsateshacha'rga: "Shain 1amal e shain novk'akh', Okha a iiir iu /tkhan 1amal tkhan novk'akh'/.
Kh'ovsa, tkho a kh'ovsur du!
Delan iu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a k'aile. Tsu'nga dIado'rzu masso a gIullakkh, Tsunna Iibadat de, Tsunna tIetovzha. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tergal tsa desh vats ash diirig.
Alif-lam-ra. KhIorsh k'eginchu zhainin aiatash du.
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossiina i K'ur'an 1a'rbiin /mattakh'/, shu kh'ek'ale khila tam bara.
Okha du'itsu kh'o'ga uggar khaza khabarsh kh'o'ga va'kh'itsa khIara K'ur'an daiitartsa, tsul kh'alkha kh'o tsakhuucharakh khillekh' a.
Kh'akhade: Iusufa ma elira shen dega /IaIk'ube/: "Dada, suna gi tskh'aitta seda a, malkh a, butt a, suna gi u'sh saina suzhud desh".
Tso (IaIk'uba) elira: "KhIai san zhima k1ant, i kh'aina ginarg ma diitsalakh' kh'ain vezharshka - mekarlo iiir iu kh'una tsara. Bakk'alla a, shaitIa adamna bilggal mostagI ma du.

Ishtta kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho khorzhur volush vu kh'o, kh'una Iamor dolush du Tso khillarsh tidan, Shen niImat kh'una kkhochushdiir dolush du Tso, IaIk'uban do'zalna a, Sha kh'alkha kh'an daishna IbrakhIimna a, Iskh'ak'na a kkhochushdina khilare terra. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg khuush verg a vu, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu".
Iusufekh' a, tsu'nan vezharshkakh' a delilash ma khilira khottucharna.
Tsarama elira: "Iusuf a, tsu'nan vasha adukkhabeza vain dena vail, tk'a vai tskh'a toba ma iui, bakk'alla a, i vain da bilggalchu tilar chokh' vu-kkh.
Ve Iusuf ia /kkhechu/ makhka dIakkhossa - shun den iu'kh' shuna tIeio'rzur iu, tsul tIa'kh'a dika k'am khir shu (toba diir du ash-tIakkkha gechdiir du shuna Dala").
Tsarakh oluchoelira: "Ma ve Iusuf, gIu chu kkhossa i - dIabo'lkhush bolcharakh tskh'abolchara skh'avokkkhur vu, sha'sh desh khillekh'" /i gIullakkh de/.
Tsaraelira: "KhIai tkhan da! Akh' khIunda tsa vu'tu Iusuf tkhokh teshna, tkho tsunna kh'ekhamchash ma dui!
Vaiitakh' i tkho'tsa kkhana - samuk'adokkkhur shena, lovzur shena, okha i Ialashviir ma vu".
Tso (IaIk'uba) elira: "San sagatlur ma du ash i d1avigcha, so kkho'ru i barzo vaarna, ash tsu'nan tergo a tsa esh".
Tsara elira: "I barzo vaakh' - tkho tskh'a toba ma iui, tIakkkha tkho, bakk'alla a, eshnarsh khir ma dara".
TIakkkha tsara i d1avigcha, tseran bart khilira i gIu chu kkhossa. Okha khaiitira tsu'nga (Iusufe) va'kh'itsa: akh' du'itsur ma du tsa'rga i tsara dinarg, tsarna i dagakh' a dotsush.
U'sh ba'khkira shain da volchu sarakh', belkha a bo'lkhush.

Elira: "Kh1ai tkhan da! Tkho dakhara /dovdarekh' ia Iad kkhossarekh'/ k'iisa a lush, Iusuf tkheshan khIumanashna ullokh' vitira okha, tIakkkha i barzo viira. Kh'o tkhokh teshar volush vats, tkho bak'lu'ish khillekh' a".

U'sh ba'khkira tsu'nan (Iusufan) kucha tIekh' kharts tsIii dolush. Tso (IaIk'uba) elira: "Shain sinosha tskh'a vonig khazdina shuna. Sobar du-kkh khaza derg. Dela vu-kkh Shega gIo dekha kh'ak' verg /kkhu/ ash khIottochu surta tIekh'".

Tskh'a lelash iolutoba eara, tsara vakhiitirashain khi kkho'kh'ush verg, tso shen vedar okh'adakhiitira- elira: "Kkha' bu! KhIara kIant vu!" Tsara (Iusufan vezharsha) kh'uldira i (Iusufan gIullakkh - i shain vedda lai vu a'lla), tsunakh iokhka-etsaran khIuma a iina. Dela khuush verg ma vu tsara lelosh derg.
Tsara (vezharsha) vo'khkira i kIezzigchu mekhakh - tskh'a massiita dirkhIamakh. Tsunakh u'sh khilira kIezzig khIumanakh toam becharakh.

Misrarchu i etsnacho shen zudchu'nga elira: "Khazdelakh' tsu'nan Iar, vaina paida ban mega tso, ia vai va'shna kIant viir vu tsunakh". Ishtta Okha chIagIvira Iusuf la'tta t1ekh', tsunna khillarsh tida Iamadarkh'ama a. Dela Shen gIullakkha tIekh' tolam bokkkhush vu, delakh' a, dukkhakh bolchu nakhana tsa kha'a-kkh.
Iza g1emettakh1o'tticha, Okha tsunna kh'ek'alalla a, Iilma a delira. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha dikacharna.

Iza (Iusuf) shen kh1usamekh' volu zuda i Iekho gIo'rtira, tso neIarsh dIa a k'evlina, elira: "Skh'avola!" Tso (Iusufa) elira: "Dala larvoila! Bakk'alla a, iza (kh'an maira) san ela vu, tso san Iar khazdina, bakkkhiibiir bats zulamkhoi".

Tsu'nanotsu'nga (Iusufe) bezam bakhnera, tk'a tsu'nan a otsu'nga (zudchu'nga ) bezam bakhnera, shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara deliltsa ginekh'ara /zina diir dara tso/. Ishtta /dira Dala/ tsunakh vonig a, bo'khanig a dIadakkkharkh'ama. Bakk'alla, i Tkhan tsIenchu lekh vu.

I shii akh'alkhadala k'u'isush, neIare sikhdelira, tso (Zuleikhas) tsu'nan (Iusufan) koch iatIiira tIekh'akhula, neIarekh' u'sh t1e1ittabelira tsarna tsu'nan elana. Tso (Zuleikhas) elira: "KhIun bekkham bu kh'an do'zalna vonig luuchunna: ia i nabakhti chu tsa vo'llicha, ia lazosh dolu Iazap ben (tsa dicha)?"

Tso (Iusufa) elira: "I gIo'rtira so Iekho". Tsu'nan (Zuleikhin) gergarcharakh tskh'ana teshoteshalla dira: "Nagakh' sanna tsu'nan koch kh'alkhakhula ia'ttIa elakh' - i bak' iu, tk'a iza khartslu'icharakh vu.
Nagakh' sanna tsu'nan koch tIekh'akhula ia'ttIa elakh' - i kharts iu, tk'a iza bak'lu'icharakh vu".
Shena tsu'nan koch tIekh'akhula ia'ttIa gicha, tso (mairacho) elira: "Shun (zudariin) mekarlonakh du-kkh khIara, bakk'alla a, shun mekarlo eza-iokkkha iu-kkh.
Iusuf, kh'o dIaverza khIokkhunakh. Tk'a akh' /kh1ai Zuleikha/ kh'ain k'inna /du'kh'al/ gechdar dekha, bakk'alla a, kh'o gal'ia'llacharakh khili".
GIalakh' zudarsha elira: "Elan zuda tskh'a k'onakh (shen lai) shetsa Iekho gIirtira, tsu'nga bolu bezam ch1og1a dagchu bakhna tsu'nan. Bakk'alla a, vaina ma go i bilggalchu tilar chokh' khilar".

Shena tseran mekarlo khezcha, tso tsarna tIe /tskh'a'/ vakhiitira. Tsarna d1atevzhiilasha kechiira, tsarakh khIoranga urs a delira, tIakkkha elira /Iusufe/: "Guchuvala tsarna!" Shaina i gicha, tsara i vazvira, shain ku'igash khediira, elira: "Dala lardoila! KhIara adam a dats! KhIara siilakh' malik du!"

Tso (Zuleikhas) elira: "I vu-kkh shuna ash suna sha bakh'anekh' bekhkash dekhkinarg! So i Iekho ma gIo'rtira - i chIagIvelira. As shega omra desh derg tso tsa dakh', nabakhti chu vullur vu i, i khir vu siisaza bolcharakh".

Tso (Iusufa, Dele do'khush) elira: "So Kkhiosh-Kkhobush volu Dela, nabakhti dukkhakho eza suna tsara so shena (k'inna) tIekkhoikkhuchul, tseran mekarlo Akh' sokh dIa tsa iakkkhakh', so tsarna tIevo'rzur vu - tIakkkha so zhekhIal nakhakh khir ma vu".
Shen Kkhiosh-kkhobucho zhop delira tsunna, tsunakh dIaia'kkkhira tseran (zudariin) mekarlo. Bakk'alla a, Iza khezash verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.
Shaina delilash ginchul tIa'kh'a, tseran oila khilira i tskh'ana khanna nabakhti chu volla.

Tsu'ntsa tskh'ana nabakhti cho'kh'avelira shi k'onakh. Tsu shinnakh tskh'ammo elira: "Suna suo goaisa chagIar dokkkhush". Vukkho elira: "Suna suo go sain ko'rta tIekh' aisa kkhallar kkho'kh'ush, i olkhazarsha daa duush. Diitsa tkhuna i tidarkh. Bakk'alla a, tkhuna kh'o go dikacharakh".

Tso elira: "Shushinna tIe shuna baosh bolu kkhacha kkhochur ma bats as shuna tsu'nan tidarkh du'itsush ben i shu'ga kkhachale. I du shuna san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho suna Iamiinachukh. As ditina sha Delakh tsateshachu, sha ekhartana kersta dolchu k'oman din.

So tIa'kh'ava'zna san dain IbrakhIiman, Iskh'ak'an, IaIk'uban dinna. Tkhan tsa khilla tskh'ana a khIumantsa Delatsa nak'ost latsar. I Delan koma'rshallakh du tkhuna a, nakhana a. Delakh' a, dukkhakhbolchu nakha barkalla tsa olu.
KhIai san nabakhtin shi nak'ost! Taip-taipana delii bu dika ia Sha tskh'a' volu, nu'tsk'ala volu AllakhI-Dela vu?

I votschunna ash shaina Iibadat diirig ekk'a tsIersh ma iu, ash sha'sh a, shun daisha a tekhkina iolu, tsa'rtsa tskh'a a delil Dala dossiina ma dats. Kh'ukma Delan ben ma dats. Tso omra dina, Shena ben Iibadat ma de, a'lla. I du mekhala din, delakh' a, dukkhakhbolchu nakhana tsa kha'a-kkh.

KhIai san nabakhtin shi nak'ost! Shushinnakh tskh'amma shen elana chagIar malor du, tk'a vazha irkh'ullur vu, tsu'nan ko'rta t1era /mezhenash/ olkhazarsha iuur iu. Kkhochushkhili gIullakkh, ash shekh la'tsna kho'ttush dolu".

Tso elira shena tsarakh kIelkh'arver vu khetachu'nga: "Kh'ain elana gergakh' so kh'akhavelakh'". ShaitIano ditsdaliitira tsunna shen ele i kh'akhavar. TIakkkha i visira nabakhti chokh' tskh'a masiitta sharakh'.
/Misran/ pachchakh'o elira: "Suna go vorkhI berstina ett vorkhI ozachara buush, vorkhI ba'tstsara kan, kkhibersh - bak'abella. KhIai elii! Tidal suna san gIan, sha'sh gIenash tu'dush khillekh'".
Tsaraelira: "Vovshakh iinagIenash dara u'sh-m. Tkho /ishtta/ gIenash tida khuush dats".
Tsu shinnakh kIelkh'arava'llacho elira, tskh'a khan ia'lcha dagadeara tsunna: "As du'itsur du shuna iza tidarkh, so vakhiita /g1enash tu'durg valo/".

"Iusuf! KhIai bak'lu'ish verg! Satsam be tkhuna /gIan tidartsa/ vorkhI berstinchu attakh, vorkhI ozacho sha'sh buush bolchu, vorkhI ba'tstsarchu kenakh a, kkhibolchu bak'abellacharakh a. So iukhaverza magara nakhana tIe, tsarna khaa a magara".
Tso (Iusufa, g1an tu'dush) elira: "VorkhI sharakh' tIettIa ash dika ialta du'ir du, sha'sh chuderziinarg - ditalash iza kenashkakh', sha'sh duur dolu /tskh'a/ kIezzig dotsurg.
TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a vorkhI khala(sho) dogIur du: tsara duur du ash tsarna kh'alkha kechdinarg, ash Ialashder dolchukh /tskh'a/ kIezzig dotsurg.
TIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a tskh'a sho dogIur du, shena chokh' nakhana alssam dogIa dog1ur dolush, shena chokh' tsara (nakha) dokkkhur dolush /chag1ar a, mutt a, da'tta a/".

Pachchakh'o elira: "Suna tIevalave iza (Iusuf)". Shena tIevakhiitinarg ve'cha, tso (Iusufa) elira: "Kh'ada, iukhaverza kh'ain elana tIe, khatta tsu'nga: "KhIun bala bu shain ku'igash khediinchu zudariin (kh1un khilira shchain ku'igash khediinachu zudarekh)? Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh - Kkhoburg tseran mekarlonash khuush ma vu".

Tso (elo) elira /zudarshka/: "KhIun gIullakkh dara shun, shu i Iusuf Iekho gIertar?" Tsara elira: "Dala lardoila! Tkhuna tsa khii tsunakh tskh'a a vonig". Elanzudcho elira: "KhIintsa guchada'lla bak'derg. So gIo'rtira i Iekho, i bak'lu'icharakh vu.
Iza /olu as/ - tsunnakhaarkh'ama as shena k'ailakha teshnabekhk bina tsakhilar, Dela a vuila nis tsa esh teshnabekhk besh bolcheran mekarlo.
As tsIan tsa do san sa, bakk'alla a, sino vonig kh'o'khu san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho k'inkhetam binarg dotsurg, bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu".
Pachchakh'o elira: "Suna tIevalave iza. As saina /gIo'ncha/ vu'tur vu iza". Tsu'ntsa shen k'amel khilcha, tso elira: "Kh'o takhana tkhuna gergakh' chIogIa verg a vu, teshame verg a vu".
Tso (Iusufa) elira: "So makhkan khaznashna tIekhIottave, so Ialashdiirig a vu, khuurg a vu".
Ishtta chIagIvira Okha Iusuf makhkakh', shena luuchokh' vakha okh'a a khuush. Tkhan k'inkhetamakh kkhiavo Okha Tkhaina luurg, dikacheran ial tsa eshaio Okha.
Tk'a bakk'alla a, ekhartan ial dika iu iiman dillincharna, /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillacharna.
Iusufan vezharii ba'khkira, i volchu cho'kh'a bevlira u'sh, tsunna u'sh bevzira, tsarna iza tsa vevzira.

Sha u'sh shain gIirsatsa kechbinchul tIa'kh'a, tso elira: "Shain den agIorkh'ara /kkhechu nanas vina/ volu shain vasha valave suna tIe. Shuna tsa go: as niisa kkhochushbo baram, so shena /shu/ tIedussucharakh dikanig vu.
Ash suna i tsa valavakh' - shuna baram bats san gergakh', suna gerga ma du'ilalash".
Tsara (Iusufan vezharsha) elira: "Okha shen degara Iekhiina valor vu iza. Bakk'alla a, Okha /kkhochush/diir du".
Shen ialkhoshka tso (Iusufa) elira: "Tseran khIumanash shain kiranii chu dIaekhka: shain do'zalna tIebirzicha, tsarna u'sh iovza megara, u'sh iukha skh'a ban megara".
Shain dena tIe iukhabirzicha, tsara elira: "KhIai dada! /KIan/ baram dukhato'khna tkhokh, i tkhan vasha vaiita tkho'tsa - barambiir bu okha, tkho tsunna lardarkhoi khir du".
Tso (IaIk'uba) elira: "I shukh teshna vu'tur varii as, kh'alkha tsu'nan vasha shukh teshorakh terra? Dela vu-kkh dika lardarkho. I vu-kkh uggar k'inkhetame verg".

Shain kiranash skh'adillicha, tsarna kariira shain khIumanash shaiga iukhaiaiitina. Tsara elira: "KhIai dada! KhIun lo'khu vai? Vain khIumanash iukhaiaiitina vaiga! Vain tsIiinan okhIla a kkhobur iara iuuchu'ntsa, tkhan vasha a Ialashviir vara, alsambokkkhur bara Okha baram tskh'ana emkalna. I baram atta bu-kkh".

Tso (IaIk'uba) elira: "As vanne a vou'itur ma vats i shu'tsa, ash suna Delatsa chIagIo tsa iakh', sha'sh suna skh'avalor vu iza, a'lla, shaikh tskh'a khIuma tsa khilakh'". Tsara shena dui bi'cha, tso elira: "Dela vu-kkh vai du'itsuchunna vekal (tesh)".

/IaIk'uba/ elira: "KhIai san kIentii! Tskh'ana neIarekhula chu ma gIolash. Taip-taipana neIarshkakhula chu gIolash. Shu khIumma kIelkh'ardakha tsa lo suna Delera. Kh'ukam Tsu'ngakh' ben dats. Tsunna tIetevzhina so. Tsunna tIetevzhiila sha'sh tevzhash bersh".

U'sh chu ba'khkicha, shain das shaiga omra dinchukhula, i tsa khillera tsarakh Delera khIumma kIelkh'aradakkkha, dekk'a IaIk'uban shegakh' tskh'a kh'asht ben - tso i kkhochushdira. Bakk'alla a, i Iilma dolush verg vu Okha shena Iamiinachunna. Delakh' a, dukkhakhbolchu nakhana tsa kha'a-kkh.
U'sh Iusuf volchu chu ba'khkicha, tso shen vashashena tIeiitsira, elira: "Bakk'alla a, so kh'an vasha vu. Akh' sa ma kh'iizade tsara desh khillachu'ntsa".
Sha tsarna kechbinchul tIa'kh'a tseran kecham, shen veshin mokh'a chu kadbillira tso. TIakkkha kkhoikkhucho kkhaikkhira: "KhIai kovra (k'epal)! Shu k'ui du!"
Tsara (vezharsha) elira, sha'sh tsarna tIeba'khkina: "KhIun iaina shun?"
Tsaraelira: "Pachchakh'an kad baina tkhan, i skh'abe'nachunna tskh'ana emkalan mokh' bu. As dosh lo tsunna tIera".
Tsara (vezharsha) elira: "VallakhIi, shuna ma-kha'ara, tkho la'ttakh' vonig dan da'khkina ma datsara, k'ui ma datsara tkho".
Tsaraelira: "KhIun bekkham khir bu tsu'nan, nagakh' sanna shu khartslu'ish khillekh'?"
Elira /vezharsha/: "Tsu'nan bekkham - shen mokh'a chokh' i kariinarg - i sha vu tsu'nan bekkham. Ishtta bekkham bo okha zulamkhoshna".

I volavelira /iaina khIuma lakha/ tseran kiranashkara shen veshin kiranal kh'alkha, tIakkkha i /kad/ skh'aba'kkkhira tso shen veshin kiranna chu'ra. Ishtta khIilla 1amiira Okha Iusufna. Shen vasha skh'alotsiila (bukhasatsoila) datsara tsu'nan /ishtta a ben/ pachchakh'an dinekh', Dalla li'cha a ben. Tkhaina luurg darzhashkakh' lakkhavokkkhu Okha. Masso shegakh' Iilma dolchunna tIekh' a Iilma derg vu Iza /Dela/.

Tsara elira: "Tso lachk'iina belakh', kh'alkha tsu'nan vashas a lachk'iira". I shegakh' kh'uldiraIusufa, tsarna guchu tsa da'kkkhira, elira /sha-shega/: " Shu du-kkh /tkhol/ vuno vochu kh'olekh'. Dela dika khuush vu-kkh ash kh1ottosh dolu surt".
Tsara elira: "KhIai veza ela! Tsu'nan da vu vokkkha k'ena stag, tkhokh tskh'a' bukhasatsavekh'a tsu'nan metta, tkhuna kh'o dikacharakh gush ma vu".
Tso elira: "Dala lardoila Okha tkheshan khIuma shegakh' kariinarg ben satsatsavarkh! TIakkkha tkho zulamkhoi khir ma darii".

Sha'sh tsunakhdog dillicha, vovshashtsa dagabu'ilush sha'sh bisira u'sh. Tsarakh vokkkhachoelira: "Shuna kha'ii shain das shaiga Delatsa ch1ag1o iaitina khilar, ash kh'alkha Iusufan kh'ok'ekh' ledarlo ialiitira. So khIokkhu la'ttara (makhkara) dIag1ur vats san das suna purba lakh' ben, ia Dala suna kh'ukma dakh' ben. Iza kh'ukma decharakh dikanig vu.
