Shu iukhaderza shain dena tIe, ash ala: "Dada! Kh'an kIanta k'ola dina, Okha teshalla dina ma dats tkhaina khuush khillachukh ben, tkho tsa khilla k'ailakh derg 1alashdesh a (tkhuna tsa kha'a k'ailakh derg).
Khatta kh'aina tkho khillachu iurte a, tkho shetsa da'khkinchu kovre a. Bakk'alla a, tkho bak'lu'ish dersh ma du-kkh".

Tso (IaIk'uba) elira: "KhIa'! Shun sinosha tskh'a gIullakkh khazdira shuna. Sobar du-kkh /suna/ t1ekh dika. Dala u'sh berrige a skh'abalo mega suna. Bakk'alla a, Iza - khuush verg a vu, kh'ukma /niisa / desh verg a vu-kkh".
Tsarakh dIavirzira iza, elira: "Ma lazam bu-kkh so'gakh' Iusuf bakh'anekh'". Singattamna kIaibelira tsu'nan b1a'rgash. I satukhush vara.
Tsara (IaIk'uban gonakh' bolchara) elira: "VallakhIi, Iusuf vu'itsuchura kh'o sotsur ma vats kh'uo tsomgush khillalts ia khIallakkhillalts".
Tso (Ia1k'uba) elira: "As Dele balkhabo sain bala a, sain gIaigIa a, so kha'a Delera shuna tsakhuurg a.
KhIai san kIentii! GIo, t1ekkhialash Iusufakh a, tsu'nan veshekh a /khillachunna /. Delan k'inkhetamakh dog ma dillalash. Delan k'inkhetamakh dog du'llur ma dats /Delakh/ tsateshachu k'omo a ben".

Sha'sh i (Iusuf) volchu ba'khkicha, tsara elira: "KhIai veza ela! Tkho a, tkhan /tsIiinan/ okhIla a g1aig1anola'tsna. Tkho da'khkina tskh'a kIezg-mezg /iokhka/ khIumanash iokh'ush - kkhacham bollush baram lokh'a tkhuna, sagIa a lokh'a tkhuna. Dala ial lur ma iu sagIa lucharna".
Tso (Iusufa) elira: "Shuna khi'nii, sha'sh khIun dira Iusufana a, tsu'nan veshina a, sha'sh zhekhIaldolush?"

Tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, kh'o vui Iusuf?!". Tso elira: "So Iusuf a vu, khIara san vasha a vu. Dala k'inkhetam bina tkhokh. Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush verg a, sobar desh verg a /dek'al vu-kkh/. Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa eshaio dikacheran ial".
Tsara elira: "VallakhIi, Dala tkhol vazvina kh'o, tkho khilla-kkh gIalatdevllarsh!"
Tso elira: "Bekhk tsa bokkkhu shu'ga takhana. Dala gechdiir du shuna. Iza uggare k'inkhetame verg ma vu.
Du'lo, d1ag1o khIara san koch a etsii, san den iu'kh' t1e tasa i - bIa'rsa iukhadogIur du tsu'nan. Berrige shain do'zal balosh, suna tIe du'ila".
Kovra (k'epal) araia'lcha, tseran das (IaIk'uba) elira: "Bakk'alla a, Iusufan kh'ozha iogIush vu-kkh so, ash so Iovdal ma larakh'ara".
Tsaraelira: "VallakhIi, kh'ain kh'alkhalerchu tilar chokh' vu-kkh kh'o!"
Kkha' bokkkhurg ve'cha, tso i (Iusufan koch) tesira tsu'nan (IaIk'uban) iu'kh' t1e - tsu'nan bIa'rsa iukhadeara, tso elira: "As tsa a'llera shu'ga: suna Delera shuna tsakhuurg a kha'a".
Tsara elira: "Tkhan da! Tkhan k'inoshna (Dele) gechdar dekhakh'a tkhuna, tkho khilla-kkh gIalatdevlla".
Tso elira: "TIa'kh'a do'khur du as san Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'nga shuna gechdar. Bakk'alla a, Iza - gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu".
U'shIusuf volchu chuba'khkicha, shen da-nana marado'llira tso, elira: "Cho'kh'a dovla Misra, Dala muk'alakh', ma'rsha (tskh'a a kkheram a botsush)!"

Shen da-nana pachchakh'an g1anta t1e /shena ullo/ kh'alabekhira tso, u'sh tsunna /sii desh/ suzhude bakhara. Tso elira: "Dada, khIara du-kkh suna kh'alkha ginchun(g1enan)tidar, san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho bak'dina iza, so'tsa dika khili Iza- so arava'kkkhi nabakhti chu'ra, shu skh'adaliina gIum-arara shaitIano suna a, san vezharshna a iuk'a dov tesnachul tIa'kh'a. Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg tIekh tIekare vu-kkh Shena luuchu'ntsa. Iza khuush verg a vu, kh'ukma /niisa / desh verg a vu.

So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, Akh' pachchakh'alla a della suna, khillarsh-khindersh (g1enash) tida a Iamiina Akh' so. Stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llinarg - Kh'o vu-kkh san doladiirig du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a. Akh' so valiitalakh' busalba a volush, Akh' so tokhalakh' dikacharakh!"

I kh'ulamekh' dolchu khabarekh du, Okha kh'o'ga /khIai Mukh'ammad/ khou'itush va'kh'itsa. Kh'o vatsara tsa'rtsa tsara shain gIullakkhna t1ekh' bart besh, sha'sh /Iusuf shen dekh d1ak'asto / mekarlo esh bolush.
Dukkhakhbolu nakh, kh'una mel li'cha a, teshar bats /Delakh/.
Akh' tsa'rga tsu tIekh' makh tsa bo'khu. Iza bekk'a kh'ekham bu-kkh Ialamashna!
Stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel dukkha Ialamatekh tIekhbovlu u'sh, tsarakh dIabo'rzush /oila tsa esh/.
Tsarakh dukkhakhbersh Delakh tsa tesha, sha'sh /Tsu'ntsa/ nak'ost lotsush a ben.
U'sh teshna bu-te shaina tIe Delan Iazapan sharshu t1ekkhullurg tsakhilarkh, ia tsIekhkh'ana shaina tIe sakh'tkh1ottarkh, shaina khaa a tsa lush?
Akh' ala: "KhIara bu san nek', as Dele kkhoikkhu, bilgala dolchu Iilmanna tIekh' vu so a, suna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg a, vochukh tsIena vu i Dela, so ma vats /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsucharakh".

Kh'ol kh'alkha a iartashkarchu nakhakh bozharii ben tsa bakhiitira Okha, shaiga va'kh'itsa Okha khaam lush. Tk'a u'sh tsa lelara la'ttakhula, u'sh tsa kh'a'vsira, mukha khilla shail kh'alkha khillacheran tIa'kh'e? Ekhartan tsIa dika ma du /Delakh/ kkhiirincharna. Shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?

Elchanasha dog dillinchul t1a'kh'a, tsarna sha'sh khartsbina bevlla mo'ttinchul t1a'kh'a, Tkhan gIo dogIura tsa'rga, kIelkh'arbovlura Tkhuna /k1elkh'arabakha/ luursh. Tkhan nitsk' bukhatukhur ma bats k'inosh dinchu nakhakh.

Tsarakh la'tsna diitsar chokh' kh'ekham khilla kh'ek'al dolcharna. I khilla dats kkho'llina khabar - i du shel kh'alkha khillarg bak'dar a, masso a khIumanan k'astadara, niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a teshash bolchu nakhana.
Alif-lam-mim-ra. KhIorsh zhainin aiatash du. Kh'o'ga kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara dossinarg - bak'derg du, delakh' a, dukkhakhbolu nakh tsa tesha.

Dela vu sha stiglanash aiiinarg shuna gush g1ortorash a iotsush, tIakkkha sha dIanisvella Iza Iarsha tIekh'. Malkh a, butt a mu'tIakh' bina Tso /Shen len g1ullakkhashna/ - derrige dIasalela /shen/ to'khnachu khene. GIullakkhna urkhalla do Tso, aiatash bilgaldokhu Tso. Shu shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna du'kh'alkkhetarkh /doggakh/ tesha megar-kkha.

Iza vu latta darzhiinarg, tsu tIekh' la'mnash a, khish a khiliitinarg, masso a sto'mekh tsunna (la'tta) tIekh' Tso khiliitina shishsha taipa. Bu'isane de kh'uldoitu Tso. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash du oila echu nakhana.

La'ttakh' ul-ullokh' dak'oshdu, kemsiin boshmash iu, ialta du, khurmanash iu tskh'ana oraman a, tskh'ana oraman iotsursh a, tskh'a khi du tsarna du'llush derg. Tsarakh tskh'aersh vukkharal iaz'iina Okha iaarekh'. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash du-kkh kh'ek'al dolchu nakhana.

Kh'o tsetsvalakh', tsetsvokkkhush du tseran deshnash: "Tkhokh latta khilcha, kerlachu kkhollarna chokh' khir du tkho (iukha a denlur du tkho)?" U'sh bu shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna kerstanalla dinarsh, tseran logekh /tesna k'ematdiinakh'/ g1o'mash (burzhalsh) khir du, u'sh /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai bu, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttar bu.

Kh'o sikhvesh vu tsara vochu'ntsadikachul kh'alkha. Tsaral kh'alkha a dIadakhna masale taIzarsh. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg Shegakh' nakhana gechdar dolush vu, tseran zulamashka a tsa kh'o'zhush. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg chIogIanig a vu bekkhamtsa.
Tsateshachara olu: "Shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara tskh'a delil dossiinekh'ara tsu'nga!" Kh'o dIakhou'iturg vu. KhIor k'oman kh'ekhamkho vu.
Dalla kha'a khIor stechu diinato /kiirakh'/ lelorg, beran tsIiinan gatdalar a, shordalar a. Masso a khIuma Tsunna gergakh' /shen/ baramtsa du.
Kh'ulamekh' derg a, guchokh' derg a khuush verg a, vokkkha verg a, lakkhava'llarg a vu Iza.
/Tsu Dalla/ tskh'abossa vu shukh dosh k'ailada'kkkhinarg a, i guchokh' ditinarg a, sha busa kh'ullush verg a, diinakh' dIasalelash verg a.

Tsunna (adamna) kh'alkhakhula a, tIekh'akhula a tsu'ntsa tskh'a'na d1asalelash dershdu, sha'sh i Ialashvesh Delan omratsa. Bakk'alla a, Dala nakhakh dolchukh khIumma a tsa khu'itsu, tsara sha'sh shaikh derg khiitstsalts. Dalla nakhana vonig li'cha, tsunna dukhatokhar dats, I votsurg urkhalchama vats tsarna.
I vu shuna kkheramtsii, dogdakhartsii tk'es goitush verg, Tso kkhiaio eza markhash.

Tsunna khastam bartsa tasbikh' do stigal k'ovk'aro. Malikasha a /do Dalla tasbikh'/ Tsunakh kkherartsa. Stelakha'shtigash o'khu'itu Tso, u'sh Shena luuchunna tIetukhu, u'sh Delan kh'ok'ekh' k'u'isush a bolush. Iza - nitsk'atsa chIogIanig vu.

Tsu'nga du bak'dolchun kkhaikkhar. I votschu'nga kkhoikkhush bersh - tskh'anna a khIumantsa tsarna zhop lur dats tsara, u'sh tera bu khi tIe genara ku'igash kkhovdinchukh i shen baga kkhachiita - tk'a iza tsa kkhochu tsu'nga. Tsateshacheran /shain delashka/ kkhaikkhar ma dats tilar chokh' ben.
Dalla suzhud desh vu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel verg, luush a, tsa luush a. Tseran IindagIash a /du Tsunna suzhud desh/ Iu'iranna a, su'iranna a.

Ala /khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Mila vu stigaliin a, la'ttan a Ela?" Ala: "Dela vu". Ala: "Tk'a, Iza a vu'tii, /Iibadat dan kkhin/ nak'ostii lo'tsu ash, shain dogImashna a paida a, ia zen shaigakh' dotsu?" Ala: "Tskh'aterra vui tk'a bIa'rzenig a, bIa'rsaderg a, ia tskh'aterra dui tk'a bodanash a, nur a?" Ia tsara Dalla nak'ostii khiliitina, sha'sh /khalk'/ kkho'llina, Tso kkhollarkh terra - tsarna i khalk'akh tardella? Akh' ala: "Masso a khIumanan kkhollarkhovu Dela. I sha tskh'a' verg a, nitsk' alssam berg a vu".

Tso dossiina stiglara khi- Iovrash ikhira khershanashkakhula shain baramekh', Iovrasha d1aia'kh'ira aiiella chopa. Tsara tsIergakh' khazallash ia kkhin khIumanash esh iagaechukh a chopa iu tsunakh terra. Ishtta dalado Dala bak'dolchun a, khartsdolchun a masal.Chopa erna dIagIo, tk'a nakhana paida besh derg la'ttakh' du'su. Ishtta dalado Dala masalsh.

Shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna zhop dellacharna khazanig du - (ialsamani). Tsunna zhop tsadellacharna la'ttakh' mel derg khilcha a, tsu'ntsa kkhin tsul a, i tsunakh (Delan Iazapakh kIelkh'ardovla) dIalur ma dara tsara. Ma von kh'esap du-kkh tsarna! Tseran chugIoila zho'zhakhati iu. Von (dIavu'zhu) mott bu i!
Tk'a kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara kh'o'ga dossinarg bak'derg duila khuush verg bIa'rsa dotsuchukh tera vu? Bakk'alla a, dagadou'itu kh'ek'al dolchara,
Sha'sh kkhochush'esh bolchara Delan vaIda, tsa bokhosh bolchara bart,
Sha'sh vovshakhtosushbolchara Dala vovshakhtasa a'lla omra dinarg a, shain Delakh kkho'ruchara a, vochu kh'esapakh larluchara a.

Sha'sh sobar dinachara a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun iu'kh' ezash, lamaz khIottiinachara a, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'akh a k'ailakha a, guchakh' a kharzhiinachara, sha'sh vonig dikachu'ntsa dukhatukhush bolchara a,- tsarna iu-kkh dakharantIa'kh'e -
Iadnanboshmash. Tsarna chugIur bu u'sh a, tseran daikh a, zudarekh a, zu'rrietakh a dika Iamal mel iinarg a. Malikash tIedogIur du tsarna masso a neIarekhula /olush/:
"Marsho iu shuna ash sobar darna". Ma dika iu dakharan tIa'kh'e!
Sha'sh Delatsa khilla va1da, i ch1ag1'iinchul t1a'kh'a, iokhosh bolcharna, Dala vovshakhtasa a'llarg khedosh bolcharna, la'ttakh' bo'khanig darzhosh bolcharna - tsarna neIalt du, tsarna von tsIadu.
Dala ritsk' kkhovdado Shena luuchunna /shortta/, baram a bo. Bakkkhiibe u'sh du'nenan dakharkh. Du'nenan dakhar ma dats, ekhartatsa du'sticha, tskh'a khIu'malgben.

Tsateshnachara olu: "Tsu'nga (Mukh'ammade) dossiina khillekh'ara shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara tskh'a delil". Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, Dala tilavala vu'tu Shena luurg, Tso nis ma vo Shena tIe sha virzinarg.
Iiman dillinarsh a, shain degnashna Dela kh'ekhavartsa sintemkhillarsh a /nisbo Dala niisachu novk'a/, tk'a Dela kh'ekhavartsa tsa khu'lu degnashna sintem?
Iiman dillincharna, dika Iamalsh iincharna - zovkkh kh'egar a du, khaza chugIoila a iu".

Ishtta vakhiitira Okha kh'o ummatna iukk'e- tsul kh'alkha a dIadakhara ummatash - akh' tsarna desharkh'ama Okha kh'aiga va'kh'itsa dellarg, u'sh K'inkhetam bolchunna kerstanalla desh a bolush. Akh' ala: "Iza san Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg vu, I votsurg kkhin dela vats, Tsunna tIetevzhina so, Tsu'nga du san toba dar".

K'ur'antsa la'mnash lellekh'ara, ia latta khediinekh'ara, ia tsu'ntsa bellarsh bistkhillekh'ara /iza Delan omra khir dara - tIakkkha a iiman du'llur datsara tsara/. KhIa'. Delan du-kkh gIullakkh derrige a. Tk'a iiman dillincharna (kh1intsa a) tsa kha'a, Dalla laakh'ara, nakh berrige a Tso nisbina khirg khilar? Tsateshachara sha'sh dinarg bakh'anekh' tsarna t1e tsa bussush tsa sotsu bala, ia tseran tsIiinan ullokh' /bussu/ i Delan vaIda iallalts. Bakk'alla a, Dala tsa iokhaio /Shen/ vaIda.
Kh'ol kh'alkha a siisazbina elchanash, As khan ella bitira tsatesharsh, tIakkkha As /Iazaptsa/ skh'aletsira u'sh. Mukha khilira San taIzar?!

Tk'a I Sha khIor sinna tso shena karadinchu'ntsa TIekhIo'ttinarg /tera vu kkhecharakh/? Dalla nak'ostii khiliitina tsara. Akh' ala: "TsIersh iakha tseran! Ia ash Tsu'nga du'itsur du Tsunna la'ttakh' tsakhuurg ia t1ekhula (desa) dolu dosh du /i ash du'itsurg/?" KhIa', khazdina tsateshacharna shain khIilla, /niisachu/ nek'akh ba'khna u'sh. Dala tilavala vitinchunna tskh'a a ba'chcha vats /i nisvalur volush/.
Tsarna du'nenan dakharekh' a Iazap du, tk'a ekhartan Iazap kkhin a khala du. Ma vats tsarna sha'sh Delakh (Tsu'nan Iazapakh) lardan tskh'a a.

/Delakh/ kkho'rucharna vaIda iina iolchu /shen gIalaniin/ bukhakhula khish o'khush iolchu beshansurt du: tsu'nan daar guttar a du, tsu'nan IindagIa a /guttar du/. I du /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillacharna khinderg. Tsateshacharna khin'erg /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu!

Okha shaiga zhaina dellarsh bakkhiibesh bu kh'o'ga dossiinachukh. (Kh'una du'kh'alievllachu mushrikekh a, zhu'gtekh a la'ttash khillachu) tobanekh iu tsu'nan (K'ur'anan) tskh'adolchunna inkarlo esh erg a. Akh' ala: "Suna omra dina as Dalla Iibadat dan a, Tsu'ntsa nak'ost tsa latsa a. As Tsu'nga kkhoikkhu, Tsu'nga du san dIaverzar a".
Ishtta dossiira Okha i (K'ur'an) Ia'rbiin /mattakh'/ kh'ukma khilla. Kh'o tseran dezarshna tIa'kh'akhIottakh' kh'aiga Iilma de'nachul tIa'kh'a - Delekh'ara valia vats kh'una, lardarkho a vats.
Kh'ol kh'alkha a elchanash bakhiitira Okha, tsarna zudarii a, zurriet a khiliitira Okha. /Tarlur/ datsara tskh'anna elchanna aiat daiita Delan purbantsa a ben. KhIor khanna a shen zhaina du.
Dala Shena luurg doi'u, /Shena luurg/ chIagI a do. Tsu'ngakh' zhainin nanaiu.

Ia Okha gaitaza du'tur du kh'o'ga Okha tsarna vaIda iinchukh tskh'adersh, ia Okha kh'o volu'itur vu /u'sh tsa goitush/ - kh'una tIekh' /kh'aiga Dala dellarg nakhe/ dIakhaiitar du, Tkhuna tIekh' kh'esap dar du.

Tsarnatsa go-te Okha Latta zhim-zhimma eshosh khilar shen iistashkara /busalbanasha mushrikiin mekhkash skh'abokhush shainacharekh tukhush/? Dala do kh'ukma, Tsu'nan kh'ukmanna novk'arlo en erg ma vats. I vu kh'esapekh' sikha verg.

Tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a mekarlo iira, Delekh' iu mekarlo errige a /nekhan mekarlonash iokho nitsk'/. Tsunna kha'a khIor sinna karadesh derg. TIakkkha khuur du kerstanashna, kh'anna kkhochur iu /ekhartakh' khir iolu khastame/ kh1usam.
Tsateshachara olu: "Kh'o vaiitinarg vats ( kh'o elcha vats)", akh' ala: "Kkhachame du Dela tesh khilar a suna a, shuna a iukk'ekh', shegakh' zhainin Iilmaderg a".

Alif-lam-ra.Zhaina du /khIara/, Okha sha kh'o'ga dossiina dolu, kh'o'ga nakh bodanashkara serlonga arabakhiitarkh'ama shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun purbantsa, Sha veza volchun, Sha khastame volchun novk'a,
Delan /novk'a/, stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg Shen dolchu. Bala bu-kkh tsateshacharna chIogIachuIazapakh.
Ishttanash bu u'sh shaina du'nenan dakhar ekhartal t1ekh dukkha dezash, Delan nek'akh /nakh/ dIato'ttush, i gamban gIertash, - u'sh genarchu tilar chokh' ma bu.

Okha tsa vaiitina tskh'a a elcha shen k'oman mattakh' ben tsu'nga tsarna bilgaldakkkhiitarkh'ama. Shena luurg tilavala vu'tu Dala, Shena luurg niisachu novk'a vu'llu. I veza verg a, kh'ukma /niisa desh/ verg a vu.

Okha Musa vakhiitira Tkheshan aiatashtsa: "Aradakkkha kh'ain k'am bodanashkara serlonga, dagadaiita tsarna Delan /niImat shaina dukkha khilla/ denosh",-a'lla. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash du khIor t1ekh sobare volchunna a, barkalla olush volchunna a.

Kh'akhade: Musas a'llera shen k'ome: "Ash dagadaiita shaina khilla Delan niImat! Tso kIelkh'ardekhira shu FirIavnan do'zalkh, bo'kha Iazap shuna tIekh' khIottosh khilla bolchu, shun kIentii boi'ush, shun zudarii diina bu'tush. Tsu chokh' shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara siilakh'-dokkkha zer du shuna".
Dagadaita: shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho dIakkhaikkhira: "Shu barkalle khilcha, As sovdokhur du shu /niImatashkakh'/, ash /San ni1matashna/ kerstadicha, San Iazap chIogIa du!"
Musas elira: " Asha a, la'ttakh' mel volcho a - massara a kerstadakh' a, - bakk'alla a, i Dela kh'al dolush a vu (khIumma o'shush vats), khastame a vu".

Shu'ga tsa kkha'chna shul kh'alkha khillacheran -Nukh'an k'oman, Iadiin, Samudiin a khabar, tsaral tIa'kh'a khillacheran a /khabar/? Dalla a ben tsa kha'a u'sh. Tsa'rga ba'khkira shain elchanash bilgalonashtsa - ku'igash shain baga a dukhkii, tsara olura: "Okha kerstadina shu shetsa daiitinchunna, tkho chIogIachu shekonekh' du ash tkho shena tIekkhoikkhuchukh".

Tseran elchanasha elira: "Tk'a Delekh' /I tskh'a' khilarekh' a, derrig 1ibadat Tsunna darekh' a/ sheko iu, stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llina volchu? Tso kkhoikkhu shu shun k'inosh Sha gechdare, to'khnachu khanna shu tIa'kh'atattare". Tsara elira: "Shu ma dats tkho sanna adamash ben, shuna la'a tkho dIatatta tkhan dai shena Iibadat desh khillachukh, dalade tkhuna bilggala delil".

Tseran elchanasha tsa'rga elira: "Tkho-m shu sanna adamash dara, delakh' a, Dala Shen lekh Shena luuchunna niImat lo. Shuna tskh'a a delil daloila tsa khilla tkhuna Delan purbantsa a ben, Dalla tIetevzhiila mu'min nakh.
Tkho khIunda tsa tevzha Dalla tIe - Tso tkho nis ma dina tkheshan nek'ashna tIe, okha sobar diir ma du ash tkhuna echu khalonashkakh', Dalla tIetevzhiila sha'sh t1etevzhash bersh! "

Tsateshachara elira shain elchanashka: "Okha aradokhur ma du shu tkheshan la'ttara (makhkara) ia shu t1edo'rzur ma du tkhan dinna ". Tsa'rga /paikhamarshka/ tseran Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho va'kh'itsa khaiitira: "KhIallakbiir ma bu Okha zulamkhoi,
Okha dakha khovshor ma du shu /paikhamarsh a, tsarna t1a'kh'aba'znarsh a/ la'ttakh' tsaral tIa'kh'a, iza du Suna kh'alkha sha d1akhIottarkh kkho'rush volchunna a, San taIzarkh kkho'rush volchunna a".
Tsaratolam biikhira - iishira masso a iukhakh'arava'lla Iazapkho.
Tsu'nan tIekh'akhula zho'zhakhati iu, natk'aran khi malor du tsunna.
Tso k'urdash biir bu tsunakh, amma i khalla ben kiira dakhiitalur dats tsu'nga - masso a ag1ora tsunna tIe valar dogIu, i vala tsa le, tsunna tIekh'akhula lu'ra Iazap du.

Shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchukh tsateshnacheran masal du: tseran Iamalsh ch1og1a mokh ba'llachu diinakh' tsu makho barzhiinachu chimakh tera iu. Shaina karadeanchu khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush bats u'sh. Iza du-kkh genara tilar!
Kh'una tsa khi'na Dala stiglanash a, latta a bak'ontsa kkho'llina khilar? Shena li'cha, Tso shu dIa a dokhur du, kerla khalk' dalor du.
Dalla deza a (khala khIuma a) dats i.

Dalla guchubevr bu berrige a /k'ematdiinakh'/. Ledara khillachara er du kura khillacha'rga: "Bakk'alla a, tkho dara /du'nenakh'/ shuna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush. Shu'ga d1aiakkkhaloi tkhuna tIera Delan Iazapakh khIumma a?" Tsara er du: "Dala tkho nisdinekh'ara - okha shu a nisdina khir dara. Tkhuna tskh'aterra du: tkha'sh sintem baina kh'iizicha a, ia tkha'sh sobar desh Iiicha a, - tkhuna kIelkh'ardovlar dats".

ShaitIano er du /k'ematdiinakh'/, gIullakkh kkhochush khilcha: "Bakk'alla a, Dala iinera shu'tsa bak' vaIda, asa a vaIda iinera shu'tsa - as teshnabekhk bina shuna. Shuna tIekh' tskh'a a kh'a'kamalla ma datsara san, as shu'ga kkhaikkhar ben - ash suna zhop delira. Suna bekhkash ma bakhka - shaina bekhkash bakhka. San shuna dan gIo a dats, shun suna dan gIo a dats. As kerstdina ash so kh'alkha nak'ost la'tsna khilar". Bakk'alla a, zulamkhoi - tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap khir ma du.

Teshash khillarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a chubakhiitina khir bu /ialsamanin/ boshmashka, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, sha'sh guttar tsu chokh' khir bolush shain Delan purbantsa. Tseran marshalla tsu chokh' "Salam" du.
Kh'una tsa khi'na, mukha masal daliina Dala khazchu dashtsa? I khazchu dittakh tera du: tsu'nan oram chIogIa bu, tsu'nan ga stiglakh' du.
Shen daarlo tso masso a khenakh' shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun purbantsa. Dala masalsh dalado nakhana - tsara oila iiir iatsara-te!
Bo'khachu deshan masal - bo'khachu dittakh tera du, sha skh'ada'kkkhina dolchu /oramashtsa/ la'tta tIera - chIagIo iats tsu'nan.
Dala chIagIbo iiman dillinarsh /Dela tskh'a'varan/ chIogIachu dashtsa du'nenan dakharekh' a, ekhartakh' a. Dala tilabala bu'tu zulamkhoi. Dala do Shena lu'urg.
Kh'o tsa kh'a'zhna /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ sha'sh Delan niImat kerstanallakh khiitsincha'rga? Tsara okh'akhai shain khalk' khIallakkhilaran ts1a chu,
Zho'zhakhati chu, shena chokh' u'sh bogur bolu? Ma von iu-kkhu'sh kkhochu bolu mettig!
Dalla nak'ostii khiliitira tsara Tsu'nan nek'akh /nakh/ tilorkh'ama. Akh' ala: "Zovkkh kh'ega shaina - shun dIadakhar /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIerga du".

Akh' ala San iiman dillinchu leshka: lamaz khIottadoila tsara, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh k'ailakh a, guchokh' a /dikchu ag1or/ kharzhash ioila /Delan novk'akh'/ shena chokh' iokhka-etsar a, dottagIalla a dotsu /k'emat/de dale kh'alkha.

Dela vu Sha kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a. Tso daiitina stiglara khi, tsu'ntsa kkhiira Tso tskh'adolu sto'mash shuna ritsk' khiliita. Shuna mu'tIakh' dinaTso kemanash leliita khIorda chokh' Shen omratsa, shuna mu'tIakh' dina Tso khish.
Tso mu'tIakh' bina shuna malkh a, butt a, i shii a, khaddaza (shain nek'ashkakhula lelash) bolush. Tso mu'tIakh' dina shuna bu'isa a, de a.
Ash Shega dekhnachukh derrige a della Tso shuna. Delan niImatash ash dagardakh' - dagardalur dats u'sh shuna. Bakk'alla a, adam t1ekh zulame a, barkalla tsa olush a ma du.
Kh'akhade: IbrakhIima ma a'llera: "So Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, Akh' khiliitalakh' khIara mokhk ma'rsha, Akh' genavakkkhalakh' so a, san k1entii a okha zha1arshna 1ibadat darkh.
So Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, bakk'alla a, tsara tila ma bina nakhakh dukkhabersh. Suna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg - sokh vu, suna Iesa khillarg, - bakk'alla a, Kh'o gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu-kkh.

Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg! As dakha khaii san zu'rietakhtskh'abersh ialta dotschu arengakh' Kh'an siilakh' dolchu tsIiina ullokh' tsara tsigakh', tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, lamaz khIottorkh'ama. Tskh'abolchu nekhan degnash tsarna t1etevzhash khiliitalakh', sto'mekh ritsk' lolakh' tsarna - tsara barkalla ala tarlora.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg! Kh'o khuush vu-kkh okha k'ailadokkkhurg a, okha guchudokkkhurg a. Delakh k'ailaer iats khIumma la'ttakh' a, stiglakh' a.
Dalla bu khastam, suna vokkkhallekh' IsmaIil a, Iskh'ak' a vellachu! Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg doIa khezash verg vu-kkh.
San Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, sokh khiliitalakh' lamaz khIottosh verg, san zu'rietakh a /khiliitalakh' dika Iamalsh esh bersh/. Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, san doIa k'obaldelakh'.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, gechdelakh' suna a, san dena-nannaa, mu'min nakhana a kh'esap khIuttur dolchu /k'emat/ diinakh'".
Kh'una ma mottalakh' Dela gIopal vu zulamkhosha dechukh. Tso tIa'kh'atottush bu u'sh /1azap tsa desh/ shena chokh' bIa'rgash k'a'rzarbolchu /k'emat/ diine.
Sikha gIur bu u'shshain kortosh aibina, shain bIa'rakh'azhar iukhado'rzur dats tsa'rga, tseran degnash dassadella khir du/Delan 1azapakh ch1og1a kkherabella/.

Akh' kkheram tasa nakhana shaiga Iazap dogIur dolchu diinatsa, sha'sh zulam dinachara erig khilar: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, tIa'kh'atattakh' tkho iotstsachu khanna - Kh'an kkhaikkhamna zhop lur dara okha, elchanashna a tIa'kh'akhIu'ttur dara tkho". Tk'a shu datsara kh'alkha duinash buush shaina daina dIadovlar dats, bokhush?
Shu okh'akhevshira sha'sh shaina zulamash dinacheran gIishloshkakh', shuna guchudelira, khIun dina Okha tsarna, shuna masalsh daliira Okha.
Shain mekarlo iira tsara. Dalla gergakh' iu tseran /mekarlo iokho/ mekarlo, i tseran mekarlo khillekh' a shetsa la'mnash dokhosh. VAKhITA
Kh'una tsk'a a ma mottalakh', Dela Shen elchanashtsa iolu vaIda iokhor iolush vu, alii. Bakk'alla a, Dela veza verg a vu, bekkham Shegakh' berg a vu.
Otsu diinakh' latta khiitsor du kkhechu la'ttatsa, stiglanash a /khiitsor iu kkhecha'rtsa/ - u'sh tskh'a' volchu, t1ekh nu'tsk'ala volchu Dalla kh'alkha dIakhIuttur bu.
Kh'una gur bu otsu diinakh' k'inosh dinarsh zIenashtsa (z1ainashtsa) d1abikhkina.
Tseran bedarsh silamakh /khir iu/, tseran iakhkh'ash tsIero dIakh'uliiir iu.
Dala bekkham barkh'ama khIor sinna sha karadiinachu'ntsa. Bakk'alla a, Dela kh'esap darekh' sikha verg ma vu.
KhIara khaam bu nakhana, tsu'ntsa tsarna kkheram tasarkh'ama a, tsarna khaarkh'ama a Iza khilar tskh'a Dela, kh'ek'aldolcha'rga oilaiaitarkh'ama a.
Alif-lam-ra. U'sh /Delan/ zhainin a, k'eginchu K'ur'anan a aiatash du.
Ma luur du tsateshnacharna sha'sh busalbanash khilla belkh'ara a'lla.
Bita u'sh /khIuma/ iaa a, zovkkh kh'ega a, /dakhare/ dogdakharo iimanakh iuk'akhbakha a. TIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna.
Tskh'a a iurt khIallak iina ma iats Okha tsunna /khIallak'ian/ kh'alkhkhe to'khna bilgala khan iolush ben.
Tskh'a a ummatshena /to'khnachu/ khenal kh'alkhader ma dats, tIa'kh'adu'sur a ma dats.
Tsara elira: "KhIai kh'aiga dagadaiitar dossosh khillarg! Kh'o zhinekhma vu!
Malikash khIunda tsa dalado akh' tkhuna, kh'uo bak'lu'icharakh khillekh'?"
Malikash tsa dissado Okha bak'dolchu'ntsa ben, tIakkkha u'sh /tsateshash bersh Iazapakh/ tIa'akh'atettinarsh khir bats.
Okha bossiina i kh'ekham (K'ur'an). Okha i Ialashbiir a bu.
Kh'ol kh'alkha a bakhiitina Okha kh'alkhalerachiin tobanashkakh' /elchanash/.
Tskh'a a elcha tsa veana tsa'rga, tsara iza siisazvesh ben.
Ishtta du'llu Okha izak'inosh desh bolcheran degnashka.
Tsunakh tsa tesha u'sh. Ishtta dIadakhna kh'alkhalerachiin Iadat a.
Okha tsarna stiglara neI ellekh'ara, u'sh bu'sush tsu chukhula kh'alabovlush,
Tsara er ma dara: "Tkhan bIa'rsa dakhiina, tkho shaina bozbuunchalla dina nakh du".
Stiglakh' gIalanashiina Okha, u'sh khaziina Okha kh'o'zhucharna.
Masso a tIulgashtsa ekkkhoshdolchu shaitIanakh i1alash a iina Okha.
Sha k'ailakh ladugIush dotsuchukh - tsunna a tIa'kh'abolu bilgal bolu seda.
Latta a darzhiina Okha, tsunna t1ekh' chIogIa la'mnash a do'g1na, tsunna t1ekh' daliitina Okha khIor baram binchu khIumanakh.
Okha tsunna t1ekh'bakham khiliitina shuna a, ash shaina ritsk' tsa lush khillacharna a /akkkharoi, olkhazarsh.../
Tskh'a a khIuma iats Tkho'gakh' shen khazna iolush ben, Okha i okh'a tsa iossaio khuush bolchu baramtsa a ben.
Okha dakhiitina ialta kh'o'k'u'itu mekhash, stiglara khi dossiina Okha - i maliina Okha shuna - shu dats i /dIadillina/ lattosh.
Bakk'alla a, Okha den a do, Okha dala a dolu'itu, Tkho du verasash.
Shukh kh'alkha d1abevllarsha bevzina Tkhuna, tIa'kh'abu'subersh a bevzina.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg - I vu-kkh u'sh gulbiir bolush. Bakk'alla a, Iza kh'ukameverg a /Shen gIullakkh darekh'/, khuush verg a vu /Shen khalk'ekh' derg/.
Okha adam kkho'llira bek'achu (zevnechu), t1edachu popparkh, (bastsa a, kh'ozhantsa a) khiitsaluchu.
Zhinashkkho'llira Okha kkhin a /Adamal/ kh'alkha t1ekh iovkhachu tsIarakh.
Khaiita: kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho malikashka a'llera: "So vollu adam kkholla bek'achu (zevnechu), t1edachu popparkh, (bastsa a, kh'ozhantsa a) khiitsaluchu.
As i nisdicha, Sain sikh tsunna chu sa a dillicha, shu iegalash tsunna suzhude".
Malikasha massara a suzhud dira.
Iblis dotscho - i du'kh'aldelira suzhud decha'rtsa khila.
Tso (Dala) elira: "Kh1ai Iblis, kh'una khIun du suzhud decha'rtsa tsa khila?"
Tso (Ibliso) elira: "So khila tsa dog1u adamna suzhud desh, Akh' sha kkho'llina dolchu bek'achu (zevnechu), t1edachu popparkh, (bastsa a, kh'ozhantsa a) khiitsaluchu>>.
Tso (Dala) elira: "Aradala tsu /ialsamanin/ chu'ra! Kh'o tIulgash dettash ekkkho dezargdu.
Kh'una tIekh' neIalt du bekkhaman dekkhachchalts".
Tso (Ibliso) elira: "San Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, tIa'kh'atattaso u'sh denbiir bolchu diine kkhachchalts".
Tso (Dala) elira: "Bakk'alla a, kh'o (dalarkh) tIa'kh'atettincharakh du.
Khuush iolchu khenan detIekkhachchalts".
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, Akh' so tilorna, as khazdiir ma du tsarna (Adaman t1a'kh'enna) la'ttakh' derg /k'inosh dar/, as tilor ma bu u'sh berrige a
Tsarakh Kh'an k'astiina lesh botsursh".
Tso (Dala) elira: "KhIara bu Suna tIebog1u niisa nek'.
Bakk'alla a, San lesh - tsarna tIekh' bak'o iats kh'an! Tilabellacharakh kh'aina tIa'kh'akhIittincharna tIekh' ben.
Bakk'alla a, zho'zhakhati iu-kkh tsarna massarna khin iolu (k'astiina) mettig.
Tsu'nan vorkhI neI iu, khIor neIarna tsarakhk'astiina dak'a du / chu bakha/.
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh - boshmashkakh' a, shovdanashkakh' a khir bu".
"ChugIo tsu (ialsamane) chu salamtsa, kkheram botsush!"
Tseran degnashkakh' iolu k'izalla dIaia'kkkhira Okha, vezharii khilla, mettanashna tIekh' vovshashna du'kh'-du'kh'al birzina /khir bu u'sh/.
Tsarakh kh'akkhalur iats tsu chokh' khalo, u'sh tsu chu'ra ara a bokhur bats.
D1akhaiita San leshka: "Bakk'alla a, So t1ekh gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetam biirig a vu.
San Iazap - iza lazosh dolu Iazap du".
Diitsa tsarna IbrakhIiman kh'eshakh /la'tsna/:
I volchu ba'khkira u'sh, elira: "Marshalla". Tso (IbrakhIima) elira: "Bakk'alla a, tkho shukh kkho'rush du".
Tsara elira: "Ma kkhera. Okha kh'una kkha' bokkkhu kkhetame khir volchu kIantatsa".
Tso elira: "Ash suna kkha' ba'kkkhina, so k'anallo skh'ala'tscha? Stentsa kkha' bokkkhu ash?"
Tsara elira: "Bak'dolchu'ntsa kkha' ba'kkkhina Okha kh'o'ga, dogdillincharakh ma khilalakh'".
Tso elira: "Mu'lsh bu tk'a shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun k'inkhetamakh dog du'llu bersh, sha'sh tilabellarshben? "
Elira /IbrakhIima malikashka/: "KhIun du shun gIullakkh, khIai dakhkiitinarsh? (Kh1un g1ullakkh dakh'ash dakhkiitina shu Dala?"
Tsara elira: "Tkho dakhkiitina k'inosh dechu nakhana tIe /tsarna 1azap dan/,
LutIan do'zal botsurg - u'sh berrige a Okha k1elkh'arbokhur bolush bu,
Tsu'nan tskh'a zuda iotsurg. Okha kkhiel iina: i bukhabu'sucharakh(kh1allakben bolcharakh khir) iu".
I bakhkiitinarsh LutIan nakhana (Lut1 paikhamarna) tIe ba'khkicha,
Tso (LutIas) elira: "Bakk'alla a, shu (suna) tsa devza nakh du-kkh".
Tsara elira: "Amma, tkho kh'o volchu da'khkina u'shshain sheko khillachu'ntsa.
Tkho da'khkina kh'o volchu bak'dolchu'ntsa - bakk'alla a, tkho bak'lu'ish dersh ma du.

DIagIuo kh'ain do'zaltsa bu'isanakh tskh'a dak'a da'lcha, kh'o a gIuo tsarna tIa'khkh'e. Tskh'a a iukha ma kh'ozhiila shukh /zulamkhoshna den dolu 1azap shaina tsa garkh'ama i ginchunna a shena i tsa khiliitarkh'ama/, shaiga omra dinchudIagIuo".
I gIullakkh (Tkheshan kkhiel) tsunna (Lut1ina) d1akhaiitira Okha: khIokkheran tIa'kh'e khador iolush iu Iu'irenga bovlartsa (u'sh berrige a kh1allakbiir bolush bu 1u'iranna).
GIalara nakh ba'khkira bakkkhiibesh.
Tso (LutIas) elira: "KhIorsh san kh'eshii bu, so siisaza ma velash.
Delakh kkheralash, so iu'kh'Ia'rzha ma khIottavelash".
Tsara elira:"Okha bekhkam bina batsara kh'una masso a nakhakh /khiira nakh t1e ma latsa, a'lla?".
Tso elira: "Kh1orsh san io1arii bu shuna, shu /bo'khanig/ tsa desh tsa Iakh' /u'sh balabeish shaina, san kh'eshii a bitii".
Kh'an dakharora /khIai paikhamar/, bakk'alla a, u'sh shain bekhna khilarekh' dIai-skh'ai u'idush ma bu.
Malkh kkhetash, tsIogIano skh'aletsira u'sh (ch1og1achu g1ovg1ano kh1allakbira u'sh).
Tsu'nan lakkhenakh lakhe iiraOkha, tsarna tIe dagiinachu la'ttan tIulgash /dog1a sanna/ delkhiitira Okha.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash ma du, oila esh, kh'o'zhucharna.
Bakk'alla a, ima iu /niissa Makkara Shama bo'duchu/ novk'akh'.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' (Lut1in k'am kh1allakdarekh') delil ma du mu'min nakhana.
Aikatanbakharkhoi ma khilira zulamkhoi.
Tsarna bekkham bira Okha, bakk'alla a, i shi'bilgalchu mettigekh' ma iu.
Kh'izhranbakharkhosha a kharts ma bira elchanash.
Okha Tkheshan aiatash daliira tsarna, tk'a u'sh tsarakh dIabo'rzush khu'lura.
U'sh khilla, la'mnashch ogush, tsIenosh desh, sha'sh kkheramazallekh' a bolush /tsarna chokh' bakha/.
Ts1og1ano skh'aletsira u'sh, Iu'irenga bovlush.
Shaina karadesh khillacho u'sh k1elkh'ara tsa bekhira /Delan 1azapakh/.
Okha tsa kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, tsarna iukk'ekh' mel derg a bak'dolchu'ntsa ben. Sakh't/sheko iotstsush/ dogIur dolush du. Kh'o khazachu kepara k'int1eravalalakh' /tsarna/.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg vukhuush volu /derrige a/ kkhollarkho.
Okha delira kh'o'ga kest-kesta dalocharakh vorkhI/aiat/ a, siilakh'-deza dolu K'ur'an a.
Kh'ain bIa'rgash ma kh'ezhabe Okha tsarakh (kerista nakhakh) taip-taipana bolcharna dellachu ni1matashka, tsarna tIekh' sa a ma gatta de, kh'ain /k'inkhetaman/ tIam t1etovzhabe mu'min nakhana.
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, so bilggal volu kkheramchavu".
Okha /kho'ga/ dossiina /K'ur'an, khIai Mukh'ammad, zhainash dissorakh/ terra /din/ do'k'ucha'rga.
Ishttanash bu u'sh sha'sh Desharkh (K'ur'anakh) dak'osh dina bolu.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu Delora, Okha khattaza du'tur ma dats tsa'rga massa'rga a
Tsara sha'sh desh khillachukh.
DIakkhaikkhade /khozu'itush/ kh'aiga omra dinarg, /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsucharakh dIaverza.
Bakk'alla a, Okha k1elkh'arva'kkkhira kh'o /kh'okh/ kkha'rdacharakh,
Sha'sh Delatsa kkhin dela a khu'lu'itush bolchu. Kesta khuur du tsarna /sha'sh desh khillachun zham1/.
Tkho khuush du kh'an dog 1a'vdash khilar tsara /mushrikunasha kh'an dinakh la'tsna/ du'itsuchukh.
Tasbikh' de kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna khastambartsa, suzhud decharakh khila.
Kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna Iibadat de kh'aiga bak'derg kkhachchalts.
Delan omra kkha'chna (gergadeana k'ematde khIottar), i sikhdar ma lekhalash. Vonakh tsIena vu Iza, lakkhaveli Iza tsara /Shetsa/ nak'ost latsarkh.
Malikash dissado Tso sitsaShegara omratsa Shen lekh Shena luuchu'nga "Ash dIakh'ede: So votsurg kkhin dela tsakhilar, Sokh kkheralash",-olii.
Tso kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a bak'dolchu'ntsa. Lakkhaveli I tsara /Shetsa/ nak'ost latsarkh.
Adam kkho'llina Tso tIadamakh, tk'a iza bilggal mostagI vu-kkh (kersta, Dalla inkarlo esh volu).
Da'khni a - Tso kkho'llina iza. Tsu'ntsa shuna iovkho a iu (, paidanash a bu, tsarakh ash dou.?
Shuna tsa'rgakh' khazalla iu, ash/u'sh/ chulokhkuchu khenakh' a, ashdazha aradokhush a.
Shun makhkh'ash dIakkho'kh'u tsara (da'khnino) shu chIogIa khala a ben d1akkhochur dotschu makhka (mettigashka). Bakk'alla a, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg /shukh/ dog lozush a vu, k'inkhetame a vu.
Govrash a, bIa'rzanash a, varrash a shu shaina tIekh' leliita a, khazallina a iu. Tso kkhullu shuna tsa khuurg a.
Dalla tIekh' du /adam / niisachu novk'a kh'azhor, tsunakh (nek'akh) bu /bak'dolchukh/ dIaverzosh berg a. Shena li'nekh'ara, shu derrige a niisachu novk'a nisdina khir dara Tso.

I vu Sha stiglara khi (dog1a) daiitinarg, shuna tsunakh (khikh) malar a du (ash molush dolu khi), tsunakh ash shen chokh' bezhnash dazhosh dolu butsa iu (dog1antsa Dala iolu'itu buts shun bezhnash dazhiita).

Tsu'ntsa Tso shuna skh'adolu'itu ialta a, zait-dittash a, khurmanash a, kemsash a, masso a taipa sto'mash a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' Dela /tskh'a' khilaran a, nitsk' bolush khilaran a / delil ma du oila echu nakhana.
Shuna mu'tIakh' dina Tso bu'isa a, de a, malkh a, butt a. Sedarchii a /shuna busa nek' goitush/ mu'tIakh' dina Tsu'nan omratsa. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash ma du kh'ek'ale bolchu nakhana.
Tso shuna la'ttakh' taip-taipanan besashkakh' kkhiiina khIumanash (diinatash, oramatash...) /mu'tIakh' iina shuna/. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil du-kkh dagadoitush bolchu nakhana.

I vu /shuna/ mu'tIakh' binarg khIord shu'ga tsu chu'ra kerla zhizhig (ch1erii...) daiita, shu'ga tsu chu'ra ash sha'sh tIeukhkush dolu zhovkhIarsh dakhiita. Kh'una go kemanash d1asalelash tsu chukhula, Tsu'nan koma'rshallikh /khIumanash/ shu'ga lakhiita (kh1ordan ni1matash a, iokhka-etsar lelorna a), shu barkalla olush khiliita a.
La'tta t1ekh' la'mnash do'g1na Tso, iza shu'tsa tskh'a'na tsa lestiitarkh'ama, khish a, nek'ash a /khiliitira/, - shu nislur datsara-te niisachu novk'a (shaina Ialashonashna tIe).
(Kkhidolu) Ialamatash a /kkho'llina Tso shuna nek'ash bilgaldakha/, tk'a sedantsa (sedarchashtsa) tsarna karabo niisa nek' /busa sha'sh d1abakha bezachu mettige/.
Sha kkhullurg tsakkhulluchukh tera vu-te? Ash oila tsa io-te?
Ash Delan niImat dagardakh' - kh'esap dalur dats shu'ga tsu'nan. Bakk'alla a, Dela t1ekh gechdesh verg a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Dalla kha'a ash k'ailadokkkhurg a, ash dIakh'ediirig a.
Dela a vitina, tsara shaiga kkhoikkhush bersh - tsara khIumma a tsa kkhullu, u'sh sha'sh a kkhullush bu.
Bella bu u'sh, diina botsush. Tsarna tsa kha'a, matsa denbiir bu u'sh (shaina 1ibadat desh khillarsh).
Shun dela Sha tskh'a' volu Dela vu (Shena 1ibadat dan masso a kh'ak' volu). Sha'sh ekhartakh tsa teshash bersh - tseran degnash inkarlo esh du, sha'sh kurabevlla a bu u'sh (bak'derg t1e tsa lotsush).
Sheko iotstsush, Dalla ma kha'a ash k'ailadokkkhurg a, ash dIakh'ediirig a. Bakk'alla a, Tsunna tsa beza kurabevlarsh.
Tsa'rga (mushrikashka) a'lcha: "KhIun dossiina shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho?", tsara olu: "Kh'alkhalerachiin (kh'alkha ba'khnachu nekhan) tu'iranash ".
Tsara dIakh'oila shain /k'inoin/ mokh' kkhochchush k'ematdiinakh', tskh'a a khaar dotsush sha'sh tiliinacheran mokh' a. Von tsa khili tsara dIakh'osh erg!? /Khili!/

Tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a mekarlo iira - dIaia'kkkhira Dala tseran gIishlo (tseran mekarlo) bakhkhashkara du'ina, tkhov tIebu'izhira tsarna tIekhula. Tso Iazap daiitira tsarna shaina tsa khaaluchukhula.

TIakkkha k'ematdiinakh' Tso siisazbiir bu u'sh, er a du (tsa'rga): "Michakh' bu San "nak'ostii" (ash So'tsa nisbesh khilla bolu kharts delanash), sha'sh bakh'anekh' ash /bak'dolchu'ntsa/ k'u'isush khilla bolu?" Shaina Iilma dellachara er: "Bakk'alla a, takhana siisazalla a, von a du-kkh kerstanashna,

Malikasha bolu'itush (shain sinosh skh'ao'tsush) bolu sha'sh shaina zulam dechu kh'olekh'". TIakkkha /shain sinosh skh'ao'tsuchu khenakh'/ mu'tIakh' khilira u'sh: "Tkho datsara vonig desh". KhIa'! Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush verg vu ash desh khillarg.
"Zho'zhakhati chu gIuo neIarshkakhula, daima a tsu chokh' du'sush. Ma von iu-kkh kurabevllacheran chugIoila".

/Delakh/ kkhiirincha'rga elira: "KhIun dossiina shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho?", tsara elira: "Dikanig". Dikanig dinacharna khIokkhu du'nenakh' a dikanig du, ekhartan kh1usam to'lush iu. Ma dika iu-kkh /Delakh/ kkho'rucheran kh1usam!
Shainabukhakhula khish o'khush iolu Iadnanboshmash - tsarna chu gIur bu u'sh. Tsarna tsu chokh' shaina (mel) eznarg khir iu. Ishtta ial lo Dala /Shekh/ kkho'rucharna.

Sha'sh malikasha (sinosh o'tsush), (k'inoikh) tsIena a bolush, bolu'itush bolchu (Delakh kkho'rush khilachu mu'min nakhe), olu: "Marshalla du shu'ga! Chu gIuo ialsamanina sha'sh /dika/ Iamal esh khilarna".

U'sh (kerstanash) kh'ovsush bu-te shaiga (sinosh ietsa) malikash dakhkare, ia kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun (shaina 1azap dan) omra dare? Ishtta dira kh'una tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a. Dala zulam tsa dira tsarna, delakh' a, sha'sh shaina zulam desh khilira u'sh.
Sha'sh dina vonash (bekkham khilla) shaikh dakhara tsarakh, sha'sh tsa deshash khillarg shaikh dakhara tsarakh.

/Delatsa/ nak'ost la'tsnachara elira: "Dalla li'nekh'ara, I votschu tskh'ana a khIumanna Iibadat dina khir datsara okha - okha a, tkhan daisha a, Tso tsa iinarg, tskh'a a khIuma kh'aram iina khir iatsara okha". Ishtta /kh'ukma/ dora tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a. Elchanashna tIekh' dui tk'a (Dala dellarg nakhe) k'eggina dIakkhachor ben?

KhIor ummate Okha vaiitira elcha, Dalla Iibadat de, tIagIutakhgenadovla, a'lla. Tsarakh (otsu ummatekh) Dala nisbinarsh a bu, tsarakh shaina tIekh' (niisachu nek'akh) d1atilar kkhochushkhillarsh a bu. Lela shu la'ttakhula, kh'ovsa, mukha khilla /Delan tsIena din / khartsdinacheran chakkkhe!
U'sh nisbala kh'una mel ch1og1a li'chi a, Dala nis ma tsa vo Sha tilavala vitinarg. Tsarna (Delan 1azapakh k1elkh'arabakha) gIo'nchii ma bats.
Delakh chIogIa duinash ma bi'na tsara "Denviir vats Dala vellarg",-bokhush. Melkho a, iza bak' khilla iolu vaIda iu-kkh Tsu'ngara! Delakh' a, dukkhakhbolchu nakhana tsa kha'a-kkh;
Bilgaldakkkharkh'ama tsarna shena chokh' tseran khilpalo erg, kerstanashka khaiitarkh'ama sha'sh khartslu'ish dersh duila.
Bakk'alla a, Tkhan dosh du tskh'ana khIumane, Tkhuna i /khila/ li'cha, tsu'nga "Khila!" alar. T1akkkha i khu'lu.
Shaina zulam dinchul tIa'kh'a Delan du'kh'a (kkhechu makhkashka) dIakkhelkhinarsh- Okha u'sh bissor ma bu du'nenakh' a dikachunna tIe, ekhartan ial-m melkho a iokkkha iu, tsarna (i) khuush khillekh'.
U'sh bu sha'sh sobar dinarsh a, shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna tIetevzhinarsh a.
Kh'ol kh'alkha a tsa bakhiitinaOkha bozharii ben, Okha shaiga va'kh'ii a lush. Ash khattal kh'ekham (khaam) shegakh' bolchu okhIlane, sha'sh khillekh' tsa khuush.
Bilgalonashtsa a, zhainashtsaa /bakhkiitira Okha elchanash/. Kh'o'ga bossiina Okha kh'ekham, kh'o'ga nakhana bilgaldakkkhiita a tsa'rga dossosh khillarg (Delan kh'ukmanash), u'sh oila esh khiliita a.
Vochu'ntsa mekarlo iinarsh teshna bu-te Dala sha'sh la'tte d1a tsa khudabaitarkh, ia shaiga Iazap dogIur tsakhilrkh shaina khaa tsa luchukhula?
Ia Tso sha'sh skh'atsalatsarkh shain dIai-skh'ai idarshkakh'? Tsara kIeldu'tur ma dats /Delan gIullakkh/.
Ia Tso sha'sh skh'alotsurg khilarkh,sha'sh kkheramekh' a bolush? Bakk'alla a, shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg /shukh/ dog lozush a vu, k'inkhetame a vu.
U'sh tsa kh'ovsu-te Dala kkho'llichu khIumanashka, shain IindagI Dalla suzhud dartsii a'ttu agIorkh'a a, a'rru agIorkh'a a teIash iolchu, sha'sh /Delan nitsk'ana/ mu'tIakh' iolchu?
Dalla suzhud do stiglanashkakh' mel dolcho a, la'ttakh' mel dolcho a, diinatekh /dolchara a/, malikasha a, sha'sh kuralla a tsa esh.
U'sh kkho'rush du shaina tIekh' volchu shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchukh, desh du shaiga de bokhurg.
/Diitsa tsa'rga, kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ Dala elira: "Ash ma letsa shi dela. Iza tskh'a Dela vu. Sokh (tskh'annakh) kkheralash!
Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Tsu'nan du daima dolu din, tk'a Dela votschukh kkho'ru shu?
Shu'tsa mel dolu niImat Delera du-kkh. TIakkkha sha'sh tskh'ana bokhamo skh'ala'tscha - Tsu'nga do'khu ash mokh' bettash.
TIakkkha Tso i bala shukh dIaba'kkkhicha, shukh /tskh'ana/ tobano shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ntsa nak'ost lotsu
Okha shaina dellachu /niImatna/ inkarlo iarkh'ama. Zovkkh kh'ega shaina! TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna /sha'sh dinchukh khinderg/.
Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'anakh shaina /kh1un iu/ tsa khuucharnadak'a do tsara. TallakhIi, shu'ga khattaza du'tur ma dats ash /Dalla du'kh'al/ kharts kkhullush khillachukh.
Dalla mekhkarii khu'lu'itu tsara - vonakh tsIena vu Iza - tk'a shaina - shaina dezarg /kIentii/ khu'lu'itu.
Tsarakh tskh'anna ioI khilla a'lla, kkha' ba'kkkhicha, iu'kh' Iarzhalo tsu'nan, kiirakh' khalla setsaio shen o'g1azlo.
I lech1k'a nakhakh shega kkha' ba'kkkhina bolu tsatam bakh'anekh'. "Siisazallitsa t1elotsu-te sha i /ioI/, ia la'ttakh dIakh'ulio-te?" Ma von du-kkh tsara desh dolu kh'ukma!
Ekhartakh tsateshacharna von masal du, tk'a Delekh' ma du vuno lakkhara masal. Iza veza verg a, kh'ukma /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Dala nakh shain zulam bakh'anekh' /balane/ lotsush khillekh'ara, tsunna (la'tta) tIekh' tskh'a a diinat (Delakh teshash votsu kersta) du'tur ma datsara Tso, delakh' a, tIa'kh'atottu Tso u'sh bilgal ia'kkkhina khan tIekkhachchalts. Shain /bilgal ia'kkkhina/ khan t1e'cha - tskh'a sakh't tIa'kh'a a tsa bu'su u'sh, kh'alkha a tsa bovlu.
Dalla shaina tsadezarg khu'lu'itu tsara, khartsdolchu'nan surt khIottado tseran mettanasha, shaina dikanig du, bokhush. Sheko iotstsush, tsarna /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu, u'sh /tsu chokh'/ bitsbiir bu.

TallakhIi, kh'ol kh'alkha a ummatashka bakhkiitira Okha /Tkheshan elchanash/, shaitIano shain Iamalsh khaziira tsarna. Takhana a tseran doladiirig (nak'ost) i du, tsarna (kechdina) lazame dolu Iazap du.
Kh'o'ga zhaina dossiina ma dats Okha, dekk'a akh' tsarna bilgaldakkkha a ben tseran shena chokh' khilpalo khillarg, niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a khila a ben teshash dolchu k'omana.
Dala stiglara khi dossiina, tsu'ntsa latta dendina Tso i dellachul tIa'kh'a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' /Dela tskh'a' khilaran a, nitsk' bolush khilaran a/ delil ma du ladugIuchu nakhana.
Bakk'alla a, shuna kh'aibanashkakh' a ma'Ina du: Okha shuna malaio tseran kiirakh' iolchukh bo'khallina a, tsIiina a iukk'era shura, tsIena a, cham bolush a iolush molcharna.
Khurmaniin a, kemsiin a sto'mekh ash dokkkhu vakhosh dolu malara, khaza ritsk' a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du kh'ek'ale bolchu nakhana.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho nakkharmozan dag chu tesira: kh'aina g1ishlosh e la'mnashkakh' a, dittash t1ekh' a, tsara (nakha) dechu ts1enosh chokh' a (tkhevnashna t1ekh') a'lla.

TIakkkha daa kh'aina masso a sto'mekh ritsk', kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun, kh'aina mu't1akh' dinchu, nek'ashkakhula lela, a'lla. Tseran (nakkharmoziin) kiirara malar dolu, shen bos taip-taipana a bolush, shena chokh' nakhana darba a dolush. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' /Delan nitsk' khilaran/ delil du-kkh sha'sh oila echu nakhana.

Dala kkho'llina shu, tIakkkha Tso dolu'itur du shu. Shukh vu dakharan uggar irchachu kh'oleverzosh verg a, tsunna /k'ona volush/ khuush khillachul tIa'kh'a /kkhin/ khIumma a tsa khaiita. Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush a vu, nitsk' kkhochush a vu.

Dala shukh tskh'abersh vukkkharal bazbina /shaina/ ritsk' dalarekh'. Ma bats i bazbinarsh shain ritsk' lur dolush shain a'ttu ku'igasha doladinacharna (leshna, ialkhoshna), sha'sh tsu chokh' (ritsk'anekh'), u'sh shaitsa nis a besh. Delan niImat a kharts do tk'a tsara?

Dala shuna shukh shaikh a zudarii bina, Tso shuna shun zudarshkakhula kIentii a, kIentiin kIentii a khiliitina. Tso shuna dikchukh ritsk' della. Tk'a khartsdolchukh tesha u'sh, Delan niImatana kerstanalla do?
Tsara Iibadat do Dela votschu, shain dolakh' tsarna iala stiglanashkara a, la'ttara a ritsk'ekh khIumma a iotsucharna,/iala li'cha a/ nitsk' tsa kkhochucharna.
Delatsa tskh'a a ma nisve. Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush vu, shu tsa khuush du.

Dala daliina shuna masal: tskh'a' shekh /kkhechara/ doladesh volu lai vu, shen khIumanna nitsk' a tsa kkhochush volu, /vazha/ Okha shena Tkhaigara dika ritsk' dellarg vu, tso tsunakh kharzh a io /sagIa lo/ k'ailakha a, guchakh' a. Tskh'aterra bui u'sh? Khastam Dalla bu. Delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh tsa khuush bu.

Dala /kkhin/ masalina valiina shi stag: otsu shinnakh tskh'a' mott tsa khuush vu, tskh'anna a khIumanna nitsk' tsa kkhochu tsu'nan, i verrig shen elan (shena t1ekh1o'ttinchu stegan) kochakh' vu, sha michchakh'a a kh'azhiicha a, tso dikanig tsa dokh'u. Tk'a tskh'aterra vui iza a, niisontsa omra desh verg a, sha niisachu novk'akh' a volush?

Delan iu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a k'aile. Ma dats sakh'tangIullakkh (k'ematde kh1ottar) bIa'rnegIar tokhar sanna a ben, ia kkhin a gergakh'. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush vu.
Dala skh'ada'khna shu shain nanoin kiirara, khIumma khuush datsara shu. Tso shuna lersa a, bIa'rsa a, degnash a khiliitira (delira), shu khila megar-kkh barkalla olush.
Tsarna tsa go-te olkhazarsh, stiglan khIavaekh' /t1emadevlla Dala/ a'tto bina dolchu? U'sh tsa setsado /stiglakh'/ Dala ben. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash du teshash bolchu nakhana.

Dala shuna khiliitina shun g1ishloikh /parg1at chokh' 1en/ khIusamash, Tso khiliitina shuna kh'aibaniin ts1okanekh kh1usamash, sha'sh shuna eza a iotsush shu dIa-skh'ado'lkhuchu diinakh' a, shu / sada1a/ sevtsinchu diinakh' a; tseran (u'stag1iin) tIargIanakh a, /emkaliin/ t1arg1anakh a, /gezariin/ chokh (t1arg1anakh) a shuna iiibar (salpal) a iu, tskh'ana khanna paidaetsa khIumanash a iu.

Dala khiliitina shuna Sha kkho'llinchukh IindagI, Tso khiliitina shuna la'mnekh lochIk'iila, Tso khiliitina shuna dukhar, shu lardesh iovkhonakh, khiliitina dukhar (t1eman dukhar) a shu lardesh vovshiin nitsk'akh (derallakh). Ishtta kkhochushdo Dala Shen niImat shuna tIekh', shu khilarkh'ama mu't1akh' khilla.
U'sh dIaberzakh' - kh'una tIekh' bilgal dIakkhachor du /Tkhan elchalalla/.
Delan niImat devza tsarna, tIakkkha a inkarlo io tsara tsunna, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh kerstanashbu.
Otsu diinakh' (k'ematdiinakh') Okha vokhu'itur vu khIor ummatakh tesh, tIakkkha kerstanashna (dokhkobovla) purbalur dats, tsa'rga bekhkazlonasha ialaioitur iats.
Zulamkhoshna (Delakh tsateshnacharna) Iazap gicha, tsarna i daidiir a dats, tIa'kh'atottur a bats u'sh (tsunakh).

/Delatsa/ nak'ost la'tsnachara shain "nak'ostii" gicha, er du: "Tkho Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, khIorsh bu tkhan nak'ostii, Okha shaiga, Kh'o a vitina, kkhoikkhush khilla bolu". Tsaratsa'rga dosh kkhussur du: "Bakk'alla a, shu khartslu'ish dersh du-kkh",-a'lla.
Dele kkhovdor iu tsara otsu diinakh' mukIarlo, dIak'a'stardu tsarakh tsara (khapts) kkhullush khillarg.
Tsateshnacharna a, Delan nek'akh /nakh/ d1atilincharna a Okha tIetukhur du Iazapa tIe a Iazap u'sh bo'khanig desh khilarna.

Otsu diinakh' khIor ummatna t1e Okha vokhu'itur vu (shaigakh'a volu a-teshash khillacharna) shaina du'kh'al volu a - tsateshacharna) tesh tsarakh shaikh, kh'o (kh1ai Mukh'ammad) valor vu Okha khIokkharna /shaigakh'a volu a, shaina /du'kh'al volu a tesh khilla. Kh'o'ga zhaina dossiina Okha sha masso a khIumanan bilgalo khilla dolu, sha busalbanashna niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a, kkha' a khilla dolu.
Bakk'alla a, Dala omra do niiso, dikanig /lelade olii/ a, gergarcharna /sagIa/ dalar a; tsa magado /Dala/ bo'khanig a, vonig a, kh'agI a. Tso shuna kh'ekham bo; kh'ekham tIelotsur batsara-te ash.
Delatsa iina chIagIo kkhochush'e, sha'sh chIagIo iinchul tIa'kh'a, duinash ma k'arbe, sha'sh u'sh chIagIbinchul tIa'kh'a: ash Dela ma vina shaina tIekh' tesh. Bakk'alla a, Dalla kha'a ash diirig.

Shu ma khilalash shen u'irig ba'stinchu zudchukhtera, sha i khala binchul tIa'kh'a, shain duinekh vovshashna iukk'ekh' paidao'tsush, tskh'abersh vukkharal kh'al sov dolush khiliitarkh'ama. Dala shu tsu'ntsa (va1da kkhochush'e alartsa) zu'ish du. Tso shuna k'ematdiinakh' bilgaldiir du shu shena chokh' khilpalo esh khillarg.

Dalla li'nekh'ara, Tso shu tskh'a ummat khu'lu'itur dara, delakh' a, Tso tilavala vu'tu Shena luurg, Tso nisvo Shena luurg. Shu'ga /k'ematdiinakh'/ khattanza du'tur ma dats ash /du'nenakh'/ lelosh khillachukh.

Shain duinekh vovshashna iukk'ekh' khartsonash ma elash - shain kog tsa sharshiita i chIagIbella la'ttash khillachul tIa'kh'a, /ash i kh1umanash dakh'/ vonig Iovshur du ash sha'sh Delan nek'akh /nakh/ tilorna, shuna deza- dokkkha Iazap a khir du.
Ma etsa Delan vaIdanakh kIezzig makh! Bakk'alla a, Dalla gergakh' derg dika du shuna, shu khuush khillekh'.
Shu'gakh' derg kkhachalur du, Dalla gergakh' derg bukhadu'sur du. Sobare khillacharna dIaialaza iu'tur ma iats Okha shain ial tsara desh khillachukh uggar khazachu'ntsa.
Dika Iamal iinarg, bo'rsha stag velakh' a, zuda elakh' a, sha mu'min bolush - u'sh denbiir ma bu Okha khazchu dakhartsa, tseran ial dIalur ma iu Okha tsara desh khillachukh uggar khazchu'ntsa.
Aikh'a K'ur'an do'shush, Dele larvalar dekhalakh', tIulgash kkhu'ssush, ekkkhochu shaitIanakh.
Bakk'alla a, tsu'nan bak'o iats, iiman a dillina, shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna tIetovzhush bolcharna tIekh'.
Tsu'nan bak'o iu shekh /shaina/ verasalla lelocharna tIekh' a, sha'sh tsunakh (Delatsa) nak'ost lotsucharna tIekh' a.
Okha aiat /kkhechu/ aiatatsa khiitsicha, - Dela dika khuush vu Sha dossosh derg, - tsara olu: "Bakk'alla a, kh'o kkhullush verg vu". KhIa', tsarakh dukkkhakhbersh khuush bats.
Akh' ala: "I /K'ur'anan aiat/ dossiina Dezchu sinokh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara bak'dolchu'ntsa, Sha chIagIbarkh'ama iiman dillinarsh, Sha niisa nek' a, kkha' a khilla busalba nakhana".
Tkhuna khuush du, tsara olu: "IzaIamavesh vu adamo". U'sh shena tIekkhiidash berg Iazhammott ma bu, tk'a khIara bilggal Ia'rbiin mott ma bu.
Bakk'alla a, Delan aiatekh tsa teshash bersh - Dala nisbiir bats u'sh (niisachu novk'a), tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap khir du.
Bakk'alla a, /Delan sibatash t1ekh'/ khartsderg kkhullu Delan aiatekh tsa teshash bolchara - tk'a u'sh ma bu khartslu'ish bersh.

Sha iiman dillinchul tIa'kh'a Dalla kerstanalla dinarg, shen dog iimantsa chIagIdella a dolush, shena nitsk' binarg votsush, kerstanallina shen dog d1adellinarg- tsarna Delera o'gIazlo a iu, tsarna deza-dokkkha Iazap a du.
Iza (1azap) - tsarna Ekhartal du'nenan dakhar sov dezarna du, Dala (niisachu novk'a) nisbesh tsakhilarna du kersta k'am.
U'sh bu Dala shain degnashna a, khazarna a, bIa'rsinna a mukhIar to'khnarsh - u'sh bu sha'sh gIopal bersh!
Sheko iats Ekhartakh' u'sh eshnarsh khilaran.

TIakkkha, bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg /gechdesh vu/ khIizhar dinacharna, sha'sh pitane la'tsnachul tIa'kh'a k'akh'egna bolchu, sobar dina bolchu, - bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tsul tIa'kh'a gechdesh verg a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' kh1or sa dogIur du sha k'u'isush (shen bolkh balkhosh), masso a sinna /kkhochchush/ lur du tso sha /du'nenakh'/ dinarg. Tsarna zulam diir dats (tsarna khartso iiir iats)!

Dala masallina ialiina tskh'a iurt (Makka). I khilla ma'rsha a, pargIat a: tsunna (iu'rtarchu nakhana) shortta shen ritsk' dogIura masso a mettigera. TIakkkha tso(Makkin okh1lano) Delan niImatashna kerstalla dira. TIakkkha Dala tsu'nga Iovshiitira matsallin a, kkheraman a dukhartsara desh khillarg bakh'anekh'.
Tsa'rga veara elcha, tsarakh a volush - tsara iza khartsvira. TIakkkha u'sh skh'aletsira Iazapo, sha'sh zulamkhoi a bolush (khartsonna t1ekh' a bolush).
Ash daa Dala shaina dellachu ritsk'ikh kh'anal derg a, tsIena derg a, Delan niImatashna shukur de, sha'sh Tsunna Iibadat desh delakh'.

Bakk'alla a, Dala kh'aram iina shuna ekk'a k'eella khIuma a, tsIii a, kh'akkhin zhizhig a, Dela votsush /kkhechun/ tsIe ia'kkkhinarg a (shena urs kh'okkhuchu khenakh'). Sha (iaaza) tsa va'llarg/matsalla tsa vala/, k'a desh votsush (i iaar magosh dotsush), baramal t1ekh tsa volush(vuzzalts a tsa iuush), - tIakkkha Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu (tsa va'lla i kh'aramiina kh1uma ii'nachunna).

Ash ma alalash shain mettanasha du'itsuchu khartsderg bakh'anekh': "KhIara kh'anal du, khIara kh'aram du", Dalla tIe khartsderg kkhollarkh'ama. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tIe khartsderg kkhullush bersh bakkkhiibiir bolush bats.
KIezzig zovkkh kh'egar du /i tsarna/ - lazosh dolu Iazap du tsarna /kechdina/.
Zhu'gtiin dinekh' khillacharna a kh'aram dina Okha kh'o'ga kh'alkha diitsinarg, Okha tsarna zulam tsa dira, delakh' a, u'sh khilira sha'sh shaina zulam desh.

TIakkkha, bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tsa khuush vonig dinacharna, tIakkkha tsul tIa'kh'a toba desh dika Iamalsh iinacharna, - bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tsul tIa'kh'a /tsarna/ gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, IbrakhIim khilla Dalla mu'tIakh' imam, tsIena din derg, i tsa khilla shirkdecharakh.
Tsu'nan niImatashna shukur diirig a /khilla iza/. Tso (Dala) kha'rzhira iza, nis a vira niisachu novk'a.
Okha tsunna delira du'nenakh' a dikanig, iza Ekhartakh' a dikacharakh a vu.
TIakkkha Okha kh'o'ga va'kh'ii dossiira tsIena din dolush khillachu IbrakhIiman millatna tIa'kh'akhIotta a'lla. I (Ibrakh1im) tsa khilla shirk decharakh.
Sho'tan de/dazdar/ khiliitina tsu'ngakh' khilpalo khillacharna. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg kh'ukma diir dolush vu k'ematdiinakh' tsarna iukk'ekh' u'sh khilpalo esh khillachunna.

Akh' kkhaikkha kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun novk'a kh'ek'altsii, khazchu kh'ekhamtsii, tsa'rtsa (kh'aina du'kh'albolcha'rtsa) k'iisa khazchu kepara. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vuno dika vevzash vu Shen nek'akh tilavellarg. Iza vuno dika bevzash vu niisachu novk'akh' bersh a.
Nagakh' sanna ash taIzar dakh', taIzar de shaina taIzar dinchukh terra, ash sobar dakh' - iza sobar decharna dika du-kkh.
Akh' sobar delakh', kh'an sobar Delatsa a ben dats, tsarna poshme ma khila, kh'o ma khila sagatlush tsara echu mekarlonakh.
Bakk'alla a, Dela vu /Shekh/ kkhiirincha'rtsa, Iza vu dikacha'rtsa /u'sh 1alash a besh, tergo a 1esh/.

Masso a vonakh tsIena vu Iza (Dela), Sha Shen laibusa /kkharsta/ va'kkkhina volu Dezchu ma'zhdigeraGenarchu ma'zhdige, Okha shen gonakha derg berkate dina dolchu, tsunna gaitarkh'ama Tkhan aiatash. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu khezash verg a, gush verg a.
Okha delira Musaga zhaina, tsunakh khiliitira niisa nek' Israilan kIentashna, Sha votsurg, kkhin vekal ma latsa, a'lla.

Kh1ai Okha sha'sh Nukh'atsa leliinacheran zurriet /Israilan k1entii! Dagadaiita Okha shain dai khina bukhabakharkh k1elkh'arbakhar; shukur de Dalla/. Bakk'alla a, iza (Nukh' paikhamar) khili barkale lai.
Okha khaam bira Israilan kIentashka zhaini chokh': "Telkhina derg tsa desh 1iir ma dats shu la'tta tIekh' shozza, kuradevr du shu t1ekh kurallitsa",-a'lla.
Tsu shinnakh kh'alkhara vaIda e'cha, Okha shuna tIe bakhkiitira Tkheshan lesh, shaigakh' chIogIa nitsk' bolu, chekkhbevlira u'sh kh1usamash chukhula- vaIda kkhochushkhilira.
T1akkkha /ash toba dinchul t1a'kh'a/ Okha shu'ga iukhabakkkhiitira tsarna tIekh' tolam, gIo dira shuna kh'olatsa a, kIentashtsa a, shukh khiliitira vuno iokkkha toba ( dukkha khalk').

Ash dikanig dicha - i dikanig dina shaina, ash vonig dicha - iza a shuna shaina (zulame) du. /Delan/ sholgIa vaIda kkhochushkhilcha - /Dala kkhin mostagIii tIetesira shuna/ tsara shun iakhkh'ash erchaiakha, ma'zhdigau'sh chu bakha, du'khkh'ara sha'sh bakhare terra, dokho shaina dola mel de'narg.

Shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho shukh k'inkhetam ban mega. Shu dukhaderzakh' /k'inosh darna/, Tkho a dukhadu'rzur du /shuna taIzar darna/. Okha khiliitina zho'zhakhati kerstanashna nabakhti /u'sh tsu chu'ra ara tsa bovlalush/.
Bakk'alla a, khIokkhu K'ur'ano nisvo sha uggar niisadolchunna tIe, kkha' bokkkhu sha'sh dikanash desh bolchu mu'min nakhana tsarna iokkkha ial khilartsa.
Ekhartakh tsa teshash bersh - Okha tsarna kechdina lazosh dolu Iazap.
Adamo /shena ia shen do'zalkhochunna, sha o'g1azvakhcha/ vonig do'khush doIa do, sha dikanig do'khush doIa dare terra. Adam /shen kkhollamekh'/ khilla sikha /amal iolush /.

Okha khiliitina bu'isa a, de a shi bilgalo khilla. Bu'isanan bilgalo dIaiokkkhu Okha, diinan bilgalo gush ioi, shu'ga lakhiitarkh'ama shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun koma'rshonakh /ritsk'/, sheriin baram a, kh'esap a shuna khaiitarkh'ama. Masso a khIuma k'astiina Okha kkhochchush bolchu k'astamtsa.

Masso a adamna logakh kh'archiina Okha shen kkhollam.Okha tsunna k'ematdiinakh' zhaina guchudokkkhur du - tsunna gur du iza skh'adillina (du'nenakh' sha dina dikanig a, vonig a tsunna kh'alkhakh' khir du k'ematdiinakh').
"Desha kh'ain zhaina. Kh'ain sa kkhacho khili kh'una takhana kh'esap dan" /er du tsu'nga/.
Nisvellarg - shena nislush vu. Tilavellarg a - shena tilalush vu. Kh'ur bats kh'ush volcho kkhechu'nan mokh'. Tkho tsa khilla Iazap desh, Okha elcha vakhiittalts.

Tkhuna tskh'a iurt khIallak'ian li'cha, Okha /elchanashkakhula/ omrado tsu'nan /iu'rtakhoin/ kh'oladaishka /Dalla mu't1akh' khila, olii/, - tsara tsu chokh' (iu'rtakh') 1esalla io (Dalla), tIakkkha otsunna tIekh' /Delera 1azap dussur du, a'lla dolu/ dosh bak'khu'lu - tIakkkha Okha iza iokhaio kkhochchush.
Masa tIa'kh'e khIallakiina Okha Nukh'al t1a'kh'a! Kkhacho iu kh'an Dela Shen len k'inosh sov dika khuush a, gush a khilar.

Milla a khillekh' dezash sikhanig- sikhdina /lur du/ Okha tsunna tsu chokh' (du'nenakh') Tkhaina luurg Tkhaina luuchunna, tIakkkha Okha khiliitina tsunna zho'zhakhati - chug1ur vu iza tsunna /vaga/ bekhke a khilla, siisaza a volush (Delan k'inkhetamakh genava'kkkhina).
Milla a velakh' dezash tIa'kh'arnig, tsunna tIekkhacha sikhvellarg shen k'akh'egartsa, sha teshnaa volush, - u'sh bu shain k'akh'egar barkalle (dek'ala) khillarsh.
KhIoranna a lo Okha - khIokkharna a (du'ne lo'khucharna), vukkharna a (ekhart lo'khucharna) - kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun niImatakh. Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun niImat tsa khilla dikhkina.

Kh'azhal, mukha bazbina Okha tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharal (du'nenan dakharekh')! Tk'a ekhart -darzhekh uggare dokkkhanig a du, dozallakh uggare dokkkhanig a du (Delakh kkho'rush khillacharna kechdina dolu).
Delatsa kkhin dela ma ve - /i vakh'/ kh'o okh'akhuur vu bekhke a khilla, (Delera) gIo dotsush a visina.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho omra dina: ash Iibadat ma delash Sha votschunna, detsa-nenatsa dika a khilalash, a'lla. Kh'una gergakh' tsarakh tskh'a' ia shii a k'anallina tIekkhachakh', akh' tsu shinga ma alalakh': "Uffai!", dIa ma k'akhkadelakh' i shi', akh' alalakh' tsu shinga khaza dosh.
Akh' okh'abakhiita tsu shinna k'inkhetamakh mu'tIakh' khilaran tIam, ala: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, k'inkhetam bekh'a tsu shinnakh, tsu shimmo zhima volush (tergo esh) so kkhiorakh terra".
Shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dika khuush vu shun degnashkakh' derg. Shu dika khilakh' - bakk'alla, Iza khilla /daggara toba dartsa/ Shena tIebo'rzucharna gechdesh.
Gergarchunna shen kh'ak' dIalo, miskachunna a, nek'akhochunna a /dIalo tseran kh'akk'ash/, daia ma daia /kh'ain khIuma/ erna.
Erna doiush bersh khilla shaitIaniin vezharii, tk'a shaitIa shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna kersta khilla.

Nagakh' kh'o tsarakh (gergaracharakh, miskacharakh, nek'akhoikh - tsarna sagIina dala khIuma dotsush) d1avirzinekh', kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun k'inkhetam bezash (Delan k'inkhetamakh ritsk' dezash), i khilare satu'isush a volush, /t1akkkha otsunakh tsarna sag1ina dala dagakh'/, akh' tsa'rga alalakh' k1eda-merza dosh.
Ma khiliita kh'ain ku'g kh'ain logakh dikhkina, darzha a ma de i derrig darzhortsa-t1akkkha (i dakh') okh'akhuur vu kh'o bekhkame a khilla, gIaigIane a vakhana.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho ritsk' darzhado Shena luuchunna /shortta/, baram a bo. Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla Shen lesh dika bevzash a, gush a.
Ma daia shain berash miskallakh kkho'rush - Okha kkhobur bu u'sh a, shu a. Bakk'alla a, u'sh baiar khilla dokkkha gIalat.
Zinanagerga ma gIolash, bakk'alla a, i du irchanig, i bu bo'kha nek' /zho'zhakhate vu'gush/.

Ma delash Dala /den/ kh'aram dina dolu sabak'ontsiiben. Shena t1ekh' zulam a desh viinarg - Okha tsu'nan verasna (irs o'tsuchunna) bak'o ella /chIir etsa/, baiarekh' tIekh ma voliila iza. Bakk'alla a, iza (vellachun veras) khir vu (Dala) shena (ch1ir etsa) gIo dinarg.

Shu gerga ma gIolash boberan da'khnina uggar dikchu'ntsa (tsunna paidekh') ben i /kkhochchush/ g1emettakh1ottalts. Ialashbe bart (shain kkhecha'rtsa khilla chIagIonash). Bakk'alla a, bart zho'palle khilla. (Dala zhop do'khur du tsunakh).
Niiso e (sha'sh nakhana kh1umanash) iustarekh', sha'sh iustuchu khenakh'), ozalash niisachu terzantsa. Iza dika a du, melkho a khaza a du tIa'kh'engakh' (ekhartakh' mela khilartsa).
Kh'o tIa'kh'a ma khIottalakh' kh'aigakh' Iilma dotschu kh1umanna. Bakk'alla a, lersa a, bIa'rsa a, dog a - u'sh derrig khir du tsunakh zhop do'khur dolush (k'ematdiinakh').
Ma lelalakh' la'tta tIekh' kurallitsa- bakk'alla a, akh' la'ttan bukh okhkur ma bats, lamanan lokkhalle a kkhochur ma vats kh'o!
Otsu derrigenan vonig kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchunna gergakh' tsa dezash khilla (du).

I du kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho kh'o'ga va'kh'itsa khaiitinchu kh'ikmatakh. Ma khiliita Delatsa kkhin dela - tIakkkha zho'zhakhati chukkhussur vu kh'o bekhkame a khilla (khir volush), /masso a dikanakh/ iukha a to'khna.
Tk'a shu kha'rzhina shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho kIentashtsa, Shena malikekh io1arii bina? Bakk'alla a, shu olush ma du (shen irchallitsa) deza-dokkkha dosh.
Okha /masso a khIuma/ bilgaldina khIokkhu K'ur'an chokh' tsarna (adamashna) dagadaiitarkh'ama - tso-m (otsu bilgaldaro) u'shalsam tsa bokhu /bak'dolchukh/ dIak'akhkartsii ben.
Akh' ala: "Tsu'ntsa kkhin delii khilcha, tsara ma-bokhkhu, - Iarsh iolchunna (Dalla) tIe nek' lokhur ma bara tsara(i 1arsh d1alatsa g1ertash, derrige pachchakh'alla shain karaderzo luush)".
Vonakh tsIena vu Iza, t1ekh lakkkhaveli Iza tsara (kerstanasha) du'itsuchukh.

Tsunna tasbikh' desh iu vorkhI stigal a, latta a, tsarna chokh' mel bersh a (Dala mel kkho'llina kh1uma). Tsu'nan khastamtsa tasbikh' tsa desh khIumma a iats, delakh' a, shu (kh1ai adamash) tsa kkheta tseran tasbikh'akh. Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla t1ekh sobarea, gechdiirig a.
Akh' K'ur'an do'shush, Okha kh'una a, ekhartakh tsateshacharna a iukk'ekh' khiliitina kh'uldina kirkh'a.

Okha iina tseran degnashna tIekh' gIat (t1ekkho'llina kh1uma), u'sh tsunakh (K'ur'anakh) tsa kkhetiita, tseran lergashna chokh' a k'oralla iu. Akh' K'ur'ana chokh' vekk'a Sha tskh'a' kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg kh'ekhiicha, u'sh iukhabovlu, /bak'dolchukh/ k'a'khkash.

Tkho dika khuush du tsara stenga ladug1u, kh'o'ga sha'sh ladugIuchu khenakh', /t1akkkha/ k'ailakha vovshashka khabarsh du'itsush, zulamkhosha olu: "Shu tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma du shegakh' bozbuunchalla dolchu stagana".
Kh'azhal, mukha daliina tsara kh'una masalsh, tilabella u'sh, nitsk' tsa kkhochu tseran /niisa/ nek' /karo/.
Tsara elira: "Tkhokh da'Iakhkash a, chim a khilcha, tkho dendiir du, kerla khalk' a khilla?"
Akh' ala: "Shukh tIulg ia echig,

Ia /mu'lkhkha/ kkho'llina khIuma khilcha a, sha iokkkha khu'lush iolu shun degnashkakh' /iza a deniiir iu/." TIakkkha tsara er ma du: "Kh'an /dendina/ dukhaderzor du tkho?" Akh' ala: "Du'khkh'ara shu kkho'llincho". TIakkkha tsara shain kortosh lestosh kh'o volchukh'a, er ma du: "Matsa /khir/ du iza?" Akh' ala: "Iza kesta khila tarlo".
Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' Tso shu'ga kkhoikkhur ma du, ash Tsunna khastambartsa zhop lur du, shuna mo'ttur du sha'sh kIezzig ben tsa 1iina (du'nenakh' ia koshakh').
Akh' ala San leshka, tsara oliila (sha'sh k'amelash desh) uggare dikanig. Bakk'alla a, shaitIano tsarna iukk'e dov tu'ssu. Bakk'alla a, shaitIa adamna k'a'sttina mostagI khilla.
Shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg shu dika devzash vu. Shena laakh', k'inkhetam biir bu Tso shukh, ia Shena laakh', Tso shuna Iazap diir du. Okha tsa vakhiitina kh'o tsarna tIekh' vekal khilla.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dika bevzash vu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a bersh. Okha bazbina tskh'abolu paikhamarash vukkharal, Okha della Davude Zabur.
Akh' ala: "Ash kkhaikkha sha'sh, I /AllakhI-Dela/ vitina, delii bu bokhucha'rga /shaina gIo de alii/". Tseran dolakh' ma dats shuna tIera zen d1aaidar a, /ia i kkhecharna t1e/ derzor a.

Tsara shaiga kkhoikkhush bershsha'sh a bu shain Dele /gerga khila/ nek' lo'khush, tsarakh vuno /Dalla/ gerga verg mu'lkhanig vu-te /kh'o'zhush/. Dog dokhush bu u'sh Tsu'nan k'inkhetame, kkho'rush bu Tsu'nan Iazapakh. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh- Kkhobuchun Iazap khilla shekh lardala dezash.
Ma iats tskh'a a iurt Okha khIallakiiir iotsush k'ematde dale, ia Okha shena chIogIa Iazap diir dotsush. I khilla /Lavkh' makh'fuz/ zhaini chokh' iazdina /khiitsalur dotsush/
Tkho dukha tsa to'khna Okha aiatashdissorakh u'sh kh'alkhalerachara khartsdaro ben. Okha elira samudashnaemkal, gush a iolush, tsara tsu'ntsazulam dira. Okha tsa bossabo aiatashtsakkheram ben.

Dagadaita: Okha ma elira kh'o'ga: "Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho nakhakh guo billina". Okha tsa khiliitira Okha kh'una gaitina khilla dolu gara, K'ur'an chokh' shena neIalt a'lla dolu ditta nakhana pitana ben. Okha tsarna kkheram kkhu'ssu, tso u'sh alsam tsa bokhu dokkkhachu tilartsa ben.
Kh'akhade, (kh1ai paikhamar): Okha elira malikashka: "Suzhud de Adamna". Tsara suzhud dira, iblis dotscho. Tso elira: "As suzhud do tk'a Akh' popparkh kkho'llinchunna?"
Elira /ibliso/: "Kh'azhakh'! KhIara vu Akh' suna tIekh' vazvinarg? Akh' so tIa'kh'atattakh' k'ematde dallats, tsu'nan zurriet tilor ma du as, tskh'a kIezzig bersh botsursh".
Tso (Dala) elira: "DIadala! Tsarakh kh'una tIa'kh'a milla khIottakh' a,- bakk'alla a, zho'zhakhati iu-kkh shuna kkhochchush bekkham.

Kkheram tasa tsarakh kh'ain nitsk' kkhochucharna kh'ain ozatsa, gulbe (t1ekhetsa) tsarna du'kh'al kh'ain doshloi a, gIashloi a, dek'ashkho khila tsa'rtsa (tseran) kh'olekh' a, do'zalshkakh' a, vaIda e tsarna!" ShaitIano vaIda ma tsa io tsarna (u'sh) Iekhabar ben.
"Bakk'alla a, San /dog ts1ena, teshame bolu/ lesh, - tsarna tIekh' bak'o iats kh'an". Kkhachame du kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg (u'sh shait1anakh 1alashbarekh') vekal khilar.
Shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg vu shuna khIorda chukhula kemanash lelosh verg shu'ga lekhiita Shen koma'rshallakh(ritsk') Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla shuna k'inkhetame.

Shukh zen-zulam 1ottadelcha khIorda chokh', dIa ma tu'lii i, ash Iza votschu'nga, shaiga kkhoikkhush bersh. TIakkkha Tso sha'sh kIelkh'arda'khcha arenna tIe - shu dukhadevli. Bakk'alla a, adam khili barkalle dotsush.
Shu teshna khili-te Tso shu arenan tskh'ana dek'ana bukhadokhu'turg tsakhilarkh ia Tso shuna tIe darts kh'ovzor tsakhilarkh? TIakkkha shuna karor ma vats shaina vekal.

Ia shu teshna dara-te Tso shu tsunna (khIorda) chu /tsk'a shun doIa bakh'anekh' Okha arada'khnachul tIa'kh'a/ iukha a derzorig tsakhilarkh, tIakkkha shuna tIe mekhan darts kh'avziina, tso shu khi bukha dokhu'itur dolush, shu tsa teshash khilarna? TIakkkha shuna karor vats shaina Tkhuna tIekh' tsu'ntsa / bekkham etsa/ tIa'kh'ava'llarg.

Okha siidina (leeram bina) Adaman kIentekh, Okha leliina u'sh arentsa a, khIorda chukhula a, ritsk' della tsarna tsIenchukh, Okha bazbina u'sh Tkha'sh kkho'llinchu /khalk'ekh/ dukkkhacharakh bazbartsa.

Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' Okha kkhoikkhur du derrige a adamashka shain imamatsa. Shen zhaina shen a'ttu ku'iga dellarg milla velakh' a i, tsara shain zhaina do'shur ma du, tsarna tsu'rrig zulam diir ma dats.
Kkhuzakh'bIa'rsadotsush milla khillekh' a, - iza ekhartakh' a bIa'rsa dotsush khir vu, nek'atsa uggar tilavellarg a vu.
U'sh gerga khilira Okha kh'o'ga va'kh'itsa dossiinachukh kh'o dIatilavankh'o'ga Tkhuna tIekh' kkhiderg kkholliita. TIakkkha kh'o dottagI la'tsna khir ma vara tsara!
Okha kh'o (bak'dolchunna t1ekh') tsa satsiinekh'ara, kh'o gerga vara zhimma tsarna tIetovzha.

TIakkkha /kh'o mushrikashna tskh'a zhimma a gergavakhana khillekh'/ Okha kh'o'ga /Iazap/ Iovshiitina khir dara shozza dakharekh' a, shozza valarekh' a, tIakkkha kh'una Tkhuna du'kh'al gIo'ncha karor ma vatsara.
U'sh gerga bara kh'o otsu la'ttara (Makkara) khervan, kh'o tsu chu'ra (Makkara) aravakkkharkh'ama. TIakkkha kh'ol tIa'kh'a u'sh kIezzig ben 1iir ma batsara (Dala Iazap diir dara tsarna).
Okha kh'ol kh'alkha bakhkiitinchu Tkhan elchaniin Iedalekh'du iza. Kh'una karor ma dats Tkhan Iedalan khiitsdalar.
Akh' lamaz khIottade malkh dIakerchachu khenera bu'isanan bodane kkhachchalts, satasaran K'ur'ana desha (Iu'ire-lamaz de). Bakk'alla a, satasaran K'ur'an khilla shena teshallash dolush.
Bu'isanakh a (tskh'ana dek'ekh') akh' k'akh'ega aikh'a tsu'ntsa (K'ur'an deshartsa) sovnakha lamazashkakh' - kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kh'o vakhiita tarlo khastame mettige.

Akh' ala: "San Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg! San chug1oila khiliitalakh' bak'dolchun a, siilallin a ne1arekhula, san aravoliila a khiliitalakh' bak'dolchun a, siilallin a ne1arekhula. Khiliitalakh' suna gIo'nna Kh'aigara bak'o a, nitsk' a (Kh'an mostag1ekh so larvesh, Kh'an din dazdesh)".
Akh' ala: "Bak'derg deana, khartsderg d1ada'lla. Bakk'alla a, khartsderg d1adala dezash khilla".
Okha dossado K'ur'an chu'ra (aiatash) mu'min nakhana /degnashna a, dog1mashna a) darba derg a, k'inkhetam berg a. Zulamkhoshna - tso darash (zen) ben sov tsa dokhu.
Okha adamna niImat delcha, - i iukhavolu, genavolu / Tkhuna 1ibadat darkh/, sha bokhamo skh'ala'tscha, i khu'lu /Delan k'inkhetamakh/ dogdillina.
Akh' ala: "Masso a vu Iamal esh shen-shen kepara". Shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg diko khuush vu novk'atsa /massaral/ nisvellarg milla velakh' a.
Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu sikh /la'tsna/.Akh' ala: "Sa san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gIullakkhakh du. Shuna Iilma kIezzig ben tsa della".
Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, Okha dIada'kkkhina khir dara kh'o'ga Tkha'sh va'kh'itsa dellarg - tIakkkha kh'una karor vats kh'aina tsu'ntsa Tkhuna tIekh' vekal (i dukhaderzo nitsk' berg)
Kh'o Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara k'inkhetam a ben. Tsu'nan koma'rshalla kh'una tIekh' iokkkha khilla.
Akh' ala: "Adamash a, zhinash a guldelcha khIokkhu K'ur'anakh teranig dan, diir datsara tsara tsunakh teranig, tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharna nak'ostii khilcha a".
Okha khIokkhu K'ur'an chokh' nakhana bilgalda'kkkhina masso a kh1uma. T1akkkha a dukkhakhbolu nakh kerstanalla dotschunna du'kh'al khilira.
Tsara elira: "Tkho tsk'a a teshar ma dats kh'okh akh' tsa dakkkhakh' tkhuna la'ttakh kh'ast (shovda),
Ia kh'una khurmaniin a, kemsiin a besh tsa khilakh', tsunna iukk'ekhula akh' khin tatolash tsa dakhkakh'.
Ia stigal akh' tkhuna tIe, akh' ch1ag1 ma-darra, keskashtsa tsa iozhaiakh', ia kh'o tkhuna du'kh'al Dela a, malikash a dalosh tsa vag1akh',

Ia kh'an khaziinchu kh1umaniin (dasho) tsIa tsa khilakh', ia kh'o stigla tsa valakh'. Tsk'a a teshar dats tkho kh'an /stigal/ valarkh a, akh' tkhuna zhaina dossadalts, okha sha do'shush a dolush". Akh' ala: "Vonakh tsIena vu san Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, tk'a so adam - elcha ben ma vats."
Nakh (kerstanash) tsa sovtsiina tesharkh (iiman dillarkh) shaiga niisa nek' be'cha a, "Adam dou'itu tk'a Dala elcha khu'lii?" sha'sh alaro ben.
Akh' ala: "La'ttakh' pargIat lelash malikash khillekh', tsa'rga dossiina khir dara Okha stiglara malik, elcha a khilla".
Akh' ala: " Kkhacham bu Dela tesh khilar suna a, shuna a iukk'ekh'. Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla Shen lesh /sov dika/ bevzash a, gush a".

Dala nisvesh verg - iza vu niisachu novk'akh' verg, Dala tilabala bu'tush bersh - kh'una karor ma bats tsarna gIo'nchii, I Sha votsurg. Okha gulbiir bu u'sh k'ematdiinakh' shain iakhkh'ash tIekh' bIa'rsa dotsush, mott tsa khuush, k'ora. Tseran chugIoila - zho'zhakhati /-n tsIe/ iu. I ma iainekh', Okha tsarna alu soviokkkhu.
Iza tsarna bekkham bu u'sh Tkhan aiatekh tsa teshash khilarna a, tsara alarna a: "Tkho da'Iakhkash a, chim a khilcha, kerla khalk' khilla dendiir du, tk'a?"

Tsarna tsa go-tekh'a i stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llina volu Dela nitsk' kkhochush khilar i sannarg iukhakkholla? Tso tsarna shegakh' sheko iotsu Iozhalla iillira, - t1akkkha a zulamkhosha kerstanalla ben k'obal tsa dira.
Akh' ala: "Shu khilcha a san Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun k'inkhetaman khazniin doladesh, bIa'rmetsig khir ma dara shu, u'sh (i khaznash) shaigara dIadovlarna kkho'rush. Adam khilla pis (sutara).

Okha delira Musaga iss bilgala dolu delil. Akh' khattal Israilan kIentashka: iza (Musa) tsarna t1e ve'cha, FirIavna tsu'nga ma elira: "Suna kheta kh'o, Musa, /nakha/ kh'aina bozbuunchalla dina verg vu".
Tso elira: "Kh'una khi'na: khIorsh tsa dissiina stiglaniin a, la'ttan a Elo ben, gush iolu bilgalonash a iolush. Suna kheta, khIai FirIavn, kh'o khIallakkhir vu".
TIakkkha tsunna (FirIavnna) liira u'sh (Israilan kIentii) la'ttara (Misrara) d1alakhka, Okha iza a, tsu'ntsa mel verg - masso a khina bukhavakhiitira.

Okha elira tsul tIa'kh'a Israilan kIentashka: "(Kh1okkhu) la'ttakh' dakha, ekhartan (k'ematde kh1ottaran) vaIda de'cha, Okha shu d1adu'gur du /Dalla kh'alkha/ vovshashtsa iina /iiman dillinarg - kersta, dikanig - vonig/".
Bak'dolchu'ntsa dossiina Okha iza /K'ur'an/, bak'dolchu'ntsa do'ssina iza /Dalla gergara/. Kh'o tsa vaiitinaOkha khaamcha a, kkheramcha a volchu kh'olekh' ben.
K'ur'anan a dak'osh adina Okha kh'o'ga i pargIat deshiita nakhana. Okha i dossiina kIez-kIezzig dossortsa.
Akh' ala: "Tesha tsunakh, ia ma tesha (K'ur'anakh)! Bakk'alla a, shaina tsul kh'alkha Iilma dellarsh i (K'ur'an), shaina do'shush, chIenigishna tIe guora o'gu".
Tsara (1ilma dellachara) olu: "Vonakh tsIena vu tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun vaIda kkhochushkhilla".
ChIenigashna tIe iega u'sh, bo'lkhush, tso (K'ur'an desharo) u'sh sovbokhu /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' khilartsa.

Akh' ala: "Shu kkhaikkha /Dele/ AllakhI alii, ia K'inkhetame vergalii. Shu mu'lkhachu'ntsa (ts1artsa) kkhaikkhakh' a -/dika du/, Tsu'nan khaza tsIersh iu". Kh'ain lamaz dukkha chIogIa (az aidina) a ma de, sov mellasha (az lag1dina) a ma de, tsu iukk'ekh' nek' lakha kh'aina(iukk'erchu baramekh').

Akh' ala: "Khastam bu Dalla, do'zalkho (Shena) tsa la'tsnachu, Shena pachchakh'allekh' /mulkekh'/ nak'ost (o'shush) tsa khillachu. Siisazallakh /larvan/ gIo'ncha a tsa eshna Tsunna". Vokkkha vie Iza vokkkhavartsa!
Khastam bu Dalla, Sha Shen lega zhaina dossiinachu, tsu chokh' (K'ur'an chokh') niisa dotsurg tsa daliina Tso.
Niisa khilla dolu /zhaina du iza/, tsunakh /tsateshacharna/ kkheram khiliita Shegara chIogIachu nitsk'atsa, sha'sh dikanash desh bolchu mu'min nakhana kkha' bakkkhiita tsarna khaza ial khilartsa.
U'sh tsu chokh'guttar la'ttash.
Kkheram tasa sha'sh olucharna: "Dala do'zalkho la'tsna".
Tsarna tsu'ntsa tskh'a a Iilma dats, tseran daishna a (tsa khilla i). Inzare dokkkha khili tseran bagakhula dolurg (dokkkha k'a khilaran) dashtsa. Khartsderg ben ma dats tsara olush derg.
Kh'o khila mega kh'ain dog dokhosh tseran larshtsa (u'sh bakh'anekh' singattame a khilla), khalakhetash khIokkhu khabarekh a u'sh tsa tiishicha.
Okha la'tta tIekh' mel derg khazdina tsunna (la'ttana), u'sh zerkh'ama: mu'lkha vu-te Iamaltsa uggar dikanig?
Okha khu'lu'itur iu tsu tIekh' mel erg dek'a latta (t1ekh' kh1umma a iotsush).
Ia kh'o mo'ttush vara-te i kh'ekhan a, rak'imana dai Tkhan aiatashna /iukk'ekh'/ tamashe khIuma khilla?

Kh'akhade /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: tskh'a k'onakhii d1a ma lechk'ira kh'ekha chu, tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, Kh'aigara k'inkhetam lolakh' tkhuna, atta delakh' tkhuna tkhan gIullakkhekh' nisdalar".
Okha tseran lergash d1ak'evlira kh'ekha chokh' masiitta sharna.
TIakkkha Okha u'sh denbira (samabekhira) Tkhaina khaarkh'ama /nakhana guchudokkkhush/, shina tobanakh mu'lkhanig iu tsara ia'kkkhina khan dika iagar'esh.
Okha du'itsu kh'o'ga tseran khabar bak'dolchu'ntsa. Bakk'alla a, u'sh k'onakhii bara shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchukh teshna, Okha sovbekhira u'sh niisachu nek'atsa.

Okha chIagIdira tseran degnash, u'sh kh'alagIevticha. Tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, stiglaniin a, la'ttan a Ela vu Kh'o, okha kkhoikkhurma dats I votschu Dele, - tIakkkha okha gIalat derg er ma dara!
KhIokkhu tkhan k'omo Iza votsurg /kkhin/ delanash la'tsna. Tsara de'nekh'ara tsarna tIekh' bilgala delil! Mila vu tk'a vuno zulame sha Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkho'llinchul?"

"Shu tsarakh a, tsara, Dela a vitina, Iibadat dechukh a dIak'a'sti, kh'ekha chu dIalovchk'iisha - shuna barzhor bu shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho Shen k'inkhetamakh /k'inkhetam/, Tso shuna a'tto biir bu shun g1ullakkhashkakh'".

Kh'una go, malkh skh'akkhetachu khenakh' tseran kh'ekhana a'ttu agIorkhula dIakh'a'vzash, dIabuzuchu khenakh' - tsarakh dIatu'lush a'rru agIorkhula, u'sh tsu'nan (kh'ekhan) parg1atchu mettigekh' a bolush. Iza Delan delilekh du. Dala nisvesh verg - iza niisa verg vu, Dala tilavala vu'tush verg - kh'una tsk'a a karor ma vats tsunna niisa nek' kh'o'khu g1o'ncha.

Kh'una mo'ttu u'sh sema bu, tk'a u'sh nab esh bu, Okha berzabo u'sh a'tto agIor a, a'rru agIor a /latte tseran dog1mash tsa daiita/. Tseran zhIa'la, shen shi kog a barzhiina, neIsagIekh' du. Tsarna tIekkhi'nekh', - iukhaver vara kh'o vedda, t1ekhder ma dara kh'an tsarakh kkherar.

Ishtta denbira (samabekhira) Okha u'sh, tsa'rga vovshashka khattiitarkh'ama. Tsarakh olucho elira: "Mel la'ttira shu (otsu kh'olekh')?" Tsara elira: "Tkho la'ttira tskh'ana diinakh' ia diinan dek'akh'?" Tsara elira: "Shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dika khuush vu shu mel la'ttinekh' a. Ash vakhiita shaikh tskh'a' khIokkhu kekhatashtsagIala. Lokhiila tso uggar tsIena kkhacha - tsunakh ritsk' dokh'iila tso shuna, sema khu'liila iza, tskh'a'nga ma khou'itiila tso shukh derg.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh shuna tIenislakh', tsara tIulgash dettar du shuna, ia shu dukhaderzor du shain dine - tIakkkha tsk'elliga tsk'a a dakkkhiider dats shu!"

Ishtta Okha tsarna tIe /nakh/ nisbaliitira, tsarna khaiitarkh'ama Delan vaIda bak' iuila, sakh't- tsu chokh' sheko iotsiila (k'ematde kh1uttur khilarna). Tseran gIullakkhekh' vovshashtsa galmorzakhbevlira u'sh. Elira (tskh'abolchara): "GIishlo e tsarna tIekhula (kh'ekhana gonakhula). Tseran Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dika khuush vu tsarakh derg". Tseran gIullakkhna tIekh' to'llachara elira: "Tsarna tIekh' ma'zhdig (lamaz den mettig) diir du vai".

Tsara er du: "Kkho' vu (u'sh), tseran do'algIanig - tseran zhIa'la du". Olu /tskh'a kkhechara/: "Pkhi' vu (u'sh), tseran iolkhalgIanig - tseran zhIa'la du", guchakh' dotsurg khaa gIertash. Olu /vukkhara/: "VorkhI vu, tseran borkhIalgIanig - tseran zhIa'la du". Akh' ala: "San Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dika khuush vu tseran terakh' (u'sh masa khillekh'), u'sh tsa bevza kIezzigcharna ben". Tsa'rtsa ma k'iisa bilgaldolchu'ntsa ben. Tsarakh la'tsna kh1okkharakh tskh'a'nga ma khetta.
Akh' allane a ma alalakh' tskh'ana khIumanna tIekh': "As diir du iza kkhana,
Dalla laakh'",-olush ben. Kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg dagavaiitalakh' kh'uo vitsvelcha, alalakh': "KhIokkhul a niisachunna gerga vakhiita mega so sain Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho".
Shain kh'ekha chokh' u'sh la'ttira kkhaa bIe sharakh', /kkhin/ iss /sho/ t1etu'ikhira tsarna (sherashna).
