Akh' ala: "Dela dika khuush vu u'sh mel la'ttira, Tsu'ngakh' iu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a k'aile". Ma dika gush vu Iza (gan mel dezarg)! Ma dika khezash vu Iza (khaza mel dezarg)! I votsurg tskh'a a doladiirig ma vats tsarna, Shen kh'ukamekh' tskh'a a nak'ost tsa lotsu Tso.
Akh' diitsa (Iamade) kh'aiga va'kh'itsa dellachu kh'ain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun zhainakh. Vats Tsu'nan deshnash khu'itsuverg, kh'una tsk'a a karor iats Tsunna Shena t1e iotsurg dIavada mettig.

Kh'o sobare khila shain kkhiosh-kkhobuchu Delan iu'kh' ezash, Tsu'nga Iu'iranna a, su'iranna a kkhoikkhucha'rtsa. Kh'ain shi bIa'rg dIa ma berzabe tsarakh, du'nenan khazalla ezash, kh'o mu'tIakh' ma khila Okha shen dog Tkho kh'ekhorna gIovpaldinchunna a, shen dezarshna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinchunna a, - tsu'nan gIullakkh erna khilla.

Akh' ala: "Bak'derg du shun Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ngara. Shena li'narg teshiila, shena li'narg kersta khu'liila". Bakk'alla a, Okha kechiina zulamkhoshna /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe, tsu'nan penasha gobiir bu tsarakh. Tsara gIo dekhakh', tsarna gIo diir du khitsa, sha laliinachu echigakh tera dolchu, iakhkh'ash a iagaesh. Ma von malar du-kkh! Von khilla /tseran/ chug1oila(zho'zhakhate)!
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dika 1amalsh iinarsh a, - bakk'alla a, Okha eshor ma iats khaza Iamal iinchun ial.

U'sh bu shaina Iadn(ialsamanin) boshmash ersh, shain /kogash/ bukhakhula khish o'khush, khazbiir bu u'sh tsu chokh' dasho kh1azarshtsa, tsara tIedukhur du atlasan a, deza dariin ba'tstsara dukhar a, tsu chokh' sha'sh ma'ngeshna tIetevzhina la'ttash. Ma dika mela bu-kkh! Khaza khili (tseran) chug1oila (ialsamane)!
Masalna valave tsarna shi stag. Tsu shinnakh tskh'anna Okha kemsiin shi besh khiliitina, tsu shinna (beshana) go bira Okha khurmanashtsa, tsu shinna iukk'ekh' ialta khiliitira.
Shina a besho shain daardelira, tsunakh (sto'mekh) khIumma a tsa telkhira. Tsarna iukk'ekhula khi digira Okha.
Tsunna khilira sto'mash, tIakkkha tso shen nak'oste elira, i shetsa k'amel desh a volush: "San kh'aichul alsamo bu bakham a, so kh'ol siilakh'o vu nak'ostii khilartsa a".
I shen besha velira, shena zulam desh a volush, tso elira: "Suna tsa mo'ttu tsk'elliga tsk'a a dIaer iu /khIara besh/.
Suna tsa mo'ttu sakh'tkhIuttur du. So sain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'nga dIaverzavakh', suna karoza du'sur ma dats dIaverzartsa tsul dikanig".

Elira tsu'nga tsu'nan /busalba/ nak'osta, sha tsu'nga k'amel desh volush: "Akh' kerstanalla do tk'a kh'o kkho'llinchunna popparkh, tIakkkha tIadamakh, tIakkkha kh'o Sha nisvina volchu /onda/ stag a khilla?
Delakh' a, saikh la'tsna a'lcha, Iza AllakhI vu - san Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, sain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ntsa tskh'a a nak'ost lotsur vats asa-m!
Kh'uo kh'ain besha vakhcha, akh' a'llekh'ara: "MashaAllakhI! Delatsa ben nitsk' ma bats". Kh'una so gush velakh' kh'ail ledaro kh'olatsa a, do'zalshtsa a,
San Kkhiosh-kkhobucho suna dala a mega kh'an beshal a dikanig, dossadan tsu'nan (kh'an besha) tIe stiglara kh'esap- tIakkkha tsunakh shera a mettig khu'lush (la'ttatsa d1ashariina),
Ia tsu'nan khi (la'ttakh) d1akhudush, kh'an tsk'a a nitsk' tsa kkhochur botsush i karadan".

Gobira tsu'nan sto'mekh (kh1allakkhilaro), i volavelira shen ku'igash vovshekh detta, sha tsunna (beshana) kharzh iarna, tk'a iza (besh) shen bukh tIekh' esa iolush. Tso olu: "As tsa la'tsna khillekh'ara sain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'ntsa tskh'a a nak'ost!"
Tsa khilira tsunna /gIo'nchiin/ toba, sha tsunna gIo desh Dala dinchunna du'kh'al. I sha tsa khilira shena gIo dalush!
Tsigakh' gIo - kh'ak' volchu Delan du. I vu dika verg mela balartsa a, dika verg /khaza/ tIa'kh'e khiliitartsa a.

Dalade tsarna masalna du'nenan dakhar: Okha stiglara dossiina khi (dog1a) sanna du iza - tsunakh iira la'ttan oramatash. T1akkkha tsarakh dak'adella asarsh khilira, sha'sh mekhasha d1asa a darzhadesh. Khilira Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush.
Bakham a, kIentii a - du'nenan dakharan khazalla iu - bukhadu'sush dolu dikanashto'lu kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun gergakh' melatsa a, to'lu dogdakhartsa a.
Okha la'mnash du'iladolu'ituchu (d1a-skh'adarzhochu) /k'emat/ diinakh', kh'una gur du latta shardella. Okha skh'agulbiir bu u'sh (berrige a), bukhavu'tur vats tsarakh tskh'a a.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun kh'alkha d1akhIittor bu u'sh mog1ara: shu da'khkina Tkho dolchu, Okha shu du'khkh'ara ma-kkhollara. Shuna-m mottara Okha shaina /Tkhuna du'kh'alkkhetaran/ khan iu'llur iats, a'lla.

Okh'adu'llur du teptar (adamasha du'nenakh' mel iina dika a. von a 1amal d1aiaziina dolu), tIakkkha kh'una gur bu k'inosh dinarsh tsu chokh' dolchukh kkho'rush, sha'sh olush: "Ma bala bu vaina, kh1ara kh1u teptar du? KhIokkho -m bukha tsa ditina zhimanig a, ia dokkkhanig a tergal tsa desh!" Tsarna kariira sha'sh /du'nenakh' dolush/ dinarg (shaina) kh'alkhadillina. Zulam tsa do kh'an Kkhiosh-Kkhobucho tskh'anna a.

Dagadaiita! Okha ma a'llera malikashka: "Suzhud de Adamna". Tsara suzhud dira, Iblis dotscho - i dara zhinekh, tso la tsa du'ig1ira shen Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchun omrane. Tk'a ash lotsu iza a, tsu'nan zurriet a dottagIii, So a vu'tii, - u'sh shuna mostagIii ma-bu?! Ma von bu-kkh zulamkhoshna /sha'sh bina/ khiitsam!
As u'sh stiglanash a, latta a kkhollaran a, u'sh sha'sh kkhollaran a, teshash tsa khIittiina. So tsa khilira /i San khalk'/ tilosh bersh gIo'nchii lotsurg a.

Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' Tso (Dala) er du: "Kkhaikkha ash sha'sh San nak'ostii bu, bokhush, chIagIbesh khillacha'rga!" U'sh kkhaikkhira tsa'rga. Tsara otsarna zhop tsa delira, Okha khiliitira tsarna iukk'ekh' khIallakkhilar (zho'zhakhati bakhiitar).
Gira k'inosh dinacharna /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe, tsarna khiira sha'sh tsu chu kkhochur duila, tsa kariira tsarna tsunakh dIasakh'ovziila.
Okha /k'astosh/ daliina khIokkhu K'ur'an chokh' nakhana masso a taipa masal. Adam khilira vuno dukkha khIumanashtsa k'u'isush.

Tskh'a a du'kh'alo tsa khilla nakhana /Delakh/ tesha shaiga niisa nek' be'cha, shain Kkhiosh-Kkhobuchu'nga gechdar dekha a - tsa'rga kh'alkhalerachiin masal daro ben, ia shaina kh'alkha Iazap kh1ottaro ben.

Okha tsa bokhku'itu elchanash kkha' bokkkhush a, kkheram tosush a ben. Tsateshachara khartsdolchu'ntsa k'u'isu bak'derg kIelditarkh'ama. San aiatash a, shaina kkheram tesnarg a siisazadesh tIela'tsna tsara.

Mila vu zulame shena shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatash kh'ekhiina, tIakkkha tsarakh iukhava'llachul, shen ku'igasha kh'alkhada'kkkhinargditsdiinachul? Bakk'alla a, Okha tseran degnash chu gIat dillina - tIakkkha u'sh tsunakh (K'ur'anakh) tsa kkheta, tseran lergash chu /iillina/ k'oralla. Akh' u'sh niisachu novk'a kkhaikkhicha a, tsk'elliga tsk'a a nislur bats u'sh.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gechdiirig vu, /Shegakh'/ k'inkhetam (bokkkha) bolush. Tsara /du'nenakh'/ karadinchu'ntsa Tso u'sh /Iazape ia balane/ lo'tsush belakh'ara, tsarna Iazap sikhdiir dara Tso. Tsarna to'khna khan iu, Tsunna tIekhbevla bovda mettig tsk'a a karor ma iats tsarna.
I iartash - Okha khIallakiira u'sh, tsara zulam dicha, u'sh khIallakbarna khan iillira Okha.
Dagadaiita! Musas a'llera shen k'onakhe: "So sotsur vats shi khIord vovshakhkkhetachu mettige kkhachchalts, ia lelar vu ekhkhachu zamanakh'".
I shi' /khIord/ vovshakhkkhetachu mettige kkha'chcha, tsarna shain chIara bitsbelira, tk'a tso /la'ttakhula/ Iu'rg dokkkhush shen nek' khIorda chu billira.
TIakkkha sha'sh - shi' /otsu mettigakh/ chekkhva'lcha, tso elira shen k'onakhe: "Skh'alo vaina vain kkhacha. Vaina du'kh'alkkhiiti khIokkhu vain nek'akh khalo".

Tso (Musatsa khillachu kIanta) elira: "Kh'azhakh'! Vai charaiolchu dirzicha, suna bitsbelira chIara, shaitIano a ben suna i bits tsa baliiti, suna i daga tsa boitush, tk'a tso shen nek' tskh'a tamashe kepara khIorda chu billira".
Tso (Musas) elira: "I dara vaina dezash khillarg". TIakkkha i shi' shain tachcha (lorakh) iukhabirzira.
Tsarna shinna kariira Tkhan leikh tskh'a lai, Okha shena Tkhan gergara k'inkhetam bella volu, Okha shena Tkhaigara Iilma Iamiina volu.
Musas tsu'nga elira: "Kh'una tIa'kh'akhIuttii so, akh' suna Iamorkh'ama kh'aina Iamiinachukh kIorggera bak'derg?"
Tso (Khizras) elira: "Kh'una maggane a mogur dats so'tsa sobar dan.
Mukha diir du akh' sobar, kh'aina shekh khaar dotschu'ntsa".
Tso (Musas) elira: "Kh'una karor vu so, Dala muk'alakh', sobar desh, kh'una Iesa khir vats so omra kkhochushdartsa".
Tso elira: "Kh'o suna tIa'kh'akhIottakh', so'ga ma khattalakh' tskh'ana a khIumanakh latsii, as kh'una shekh derg d1adiitstsalts".
TIakkkha i shi' dIavolavelira kemanna tIekha'alts - tso tsunna Iu'rg da'kkkhira. Tso (Musas) elira: "Iu'rg da'kkkhi akh' tsu'nan nakh bukhabakhiitarkh'ama, tskh'a ircha khIuma ma di akh'!"
Tso elira: "As tsa elira: kh'una maggane a mogur dats so'tsa tskh'ana sobar dan".
Tso (Musas) elira: "Akh' suna bekhk ma billa so vitsvalarna, khalo ma e suna /kkhu/ san gIullakkhakh".
TIakkkha i shi' dIavolavelira tskh'ana kIantana du'kh'alkkhettalts - tso i viira. /Musas/ elira: "/Vanakh/ akh' tsIena sa dii-kkh, sina du'kh'al a dotsush! Ma von khIuma dii-kkh akh'!"
Tso elira: "As tsa a'llera kh'o'ga: kh'una danne a so'tsa sobar dalur dats, a'lla?"
Tso (Musas) elira: "Nagakh' sanna as kh'o'ga khIuma khattakh' khIokkhul tIa'kh'a, - suna nak'ostalla ma de: so'gara bekhkazlo iu kh'una".

TIakkkha i shi' dIavolavelira tskh'ana iu'rtan nakhana tIekkhachchalts. Tsara tsu'nan nakhe daa khIuma diikhira, tk'a tsara du'kh'alo iira tsu shinna kh'oshalla dan. Tsu shinna kariira tsu chokh' iozha iollush kert - tso (Khizras) iza irakhIottiira. Elira /Musas/: "Kh'aina li'nekh', tsunakh makh o'tsur bara akh'".
Tso elira: "Kh1ara suna a, kh'una a iukk'ekh' d1ak'astar du. As dostur du kh'una shetsa sobar dan tsa megnarg:
Amma kema - khIorda chokh' bolkh besh bolchu miskachu nekhan dara iza. Suna liira iza dokho - tsarna tIekh'akh' la'ttash vara pachchakh', masso a /dika/ kema skh'adokkkhush nitsk'itsa.
Tk'a kIant - tsu'nan da-nana mu'min nakh bara, tkho kkho'rura tso tsarna khalakhetiitarna /Delan/ dozanekh valartsa a, /Dalla/ kersta khilartsa a.
Tkhuna liira tseran Kkhiosh-kkhobucho tsu shinna, khiitsina, tsul dikanig /do'zalkho/ loila, tsIena volush, k'inkhetamtsa melkho a gerga volush.

Tk'a kert, i iara gIalakh' shinna kIentan - boberiin, tsunna bukhakh' tsu shinnan khazna iara. Tsu shinnan da vara dika Iamal iolush stag. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna liira i shi' g1emettakh1ottiita, tsa'rga shain khazna skh'aiakkkhiita kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara k'inkhetamtsa. Iza as tsa dina san gIullakkhatsa. I du kh'una shena tIekh' sobar dan tsa megnachun tidar".
Tsara kh'o'ga kho'ttu Shi maIa iolchukhla'tsna. Akh' ala: "As du'itsur du shuna tsunakh la'tsna khabar".
Bakk'alla a, Okha chIagIvira iza la'ttakh', belira tsunna /shen laame kkhacha/ masso a khIumanan nek' (nitsk').
Tskh'ana novk'a khIo'ttira iza.

Malkhbuze kkha'chcha, tsunna kariira i dIabuzush 1a'rzha poppar bolush /dovkha/ shovda dolchu mettigekh', tsu'nan ullokh' tskh'a nakh kariira tsunna. Okha elira: "KhIai Shi maIa erg! Ia Iazap diir du akh', ia akh' tsa'rgakh' dikanig diir du".
Tso elira: "Tk'a zulam dinarg milla velakh', - tIa'kh'a tsunna Iazap diir du okha. TIakkkha shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIeverzor vu iza - Tso Iazap diir du tsunna, ircha Iazap.
Tk'a iiman dillinarg a, dika Iamal iinarg a - tsarna khaza bekkham bu. Okha tsu'nga er du tkhan omrakh atta derg".
TIakkkha tskh'ana /kkhechu/ novk'a khIo'ttira iza.
Malkh skh'akkhetachu mettige kkha'chcha, tsunna kariira i skh'akkhetash tskh'ana nakhana, Okha shaina tsu'nan (ma'lkhan) du'kh'al tskh'a a kh'ulam tsa binchu.
Ishtta dIaletsira Okha tsu'ngakh' derg khaartsa.
TIakkkha tskh'ana /kkhechu/ novk'a khIo'ttira iza.
Shina /la'mniin/ du'kh'alonan iukk'e kkha'chcha, tsunna kariira tsarna bukhakh' /Zul-K'arnain tskh'ana a/ dashakh kkhetash botsu nakh.
Tsara elira: "KhIai ShimaIaerg! Bakk'alla a, Ia'zhuzh a, Ma'zhuzha bo'khanig darzhosh bu la'ttakh'. Okha kh'una -kharzh ioi, akh' tkhuna a, tsarna a iukk'ekh' du'kh'alo iiirig?"
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobucho so shena chokh' chIagIvinarg dika du. Suna nitsk'itsa gIo de, er as shuna a, tsarna a iukk'ekh' chIagIo.
Lo suna echigan kiisikash". Sha u'sh shinna lamanan iistoshkakh' nisiicha, tso elira: "/TsIe/ marsaiakkkha!" Tso tsunakh tsIe khiliiticha, elira: "Skh'alo so'ga, as tsunna tIe laliina echig duttur".
Tsa megira tsarnatsunna tIe bovla a, tsa megira tsarna tsunna Iu'rg dakkkha a.
Tso elira: "KhIara san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara k'inkhetam bu. San Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun vaIda e'cha, Tso la'ttatsa nisiiir iu iza. San Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun vaIda kh'ak'-bak' khilla".
Okha bu'tur bu u'shotsu /k'emat/ diinakh' tskh'abersh vukkharna tIe bettalush. Sur lokkhur iu, Okha u'sh gulbiir bu berrige a.
Kh'alkhaiu'llur iu Okha otsu diinakh' tsateshacharna zho'zhakhati shu'irra.
U'sh bara shain bIa'rgashna du'kh'al pardu dolush So kh'ekhorkh /u'sh dukhatukhush/, u'sh bara ladogIa tsa mogush.
Tsateshnacharna mo'ttu-te sha'sh, So votsurg, San lesh gIo'nchii lu'itsur bu? Okha kechiina zho'zhakhati tsateshacharna chubissa.
Akh' ala: "As bu'itsii shuna Iamalashtsa uggar eshnarsh,
Du'nenan dakhare shain k'akh'egar /erna/ daiina khillarsh, sha'sh dika bolkh besh bu mo'ttush?"
U'sh bu sha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatashna a, Tsunna du'kh'alkkhetarna a kerstanalla dinarsh, erna khilla tseran Iamalsh, khIottor dats Okha tsarna k'ematdiinakh' terza.
I - tsarna bekkham bu - zho'zhakhati: sha'sh kerstanalla darna a, San aiatash a, San elchanash a bakh'orna a.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dikanash dinarsh a - tsarna khilla Firdavsanboshmash chokh' Ian -
Tsu chokh' guttar la'ttash, tsarakh shaina dIatila tsa luush.

Akh' ala: "KhIord san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun deshnashna shek'a khilcha a, - khIord kkhachalur bara san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun deshnash kkhachadalale, tsunakh teranig Okha alssam de'chi a /kkhin khIord khiliiticha a/".

Akh' ala: "So adam du shu sanna, suna va'kh'itsa khaiitina shun Dela tskh'a Dela vuila. Shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna du'kh'alkkhetare dog dokhush khillacho - dika Iamal ioila, shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun Iibadat darekh' tskh'a a nak'ost ma lotsiila".
Kaf-khIa-ia-Iain-sod.
Shen lekh Zakariiakh kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho /bina bolu/ k'inkhetam kh'ekhor /du khIara/.
Kh'akhade! Tso kkhaikkhira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga k'ailakha kkhaikkhartsa.

Elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg (san vezan Dela)! Bakk'alla, san da'Iakhkiin g1ora daina /so k'anvalartsa/, /san/ korta bu'zna k'o'zhachu cho'sha, so tsa khilira Kh'o'ga kkhaikkharekh', /vezan/ Dela, dek'aznig (Akh' san doIina zhop tsa lush tsa vu'tura so - zhop lokh'a suna khIintsa a).
So kkho'ru sol tIa'kh'a bu'suchu san gergarcharakh/tsara Kh'an din dIatasarna/, zuda a khili san ber tsa khu'lush, lokh'a suna Kh'aigara /dika/ do'zalkho.
San irs o'tsur tso, IaIk'uban do'zalan irs a o'tsur tso, Akh' khiliitalakh' iza, so kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, /Kh'o shena/ reza volush".
"KhIai Zakariia! Okha kkha' bokkkhu kh'una kIantatsa, shen tsIe Iakh'ia iolchu. Tsa khiliitina Okha tsul kh'alkha i tsIe erg".
Tso elira: "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, michara khir vara suna kIant?! San zuda a ber tsa khu'lush ma iu, so a vokkkhallekh' dukkha tishvella".
/Delan maliko/ elira: "Ishtta a'lla kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho: "I Suna /dukkha/ atta du, kh'o a kkho'llina As kh'alkha, kh'o khIumma a ma iatsara".
Tso (Zakariias) elira: "So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, tskh'a bilgalo khiliitakh' suna!" Elira: "Kh'una bilgalo iu-kkh akh' nakhe niissa kkhaa bu'isanna khabar tsadiitsar".
TIakkkha shen nakh bolchu aravelira iza mikh'rabachu'ra, tso tsa'rga khaiitira ishar iartsa: "Tasbakh' delash /Dalla/ Iu'irantsa a, su'irantsa a",-a'lla.
/Dala elira/: "KhIai Iakh'ia! Skh'aetsa zhaina nitsk'itsa!" Okha delira tsu'nga kh'ukam i zhimakIant volush.
Tkho'gara k'akhetar a, tsIenalla a/dara iza/. I khilira /Delakh/ kkho'rush a,
Dena-nanna dika a /khilira i/, i vatsara /nakhana/ nitsk' biirig a, Iesa verg a.
Salam du tsunna i du'nena va'llachu diinakh' a, i liir volchu diinakh' a, i iukha /gIattiina/ denviir volchu diinakh' a.
Akh' kh'akhae zhaina chokh' Mar'iam. Zhimma genaelira iza shen nakhakh malkhbalechu mettige.
TIakkkha tso letsira shena tsarna du'kh'al pardo. Okha dakhiitira tsunna tIe Tkhan Sa, i tardelira tsunna niisa dolchu adamakh.
Tso (Mar'iama) elira: "So K'inkhetam bolchu'ntsa /Delatsa) larlo kh'okh, kh'o /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillekh'".
Tso (Dzhabrail maliko) elira: "So kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun elcha vu, kh'una tsIena kIant vala veana".
Tso (Mar'iama) elira: "Michara khir vu suna kIant! Sokh adam a kh'akkha tsa della, so nakhatsa lelash a tsa khilla".
Tso elira: "Ishtta a'lla kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho: "I suna atta du". I (Iisa paikhamar du'nenchu valar) khu'lu'itur du Okha nakhana delil a, Tkhaigara k'inkhetam a. GIullakkh kkhochushkhilla".
I tsunakhberakh iisira, tIakkkha i tsu'ntsa genaelira genarchu mettige.
Ber desh lazar daro i ialiira khurman dittan gIad dolchu, tso elira: "Ella elakh'ara so khIokkhul kh'alkha, - iits'ella ia'lla khir iara so!"
Tso (Dzhabrail maliko) tsu'nga kkhaikkhira tsu'nan (khurman ditta) kIelara: "GIaigIane ma iozha, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kh'una bukhakh' /khin/ tatol khiliitina.
DIasalastade kh'aina khurman dittan gIad, tso egor iu kh'una mad'ella tIeda khurmanash.
Daa, mala, iokkkhae (iokkkha eda). Kh'aina nakhakh milla gakh' a, ala: "So K'inkhetam bolchunna (Dala) markha latsa vaIda iina iu, so takhana iist khir iats tskh'anna adame ".
TIakkkha i iakhara tsu'ntsa (beratsa Iiisatsa) shen nakh bolchu, sha i kh'osh /shen karakh'/, tsara elira: "KhIai Mar'iam, ma tamashe khIuma deana akh'!"
"KhIai KhIarunan iisha! Kh'an da ma tsa khilla von stag, kh'an nana a ma tsa khilla nakhatsa lelash".
Tso (Mar'iamo) tsu'ngakh'a (shen kIant Iiisagakh'a) ishar iira. Tsara elira: "Tkho mukha dist khu'lu sha aganchokh' dolchu bere?"
Tso (zhimchu beras-Iiisas) elira: "So Delan lai vu. Tso so'ga zhaina della, Tso sokh paikhamar khiliitina.
Tso so berkate khiliitina so michchakh' velakh' a. Suna veset dina Tso lamaz a, zakat a, so diina mel la'tta,
San nanna dika khilar a. Tso tsa khiliitina so /nakhana/ nitsk'biirig a, dek'aznig a.
Salam du suna du'nena va'llachu diinakh' a, liir volchu diinakh' a, iukha /gIattiina/ denviir volchu diinakh'!"
Iza vu Iiisa, Mar'iaman kIant - bak'onan dosh, tsara shena chokh' sheko esh dolu.
Dalla tsa khilla /tam bolush/ tskh'a a do'zalkho latsa. Vonakh tsIena vu Iza. Sha tskh'a gIullakkh kkhochushdesh, Tso tsu'nga olu: "Khila!" - iza khu'lu.
" Bakk'alla a, AllakhI - Dela san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a vu, Tsunna Iibadat deisha. KhIara bu niisa nek'".
Otsarakh tobanii iukk'ekh' khilpalonashkhilira: bala bu tsa teshash khillacharna deza-dokkkhachu /k'emat/ diinakh' gur dolchukh.
Ma bilgala khozur du tsarna, ma k'a'ggina gur du tsarna sha'sh Tkhuna tIeda'khkinchu /k'emat/ diinakh'! Delakh' a, zulamkhoi takhana bilgalchu tilar chokh' ma bu.
Kkheram tasa tsarna balanan /k'emat/ diinatsa, gIullakkh kkhochushkhilla u'sh tidama chokh' botsush, u'sh tsa teshash bolush.
Bakk'alla a, Okha irsana o'tsu latta a, tsunna tIekh' mel verg a, Tkhuna tIe iukhaberzor bolush bu u'sh a.
Kh'akhave zhaina chokh' IbrakhIim. Bakk'alla a, iza khilla t1ekh bak'lu'ish verg a, paikhamar a.
Kh'akhade! Tso a'llera shen dega: "Dada, akh' khIunda Iibadat do shena /kh1umma a/ tsa khozuchunna, shena /kh1umma a/ tsa guchunna, sha kh'o tskh'ana a khIumanakh kIelkh'arvokkkhur votschunna?
Dada, so'ga deana Iilmanakh kh'o'ga tsade'narg, suna tIa'kh'akhIotta - as niisachu novk'a vu'llur vu kh'o.
Dada, shaitIanna Iibadat ma dekh'a. Bakk'alla a, shaitIa K'inkhetam bolchunna (Dalla) Iesa khilla.
Dada, so kkho'ru K'inkhetam bolchu'ngara Iazapo kh'o skh'alatsarna - tIakkkha kh'o shaitIanan dottag1 khir ma vu".
Tso (IbrakhIiman das) elira: "Tk'a kh'o k'a'khka san delekh, khIai IbrakhIim? Kh'o tsa satsakh', as kh'una dettane a tIulgash dettar ma du. Genavala suna tskh'ana khanna!"
Tso (IbrakhIima) elira: "Salam du kh'una. As gechdar do'khur du kh'una san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga. Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla so'tsa dukkha dika.
Shukh a dIak'a'sta so, ash, Dela a vitina, shena Iibadat dechukh a. As Iibadat do san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, so tsa khila tarlo san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna Iibadat dartsa dek'aznig".
Iza tsarakh a, Dela a vitina, tsara shena Iibadat dechukh a dIak'a'sticha, Okha tsunna velira Iskh'ak' a, IaIk'ub a - khIorannakh khiliitira Okha paikhamar.
Okha delira tsarna Tkhan k'inkhetamakh /da'khni a, do'zal a/, Okha khiliitira tsarna bak'dolchun mott lekkhachu darzhekh'.
Kh'akhave zhainakh' Musa. Bakk'alla a, iza vara /Dala Shena/ k'astinarg, iza vara elcha a, paikhamar a.
Okha tsu'nga kkhaikkhira lamanana'ttu agIorkh'ara, gergavaliira iza k'ailakhchu k'amelana.
Okha Tkhan k'inkhetamakh /sovg1atna/ velira tsunna shen vasha KhIarun paikhamar khilla.
Kh'akhave zhainakh' IsmaIil. Bakk'alla a, iza vara vaIda bak'iesh verg, i vara elcha a, paikhamar a.
Iza khu'lura shen okhIlanna omra desh lamaztsii, zakattsii, i vara shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' shena /Iza/ reza verg.
Kh'akhave zhainakh' Idris. Bakk'alla a, iza vara t1ekh bak'lu'ish verg a, paikhamar a.
Okha kh'alava'kkkhira iza lekkhachu mettige.

U'sh bu Adaman zu'rretakh bolu Okha Nukh'atsa leliinacharakh a, IbrakhIiman a, Israilan a zu'rretakh a, Okha sha'sh nisbincharakh a, kha'rzhincharakh a bolchu paikhamarekh Dala shaina niImat dellarsh. Shaina K'inkhetam bolchun aiatash deshcha, - gora gIora u'sh suzhd dartsii, belkhartsii.
Tsaral tIa'kh'a tskh'a tIa'kh'e khilira sha lamaz doiush, /deg1an/ shovk'ashna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush. T1a'kh'a begar bu u'sh tilar chu /i bakh'anekh' du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a bekkham khir bu tsarna/.
Toba dinarg a, iiman dillinarg a, dika Iamal iinarg a votsurg. U'sh ialsamani chu gIur bu, tsarna khIumma zulam diir dats.
Iadnan boshmashna chu, K'inkhetam bolcho Shen leshna /tsara i shaina/ gush a iotsush /tsunna 1amal iarna/ vaIda iina iolchu. Bakk'alla a, Iza vara Shen vaIda kkhochushkhir iolush.
Tsarna tsu chokh' desa khabar khezar dats, "Salam"ben, tsarna shain ritsk' khir du tsu chokh' Iu'iranna a, su'iranna a.
I ialsamani iu Okha irsana lush Tkhan lekh /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillachunna.
"Tkho okh'a tsa dussukh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun omratsa ben. Tsu'nan du vain kh'alkhakh' derg a, vain tIekh'akh' derg a, otsarna iukk'ekh' derg a. Tsa khilla kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vitslush".
Stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsarna iukk'ekh' mel dolchun a Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu iza, Tsunna Iibadat de, Tsunna Iibadat darna tIekh' sobar a de. Kh'una vevzii Tsu'nan tsIerkho?
Adamoolu: "So velcha, tIa'kh'a denvina aravokkkhur vu?"
Oila tsa io-te adamna Okha sha kkho'llina khilar kh'alkha - i khIumma ma iatsara?
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh dui bou /As/, Okha gulbiir ma bu u'sh a, shaitIanash a, tIakkkha zho'zhakhatina gonakha balor ma bu gorabakhana.
TIakkkha Okha skh'avokkkhur vu khIor tobanakh K'inkhetam bolchunna du'kh'alo iartsa uggar chIogIa verg.
TIakkkha Tkho dika khuush du sha'sh tsu chokh' baga tam bersh.
Shukh ma vats tsu chu gIush vergben. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun i khilla satsam bollush kkhochushkhillarg.
TIakkkha Okha kIelkh'arbokhur bu sha'sh /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillarsh, zulamkhoi bu'tur bu Okha tsu chokh' gorabakhana.
Shaina bilgala dolu Tkhan aiatash deshcha, tsateshachara elira iiman dillincha'rga: "/Vaikh/ shinnakh mu'lkha toba iu dika bakhamtsa, vovshashtsa tskh'anakkhetartsa khaza?"
Mel khIallakiina Okha tsaral kh'alkha tIa'kh'enash, otsaral vuno khaza iolush kh'olatsa a, gartsa a!

Akh' ala /khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Milla khillekh' a tilar chokh', K'inkhetambolcho iakhio tsunna khan /balane tsa lotsush/ i shena vaIda iinarg: /du'nenan/ Iazap, ia sakh'tshen b1a'rgii kh'alkha kh1ottalts - tIakkkha khuur du tsarna, mila vu von verg mettigatsa, uggar ledar verg eskartsa.
Sovbokhu Dala nisbalagIertarsh niisachu nek'atsa. Bukhaiu'sush iolu dika Iamalsh to'lu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh' melatsa, to'lu dukhaderzor dolchu'ntsaa.
Kh'una girii i Tkhan aiatekh tsateshnarg? Tsoelira: "Suna lanne a lur bu bakham a, do'zal a".
K'ailakhdolchunna t1ekkhi'na- te iza, ia K'inkhetambolchu'ngaravaIda etsna-te tso?"
KhIan-khIa! Okha iazdiir du tso bokhurg, iakhiiir iu tsunna Iazapan khan iakhiartsa.
Okha skh'ao'tsur du irsana tso bokhurg (tsu'nan bakham a, tsu'nan do'zal a i kh1allakvinchul t1a'kh'a), Tkhuna tIe vogIur vu iza tskh'a /da'khni a, do'zal a botsush/.
Tsara la'tsna Dela votsurg /kkhin/ delii, shaina tsarakh sii khilarkh'ama.
KhIan-khIa! Tseran Iibadatna kerstanalla diir du tsara, tsarna mostagIii khir bu tsarakh /k'ematdiinakh'/.
Kh'una tsa khi'na, Okha shaitIanash dakhiitina kerstanashna tIe tsara u'sh lu'ira k'inoshna tIekkhoikkhush (u'sh tsarna khazdesh)?
Sikh ma lo tsarna. Okha tsarna dagardesh du /denosh/ dagardartsa.
Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' Okha gulbiir bu /Delakh/ kkho'rursh K'inkhetambolchunna tIe tIekhevshina.
Okha d1alokhkur bu k'inosh dinarsh zho'zhakhate gIash.
ShapaIatanda khir vats sha K'inkhetambolchu'ngara vaIda etsnarg a ben.
Tsara elira: "K'inkhetambolcho do'zalkho la'tsna /shena/"
Ircha khIuma deana ash.
Stiglanash etIarna gerga du tsunakh, latta dadarna, la'mnash do'khna degarna /gerga du/
Tsara K'inkhetambolchunna do'zalkho kkhaikkhar bakh'anekh'.
Tam bats K'inkhetam bolchunna do'zalkho latsa.
Masso a stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel verg ma vats K'inkhetam bolchunna tIe lai khilla vogIur volush ben.
Tso tseran kh'esap dina, bagarbina u'sh bagarbartsa.
U'sh masso a Tsunna tIe bogIur bu k'ematdiinakh' sha'sh-sha'sh.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a - tsarna K'inkhetambolcho bezam khu'lu'itur bu.
Bakk'alla a, Okha atta dina i (K'ur'an), kh'anmattakh' kh'o'ga /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna tsu'ntsa kkha' bakkkhiita, lu'rachu k'omana tsu'ntsa kkheram tasiita.
Mel khIallakiina Okha tsaral kh'alkha tIa'kh'enash! Khaaloi kh'una tsarakh tskh'a a, ia khezii kh'una tseran tata a?
TIakhIa.
Okha tsa dossiina kh'o'ga K'ur'an kh'una khala khiliita (kh'o'ga balanash kh'egiita).
Kh'ekham khilla ben sha /Delakh/ kkho'rush volchunna.
Sha latta a, lekkha stiglanash a kkho'llinchu'ngara dossosh dolchu kh'olekh' /du khIara/.
Sha sov k'inkhetame verg vu I - Iarsha tIekh' d1anisvella I.
Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' derg a, la'ttakh' derg a, tsu shinnaiukk'ekh' derg a, la'tta bukhakh' derg a.
Akh' dosh chIogIa alakh'a, - bakk'alla a, Iza khuush vu k'aile a, vuno kh'ulamekh' derg a.
/Tskh'a Allakh1/ Dela vu - kkhin dela vats I ben. Tsu'nan iu khaza tsIersh.
Kh'o'ga deanii Musan khabar?

Dagadaiita! Tsunna ma gira tsIe, tIakkkha tso elira shen do'zale: "Shu sovtsa /khIokkhu mettekh'/, suna tsIe khaaella, so van mega shuna tsunakh tskh'a alu iokh'ush, ia suna karor bu tsIera tIekh' niisa nek'".
Iza tsunnatIeve'cha, kkhaikkhira: "KhIai Musa!
Bakk'alla a, So vu kh'an Ela, dIaiakha kh'an machash - kh'o vu TIuva oluchu ezachu atagIakh'.
As kh'o kha'rzhina - ladogIa vekh'etsa du'itsuchu'nga.
Bakk'alla a, So Dela vu, kkhin dela vats So votsurg, Suna Iibadat de, lamaz khIottade So kh'ekhavan.
Bakk'alla a, sakh'tdogIur dolush du, So la'tta i kh'uldesh, khIor sinna sha tIegIertash dolchu'ntsa bekkham khiliita.
Kh'o tsunakh iukha ma vokkkhiila sha tsunakh tsa teshash shen dezarshna tIa'kh'a khIo'ttincho - tIakkkha khIallakkhir vu kh'o.
I khIun iu kh'an a'ttu ku'igakh' erg, kh1ai Musa?"
Tso elira: "I san Iasa iu, so tsunna tIetovzhu, as tsu'ntsa san zhana gIash degado, suna tsu chokh' kkhin paidanash a bu".
Tso (Dala) elira: "DIakkhossa i, kh1ai Musa!"
Tso i dIakkho'ssira - tsunakh chukkhissalush tekkharg khilira.
Tso elira: "Skh'aetsa i, ma kkhera!" Shen kh'alkhalerrachu ku'tse erzor iu i Okha.
Kh'an ku'g kh'an agIonna tIetaIade - kIaidella skh'ader du iza khalo iotsush - kkhin delil du kh'una
Okha kh'o'ga gaita Tkhan dakkkhiichu delilekh.
Kh'ada FirIavnna tIe gIo, - bakk'alla a, i tIekhva'lla /Delan dozanekh/".
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, san dog pargIatdakkkhakh',
Akh' daidekh' suna san gIullakkh.
Akh' bastakh'a san mattakh bolu shad-
TIakkkha u'sh kkhetar bara san dashakh.
Khiliitakh' suna gIo'ncha san okhIlakh,
KhIarun, san vasha.
Tsu'ntsa san nitsk' chIagIbekh'a.
Suna nak'ostalla daitakh'a tsu'nga san gIullakkhekh'.
Okha Kh'una tasbikh' darkh'ama dukkkha a.
Okha Kh'o kh'ekhavarkh'ama dukkkha a.
Bakk'alla a, Kh'o khilla-kkh tkho gush verg".
Tso (Dala) elira: "Kh'una della aikh'a do'khurg, kh1ai Musa.
Okha kkhin /kh'alkha a/ ma binera kh'okh k'inkhetam,
Okha vekh'etsa khaiitira kh'an nene khou'iturg:

"TIorkaza chu villa i, tIakkkha khIorda chu kkhossa i. KhIordo iu'stakha kkhussur vu iza - San a, tsu'nan a mostagIcho skh'ao'tsur vu". As kh'una bezam tesira Saigara, kh'o kkhiarkh'ama San bIa'rgiin kh'alkha.

Kh'an iisha ma iakhara, tIakkkha tso olu: "As tIekh'azhadoi shu ikkhoburg volchunna?" Okha kh'o iukhaverziira kh'an nene tsu'nan bIa'rg buzo, i gIaigIane tsa iozhiita a. Akh' tskh'a stag vira - Okha kh'o kIelkh'arva'kkkhira poshmallakh. Okha ziira kh'o zertsa. Kh'o visira tskh'ana sherashkakh' Mad'ianan nakh bolchokh'. TIakkkha kh'o veara /elchanalla kh'una t1edilla bilgaldinchu/ khennakh', kh1ai Musa.
As Saina /elchalla d1adakh'a/ kha'rzhina kh'o.
Kh'ada, gIuo kh'o a, kh'an vasha a San delilashtsa, ash shimmo ledarlo ma elash So kh'ekhavarekh'
DIagIo shii a FirIavnna tIe, bakk'alla a, i tIekhva'lla /Delan dozanekh/.
Ash shimmo ala tsu'nga kIeda dosh, oila ian tarlo tso, ia kkheravala tarlo iza.
Tsu shimmo (Musas a, KhIaruna a) elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, tkho kkho'ru tso tkhuna vas iarna, ia i tIekhvalarna".
Tso (Dala) elira: "Shu /shi'/ ma kkhera, So shu'tsa vu, khezash vu, gush vu.

DIagIo tsunna tIe, ash ala: "Bakk'alla a, tkho kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun elchanash du. DIabakhkiita tkho'tsa Israilan kIentii, Iazap ma de tsarna. Tkho da'khkina kh'una tIe kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara delilatsa. /Delan 1azapakh/ marsho iu niisachu novk'a t1a'kh'akhIo'ttinchunna.
Tkhuna vekh'etsa khaiitina: Iazap khir du, a'lla, /tsIena Delan din/ khartsdinchunna a, /otsunakh/ iukhava'llachunna a".
Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Mila vu shu'shinnan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, khIai Musa?"
Elira /Musas/: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu, Sha masso a khIumanna kkhollar dellarg a, tIakkkha /i/ niisachu novk'a dillinarg a".
Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Kh'alkha khillachu tIa'kh'eniin gIullakkh mukha du?"
Elira /Musas/: "Tseran Iilma san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' zhaina chokh' du, tila a tsa lo san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, vits a tsa lo.
I vu Sha khiliitinarg shuna latta agasanna, Tso shuna tsu (latta)chukhula nek'ash dikhkina, Tso daiitina stiglara khi". Okha skh'ada'khna tsu'ntsa (khitsa) shinakeparataip-taipana oramatash.
Daa shaina a, da'khni a dazhade. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash ma du kh'ek'al dolcharna.
TsunakhOkha kkho'llina shu, tsu chu Okha shu iukhaderzosh du, tsunakh Okha shu aradokhur dolush du kkhin tsk'a.
Okha tsu'nga (FirIavne) gaitira Tkhan derrige a delilash - tso khartsdira, tso tIe tsa iitsira /u'sh/.
Tso elira: "Kh'o veana tkho tkhan la'ttaraaradakha kh'an bozbuunchallitsa, khIai Musa?

Okha lur ma du kh'una tsunakh terra bozbuunchalla. Khan tokha tkhuna a, kh'aina a iukk'ekh', okha a iokhor iotsush, akh'a a - iukk'era mettig (massarna tIe bakhka atta iolu mettig kharzha vaina k'ovsa)".
Tso (Musas) elira: "Khan iu shuna - khazdaran de, Iu'ire delk'ekh'a io'rzush /ia malkh gIekhkh'a kh'alaba'lcha, tsiga/ nakh gulbar a".
FirIavn d1avakhara, shen mekarlo guliira, tIakkkha veara.
Tsa'rga Musas elira: "Ma bala bu shuna! Ma kkholla Dalla tIekh' khartsderg - Tso Iazap dou'itur du shuna. KhIallakkhilla khartsderg kkho'llinarg".
Tsara k'iisira shain gIullakkh vovshashlakh', k'ailakha kkhetasho iira.
Tsara elira: "KhIara shi' bozbuunchash ma bu. Tsu shinna luush du shu shain la'ttara aradakha shain shinnan bozbuunchallitsa, shun masal khilla dolu nek'dIatilaban luush ma bu u'sh.
DIagul'e shain mekarlo, tIakkkha tskh'a mogIa be. Vokkkhavu'ir vu takhana to'llarg".
Tsara elira: "KhIai Musa, ia akh' kkhussu, ia tkho khir du'khkh'ara kkhussursh?"
Tso elira: "KhIan-khIa, kkhossa ash!" TIakkkha tseran mashshash a, tseran Iasanash a tsunna khaalora tseran bozbuunchallitsa tIekkhissalush.
Musas shegakh' kkheram laira.
Okha elira: "Ma kkhera, bakk'alla a, kh'o vu vuno lakkhakh' verg.
Kkhossa kh'an a'ttu ku'igakh' erg, tso kkhollur iu tsara iinarg. Bakk'alla a, tsara iina bozbuunchiin mekarlo. Vokkkhaver vats bozbuuncha, michchakh'ara ve'cha a".
Bozbuunchash suzhdane begiira. Tsara elira: "Okha iiman dilli KhIarunan a, Musan a Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunga".

Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Ash iiman dilli Tsu'nga as shaina purba dalale kh'alkha? Bakk'alla a, shun vokkkhanigvu iza sha shuna bozbuunchalla Iamiinarg. As khaddane a khador ma du shun ku'igash a, kogash a du'kh'-du'kh'al, as irkh'ukhkur ma du shu khurmanan dittashna tIekh', shuna kha'ane a khuur ma du, mu'lkhanig vu tkhokh Iazaptsa nu'tsk'ala verg a, melkho a bukhavu'surg a".

Tsara elira: "Okha tsk'a a kh'o khorzhur ma vats tso (Musas) tkh'o'ga e'nachu bilgalonel a, tkho kkho'llinchul a (tkhan Delal a/. Kkhochushde aikh'a kkhochushdiirig: akh' kkhochushdiir du-kkh dekk'a kh1okkhu du'nenan dakhar (-an g1ullakkh).

Bakk'alla a, Okha iiman dilli tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga Tso tkhuna gechdarkh'ama tkhan gIalatash a, akh' tkho nitsk' shena tIedakhiitina bozbuunchalla a. Dela - dika a vu, /kh'ol a, massarel a/ bukhavu'surg a vu".
Bakk'alla a, shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe k'inosh dina vogIurg - tsunna khir iu zho'zhakhati, liir vats i tsu chokh', vekhar a vats.
Tsunna (Dalla) tIe iimanekh' a bolush, dika Iamalsh a esh be'narsh - u'sh bu shaina vuno lakkkhara darzhash dersh -
Iadnanboshmash, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar la'ttash. I bu bekkham sha tsIanvellachunna.

Okha vekh'etsa khaiitira Musaga: "Aravala San leshtsa busa, tokha kh1ordakh /kh'an 1asa/ tsarna bek'a nek' khiliita. Ma kkheralakh' /Fir1avnan eskar kh'aina/ tIekkhiarkh, ma kkheralakh' /sha'sh khina bukhadakharkh a /.
Tsarna tIa'kh'avelira FirIavn shen eskartsa - u'sh d1akh'ulbiira khIorda chokh' sha kh'ulbecho.
Tilira FirIavnas shen nakh, niisachu novk'a tsa bikhkira.
KhIai Israilan kIentii! Okha kIelkh'ardekhira shu shun mostagIchukh, vaIda iira shutsalamanan a'ttu agIorakh', Okha dossiira shuna manna a, salva a.
Daa Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'ikh tsIenaderg, tIekh ma dovlalash /dozanekh/ tsu tIekh' - tIakkkha San o'gIazlo kh'a'rchar iu shukh. Shekh San o'gIazlo kh'a'rchinarg - khIallakkhilla.
Bakk'alla a, So vu tIettIa gechdiirig sha toba dinchunna, iiman dillinchunna, dika Iamal iinachunna, tIakkkha nisvellachunna.
"Kh'o steno sikhvi kh'an k'omakh, khIai Musa?".
Tso elira: "U'sh dIogakh' bu san tachcha /bogIush/, so-m sikhvelira Kh'una tIe, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Kh'o reza khilarkh'ama".
Tso (Dala) elira: "Bakk'alla a, Okha pitane la'tsna kh'an k'am kh'ol tIa'kh'a, u'sh-m tilabina Samiriis".

Musa shen k'omana tIe iukhavirzira o'gIazvakhana, poshme a khilla. Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho shu'tsa khaza vaIda tsa iinera tk'a? Iakh'eli shuna vaIda ia shuna lii shaikh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun o'g1azlo kh'archa - ash iokhii san vaIda?"

Tsara elira: "Okha tsa iokhiira kh'an vaIda tkhan nitsk'itsa a, tkhan laamtsa a, delakh' a, tkho'ga skh'abaiitira /masso a/ k'oman khazniin makhkh'ash, Okha u'sh /ts1erga/ kkhissira. Ishtta kkho'ssira Samiiriis".
Tso tsarnaesa skh'ada'kkkhira degIatsa shen Iekhar a dolush, tIakkkha tsara elira: "KhIara shun a Dela vu, Musan a Dela vu. Tso (Musas) vitsvina /i shen Dela, dIavakhana/".
Tsarna tsa go-te: tso (eso) tsarna dosh a iukha tsa derzado, tsu'ngakh' tsarna zen a dats, paida a bats?
Tsa'rga KhIaruna a ma elira kh'alkha: "KhIai san k'am, shu tsu'ntsapitane la'tsna. Bakk'alla a, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg Ar- Rakh'manvu, suna tIa'kh'akhIitta, san omrana mu'tIakh' khila".
Tsara elira: "Tkho sovtsur dats tsunna Iibadat dechukh tkhuna tIe Musa iukhaverzzalts".
Tsoelira: "KhIai KhIarun, kh'una steno novk'arlo ii, u'sh tilabella gicha,
Suna tIa'kh'akhIotta? San omrana Iesa khilla kh'o?"
Tso (KhIaruna) elira: "KhIai san nenan kIant! Ma latsa san mazh a, san korta a. So kkhiirira akh' alarna: "Israilan kIentii bek'na akh', san dosh a tergal tsa di akh'".
Tsoelira: "Kh'an khIun bala bu, khIai Samirii?".
Tso elira: "Suna gira tsarna tsa ginarg: as skh'aletsira elchanantachekh tskh'a kana /chan/, i kkho'ssira as /esa t1e/, ishtta khazdira suna san sino".

Tso (Musas Samiriichu'nga) elira: "DIagIo! Kh'una /du'nenan/ dakharekh' khir du /taIzar/, akh' olush: "Ma kh'akkhale/sokh/". Kh'una to'khna khan iu, iokhor iotsush. Kh'azhal kh'ain dele, kh'o shena Iibadat desh la'ttash volchu, okha i vagavo, tIakkkha okha i varzhor vu chim bina khIorda chokh'".
Shun Dela AllakhI vu, Sha votsurg kkhin dela votsu, masso a khIuma chula'tsna tso Iilmantsa".
Ishtta Okha du'itsu kh'o'ga khabarekh sha kh'alkhadakhnarg, Okha delira kh'o'ga Tkhaigara dagadaitar.
Tsunakh dIak'a'stinarg, milla velakh' a, - bakk'alla a, tso kh'ur ma bu k'ematdiinakh' /k'inoin/ mokh'.
Guttar la'ttash tsu /zho'zhakhati/ chokh' - von khili tsarna k'ematdiinakh' mokh'.
Otsu diinakh' sur lokkhur iu, Okha gulbiir bu otsu diinakh' k'inosh dinarsh /bIa'rgash/ senbella.
Vovshashka shabar-shibar diir du tsara: "Asha-m tsa da'kkkhira /tsigakh'/ itt /de/ ben".
Tkho dika khuush du tsara olurg. Tsarakh lelartsa uggar to'llachara er du: "Asha-m tskh'a /de/ ben tsa da'kkkhina".
Tsara kho'ttu kh'o'ga la'mnekh la'tsna, akh' ala: "Dokhiina darzhor du u'sh san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho".
Du'tur du Tso u'sh niisa ia'ssa mettig khilla.
Kh'una gur iats tsigakh' lokhe a, lakkhe a.
Otsu diinakh' u'sh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttur bu kkhoikkhuchunna, shekh iu'stakhbovliila dotsush, a'znash mukIar khir du Sha sov k'inkhetame volchunna (Dalla), kh'una khezar dats shabar-shibar ben.
Otsu diinakh' paida biir bats shapaIatoSha sov k'inkhetame volcho shena purba dellachunna ben, shen dashnaIza reza khillachunna ben.
Tsunna (Dalla) kha'a tsaral kh'alkha khillarg a, tsaral tIa'kh'a khinderg a, u'sh tIa'kh'akkhu'ur bats Tsunakh Iilmantsa.
Iakhkh'ash mukIar khilira Sha diina volchunna, Sha /Ialamiin gIullakkhashna/ d1akhIo'ttiina volchunna (Dalla), dog dillina visira zulam deanarg (Delatsa nak'ost la'tsnarg).
Sha dikanash dinarg, sha mu'min volush - i kkho'rur vats zulamakh a, eshamakh a.

Ishtta okh'adossiira Okha i Ia'rbiin Deshardina, tsu chokh' kkheramash bilgalbekhira Okha, u'sh kkho'rur batsara-te, a'lla, ia tso tsarna /shail kh'alkha khillarsh khIallakkhilar/ dagadoitur datsara-te, a'lla.
Lakkhaveli Dela - Sha bak'volu pachchakh'! Sikh ma lo K'ur'antsa kh'aiga Tsu'nan vekh'i chekkhdallalts, ala: "So Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg, sovvakkkha so Iilmantsa".
Okha vaIda iinera kh'alkha Adamtsa a - tsunna i iits'elira. Tkhuna tsa kariira tsu'ngakh' chIogIalla.
Kh'akhade! Okha a'llera malikashka: "Suzhud deAdamna". Tsara suzhud dira, iblis dotscho - i du'kh'alkhilira /suzhud dan/.
Okha elira: "KhIai Adam, bakk'alla a, khIara /iblis/ mostagI du kh'una a, kh'an zudchunna a, tso dakhkhane a ialsamani chu'ra ara ma dokhiila shu'shi' - tIakkkha dak'azaver vu kh'o.
Kh'una tsu /ialsamani/ chokh' matsloila a dats, verza-tIerza (verziina) vu'siila a dats.
Kh'o tsu chokh' kh'aglur a vats, /ma'lkhan/ iovkhono vagor a vats".
ShaitIa tIedirzira tsunna /tilavan/, elira: "KhIai Adam, as tIenisvoi kh'o guttarenan a, sha chekkhder dotschu pachchakh'allin a dittana tIe?"

Tsara shimmotsunakh kkha'llira /stom/ - tIakkkha tsarna shinna sha'shshinnan evkh'e mettigash guchuevlira - u'sh bu'ilabelira shaina tIe ialsamanin gIash letadan. Adamo Iesalla iira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna - i tilavelira.
TIakkkha shen Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kha'rzhira iza, toba k'oboldira tsu'nan, nisvira /niisachu novk'a/.

Tso (Dala) elira: "Okh'adissa shu shi' tsu /ialsamani/ chu'ra shun zu'rretakh tskh'abersh vakkharna mostag1ii khilla /la'ttakh'/ tskh'a'nakkhetar bolchu kh'olekh'. Shu'ga be'cha So'gara niisa nek', tsu San nek'ana tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg - i tilalur vats, i dek'azaver vats.
So kh'ekhorakh iukhava'llarg - sov gotta bakham bu tsu'nan. Okha gulviir vu i k'ematdiinakh', bIa'rsa a dotsush.
Tso er: "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' khIunda gulvi so, bIa'rsa a dotsush, so bIa'rsa dolush ma vari-i?"
Tso (Dala) elira: "Ishtta deara kh'o'ga Tkhan aiatash - akh' u'sh ditsdira. Ishtta takhana kh'o vitsviir vu".
Ishtta bekkham bo Okha tIalam tsa binchunna, shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatekh tsa teshnachunna. Ekhartan Iazap melkho a chIogIa a du, /khanna/ dekha a du.
U'sh nis tsa bina-te Okha shail kh'alkha mel khIallakiinchu tIa'kh'enasha? - tseran bakhamashkakhula d1asalelash ma bu u'sh! Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash ma du, kh'ek'al dolcharna.
Doshkh'alkha tsa da'llekh'ara kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara, ikhilaza tsaderig dara, tsIe to'khna khan a /tsa khillekh'ara/.

Akh' sobar de tsara du'itsuchunna tIekh', kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tasbakh' de malkh skh'akkhetale a, i dIabuzale a. Bu'isanan zamanashkakh' atasbakh' de, diinan tIegIeshkakh' a, - kh'o reza khila tam bara.

Kh'an bIa'rgash danne a ma kkhiidadeOkha tsarakh shaina niImat dellachu maroshka-zudarshka - du'nenan dakharan zazadakkkhar du iza, u'sh tsu chokh' Okha zerkh'ama. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun ritsk' dika a, vuno khanna dekha a du.
Omra de kh'an okhIle lamaz de, alii, tsu tIekh' sobare khila. Okha tsa do'khu kh'o'ga ritsk'. Okha lur du kh'una ritsk'. TIa'kh'e- /Delakh/ kkherarekh' iu!
Tsara elira: "Tso (paikhamara) de'nekh'ara vaiga shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara tskh'a /bilgala/ delil?" Tsa'rga tsa eana tk'a bilgalo kh'alkhalerchu zhainashkakh'?

Okha u'sh khIallakbinekh'ara Iazaptsa tsul (paikhamaral) kh'alkha, tsara er ma dara: "Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' vaiitinekh'ara tkho'ga elcha, - tkho tIa'kh'akhIu'ttur ma dara Kh'an aiatashna, tkho siisaza khilale, tkho iu'kh'Ia'rzha khIottale?"
Akh' ala: "Masso a kh'o'zhush vu, kh'ezha shu a, tIakkkha tIa'kh'a khuur du shuna, mu'lsh bu niisachu nek'an dai, mu'lsh bu nisbellarsh".
Gergadeana nakhana shaitsa kh'esap dar, u'sh tIakkkha a tergo tsa esh, /ekhartan Iamal iarkh/ dIabirzina ma bu.
Tsa'rga tsa bogIu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara tskh'a a kerla kh'ekham tsara tsu'nga ladugIush ben, sha'sh lovzush a dolush. (Zabare lotsu tsara i).

Shain degnash /tsu'nan ma'1nakh/ tidambotsush dolush. K'ailada'kkkhira khabar zulam dinachara: "KhIaraadam ben dats shu sanna? Bozbuunchalla k'obaldo ash, shaina gush a dolush /i bozbuunchalla duila/?"
Tso (paikhamara) elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kha'a dosh, stiglakh' a, la'ttakh' a /a'lla dolu/. Iza khezash verg a, khuush verg a vu".
KhIa', tsara elira: "Vovshakh iinagIenash du. KhIa', tsokkho'llina i. KhIa', iza illancha vu. Vaiga tskh'a delil daiita tso, kh'alkhalernash bakhkiitare terra".
Iiman tsa dillira tsaral kh'alkha a Okha khIallakiinchu tskh'ana a iu'rto. KhIokkhara iiman du'llur dara?
Okha tsa bakhkiitira kh'ol kh'alkha a bozhariiben, Okha tsa'rga vekh'esh lush. Khattal kh'ekhambolchu nakhe, sha'sh tsa khuush khillekh'.
Okha tsa khiliitira tsarakh kkhacha tsa bou degI, u'sh tsa la'ttira daima.
TIakkkha Okha bak'khiliitira tsa'rtsa (elchanashtsa khilla) vaIda. Okha kh'alkhabekhira u'sh a, Tkhaina luursh a, Okha khIallakbira tIalambotsursh (elchanash khartsbinarsh).
Okha dossiina shu'ga zhaina /khIai Ia'rbii/, shena chokh' shu kh'ekhor /shukh siidar/ dolush /i shun mattakh' khilartsa/, shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?
Masa iokhiina Okha zulame khilla iolu iurt! Kkhiiira Okha tsaral tIa'kh'a kkhin k'a'mnash.
Shaina Tkhan nitsk' khaabelcha, u'sh tsunakh sikha bovdu.
"Ma dovda! Iukhaderza shu shena chokh' /kh'alkha/ niImat khillachu /dakharna/, shain khIusamashka shu'ga bart khattarkh'ama ".
Tsara elira: "Bala bu-kkh tkhuna! Bakk'alla a, tkho khilla-kkh zulamkhoi!"
I tseran uzarsh tsa setsira Okha sha'sh kh'a'kkhna ialtin are sanna khilliittalts, sha'sh dIatiina a bu'sush.
Okha tsa kkho'llina stigal a, latta a, tsa'rshinna iukk'ekh' erg a Tkha'sh lovzush.
Tkho khillekh'ara sink'eram bezash /zudchuntsa ia do'zalkhochuntsa/, Okha i etsna khir bara Tkhaigara (Tkhan gergakh' bolchu kh'urulIinekh a, malikekh a), Okha i desh khilcha.
KhIa', Okha bak'dolchu'ntsa tukhu khartsdolchunna tIe - tso i daia, i khIallakkhu'lu. Shuna balabu sha'sh /Tkhuna t1e/ kkhulluchu /kharts/ sibatekh.
Tsu'nan bu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel bersh. Tsunna gergakh' bersh kura tsa bovlu Tsunna Iibadat dan, kIad tsa lo u'sh.
Tsara tasbakh' do busa a, diinakh' a, u'sh lagI tsa lush.
Tk'a tsara etsna-te delii la'ttakh, tsara denbesh /bellarsh/?
Tsu shinnakh'a aAllakhI votsurg /kkhin/ delii khillekh'ara - u'sh shi'a khIallakkhilla khir iara. TsIena vu i Dela, Iarshan Da, tsara /Shena t1e/ kkhulluchu kharts sibatekh.
Tsu'nga tsa khottu Tso dechukh, tsa'rga khottur du /tsara du'nenakh' dinchukh la'tsna/.

Tk'a tsara liitsina I votsurg /kkhin/ delii? Akh' ala: "Dalade shain teshallash! KhIara kh'ekham bu so'tsa bolcheran a (K'ur'an), sol kh'alkha khillacheran a (Tavrat a, Inzhil a, kkhin zhainash a - tsarna chokh' massankh'a a Dela tskh'a'khilar chIag'desh du). KhIa', dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a bak'derg, u'sh du'kh'albevlla".
Okha tsa vakhiitina kh'ol kh'alkha tskh'a a elcha, Okha shega vekh'etsa khou'itush ben kkhin dela vats So ben, Suna Iibadat deisha, a'lla.
Tsara elira: "La'tsna K'inkhetam bolchodo'zalkho". Vonakh tsIena vu Iza! U'sh-msiilakh' bolu lesh bai!
U'sh (paikhamarash) Tsul kh'alkha tsa bovlu dashtsa, u'sh Tsu'nan omratsa 1amal esh bu.
Tsunna kha'a tseran kh'alkhakh' derg a, tseran tIekh'akh' derg a, tsara shapaIatdiir dats Iza shena reza khillachunna ben, u'sh Tsunakh kkho'rush, egosh bu.
Milla velakh' a, tsarakh olush: "So vu dela, Iza a votsush",-tsunna bekkham biir bu Okha zho'zhakhatitsa. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha zulamkhoshna.
Tsateshacharna tsa go-tekh'a stiglanash a, latta a khilla khilar vovshakhkhottadella? Okha u'sh k'astiira! Okha kkho'llira khikh masso a diina (sa dolu) khIuma. U'sh tsa tesha-te?
Okha khiliitira la'ttakh' la'mnash, iza tsa'rtsa chIagIdaliitarkh'ama. Okha khiliitira tsu chokh' togIin nek'ash - u'sh niisachu novk'a bakha megar-kkh.
Okha khiliitira stigalakh sha Ialashbesh bolu tkhov, tk'a u'sh tsu'nan (stiglan) aiatekh d1abo'rzush bu /oila tsa esh/.
Iza vu Sha kkho'llinarg bu'isa a, de a, malkh a, butt a. Masso a shen mettekh' neka desh iu.
Okha tsa khiliitina adamna kh'ol kh'alkha a abade. Tk'a kh'o velcha, u'sh guttar la'ttar bolush bu-te?
Masso a sino Iovshur du dalar. Okha zu'ir du shu vonatsa a, dikantsa a pitanakhilla. Tkhuna tIe iukhaderzor dolush a du shu.
Tsateshacharna kh'o gicha, kh'o siisazvoi ben tIe tsa lotsu tsara: "KhIara vu shun delii kh'ekhosh verg?" Tk'a u'sh K'inkhetam bergkh'ekhorna kersta bu.
Adam kkho'llina sikhonakh. Goitur du As shuna San delilash, ash So sikh ma ve!
Tsara olu: "Matsa khir iu i vaIda /kkhochush/, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'?"
Khaakh'ara tsateshacharna sha'sh shain iakhkh'ashna tIera a, shain bakk'ashna tIera a tsIe dIa to'ttur iotsu, shaina gIo khir dotsu khan! /Ma sikh diir datsara tsara tIakkkha i Delan Iazap/!
KhIa', tsarna tIe dogIur du i /k'ematde/ tsIekhkh'ana, u'sh kh'ere biir bu tso, tsarna mogur dats i dukhatokha, u'sh /tsunakh/ tIa'kh'atottur a bats.
Siisazbina elchanash kh'ol kh'alkha a. Tsarakh (elchanekh) tsa beshash khillacharakh shaikh kh'akkhadelira sha'sh siisazdesh khillarg.
Akh' ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Kh'an lardiir du shu busa a, diinakh' a K'inkhetam bolchukh /Delakh-Tsu'nan Iazapakh/?" KhIa', u'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhoburg kh'ekhorkh d1abo'rzush ma bu.
Ia tseran, Tkho dotsurg, /kkhin/ delii bu-te, sha'sh u'sh dukhatukhur bolush /Iazapakh/? Tsarna mogur dats shaina gIo dan a, u'sh Tkhokh /Tkhan Iazapakh/ laror ma bats.
KhIa', Okha niImatash dellera khIokkharna a, tseran daishna a shaina tIekh' o'mar iakh'iallalts. Tsarna tsa go-te Tkho dokhkush latta eshadesh shen iistashkakhula? U'sh bu tk'a to'llarsh?
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, as shuna kkheram tosu vekh'etsa. Tsa kheza-kkh k'ora bolcharna kkhaikkham, shaina kkheram tosush".
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun Iazapan khIo kh'akkharo sha'sh skh'aletscha, tsara allane a er ma du: "Ma /bokkkha/ bala bu-kkh tkhuna! Tkho khilla-kkh zulamkhoi!"
Okha khIottor iu k'ematdennaniisonan terzanash, zulam diir dats sinna /tskh'ana a/ khIumantsa. KIollan bu'rtigan baramekh' erg a dIalur iu Okha. Kh'esap diirash khila kkhacho iu Tkhan.
Okha belira Musaga a, KhIarune a k'astam a, serlo a, kh'ekham a /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna.
Ishttanash bu u'sh, sha'sh kkho'rush shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh, I /b1a'rgashtsa/ gush votstsushekh', u'sh bu sakh'takh/kkho'rush/, begabesh.
KhIara /K'ur'an/ berkate kh'ekham bu, Okha sha bossiina bolu. Ash tsunna inkarlo io?
Okha belira IbrakhIime a kh'alkha shen niisa nek', Tkho i vevzash dara.
Kh'akhade! Tso a'llera shen dega a, tsu'nan k'ome a: "KhIorsh khIun su'rtash (zha1arsh) du, shu shaina guora o'khush dolu?"
Tsara elira: "Tkhuna kariina tkhan dai tsarna Iibadat desh".
Tso (Ibrakh1ima) elira: "Shu a, shun dai a khilla-kkh bilgalchu tilar chokh'".
Tsara elira: "Kh'o tkhuna veana-te bak'dolchu'ntsa, ia kh'o /tkho/ lovzocharekh vu-te?!"
Tso elira: "KhIa', shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Sha u'sh kkho'llina a vu /khIumma iotschu khIumanakh/, so otsunna tIekh' teshalla decharakh vu-kkh.
Delatsa dui bou as: shun tsIushna (zha1arshna) ianne a mekarlo iiir ma iu as shu /tsarakh/ bakk'ash berziina genadevllachul tIa'kh'a ".
TIakkkha tso tsarakh keskash iira, tseran iokkkhanig iissalts - u'sh tsunna tIe berza megara.
Tsara elira: "Kh'an dina khIara vain delashna? Bakk'alla a, i zulam dinacharakh vu-kkh!"
Elira /tsarakh Ibrakh1ima a'llarg kheznachara/: "Tkhuna khezira tskh'a kIant u'sh (vai delii) kh'ekhosh, tsunakh IbrakhIim olura".
Elira /pachchakh'a Namruza a, tsu'nan kh'oldaisha a/: "Skh'avalave iza nekhan bIa'rgashna kh'alkha - tsara teshalla dan megara".
Tsara elira: "Akh' dina khIara tkhan delashna t1ekh', khIai IbrakhIim?"
Tso elira: "KhIan-khIa. I dina khIokkhu tsarakh vokkkhucho. Ash tsa'rga khattiisha, u'sh bistkhu'lush khillekh'!"
U'sh sha'sh shaina tIebirzira, tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, shu du-kkh zulamkhoi!"
T1akkkha tseran kortosh okh'abakhiitira/ekh'khetaro/, /olush/: "Kh'una ma kha'ii kh1orsh bist tsa khu'lii".
Tso (IbrakhIima) elira: "Tk'a ash Iibadat do, Dela a vu'tii, shaina khIumma a paida a tsa bechunna, zen a tsa dechunna?
Tuf! Shuna a, Dela a vitina, ash Iibadat decharna a! Shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu-te?"
Tsara elira: "Vagave i (IbrakhIim), gIo de shain delashna, sha'sh /gIullakkh/ desh khillekh'!"
Okha elira: "KhIai tsIe! Kh'okh khilalakh' IbrakhIimna shelo a, marshoa".
Tsarna iiizira tsunna du'kh'al mekarlo- Okha u'sh khiliitira dokkkha zen khillacharakh.
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, LutI a, Okha sha Ialamashna berkate dinchu lattat1e /Shama d1akh'azhiira/.
Okha tsunna velira Iskh'ak' a, kkhin sovgIatana IaIk'ub a. /U'sh/ berrige a khiliitira dikanash.
Okha tsarakh khiliitira tkh'amdanash, Tkhan omratsa sha'sh /nakhana/ niisa nek' goitush. Okha tsa'rga khaiitiradikanash dar a, lamaz khIottadar a, zakat dalar a. U'sh khilira Tkhuna Iibadat desh.
LutIana a delira Okha kh'ukam a, Iilma a. Okha i kIelkh'arva'kkkhira sha bo'khanash desh khilla iolchu iu'rtara. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira vonan nakh, pesak'ash.
Okha iza (LutI paikhamar) vo'llira Tkhan k'inkhetam chu. Bakk'alla a, iza dikacharakh vu.
Nukh' a, tso kkhaikkhira kh'alkha. Okha tsunna zhop delira: kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, tsu'nan do'zal a bokkkhachu balanakh.
Okha larvira iza Tkhan aiatash khartsdinchu nakhakh. Bakk'alla a, u'sh bara vochu khIumanan nakh, Okha u'sh berrige a /khina/ bukhabakhiitira.
Davudana a, Suleimanna a, sha'shshimmo kh'ukam dechu khenakh' /ialtin/ arenakh la'tsna, sha nekhan u'stagIasha kh'a'shna khilla iolchu. Tkho khilira tseran kh'ukaman teshash.

Okha tsunakh (kh'ukamakh) kkhetiitira Suleiman a. /Tsu shinnakh/ kh1oranna a Okha delira kh'ukam a, Iilma a. Okha mu'tIakh' dira Davudana la'mnash - tsara tasbakh' a desh, olkhazarsh a /dira Okha tsunna mu't1akh'/, tkho khilira /gIullakkh/ diirash.
Okha tsunna Iamiira shuna bedarshiar, tsara shu Ialashdarkh'ama shun /mostag1iin/ nitsk'akh. Ash barkalla tsa olu?
Suleimanna a /mu'tIakh' bira Okha/ nu'tsk'ala mokh - dIasalelash Tkhan omratsa Okha sha berkate dina khillachu la'ttakhula. Tkho khilla masso a khIuma khuush dersh.
ShaitIanekha khilla tsunna/khIorda/ chu lelkhash, i dotsurg a, kkhin belkhash a besh, Tkho khilira u'sh Ialashdiirash.
Aiub a /kh'akhave/. Tso kkhaikkhira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga: "So balano la'tsna, Kh'o k'inkhetam bolcharakh a uggar k'inkhetame verg vu-kkh".
Okha tsunna zhop delira, aibira tsu'ntsa khilla bala, belira tsunna shen do'zal a, tsa'rtsa tskh'ana kkhin ishttal, Tkhan gergara k'inkhetam a khilla, Iibadat decharna kh'ekham a khilla.
/Kh'akhave/ IsmaIil a, Idris a, Zul'-Kifla, masso a sobare khillacharakh bu.
Tkhan k'inkhetam chu bakhiitira Okha u'sh. Bakk'alla a, u'sh dikacharakh bu.

Zun-Nuna, dIavakhara iza o'gIazvakhana, tsunna khaalora Okha sha gatviir votsiila ta1zar dartsa. TIakkkha tso kkhaikkhira bodanekh': "Kh'o votsurg kkhin Dela vats, vonakh tsIena vu-kkh Kh'o, so khilla-kkh zulam decharakh".
Okha tsunna zhop delira, i kIelkh'arva'kkkhira singattamakh. Ishtta kIelkh'arbokhu Okha mu'min nakh.
Zakariia /kh'akhave/, tso kkhaikkhira shenKkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga: "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, ma vitakh' so tskh'a, Kh'o irs lucharakh uggar dikanig ma vara!"

Tsunna a zhop delira Okha, velira tsunna /kIant/ Iakh''ia, Okha tsunna toialiitira tsu'nan zuda. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira sikhlush dikanash darekh', Tkho'ga kkhoikkhura dog dokhush /Tkhan dikane/, kkho'rush /Tkhan Iazapakh/. U'sh khilira Tkhokh kkho'rush.
I shen io1stagalla Ialashdinarga /kh'ekhaie/, Okha tsunna Tkhan sikh sa chudillira. Tsunakh a, tsu'nan kIantakha /masso a/ Ialamna delil khiliitira Okha.
Bakk'alla a, khIara shun ummattskh'a ummat du, So shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a vu, Suna Iibadat deisha.
Tsara (tIa'kh'abogIuchara) diik'irashain gIullakkh vovshashna iukk'ekh'. Masso a Tkhuna tIe iukhabo'rzu.
Dikanash desh verg, sha mu'min volush - khir iats tsu'nan k'akh'egarna inkarlo, bakk'alla a, Tkho tsunna iazdesh du.
Kh'aram du Okha sha khIallakiinchu iu'rta (-n dai) iukhaberza
Ia'zhuzh a, Ma'zhuzha guchubovllalts. U'sh masso a ag1orkh'ara, lakkharchu mettigashkara okh'akhetsalur bu.
Gergaeana bak'iolu vaIda, tsa teshash khillacheran bIa'rgash tIeba'lla: "Ma bala bu-kkh vaina, vai dar-kkh khIara tergal tsa desh, vai khilla-kkh zulam dinarsh"/er du tsara/.
Bakk'alla a, shu a, Dela a vitina, ash shaina Iibadat desh bersh a, zho'zhakhatin iagorig iu, shu tsu chu gIur dolush a du.
U'sh delii khillekh'ara, - tsu chu gIur batsara. Masso a tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar vu.
Tsarna tsu chokh' khala sa iizar a du, tsarna tsu chokh' khezar a dats.
Bakk'alla a, shaina Tkho'gara dikanig kh'alkhada'llarsh - u'sh tsunna (zho'zhakhatina) genakh' khir bu.
Tsarna khezar dats tsu'nan (zho'zhakhatin) shakh-shikh a, u'sh shain sinoshna deznachokh' guttar la'ttar bu.
U'sh singattame biir bats bokkhachu kkheramo, tsarna du'kh'alkkhetar du malikash /olush/: "KhIara du shun de, shuna khir du a'llarg".

Otsu diinakh' Okha tIeguliiir iu stigal, zhainan kekhatash tIeguldare terra. Okha du'khkh'ara kkhollar dolore terra, karladokkkhu Tkhuna tIekh' khilla iolchu vaIditsa. Bakk'alla a, Tkho khilla /gIullakkh/ desh dersh.
Okha iazdinera Zaburachokh' kh'ekhamaltIa'kh'a: "La'ttakh irs o'tsur du San dikachu lesha".
Bakk'alla a, khIokkhu chokh' kkhochchush kkhetam bu Iibadat dechu nakhana.
Okha tsa vakhiitina kh'o /khIai Mukh'ammad/ masso a Ialamna k'inkhetam khilla a ben.
Akh' ala: "Suna va'kh'itsa khaiitina shun Dela tskh'a' vuila. Shu mu'tIakh'khu'lii?"
U'sh dIaberzakh', akh' ala: "As dIakkhaikkhiina shu'ga tskh'aterra, suna tsa kha'a, gerga du, ia gena du shuna vaIdaiinarg.
Bakk'alla a, Tsunna (Dalla) kha'a dashakh khezash derg a, Tsunna kha'a ash k'ailadokkkhush derg a.
Suna tsa kha'a i /shuna taIzar tsa desh tIa'kh'atattar/ khila tarlo shuna pitana /zer/ a, tskh'a khan iallalts bakham a".

Elira /Mukh'ammad paikhamaro/: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' de-kkh bak'ontsa kh'ukam /suna a, kh1ara din khartsdecharna a iukk'ekh'/. Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu sov k'inkhetame verga, ash sibat dechunna tIekh'Shegara gIo etsa dezash verg a ".
KhIai nakh! Kkhera shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh. Bakk'alla a, sakh't degardokkkha-deza khIuma du.

Otsu diinakh', shuna shaina gush, masso a /ber/ dakkhosh erg iitslur iu sha dakkhiinachukh, okh'abu'llur bu shen /kiirakh'/ mokh' bolchoshen mokh'/khenaza/, kh'una gur bu nakh bekhna - bekhna bats u'sh, delakh' a, Delan Iazap chIogIa du.
Nakhakh vu sha Delekh' k'u'isush verg /tskh'a a/ Iilma dotsush, sha tIa'kh'akhIuttush verg kh1or a'rkhada'llachu shaitIanna.
Tsunna (shaitIanna) iazdella shetsa dottagIalla leliinarg sha tilor a vu, tsIeran Iazape dIanisviir a vu, a'lla.

KhIai nakh! Shu khillekh' iukha dendina /gIovtorakh/ shekona chokh' - Okha shu kkho'llina popparakh, tIakkkha tIadamakh, tIakkkha tsIiinan ulkhakh, tIakkkha zhizhigan kiisakakh, kep iolush dolchukh a, kep iotsush dolchukh a shuna bilgaldakkkharkh'ama /Tkho nitsk' bolush duila/. Okha dIanisdo /shu/ beran tsIiinachokh' Tkhaina ma lu'u tsIe to'khna khan tIekkkhachchalts, tIakkkha Okha aradokhu shu ber khu'lii, tIakkkha shu tIekkhiarkh'ama shain nitsk'ina. Shukh lesh verg a vu, shukh /k'anvalartsa/ uggar siisazchu dakharna tIeverzosh verg a vu, shena /dukkkha a kh1umanash / khuush khillachul tIa'kh'a khIumma a tsa khaiitarkh'ama. Kh'una go latta dak'adella. Okha shena tIe khi dossiicha, i dettalo, desta, /tsu'ntsa/ kkhu'u masso a khaza shishsha taipa /iarash/.
Iza du - Dela khilarna bak'derg, Tso denbiirig khilarna bellarsh, Iza khilarna masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk'berg.
/Iza du/ - sakh'tdogIurg khilarna, tsu chokh' sheko iats, Dela khilarna denbina gIovtor bolush keshnii chokh' bersh.
Nakhakh vu sha Delekh' k'u'isush verg, shegakh' Iilma a dotsush, niisa nek' a botsush, nu're dolu zhaina a dotsush.
/Kuralla iartsa/ shen lag dIagIertosh Delan novk'akh /nakh/ tilabarkh'ama. Tsunna du'nenakh' a siisazalla iu, Okha Iovshu'itur du tsu'nga k'ematdiinakh' tsIeran Iazap.
/Tsu'nga er du/: "I du kh'an shina ku'igo kh'alkhada'kkkhinarg bakh'anekh', Dela tsakhilarna a zulamash diirig leshna".

Nakhakh vu sha Dalla Iibadat desh verg u'rallin iu'kh'iga tIekh'volchukh tera: shekh kkhi'cha dikanig, tsu'ntsa pargIatvolu iza, shekh pitana (bala) kkhi'cha, shen iu'kh' tIe dIavo'rzu i /tsatesharna tIe/ - du'ne a, ekhart a daiina tso. Iza bilggala esham bu-kkh!
Tso kkhoikkhu Dela votsuchu'nga, shena zen tsa dechu'nga, shena paida tsa bechu'nga. Iza du-kkh genara tilar!
Tso kkhoikkhu shena /khu'luchu/ paidanal shena zen gerga dolchu'nga- ma von ela vu-kkh, ma von nak'ost vu-kkh /tso la'tsnarg, Dela a vitina/!
Bakk'alla a, Dala chubokhu'itur bu iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a boshmashna, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush iolchu. Bakk'alla a, Dala do Shena luurg.

/Shen elchanna/ Dala du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a gIo diir dats mo'ttush khillarg - tso mush dIatosiila tkhov tIe irkhkkhazvala, tIakkkha khadadoila /shen lag/, tIakkkha kh'ozhiila shena, dIadekh'nii-te tsu'nan mekarlos i o'gIazvokhu'iturg.
Ishtta dossiira Okha i /K'ur'an/ bilgala aiatash khilla, Dela khilarna a nisvesh Shena luurg /niisachu novk'a/.

Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, zhu'gtiin dinekh' bersh a, sabiinash a, nasarash a, tsIeran gIullakkh desh bersh a, /Delatsa/ nak'ost la'tsnarsh a... Bakk'alla a, Dala k'astor du tsarna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh'. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' tesh vu.

Kh'una tsa go Dalla suzhud ma doi stiglanashkakh' volcho a, la'ttakh' volcho a, malkho a, batto a, sedarchasha a, la'mnasha a, dittasha a, diinatasha a, nakhakh dukkhabolchara a? Dukkhabolcharna Iazap kh'ak' khilla. Dala siisazvinarg, milla velakh' a, - ma vats tsunna sii aidan tskh'a a. Bakk'alla a, Dala do Shena luurg.
KhIokkhu shina mostagIchoshain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngakh' k'iisira. Tsateshnarsh - tsarna bedarsh khador iu tsIarakh, tseran kortoshna tIe duttur du ts1iidina khi.
Dagor du tsu'ntsa tseran gaish chokh' derg a, chk'or a.
Tsarna a'chkan chkh'onkarsh iu.
Tsarna tsu chu'ra balakh'egarkh arabovla mel lii, tsu chu iukhaberzor bu u'sh /er du/: "Iovsha shaina tsIeran Iazap!"

Bakk'alla a, Dala chubukhkur bu iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalash iinarsh a /ialsamanin/ boshmashna, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush iolchu, khazbina khir bu u'sh tsu chokh' dashochu chIagarshtsa a, zhovkhIarshtsa a, tseran dukhar tsu chokh' khir du dari.
U'sh nisbina /du'nenakh'/ dashakh khazachu'nga /K'ur'anakh/, u'sh nisbina khastamechu novk'a.

Bakk'alla a, tsateshnarsh a, sha'sh /nakh/ dIatottush bersh a Delan nek'akh a, Dezachu ma'zhdigakh a, Okha sha nakhana tskh'anissa /siilakh'/ khiliitina dolchu shena chokh' volchunna a, arara /ziiarate/ ve'nachunna, tsu chokh' zulamtsa bak'dolchukh d1akh'avzar /Delakh tsateshar/ dezash verg a - Okha Iovshu'itur du tsa'rga lazosh dolu Iazapakh.

Kh'akhade: Okha bilgal'ia'kkkhira IbrakhIimna /Kh'a'zh/tsIiinan mettig, olush: "Ma latsa So'tsa nak'ost tskh'ana a khIumantsa, tsIande San tsIago bokkkhucharna a /t1avaf desh/, khIo'ttina la'ttacharna a, rukIebakhancharna a, suzhdanebakhancharna a.
Kkhaikkha nakhalakh' kh'a'zhalla: u'sh (mu'min nakh) bogIur bu kh'una gIash a, kh1or ezachunnatIekh' a, sha'sh iogIush khilla iolchu kh1or tu'para bo'rara
Teshalla dan shaina paidanashna, Delan tsIe kh'ekhaian a tskh'ana bilgalchu denoshkakh', Tso shaina ritsk'ina dellachu bezhanna tIekh'. Daa tsunakh, daade balakho'guchunnaa, pek'arnaa.

TIakkkha dIaiokhiila tsara /Kh'a'zh dekhkartsa/ shain bo'khallash (gIurban bezhna dinchul tIa'kh'a korta basha ia larga, maIarsh teda...), kkhochushdoila shain nuzarsh, gobokkkhiila Shirchu TsIiinna".

/GIullakkh ishtta du/. Delan kh'urmatash dazdesh verg - i tsunna shena dika du shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh'. Kh'anal dina shuna bezhanash /daa/, shuna tIekh' do'shushdotsursh. Genadovla tsIuin (zha1ariin) rizhsakh, genadovla kharts dashakh

Dalla tIedirzinarsha khilla, Tsu'ntsa nak'ost la'tsnarsh tsa khu'lush. Tk'a Delatsa nak'ost lotsurg... i tera vu stiglara vo'zhnachukh, tIakkkha olkhazarsh skh'alotsush, ia mekho genarchu mettige dIavu'gush volchukh.
/GIullakkh ishtta du/. Delan Iedalashdazdesh verg, - bakk'alla a, izadegnash /Delakh/ kkherarkh du.
Shuna tsu chokh' paidanash bu tsIeto'khna khan tIekkhachchalts, tIakkkha tseran /urs kh'akkha kh'anal iolu/ mettig Shirchu TsIiinan gergakh' iu.

KhIor ummatana a Iibadat daran kep khiliitina Okha tsa'rga Delan tsIe iakkkhiita Tso Shena ritsk'ina dellachu da'khnin bezhanna tIekh'. Shun Dela tskh'a Allakh1 - Dela vu, Tsunna mu'tIakh' khila: akh' kkha' bakkkhamu'tIakh' bolcharna.

U'sh bu Dela kh'akhavicha, shain degnash kkho'rushbersh, shaina tIede'nachu vochunna sobar desh bersh, lamaz khIottadesh bersh, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'ekh /Dela reza volchu novk'a/ kharzhash esh bersh.

I erstana emkalkhiliitina Okha shuna Delan din guchudokkkhuchu bilgalonekh, shuna tsu chokh' dikanig du. Kh'ekhae tsarna tIekh', tskh'ana mogIara khIo'ttinchu kh'olekh', Delan tsIe. U'sh shain agIonashna tIedegcha, daa tsarakh, daade do'khuchunna a, tsa do'khuchunna a. Ishtta Okha mu'tIakh' dina u'sh (bezhanash) shuna, - shu khir datsara-te barkalla olush.

Dalla tsa kkhochu tseran zhizhig a, tseran tsIii a, delakh' a, Tsu'nga kkhochu shu'gara /Delakh/ kkherar. Ishtta Tso u'sh (bezhanash) mu'tIakh' dina shuna ash Dela vazvarkh'ama Tso shu /niisachu novk'a/ nisdarna. Akh' kkha' bakkkha dikadecharna.
Bakk'alla a, Dala larbo iiman dillinarsh. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa veza masso a teshnabekhk besh verg, /Delan ni1matna/ sha t1ekh inkarlo esh volu.
Magiina shaitsa tIom besh bolcharna/tIom ban/, tsarna zulam dina khilarna. Bakk'alla a, Dela tsarna (tsu busalbanashna) gIodarna tIekh' nitsk' bolush vu,

Shain tsIenoshkara araba'khna bolchu, tskh'a a bak'o iotsush, dekk'a tsara alarna: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg Allakh1-Dela vu". Dala nakh vovshashtsa larbesh tsa khillekh'ara, iokhiina khir iara /nasariin mozg1ariin/ Iibadat den mettigash a, kilsash a, /zhu'gtiin/ lamazan mettigash a, ma'zhdigash a, shaina chokh' dukkkha Delan tsIe kh'ekhosh iolu. Danne a gIo diir ma du Dala Shena /gIullakkhna/ gIo desh volchunna. Bakk'alla a, Dela nitsk' berg ma vu, veza verg a ma vu.
U'shbu Okha sha'sh la'ttakh' chIagIbicha, lamaz khIottosh bersh, zakat lush bersh, dikanig de, a'lla, omra desh bersh, vochukh /nakh/ dukhatukhush bersh. Delan iu gIullakkhiin chakkhe.
Kh'o tsara khartsvakh', - khartsbinatsaral kh'alkha Nukh'an a, Iadiin a, Samudiin a k'a'mnasha,
IbrakhIiman k'omo a, LutIin k'omo a,
Mad'ian daisha a. Khartsvira Musa a. As khanna tIa'kh'atettiratsa teshash bersh. TIakkkha As skh'aletsira u'sh. Mukha khilira San tsalarar /u'sh shaina Iazap dartsa/!
Masa iurt khIallakiina Okha, sha'sh zulame khilla iolu! U'sh shain bukha tIekh' ia'ssa iu. Masa shovda da'ssa disina! Masa io'gIna gIala /ia'ssa iisina/!
La'ttakhula tsa lela u'sh? - khir dara tsarna degnash, shaitsa tsara oila esh, ia lergash, shaitsa tsara ladugIush. BIa'rsa dats bIa'rze - kiirakh' dolu degnash du bIa'rze!
Kh'o sikhvo tsara Iazapatsa. Dala iokhor iats Shen vaIda. Tskh'a de kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh' ezar sho sanna du ash dagardechukh.
Masa iurt /khanna/ tIa'kh'atettira /Iazap tsa desh/ As, u'sh zulame a iolush? TIakkkha skh'aletsira u'sh As, Suna t1e du tIekkhachar.
Akh' ala: "KhIai nakh! Bakk'alla a, so shuna bilgala kkheramcha vu-kkh".
Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamal iinarsh a - tsarna gechdar a, siilakh' ritsk' a du.
Tkhan aiatashna du'kh'al, u'sh dokho g1ertash k'akh'egnarsh - u'sh zho'zhakhatin dai bu.

Okha tsa vakhiitina kh'ol kh'alkha tskh'a a elcha a, tskh'a a paikhamar a tso satu'isuchu khenakh' tsu'nan satiisamiin chu shaitIa tsa o'kkkhush, tIakkkha Dala dIadokkkhush ben shaitIano kkho'ssinarg. TIa'kh'a Dala kh'ukam doitur du Shen aiatashka. I Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
/I du/ shaitIano kkho'ssinchukh pitana khilarkh'ama shain degnashkakh' tsamgar iolcharna, shain degnash k'iza dolcharna. Bakk'alla a, zulamkhoi genarchu mostagIallina chokh' ma bu.

Iilma dellacha'rga khaiitarkh'ama, iza kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bak'derg khilar, tsunakh teshiila u'sh, mukIar khu'liila Tsunna tseran degnash. Bakk'alla a, Dela ma vu nisbesh verg iiman dillinarsh niisachu novk'a.
DIatilar bats tsateshnarsh tsunakh shekonekh' lattarkh, shaina tIe tsIekhkh'ana sakh'tkkhachchalts, ia shaina tIe Iakhar diinanIazap kkhachchalts.
Pachchakh'alla otsu diinakh' Delan du, Tso kh'ukam diir du tsarna iukk'ekh'. Tk'a iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a - niImatan boshmashkakh' khir bu.
Tsateshnarsh a, Tkhan aiatash khartsdinarsh a - u'sh bu shaina siisaza dolu Iazap khir dersh.
Delan novk'akh' dIakkhelkhinarsh, tIakkkha baiinarsh ia bellarsh - dallane a khaza ritsk' lur du tsarna Dala. Bakk'alla a, Dela - I vu-kkh ritsk' lucharakh uggar dikanig.
Tso bokhkanne a chubukhkur bu u'sh sha'sh shaina reza dolchu chugIoilina (ialsamani chu). Bakk'alla a, Dela ma vu khuurg a, dukkha sobareverg a /tsarna Iazap tsa desh/.

Ishtta du iza. Milla velakh' a /mu'min nakhakh/ sha shena /kerstanasha/ dinchul /tsarna/ taIzar a dina, tIakkkha shena /tsara iukha a/ zulam dina - danne a tsunna gIodiir du Dala. Bakk'alla a, Dela k'intIeravolurg a vu, gechdiirig a vu.
I /gIo du/ Dela khilarna bu'isa denna chuialosh, de -bu'isanna chudalosh, Dela khilarna khezash verg a, gush verg a.
I /gIo du/ Dela - Iza khilarna bak'derg, I vitina, tsara /shega/ kkhoikkhurg - i khilarna khartsderg, Dela - Iza khilarna lekkha verg a, vokkkha verg a.

Kh'una tsa go Dala dossiina stiglara khi - tIakkkha la'tta khu'lu sendella. Bakk'alla a, Dela vu /Shen leshna ritsk' dalarekh'/ dika kkhetash verg a, /tseran degnashkakh' dolu kh1umanakh sikha dogdillar/ dika devzash verg a.
Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' derg a, la'ttakh' derg a. Bakk'alla a, Dela - I vu kh'ole verg a, khastame verg a.

Kh'una tsa khi'na Dala shuna bolkh boitush khilar la'ttakh' mel dolchu'nga a, kemane a - lela i khIorda chukhula Tsu'nan omratsa. Tso satsaio stigal la'tta tIe iozharkh, Shen purbantsa a ben. Bakk'alla a, Dela nakhana dikanig luush verg a (i iollu kh1uma shuna mu't1akh' iartsa), k'inkhetame verg a vu.
I vu shuna dakhar dellarg, tIakkkha dolu'itu Tso shu, tIakkkha /iukha/ dendiir du. Bakk'alla a, adam- ch1og1a kersta du-kkh.

KhIor ummatana Okha khiliitina Iibadat den mettig, tsara shena Iibadat a desh. Kh'o'tsa ma k'u'siila tsara gIullakkhekh'. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhaikkha /u'sh/. Bakk'alla a, kh'o niisachu novk'akh' ma vu.
Tsara kh'o'tsa k'iisakh', akh' ala: "Dalla dika kha'a ash desh derg".
Dala kh'ukam diir du shuna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh' shuna shegakh' khilpalo khillachokh'.
Kh'una tsa kha'a Dela khuush vuila stiglakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg? Bakk'alla a, iza /Lavkh' makh'fuz/ zhaina chokh' du. Bakk'alla a, iza Dalla atta du.
Tsara Iibadat do, Dela a vu'tii, Tso shetsa tskh'a a delil tsa dossiinchunna, shaina shekh la'tsna tskh'a a Iilma dotsuchunna. Ma vats zulamkhoshna tskh'a a gIo'ncha.

Shaina tIekh' Tkhan bilgala dolu aiatash deshcha, kh'una khaalo tsateshacheran iakhkh'ashkakh' inkarlo. Lata kiicha bu u'sh shaina tIekh' Tkhan aiatash do'shucha'rtsa. Akh' ala: "As du'itsii shuna tsul vochukh? - TsIe iu, Dala tsateshnacharna vaIda iina iolu, ma von tIekkhachar du-kkh!"

KhIai nakh! Masal daliina, ladogIa tsu'nga. Bakk'alla a, Dela a vitina, ash /shega/ kkhoikkhucho tskh'a'lliga tskh'a moza a kkhullur bats, u'sh tsunna gulbelcha a. Mozano shaigara tskh'a khIuma ia'kkkhicha, - iza tsu'ngara iukha tsa iakkkhalo tsarna. Ledara va'lla lo'khurg a, shegara lo'khurg a.
Tsara tsa vazvira Dela sha vazvan ma-vezzara. Bakk'alla a, Dela nu'tsk'ala verg a vu, veza verg a vu.
Dala khorzhu malikekh a /paikhamarshka/ elchanash, nakhakh a /nakhe elchanash/. Bakk'alla a, Dela khezash verg a vu, gush verg a vu.
Tsunna kha'a tsaral kh'alkha khillarg a, tsaral tIa'kh'a khinderg a. Dele d1ado'rzu gIullakkhash.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! RukIe gIo, suzhdane gIo, Iibadat de shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, dikanig de -shu dakkkhiiden tam bu.

K'akh'ega Delekh' sha k'akh'ega ma-dezzara, Tso shu kha'rzhina, tsa iina shuna dinekh' tskh'a a khalo, shun den IbrakhIiman millatakh /du i shun din/, Tso (Dalla) a'lla shukh busalbanashkh'alkha a, khIokkhu /K'ur'an/ chokh' a, elcha shuna tIekh' tesh khiliitarkh'ama, shu a teshash khiliitarkh'ama nakhana tIekh'. Lamaz khIottade, zakat lo, Delatsa chIagIlo. I vu shun vali- dika vali a vu, dika gIo'ncha a vu.
Bakkkhiibiiramu'min nakh.
U'sh bu shain lamazashkakh' /Delakh kkho'rush, Tsu'nan vazzallina/ mu'tIakh' bersh.
U'sh bu da'ssachu khabarekh iu'stakhbovlush bersh.
U'sh bu zakat dokkkhush bersh.
U'sh bu shain evkh'e mezhenash lar'esh bersh.
Shain zudarshna a, ia shain a'ttu ku'igashadoladinacharna a ben /tIe tsa gIertash bersh/ - tIakkkha u'sh bekhke bats.
Tsaral dekh'a kkhiidinarsh - u'sh /Delan/ dozanekh bevlarsh bu.
U'sh bushaikh teshna ditina khIuma a, shaitsa khilla bart a Ialashbesh bersh.
U'sh bu shain lamazash lardesh bersh.
U'sh bu verasash.
Shaina irsana Firdavskkhochur ersh, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bolush.
Okha kkho'llina adam (du'khkh'ara stag Adam) tsIenchu popparkh (topparkh).
TIakkkha khiliitina Okha tsunakh tIadamchIogIachu mettigekh'.

TIakkkha tIadamakh dek'a tsIii kkho'llira Okha, dek'achu tsIiikh kkho'llira Okha zhizhigan kiisak, zhizhigan kiisakakh kkho'llira da'Iakhkash, tIakkkha da'Iakhkii tIe zhizhig du'khiira (dillira) Okha, tIakkkha Okha kkhiiira kkhin kkhollar. Berkate khilla Dela - kkhollarkhoikh uggar dikanig.
TIakkkha, bakk'alla a, shu tsul tIa'kh'a liir du.
TIakkkha, bakk'alla a, shu k'ematdiinakh' dendiir du.
Okha kkho'llira shuna tIekhula vorkhI g1att/stigal/ - Tkho tsa khilira /masso a Tkhash kkho'llinchu/ khalk'akh gIovpal (tidam botsush).
Okha dossiira stiglara khi baramtsa, i satsiira Okha la'ttakh', Tkho i dIadakhiita a nitsk' bolush du.
Okha kkhiiira shuna tsu'ntsa (dogIitsa) khurmanan a, kemsiin a boshmash, shuna tsu chokh'dukkkha sto'mash a bu, ash tsarakh bou.
Saina'lamanakh skh'adolush dolu zait-ditt a /kkho'llina Okha/, tsunakh dolu zaitda'tta a, chambiirig a iuucharna.
Bakk'alla a, shuna bezhnashkakh' /kkhin sa dolchu khIumnashkakh' a/ masalma du: Okha shuna malaio tseran kiirakh' iolchukh, shuna tsa'rgakh' dukkkha paidanash a bu, tsarakh ash dou.
Tsarna (bezhnashna) tIekh' a, kemanna tIekh' a shu d1asalelado.
Okha vakhiitira Nukh' shen k'omana tIe. Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Ash Iibadat de Dalla, shuna vats I votsurg kkhin dela, shu tsa kkho'ru?"

Tsu'nan k'omakh tsa teshash khillacheran elasha elira: "KhIara-m adam ben dats, shu sanna, iza luush vu shuna tIekh' kh'alavala, Dalla li'nekh'ara, Tso malikash dokhku'itur dara. Tkhuna tsa khezna otsunakh tkhan kh'alkhalerchu daishkakh' a.
Iza (Nukh') zhinekh volu stag ben ma vats, shu kh'ovsal tsu'nga tskh'a khan iallalts".
Tso (Nukh'as, Dele do'khush) elira: "So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, Akh' gIo delakh' suna tsara so khartsvarna".

Okha khaam bira tsu'nga vekh'etsa: "Kema de Tkhan bIa'rgii kh'alkhakh', Tkhan kh'ekhamtsa. Tkhan gIullakkh de'cha, pesh kkhekhkicha, tsu chu (kemanna tIe) lakhka khIorannakh shishsha taipa a, kh'an do'zal a, tsarakh shaina tIekh' dosh kh'alkhada'llarsh botsursh. So'ga ma kh'ekhabelakh' zulam dinarsh. U'sh khina bukhabokhu'itur bu".
Kh'o a, kh'o'tsa verg a kemanna tIekh' dIanisvelcha, akh' alalakh': "Khastam bu Dalla, tkho kh'alkhada'khnachu zulamechu k'omakh".
Akh' alalakh': "So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, okh'avossavelakh' so berkatechu mettigekh', Kh'o uggar dika okh'avossorig vu-kkh."
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilash du-kkh, Tkho khilla-kkh zu'ish dersh.
TIakkkha Okha kkhiiira tsaral tIa'kh'a kkhin tIa'kh'e.
Okha vakhiitira tsa'rga tsarakh elcha, Iibadat de Dalla, shuna vats Iza votsurg kkhin dela, a'lla. Shu tsa kkho'ru?

Tsu'nan k'oman tsa teshash khillachu, ekhartatsa tskh'anakkhetar khartsdesh khillachu, Okha du'nenan dakharekh' shaiga zovkkh kh'egiitinchu elasha elira: "KhIara-m adam ben dats, shu sanna, ash iuuchukh iuu tso, ash moluchukh molu tso.
Shu mu't1akh' khilakh' sha'sh sannachu adamna, tIakkkha, bakk'alla a, ma eshnarsh du-kkh shu.
Tso vaIda do shuna, shu delcha, shukh latta a, da'Iakhkash a khilcha, shu aradokhur du, a'lla?
Ma gena du-kkh, ma gena du-kkh shuna desh dolu vaIda!
KhIara vain du'nenan dakhar ben kkhin dakhar dats, le vai, dekha vai - vai iukha dendiir dats.
I vu vekk'a Dalla tIe khartsderg kkho'llina stag, vai tsunakh teshar dats".
Tso (elchano) elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' suna gIo delakh' tsara so khartsvarna".
Tso (Dala) elira: "Tskh'a kIezzigchu /khenakh'/ u'sh dokhkobevlla khir bu kh'una".
U'sh skh'aletsira tsIogIa tokharo, latsa kh'ak' bolush, Okha nekhash iira tsarakh. Della dala zulame k'am!
TIakkkha, tsaral tIa'kh'a, kkhiiira Okha kkhin tIa'kh'enash.
Kh'alkhader dats tskh'a a ummat shen Iozhallal, tIa'kh'abu'sur a bats u'sh.

TIakkkha tIettIa bakhiitira Okha Tkhan elchanash. Matstsa a ummatana tIe shen elcha ve'cha - tsara i khartsvora, Okha tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharna tIa'kh'abakhiitira. Okha tsarakh khiliitira diitsarsh. Della dala tsa teshash dolu k'am!
TIakkkha Okha vakhiitira Musa a, tsu'nan vasha KhIarun a Tkhan aiatashtsa a, bilgalchu delilatsa a
FirIavnna a, tsu'nan elashna a tIe - u'sh kurabevlira, tsarakh khilira lakkhadala gIerta k'am.
Tsara elira: "Tkho teshar du tk'a tkho sannachu shina stagakh, tsu shinnan nakh tkhuna /lesh khilla/ gIullakkh desh a bolush?"
Tsara i shi' khartsvira, sha'sh khIallakkhillacharakh khilira.
Okha delira Musaga zhaina, u'sh nislur batsara-te, a'lla.
Okha khiliitira Mar'iaman kIantakh a, tsu'nan nenakh a delil. Okha /tskh'ana khanna bakha/ okh'akhovshiira i shi'lekkhachu mettige, shen chIagIo a, shovda a dolchu.
KhIai elchanash! Daa tsIenchukh, Iamal e dikanig! Bakk'alla a, So ash desh derg khuush vu shuna.
Bakk'alla a, khIara shun ummattskh'a ummat du, So shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu, Sokh kkheralash.
Tsara khadiira shain gIullakkh vovshii iukk'ekh' tobanashtsa. Masso a toba shegakh' dolchu'ntsa iakkkhiiesh iu.
Bita u'sh shain kegari chokh' /u'sh liir bolu/ khan tIekkkhachchalts.
Tsarna mo'ttu-tekh'a Okha shaina shetsa bakham a, kIentii a lush khilar
Okha shaina dikanash sikhdar du? KhIette a, tsa khaalo-kkh tsarna.
Bakk'alla a, sha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkho'rush egna bersh,
Sha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatekh teshash bersh,
Sha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa nak'ostii tsa lu'itsush bersh,
Sha'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe d1ado'rzur duila a khuush, /Tsunakh/ shain degnash kkho'rush a dolush, shaina /Dala/ dellachu ritsk'ikh /sagIa/ lush bersh -
U'sh bu dikanashna tIe sikhbellarsh - u'sh tsarakh (shain dikanekh) kh'alkhkhe t1ekkhu'ur bu!
Okha tIe tsa du'llu sinna tsu'nan nitsk' kkhochurg ben. Tkho'gakh' du zhaina, sha bak'derg du'itsush dolu, tsarna zulam diir dats.
Tseran (kerstaniin) degnash otsunakh (bak'dolchukh) dIatilar chokh' du, tsarna u'sh iotsursh a /kkhin von/ Iamalash iu, sha'sh esh iolu.
Tsarakh niImat dellarsh Okha Iazapatsa skh'ala'tscha, u'sh mokh' kh'o'kkhush bisira.
/Tsa'rga elira/: "Mokh' ma kh'ekkha takhana - shuna Tkho'gara gIo khir dats!"
Khilla San aiatash shuna tIekh' do'shush - khilla shu tsarakh iukhadovlush.
Kuradevlla tsu'ntsa (KaIbitsa), bu'isanna /K'ur'anakh/ lu'ish.
Tsara oila tsa io dashakh, ia tsa'rga deana tseran kh'alkhalerchu daishka tsa de'narg?
Ia tsarna tsa vevzira shain elcha, tsara tsunna inkarlo a esh?
Ia tsara olu: "Tsu'ntsa zhinash du?" I veana tsa'rga bak'dolchu'ntsa, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh bak'derg tsa dezash bu.

Bak'derg tseran dezarshna tIa'kh'a da'llekh'ara, stiglanash a, latta a, tsu chokh' mel derg a khIallakkhir dara. Okha tsa'rga belira /shena chokh'/ shaina sii a, dozalla a dolush kh'ekham (K'ur'an). U'sh shaina /bechu/ kh'ekhamakh d1abo'rzura.
Ia akh' tsa'rga kharzh io'khu? Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun kharzh to'lash iu. Iza ritsk' lucharakh uggar dikanig vu.
Bakk'alla a, akh' u'sh kkhoikkhu niisachu novk'a.
Bakk'alla a, ekhartakh tsatesharsh /niisachu/ nek'akh dIatu'lush ma bu.
Okha k'inkhetam binekh'ara tsarakh, aidinekh'ara tsarakh dolu zen, u'sh kkherstash chukh'ovdur ma bara shain tilarna.
Okha Iazapatsa skh'aliitsira u'sh, amma u'sh mukIar tsa khilira shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, /Tsu'nga/ kh'asta tsa belira.
Okha shaina tIe chIogIa Iazap dolu neI skh'aellalts - u'sh tsigakh' masso a khIumanakh dog dillina bisira.
Iza (Dela) vu kkho'llina shuna khazar a, bIa'rsa a, degnash a - ma kIezig barkalla olu-kkh ash!
Iza vu kkhiiina shu la'ttakh' - Tsunna tIe shu d1aguldiir dolush a du.
Iza vu dendesh verg a, dolu'itush verg a, Tsu'nan du bu'isa a, de a kh'iizar, shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?
KhIa', tsara elira kh'alkhalerchara a'llachukh teranig.
Tsara elira: "Tkho delcha, tkho'kh latta a, da'Iakhkash a khilcha, tkho iukha a dendiir du?
I vaIda dinera tkhuna a, tkhan daishna a kh'alkha, iza-m kh'alkhalerachiin tu'iranash ben dats".
Akh' ala: "Kh'enan du latta a, tsu chokh' mel derg a, shu khuush khillekh'?"
Tsara er du: "Delan du". Akh' ala: "Ash oila tsa io?"
Akh' ala: "Mila vu vorkhI stigalan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, siilakh'-iokkkhachu Iarshan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg?"
Tsara er du kh'una: "/U'sh/ Delan iu-kkh". Akh' ala: "Shu tsa kkho'ru /Delakh/?"
Akh' ala: "Mila vu shen karakh' masso a khIumanan pachchakh'alla derg, sha /kkhibersh/ larosh verg, shena du'kh'al /kkhechara/ laron iish iotsurg, shu khuush khillekh'?"
Tsara er du: "Dela vu-kkh". Akh' ala: "Ma bozbuunchalla desh du-kkh shuna!"
KhIa', Okha tsa'rga delira bak'derg. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khartslu'ish bersh ma bu.

Dala tsa letsira tskh'a a do'zalkho, tsa khilira tsu'ntsa tskh'a a dela. TIakkkha-m masso a delas sha kkho'llinarg dIakh'ur ma dara, tsarakh tskh'abersh (delii)vukkharal lakkhabevr ma bara. TsIena vu i Dela tsara Shekh kkhulluchukh.
Kh'ulamekh' derg a, guchakh' derg a khuush volu, lakkhava'lla Iza tsara shetsa nak'ost lotsuchukh.
Akh' ala: "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, nagakh' Akh' gaitanne a gaitakh' suna tsarna khir du a'llarg (Iazap),
So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, tIakkkha so ma khiliitalakh' zulame nakhana iukk'ekh'".
Bakk'alla a, Tkho kh'o'ga gaita Okha tsarna vaIda dinarg nitsk' bolush du kh'una,
Akh' dukhatokhalakh' vonig sha dikakh dolchu'ntsa. Tkho dika khuush du kh'una tsara /Dalla tIe/ kkhullurg.
Akh' alalakh': "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, so larlo Kh'o'tsa shaitIaniin t1ekh1usdechu /vochu/ kh1umanekh.
So larlo Kh'o'tsa, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, u'sh (shaitIanash) suna gergadakhkarkh".
Tsarakhtskh'anna tIe valar de'cha, er du: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, iukhaverzave-kh'a so /du'nena/.
