Dika Iamal ian megara as, aisa tsa esh iitinarg". KhIan-khIa! I dosh du tso (shaitIano, tsateshachu staga) sha a'lla dolu. Tseran tIekh'akh' du'kh'alo iu u'sh iukha denbiir bolchu diine kkhachchalts.
Sur lekkhcha, - gergarlonash khir dats tsarna iukk'ekh' otsu diinakh', vovshashka kho'ttur dats tsara.
Shain mizan-terza dazdellarsh- u'sh khir bu bakkkhiibu'irash.
Shen miza-terza daidellarsh- u'sh sha'sh khIallakbinarsh bu, guttar zho'zhakhati chokh' khir bu u'sh.
Shain iakhkh'ash tsIaro iagaesh, sha'sh tsu (zho'zhakhati) chokh' kkho'lina (iu'kh' khabiina) khir bu u'sh.
San aiatash tsa khilira shuna tIekh' do'shush? Shu ma khilira u'sh khartsdesh!
Tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, tkhan dek'azalla tu'ilira tkhuna tIekh', tkho khili-kkh tiladella k'am.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, aradakhakh' tkho tsu (zho'zhakhati) chu'ra, tkho iukha a tIederzakh' /k'inoshna/, - tIakkkha tkho khir kh'una zulamkhoi".
Tso (Dala) elira: "DIasovtsa tsu chokh', k'amel ma de So'ga!"
Bakk'alla a, San lekh tskh'a toba khilira olush: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, iiman dillina okha, gechdekh'a tkhuna, k'inkhetam bekh'a tkhokh, Kh'o vu-kkh k'inkhetam becharakh uggar dikanig".
Ash tsarakhbelar dira otso shu'ga San kh'ekham bitsbaittalts, shu khilira tsarakh do'lush.
Bakk'alla a, As ial eli tsarna takhana tsara sobar darna, bakk'alla a, u'sh bu-kkh tolam ba'kkkhinarsh.
Tso (Dala) elira: "Mel la'ttira shu la'tta tIekh' sheriin baramekh'?"
Tsara elira: "Tkho la'ttira diinakh', ia diinan tskh'ana dek'ekh', khattal dagardecha'rga".
Tso elira: "Shu kIezzig ben tsa la'ttira, shu khillekh'ara khuush".
Shuna mo'ttina-te Okha shu kkho'llina erna, sha'sh Tkhuna tIe d1aderzor a dats?
Lakkhaveli Dela - bak'volu pachchakh', vats kkhin dela Iza votsurg - siilakh' iolchu Iarshan Da /vu Iza/.

Milla velakh' Delatsa tskh'ana kkhechu dele kkhoikkhush, shena tsu'ntsa tskh'a a teshalla a dotsush - tsu'nan kh'esap shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun karakh' du. Bakk'alla a, bakkkhiibu'ir ma bats tsateshnarsh.
Akh' ala: "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, gechdekh'a, k'inkhetam bekh'a, Kh'o vu-kkh k'inkhetam becharakh uggar dikanig".
Surat du Okha sha dossiina dolu, Okha /shen kh'ukamash kkhochushdar/ farz dina dolu, Okha dossiina tsu chokh' bilgala dolu aiatash - ash oila iiir iatsara-te!

Kkhakh'pa lela zuda a, kkhakh'pa lela stag a - tokha tsu shinnakh khIoranna bIe gIazh. Shun ma khu'liila tsu shinnakh doglazar Delan dinekh', nagakh' sanna shu khillekh' teshash Delakh a, ekhar /dogIur dolchu/ diinakh a. Tseran shinnan a taIzar goila mu'min nakhakh tskh'ana tobanna.

Kkhakh'pa lelachu staga ialor iats kkhakh'pa lela zuda ia /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsuzuda a ben, kkhakh'pa lela zuda iu'gur iats kkhakh'pa lelachu staga ia /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsuchu staga a ben, - kh'aram dina iza mu'min nakhana.

O'zdachu zudarshna tIe bekhk kkhu'ssushbersh /u'sh nakhatsa lela a'lla/, tIakkkha tsara vi' tesh tsa valavakh' - tokha tsarna eztIk'a gIazh. Kkhin tseran teshalla k'obal ma delash tsk'a a. U'sh - pesak'ashbu.
Sha'sh tsul tIa'kh'a toba a dina, dika Iamal iinarsh botsursh - tIakkkha, bakk'alla, Dela t1ekh gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Shain zudarshnabekhk kkhu'ssush bersh, shaina teshash botsush, sha'sh ben, - tsarakh tskh'anno teshalla doila Delatsa do'azza, bakk'alla a, sha bak'lu'icharakh ma vu, a'lla.
Pkho'azlagIa Delan neIalt khu'lda shena, nagakh' sanna sha khillekh' khartslu'icharakh, a'lla.
Tsunakh (zudchukh) taIzar dukhatukhur du tso teshalla dartsa Delatsa di' teshallitsa, bakk'alla a, iza (i shen mar) khartslu'icharakh ma vu, a'lla.
Pkho'azlagIa Delan o'gIazlo khu'liila shena tIekh', nagakh' sanna i khillekh' bak'lu'icharakh, a'lla.
Delan koma'rshalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a tsa khillekh'ara shuna tIekh', I Dela toba t1ekh/dukkha/ k'obaldiirig a, kh'ukam /niisa/ diirig tsa khillekh'ara /khIallakkhir dara shu/.

Bakk'alla a, i eladitade'narsh - shukh tskh'a toba ma iu. Shuna ma mottalash i shuna von du. KhIa', i shuna dika du. Tsarakh khIor stagana k'inakh sha karadinarg du. Tsarakh shena tIe tsu'nan (k'inan) dokkkhanig la'tsnarg- tsunna dokkkha dolu Iazap du.
I shaina khezcha, khIunda tsa mo'ttura mu'min bozharshna a, mu'min zudarshna a shain degnashkakh' dikanig, tsara khIunda tsa elira: "KhIara bilggala eladita du-kkh?"
Vi' tesh valiinekh'ara tsara tsunna tIekh'. Tsara teshash tsa balabakh', - u'sh bu Dalla gergakh' sha'sh khartslu'ish bersh.
Delan koma'rshalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a tsa khillekh'ara shaina tIekh' du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a, shu la'tsna khir dara ash tIekh diitsinchokh'deza-dokkkhachu Iazapo.
Ash tIe ma lotsu i shain mattatsa, ma du'itsu shain baganashtsa shaina shetsa tskh'a a Iilma dotsurg, shuna mo'ttu i atta du, iza Dalla gergakh' deza- dokkkha du.
Shaina iza khezcha, ash khIunda tsa elira: "Tkhuna megar dats iza diitsa. Vonakh tsIena vu Kh'o, ma deza-dokkkha eladita du-kkh khIara".
Dala kh'o'khu shuna ishttachunna tIe shu tsk'a a tsaderzar, shu mu'min nakh delakh'.
Dala bilgaldo shuna aiatash. Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillincha'rgakh' bo'khanig darzha luush bersh - tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap khir du du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a. Dalla kha'a, shuna khaats.
Delan ko'ma'rshalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a shaina tsa khillekh'ara, i Dela dikanig luush a, k'inkhetame a vatsakh'ara /khIallakkhir dara shu/.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! ShaitIanan gIulchashna tIa'kh'a ma khIittalash. ShaitIanan gIulchashna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttinarg - bakk'alla tsokh'o'khu bo'khanig a, inkarlo a. Shaina tIekh' Delan ko'marshalla a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetam a tsa khillekh'ara, shukh tskh'a a tsk'a a tsIanlur ma vatsara. Delakh' a, Dala tsIanvo Shena luurg. Dela khozush verg a, khuush verg a vu.

Dui ma boiila shukh shegakh' ko'ma'rshalla a, kh'al a dolcho gergarcharna a, miskacharna a, Delan novk'akh' dIakkhelkhinacharna a /sagIa/ lur dats,alii. K'intIera boliila u'sh, bekhkazbokhiila tsara. Shuna tsa deza Dala shaina gechdar? Dela t1ekh gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Bakk'alla a, o'zdachu, /shaina bo'khanig/ tsa devzachu mu'min zudarshna bekhk kkhu'ssush bersh - du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a neIalt a'lla tsarna, tsarna deza-dokkkha Iazap a du.
Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' teshalla diir du tsarna tIekh' tseran mettanasha, tseran ku'igasha a, tseran kogasha a tsara lelosh khillachu'ntsa.
Otsu diinakh' Dala biir bu tsarna kh'ak'-bak' bolu bekkham. Tsarna khuush du i Dela Sha vuila bilgala bak'derg.

Bo'kha /lela/ zudarii - bo'khachu bozharshna, bo'kha /lela/ bozharii - bo'khachu zudarshna. TsIena /lela/ zudarii - tsIenchu bozharshna, tsIena /lela/ bozharii - tsIenchu zudarshna. U'sh /Iaishat i sannarsh/ tsIena bu tsara du'itsuchukh. Tsarna gechdar a du, siilakh' ritsk' a du.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu chu ma gIolash shain dotschu tsIenoshka bak'o a tsa io'khush, tseran daishka salam tsa lush. Iza shuna dika du /shu ts1ekhkh'ana tsarna chu g1ochul/. Ash oila iiir iatsara-te?

Shuna tsa karavakh' tsu chokh' (tsu nekhan tsIenoshkakh') tskh'a a - chu ma gIolash shaina purba dallalts. Shaiga "Iukhaderza" alakh' - iukhaderzalash /chu tsa gIosh/. Iza vuno a tsIena du shuna. I Dela ash diirig khuush vu.
K'a dats shuna bekhash nakh botschu, shuna o'shu khIumanash / ia paida bolchu/ tsIenoshnachu shu dakha. I Dela khuush vu ash guchudokkkhurig a, ash d1akh'uldiirig a.
Akh' ala mu'min nakhe okh'atukhiila tsara shain kh'ezhar, shain evkh'e mezhenash larioila tsara. Iza vuno a tsIena du tsarna. Bakk'alla a, Dela dika devzash vu tsara diirig.

Akh' ala mu'min zudarshka okh'atukhiila tsara shain kh'ezhar, larioila tsara shain evkh'e mezhenash, ma goitiila tsara shain khaznashtsunakh guchakh'erg ben, tsara tIe kkhussiila shain kkhollar shain nekkhiin gonakh'a. Tsara ma goitiila shain khaznash shain maroshka, ia shain daishka, ia shain maroin daishka, ia shain kIentashka, ia shain maroin kIentashka /kkhechu zudarsha bina bolu/, ia shain vezharshka, ia shain vezhariin kIentashka, ia shain iizhariin kIentashka, ia shain /kh'alkhakh' gIullakkh desh bolchu/ zudarshka, ia shain a'ttu ku'igasha doladinacha'rga, ia tIekh'o'zhush bolu shain shovk' dIaialla bolu bozharshka, ia zudariin evkh'e mezhenashka tsa kh'o'zhuchu berashka a ben. Shain kogash ma bettiila tsara sha'sh kh'uldina shain khazalla dovziitarkh'ama. Toba de Dele massaraa, khIai mu'min nakh, shu dakkkhiiden tarlo.

Zudarii balabe shaikh zhera-bozharshna a, shain lekh dikacharna a, mare lo shain lai-zudarii. Nagakh' u'sh miska khilakh', - Dala kh'al lur du tsarna shen ko'marshallakh. Dela tIekh koma'rsha vu /Shen luuchunna shortta ritsk' lush/, khuush vu.

Iukhaozalush khu'liila /nakhatsa lelarkh/ shaina zuda ialor /mare bakhar/ tsa nisbellarsh Dala shaina Shen koma'rshallakh kh'al dallalts. Shun a'ttu ku'igasha doladinacharakh azat bala iazbala luush bersh - iazbe u'sh, nagakh' sanna shuna khaalakh' tsu chokh' dikanig. DIalo tsarna Delan bakhamakh, Tso shuna bella bolchu. Ma teIabelash shain mekhkarii kkhakh'ballina tIe, tsarna li'nekh' tsIena khila, ash du'nenan dakharan khilamash (bakham) lo'khush. U'sh tIeteIosh verg /kkhakh'ballina- tsunna ta1zar diir dolush du Dala/... Dela u'sh /nitsk'a/ tIeteIabinachul tIa'kh'a/tsu zudarshna/ gechdesh a vu, k'inkhetame a vu.
Okha dossina shu'ga /masso kh1uma/ bilgaldokhu aiatash a, shul kh'alkha bakhancheran /dakharan/ masal a, /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna kh'ekham a.

Dela-stiglaniin a, la'ttan a nur du. Tsu'nan nur penan iuk'akh tera du, shena chokh' chirkkh bolchu. Chirkkh shishana chokh' bu. Shisha /nur/ lepachu sedakh tera du. Berkatechu zait-dittan /da'ttanakh/ latabo i (chirkkh). Malkhbalekh' a, malkhbuzekh' a dats i (ditt-ia'ssachu arakh' du, guttar malkh kkhetartsa shen sto'mash sikha a, khaza a madlush). Da'tta gerga du k'aga shekh tsIe kh'akkhaella iatsakh' a. Nur tIekh' a nur du. Nisvo Dala Shen nur tIe Shena luurg. Dalado Dala masalshnakhana. I Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.

/I nur du Delan/ tsIenoshkakh' (ma'zhdigashkakh') Dala sha'sh /siidesh/ lakkha dakhan a, shaina chokh' Tsu'nan tsIe kh'ekhaian a omra dina dolchu. Tsarna chokh' Dalla tasbakh' (lamazash) do Iu'iranna a, su'iranna a -

/Mu'min/nakha, sha'sh iokhk-etsaro iuk'akhbokhur botsush Dela kh'ekhorakh a, lamaz khIottorakh a, zakat dalarkh a. U'sh kkho'ru /k'emat/diinakh, shen /irchallikh nekhan/ degnash a, bIa'rsa a dettalur dolchu.
Dala shaina bekkham barkh'ama sha'sh diinachukh uggar khazachu'ntsa, Tso shaina sovdakkkharkh'ama Shen koma'rshallakh. I Dela ritsk' lush vu Shena luuchunna kh'esap a dotsush.

Tsateshnarsh - tseran Iamalsh sherachu arakh' /khIuttuchu/ iilbazgIalakhtera iu: kh'ogakh volchunna i khi du metta, i tsunna tIevakhcha, - i khIumma tsa karaio tsunna. Tsunna karavo Dela shena gergakh' - Tso kkhochushdo tsu'nan kh'esap (shen Iamalashka kh'ozhii Dala bekkham bo tsunna). I Dela kh'esap darekh' sikha verg vu.

Ia /Delakh tsateshacheran 1amalash/ tera iu kIorgachu khIo'rda chokh' bolchu bodanakh, sha kh'ulbesh bolchu tolgIano. Tsunna tIekhula tolgIa iu, tsunna tIekhula markha iu. Bodanash du tskh'adersh vukkharna tIekh', tso shen ku'g aradekkkhi cha, - tsunna i gan tsa tu'gu. Dala shena nur tsa dinachunna tskh'a a nur dats.

Kh'una tsa khi'na i Dela khilar Shena tasbakh' desh stiglanashkakh' a, lattakh' a mel volcho, mogIarshtsa /tIama dellachu/ olkhazarsha a? KhIoranna khi'na shen lamaz a, shen tasbakh' a. I Dela khuush ma vu tsara diirig.
Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. Dele du dIaderzar a.

Kh'una tsa go Dala d1alokhku markhash, tIakkkha tIegulio u'sh, tIakkkha Tso u'sh khu'lu'itu tIettIa /barz/, kh'una go dogIa tseran iukk'ekhula skh'adolush, Tso dossado stiglara /markhiin/ la'mnash, shaina chokh' tIk'es iolush. Shena luuchunna tukhu Tso i, Shena luuchukh iukha dIakh'avzaio. TIk'esan nuro /nekhan/ bIa'rsa dIakh'osh la'tta.
Khartsaio Dala bu'isa a, de a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' kh'ekham ma bu bIa'rsa dolcharna.

Dala kkho'llina masso a diinat khikh. Tsarakh shen gai tIekh' lelarg du, tsarakh shina koga tIekh' lelarg a du, tsarakh dea koga tIekh' lelarg du. Kkhullu Dala Shena luurg. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochurg vu.
Okha dossina mai bilgala dolu aiatash. Dala nisvo Shena luurg niisachu novk'a.
Tsara olu: "Teshna tkho Delakh a, elchanekh a, mu'tIakh' a khilla tkho". TIakkkha dIaio'rzu /bak'dolchu dinakh/ tsarakh tskh'a toba tsul tIa'kh'a - u'sh mu'min nakh bats!
Sha'sh Dalla a, elchanna a tIe kkhaikkhicha shain iukk'ekh' kh'ukam dan - tsarakh tskh'a toba du'kh'aliolu.
Shaina khilakh' bak'o- tsunna tIe bogIu u'sh, mu'tIakh' khu'lii.
Tseran degnashkakh' tsamgar iu-te, ia shekbevla-te u'sh, ia kkho'ru-te u'sh Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a shaitsa niiso tsa ian? KhIa'! U'sh zulamkhoi bu!
Bakk'alla a, mu'min nekhan dosh khili sha'sh Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a tIe kkhaikkhicha shaina iukk'ekh' kh'ukam dan, tsara alar: "Lado'gIna okha, mu'tIakh' khilla tkho". U'sh bu bakkkhiiben bersh.
Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' verg, Delakh kkho'rush verg, Tsu'ntsa vochukh larlush verg - u'sh bu tolam ba'kkkhinarsh!

Delatsa biira tsara shain chIogIa duinash akh' shaiga omra dicha, aradovlur dusha'sh, bokhush. Akh' ala: "Ash dui ma baa! Mu'tIakh' khilar dika dara /shu'gara/. Bakk'alla a, Dela dika khuush vu ash diirig".

Akh' ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Mu'tIakh' khila Dalla, mu'tIakh' khila elchanna!" U'sh dIaberzakh', tsunnashena tIe dillinarg du, shuna - shaina tIe dillinarg du. Tsunna /elchanna/ mu'tIakh' shu khilakh' - shu niisachu novk'akh' du. Elchanna-m tIekh' dats bilgala dIakkhachor ben.

Dala vaIda dina shukh iiman dillincharna a, dika Iamalsh iinacharna a Sha tIa'kh'e lur iu tsarna la'ttakh', a'lla, Sha tsaral kh'alkha khillacharna ialarkh terra, Sha chIagIdiir du tsarna shain din, Sha tsunna tsarna reza khilla volu, Sha tsarna tseran kkheramal tIa'kh'a tesham lur bu (marsho lur iu), a'lla. Tsara Suna Iibadat diir du, tskh'a a khIuma khu'lu'itur iats Suna nak'ostalla dan. Tsul tIa'kh'a kersta khillarg - u'sh bu pesak'ash!
Ash khIottade lamaz, lo zakat, shu mu'tIakh' khila elchanna - shukh k'inkhetam ban megara.
Kh'una ma mottalakh' i tsatesharsh /Tkhan shaina t1ekh'/ nitsk' botsush bu la'ttakh' (du'nenan dakharekh'). Tseran chugIoila - tsIe iu. Ma von dIaderzar du-kkh i!

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu'ga purba do'khiila kkhuzza shun a'ttu ku'igo doladinachara a, shukh kkhi'natsa va'llacho a, satasaran lamazal kh'alkha a, sha'sh delk'akh' bedar iokkkhuchu khenakh' a, pkh'u'ire- lamazal tIa'kh'a a - shun kkho Iovrat /iolu khan iu iza/. Shuna a, tsarna a k'a dats tsaral (tsu khenal) tIa'kh'a /chu ban/. TIekh'o'zhush bu shuna shukh tskh'abersh vukkkharna. Ishtta bilgaldokhu Dala shuna aiatash. I Dela khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ diirig a vu.
Shun berasha kkhi'na ba'lcha,purba do'khiila tsarashail kh'alkhaleracharadekharkh terra. Ishtta bilgaldokhu Dala shuna Shen aiatash. Dela khuush verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ diirig a vu.

Zudarekh k'anbellarsh, mare bakha dog dokhush botsu - tsarna k'a dats shain /tIekhula iolu/ bedarsh d1aiakharkh, khazalla guchudokkkhush batsakh'. U'sh o'zda khilcha,- tsarna dika du. Dela khozush verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.

BIa'rsa dotschunna k'a dats, astagI volchunna k'a dats, tsomgash volchunna k'a dats, shuna shaina a /k'a/ dats ash /khIuma/ iaarkh shain tsIenoshkara, ia shain dain tsInoshkara, ia shain nanoin tsIenoshkara, ia shain vezhariin tsIenoshkara, ia shain iizhariin tsIenoshkara, ia shain den vezhariin tsIenoshkara, ia shain den iizhariin tsIenoshkara, ia shain nenan vezhariin tsIenoshkara, ia shain nenan iizhariin tsIenoshkara, ia shain /tsIenoin/ dogIanashna ash doladecheran/tsIenoshkara/, ia shain dottagIchun /tsIenoshkara/. Dats shuna k'a ash /khIuma/ iaarkh tskh'ana, ia sha'sh-sha'sh. Sha'sh tsIenoshna chu do'dush salam lo vovshashka Delan gergara berkate a, tsIena a khillachu marshallitsa. Ishtta bilgaldokhu Dala shuna aiatash - shu khila megara kh'ek'ale.

Bakk'alla a, mu'min nakh bu sha'sh teshnarsh Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a, sha'sh tsu'ntsa (Delan elchantsa) dolush tskh'ana iuk'ara gIullakkhna tIekh' dIa tsa bo'dush bersh tsu'nga purba dekhna a ben. Bakk'alla a, i kh'o'gapurba do'khursh - u'sh bu Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a teshash bersh. Tsara kh'aiga purba dekhcha shain tskh'atstsa gIullakkhna, purba lo tsarakh kh'aina luuchunna, gechdar a dekha tsarna Dele. Bakk'alla Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetam biirig a vu.

Ash ma de elchane kkhaikkhar shaina iukk'ekh' shaikh tskh'abolcheran vukkharga kkhaikkharkh tera. Dalla bevzash bu shukh lachIk'a bu'ilursh. Larloila i tsu'nan (elchanan) omrana khilpalo esh bersh pitna (du'nenan bala) shaikh kh'archarkh, ia /ekhartan/ lazosh dolu Iazap shaikh kh'archarkh.

Tk'a Delan dats stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg? Tsunna kha'a shu Shena tIekh' derg. U'sh Shena tIeberzinchu /k'emat/ diinakh' Tso tsa'rga du'itsur du tsara diinarg. I Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.
Berkate khili Sha k'astordossosh khillarg Shen legai khiliitarkh'ama Ialamashna kkheramcha.

Iza /AllakhI-Dela/ vu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla Shegakh' derg, Tso tsa la'tsna do'zalkho, vats Tsunna nak'ost pachchakh'allekh'. Tso kkho'llina masso a khIuma, baram bina tsunna (masso a khIumanna) baramtsa.

Tsara letsira, Iza a vitina, delii, tsara khIumma tsa kkhullu, u'sh sha'sh kkhullush bu /Dala/. Tsara dola tsa do shain sinoshna zenna a, paidenna a, tsara dola tsa do dalarna a, dakharna a, dendarna a.
Elira tsateshachara: "KhIara /K'ur'an/ khartsderg du, sha tso (paikhamara) kkho'llina dolu, tsunna gIo dina tsu tIekh' kkhechu nakha a". Tsara deana zulam a, khartsderg a.
Tsara elira: "Kh'alkhalerancherantu'iranash du. Tso (Mukh'ammada) iazdaitina u'sh, u'sh tsunna do'shush du Iu'iranna a, su'iranna a".
Akh' ala: "Iza /K'ur'an/ dossiina Sha stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a k'aile khuush volcho. Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla t1ekh gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a".
Tsara elira: "KhIun du khIokkhu elchanna? Daar dou tso, bazarshkakhula lela iza. Do'ssina khillekh'ara tsu'nga malik, t1akkkha i khu'lush tsu'ntsa tskh'ana kkheramcha.
Ia kkho'ssinekh'ara tsu'nga khazna, ia khillekh'ara tsunna besh, tso tsu chu'ra iuush". Elira zulamkhosha: "Shu tIa'kh'akhIittina ma du shena bozbuunchalla dinchu stagana".
Kh'azhal, mukha daliina tsara kh'una masalsh - tilabella u'sh, /bak'dolchunna tIe/ nek' /lakha/ tsa mogu tsarna.
Berkate khili Iza, Shena li'cha, khu'lu'itur iara kh'una tsul dikanig - boshmash, shena bukhakhula khish o'khush iolu, khu'lu'itur iara kh'una gIalanash.
KhIa', tsara khartsdira sakh't. Okha kechiina sakh't khartsdinchunna /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe.
Tsunna (zho'zhakhatina) u'sh gicha genarchu mettigera, tsarna khezar du tsu'nan deralla a, ugIar a.
Tsu chu'ra gottachu mettige sha'sh kkhissicha, dIadikhkina a dolush /ku'igash logekh/, tsara kkhoikkhur dara khIallakkhilare.
/Er du tsa'rga/: "Ash ma kkhaikkha takhana tskh'ana khIallakkhilare, kkhaikkha dukkkha a khIallakkhilarshka!"
Akh' ala: "KhIara to'lu, ia guttarenna a iolu /ialsamanin/ besh /to'lu/, sha /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna khir iu a'llarg? I khilira tsarna bekkham a, t1etovzhiilaa".
Tsarna tsu chokh' shaina luurg iu, guttar /sha'sh tsu chokh'/ la'ttash. I khili kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna t1ekh' zho'pallin vaIda.
Sha u'sh a, tsara, I vitina, shaina Iibadat dinarsh a gulbinchu diinakh', Tso er du: "Ash tiliira khIara San lesh, ia sha'sh /niisachu/ novk'akh bevlira u'sh?"

Tsara er: "Vonakh tsIena vu Kh'o, tkhuna o'shush tsa khilira Kh'o votsurg verasash liitsa, delakh' a, Akh' zovkkh kh'egiitira tsa'rga a, tseran daishka a tsarna kh'ekham bitsballalts, u'sh khilira khIallakkhilla k'am".
/Er du Dala/: "Tsara shu khartsdira ash du'itsuchu'ntsa, shuna tsa mogu dukhatokha a /shaikh Iazap/, gIo khiliita a. Shukh milla velakh' a zulam desh, - tsu'nga Iovshu'itur du Okha dokkkha Iazap".

Okha tsa vakhiitina kh'ol kh'alkha a elchanekh /tskh'a a/, tsara kkhacha boush a, u'sh bazarshkakhula lelash a ben. Okha khiliitira shukh tskh'abersh vukkharna pitana. Ash sobar doi? Khilira kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gush verg.

Elira Tkhuna du'kh'alkkhetare dog tsa dokhuchara: "Vaina dossinekh'ara malikash, ia vaina gush velakh'ara vain Kkhiosh-kkhoburg". U'sh kurabevlira sha'shlakh', /Delan/ dozanekh bevlira u'sh balaral a sov.
Shaina malikash ginchu diinakh' - kkha' khir bats otsu diinakh' k'inosh dinacharna, tsara (malikasha) er du: "Kh'aram bina kh'aram bu".
Tkho tIedirzira tsara (kerstanasha du'nenakh') iinchu Iamalna, tsunakh khiliitira Okha ba'rzhina chim(tsa lerira Okha tseran Iamalsh).
Ialsamanin dai otsu diinakh' dika khir bu chIagIbalaran mettigtsa a, vuno dika khir bu /delk'akh'/ sadaIaran mettigtsa a.
Tsu diinakh' etIar iu stigal markhashtsa, okh'adossor du malikash /mogIarshtsa/ okh'adossortsa.
Kh'ak'-bak' dolu pachchakh'alla tsu diinakh' K'inkhetam bolchunna (Dalla) du. I khiliratsateshacharna khala /de/.
Tsu diinakh' zulam dinchotsergash iu'khkur iu shen ku'igekh, er du: "Ma dek'azva'lla-kkh so. Elchantsa nek' la'tsna khillekh'ara as.
Ma bala bu-kkh suna! Ma la'tsnekh'ara-kkh as kh'enekh dottagI.
Tiliira tso so kh'ekhamakh, i so'ga be'nachul tIa'kh'a. ShaitIa khilira adamna iamartkho".
Elira elchano /Dele dalkhosh shen g1ullakkh/: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu Dela, bakk'alla a, san k'omo khIara K'ur'an dIatesna ma diti!"
Ishtta khIora paikhamarna a Okha khiliitira mostagI k'inosh dinacharakh. To'ur du kh'una kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg khilar nisvesh verg a, gIo'ncha a.
Elira tsateshachara: "Do'ssinekh'ara tsu'nga /khIara/ K'ur'an tskh'ana teptartsa". Ishtta/dossiina Okha i/ shetsa kh'an dog chIagIdarkh'ama, Okha diishira i tIettIa".
Kh'o'ga dakh'ar dats tsara tskh'a a masal (khattar), Okha kh'una lush /i dukhatukhush/ bak'derg a, vuno khaza tidar a ben.
Sha'sh gulbiir bersh shain iakhkh'ash t1ekh' /tekkhosh/ zho'zhakhatina tIe - u'sh bu von bersh mettigatsa, uggar tilabellarsh nek'atsa.
Okha delira /kh'alkha/ Musaga zhaina, vazirkhiliitira tsu'ntsa tsu'nan vasha KhIarun.
Okha elira: "DIagIo shu shi' sha'sh Tkhan aiatash khartsdinchu /Fir1avnan/ k'omana tIe". TIakkkha Okha u'sh bokhiira /ch1og1achu/ bokhortsa.
Nukh'an k'am a, tsara elchanash khartsbicha, khin bukhabakhiitira Okha u'sh. Okha khiliitira tsarakh nakhana delil. Okha kechdira zulamkhoshna lazosh dolu Iazap.
Iadash a, Samudash a, Rassan dai a, tsarna iukk'ekh' tIa'kh'enash dukkkha a /khIallakiira Okha/.
KhIoranna Okha daliira shen masalsh, khIora a Okha khIallakvira khIallakvartsa.
U'sh (Makkan kerstanash) ma bakharii iu'rtatIe, shena tIe vonan dogIa dilkhina khillachu. Tk'a u'sh khilira i tsa gush? KhIan-khIa! U'sh khilira iukhadendare dog tsa dokhush.
Kh'o shaina gicha, kh'okh belar do tsara: "KhIara vu Dala vaiitinarg elcha vina?
Vai vain delekh dIatiladarakh tsa sotsu-kkh iza, vai tsarna tIekh' sobar tsa dakh'". TIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna shaina Iazap gicha, mila khilla uggar tilavellarg nek'atsa.
Kh'una gini-i i shen chIogIa dezachu khIumanakh shena dela la'tsnarg? Tk'a kh'o khir vara tsu'nan tIekh' vekal? (Kh'una mogur ma dats i nisvan).
Ia kh'una mo'ttu tsarakh dukkhakh bersh khozush ia oila esh bu? U'sh-m bezhnash sanna a ben batsii. KhIa', u'sh vuno a tilabellarsh bu nek'atsa.
Kh'o tsa kh'o'zhu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunga, mukha darzhina Tso IindagI? Shena li'nekh'ara, Tso i khu'liitara dara /pargIat/ setstsa. TIakkkha Okha malkh khiliitira tsunna tIekh' delil.
TIakkkha Okha Tkhaina tIe ozadira i (IindagI) daia ozadartsa (kIez-kIezzig dokkkhush dIa da'kkkhira Okha i IindagI, tIakkkha kIez-kIezzig iukhakhu'lu'itu).
Iza vu Sha khiliitinarg shuna bu'isa dukharkhilla, nab - sintem khilla. Tso khiliitina de iukhadendalarkhilla.
Iza vu baiitinarg mokh kkha' khilla Shen k'inkhetamalkh'alkha, Okha okh'adossira stiglara t1ekh tsIena khi.
Tsu'ntsa Okha denbarkh'ama bella mokhk, i malado Okha /shortta/ Tkhash kkho'llinchukh bezhnashna a, dukkkha nakhana a.
I (khi) darzhiira Okha tsarna iukk'ekh' tsarna dagadaitarkh'ama /Delan niImat/. T1akkkha a nakhakh dukkhakhbersh du'kh'al khilira kerstanalla dotsuchunna.
Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, Okha vaiitina khir vara khIor iurtakh' kkheramcha.
Kh'o mu'tIakh' ma khilalakh' tsateshacharna, k'iisam lattabe tsa'rtsa tsu'ntsa (K'ur'antsa) bokkkha k'iisam.

Iza vu shi khIord khetsna bitinarg /ia o'khuchu khin shi agIo khetsna iitinarg/: khIara: teza - merza, khIara: du'ra-chemaza. Tso khiliitina tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' /dokkkha/ pardo a, chIogIa du'kh'alo a u'sh /vovshakh tsa en /.
Iza vu kkho'llinarg khikh adam, Tso tsunna khiliitina shen taipan agIorkh'ara gergarlo a, zudariin agIorkh'ara (zakhallin) gergarlo a. Khilira kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg nitsk' kkhochush.
Tsara Iibadat do, Dela a vu'tii, shaina paida a, zen a tsa dechunna. Khili tsatesharg shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna du'kh'al gIo'ncha.
Kh'o tsa vakhiitina Okha kkha' bokkkhurg, kkheram tosurg khilla a ben.
Akh' ala: "As shu'ga tsa bo'khu tsunna t1ekh' tskh'a a makh, shena luucho shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga nek' latsar ben".
Kh'o tIetovzha sha diinavolchunna (Dalla), liirig votschu, tasbakh' de Iza khastortsa. Kkhacho iu Tsu'ntsa Shen lein k'inosh dika dovzartsa.

Ishttannig vu Iza Sha kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel derg ialkh diinakh', tIakkkha dIanisvella Iza IarshatIekh'. K'inkhetame verg vu Iza. Khatta tsu'nakh dika khuush volchu'nga.
Shaiga a'lcha: "Suzhud de K'inkhetame volchunna", tsara elira: "Mila vu i K'inkhetame verg? Tk'a okha suzhud do akh' tkhuna omra dechunna?" Tso sovbekhira u'sh /Delan nek'akh/ dog dalartsa.
Berkate vu /Dela/, Sha stiglakh' /sedarchiin/ g1alanashiinarg, Tso bina tsu chokh' chirkkh a, nure bolu butt a.
Iza vu khiliitinarg bu'isa a, de a khiitsalush shena luuchunna oila ian, ia barkalla ala.
K'inkhetame volchun lesh bu - sha'sh esala (kura botsush) la'ttakhula lelash bersh, shaitsa zhekhIal nakha k'amel desh, olush bersh: "Salam!"
/Dalla/ suzhudane bakhanchu kh'olekh' a, irakh1o'ttina la'ttash a lamazash dartsii bu'isanash den esh bersh a /bu/.
Olush bersh /a bu/: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! DIadakkkhalakh' tkhokh zho'zhakhatin Iazap. Bakk'alla a, tsu'nan Iazap khilla tIedo'zhna (k'inosh decharakh tsa k'a'stash).
Bakk'alla a, ma von khili-kkh iza /chokh'/ lattarna a, /sadaIa/ mettig khilarna a".
ShIa'sh /sagIa dokkkhush, kkhin/ kharzhash esh, kkhoam a besh, pis a tsa khu'lush, tsu iukk'ekh' khIo'ttina la'ttash bersha /bu Tsu Delan dika lesh/.

Delatsa kkhin dele tsa kkhoikkhush bersh a /bu Delan dika lesh/. Tsara tsa doiu sa, Dala sha /den/ kh'aram dina dolu, /den/ kh'ak' dolush ben. Zina tsa do tsara. I desh verg k'itsa du'kh'alkkhetar vu.
Shozza alsam dokkkhur du tsunna (Delatsa nak'ost la'tsnachunna) Iazap k'ematdiinakh', guttar la'ttar vu iza tsu chokh' siisaza khilla.
Sha toba dinarg a, iiman dillinarg a, dika Iamal iinarg a votsurg - u'sh bu Dala shain vonash dikanashtsa khiitsor dersh. Khili Dela t1ekh gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame a verg.
Toba dinarg a, dika Iamal iinarg a - bakk'alla a, tso toba do Dele /k'inoshna/ dokhko valartsa.
Kharts teshalla tsa desh bersh a, sha'sh da'ssachu khabarna ullokhula bo'dush - o'zda chekkhbolush bersh a /bu tsarakh/.
Shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatash shaina tIekh' kh'ekhiicha, k'ora khilartsii a, b1a'rze khilartsii a tsarakh d1a tsa bo'rzu u'sh.
Olush bersh / bu u'sh/: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, lolakh' tkhuna tkhan zudarekh a, do'zalakh a bIa'rg bekkhabalar, tkho khiliitalakh' /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna masal (u'sh Tkhuna tIa'kh'akhIuttush)".
Tsarna ial lur iu /ialsamanin/ khIusamtsa tsara /iimantsa/ sobar darna. Tsigakh' tsarna du'kh'aldogIur du /malikash/ marshallitsa a, salamtsa a.
Guttar la'ttar bu u'sh tsu chokh'. Ma khaza khili i satsavala mettig khilartsa a, /kh'oshalg1a/ vossa mettig khilartsa a /sha Delakh kkho'ruchunna/!

Akh' ala: "Shu'tsa bala khir batsara san Kkhiosh - kkhobuchun shun /khalonashkakh' a, balanashkakh' a Tsu'nga/ kkhaikkhar tsa khillekh'ara. Ash khartsdina /Tsu'nan din/ - tIa'kh'a khir du shuna iza khilaza tsa dolush derg".
TIa-sun-mum.
KhIorsh bilgala dolchu zhainan (K'ur'anan) aiatash du.
Kh'o khila mega kh'uo khIallakvesh u'sh tsa teshash khilarna.
Tkhuna laakh', Okha dossor du tsarna stiglara aiat - tIakkkha du'sur du tseran legash tsunna (Delan aiatana, delilna) mu'tIakh' khilla.
Tsa'rga tsa bogIu K'inkhetambolchu'ngaratskh'a a kerla kh'ekham u'sh tsunakh dIabo'rzush ben.
Khartsbira tsara /elchanash/ - tIa'kh'a bogIur bu tsa'rga khaam, u'sh shekh tsa beshash khilla bolu.
U'sh tsa kh'o'zhu-te la'tte: mel dukkha dika khIumanash ialiitina Okha tsunakh shish-shish!
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilma du. Tsa khili-kkh tsarakh dukkhakhbersh teshash.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - Iza vu-kkh veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Dagadaiita! Kkhaikkhira kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho Musaga: "DIagIo zulame k'am tIe,
FirIavnan k'am tIe. U'sh kkho'rur batsara-te?"
Tso (Musas) elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru-kkh tsara so khartsvarna.
Gattalo-kkh san dog, tsa bastalo-kkh san mott a. KhIarunna tIe bakhiitakh' /i so'tsa vaitan/.
Tseran suna tIekh' k'a du- so kkho'ru tsara so ven".
Tso (Dala) elira: "KhIan-khIa! DIagIo shu shi'Tkhan aiatashtsa. Bakk'alla a, Tkho shu'tsa du ladugIush.
Shu shi' dIagIo FirIavna tIe, ash shimmo dIaala: "Tkho Ialamiin Den elchanash du.
DIabaiita tkho'tsa Israilan kIentii".
Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Okha tsa kkhiira kh'o /khIai Musa/ tkhaina iukk'ekh' /kh'o/ ber a dolush, akh' d1a ma dekh'ira tkhuna iukk'ekh' kh'an dakharan sherash.
Akh' ma diira kh'an gIullakkh, aikh'a diinarg (tkhokh tskh'a stag viira akh' - dokkkha k'a diira) - barkalla tsa olucharakh vu-kkh kh'o".
Tso (Musas) elira: "I diira as so tilabellacharakhvolchu khenakh'.
So dIavedira shukh, suo shukh kkheravellachul tIa'kh'a. TIakkkha delira suna san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kh'ukam, Tso khiliitira so elchanekh.
KhIara niImat du akh' suna sha tIekhdettash aikh'a Israilan kIentekh lesh barna" (u'sh batsorna).
FirIavnas elira: "Mila vu Ialamiin da?"
Tso (Musas) elira: "Stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsu shinna iukk'ekh' mel dolchun a Da vu-kkh, shu /bak'dolchukh/ teshash khillekh'".
Tso (FirIavnas) elira shena gonakh' bolcha'rga: "Shu ladugIush dats?"
Tso (Musas) elira: "Shun Dela a vu I, shun kh'alkhalerchu dain a Dela a vu".
Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Bakk'alla a, /khIara/ shun elcha, shu'ga vaitina volu, zhiniikh ma vu".
Tso (Musas) elira: "Malkhbalen a, malkhbuzen a tsu shinna iukk'ekh' dolchun a Dela vu Iza, shu khillekh' kh'ek'ale".
Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Akh' so votsurg dela latsakh', as kh'o nabakhti chokh' bolcharakh khu'lu'itur ma vu". ("As kh'o nabakhti chu vu'llur ma vu").
Tso (Musas) elira: "So kh'aiga tskh'ana kkha'stash khIumantsa ve'nekh' a, e?"
Elira /FirIavnas/: "Skh'alo i /aikh'a de'narg/, kh'uo khillekh' bak'lu'icharakh".
TIakkkha tso (Musas) shen Iasa kkho'ssira - tsunakh k'egnalekh' khilira.
Tso arada'kkkhira shen ku'g /cho'kh'ara/ - iza shurul kIain khilira kh'o'zhucharna.
Tso (FirIavnas) elira shen gonakh' bolchu elashka: "Bakk'alla a, khIara govza volu bozbuuncha vu.
Luush vu i shu aradakha shun la'ttara shen bozbuunchallitsa - ash khIun omra do?"
Tsara elira: "Khan lotsunna a, tsu'nan veshina a, bakhiita gIalanashka /nakh/ gulbiirash.
Kh'una tIe bogIiila u'sh masso a govza volchu bozbuunchitsa".
TIakkkha gulbiira bozbuunchash bilgalchu diinakh' /to'khnachu/ khenakh'.
Elira nakhe: "Shu guldellii?
Vai tIekh'adaza mega bozbuunchashna, nagakh' u'sh khilakh' to'llarsh".
Bozbuunchash ba'khkicha, tsara elira FirIavne: "Tkhuna, bakk'alla a, makh khir bui, tkho khilakh' to'llarsh?"
Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "KhIa', bakk'alla a, shu tIakkkha /suna/ gerga- daliinacharakh khir du".
Elira tsa'rga Musas: "Kkhissa sha'sh kkhu'ssush erg".
Tsara kkhissira shain mushash a, Iasanash a, elira: "FirIavnan vozzalitsa, bakk'alla a, vai to'lur ma du".
TIakkkha kkho'ssira Musas shen Iasa - tso iudu (kkhollu) tsara mel kkhullurg.
Okh'abigira bozbuunchash, suzhud desh.
Tsara elira: "Okha dillina Ialamiin Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga,
Musan a, KhIarunan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga".

Tso (FirIavnas) elira: "Ash dilli as shaina purba dalale? Bakk'alla a, iza (Musa) shun vokkkhanig vu, sha shuna bozbuunchalla Iamiinarg, tIa'kh'a khuur du shuna. As khaddane a d1akhador du shun ku'igash a, kogash a du'kh'-du'kh'al, as irkh- ukhkur ma du shu derrige a".
Tsara elira: "Zen dats. Bakk'alla a, tkho tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga dIado'rzur du.
Bakk'alla a, tkho /chIogIa/ luush du tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobucho (Dala) gechdan tkhan gIalatash tkhash khilarna du'khkh'ashkhalgIa iiman dillinarsh".
Okha Musaga khaam bira vekh'etsa: "San leshtsa bu'isana aravala, a'lla, bakk'alla a, /FirIavnan nakh/ shuna tIa'kh'abovlur bolush ma bu".
Bakhiitira FirIavno gIalashkakhala gulamchash.
/Olush/: "KhIorsh-m (Israilan kIentii) kIezzig iolu tskh'a ledara toba iara.
Bakk'alla a, tsara vain degnash ma etIo.
Bakk'alla a, vai derrige a sema khila dezash ma du".
Okha arabekhira u'sh boshmashkara a, shovdanashkara a.
Khaznashkara a, siilakh'chu mettigera a.
Ishtta Okha u'sh irsana delira Israilan kIentashna.
U'shtsarna tIa'kh'abevlira malkh kkhetash.
Shina tobannavovshii gicha, Musan nak'ostasha elira: "Bakk'alla a, /FirIavnan bIo/ vaina tIa'kh'akkhu'ush bu".
Tso (Musas) elira: "KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, so'tsa san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu, Tso nisviir vu so".
Okha vekh'etsa khaiitira Musaga kh'an Iasa tokha khIordakh, a'lla. TIakkkha iza bek'abelira, khilira khIor dak'a bokkkhachu lamanakh tera.
Okha gergabalira tsiga vazhash a.
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira Musa a, tsu'ntsa verg a - berrige a.
TIakk'a Okha /khIorda/ bukhabakhiitira vazha bersh.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil du-kkh. Tsa khilira tsarakh dukkhakhbersh iiman dillina.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - Iza vu veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Diitsa tsarna IbrakhIiman khabar.
Tso ma a'llera shen dega a, shen k'ome: "Stenna Iibadat desh du shu?"
Tsara elira: "Tkho Iibadat desh du tkhan zha1arshna (tsIushna). Tkho la'tta tsarna suzhdane dakhna".
Tso elira: "Tsarna shu khozii ash kkhoikkhush?
Ia shuna paida besh bui tsara, ia zen desh dui?"
Tsara elira: "Delakh' a, tkhuna kariira tkhan dai ishtta /gIullakkh/ desh".
Tso elira: "Shuna tsa go, shu stenna Iibadat desh khilla,
Shu a shun shira dai a?
TIakkkha u'sh mostagIii bu-kkh suna, Ialamiin Davotsurg.
Sha so kkho'llina volu, Tso nisviir vu so.
Iza vu suna daa a, mala a lush verg.
So tsomgash khilcha, Tso so tavo.
Tso so volu'itur vu, tIakkkha denviir vu.
Iza vu suna chIogIa luush verg Tso san gIalatash gechdoila bekkhaman diinakh'.
So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, lo suna kh'ek'alalla, so kkhiave dikacharakh.
Khiliitalakh' so khaza kh'ekhavesh tIa'kh'abog1ucha'rgakh'.
So khiliitalakh' niImatiin ialsamaninirso'tsucharakh.
Akh' gechdelakh' san dena, bakk'alla a, iza khili-kkh tilabellacharakh.
Siisaza ma velakh' so /Kh'an ta1zartsa/ u'sh denbiir bolchu diinakh',
Kh'olo a, kIentasha a paida biir botschu diinakh'
Sha tsIenchudagtsa Dalla tIe ve'narg votschunna".
Ialsamane gergaialira /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna.
Zho'zhakhati gaitira galaba'llacharna.
Eliratsa'rga: "Michakh' iu i shu shena Iibadat desh khillarg,
Dela vitina, shuna gIo doi tsara? Ia shaina gIo doi tsara?"
Iakhkh'ashna tIe okh'atukhur bu tsu chokh' u'sh a, galaba'llarsh a,
Iblisan masso a eskar a.
Er du tsara, sha'sh tsu chokh' k'u'isush bolush:
"TallakhIi, tkho ma dara bilgalchu tilar chokh',
Okha shu nisdechu khenakh' Ialamiin Detsa.
Tkho tila ma tsa dina k'inosh dinachara ben.
Ma vats tkhuna shapa1at decharakh tskh'a a,
Dog tsIena dottagI a.
Tkho iukha /du'nena/ dokhu'itush delkh'ara - tkho khir ma dara iiman dillncharakh".
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du. Tsa khilira tsarakh dukkhakhbersh mu'min nakh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - Iza vu veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Khartsbira Nukh'an k'omo a elchanash.
Ma a'llera tsa'rga tseran vashas Nukh'as: "Shu tsa kkho'ru /Delakh/?
Bakk'alla a, so shuna teshame elcha ma vu.
Kkhera Delakh, suna mu'tIakh' a khila
As shu'ga tsunna tIekh' makh tsa bo'khu. Suna makh balar Ialamiin Degakh' ben dats.
Kkhera Delakh, suna mu'tIakh' a khila!"
Tsara elira: "Tkho mukha tesha kh'okh, kh'una tIa'kh'akhIittina ma bu /tkhokh/ uggar bukhabisnarsh".
Tso elira: "Suna khaats, u'sh khIun desh khilla.
Tseran kh'esap san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIekh' du, shuna khaalakh'.
As d1alelkhor bats mu'min nakh.
So bilgala volu kkheramcha ben vats".
Tsara elira: "Kh'o tsa satsakh', khIai Nukh', kh'o khir ma vu shaina tIe /okha/ tIulgash bittincharakh".
Tso elira /Dele do'khush /: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, san k'omo so kharts ma vina.
Akh' kkhiel ekh' suna a, tsarna a iukk'ekh', kIelkh'arvakkkhalakh' so a, mu'min nakhakh so'tsa mel verg a".
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, tsu'ntsa mel verg du'zzinchu kemana chokh'.
TIakkkha Okha /khIorda/ bukha- bakhiitira bisnarsh.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du. Tsa khili-kkh tsarakh dukkhakhbersh mu'min nakh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - Iza ma vu Sha veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Khartsbira Iadasha elchanash.
Tsa'rga ma elira tseran vashas KhIudas: "Shu tsa kkho'ru /Delakh/?
Bakk'alla a, so shuna teshame elcha ma vu.
Shu kkhera Delakh, suna mu'tIakh' a khila.
As tsa bo'khu shu'ga tsunna tIekh' makh. Suna makh balar Ialamiin Dena tIekh' ben dats.
Ash bo khIor aiellachu mettigekh' gIirs /bilgalo esh lelacharna/ samuk'adu'ilush.
Lu'itsush du shu /bakkhii/ gIirsash, sha'sh guttar la'ttar du mo'ttush.
Sha'sh tukhush, tukhu ash k'inkhetam botsush.
Shu kkhera Delakh, suna mu'tIakh' a khila.
Shu kkhera Sha shuna khuurg shuna shortta dellachukh.
Tso shuna shortta della da'khni a, kIentii a,
Boshmash a, shovdanash a.
Bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru shuna dezachu diinanIazapakh".
Tsara elira: "Tskh'aterra du tkhuna, akh' kh'ekham biichi a, ia kh'o kh'ekham becharakh tsa khilchi a.
KhIara kh'alkhalerachiin gIillakkh ben dats.
Tkhuna Iazap diir dolush dats".
Tsara iza khartsvira, tIakkkha Okha u'sh khIallakbira. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du. Tsa khili-kkh tsarakh dukkhakh bersh mu'min nakh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhioshkkhoburg - Iza vu-kkh Sha veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Khartsbira Samudasha a elchanash.
Ma elira tsa'rga tseran vashas Salikh'o: "Shu tsa kkho'ru?
Bakk'alla a, so shuna teshame elcha vu.
Kkhera Delakh, suna mu'tIakh' a khila.
As tsa bo'khu shu'ga tsunna tIekh' makh. Suna makh balar Ialamiin Dena tIekh' ben dats.
Shu du'tur dolush du tk'a kkhuzakh' sha'sh dolchakh' (kh1okkhu du'nenakh' guttar ni1matashkakh'), kkheram a botsush?
Boshmashkakh' a, shovdanashkakh' a.
Ialtanashkakh' a, khurmanashkakh' a - shen stom kh'ena bolchu.
Ash tu'stu la'mnekh tsIenosh kuradovlush.
Kkheralash Delakh, suna mu'tIakh' a khilalash.
Shu mu'tIakh' ma khilalash israp desh bolcheranomrana.
U'sh bu la'ttakh' bo'khanig desh bersh, dikanig tsa do tsara.
Tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, kh'o shena nu'tsk'ala bozbuunchalla dincharakh vu-kkh.
Kh'o ma dats tkho sanna adam a ben, dalade delil, kh'uo velakh' bak'lu'icharakh".
Tso elira: "KhIara emkal iu. Tsunna malar du, shuna a malar du bilgaldinchu diinakh'.
Ma kkhetalash tsunakh vonig dartsa - tIakkkha siilakh' deza dolchu diinan Iazaposkh'alo'tsur du shu".
Tsara tsunna urs kh'a'kkhira - u'sh dokhko bevlla Iu'iranga bevlira.
Iazapo skh'aletsira u'sh. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du. Tsa khili-kkh tsarakh dukkhakhbersh mu'min nakh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Dela - Iza vu-kkh Sha veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Khartsbira LutIan k'omo elchanash.
Ma elira tsa'rga tseran vashas LutIas: "Shu tsa kkho'ru?
Bakk'alla a, so shuna teshame elcha ma vu.
Shu kkheralash Delakh, suna a mu'tIakh' khilalash.
As tsa bo'khu shu'ga tsu tIekh' tskh'a a makh. Suna makh balar Ialamiin Dena tIekh' ben dats.
Shu o'khu tk'a bozharshna tIe masso a Ialamera?
Ash dIatesna du'tu shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho shaina kkho'llina khillachu shun zudarekh(shaina shovk' lakhar). KhIa', shu du-kkh dozanakh da'lla k'am".
Tsara elira: "Kh'o tsa satsakh', khIai LutI, kh'o khillanne a khir ma vu araba'khnacharakh". ("Okha iu'rtara aravokkkhur vu kh'o".)
Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, so shun Iamalna chIogIa o'gIazbakhnacharakh vu-kkh.
So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, kIelkhIarvakkkhalakh' so a, san do'zal a tsara dechukh".
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, berrige a tsu'nan do'zal a,
Tskh'a k'ena zuda iotsurgbukhabisincharna iukk'ekh'.
TIakkkha bokhiira Okha bisnarsh.
Okha do'ttira tsarna tIe dogIa. Ma von khilira shaina kkheram tesnacheran dogIa!
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil du-kkh. Tsa khilira tsarakh dukkhakh bersh mu'min nakh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - Iza vu-kkh sha veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Khartsbira Aikatandaisha a elchanash.
Ma elira tsa'rga ShuIaibas: "Shu tsa kkho'ru?
Bakk'alla a, so shuna teshame elcha ma vui.
Shu kkheralash Delakh, suna a mu'tIakh' khilalash.
As tsa bo'khu shu'ga tsu tIekh' tskh'a a makh. Suna makh balar Ialamiin Dena tIekh' ben dats.
Niisa khiliitalash /terzan/ baram, shu ma khilalash /terza/ eshocharakh.
Ozalash niisachu terzantsa.
Ash ma eshaelash nakhana tseran khIumanash, ma lelalash la'tta tIekh' bo'khanig darzhadesh.
Shu kkheralash, Sha shu a, /shul/ kh'alkhalerachiin ummat a kkho'llinchukh.
Tsara elira: "Kh'o shaina bozbuunchalla dinacharakh vu-kkh.
Kh'o a ma dats adam ben, tkho sanna dolu. Tkho teshna ma du, kh'o khartslu'charakh vu a'lla.
Akh' egae tkhuna kiisakash stiglara, kh'o velakh' bak'lu'icharakh".
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg dika khuush vu-kkh ash diirig".
TIakkkha tsara iza khartsvira, tIakkkha u'sh skh'aletsira IindagIan diinanIazapo. Bakk'alla a, iza khilira deza - dokkkhachu diinan Iazap.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du. Tsa khilira-kkh tsarakh dukkhakh bersh mu'min nakh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - Iza vu-kkh veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Bakk'alla a, iza /K'ur'an/ - Ialamiin Degara okh'adossar du.
Okh'ado'ssira tsu'ntsa (K'ur'antsa) Teshame Sa.
/Tso diishira i kh'una/ kh'an dagchokh' /ch1ag1dallalts/ kh'o khiliitarkh'ama kkheram tosucharakh.
Bilgalchu Ia'rbiin mattakh'.
Bakk'alla a, iza kh'alkhakhillacheran zhainii chokh' a du.
Tsarna tsa khilla-te delil i khuush khilar Israilan kIentiin Ielamnakhana?
Okha iza /K'ur'an/ dossiina khillekh'ara kkhechu k'a'mniin tskh'abolcha'rga,
Tsara iza tsarna do'shura dara - khir batsara u'sh tsunakh a teshash.
Ishtta dillira Okha i (K'ur'an khartsdar) k'inoshdecheran degnashka.
Teshar bats u'sh tsunakh shaina lazame dolu Iazap galts.
Iza dogIur du tsarna tsIekhkh'ana, shaina khaa tsa lush.
Tsara tIakkkha er du: "Vaina tskh'a /kIezzig/ khan tsa lo /Iazap tsa desh/?"
Tkhan Iazapatsa sikhlo u'sh?
Kh'una tsa gora Okha u'sh sherashkakh' /du'nenakh'/ bakhiiticha a...
TIakkkha deara tsa'rga, shaitsa khir du, a'lla, vaIda dina khillarg.
KIelkh'ar tsa bekhira u'sh /Delan Iazapakh/ tsarna bella khillachu bakhamo.
Okha khIallak tsa iira tskh'a a iurt shena kkheramchash botsush
/Tsarna/ dagadaita. Tkho tsa khilira zulamkhoi.
Tsa do'ssira tsu'ntsa shaitIanash (shaitIanasha tsa dossina i K'ur'an, tskh'abolchu kerstanasha ma bokhkhu).
Tarlush dats tsarna (shaitIanashna vekh'eshtsa okh'adissa), tsarna nitsk' tsa kkhochu.
U'sh /shaitIanash malikashka/ ladogIarakhdIasak'astiina du.
Ma kkhaikkha Delatsa kkhin dele - tIakkkha kh'o khir vu shaina Iazap diirdolcharakh.
Akh' kh'ekham bekh'una iukhkhera gergarcha'rga.
Kh'an tIam okh'abakhiita mu'min nakhakh kh'aina tIekh'akhIo'ttincharna (kIeda-merza khila tsa'rtsa).
Tsara kh'una Iesalla iakh', akh' ala: "So tsIena vu-kkh ash dechukh".
Kh'o tIetovzhaSha veza volchunna a, k'inkhetame volchunna a.
Shena kh'o gush volchunna kh'o irakhIuttuchu khenakh'.
Kh'an dIasaidar a du suzhud decheran iukk'ekh'.
Bakk'alla a, Iza vu-kkh khozush verg a, khuush verg a.
As du'itsii shuna /khIai Makkan kerstanash/, shena tIeshaitIanash dussuchukh?
U'sh du'ssu khIor khartslu'chunna a, k'inosh dechunna a tIe.
Tsara /shaitIanasha malikashkara k'ailenash/ khazar bozbuunchashka kkhu'ssu, tsarakh dukkhakh bersh khartslu'ish bu.
Nazmanchash - tsarna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttu tilabellarsh.
Kh'una tsa go u'sh masso a bu'irakh' dIasau'idush?
Tsara du'itsu sha'sh tsa diirig

Iiman dillinarsh, dika Iamalsh iinarsh, dukkkha Dela kh'ekhiinarsh botsursh - tsarna gIo khilira shaina zulam dinchul tIa'kh'a. TIa'kh'a khuur du zulam dinacharna, mu'lkhachu kh'ovzarna sha'sh tIekh'ovzur du.
TIa-sun. KhIorsh du K'ur'anan - bilgalchu zhainan aiatash.
Sha'sh niisa nek' a, mu'min nakhana kkha' a khilla bolu.
U'sh bu sha'sh lamaz a khIottadesh, zakat a lush, ekhartakh a sha'sh /ch1og1a/ teshash bersh.
Bakk'alla a, ekhartakh tsa teshash bersh - Okha khaziina tsarna shain Iamalsh, t1akkkha u'sh /shain tilar chokh'/ dIasau'idush bu.
U'sh bu shain /du'nenakh' - baiartsa, iiisare liitsartsa/ chIogIa Iazap khir dersh, ekhartakh' u'sh khir bu vuno tIekh eshnarsh.
Bakk'alla a, /khIai Mukh'ammad/ kh'una /nu'tsk'ala a/ du'itsush du K'ur'an Sha kh'ukamea, khuush a volchungura.
Musas ma elira shen do'zale: "Suna khaaeli-kkh tsIe, so shuna tIevogIur vu tsunakh tskh'a khabar dakh'ash, ia as shuna bakh'ar bu tskh'a begash bolu kIogalg - shu dokhdala megara-kkh".
Iza tsiga ve'cha, tsu'nga kkhaikkhira: "Dek'ala khili tsIergakh' verg a, tsunna gonakh' verg a, vonakh tsIena vu Dela - Ialamiin Da.
KhIai Musa! Bakk'alla a, So veza volu, kh'ukame volu Dela vu.
Okh'akkhossa kh'an Iasa". Shena iza (Iasa) gicha ettalush, tekkharg sanna, i (Musa) dIavedira, iukha a tsa virzira. "KhIai Musa! Ma kkhera. Tsa kkho'ru Suna gergakh' elchanash
Zulam dinarg a ben. TIakkkha tso sha dinchu vonan metta dikanig dakh', - tIakkkha bakk'alla a, So t1ekh gechdiirig a, k'inkhetam biirig a vu-kkh.

Kh'an che dolla kh'an ku'g - akh' skh'adokkkhur du iza kIaidella, tskh'a a khalo a iotsush, FirIavne a, tsu'nan k'ome a dolchu iss /Ialamatii/ chokh' /tskh'a Ialamat du iza/. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khili pesakkh k'am.
Shaiga guchudevlla Tkhan aiatash de'cha, tsara elira: "KhIara bilgala bozbuunchalla du!"
Zulam dartsa a, kuralla iartsa a kerstadira tsara u'sh, sha'sh /dagtsa/ teshnekh' a /u'sh Delera khilarkh/. Kh'azhal, mukha khilla pasad kh1umanash (von mel derg) lelosh bolcheran tIa'kh'e?
Okha delira Davude a, Suleimane a Iilma. Tsu shimmo elira: "Khastam bu Dalla, Sha tkho dazdinchu dukkha bolchu Shen teshash bolchu leshekh".
Suleimana iitsira Davudan irs, tso elira: "KhIai nakh! Tkhuna Iamiina olkhazariin mott, tkhuna della masso a khIumanakh /niImatash/. Bakk'alla a, iza bilgala dozalla du-kkh".
Guldira Suleimanna zhinekh a, adamekh a, olkhazarekh a dolu tsu'nan eskar -tIakkkha iza (eskar) diik'ira (mogIarshkakh').
U'sh zingatiin bo'rana tIe kkha'chcha, elira /tskh'ana/ zingato: "KhIai zingatash! Chudovlalash shain bannashna, shu kh'esha ma kh'eshakh'ara Suleimana a, tsu'nan eskaro a, shaina khaa tsa lush".

Iza velak'ezhira tsu'nan /zingatan/ deshakh, elira: "San Dela, Akh' suna taro lolakh' kham ban Kh'an niImatana, Aikh'a suna a, san dena - nanna a della dolchu, Kh'o shena reza volu dika Iamal ian a. So dIatokhalakh' Kh'an k'inkhetamtsa dikachu leshna iuk'a".
Iza volavelira olkhazarsh lekha, tIakkkha elira: "Suna khIuttut khIunda tsa go, ia iotsucharakh khili iza?
As danne a Iazap diir ma du tsunna chIogIa Iazap, ia as kh'akkhanne a urs kh'okkhur ma du tsunna, ia suna /sha bekhke tsakhilaran/ tskh'a bilgala delil dakh'ar ma du tso".
Zhimma khan ialiitina /e'nachu khIuttuto/ elira: "Suna khiira kh'una tsa khi'narg, as beana kh'una Saba'arabak'bolu khaam.
Bakk'alla a, suna kariina /tskh'a/ zuda, sha tsarna tIekh' pachchakh'alla desh iolu, tsunna della masso a khIumanakh (pachchakh'alla, niImat, berkat, khazalla...), tsu'nan siilakh'-iokkkha Iarsha iu.

Suna kariina iza a, tsu'nan k'am a suzhud desh malkhana, Dela a vitina. Khaziina tsarna shaitIano shain Iamalsh, tso dIatilina u'sh /niisachu/ nek'akh -u'sh nis tsa lo (u'sh niisachu novk'a tsa kh1uttu).
Tsara suzhud khIunda tsa do-te Dalla, Sha Ioradokkkhush volchu kh'uldellarg stiglanashkakh' a, lattakh' a, Shena khuush volchu ash k'ailadokkkhurg a, ash dIakh'edorig a?
AllakhI (ts1e iolu tskh'a) Dela vu, kkhin dela vats, Iza votsurg,-siilakh'-iokkkhachu IarshanDa vu/Iza/".
Tso (Suleimana) elira: "Vai kh'ovsur du, bak' liina-te kh'o, ia kh'o khilla-te khartslu'icharakh?
Kh'ada, khIara san kekhat etsii dIagIo, tsarna kh'alkha kkhossa iza, tIakkkha tsarna iu'stakhdala, kh'azha, tsara khIun iukhaderzado".
Tsoelira: "KhIai, eliin toba, bakk'alla a, kkha'chna so'ga siilakh' dolu kekhat.
Bakk'alla a, iza du Suleimanera, tso /du'itsu-kkh/: "Sha sov k'inkhetame a, k'inkhetame a volchu Delan tsIartsa.
Shu lakkhadovla ma gIerta sol, suna tIe du'ila, mu't1akh' a khilii (Dela tskh'a' vesh)".
Tso (Bilk'iso) elira: "KhIai eliin toba! Satsam be suna san gIullakkha tIekh'. So tsa khilla-kkh tskh'a a g1ullakkh khadadesh, shutsa dagaiolush ben".
Tsara elira: "Vai nitsk' bolush a du, chIogIa kh'u'nar dolush a du, tk'a gIullakkh kh'o'gakh' du-kkh. Kh'azhakh' tk'a, khIun omra do akh' -/okha kkhochushdiir du iza/".
Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, pachchakh'asha sha'sh iu'rtana chuba'khkicha, iokhaio iza, tsu'nan okhIlakh siilakh' bersh siisazbokhu tsara. Ishtta do tsara.
Bakk'alla a, as dokh'u'itu tsarna (SuleimangIarna) sovgIat, tIakkkha kh'ozhur iu, stentsa iukhabo'rzu bakhiitinarsh".

Iza (Bilk'isa vaiitinarg) Suleiman volchu ve'cha, tso (Suleimanas) elira: "So da'khnitsa kh'ole vo ash? Dala suna dellarg dika ma du Tso shuna dellachul a, delakh' a, shu shain sovgIatatsa dakkkhiidesh du-kkh.
Iukhaverza tsarna tIe, tkho dogIur du tsarna tIe eskartsa, shetsa u'sh laralur botschu, Okha arabokhur bu u'sh tsu chu'ra (shain makhkara) siisaza khilla, u'sh kIelbu'sur bu".
Tso (Suleimana) elira: "KhIai eliin toba! Shukh mu'lkha dogIur dara suna tIe tsu'nan (Bilk'isan) Iarsh iakh'ash, u'sh suna tIe bakhkale mu't1akh' a khilla?"
Zhinekh uggar /nu'tsk'ala/ dolchu Iifrito elira: "So dogIur du kh'una tIe tsu'ntsa, kh'o kh'an mettigera kh'alagIattale. So tsu tIekh' nu'tsk'ala a, teshame a du".

Shegakh' zhainan Iilmadolcho elira: "So vogIur vu kh'una tIe tsu'ntsa, akh' bIa'rganegIar tokhale". Shena iza (Bilk'isan Iarsh) gicha, shena kh'alkhakh' la'ttash, tso (Suleimana) elira: "KhIara san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun dozallakh du, Tso so zerkh'ama, barkalla olu as ia inkarlo io. Barkalla olucho -tso shen du'kh'a olush du, inkarlo echo-bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg kh'al dolush a vu, siilakh' a vu".
Tso elira: "Khiitsam be tsu'nan Iarsha tIekh', vai kh'ovsur, evzii tsunna iza, ia khir iu-te iza i tsa evzacharakh. "

Iza (Bilk'is) e'cha, elira /tsu'nga/: "Ishtta iui kh'an Iarsh?" Tso elira: "Iza iolchukh tera iu khIara". /Suleimana elira shena Bilk'isekh' Iilma duila khi'nachul tIa'kh'a/: "Tkhuna Iilma dellera tsunchul (Bilk'isal) kh'alkha, tkho mu'tIakh' khilira /Dalla/".
Iza (Bilk'is) iukhatu'ikhira /tskh'ana Dalla Iibadat darakh/ tso, Iza a vitina, kkhechunna Iibadat daro. Bakk'alla a, iza ma iara tsa teshachu k'omakh.

Elira tsu'nga: "Cho'kh'aiala gIalina!" Shena iza (g1ala) gicha, tsunna mottadelira iza alssam khi du, tso shen nastarsh guchuekhira. Tso (Suleimana) elira: "Bakk'alla a, iza gIala iu k'eginchu a'ngalekh iina". Tso (Bilk'iso) elira: "So Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, bak'alla a, as zulam ma dina saina. /Kh1intsa/ mu't1akh' khili so Suleimanatsa tskh'ana /tskh'a' volchu/ Dalla -Ialamiin Dena".
Okha vakhiitira Samudashka tseran vasha Salikh', Dalla Iibadat de, a'lla -u'sh, shi toba a khilla, k'iisa bu'ilabelira.
Tso elira: "Kh1ai san k'am, shu khIunda sikhlo vonig /dartsa/ dikanig /daral/ kh'alkha? Gechdar dekhakh'ara ash Dele, shukh k'inkhetam ban tam bara".
Tsara elira: "Kh'o a, kh'o'tsa bersh bakh'anekh' tkhuna von bilgalonash khaaella". Tso elira: "Shun dak'a (dikanig ia vonig) Dalla gergakh' du.KhIa', shu du-kkh pitane lo'tsush dolu k'am".
Tsu gIalakh' khillera iss stag, la'ttakh' bo'khanig darzhadesh volu, dikanig a tsa desh.

Tsara elira: "Vovshashna duinash baa Delatsa, vai bu'isana voiur vu iza a (Salikh'), tsu'nan do'zal a, tIakkkha er vai tsu'nan verase: "Tkho datsara tsu'nan do'zal khIallakkhu'luchakh', tkho bak'lu'ish ma du".
Mekarlo iira tsara mekarlontsa, Okha iira /tseran mekarlonna du'kh'al/ mekarlo mekarlontsa, tsarna tsa khaalush.
Kh'azhal, mukha khilla tseran mekarlonan tIa'kh'e: Okha et1ira u'sh a, tseran k'am a -berrige a.
KhIorsh du tseran tsIenosh, do'khna la'ttash, tsara zulam dina khilarna. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil du-kkh sha khuush dolchu k'omana.
Okha kIelkh'arbekhira iiman dillina khillarsh, sha'sh /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillarsh.
LutI a /vakhiitira Okha shen k'omana tIe/, tso shen k'ome ma elira: "Bo'khanig lelado tk'a ash shaina gush dolush? (I bo'kha khilar).
Shu o'khu tk'a bozharashna tIe bezamtsa, zudarii bu'tii? KhIa', shu du-kkh zhekhIal k'am".
Tsa khilira tsu'nan k'oman dala zhop, sha'sh alar ben: "Arabakha LutIan do'zal shain iu'rtara. Bakk'alla a, u'sh ma bu tsIanbala gIertash bolu nakh".
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, tsu'nan do'zal a, tsu'nan /tskh'a/ zuda iotsurg -tsu'nan kkhollam /1azapekh'/ bukhaiu'sucharakh khiliitira Okha.
Okha do'ttira tsarna tIe dogIa -von khilira shaina kkheram tesnacharna dogIa.
Akh' ala /khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Khastam bu Dalla, salam du Tsu'nan leshna, Tso kha'rzhina khillacharna. I Allakh1-Dela to'lu, ia tsara /Tsu'ntsa/ la'tsna nak'ostii to'lu?

Ia mila vu Sha stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llinarg, shuna stiglara khi a daiitinarg? Okha ialiitina tsu'ntsa (dogIitsa) boshmash, shaitsa khazalla a iolush, ash ma dolu'itara datsara tsu'ntsa (tsu khitsa) ditt. Kkhin dela vu /tsu/ AllakhIatsa tskh'ana? KhIa', u'sh du k'am, sha /Delatsa kkhibersh/ nisbesh.

Ia mila vu Sha latta khiliitinarg chIagIo khilla, iukk'ekhula khin tatolash dinarg, tsu tIekh' la'mnash dinarg, shina khIorda iukk'ekh' du'kh'alo iinarg? Kkhin dela vu AllakhIatsa tskh'ana? KhIa', tsarakh dukkhakhbersh tsa khuush bu-kkh.

Ia mila vu Sha zhop lush verg shena gIelo khillachunna, tso Shega kkhaikkhicha, i zulam dIadokkkhush verg, shu khu'lu'itush verg la'ttan dai? Kkhin dela vu AllakhIatsa tskh'ana? Ma kIezzig oila io-kkh ash.

Ia mila vu Sha shu nisdesh verg arenan a, khIordan a bodanashkakh', Sha mokh bokhu'itush verg kkha' khilla /dogIa darna/ Shen k'inkhetamal kh'alkha? Kkhin dela vu AllakhIatsa tskh'ana? Lakkhaveli Dela tsara /Shetsa/ nak'ost latsarkh.

Ia mila vu Sha kkhollar dolosh verg, tIakkkha iza karladokkkhurg, mila vu shuna ritsk' lush verg stiglara a, lattara a? Kkhin dela vu AllakhIatsa tskh'ana? Akh' ala: "Dalade shain delil, sha'sh khillekh' bak'lu'ish".
Ala: "Tsa kha'a stiglakh' volchunna a, la'ttakh' volchunna a k'ailakh' derg, Sha Dela votschunna". Tsarna khaalur dats, sha'sh matsa dendiir du.
TIekkhi'nii tseran khaarsh ekhartana? KhIa', u'sh shekonekh' bu tsunakh. KhIa', u'sh tsunakh bIa'rsa daina bu.
Elira tsateshnachara: "Tkhokh a, tkhan daikh a latta khilcha, tkho aradokhur dolush du /keshnashkara/?
ChIagIo iinera khIokkhuntsa tkhuna a, tkhan daishna a kh'alkha a. Iza-m kh'alkhaleracheran tu'iranash ben dats".
Akh' ala: "D1asalela la'ttakhula, kh'ovsa, mukha khilla k'inosh dinacheran tIa'kh'e".
Akh' sa ma gattade tsarna, ma khila khalonekh' tsara echu mekarlonekh.
Tsara olu: "Matsa khir iu i vaIda,shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'".
Akh' ala: "Shuna t1a'kh'ade'na khila tarlo tskh'atstsa ash sikhdesh dersh".
Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhoburg dozalla dolush ma vu nakhana tIekh', delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolchara barkalla tsa olu-kkh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhoburg Sha khuush vu-kkh tseran degnasha kh'uldesh derg a, tsara dIakh'edorig a.
Dats tskh'a a k'ailakha derg stiglakh' a, la'ttakh' a bilgalchu zhainachokh' /iazdina/ dolush ben.
Bakk'alla a, khIokkhu K'ur'ano du'itsu Israilan kIentashna tseran shena chokh' khilpalo iolchukh dukkhakhdersh.
Bakk'alla a, iza niisa nek' bu, k'inkhetam a bu mu'min nakhana.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kkhiel iiir iu tsarna iukk'ekh' Shen kh'ukamtsa. Iza veza verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.
Kh'o tIetovzha Dalla. Bakk'alla a, kh'o bilgalchu bak'dolchunna tIekh' ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, akh' /khIumma a/ khozu'itur dats bellacharna, akh' kkhaikkhar khozu'itur dats k'ora bolcharna, u'sh iukhabevla dIabevdicha.
Kh'o ma vats nisbesh verg bIa'rsa dotsursh shain tilarkh. Akh' khozu'itur du dekk'a Tkhan aiatekh teshash bolcharna - tIakkkha u'sh bu mu't1akh' bersh.
Tsarna doshtIedo'zhcha, Okha la'ttan kiirara skh'adokkkhur du tsarna bezhana, tso tsa'rtsa k'amel a desh, bakk'alla a, nakh Tkhan aiatekh tsa teshash khilla, a'lla.
/Akh' kh'akhade/: otsu diinakh' Okha guliiir iu khIor ummatakh Tkhan aiatash khartsdesh khillachukh toba -u'sh dIasa- nisbiir bu.
TIakkkha u'sh /kh'esap dechu mettige/ be'cha, /Dala/ er du: "Ash khartsdira San aiatash? Shu ma datsara shaigakh' /u'sh khartsdan/ Iilma dolush a, khIun Iamal esh khillera shu?"
TIedu'izhira tsarna tIe /Iazap bak'khilaran/ dosh tsara shaigara zulam daliitarna, u'sh bist tsa khu'lu.
Tsarna tsa go-te Okha khiliitina khilar bu'isa, shaina chokh' sadaIan, de a serladakkkha. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' bilgalonash ma iu teshash dolchu k'omana.
Otsu diinakh' sur lokkhur iu -kkho'rur vu stiglanashkakh' mel verg a, la'ttakh' mel verg a, Dalla li'narg votsurg. Masso a Tsunna tIe vogIur vu mu't1akh' a khilla.

Kh'una gur du la'mnash, kh'una sha'sh Iu'llush du mo'ttush -amma u'sh dIasalelash khir du, markhash sanna -Delan kkhollar du iza, Sha masso a khIumanna kh'ukam dinchu. Bakk'alla a, Iza ash diirig dika khuush verg vu-kkh.
Dikachu'ntsa ve'narg-tsunna tsul dikanig /sha de'nachukh/ khir du, u'sh kkheramakh otsu diinakh' ma'rsha khir bu.
Vochu'ntsa ve'narg-iu'kh' tsIarga erziina khir iu tsu'nan. Ash esh khillachu Iamalashtsa ben bekkham khir bui shuna?
Suna omra dina khIokkha /Makka/ gIalin Dena Iibadat de a'lla, Sha iza kh'aramiina iolchu, Tsu'nan du masso a khIuma a. Suna omra dina so mu't1akh' khillacharakhkhila, a'lla.
K'ur'an desha a'lla a, nisvellarg /tsu KIur'ana tIe/ iza nislush vu shena. /Nakh iimanakh/ tiloshbolchu'nga akh' ala: "So kkheram tosucharakh vu".
Akh' ala: "Khastam bu Dalla. Tso goitur du shuna Shen aiatash -tIakkkha shuna u'sh devzar du. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg ma vats ash diirig tidame tsa o'tsush".
TIa-sun-mum.
KhIorsh du khIumanash bilgaldechu zhainan aiatash.
Okha du'itsu kh'una Musan a, FirIavnan a khabarekh tskh'adersh bak'dolchu'ntsa teshachu k'omana /paida khiliitan/.

Bakk'alla a, FirIavn vazvelira /Misran/ la'ttakh', tsu'nan nakhakh tobanash iira tso, tsarakh tskh'a tobagIel'esh. Tso baiara tseran kIentii, diina bu'tura tseran zudarii. Bakk'alla a, iza khilira pasad kh1umanash (telkhina mel derg) lelocharakh.
Tkhuna liira sha'sh la'ttakh' gIelbina khillacharakh (Israilan k1entekh) k'inkhetam ban a, tsarakh imamashban a, u'sh irs o'tsursh ban a,
U'sh chIagIban a la'ttakh', FirIavna a, KhIamanna a, tsu shinnan eskarna a gaita a u'sh shekh kkho'rush derg.

Okha khaam biraMusan nene vakkhave iza, a'lla. Nagakh' kh'o kkherakh' tsunakh (Musana bokham khilarkh), akh' kkhossa iza khIordachu -kkhera ma kkhera, sa ma gatde -Okha iukhaverzor vu iza kh'o'ga, khu'lu'itur vu iza elchanekh.
Iza skh'ava'kkkhira /Nil khina chu'ra/ FirIavnan do'zalo tsunakh shaina mostagI a, singattam a khiliita. Bakk'alla a, FirIavn a, KhIaman a, tsu shinnan eskar a khilira g1alatbevlarsh.
FirIavnan zudcho elira: "Suna a, kh'una a bIa'rgiin marzo iu-kkh! Ma ve iza, vaina paida ban mega tso, ia vai do'zalkho lotsur tsunakh -tsarna khaalush datsara.../otsunakh khinderg/.
Musan nenan dog da'ssaIu'irenga delira. Iza gergaiara tsu'ntsa guchuialaOkha tsu'nan dog chIagIdina tsa khillekh'ara iza (Musan nana) khiliitarkh'ama /Delan vaIdikh/ teshacharakh.
Tso elira tsu'naniishe: "Kh'ada, tsunnatIa'kh'agIo". Iza kh'o'zhura tsu'nga agIorkh'ara, tsarna khaa tsa lush.
Okha kh'aram bira tsunna i vakkhon zudarii kh'alkha. TIakkkha tsoelira: "As nisdoi shu tsIiinan okhIlana tIe, shuna iza kkhoburg volchu, sha'sh tsunna kh'ekhamchash a khu'lush".
TIakkkha Okha iukhaverzira iza shen nene, tsu'nan bIa'rg marzbala a, tso sagat tsa dan a, tsunna khaiitarkh'ama a Delan vaIda kh'ak'-bak' khilar, delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Iza (Musa) g1emettakh1o'tticha, nisvelcha, Okha tsunna delira kh'ukam a, Iilma a. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha dikacharna.

G1alina cho'kh'avelira iza tsu'nan nakh gIovpalbolchu khenakh'. Tsunna kariira tsu chokh' shi stag vovshakh letash: khIara khIokkhun tobanekh, vazha -khIokkhun mostagIekh. Tsu'nga gIo diikhira tsu'nan tobanekh volcho tsu'nan mostagIekh volchunna tIekh'. Musas tsunna bui tu'ikhira -tso iza chekkhva'kkkhira. Tso (Musas) elira: "KhIara shaitIanan gIullakkhekh du. Bakk'alla a, iza bilgala tilavesh mostagI du".
Tso (Musas kh'astavella Dele) elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobushverg, as san degIana zulam ma dina, gechdekh'a suna". Tso tsunna gechdira. Bakk'alla a, Iza t1ekh gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' suna niImat dalartsa sokh tsk'a a khir ma vats k'inoshdecharna gIo'ncha".

Iza Iu'iranga velira g1alakh' kkho'rush, sema khu'lush. /Sha ishtta la'ttash/ selkhana shega gIo diikhinarg shega mokh' bettash /gira tsunna/. Musas tsu'nga elira: "Bakk'alla a, ma gush-la'ttash tilavellarg vu-kkh kh'o!"

TIakkkha shain shinnan mostagI volchunna tokha tsunna (Musana) li'cha, tsoelira: "KhIai Musa, so ven luush vu-kkh kh'o, aikh'a selkhana stag verakh terra, kh'o luush ma vats la'ttakh' nitsk' besh verg khilla /1an a/ ben, kh'o luush ma vats /nakhana iukk'ekh'/ maslakh'at decharakh khila".
Tskh'a stag veara gIalin iistera vedda, tso elira: "KhIai Musa! /GIalin/ dai dagabevla kh'o ven, aravalalakh' /khIokkhu makhkara/. So kh'una kh'ekhambecharakh vu".
Iza tsigara (gIalara) aravelira kkho'rush, sema khu'lush. Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, kIelkh'arvakkkhakh' so zulamechu k'omakh".
Sha Madian agIorgakh'a dIavolavelcha, tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobucho so nisvan mega niisachu novk'a".

Madianan khinan ko'rte d1akkha'chcha, tsunna tsigakh' tskh'a nakh kariira khi malosh /shain bezhnashna/. Tsunna kariira tsarna tIekh'akh' la'ttash shi zuda /shain u'stagIii/ dIalo'khkush /khina tIe tsa dokhu'itush/. Tso elira: "KhIun bala bu shu-shinnan?" Tsu shimmo elira: "Okha tsa malado i Iui chekkh tsa bevlicha, tk'a tkhan da vokkkha stag vu".
Tso khi maliira tsarna shinna (tseran u'stag1ashna), tIakkkha dIavirzira IindagIe, elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, so Akh' suna dossina dikanig o'shush ma vu (metsa vu)".

Tsunna tIe eara tsu shinnakh tskh'a', ekh' khetash iolaella, tso elira: "San das kh'o kkhoikkhu kh'una makh balan akh' tkhuna khi malorna". Iza (Musa) tsunnatIe ve'cha, tso tsu'nga khabar diitsicha, tso elira: "Kh'o ma kkhera! Kh'o kIelkh'arva'lla zulamechu k'omakh".
Tsu shinnakh tskh'ammo elira: "Dada, mekhakh bolkh ban vita iza, akh' mekhakh bolkh ban vu'tur volchekh uggar dikanig vu iza -nu'tsk'ala a, teshame a vu".

Tso (ShuIaibs) elira: "Suna la'a khIokkhu san shina ioIakh tskh'a' kh'o'ga mare iala akh' suna bolkh barkh borkhI sharakh'. Akh' itt sho kkhochushdakh' -i kh'o'gara khir du, kh'una khalo ian luush vats so. Kh'una karor vu so, Dala muk'alakh', dikacharakh".
Tso (Musas) elira: "KhIara suna a, kh'una a iuk'akh' du. Tsu shinnakh mu'lkhkha zama as kkhochush'iakh', dov diir dats so'tsa. I Dela vai oluchunna tIekh' vekalma vu".

Musa shen khan chekkh a ia'kkkhina, shen do'zaltsa dIavo'dush, tsunna khaaelira T1yr lamanan agIorkh'ara tsIe. Tso elira shen do'zale: "Ash /kkhuzakh'/ sobar de, suna tsIe khaaella, so van mega shuna tIe tsu'ngara tskh'a khabar dakh'ash, ia tsIerakh tskh'a kha'shtig dakh'ash, shu dokhdalamegara".
Iza tsunna (tsIarna) tIe ve'cha, kkhiikkhira togIin a'ttu agIorkh'ara berkate iolchu mettigekh' dolchu ditt dolchu'ra: "Va Musa! Bakk'alla a, So Dela vu, Ialamiin Da.
Okh'akkhossa kh'an Iasa!" Tsunna iza gicha ettalush, tekkharg sanna, iza dIavedira, iukha a tsa vo'rzush. "Va Musa! Gergavola, ma kkhera, kh'o kkheram khir botsucharakh vu.

Kh'an ku'g che dolla, /t1akkkha skh'aadakkkha i/ - skh'ader du kIain khilla tskh'a a zen dotsush. TIetaIade /kh'an a'ttu ku'g/ kh'an /dagna/ t1e - d1ader du kh'an /tekkhargakh/ kkherar. I shi' bilgalo iu kh'una kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara FirIavne a, tsu'nan elashka a. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khili-kkh pesak' k'am".
Tso elira: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, as tsarakh stag ma vina, so kkho'ru-kkh tsara so ven.
I san vasha KhIarun, iza sol melkho a govza ma vu mattatsa, vaiitakh' iza so'tsa gIo'ncha khilla, so bak'khilar chIagIdiir dara tso. Bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru tsara so khartsvarna".

Tso (Dala) elira: "Okha chIagIviir vu kh'o kh'an veshitsa, Okha khu'lu'itur iu shuna shinna bak'o, shuna shinna tIekkhochur bats u'sh. Tkhan aiatashtsa shu shi' a, shuna shinna tIa'kh'a mel va'znarg to'lur vu".
Shaiga ve'cha Musa Tkhan bilgalchu aiatashtsa, tsara elira: "KhIara ma dats /nakha/ kkho'llina bozbuunchalla ben, tkhuna-m tsa khezna otsunakh tkhan kh'alkhalerchu daishkakh'".
Elira tk'a Musas: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu-kkh dika khuush Shegara niisachu nek'atsa mila veana a, /dakharan/ khIusaman tIa'kh'e kh'enan khir iu a. Bakk'alla a, zulamkhoi bakkkhiibiir ma bats".

FirIavnas elira: "KhIai elii! Suna tsa khi'nera shuna so votsurg /kkhin/ dela. TsIe latae suna, khIai KhIaman, popparakh (kibarchigash iotta), tIakkkha /lekkha/ gIala e suna, so mega Musan Dalla tIekkhacha. Bakk'alla a, suna iza khetash vu khartslu'icharakh".
Kuravelira iza a, tsu'nan eskar a la'ttakh' kurabovla kh'ak' botsush, tsarna mettara sha'sh Tkhuna tIe iukhaderzor a dats.
Okha skh'aletsira iza a, tsu'nan eskar a, tIakkkha Okha kkho'ssira u'sh khIorda chu. Kh'azhal kh'o, mukha khilla zulamkhoin tIa'kh'e!
Okha khiliitira tsarakh /nakh/ tsIergakkhoikkhush imamash. K'ematdiinakh' tsarna gIo diir dats.
Tsarna tIa'kh'akh'azhiira Okha khIokkhu du'nenakh' a neIalt, k'ematdiinakh' u'sh ma bu /Delan k'inkhetamakh/lelkhosh genaba'khnacharakh.
Kh'alkhalera tIa'kh'enash khIallakiinchul tIa'kh'a Okha delira Musaga zhaina, sha nakhana gush dolu delilash a, niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a khilla dolu, tsara dagadaita megara-kkh, a'lla.
Kh'o vatsara /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ malkhbuzen agIongakh' Okha Musaga gIullakkh satsadechu khenakh', kh'o vatsara /tsigakh'/ khillacharakh.
Delakh' a, Okha kkhiira tIa'kh'enash, dakhdelira tsarna tIekh' dakhar. Kh'o vatsara la'ttash Madian okhIla iukk'ekh' tsarna Tkhan aiatash a du'itsush, delakh' a, Tkho dara bokhku'itursh /elchanash/.

Kh'o vatsara T1yr lamananagIongakh' Okha /Musaga/ kkhiikkhicha, delakh' a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun k'inkhetamtsa /vaiitina kh'o/ akh' kkheram tasan k'omana, shena tIe kh'ol kh'alkha /tskh'a a/ kkheramcha tsa veana dolchu, tsara oila iiir iatsara-te?

/Okha k'uraishashka elcha tsa vakhiitinekh'ara/ shaina bokham khilcha shain ku'igasha kh'alkha kechdiinarg bakh'anekh', tsara er ma dara: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! Akh' vaiitina khillekh'ara tkho'ga elcha, tkho tIa'kh'akhIuttur ma dara Kh'an aiatashna, tkho khir ma dara teshacharakh".

Shaiga Tkho'gara bak'derg de'cha, tsara elira: "Tsu'nga (Mukh'ammad paikhamare) della khillekh'ara Musaga dellarg". Tk'a tsara kharts tsa dira Musaga dellarg kh'alkha? Tsara ma elira: "Shi bozbuunchalla (K'ur'an a, Tavrat a) du, vovshashna gIo a desh". Ma elira tsara: "Massokh a tsa tesha /tkho/".
Akh' ala: "Skh'alo Delera zhaina, sha tsu shinnal (K'ur'anal a, Tavratal a) niisa a dolush, so tsunna tIa'kh'akhIuttur vu, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'".

Tsara kh'una zhop tsa lakh', kh'una khaalakh' u'sh dekk'a shain dezarshna tIa'kh'abevla buila. Mila vu tk'a tilame, Delera niisa nek' a botsush, shen dezarna tIa'kh'ava'llachul? Bakk'alla a, Dala nis tsa do zulame k'am.
Okha kkhachiira tsa'rga dosh tIettIa, tsara oila iiir iatsara-te?
Okha shaina tsul (K'ur'anal) kh'alkha zhaina (Tavrat, Inzhil...) dellarsh -u'sh tsunakh (K'ur'anakh) teshash bu.
Iza shaina deshcha, tsara elira: "Tkho tsunakh teshna, bakk'alla a, iza bak'derg du vain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchungara, tkho khilira tsul kh'alkhabusalbanash."
U'sh -tsarna lur bu shain makh shozza tsara sobar darna a, tsara vonig dikachu'ntsa dukhatukhush khilarna a, Okha shaina dellachu ritsIk'ekh tsara /dikanna t1ekh'/ kharzhash iarna a.
Shaina da'ssa khabar khezcha, tsunakh dIak'a'sta u'sh, olush: "Tkhuna tkhan Iamalsh iu, shuna shain Iamalsh iu, salam khu'lda shuna, tkho tsa gIerta zhekhIal nakhana tIe".
Bakk'alla a, akh' nisviir vats kh'aina veznarg, delakh' a, Dala nisvo Shena luurg. Iza dika bevzash vu nisbellarsh.

Tsara (k'uraishin taipan nakha) elira: "Tkho niisachu nek'ana tIa'kh'akhIitticha kh'o'tsa tskh'ana, tkho tkhan la'ttakh dokhur ma du /kkhechu Ia'rbasha/". Okha chIagI tsa iira tk'a tsarna teshame kh'aram, tsiga masso a khIumanan sto'mash kkho'kh'ush Tkho'gara ritsk' khilla? Delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakh bolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Mel khIallakiira okha iurt, kuraia'lla khilla iolu shen dakharekh'. KhIorsh iu tseran gIishlosh, /shaina chokh'/ tsaral tIa'kh'a kIezzig ben /nakh/ tsa bekhash. Tkho khilira irs o'tsursh.

Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tsa khilira iartash khIallakiesh tseran nakhalakh' elcha tsa vokhu'itush, tso tsarna Tkhan aiatash a do'shush. Tkho tsa khilira iartash khIallakiesh, tseran bakharkhoi zulam desh bolush ben.

Shuna della khIuma -iza du'nenan dakharan /k1ezzig/ kh1uma du, tsu'nan khazalla a iu-/chekkhder dolush a du i derrige a/. Dalla gergakh'derg -dika a, melkho a bukhadu'ssush a du. Shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu /i dikanig a, bukhadu'surg a kharzha/?

Okha shetsa /ialsamane gIur vu a'lla/ khaza vaIda iinarg, iza tsunakh kkhiar a volush, tera vui tk'a Okha shena du'nenan dakharan kh'al della, tIa'kh'a sha k'ematdiinakh' /zho'zhakhate/ bakhiitincharakh khir volchukh?
Otsu diinakh' Tso tsa'rga kkhoikkhur du, olush: "Michakh' bu San nak'ostii, shuna So'tsa khilla mo'ttush khilla bolu?"

Er shaina tIekh' /zho'zhakhate gIur bu a'lla/ dosh bak'khillachara: "Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, khIorsh bu okha tilinarsh, okha u'sh tilira tkha'sh tiladarkh terra. Tkho tsIandeli /tsarakh/ Kh'o'ga /derzartsa/. U'sh tsa khilla tkhuna Iibadat desh".
Elira: "Skh'akkhaikkha shain nak'ostii /shaina gIo dan/". Tsara kkhaikkhira tsa'rga. Tsara zhop tsa delira tsarna, tsarna gira Iazap. /Ma liira tsarna sha'sh/ niisachu novk'akh' khillekh'ara, a'lla!
Otsu diinakh' Tso tsa'rga kkhoikkhur du, olush: "KhIun zhop delira ash elchanashka?"
Ia'rzha khir du tsarna khabarsh otsu diinakh', tsara vovshashka khIumma a kho'ttur dats.
Amma toba dinarg a, iiman dillinarg a, dika Iamal iinarg a -tarlo iza khila bakkkhiibecharakh.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kkhullu Shena luurg, khorzha a khorzhu. Datsara tsarna kharzhar. TsIanveli Dela /masso a kkhachambatsarekh/, lakkhaveli Iza tsara /Shetsa/ nak'ost latsarkh.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kha'a, khIun dIakh'uldina tseran degnasha, khIun tsara dIakh'edosh du.
Iza AllakhI-Dela vu, kkhin dela vats Iza votsurg. Tsunna khastam bu kh'alkharchakh'a, tIa'kh'archakh'a. Tsu'nan du kh'ukam a, Tsunna tIe dIaderzor du shu a.
Akh' ala: "Diitsal suna, Dala shuna bu'isa khiliitinekh'ara guttarena k'ematde kkhachchalts, AllakhI-Dela votsurg mu'lkhachu dala shuna serlo iou'itur iara? Shuna tsa khozu-te?"
Akh' ala: "Diitsal suna, Dala shuna de khiliitinekh'ara guttarena k'ematde kkhachchalts, AllakhI-Dela votsurg mu'lkhachu dala shuna bu'isa iou'itur iara, ash shena chokh' sadoIush? Shuna tsa go-te?
Tsu'nan k'inkhetamakh du-kkh Tso shuna bu'isa a, de a khiliitar ash shena chokh' sadaIa a, Tsu'nan niImat lakha a -shu khila megara barkalla olush".
Otsu diinakh' tsa'rga Tso kkhoikkhur du, olush: "Michakh' bu San nak'ostii, shuna /sha'sh So'tsa/ khilla mo'ttush bolu?"
Okha skh'ava'kkkhirakhIor ummatakh tesh, Okha elira: "Skh'adalade shain delilsh". Tsarna khiira bak'derg Delan duila. Tsarakh dIatilira tsara /Tsunna tIekh' kharts/ kkho'llina khillarg.

Bakk'alla a, K'aryn vara Musan k'omakh. Tsarna zulam dora tso. Okha ellera tsunna khaznash, shen dogIanash tso nitsk' bolchu tobantsa khalla d1asakkho'kh'ush khilla iolu. Tsu'nga ma elira tsu'nan k'omo: "Kh'o vokkkha ma ve. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa beza bakkkhiibedash bersh.

Akh' lakha kh'una Dala dellachokh' ekhartan tsIa, dits ma de du'nenakh kh'an dak'a a. Dikanig de, Dala kh'una dikanig ma di. Ma gIerta la'ttakh' pasad khIumanna tIe. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa beza pasad khIuma desh bersh".

Tso (K'aryna) elira: "Iza (kh'al, da'khni) suna della so'gara Iilma bakh'anekh'". Tsunna tsa kha'a-te Dala khIintsale mel /dukkkha/ tIa'kh'enash khIallakiina tsul kh'alkha, tsul nitsk'atsa melkho a chIogIa iolush, guldartsa (kh'al, da'khni) melkho a alsam iolush. Shain k'inoikh la'tsna kho'ttur a dats k'inoshdecha'rga (Dalla i dika kha'a dela).
Iza (K'aryn) arava'lira shen k'omana tIe shen khazallekh'. Du'nenan dakhar dezachara elira: "EkhI! Tkhuna delakh'ara K'arynna dellarg! Bakk'alla a, ma deza-dokkkha dak'a dolush vu-kkh iza!"
Shaina Iilma dellachara elira: "Dek'aza ma dovla! Delan ial dika iu iiman dillinchunna a, dika Iamal iinchunna a. Iza du'kh'alkkhetar ma iats sobar dinicharna a ben" /i khaza bekkham/.
Okha latta bukhavakhiitira iza a, tsu'nan tsIa a. Tsa khilira tsunna tskh'a a gIo desh toba Dalla du'kh'al, tsa khilira iza a shena gIo decharakh.

Tsu'nan mettig shaina selkhana ezash bersh bisira olush: "OkhI! Dala ritsk' darzhosh du Shen lekh Shena luuchunna, baram a bo /kIezzig lush/. Dala vaikh k'inkhetam tsa binekh'ara, latta bukhadakhna khir dara vai a. EkhI! Bakkkhii tsa bo' /Delakh/ tsatesharsh".
I ekhartan khIusam Okha khu'lu'itur iu la'ttakh' lakkhalla a, pasadtsa dezacharna. TIa'kh'e /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna iu.
Dikachu'ntsa ve'nachunna -tsunna tsul a dikanig du. Vochu'ntsa ve'narg -vonash dinacharna bekkham khir bats tsara desh khillarg a ben.
Bakk'alla a, kh'una K'ur'an tIe dillincho kh'o iukhaverzor ma vu iukhavo'rzuchu mettige. Akh' ala: "San Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kha'a-kkh nischu novk'a ve'narg a, bilgalchu tilarchokh' verg a".
Kh'o ma vatsara dog dokhush kh'aiga zhaina dalare kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara k'inkhetam khilla a ben. Kh'o khillane a ma khilalakh' /Delakh/ tsateshacharna gIo'ncha.
Kh'o dukha ma tukhiila Delan aiatekh u'sh kh'o'ga do'ssinchul tIa'kh'a. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhaikkha! Kh'o khillane a ma khilalakh' /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsucharakh (mushrikunekh).
Akh' ma kkhaikkhalakh' Delatsa kkhin dele. Kkhin dela vats kh'una Iza ben. Masso a khIuma khIallakkhir iu kh'una Tsu'nan iu'kh' iotsurg, Tsu'nan du kh'ukam, Tsunna tIe iukhaderzor dolush du shu a.
Alif-lam-mum.
Nakhana mo'ttina-te sha'sh du'tur du ala "Okha iiman dillina", sha'sh pitanetsa lu'itsush?

Okha pitane ma la'tsna tsaral kh'alkha khillarsh a. Dalla khuush ma bu kh'una bak'lina khillarsh a, Tsunna khuush ma bu kh'una khartslu'ish bersh a (Dala k'astor bu iimantsa bak'khillarsh khartskhillacharal).
Vonig desh bersh mo'ttush bara-te sha'sh Tkhol kh'alkhadevr du? Ma von kh'ukam desh bu-kkh u'sh!
Milla khillekh' Dalla du'kh'alkkhetare dog dokhush -Delan to'khna khan iogIur iolush ma iu! Iza khozush verg a, khuush verg a ma vu!
Milla velakh' a /Delan gIullakkhna tIekh'/ k'akh'o'gush -tso k'akh'o'gu shena. Bakk'alla a, Dela ma vats Shen kh'ashtash dolush Ialamashkakh'.
Iiman dillina bersh a, dika Iamal iinarsh a -tsarakh aidiir ma du Okha tseran vonash, bekkham biir ma bu Okha tsarna sha'sh desh khillachul a khazochu'ntsa.

Okha veset dina adamna shen detsa-nenatsa dika khilar. Nagakh' sanna tsu shimmo k'akh'egakh' So'tsa kh'o'ga nak'ost latsiitarkh'ama, kh'una shetsa tskh'a a Iilma dotsush, -tIakkkha akh' tsu shinga la ma dogIalakh'! Suna tIe du shun dIaderzar, tIakkkha As shu'ga du'itsur du ash desh khillarg.
Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a -u'sh bokhu'itur bu Okha dikacharna iuk'a.

Nakhakh bu sha'sh olush bersh /bagakhula/: "Okha iiman dillina Dele". T1akkkha Dele iiman dillar bakh'anekh' shaina /tskh'ana nakhera/ bokham khilcha, tsara loru nekhan pitna (bokham) Delan Iazapakh tera. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara tolam be'cha, tsara olu: "Bakk'alla a, tkho shu'tsa ma dara". Tk'a Dela vats dika khuush Ialamiin degnashkakh' derg?
Banne a bevzash bu kh'una Dalla iiman dillinarsh a, bevzash bu kh'una Tsunna munepak'ash a (Dala guchudokkkhur du nakhana tseran a, vukkheran a kh'al).
Tsateshnachara elira iiman dillincha'rga: "TIa'kh'akhIitta tkhan novk'a, okha kh'ur du shun k'inosh". Kh'ur ma dats tsara tseran k'inoikh tskh'a a khIuma. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khartslu'ish ma bu!
Tsara kh'ur ma bu shain mo'kh'ash a, /kkhin/ mo'kh'ash a shain mo'kh'ashtsa. Tsa'rga khottur ma du k'ematdiinakh' tsara /kharts/ kkhullush khillachukh.
Okha vakhiitira Nukh' shen k'omana tIe. Iza la'ttira tsarna iukk'ekh' ezar sharakh' shovztk'e itt sho t1eto'khcha, tIakkkha u'sh skh'aletsira tIovfanosha'sh zulamkhoi khilla.
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, kemanan dai a, khiliitira tsunakh Ialamashna delil.
IbrakhIim a /vakhiitira Okha shen k'omana tIe/, tso ma elira shen k'ome: "Dalla Iibidat de, Tsunakh kkhera. Iza dika du shuna, shu khuush khillekh'.

Bakk'alla a, shu Iibadat desh du-kkh Dela a vitina zha1arshna, kkhullush du eladita. Bakk'alla a, i Dela a vitina ash Iibadat decheran dolakh' ma dats shun ritsk'. Ash lakha Dalla gergakh' ritsk', Tsunna Iibadat de, Tsunna barkalla a ala. Tsunna tIe iukhaderzor du shu.
Ash i khartsdakh' -khartsdira shuna i khalk'asha shul kh'alkha a. Elchanna tIekh'-m ma dats bilgala dIakkhachor ben".
Tsarna tsa khi'na-te, mukha kkhullu Dala kkhollar, tIakkkha karladokkkhu iza. Bakk'alla a, iza Dalla atta ma du.

Akh' ala: "Lela la'ttakhula, kh'azha, mukha doliina Tso kkhollar, tIakkkha Dala kkhu'u'itu tIa'khkh'ara kkholladalar (k'ematdiinakh' khalk' iukhadendar). Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.
Iazap do Tso Shena luuchunna, k'inkhetam bo Shena luuchukh, Tsunna tIe dIaderzor dolush du shu a.
Shu ma dats gIeldiir dolush /khIumma a/ la'ttakh' a, stiglakh' a. Ma vats shuna Dela votsurg valia, gIo'ncha a."
Delan aiatekh a, Tsunna du'kh'alkkhetarkh a tsateshnarsh -tsara dog dillina San k'inkhetamakh, u'sh bu shaina lazosh dolu Iazap khir dersh.
Tsa khilira tsu'nan k'oman zhop tsara alar ben: "Ve iza, ia vagave iza!" Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira /IbrakhIim/ tsIarakh. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' aiatash (delilash) ma du teshachu k'omana.

Tso (IbrakhIimo) elira: "Bakk'alla a, ash letsi-kkh Dela a vitina zha1arsh (tsIush) bezam khilla vovshii iukk'ekh' du'nenan dakharekh'. TIa'kh'a k'ematdiinakh' shukh tskh'abolchara vukkharna kerstadiir ma du, tskh'abolchara vukkharna neIalt er ma du, shun chugIoila tsIe ma iu. Ma bats shuna tskh'a a gIo'nchii".
Tsunakh tiishira LutI. Tso elira: "So dIakkhelkha san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, bakk'alla a, Iza vu veza verg a, kh'ukame verg a".
Okha velira tsunna (IbrakhIimna) Iskh'ak' a, IaIk'ub a, khiliitira tsu'nan zu'rretekh' paikhamaralla a, zhaina a, dIaelira tsunna shen ial du'nenakh'. Bakk'alla a, iza ekhartakh' a dikacharakh ma vu.
LutI a /kh'akhave/, tso ma elira shen k'ome: "Bakk'alla a, ash dakh'ash ma du bo'khanig, shetsa Ialamekh shul kh'alkha tskh'a a tsa va'llarg.

Shu do'du tk'a bozharshna tIe, ash kheda ma bo tk'a nek'. Ash lelado shain sink'eramekh' irchanig." Tsa khilira tsu'nan k'oman zhop tsara alar ben: "Daita tkhuna Delan Iazap, kh'o khillekh' bak'lu'icharakh".
Tso elira /Dele do'khush/: "San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' gIo delakh' suna pasadkhIuma lelochu k'omana tIekh'".
Tkhan elchanashba'khkicha IbrakhIimna tIe kkha'tsa, tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, tkho du khIokkhu iu'rtan nakh khIallakban dokhkush. Bakk'alla a, tsu'nan nakh khili zulamkhoi".

Tso (IbrakhIim paikhamara) elira: "Tk'a tsarna iukk'ekh' LutI ma vui". Tsara elira: "Tkho dika khuush du tsu chokh' mila vu. Okha vakkkhanne a kIelkh'arvokkkhur vu iza a, tsu'nan do'zal a, tsu'nan zuda iotsurg -iza khili /khallakkhilla/ bainacharakh".

Tkhan elchanash ba'khkicha LutI volchu, u'sh bakh'anekh' poshme khilira iza, dog gatdelira /kiirakh' - u'sh shen k'oman bo'khachu khIumanakh larbalur bats shena mottadella/. Tsara /sha'sh Delan elchii dui khaiitina/ elira: "Kh'o ma kkhera, akh' sagat ma de. Bakk'alla a, tkho du kh'o a, kh'an do'zal a kIelkh'ardokhur dersh, kh'an zuda iotsurg -iza khili /khIallakkhilla/ bainacharakh.
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossor du khIokkhu iu'rtan nakhana tIe stiglara Iazap u'sh pesakkh khilarna".
Okha ditira tsunakh bilgala asarkh'ek'alechu nakhana.
Madiane /vakhiitira Okha/ tseran vasha ShuIaib. Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am, Dalla Iibadat de, dog dakha ekharchu diine, ma darzhade la'ttakh' pasad khIuma".
Tsara iza khartsvira. U'sh skh'aletsira /latta/lastaro -tIakkkha u'sh Iu'iranga bevlira shain tsIenoshkakh' gorabakhana.
Iadash a, Samudash a /khIallakbira Okha/. Shuna guchudelira tseran tsIenosh. Khaziira tsarna shaitIano shain Iamalsh, tso dIatilira u'sh /nischu/ nek'akh, u'sh khillekh' a dika gush.
K'arun a, FirIavn a, KhIaman a /khIallakbira Okha/. Veara tsa'rga Musa bilgalonashtsa, kuralla iira tsara la'ttakh', u'sh tsa khilira kh'alkhabovlursh /Tkhan Iazapakh/.

Masso a skh'aletsira Okha shen k'itsa.
