Tsarakh bu Okha shaina tIe chIogIa mokh bakhiitinarsh a, tsarakh bu mokh' tokharo skh'aliitsinarsh a, tsarakh bu Okha sha'sh la'tta bukhabakhiitinarsh a, tsarakh bu Okha sha'sh khina bukhabakhiitinarsh a. Tsa khilira Dela tsarna zulam desh, delakh' a, sha'sh khilira u'sh shaina zulam desh.
Dela votsurg /kkhin/ gIo'nchiila'tsnacheran masal khIusam la'tsnachu gezgan masalkh tera du -bakk'alla a, uggar ledara khIusam gezgan khIusam iu-kkh, u'sh khuush khillekh'.
Bakk'alla a, Dalla khuush du, Sha a vitina tsara shega kkhoikkhu khIuma. Iza veza verg a vu, kh'ukame verg a vu.
KhIara masalsh Okha dalado nakhana. Tseran oila-m tsa io Ielamnakha ben.
Dala kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a bak'ontsa. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil du mu'min nakhana.
Akh' desha kh'aiga vekh'etsa daiitinchu zhainakh, lamaz khIottade. Bakk'alla a, lamazo dukhatukhu bo'khanig a, irchanig a. Dela kh'ekhor melkho a dokkkha du. Dela khuush vu ash diirig.

Ash ma k'iisa zhainan okhIlantsauggar dikachu'ntsa ben tsarakh zulam dinarsh botsucha'rtsa. Ash ala: "Okha iiman dilli tkho'ga dossinchu'nga a, shu'ga dossinchu'nga a, Tkhan Dela a, shun Dela a tskh'a' vu, tkho Tsunna mu'tIakh' du".
Ishtta Okha dossira kh'o'ga zhaina. Okha shaiga zhaina dellarshtsunakh teshash bu. KhIokkharakh a (Ia'rbekh) tsunakh teshash verg vu. Tkhan aiatekh tsa teshash bats kerstanash ben.
Kh'o vatsara-mai /khIai Mukh'ammad/ tsul kh'alkha (K'ur'an dossale) tskh'a a zhaina do'shush a, iazdesh a kh'an /a'ttu/ ku'iga -khillekh'ara tsu khartsbolchara sheko iiir ma iara.
KhIa', u'sh -kkhetash dolu aiatash du shaina Iilma dellacheran degnashkakh' dolu. Tkhan aiatekh tsa teshash bats zulamkhoi ben.
Tsara elira: "Do'ssinekh'ara tsu'nga delilshshen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara. Akh' ala: "Delilsh Delan du, so bilgala volu kkheramcha vu".
Tsarna kkhacho tsa io-te Okha kh'o'ga shaina tIekh' do'shush dolu zhaina dossiina khilaro? Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' k'inkhetam a, kh'ekham a ma bu teshash bolchu nakhana.
Akh' ala: "Kkhacho io sunii shunii iukk'ekh' Dela tesh khilaro. Tsunna kha'a stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Khartsdolchunna iiman dillinarsh, Dalla kerstanalla dinarsh -u'sh bu eshnarsh".
Kh'o sikhvo tsara Iazap daiitarekh'. To'khna khan tsa khillekh'ara, tsa'rga dogIur dara i Iazap, tsa'rga danne a dogIur du iza tsIekhkh'ana, tsarna khaa tsa lush.
Kh'o sikhvo tsara Iazap daiitarekh' -amma zho'zhakhati go biir bolush ma iu tsateshacharna.
Otsu diinakh' Iazapo kh'ulbiir bu u'sh shaina tIekhula a, shain kogii bukhakhula a. Tsoer du: "Iovsha sha'sh desh khillarg!"
KhIai San iiman dillina lesh! San latta shorttadu, /dekk'a/ Suna Iibadat deisha.
Kh1or sino valar Iovshur du. TIakkkha Tkhuna tIe shu iukhaderzor du.
Iiman dillinarsh, dika Iamalash iinarsh -u'sh chukhovzhor bu Okha ialsamanera tsIenoshka, shaina bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar khir bu -dika ial iu iza Iamal iinacheran,
Sha'sh sobar dina bolchu, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe tevzhash bolchu.
Mel diinat du shen ritsk' tsa kh'osh-Dala ritsk' lo tsunna a, shuna a. Iza khozush verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.

Akh' tsa'rga kha'tticha, kh'an kkho'llina stiglanash a, la'tta a, kh'an bolkh boitush bu malkhe a, batte a, a'lla, tsara alanne a er du kh'una: "Dala". Tk'a mukha Iekhiina /dIakh'ovziina/ u'sh /bak'dolchukh/!
Dala shortta lo ritsk' Shen lekh Shena luuchunna, Tso baram a bo tsunna /kIezzig lush/. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.

Akh' tsa'rga kha'tticha, kh'an dossosh dara stiglara khi, tsu'ntsa latta dendina i dellachul tIa'kh'a, a'lla, tsara alanne a er du kh'una: "Dala". Akh' ala: "Khastam bu Dalla". KhIa', tsarakh dukkhakhbersh kkhetash bats.
KhIara du'nenan dakhar-m dats erna khan iaiar a, lovzar a ben. Bakk'alla a, ekhartan tsIa -iza du dakhar, u'sh khuush khillekh'!
Sha'sh kemana tIe khi'cha, tsara Dele kkhoikkhu, sha'sh Tsunna din tsIandesh. Tso u'sh arenga kIelkh'arba'khcha, tsara /Tsu'ntsa/ nak'ost lotsu
Kerstadarkh'ama Okha shain dellarg, zovkkh kh'egarkh'ama a. TIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna

Tsarna tsa go-te, Okha ma iina Kh'aramkkheram botsush (teshame), tk'a tsarna (Makkan bakharkhoin) gonakh' /iolchu kkhechu iartashkakh'/ nakh lu'itsush (zulamash desh)? Tk'a khartsdolchukh tesha u'sh, Delan niImat kerstado?
Mila vu vuno zulame Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkhulluchul, ia bak'derg, shega i de'nachul tIa'kh'a, khartsdesh volchul? Tk'a zho'zhakhatina chokh' /Ian/ mettig iats kerstanashna?
Tkhaigakh' k'akh'egnarsh-u'sh nisbiir bu Okha Tkhan nek'ana tIe. Bakk'alla a, Dela vu-kkh dikacha'rtsa.
Alif-lam-mum.
Eshinera rumoi /parisasha/,
La'ttana (shain makhkana) melkho a gergakh'. U'sh shain esharal tIa'kh'a to'lur bolush bu
Tskh'a masiitta sharakh. Delan du gIullakkh kh'alkha a, tIa'kh'a a. Otsu diinakh' khazakhetar du mu'manakhana.
Delan gIo'ntsa. Tso gIo do Shena luuchunna. Iza veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Delan vaIda iu. Dala iokha tsa io Shen vaIda, delakh' a, nakhakh dukkhakh- bolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Tsarna kha'a du'nenan dakharakh guchakh' derg, ekhartakh u'sh gIovpalbu.

Tsara oila tsa io-te shaikh? Dala tsa kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel derg a bak'ontsa a, tskh'ana to'khna khanna a ben. Bakk'alla a, nakhakh dukkhabersh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna du'kh'alkkhetar kerstadesh bu-kkh.

U'sh lelash bats la'ttakhula, tsa kh'o'zhu-te, mukha khilla tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran tIa'kh'e? U'sh tsaral chIogIo ma bara nitsk'atsa, tsara asar ma ditina la'ttakh', bakha ma ba'khna tsu tIekh' u'sh ba'khnachul dukkho, tsa'rga ma ba'khkira shain elchanash bilgalonashtsa. Dela vatsara tsarna zulam desh, delakh' a, u'sh sha'sh khilira /shaina/ zulam desh.
TIakkkha von dinacheran tIa'kh'e irchanig khilira tsara Delan aiatash khartsdarna, u'sh tsarakh tsa beshash khilarna.
Dala d1adolado kkhollar, tIakkkha Tso iza karladokkkhu, tIakkkha shu Tsunna tIe iukhaderzor a du.
Sakh'tkhIo'ttinchu diinakh' sovtsur bu k'inoshdinarsh dogdillina /shaina k'iisa khIuma dotsush/.
Tsa khilira tsarna shain nak'ostekh shapaIat desh bersh, u'sh khilira sha'sh /Dela a vitina liitsina khilla/ nak'ostii kh1intsa kerstabesh.
Sakh't khIo'ttinchu diinakh' -otsu diinakh' u'sh bek'alur bu.
Iiman dillinarsh, dika Iamalsh iinarsh -tsarna /ialsamanin/ boshmashkakh' khazakho'tu'itur du (tam biir bu).
Tsateshnarsh a, Tkhan aiatash a, ekhartana du'kh'alkkhetar a khartsdinarsh a -u'sh Iazapna chokh' /guttar la'ttash/ khir bu.
Tasbakh' de Dalla (lamaz de Tsunna) shu su'irenga devlicha a, shu Iu'iranga gIevticha a,
Tsunna khastam bu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a, malkhbuzekh' a, ash delk'aiuk' khiliitinchu khenakh' a/de lamazash/.
Tso skh'avokkkhu diinaverg vellachukh, vellarg a skh'avokkkhu diinachukh, dendolu'itu latta i dellachul tIa'kh'a. Ishtta shu a skh'adokhur du /keshnashkara k'ematdiinakh'/.
Tsu'nan delilekh du Tso shu kkhollar popparakh, tIakkkha shu adamash khilla da'rzhash.

Tsu'nan delilekh du Tso shuna shukh shaikh zudarii kkhollar shu tsa'rtsa /pargIat/ dakha. Tso khiliitina shuna iukk'ekh' bezam a, k'inkhetam a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh du-kkh oilaechu nakhana.
Tsu'nan delilekh du stiglanash a, latta a kkhollar, shun mettanash a, besnash a khiitsadalar. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du Ialamashna.
Tsu'nan delilekh iu shun nab bu'isana a, diinakh' a, Tsu'nan k'inkhetamakh ash /bakham/ lakhar a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du ladugIuchu nakhana.

Tsu'nan delilekh du Tso shu'ga tIk'es gaitar kkheramtsa a, /dogIa dare/ dogdakhartsa a. Tso dossado stiglara khi, tsu'ntsa dendolu'itu latta i dellachul tIa'kh'a. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du kh'ek'alechu nakhana.
Tsu'nan delilekh du stigal a, latta a Tsu'nan omratsa khIo'ttina Iar. TIa'kh'a Tso shu'ga kkhiikkhicha la'ttara skh'akkhaikkhartsa, shu /keshnii chu'ra/ aradovlur du /k'ematdiinakh'/.
Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Masso a Tsunna mu'tIakh' a bu.
Iza vu /khIuma/ kkhollar d1adolosh verg -tIakkkha Tso iza karladokkkhu. Iza Tsunna atto du. Tsu'nan vuno lekkha masal du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a. Iza -veza verg a, kh'ukame verg a vu.

Tso shuna masal daliina shukh shaikh: shuna bui Okha shuna dellachu ritsIk'ekh' shun a'ttu ku'igashadoladinacharakh nak'ostii, shu tsu chokh' tskh'aniissa a dolush, shu tsarakh kkho'rush (tsarna von khIuma khilarna), shaina /khilarkh/ kkherare terra? Ishtta k'astado Okha aiatash kh'ek'alechu nakhana.
KhIa', zulam dinarsh tIa'kh'akhIittira shain dezarshna tskh'a a Iilma dotsush. Kh'an nisviir vu-te Dala tilavala vitiinarg? Ma vats tsarna tskh'a a gIo'nchekh (g1o'ncha)!

Akh' khIottae kh'an iu'kh' /Delan/ dina tIe, tsIena din derg a khilii. Delan kkhollar du iza, Tso Shena tIekh' nakh a kkho'llina dolu. Khiitsam bats Delan kkhollaran. Iza mekhala din du, delakh' a, nakhakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Tsunna tIedo'rzush/khilalash toba dartsa/, Tsunakh kkheralash, lamaz khIottadelash, shu ma khilalash mushrikunekh.
Shain din dek'na tobanash khillacharakh a /ma khilalash shu/. Masso a toba shegakh' dolchukh iakkkhiiedash iu.

Nakh tskh'ana zeno skh'ala'tscha, tsara shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhoikkhu, Tsunna tIebu'rzii, tIakkkha Tso tsa'rga Shegara k'inkhetam Iovshiiticha, tsarakh tskh'ana dek'o shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa nak'ost lotsu
Okha shaina dellarg kerstadarkh'ama. Zovkkh kh'ega! TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna.
Okha tsa'rga teshalladossiina, tso du'itsush tsara shekh nak'ost lotsush khillachukh?
Okha nakhe k'inkhetam Iovshiticha, u'sh tsunakh bakkkhiibo'. Tk'a tsarakh vonig kkhi'cha shain ku'igasha kh'alkhada'kkkhinchu'ntsa, -tsara dog du'llu /Delan k'inkhetamakh/.
Tsarna tsa go-te Dala ritsk' darzhado Shena luuchunna, baram a bo /kIezzig lush/. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh du-kkh teshash bolchu nakhana.
DIalo gergarchunna shen kh'ak', miskachunna a, novk'akh' volchunna a /shen kh'ak'/. Iza -dika du Delan iu'kh' ezacharna. U'sh bu bakkkhiibiir bersh.
Ash della dolu riba nekhan bakhamekh' kkhiarkh'ama -tsa kkhia Dalla gergakh'. Ash della dolu zakatDelan iu'kh' ezash /alssam kkhia Dalla gergakh'/ -u'sh bu alssam ial khillarsh.

Dela vu shu kkho'llinarg, tIakkkha shuna ritsk' dellarg -tIakkkha shu dolu'itush verg, tIakkkha shu dendesh verg. Shun nak'ostekh vui sha tsunakh khIuma (i sannarg) desh verg? Ts1anveli Iza /masso a kkhachambatsarekh/, lakkhaveli tsara nak'ost latsarkh.
Bo'khanig guchudeli arengakh' a, khIorda chokh' a nekhan ku'igasha guldinchu'ntsa, /Dala/ sha'sh dinchukh tskh'adersh Iovshiita mega /tsa'rga/. U'sh iukhabo'rzur bats-te /vonig dechukh Dalla tIe/?
Akh' ala: "Shu lela la'ttakhula, kh'ovsal, mukha khilla shul kh'alkha khillacheran tIa'kh'e. Tsarakh dukkhakh- bersh /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsursh ma khilla.
Akh' khIottae kh'an iu'kh' mekhalchu din t1e shena Delera dukhatokhar dotsu /k'emat/de dale kh'alkha. Otsu diinakh' u'sh bek'alurbu.
/Delan din/ kerstadinarg -tsunna shena du shen kerstanalla. Dika Iamal iinarg -tsara sha'sh shaina /ialsamanekh' khIusamash/ kechio,
Iiman dillinchara a, dika Iamalsh iinachara a Tsu'nan k'inkhetamakh ial etsarkh'ama. Bakk'alla a, Tsunna tsa beza /Delakh/ tsatesharsh.

Tsu'nan aiatekh du Tso mekhash daiitar kkha''nash khilla shu'ga Iovshiitarkh'ama Shen k'inkhetamakh, kema leliitarkh'ama Shen omratsa, shu'ga lakhiitarkh'ama Tsu'nan koma'rshallakh, shu'ga /Tsunna/ barkalla aliita a.
Okha bakhiitira kh'ol kh'alkha a elchanash shain k'omana tIe, u'sh beara tsa'rga bilgalonashtsa, Okha chIir iitsira k'inosh dinacha'rgara. Tkhuna tIekh' kh'ak' khilla mu'min nakhana gIo dar.

Dela vu Sha mekhash dou'iturg, tso kh'eio markha, Tso iza iarzhaio stiglakh' Shena ma luu, Tso tsunakh kiisakash khu'lu'itu. Kh'una go dogIa skh'adolush tsunna iukk'ekhula. Tso iza kkhiicha Shen lekh Shena luucharna -tsarna khazakheta /dogIa de'cha/.
Tsul kh'alkha iza shaina tIe dossale u'sh khillekh' a dog dillina.
Kh'azhal Delan k'inkhetaman tIa'kh'enashka: mukha dendo Tso latta i dellachul tIa'kh'a. Bakk'alla a, Iza bellarsh denbiirig vu. Iza masso a khIumana tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush berg vu.
Okha baiitinekh'ara mokh, tIakkkha tsarna iza (la'ttakh' skh'adolush derg) mazhdella gicha, tsul tIa'kh'a a u'sh la'ttara ma bara tsa teshash.
Bakk'alla a, akh' khozu'itur dats bellacha'rga, akh' khozu'itur dats k'oracha'rga kkhaikkhar, u'sh iukharbevlicha.
Kh'o ma vats nisbiir bolush bIa'rsadotsursh shain tilarakh. Akh' khozu'itur du dekk'a Tkhan aiatekh teshacha'rga, sha'sh /Dalla/ mu't1akh' a bolush.

Dela vu shu kkho'llinarg ledarallakh (tIadamakh), tIakkkha Tso khiliitina ledarallal tIa'kh'a nitsk' (k'onalla), tIakkkha khiliitina nitsk'al tIa'kh'a ledaralla (k'analla), k'o'zha cho'sh a. Tso kkhullu Shena luurg. Iza khuush verg a vu, nitsk' kkhochurg a vu.
Sakh't khIo'ttinachu diinakh' duinash buur bu k'inosh dinachara sha'sh sakh'tekh' a tsa la'ttina bokhush /du'nenakh' k'inosh desh/. Ishtta Iekhiina khilla-kkh u'sh!
Iilma a, iiman a shaina dellachara elira: "Shu la'ttira Delan zhaina chokh' dendalaran de dalts. KhIara du dendalaran de, delakh' a, shu tsa khuush khili-kkh".
Otsu diinakh' paida biir bats zulam dinacharna shain Iu'zarsha, bekhkazadovlar a do'khur dats tsa'rga.
Okha daliina nakhana khIokkhu K'ur'an chokh' masso a masal. Kh'o tsa'rga ve'cha tskh'ana aiatatsa, er ma du tsateshachara: "Shu ma dats /bak'derg/ dokhiinarsh a ben".
Ishtta mukhIar tukhu Dala tsakhuucheran degnashka.
Akh' sobar de! Bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda bak' iu kh'una. Kh'o atta ma khetiila tsateshnacharna /sobarakh ma valalakh'/.
Alif-lam-mum.
KhIorsh kh'ukame dolchu zhainan aiatash du.
Sha'sh niisa nek' a, k'inkhetam a khilla dolu dikanig decharna.
U'sh bu sha'sh lamaz khIottosh, zakat lush, ekhartakh u'sh /sheko iotstsush/ teshash bu.
U'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara niisachu novk'akh' bu. U'sh bu bakkkhiibiirash.

Nakhakh vu shegakh' Iilma dotsush da'ssa (paida botsu) khabar o'tsush (du'itsush) vergDelan nek'akh /nakh/ tilorkh'ama, siisazboi skh'alotsu tso iza /Delan nek'/. U'sh (i sannarsh) -tsarna siisaza dolu Iazap du.
Shena Tkhan aiatash do'shush, kurava'lla dIavirzi iza, shena u'sh tsa khezcha sanna, shen lergashkakh' k'oralla erg sanna. Akh' tsunna kkha' bakkkha lazosh dolchu Iazaptsa.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a -tsarna ni1matiin /ialsamanin/ boshmash iu.
U'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bu. Delan bak' khilla iolu vaIda iu iza. Iza veza verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa desh/ verg a vu.

Tso kkho'llira stiglanash shuna sha gush tskh'a a bIogIam botsush. La'ttakhula la'mnash kkhissira Tso i shu'tsa tsa lestiitarkh'ama, darzhiina Tso tsigakh' masso a diinat (sa dolu khIuma). Okha dossiira stiglara khi, Okha kkhiiira tsu chokh' (la'ttakh') khIor berkate shishsha /oramat/.
Iza Delan kkhollar du. KhIintsa ash So'ga gaital, khIun kkho'llina Iza votscho. KhIa', zulamkhoi bilgalchu tilar chokh' bu-kkh!
Okha /kh'alkha/ dellera Luk'mannakh'ek'alalla: "Dalla shukur de. Shukur decho -shena shukur desh du. /Din/kerstadesh verg-Dela kh'al dolush a vu, khastame a vu".
Kh'akhade! Luk'mana elira shen kIante, sha tsunna kh'ekhar desh: "KhIai san kIa'tig, akh' Delatsa nak'ost ma latsalakh'. /Delatsa/ nak'ost latsar -/inzare/ dokkkha zulam du".

Okha veset dina adamna shen detsa-nenatsa /dika khilar/: shen nanas /kiirakh'/ leliina iza gIel'ialarna tIe a gIel'ialartsa, tsu'nan /nenakh dakkhorakh/ k'astar -shi sho du'zcha du. Shukur de Suna a, kh'an dena-nanna a. Suna t1e du /masseran a / dIaderzar.

Nagakh' sanna tsu shimmo k'akh'egakh' akh' So'tsa nak'ost latsarna tIekh' kh'una shetsa Iilma dotsuchu'ntsa, -tIakkkha akh' tsu shinga la ma dogIalakh'. Nak'ostalla de tsarna shinna du'nenakh' dikchu khIumanna tIekh'. Kh'o tIa'kh'avaza Suna tIevirzinachun novk'a. TIakkkha Suna tIe du shun d1aderzar. As du'itsur du shuna ash desh khillarg.

"KhIai san kIa'tig, i (vonig) khilakh' a tskh'a zhimma kIollan bu'rtigal ia tarkhakh' (charchokh'), ia stiglanashkakh', ia la'ttakh' a -iza a skh'adokkkhu Dala. Bakk'alla a, Dela tIekh kkhetame verg a vu, sov dika khuush verg a vu.
KhIai san kIa'tig, khIottade lamaz, dikanig /nakhana/ omra de, vochukh /nakh/ dukhatokha, sobar de kh'aikh kh'akkhadellachunna tIekh'. Iza gIullakkhiin chIogIallakh du.
/Kuralla esh, tsa veshash/ kh'an iu'kh' ma settae nakhana, ma lela la'ttakhula kura. Bakk'alla a, Dalla tsa veza masso a kura verg a, vezavedarg a.
Iuk'anakk'ara de kh'an bolar, az a lagIde kh'an. A'znekh uggar irchanig viran az du".

Shuna tsa khi'na-te, Dala shuna bolkh boitush khilar stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel dolchu'nga, Tso shuna shortta della Shen niImatash, gush dersh a, kh'ulamekh' dersh a? Nakhakh vu sha Delekh' k'u'isush verg tskh'a a Iilma dotsush, niisa nek' botsush, nure zhaina dotsush.

Shaiga a'lcha: "TIa'kh'akhIitta Dala dossiinachunna", tsara eli: "KhIan-khIa, tkho tIa'kh'akhIu'ttu tkhuna shena tIekh' tkhan dai kariinachunna". Ia shaitIa khilchi a tsa'rga kkhoikkhush zho'zhakhatin Iazape?
Shen iu'kh' Dalla mu'tIakh' esh verg, dika a khilla -tso skh'aletsna chIogIa u'ir, Dele iu gIullakkhiin chakkhe.
Kerstanalla dinarg -kh'o singattame ma voila tsu'nan kerstanallo. Tkho'ga du tseran d1aderzar, Okha du'itsur du tsa'rga tsara dinarg. Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush vu degnashkakh' derg.
Okha paida o'tsu'itur bu tsa'rga tskh'a kIezzig, tIakkkha Okha diir du tsarna ircha Iazap.
Akh' tsa'rga kha'tticha, kh'an kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, a'lla, tsara er ma du: "Dala". Akh' ala: "Khastam bu Dalla". KhIa', tsarakh dukkhakhbersh khuush bats.
Delan du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Bakk'alla a, Dela -Iza vu kh'al dolush verg a, khastame verg a.

La'ttakh' mel dolchu dittakh k'olamash khilcha, tk'a khIordana shel tIa'kh'a vorkhI khIordo gIo a dicha /shek'a a khilla/ -kkhachalur ma datsara Delan deshnash. Bakk'alla a, Dela veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa desh/ verg a vu.
Shu kkhollar a, shu iukhadendar a tskh'a sadaIar sanna a ben dats /Dalla/. Bakk'alla a, Dela khozush verg a vu, gush verg a vu.

Kh'una tsa kha'a, Dala bu'isa denna chu ialo, de bu'isanna chu dalo, bolkh boitush bu malkhe a, batte a, masso a dIasalelash iu shen to'khna khan tIekkhachchalts, i Dela ash diirig dika khuush khilar a /tsa kha'a shuna/?
Iza du I Dela Sha bak'derg khilar, tk'a tsara, Iza a vitina, shega kkhoikkhurg khartsderg khilar, Dela -Iza lekkha verg a, vokkkha verg a khilar a /du iza/.
Kh'una tsa go kema, dIasalelash khIorda chokh' Delan niImatatsa Tso shu'ga gaitarkh'ama Shen aiatekh /aiatash/. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' aiatash du masso a sobare volchunna a, shukur desh volchunna a.

Sha'sh tolgIano kh'ulbicha, ragIus sanna, tsara Dele kkhoikkhu, Tsunna din a tsIandesh. Tso u'sh arenga kIelkh'arba'khcha, -tsarakh iuk'anakk'ara verg a vu (kerstanallina a, iimanna a iukk'ekh'), /kerstanallina tIekh' setstsarg a vu/. Tkhan aiatash kerstadiir ma dats masso a teshnabekhk becho a, /Delan niImatashna/ inkarlo echo a ben.

KhIai nakh! Shu kkheralash shain Delakh, shu kkheralash diinakh, da shen do'zalkhochunna paidane khir votschu, do'zalkho a shen dena tskh'anna khIumantsa paidabiirig khir votschu. Bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda kh'ak'-bak' iu. Shu Iekha ma doila du'nenan dakharo, shu Iekha ma doila Delatsa Iekhadalaro.

Bakk'alla a, Dalla gergakh' du sakh'tan Iilma (k'ematde kh1ottar khaar), Tso dossado dogIa, Tsunna kha'a beran tsIa chokh' derg a. Sinna tsa kha'a, khIun karadiir du sha kkhana, sinna tsa kha'a, mu'lkhachu la'ttakh' sha liir du. Bakk'alla a, Dela khuush verg a vu /k'ailakha derg, guchakh' derg sanna/, devzash verg a vu.
Alif-lam-mum.
Zhaina okh'adossor /du khIara/, shena chokh' sheko iotsush, Ialamiin Degara.

Ia tsara olu: "Tso (Mukh'ammada) kkho'llina /khartsderg/ du iza"? KhIa', iza bak'derg du kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara akh' k'omana kkheram tasarkh'ama, kh'ol kh'alkha shaiga tskh'a a kkheramcha veana votschu, u'sh niisachu novk'a khIuttur batsara-te?

Dela vu Sha stiglanash a, latta a, tsu shinna iukk'ekh' mel derg a kkho'llinarg ialkh diinakh', tIakkkha dIanisvelira Iza IarshatIekh'. Ma vats shuna Iza votsurg tskh'a a vali a (dottagI), tskh'a a gIodakkkharkho a, ash oila tsa io-te?
Omra dIasado'k'u Tso stiglara la'tta tIe, tIakkkha iza (omra) Tsunna tIe ailo diinakh', shen baram ezar sho dolush ash dagardechu kepara.
Iza vu kh'ulamekh'derg a, guchakh'derg a khuush verg a. Veza verg a, k'inkhetame verg a /vu Iza/.
Iza vu Sha mel kkho'llinarg khazchu ku'tsara dina. Adam kkholla volavella Iza popparakh.
TIakkkha tsu'nan t1a'kh'e khiliitira Tso ladambotschu khinan tIadamakh.
TIakkkha Tso iza nisvira, Tso dillira tsu chu Shen sikh /sa/, Tso khiliitira shuna khazar a, bIa'rsa a, degnash a. Ma kIezzig du-kkh ash shukur diirig.
Tsara elira: "Tkho daicha la'ttakh', tkho kerlachu kkhollarekh' khir dui (iukhadendiir dui)?" KhIa', u'sh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna du'kh'alkkhetarna kerstakhili.
Akh' ala: "Dolu'itur du shu dalaran maliko, sha shuna tIe khIottina dolchu, tIakkkha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe shu dIaderzor du.

Kh'una gush balkh'ara i k'inosh diinarsh shain kortosh okh'ataIina shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kh'alkhakh' /olush/: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, gina tkhuna, khezna tkhuna, iukhaderzadekh' tkho /du'nen chu/ -dika Iamal iiir iara okha, tkho /khIintsa sheko iotstsush/ teshna du".

Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, Okha lur bara khIor sine shen niisa nek', delakh' a, bak'khili-kkh So'gara dosh: "Iuzanne a iuzor ma iu As zho'zhakhati zhinekh a, nakhakh a- /tsarakh Dalla 1esa khillacharakh/ massarakh a".
Iovsha /Iazap/ khIokkhu shain /k'emat/ denna du'kh'alkkhetar ash ditsdarna - Okha shu a ditsdina. Iovsha guttarenan Iazap sha'sh /du'nenakh'/ desh khillarg bakh'anekh'.
Bakk'alla a, teshash bu Tkhan aiatekh, shaina u'sh kh'ekhiicha, suzhudane begash bersh, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna khastam bartsa tasbakh' desh bersh, sha'sh kura a tsa bovlush.

Tseran agIonash ailo /bu'ishachu/ mettigashkara, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhoikkhu tsara (Tsu'nan Iazapakh) kkherartsa a, (Tsu'nan k'inkhetame) dogdakhartsa a, Okha shaina dellachu ritsIk'ekh /dikchu agIora/ kharzhash io tsara.
Tsa kha'a sinna, khIun shaina kh'uliina iu bIa'rgashna ezacharakh sha'sh iina khillachu Iamalna du'kh'al.
Tk'a mu'min stag khilla pesakkhstagakh tera? Nis tsa lo u'sh.
Tk'a iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a -tsarna boshmash iu chugIoila, kh'eshana sanna kechiina iolu tsara iina khilla Iamal bakh'anekh'.

Tk'a pesakkh khillarsh a -tseran chugIoila /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu. Tsarna tsu chu'ra arabovla mel lii, -tsu chu iukhaberzor bu u'sh, tsa'rga er du: "Iovsha shaina tsIeran Iazap, sha'sh iza khartsdesh khilla dolu".
Okha Iovshanne a Iovshiitur ma du tsa'rga daia Iazap/ekhartan/ dokkkha Iazapal kh'alkha, iukhabo'rzur batsara-te u'sh /k'inoshdechukh/.
Tk'a mila vu zulame shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatash shena kh'ekhadesh tIakkkha tsarakh dIavo'rzush volchul? Bakk'alla a, Tkho k'inosh dinacha'rgara bekkham o'tsur bersh ma du.
Okha dellera Musaga zhaina -kh'o ma khilalakh' shekonekh' tsu'ntsa vovshakhkkhetarna. Okha khiliitira tsunakh (Tavratakh) niisa nek' Israilan kIentashna.
Okha khiliitira tsarakh imamash, sha'sh nisbella bolu Tkhan omratsa, sha'sh sobare khillachul tIa'kh'a. U'sh khilira Tkhan aiatekh ch1og1a teshash.
Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho k'astor du tsarna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh' tseran khillachu khilpalonekh'.

Tk'a Okha tsaral kh'alkha mel khIallakiinchu tIa'kh'enasha a nis tsa bo-te u'sh /bak'dolchunna tIe/? U'sh d1asalelash ma bu tseran gIishloshkakhula. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' /Tkho bak'khilaran/ delilash du-kkh! Tsarna tsa khozu-te?
Tsarna tsa kha'a-te Okha d1alollu khi /dak'adella/ etIachu la'ttana tIe, tsu'ntsa ialta aradolu'itu -tsunakh ma duu tseran bezhnasha a, tsara sha'sh a?! Tsarna tsa go-te?
Tsara (din khartsdechara) olu: "Matsa khir bu /shuna/ tolam/tkhuna tIekh'/, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'?"
Akh' ala: "Tolaman diinakh' paida biir bats tsateshacharna tseran iimano, u'sh tIa'kh'atottur a bats" /toba dan/.
DIaverza tsarakh, kh'o'zhush Ielakh', u'sh bu kh'una kh'o'zhush Iesh.
KhIai paikhamar! Delakh kkheralakh', kh'o mu'tIakh' ma khilalakh' kerstanashna a, munepak'ashna a. Bakk'alla a, Dela khili khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Kh'o tIa'kh'akhIotta kh'aiga vekh'eshtsakh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara dog1uchunna. Bakk'alla a, Dela khili ash diirig sov dika khuush.
Akh' Dalla t1e tavakkalde -kkhacho khili Delatsa vekal.

Tsa dina Dala tskh'anna stagana shi dog tsu'nan kiirakh', tsa khiliitina Tso shun zudarekh, ash shaiga shun bakk'ash shain nanoin bakk'ashka tera kheta, a'lla bolchu, shun nanoi, ash dolaba'khnachu beriikh shuna kIentii tsa khiliitina Tso. Iza shun dosh du shun bagenashtsa /olush dolu/. Dala olu bak'derg, Tso nisvo niisachu novk'a.

Shain daishka dIakkhaikkhau'sh -iza du melkho a nisderg Dalla gergakh'. Shuna tseran dai tsa bovzakh', -shun vezharii a bu u'sh dinekh', shun dottagIii a bu. Shuna k'a dats shu shegakh' gIalatda'llachu'ngakh', ash dagala'tsnachu'gakh' ben. Khili Dela t1ekh gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Paikhamar tamevu mu'min nakhana shail a, tsu'nan zudarii tseran nanoi bu. Gergarnash tskh'abersh vukkharal tame bu Delan zhainakh' /kkhechu/ mu'min nakhal a, khIizhar dikhkincharala, ash shain dottagIashna dikanig desh dalakh' ben. Khili iza zhainakh' dIaiazdella.
Okha skh'aiitsira paikhamarashkara chIagIam, kh'o'gara a, Nukh'era a, IbrakhIimera a, Musagara a, Mar'iaman kIantera Iiisagara a. Okha skh'aiitsira tsa'rgara chIogIa chIagIam.
Tso (Dala) bartkhattarkh'ama bak'lu'icha'rga shain bak'lerakh. Kechdina Tso kerstanashna lazosh dolu Iazap.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash dagadaita shaina khilla Delan niImat -shuna deara /malikiin/ eskar -Okha bakhiitira tsarna tIe mokha, eskar a, shuna sha gush dotsu. Khilira Dela ash diirig gushverg.

U'sh ba'khkira shuna tIe shun tIekhula a, shun bukhakhula a -/shun/ bIa'rgash kh'en tIe bevlira, degnash k'amk'argashka kkhechira, shuna mottalora Delakh la'tsna tskh'atstsa /niisa dotsu/ mottadalarsh.
Tsigakh' ziira mu'min nakh, /tseran degnash kkheradella/ chIogIa tokhadelira.
/Akh' dagadaiita/ munepak'asha a, shain degnashkakh' tsamgar iolcharaa elira: "Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a vaitsa iina vaIda Iekhor ben ma dats".

/Akh' kh'akhade/: tsarakh tskh'ana tobano elira: "KhIai Iasribanbakharkhoi! Shuna latta mettig iats /tIom ban/, iukhaderza". Tsarakh tskh'a kkhierg (toba) paikhamare /ts1akh' iisa/ purba dekha iolaelira, olush: "Tkhan tsIenosh da'ssa du". Da'ssa ma dats u'sh -tsarna luurg bovdar du-kkh /tIamtIera/.
Tsarna chubakhkiticha tsu'nan (gIalin) iistashkakhula, tIakkkha tsa'rga pitnadiikhicha, -i lur ma dara kh'una tsara, tskh'a kIezzig kh'o'zhush la'ttar a ma batsara kh'una u'sh.
U'sh kh'alkha a khilira Delatsa vaIda esh, sha'sh dovdur dats /tIamtIera/, bokhush. Khili Delan vaIda zhop do'khush.
Akh' ala: "Paida biir bats shuna dovdaro shu dalarkh ia daiarkh devdicha, kIezzig ben bakham khir bats shuna t1akkkha a".

Akh' ala: "Mila vu iza sha Delakh shu lardiir verg, Tsunna shuna tskh'a zen li'cha, ia Tsunna shuna tskh'a k'inkhetam li'cha? Tsara karor ma vats shaina Dela votsurg tskh'a a vali a, tskh'a a gIo'ncha a".

Bevza Dalla shukh novk'arlo esh bersh /nakh gIazote tsa bokhu'itush/, shain vezharshka olush bersh: "Skh'adu'ila tkho dolchu /ma gIo gIazote/!" Tskh'a kIezzig ben tsa bira tsara (munepak'asha shu'tsa tskh'ana) tIom (gIazot),

/Iza a/ shuna /bezamtsii, doglazartsii/bIa'rmetsig khu'lush a ben. Kkheram be'cha,kh'una gira u'sh kh'o'ga kh'o'zhush shain bIa'rgash kh'iizash,valan khorsha eanarg sanna. Kkheram dIaba'lcha,shukh chekkhdokhur du tsara chIiran mettanash dikachunna bIa'rmetsig khilla. U'sh iiman dillina bats kh'una, Dala d1aiaia kh'una tseran Iamalash. Iza khilira Dalla atta.

Tsarna mo'ttu i tobanashdIa tsa iakhna. I tobanash e'cha,tsarna la'a kkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbiin iukk'ekh' dIasalelarshkhila, shun khabarsh kho'ttush. Shun iukk'ekh' khilcha a,kIezzig ben tIom bira batsara tsara.
Bakk'alla a, shuna khilira Delan elchanekh' khaza masal-/shukh/ Dele a, tIa'kh'archu diine a dog dokhush volchunna a, dukkkha a Dela kh'ekhosh volchunna a.

Mu'min nakha, shaina i /t1om ban iog1u kerstaniin/ tobanash gicha, elira: "KhIara iu Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a vaitsa iina vaIda, bak'lina Dela a, Tsu'nan elcha a". /Tsu gIullakkho/ u'sh alsam tsa bokhu iimantsa a, mu'tIakh' khilartsa a ben.

Mu'min nakhakh tskh'a bozharii bu sha'sh bak'iina shain Delatsa khilla iolu vaIda, tsarakh shen Iozhalla t1ekkha'chnarg (vellarg) a vu, tsarakh /g1azotekh' vala/kh'o'zhush verg a vu, tskh'a a khiitsam tsa bina tsara /shain Delatsa khilla vaIdin/
Dala ial ialarkh'ama bak'liinacharna shain bak'lertsa, Iazap darkh'ama munepak'ashna,Shen laakh', ia gechdarkh'ama tsarna. Bakk'alla a, Dela khili gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Dala iukhaberzira tsateshnarsh shain o'gIazallitsa, tsa kkhiira u'sh dikchukh. Kkhacho khiliitira Dala mu'min nakhana tIamakh. Khili Dela nu'tsk'ala verg a, veza verg a.
/Dala/ okh'abossiira zhainan okh1lakh tsarna gIo dina khillarshshain chIagIonashkara, Tso kkho'ssira tseran degnashka kkheram, tskh'abersh ash boiu, tskh'abersh ash iiisare lu'itsu.
Tso irsana shuna delira tseran latta a, tseran tsIenosh a, tseran bakham a, /kkhin/ ash kh'eshna dotsu la'tta a. Khili Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' bolush.

KhIai paikhamar! Akh' ala kh'an zudarshka: "Shu delakh' du'nenan dakhar dezash, tsu'nan khazalla a /ezash/, skh'adu'ila -as iitinchu zudchunna dog1urg lur du shuna, khazachu kepara pargIatdokhur du shu.
Shu delakh' vezash Dela a, Tsu'nan elcha a, tIa'kh'a khir iolu khIusam a (ialsamane), -Dala kechiina shukh dikanig decharna siilakh'- iokkkha ial.
KhIai paikhamaran zudarii! Shukh bilgala irchanig deanchunna -shozza alsam khir du tsunna Iazap. Khili iza Dalla atta.
ShukhDalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' khillarg a, dika Iamal a iinarg -tsunna ial lur iu Okha shozza. Okha tsunna kechdina siilakh' ritsk'.

KhIai paikhamaran zudarii! Shu dats zudarekh tskh'anga a tera. Shu /Delakh/ kkho'rush delakh',ma khila dashtsa kIeda /khiirachu bozharshna/ -tIakkkha shen dagchokh' tsamgar erg tIekh'iizar vu, ash ala dika dosh.

Shain tsIenoshkakh' sovtsa, kech ma lo kh'alkhalera zhekhIallin kechdalartsa. Lamaz a khIottade, zakat a lo, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' khila. Bakk'alla a, Dalla la'a, /khIai paikhamaran/ tsIiinan okhIla, shukh bo'khu khIuma dIadakkkha a, shu tsIandan a tsIandartsa.
Dagadaita shain tsIenoshkakh' do'shush dolu Delan aiatash a, kh'ikmata. Bakk'alla a, Dela khili dika kkhetash verg a, sov dika khuush verg a.

Bakk'alla a, busalba bozharii a, busalba zudarii a, mu'min bozharii a, mu'min zudarii a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolu bozharii a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolu zudarii a, bak'lu'ish bolu bozharii a, bak'lu'ish bolu zudarii a, sobare bolu bozharii a, sobare bolu zudarii a, /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' bolu bozharii a, /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' bolu zudarii a, sagIa lush bolu bozharii a, sagIa lush bolu zudarii a, markha kkhobu bozharii a, markha kkhobu zudarii a, shain evkh'e iolu mettigashlarosh bolu bozharii a, zudarii a, dukkkha Dela kh'ekhosh volu bozharii a, zudarii a -kechdina Dala tsarna gechdar a, siilakh'-iokkkha ial a.

Tsa khillamu'min stagana, ia mu'min zudchunna,Dala a, Tsu'nan elchano a tskh'a gIullakkh kkhochushdicha,shain gIullakkhakh /shain dezarg/ kharzhan bak'o. Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a Iesaverg tilavella bilgalchu tilartsa.

/Kh'azhal/ akh' ma elira Dala a, akh'a a shen niImat dellachu'nga: "Kh'aigakh' kkhaba kh'an zuda, Delakh kkhera!" Akh' kh'uldiira kh'aigakh' Dala guchudokkkhurg. Kh'o kkho'rura nakhakh, tk'a Dela melkho a tam bolush vara kh'o Shekh kkhera. Zaida tsu'ntsa shen laam kkhochushbicha (tso iza iiticha, Iiddat chekkhda'lcha), Okha iza kh'una ialiira mu'min nakhana khalo tsa khiliitarkh'ama sha'sh dai khIo'ttinchu kIentiin zudarii balo tsara shain tsartsa dolu gIullakkh chekkhda'kkhicha (sharIekh' u'sh biticha). Khili Delan gIullakkh dina da'lla.
Paikhamarna khalo khila megar dats Dala Shena tIe dillinchu'ngakh' -Delan Iadat /du iza/ kh'alkha bakhancha'rgakh' a khilla. Khili Delan gIullakkh azallekh' kkhochushkhilla.
Ishttanash bu u'sh (kh'alkhabakhanarsh) sha'sh Delan elchanalla kkhochushdina, Tsunakh kkho'rush bolush, Dela votsuchekh tskh'annakh tsa kkho'rush. Delatsa kkhacho khilla kh'esapdiirig.
Tsa khilla Mukh'ammad shun bozharekh tskh'annan a da, delakh' a,Delan elcha a, paikhamariin mukhIar a du iza. Khili Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Kh'ekhave Dela dukkha kh'ekhavartsa.
Tasbakh' de Tsunna Iu'iranna a, su'iranna a.
Iza vu shukh k'inkhetambesh verg, Tsu'nan malikash a /du shuna gechdar do'khush/, shu bodanera serlonga dakharkh'ama. Iza khili mu'min nakhakh k'inkhetambesh verg.
Tseran marshalla Tsunna du'kh'alkkhiitinchu diinakh' -salam du. Tso kechiina tsarna siilakh' ial.
KhIai paikhamar! Bakk'alla a, Okha vakhiitina kh'o tesh khilla, kkha'ancha khilla, kkheramcha khilla.
Dele kkhoikkhush verg a khilla Tsu'nan purbantsa, nure chirkkh a khilla /vakhiitina kh'o/.
Akh' kkha' bakkkha mu'min nakhana tsarna Delera iokkkha koma'rshallaiu, a'lla.
Mu'tIakh' ma khilalakh' /Delakh/ tsateshacharna a, munepak'ashna a, dita tseran /kh'una desh dolu/ khalakhetarsh. Dalla tIe tovzha. Kkhacho khili Delatsa vekal.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash mu'min zudarii baliicha, tIakkkha u'sh biticha shu tsarakh kh'akkhadalale,shuna tsarna tIekh' tskh'a Iiddatdats ash tergo ian dezash. Lo tsarna shain paida etstsal khIuma, khazchu kepara bita u'sh.

KhIai paikhamar! Okha kh'anal bina kh'una kh'an zudarii, akh' shaina makhbella bolu, kh'an a'ttu ku'iga doladinarshkh'una Dala khIonsana bellacharakh, kh'an den veshin mekhkarii a, kh'an den iishin mekhkarii a, kh'an nenan veshin mekhkarii a, kh'an nenan iishin mekhkarii a, sha'sh kh'o'tsa khIizhar dina bolu; /kkhin mu'lkhkha/ mu'min zuda a, tso sha paikhamarna dIalakh', paikhamarna iza ialon a laakh', ekk'a kh'una a /khIai paikhamar/ khu'lush kkhin mu'min nakhana iotsush. Tkhuna khii, khIun tIe dillina Okha tsarna shain zudarshkakh', a'ttu ku'igasha dola-dinacha'rgakh' a, kh'una khalo tsa khiliitarkh'ama. Khili Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Akh' tIa'kh'atottur iu kh'aina luurg tsarakh, kh'aina tIelotsur iu kh'aina luurg; kh'aina ezakh' aikh'a /kh'alkha/ iu'stakh ia'kkkhinacharakh -k'a dats kh'una /kh'o tsunna tIevakharkh/. Iza melkho a gerga du tseran bIa'rgash buzarna, u'sh singattame tsakhilarna /i Delera dui khi'cha/, u'sh reza khilarna a akh'a shaina dellachukh -u'sh masso a. Dalla kha'a shun degnashkakh' derg. Khili Dela khuush verg a, /masso a khIuma shen-shena mettige dIanisdesh verg a/, /k'inoshna du'kh'al taIzar darekh'/sikh tsa lush verg a

Kh'anal bats kh'una zudarii tsaral sov a, u'sh khiitsabar a /kkhechu/ zudarekh, tseran khazallo kh'o tsetsvakkkhakh' a, kh'an a'ttu ku'igo doladinarsh botsursh. Khili Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' tergo esh verg.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Paikhamaran tsIenoshna chu ma gIolasha shaina purba delchi ben kkhacha baa, /tIakkkha a dukkha kh'alkha ma gIolash/ i /kkhacha/ kechbina balare kh'o'zhush tsa Ian. Mukhkha delakh',shaiga kkhiikkhicha, -chu gIo. Sha'sh khIuma ii'cha,dIasadarzha, khabarna iuk'a a tsa gIosh. Bakk'alla a, shun ishtta khilaro paikhamarna novk'arlo io, tsunna shukh ekh' kheta /shu'ga ala/. Dalla ekh' tsa kheta bak'dolchukh. Ash tsa'rga (elchan zudarshka) tskh'a khIuma ekhakh', ash ekha i tsa'rga kirkh'ana dekh'akhula. Iza melkho a tsIena du shun degnashna a, tseran degnashna a. Shuna megara dats Delan elchanna novk'arlo ian a, tsu'nan zudarii balaban a tsul tIa'kh'a tsIelligatsIa. Bakk'alla a, iza khili Dalla gergakh' deza- dokkkhanig (k'a).
Ash guchudakkkhakh' a tskh'a khIuma, ia kh'uldakh' i -bakk'alla a, Dela khili masso a khIuma khuush verg.

K'a dats tsarna (zudarshna, kkhochchush kh'ul tsa belcha)shain dai, shain kIentashna, shain vezharshna, shain vezhariin kIentashna, shain iizhariin kIentashna, shain /kh'alkhakh' bolchu/ zudarshna, shain a'ttu ku'igasha doladinacharna kh'alkhakh'. Delakh kkheralash /shu zudarii -khiirachu bozharshna guchudovlarekh'/. Bakk'alla a, Dela khili masso a khIumanna tIekh' tesh.
Bakk'alla a, Dala a, Tsu'nan malikasha a salotdu'llu paikhamarna. KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Asha a dilla tsunna salot, salam lo marshallitsa.
Bakk'alla a, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a khalakho'tu'itush bersh -Dala neIalt a'lla tsarna du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a, kechdina tsarna siisaza Iazap.
Mu'min bozharshna a, mu'min zudarshna a, tsa'rgara da'lla kh1umma a dotstsushekh', khalakho'tu'itush bersh -tsara dekh'na dokkkha eladita a, bilgala k'a a.

KhIai paikhamar! Ala kh'an zudarshka a, kh'an mekhkarshka a, mu'min nekhan zudarshka a shaina tIe shain oba (paranzha, pardu) uziila tsara. Iza melkho a gerga du u'sh bovzarna a, tsarna khalakhetar tsadarna a. Khili Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Munepak'ash a, shain degnashkakh' tsamgar ersh a, Madinatekh' eladitanash darzhosh bersh a tsa sovtsakh',Okha khIottor ma vu kh'o tsarna tIe. TIakkkha kh'an lulakh' u'sh tsigakh' Iiir ma bats kIezzig ben.
Shaina neIalt khillarsh /bu u'sh/. Michchakh' khilakh' skh'alo'tsur ma bu u'sh, boiur ma bu baiartsa.
Delan sunnat du iza, kh'alkha dIabakhancha'rgakh' a lella. Kh'una karanne a karor ma bats Delan sunnatana khiitsam.
Kh'o'ga kho'ttu nakha sakh'takhla'tsna. Akh' ala: "Tsu'nan Iilma Dalla gergakh' du". Steno khou'itu kh'o'ga? -i sakh't-m gerga-khilla a mega.
Bakk'alla a, Dala neIalt a'lla tsateshacharna, Tso kechiina tsarna zho'zhakhati.
U'sh la'ttar bu tsu chokh' guttar. Tsarna karor vats tskh'a a vali a, gIo'ncha a.
Otsu diinakh' shain iakhkh'ash tsIerga erzosh,tsara er ma du: "Vai khilla khillekh'ara Dalla mu'tIakh', elchanna mu'tIakh'!"
Tsara elira: "Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, tkho mu'tIakh' khili tkhan elashna a, tkhan tkh'amdashna a. Tsara tili tkho /niisachu/ nek'akh.
Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, lolakh' tsarna shozza Iazap, dokkkha neIalt alalakh' tsarna".
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu ma khilalash Musana khalakhetar dinacharakh tera. Dala tsIanvira iza tsara a'llachukh. Iza khilira Dalla gergakh' lorush verg.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Delakh kkheralash, niisa dosh alalash.
Tso dika khu'lu'itur iu shun Iamalsh, gechdiir du shuna shun k'inosh. Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' verg -tso ba'kkkhina bokkkha tolam.

Okha kh'alkhadillira amanatstiglanashna a, la'ttana a, la'mnashna a -u'sh du'kh'al khilira i d1adakh'an, u'sh kkhiirira tsunakh, i dIadikh'ira adamo. Bakk'alla a, iza khili-kkh zulame verg a, tsa khuush verg a.

Dala Iazap darkh'ama munepak' bozharshna a, munepak' zudarshna a, shirk dinchubozharshna a, shirk dinchu zudarshna a, Dala toba k'obaldarkh'ama mu'min bozhariin a, mu'min zudariin a. Khili Dela gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
Khastam bu Dalla, Shena stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg dolchu, Shena khastam bolchunna ekhartakh' a. Iza kh'ikmate verg a vu, sov dika khuush verg a vu.
Tsunna kha'a lattana chudulush derg a, otsunakh skh'adolush derg a, stiglara okh'adogIush derg a, tsiga irkhdolush derg a. Iza k'inkhetame verg a vu, gechdeshverg a vu.

Tsateshachara elira: "Sakh't (k'ematde) vaina dogIur a dats". Akh' ala: "KhIa', san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh dui bou as, k'ailakha derg khuush volchu: danne a dogIur dolush du iza shuna". Tsunakh (Delakh) k'ailader dats misk'ala zarratal khIuma stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a, tsul melkho a zhimanig a, melkho a dokkkhanig a, bilgalchu zhainachokh' dolush a ben.
Iiman dillincharna, dika Iamalsh iinacharna ial ialarkh'ama. U'sh bu shaina gechdar a, siilakh' ritsk' a khir dersh.
Tkhan aiatash talkho k'akho'gush bersh, /u'sh/ gIeldan gIertash -tsarna Iazap du lazosh dolchu taIzarakh.
Shaina Iilma dellacharnakha'a kh'una kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara do'ssinarg bak'derg duila, sha /nakh/ nisbesh dolu veza volchun, khastame volchun (Delan) novk'a.

Tsateshnachara elira: "Okha nisdoi shu tskh'ana staganatIe, shu'ga sha du'itsush volchu, shu errig kiisak khilla /keshnii chokh'/ dakhkadelcha, shu kerlachu kkhollar chokh' khir du /iukha dendiir du/, bokhush volchu?
Dalla tIe khartsderg kkho'llina tso, ia tsu'ntsa zhinash du". KhIa', ekhartakh tsa teshash bersh Iazapa chokh' a, genarchu tilar chokh' a ma bu.

Tsarna tsa go-te stiglara a, la'ttara a shaina kh'alkhakh' a, tIekh'akh' a derg? Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, Okha la'tte khudiitur bara u'sh, ia stiglara kiisakash egor iara tsarna tIe. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delil ma du / tobadartsa Dalla / t1evo'rzush volchu lena.
Okha dellera Davudana Tkhaigara niImat, /elira/: "KhIai la'mnash! Tasbakh' de tsu'ntsa tskh'ana, /asha a/ olkhazarsh". Okha kIaddiira tsunna echig:
"GIa'gInash e, tIe iusta /u'sh/. Dikanig delasha. Bakk'alla a, So ash diirig gush vu".

Suleimanna a /mu'tIakh' bira Okha/ mokh, tsu'nan Iu'irenan nek' butt bolush, tsu'nan su'irenan nek' a buttbolush. Okha laliira tsunna tsIesta (ez), /khin/ kh'osta sanna dIao'khush. Zhinekh du sha'sh tsunna kh'alkhakh' bolkh besh dersh tsu'nan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun purbantsa. Tsarakh Tkhan omrakh dIatilnacharna Iavshor du Okha zho'zhakhatin Iazapakh.

Tsara esh tsunna, shena luu, mikh'rabash, surtash a, kedash, Ia'mnash sanna, chIogIa chIagIbina iainash a. Barkalla alartsa Iamal elash /Tkhuna/, khIai Davudan do'zal. KIezzig bu San leshekh barkalla olush bersh.

Okha tsunna (Suleimanna) Iozhalla tIekhIotticha, i valarna tIe u'sh nis tsa bira tskh'ana la'ttan diinato ben, sha tsu'nan Iasa iuush. Iza /vella/ okh'avo'zhcha, bilgaldelira zhinashna: shaina k'aile khuush khillekh'ara, la'ttar tsakhilar sha'sh siisazchu Iazapekh'.

Khilira sabaashnashain gIishloshkakh' delil: shi besh: a'ttu agIorkh'ara a, a'rru agIorkh'ara a. Daa shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun ritsk'ekh, barkalla ala Tsunna (shukur de Dala)! Tokkhe mokhk a, gechdesh volu Kkhiosh-kkhoburg /khilira tsarna/.

D1abevlira u'sh /Dalla barkalla alarkh/, Okha dossiira tsarna tIe dukkkha Iovrash, tseran shinna beshan metta khiliitira shi besh, k'a'kh'a sto'mash bolush, aslikha, /tskh'atstsa/ khIuma kIezzig sidrekha iolush.
Iza bekkham bira Okha tsarna u'sh tsa teshash khilarna. Okha /ishtta/ bekkham boi tsateshacharna a ben?

Tsarna (Sabaan) iukk'ekh' a, Okha shaina chokh' dek'aliina khillachu (Shaman) iartiin iukk'ekh' a Okha iira gush iolu iartash, tsarna chokh' k'astiira nek': "Lela tsarna chukhula bu'isanashkakh' a, denoshkakh' a, kkheram botsush!"

Tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, gena khiliitalakh' tkhan kkherstash lelar". Tsara zulam dira shaina, Okha khiliitira tsarakh /nakhana/ diitsarsh, massankh'a a dIasabarzhira u'sh. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du masso a sobare volchunna a, kham bechunna a.
Ibliso bak'daitira tsa'rga shen mottar, u'sh tsunna tIa'kh'akhIo'ttira mu'min nakhakh tskh'a toba iotsurg.
Ma iatsara tsunna tsarna tIekh' tskh'a a bak'o, dekk'a Tkhuna khaarkh'ama, mila vu ekhartakh teshash tsunakh shekonekh' khillachekh. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg masso a khIumanna lardarkho vu.

Akh' ala: "Kkhaikkha sha'sh, AllakhI vitina, /delii bu/ mo'ttush khillacha'rga". Tsara dola ma tsa do misk'ala zarrat /khIumanna/ stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a. Ma dats tsarna (tsara shain delii bu bokhucharna) tsu shinna chokh' tskh'a a /AllakhIatsa/ nak'ostalla, ma vats Tsunna tsarakh tskh'a a gIo'ncha /o'shush/.

Paida biir bats gIodakkkharoTsunna gergakh' Tso shena purba dellachunna ben. Shain degnashkara kkheram dIaba'kkkhicha, tsara (shaina shapaIat dan bak'o ella khilla dolchu malikasha a, paikhamarasha a) elira /vovshashka/: "KhIun elira shun Kkhiosh-kkhobucho /shapa1at daran kh'ok'ekh'/?" Tsara elira: "Bak'derg. Iza lekkha a, vokkkha a verg vu".
Akh' ala: "Mila vu shuna ritsk' lush verg stiglanashkara a, lattara a?" Akh' ala: " Allakh1-Dela vu". Bakk'alla a, Tkho ia shu niisachu novk'akh' du ia bilgalchu tilar chokh' du!".
Akh' ala: "Shu'ga khottur dats okha k'a darna, tkho'ga khottur dats ash desh dolchukh".
Akh' ala: "Tskh'a'natukhur du vai vain Kkhiosh-kkhobucho /k'ematdiinakh'/ tIakkkha k'astor du Tso vaina iukk'ekh' bak'dolchu'ntsa, Iza khuush volu k'astosh verg vu".
Akh' ala: "Ash gaita suna sha'sh Tsunakh kkhiina nak'ostii". KhIan-khIa! Iza -Dela vu, Sha veza volu, Sha kh'ukam /niisa/ desh volu.
Okha vakhiitina ma vats kh'o masso a nakhe kkha' bakh'ash verg a, kkheramcha a khilla ben, delakh' a, nakhakh dukkhakh- bolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Tsara olu: "Matsa /kkhochush/ khir iu i vaIda, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'?"
Akh' ala: "Shuna khan to'khna de du, tsunakh tskh'a sakh't tIa'kh'adu'sur a dats shu, kh'alkhadovlur a dats".

Tsateshnachara elira: "Teshanne a teshar ma dats tkho khIokkkhu K'ur'anakh a, tsul kh'alkha khillachukh a". Kh'una gush balkh'ara i zulamkhoi shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kh'alkha khIottiina, tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkha'rga dosh iukhaderzadesh, sha'sh za'Iip khillachara kuralla esh khillacha'rga olush: "Shu tsa khillekh'ara, tkhokh mu'min nakh khilla khir ma bara".
Sha'sh kuralla esh khillachara eliraza'Iip khillacha'rga: "Okha dIatilira shu /niisachu/ nek'akh i shu'ga be'nachul tIa'kh'a? KhIa', shu sha'sh khilira k'inosh desh".

Sha'sh za'Iip khillachara elira kuralla esh khilacha'rga: "KhIa', bu'isanan a, diinan a mekarlonatsa ash tkhuna omra ma dora tkho Delakh tsateshar, Okha Tsu'ntsa kkhibersh nisbar". Tsara kh'uldiira dokhkobovlar, shaina Iazap gicha. Okha burzholash-g1omatash tu'ikhira tsa teshash khillacheran logekh. Sha'sh desh khillachu'ntsa ben bekkham khir bui tsarna?
Okha tsa vakhiitira iu'rtakh' tskh'a a kkheramcha tsu'nan (iu'rtan) kh'aldolchara olush ben: "Bakk'alla a, tkho shu shetsa daiitinchunna /tsa teshash/ kersta du-kkh".
Tsara olura: "Tkho melkho a alsam du bakhamtsa a, do'zaltsa a, tkhuna Iazap diir dats".
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho ritsk' darzhado Shena luuchunna /dukkha lush/, baram a bo /kIezzig lush/, delakh' a, nakhakh dukkhakh- bolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh."

Shun bakham a, shun do'zal a ma bats shu Tkhuna gergadalosh bersh (kIez-kIezzig) gergadalortsa -sha iiman dillinarg a, dika Iamal iinarg a ben. U'sh bu shaina shozza ial ersh sha'sh iinchu Iamalshtsa, u'sh /khir/ bu /ialsamanin/ khIusamashkakh' kkheram botsush.
Tkhan aiatash /dokhorekh'/ k'akh'o'gush bersh, sha'sh /u'sh/ g1orasiza diir du mo'ttush,- u'sh Iazap chokh' lattor ma bu.

Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho darzhado /shortta/ ritsk' Shen leshekh Shen luuchunna, Tso tsunna baram a bo /kIezzig lush/". Ash khIumanakh sagIina ellarg- Tso mettakhIottor iu. Iza ritsk' lucharekh uggar dikanig vu.
Tsu /k'emat/diinakh' Tso gulbiir bu u'sh berrige a, tIakkkha er du malikashka: "KhIorsh bu i shuna Iibadat desh khillarsh?"
Tsara elira: "Vonakh tsIena vu kh'o, Kh'o vu-kkh tkhan vali, u'sh botsush. KhIa', u'sh khilira zhinashna Iibadat desh, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh tsarna iiman dillina bu".
Takhana shukh tskh'abolcheran dolakh' bats vukkharna paida a, zen a, Okha er du zulam dinacha'rga: "Iovsha shaina tsIeran Iazap, ash sha khartsdesh khilla dolu".

Shaina tIekh' Tkhan bilgala dolu aiatash do'shush, tsara elira: "KhIara ma vats shu shun dai shena Iibadat desh khillachukh dIatilo luush volu stag ben". Tsara elira /iukha a/: "Tso sha kkho'llina khartsderg ben ma dats khIara /K'ur'an/". Tsateshnachara elira bak'dolchunna, i shaiga de'cha: "KhIara dekk'a k'eggina bozbuunchalla du-kkh".
Okha tsa della /kh'alkha/ tsa'rga (Makkan okh1laga) tskh'a a zhaina tsara i Iamadesh dolu, Okha tsa vakhiitina tsa'rga kh'ol kh'alkha tskh'a a kkheramcha.
Khartsdira tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a, /khIorsh-m/ tsa kkhiira Okha tsarna dellachukh ittalgIachu dek'akh a. Tsara khartsbira San elchanash. Mukha khilira San /u'sh/ tsalarar (San Iazap)?

Akh' ala: "As kh'o'khu shuna tskh'a khIuma: shu d1akhIottar Dalla kh'alkha /bak'derg lo'khush/ shishsha a, tskh'a'tstsa a, tIakkkha ash oila iar: shun nak'ostma vats zhinekh. Iza ma vats kkheramcha ben, chIogIa Iazap khilale kh'alkha /vaiitina volu/".
Akh' ala: "As tsa bekhna shu'ga tskh'a a makh, iza shuna bu. San makh Dalla tIekh' ben bats. Iza masso a khIumanna tIekh' tesh ma vu".
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho du'llu /paikhamariin degnashka/ bak'derg, k'ailenash dika khuush verg vu Iza".
Akh' ala: "Deana bak'derg. D1adolalur dats khartsderg, dukhado'rzur a dats".
Akh' ala: "So tilvellekh', -so tilalush vu saina. So nisvellekh', -San Kkhiosh-kkhobucho saiga dellachu vekh'etsa /nisvella/. Bakk'alla a, Iza khozush verg a vu, gergakh' verg a vu".
Kh'una ginekh'ara u'sh kkherabella, bovla mettig iotsush, skh'a'la'tsna gergarchu mettigera.
Tsara elira: "Okha iiman dillina tsunakh". Michara du tsarna /iimanakh/ kkhiar genarchu mettigera?

Tsara kerstadina iza kh'alkha. Tsara dIatosura k'ailakha derg genarchu mettigera. (Tsara bak' tsa lorura shaiga du'nenakh' du'itsush khilla dolu k'ematdiinakh a, iukhadendarakh a, ialsamanikh a, zho'zhakhatikh a la'tsna khabarsh).
Du'kh'alo khilira tsarna a, tsarna dezachunna a iukk'ekh', u'sh sannacharakh kh'alkha dina ma khilla. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira shekonan shekonekh'.

Khastam bu Dalla -stiglaniin a, la'ttan a iu'kh'antsa Kkhollarkhachunna, shishsha, kkhokkkha, di' tIemash dolchu malikekh /paikhamarashka/ elchanash khiliitinchunna. Tso sovdokkkhu kkhollarekh' Shena luurg. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' berg ma vu.
Dala nakhana Shen k'inkhetamakh dIabellinchunna -vats tsunna dIak'ovlarkho. Tso dIak'evlinchunna -vats tsunna dIakhu'itsurg Tsul tIa'kh'a. Iza veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

KhIai nakh! Kh'ekhade shaina tIekh' khilla dolu Delan niImat. Dela votschu kkhechu kkhollarkhocho ritsk' lur darii-te shuna stiglara a, la'ttara a? Kkhin Dela ma vats Iza votsurg. Ma Iekhadesh du-kkh shu!
Kh'o tsara khartsvakh' /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/. -kh'ol kh'alkha a khartsbina elchanash. Dalla tIe dIado'rzu gIullakkhash.
KhIai nakh! Bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda -kh'ak'-bak' iu. Shu danne a Iekha ma doila du'nenan dakharo, shu danne a Iekha ma doila Delatsa Iekhocho (shaitIano).
Bakk'alla a, shaitIa shuna mostagI du, mostagI dei skh'alatsa iza. Tso kkhoikkhu shen toba zho'zhakhatin dai khilare.
Tsateshnarsh -tsarna chIogIa Iazap /khir/ du. Iiman dillinarsh a, dikanash dinarsh a -tsarna gechdar a, iokkkha ial ma iu!

Tk'a vu-te shen Iamalakh vonig shena khaziinarg, tIakk'a iza shena khaza ginarg /dika Iamal iinchukh terra/? Bakk'alla a, Dala tilavala ma vu'tu Shena luurg, Tso nis ma vo Shena luurg. Kh'an sa ma daa tsarna tIekh', gIaigIa esh. Bakk'alla a, Dela vu tsara desh derg khuush verg.
Dela vu Sha mokh bokhu'itush verg, Tso tsu'nga kh'eioitu markhash, Okha u'sh dIalekhkira bellachu makhka -tsu'ntsa (dogIitsa) latta dendiira iza dellachul tIa'kh'a. Ishtta du /shu/ iukhadendar a.

Mila a khillekh' sii dezash, -Delan du sii derrige a. Tsunna tIe kh'alaailo tsIena dosh a, dika Iamal a, Tso aiio iza. Vonashtsa mekarlo esh bersh, -tsarna chIogIa Iazap du. Tseran mekarlo -iza erna iu.

Dela vu Sha shu kkho'llinarg popparkh, tIakkkha tIadamakh. TIakkkha Tso khiliitina shukh bo'rshanig a, stenig a. Tskh'a a zuda berakh khir ma iats, tso ber diir ma dats Tsu'nan khaartsa ben. Tskh'a a vekhash verg vekhar a ma vats, tsu'nan dakharakh o'shur a ma dats zhainachokh' dolush ben. Bakk'alla a, iza Dalla atta ma du.

Tskh'aniissa bats /khIara/ shi khIord: khIara merza-teza, shen khi mala atta dolush bu, tk'a vazha -du'ra tukha du. KhIorammakh ash duu kerla zhizhig, ash /tsarna chu'ra/ skh'aiokhu mekhala marzhanash, ash u'sh tIeiukhu. Kh'una go kema tsarna chukhula kkherstash ash lakharkh'ama Tsu'nan niImatakh, ash /Dala dellachu niImatashna / shukur darkh'ama a.

Tso bu'isa denna chu ialaio, de bu'isanna chu dalado, bolkh boitu malkhe a, batte a. Masso a dIasalelash iu shen to'khna khan tIekkhachchalts. Iza vu Dela, shun Ela, Tsu'nan du pachchakh'alla. Ash, Iza a vitina shaiga kkhoikkhucheran dolakh' ma dats tsu'rrig a.

Ash tsa'rga kkhiikkhicha a, tsarna tsa khozu shun kkhaikkhar, khezcha a, -tsara shuna zhop tsa lo, k'ematdiinakh' tsara kerstadiir du shun nak'ostalla. Tskh'ammo a kh'o'ga du'itsur ma dats Sha sov khuuchu (Tso) sanna.
KhIai nakh! Shu pek'arsh du Dele. Dela -Iza vu kh'alderg a, khastame verg a.
Shena laakh', shu dIadakhiitina kerla khalk' dalor du Tso.
Iza Dalla /khIumma/ khala dats.

Kh'ur bats d1akh'ocho kkhechun mokh'. /K'ikh/ du'zna sino diikhicha a shen /mokh'/ d1abakh'ar, khIumma tsunakh d1akh'ur bats /tskhamma a/, gergarlo iolush iza khillekh' a. Akh' kh'ekham be (kkheram tasa) shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkho'rush bolcharna I gush votstsushekh', lamaz a khIottincharna. TsIanvellarg -iza shena tsIanlo. Dele du /shun masseran a/ dIaderzar.
Tskh'aniissa vats bIa'rsa dotsurg a, bIa'rsa derg a,
Bodanash a, nur a,
IindagIa a, iovkho a.
Tskh'aniissa bats diinabersh a, bellarsh a. Bakk'alla a, Dala khozu'itu Shena luuchu'nga. Kh'o ma vats khozu'itur dolush keshnii chokh' volchu'nga.
Kh'o vekk'a kkheramcha vu.
Bakk'alla a, Okha vakhiitina kh'o bak'dolchu'ntsa kkha' bokkkhurg a, kkheram tosurg a khilla. Tskh'a a ummat tsa khilla shena iukk'ekh' kkheramcha va'khna ben.
Tsara kh'o khartsvakh', tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a khartsbina /elchanash/. Tsa'rga ba'khkira tseran elchanash bilgalonashtsa a, iazonashtsa a, nure dolchu zhainatsa a.
TIakkkha As skh'aletsira tsateshnarsh. Mukha khilira As tsalarar /tseran 1amal, San o'g1azlo tsarna/?

Kh'una kha'ii Dala dossina khilar stiglara khi, Okha skh'abekhira tsu'ntsa sto'mash, shain besnash taip-taipana a dolush, la'mnekh a /dikhkira/ nek'ash: kIain a, tsIen a, shain besnash taip-taipana a dolush, chIogIa Ia'rzhadersh a.

Ishtta nakhakh a, diinatekh a, bezhnekh a /khiliitira Okha/ shain besnash taip-taipana dolush. Bakk'alla a, Delakh kkho'ru Tsu'nan leshekh Ielamnakh. Bakk'alla a, Dela vu veza verg a, gechdesh verg a.

Bakk'alla a, Delan zhaina do'shush bersh, lamaz khIottinarsh, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'ekh k'ailakha a, guchakh' a /Delan novk'akh'/ kharzhash esh bersh -u'sh dog dokhush bu tsk'a a sa iotsush iu'sur iotschu iokhk-etsare (ialsamane),
/U'sh dogdokhush bu/ Tso dIaialare shain ial, sha'sh sovbakhare Shen niImatakh. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu gechdesh verg a, barkalle verg a /Shena 1ibadat dinacharna/.
Okha vekh'etsa zhainakh kh'o'ga dellarg iza bak'derg du, niisa dogIush a khilla dolu shel kh'alkha khillachu'ntsa. Bakk'alla a, Dela Shen leshekh derg sov dika khuush a vu, gush a vu.

TIakkkha Okha zhaina (K'ur'an) delira irsana Tkhan leshekh Okha kha'rzhincharna. Tsarakh shena zulam diirig a vu /tsu K'ur'antsa Iamal tsa esh/, tsarakh baramekh' /Iamal esh/ verg a vu, tsarakh Delan purbantsa dikanashtsa kh'alkhava'llarg a vu. Iza du-kkh dokkkha dozalla!
Iadn (ts1e iolchu uggar eza iolchu ialsamanin) boshmash /iu tsarna/, shena chu u'sh bo'dur bolush, /tseran ku'igekh/ bullur bu dashon a, lu'lu'an a gIoz, tseran dukhar tsu chokh' khir du dari.
Tsara er du: "Khastam bu Dalla, tkhuna tIera singattam dIaba'kkkhinchu. Bakk'alla a, tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg gechdiirig a vu, barkalle verg a vu.
Ishtanig vu Iza Sha kh'anal dina tkhuna /guttar lattaran/ tsIa (ialsamani) Shen dozallakh, tkhokh tsa kh'akkhalo tsu chokh' khalo, tkhokh tsa kh'akkhalo tsu chokh' kIaddalar."
Tsateshnarsh -tsarna zho'zhakhatin tsIe iu, kkhiel iiir iats tsarna u'sh lesh, aidiir dats tsarna tIera tsu'nan Iazapakh /khIumma a/. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha khIor tsateshachunna.

Tsara /Dele g1o do'khush/ kkhu'ikkhur du tsu chokh': "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, aradakhakh' tkho, okha dika Iamal iiir ma iara, tkhash iina khillarg a iotsush!" Okha dakha tsa ditira shu /du'nenakh'/ sha kkhetash verg kkhettal? Shu'ga ma veara kkheramcha. Iovsha /khIintsa Iazap/, vats zulamkhoshna tskh'a a gIo'ncha.
Bakk'alla a, Dela vu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a kh'ulamekh'derg khuush verg. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu degnashkakh' derg khuush verg a.

Iza vu Sha shukh la'ttakh' tIa'kh'e khiliitina. Milla a velakh' kerstava'lla -tsunna shena du tsu'nan kerstanalla. Sovbokhur bats kerstanash tseran kerstanallo shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' o'gIazallitsa ben. Sovbokhur bats kerstanash tseran kerstanallo eshallitsa ben.

Akh' ala: "Kh'ovsal shain nak'ostashka, ash shaiga kkhoikkhush bolchu, Dela a vitina. Gaital so'ga, khIun kkho'llina tsara la'ttakh', ia tsarna /Delatsa/ nak'ostalla du stiglanashkakh', ia Okha tsa'rga zhaina della, u'sh Tsu'ngara bilgalonashkakh' a bolush? KhIa', zulamkhosha -tskh'abolchara vukkharna esh iolu vaIda Iekhor ben ma iats.
Bakk'alla a, Dala satsosh iu stiglanash a, latta a dIatilarkh. U'sh dIatilcha, sotsu'itur iari-i u'sh tskh'amma a Tsul tIa'kh'a? Bakk'alla a, Iza khilla tIekh sobareverg a, gechdiiriga.

Tsara (Makkara kerstanasha) dui biira Delatsa, inzare chIogIa dui, shaiga kkheramchavagIakh', sha'sh khir ma du uggar niisachu novk'akh' dolchu ummatekh tskh'a', a'lla. Tsa'rga kkheramchave'cha, tso sov tsa bekhira u'sh /islam dinna/ genabovlartsa ben,

La'ttakh' kurabovlartsa a, vochu mekarlotsa a ben. Von mekarlo tsa kh'ercha shen okhIlakh ben. Kh'ovsur bui u'sh kh'alkhalerchiin Iadate ben? Kh'una karor ma dats Delan Iadatna khiitsar. Kh'una karor ma dats Delan Iadatna kh'avzor /kkhechunna tIe/.

U'sh tsa lela la'ttakhula, tsa kh'ovsu-te, mukha khilla tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran tIa'kh'e? U'sh ma bara khIokkkharal vuno chIogIa nitsk'atsa. Dela khili Sha dukhatukhur votsush stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a tskh'anna khIumano. Bakk'alla a, Iza khili khuush verg a, nitsk' berg a.

Dala nakh lu'itsushbelkh'ara tsara karadinchu'ntsa, tsu /la'ttan/ ek'ana tIekh' du'sur ma datsara tskh'a a diinat, delakh' a, tIekh'atottu Tso u'sh shaina to'khna khan tIekkhachchalts. Tseran /to'khna/ khan tIee'cha, -/Tso bekkham biir bu tsarna shain Iamalashka kh'a'zhna/ - bakk'alla a, Dela khilla Shen lesh &lwH mHfwZ#1075;ush verg.
Ia sun.
Sha kh'ikmate dolchu K'ur'anakh dui bou As:
Bakk'alla a, kh'o ma vubakhkiitincharakh (tskh'a elcha)
Niisachu novk'akh'.
Sha veza a, k'inkhetame a volchu'ngara okh'adossina du iza (K'ur'an),
Kh'o'ga kh'ekham baita k'omana, shain daishna bina tsa khilla -u'sh gIovpal khilla (Delan din tsa devzash).
Tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tIekh' doshbak'khilla -tsara /akh' de'nachu'nga/ iiman du'llur dats.
Tseran logekh Okha burzhulash -g1omatash to'khna, u'sh chIengiikh (ch1enigekh) kkha'chcha, -tseran kortosh irkh aibella.
Tsarna kh'alkhakhula a, tIekh'akhula a du'kh'alo iina Okha, tseran bIa'rgii kh'alkha kirkh'a dillina Okha -u'sh gush ma bats.
Tsarna tskh'aterra du: akh' kh'ekham bicha a, tsa bicha a -u'sh teshar bolush bats /akh' de'nachukh, khIai Mukh'ammad/.

Bakk'alla a, akh' kh'ekham be kh'ekhamna tIa'kh'akhIuttush volchunna, shena gush votstsushekh' K'inkhetame volchukh (Delakh) kkho'rush volchunna. Akh' tsu'nga kkha' bakkkha tsunna gechdina khilartsa a, siilakh' ial khilartsa a.
Bakk'alla a, Okha den ma bo bellarsh, dIa iaz ma do Okha tsara kh'alkha leliinarg a (dakhiitinarg a), tseran /tIa'kh'a khir iolu/ lar a. Masso a khIuma dIanis ma dina Okha bilgalchu zhainachokh'.
Balabe tsarna masalna tskh'ana iu'rtandai: tsiga ba'khkira elchanash.
Okha vakhiitinera tsa'rga shi'-tsara u'sh shia khartsbira. TIakkkha Okha u'sh chIagIbira kkhoalgIachu'ntsa, tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, tkho shu'ga /dakhkiitina/ elchanash ma du".
Tsara (iu'rtara nakha) elira: "Shu ma dats tkho sanna adamash ben. Tskh'anna khIumantsa K'inkhetame volcho dakhkiitina ma dats shu -shu khartslu'ish ma du".
Tsara (elchanasha) elira: "Vain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kha'a-kkh tkho shu'ga daiitina elchanash duila.
Tkhuna tIekh'-m dats bilgalderg dIakkhachor ben".
Tsara (iu'rtara nakha) elira: "Shu bakh'anekh' von bilgalonash khaaella tkhuna, shu tsa sovtsakh', okha shuna tIulgash dettar ma du, tkho'gara lazosh dolchu Iazapo skh'alo'tsur ma du shu".

Tsara elira: "Shun von bilgalonash shu'tsa shaitsa iu. Tk'a shuna kh'ekham bina dela /iu shun von bilgalonash; tsundela do ash tkhuna Iazap?/ KhIa', shu du-kkh tIalamza k'am (dukkkha kIorga dakhna shu k'inosh darekh')".
GIalina iistera vedda tskh'a stagskh'akkhechira, tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! TIa'kh'akhIitta otsu elchanashna.
TIa'kh'akhIitta shaiga makh tsa bo'khush bolcharna -u'sh niisachu novk'akh' ma bu.
As khIunda tsa do Iibadat suo Kkho'llinchunna, shu a Shena tIe dIadu'gur dolchunna?

Iza a vu'tii, kkhin delii tIelotsu tk'a as? K'inkhetame volchunna (Dalla) suna tskh'a zen dan li'cha, tseran shapaIatasha khIumma a gIo diir ma datsara suna, tsara so kIelkh'arvokkkhur ma vatsara /Delan Iazapakh/.
Gan a gush dolchu tilarchokh' khir ma vara so tIakkkha.
Bakk'alla a, as iiman dilli shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, so'ga ladogIa..."
/Malikasha/ elira: "Ialsamane gIo". Tso elira /shen sa dolush/: "KhIai san k'am, shu khuush khillekh'ara-kkh
Suna san Kkhiosh-kkhobucho gechdina khilar a, Tso so siilakh'bolcharakh khiliitar a".
Tsul tIa'kh'a tsu'nan k'omanna tIe stiglara bIo tsa baiitira Okha, i bou'itursh tsa khilira Tkho.
Bekk'a tskh'a chIogIa mokh' khilira -u'sh /chim khilla/ dIatiina bisira.
Ma bokkkha bala bu-kkh /San/ leshna: tskh'a a elcha tsa veana-kkh tsa'rga, i tsara kh'iizavesh ben.
Tsarna tsa go-tekh'a: mel dukkha t1a'kh'enash khIallakiina Okha tsaral kh'alkha, u'sh tsarna tIe iukhabo'rzur ma bats.
Masso a tskh'ana Tkhuna kh'alkha dIakhIittor ma bu.
Bilgala delil ma dui tsarna della dolu latta: Okha iza dendina, tsunakh Okha bu'rtigash a skh'ada'khna -tsarakh tsara kkhacha bou.
Tsunna tIekh' Okha khurmaniin a, kemsiin a boshmash khIittiina. Tsunakh Okha shovdanash a da'khna -
Tsa'rga tsu'nan sto'mash baiita -tseran ku'igasha tsa dina iza. Barkalla khIunda tsa olu tsara?
Ts1ena vuI(Dela masso a kkhachambatsarekh), Sha masso a khIuma bo'rsha a, stea, kkho'llina volu: la'tto skh'adolu'itush derg a, u'sh sha'sh a, tsarna tsakhuurg a.
Bilgala delil du tsarna bu'isa: tsunakh de skh'adokkkhu Okha, t1akkkha u'sh bodanekh' bu'sush.
Malkh a dIalela shena khIottinchu mettige -Sha veza volchun, Sha khuush volchun dIakhIottam bu iza.
Bettan a baram bina Okha shen manzalashkakh'-dIabo'rzush khurmanan shirchu gakh tarloi.
Malkh battana tIa'kh'a tsa kkhu'u, bu'isa diinal kh'alkha tsa iolu -masso a shen-shen mettekh' neka desh iu.
Bilgala delil du tsarna Okha tseran zu'rret du'zzina khillachu /Nukh'an/ kemana tIekh' d1asaleliina khilar.
Tsunakh tera kkho'llira Okha tsarna u'sh tIe khaa khIumanash a.
Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, khi chu bakhiitina khir bara u'sh, -ma khir datsara tsarna ortsa, ma kIelkh'arbokhur batsara u'sh
Tkho'gara k'inkhetam a, tskh'a khan tIekkhachchalts bakham a khilcha ben.
Tsa'rga a'lcha: "Shu kkheralash shun kh'alkha khillachukh a, shun tIa'kh'a khirdolchukha -shukh k'inkhetam ban tam bara" /u'sh dIabo'rzu/.
Delan aiatekh tskh'a a aiat tsa dogIu tsa'rga, u'sh tsunakh dIabo'rzush a ben.

Tsa'rga a'lcha: "Sag1a lo /miskacharna /Dala shaina dellachu ritsk'akh," tsateshachara olu iiman dillincharakh: "Okha khIunda kkhobu u'sh? Dala,Shena laakh',Sha kkhobur bu, gan a gush tilarchokh' du-kkh shu".
/TIakkkha/ tsara olu: "Matsa khir du iza ash du'itsurg, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'?"
Kh'o'zhush la'ttar bats u'sh -bekk'a tskh'a chIogIa mokh' khir bu: tso skh'alotsur bu u'sh,sha'sh la'ttashekh' k'u'isush.
Veset dan a nitsk' kkhochur bats tsarna, shain nakhana tIe iukhabo'rzur a bats u'sh.
Surlokkhur iu-u'sh keshnashkara shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe sikhlur bu.
Tsara elira: "Ma bokkkha bala beana vaina! Kh'an gIovtina-te vai, diishina Iokhkuchu'ra?!" /Malikasha ia mu'min nakha er du/: "KhIara du shuna K'inkhetam bolchokhir du a'llarg. Bak'lina elchanash".
Bekk'a tskh'a chIogIa mokh' khilla -u'sh berrige a Tkhuna kh'alkha dIatarbella.
Takhana sinna tskh'anna khIumantsa zulam diir ma dats, ash iinchu Iamalshtsa ben bekkham a shuna khir ma bats.
Bakk'alla a, ialsamanin dai takhana /shain/ gIullakkhashkakh' zovkkh kh'o'gush khir bu.
U'sh a, tseran zudarii a IindagIekh' ma'nganashna tIetevzhina la'ttar ma bu.
Tsarna tsigakh' sto'mash a, tsarna sha'sh ekhnarg khir ma iu.
"Salam!" -olush marshalla khir du k'inkhetame volchu Delera.
Shu dIak'asta takhana, khIai k'inosh dinarsh!
As shu'ga tsa a'llera tk'a: "KhIai Adaman kIentii! ShaitIanna Iibadat ma delash -iza shuna bilgala mostagI ma dui?
Suna Iibadat deisha -khIara bu niisa nek'!"
Shukh iokkkha toba tilina da'lla i! -Shu tsa khili-kkh kh'ek'ale?
KhIara iu i zho'zhakhate, khir iu shuna, a'lla kh'ekhiinarg!
Iovsha tsu'nan iovkho takhana-sha'sh tsateshash khilarna!
Takhana Okha tseran bagenashna mukhIar tukhur ma du, tseran ku'igasha Tkho'ga du'itsur ma du, tsara /du'nenakh'/ karadesh khillachunna kogasha teshalla diir ma du.
Tkhuna li'nekh'ara,bIa'rsa dekh'na u'sh bu'tur bara, novk'akh tilla bisinchu tsarna michara gur dara?
Ia Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, shain mettigekh' ku'tsash khu'itsur ma dara tseran -dIabakhalur ma batsara u'sh, iukhabo'rzur a ma batsara u'sh.
Okha vakha vitinarg k'analle d1averzavo,u'sh kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu-te?
Tsa Iamiina Okha tsunna (Mukh'ammad paikhamarna) illesh-i dan tso tam a ma batsara: iza kh'ekham a, /khIumnash/ bilgaldokhu K'ur'an a ma du,
Shetsa kkheram tasa diinavolchunna, tsateshnacharna tIekh' /tsarna Iazap khir du a'lla/ dosh bak'khiliita.
Tsarna tsa go-tekh'a Okha shaina Tkhan ku'igasha dinchukh da'khni kkho'llina khilar, u'sh tsarna tIekh' dai a bina?
Okha u'sh tsarna mu'tIakh' khiliitina: tsarakh u'sh tIekhu'ishursh a du, tsarakh tsara dou.
Tsarna tsa'rgakh' paidanash a, malarsh a du -barkalla khIunda tsa olu tsara?
AllakhI-Dela a vitina kkhin delii la'tsna -shaina gIo khir du mo'ttush.
Khir dats tsarna tsa'rgakhula gIo -ma bu u'sh tsarna dIakhIottina bIo.
Tseran dasho singattame ma voila kh'o. Tkho khuush du kh'una tsara k'ailadokkkhurg a, tsara dIakh'ediirig a.
Adamnatsa go-te Okha sha kkho'llina khilar tIadamakh? -bilgala mostagI khili-kkh tsunakh!
Tkhuna masal a daliina, sha kkhollar dits a dina, a'llera: "Kh'an deniiir iu da'Iakhkash,u'sh iakhkaelcha?"
Akh' ala: "Deniiir iu u'sh sha'sh du'khkh'ara kkho'llincho -Iza masso a khIuma kkholla Sha khuush ma vu.
Iza vu shuna siinachu dittakh tsIe khiliitina, -ash tsunakh lata a esh".
Tk'a stiglanash a, latta a Sha kkhollinchunna nitsk' tsa kkhochu i sannarg iukha kkholla?! Kkhochu!!! I sha dika khuush kkhollarkho ma vu!
Tsu'nan gIullakkh du Shena tskh'a khIuma li'cha,tsu'nga"Khila!" alar -t1akkkha iza khu'lu.
Ts1ena vuI (Dela masso a kkhachambatsarekh), Shen ku'igakh' masso a khIumanan pachchakh'alla dolu, shu a Shena tIe dIaderzor dolu.
/As dui bou/ mogIarshkakh' la'ttacharakhmogIitsa.
/As dui bou/ lokhkucharakhlakhkartsa.
/As dui bou/ kh'ekham bo'shucharakh:
Bakk'alla a, shun Dela tskh'a' vu.
Stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel dolchun a Da ma vu Iza, malkhbaliin a Da ma vu Iza.
Bakk'alla a, Okha khazdina gergara stigal sedarchiin khazallitsa a,
Ialashdartsa a masso a karzakhda'llachu shaitIanakh.
Tsara ladugIur dats Lakkharchu Kkhetashone, dukhatukhur du masso a agIorkh'ara
Genadakkkhartsa, tk'a tsarna du tsk'a a khedar dotsu Iazap.
Sikhkha /tskh'a dosh/ skh'ala'tsnarg dotsurg, t1akkkha tsunna a tIa'kh'akkhu'u /stiglara/ okh'abuzhu tsIe tukhu seda.
Akh' khattal tsa'rga: "U'sh bu vuno chIogIa kkholla, ia Okha kkho'llinarg du?" Bakk'alla a, Okha kkho'llina u'sh (tseran bukh -Adam) letash bolchu topparakh (popparakh).
KhIa', tsetsva'lla kh'o, u'sh tsa beshash bu /kh'an tsetsvalarkh/.
Shaina /K'ur'antsa/ kkheram teschi a, tsara tidam tsa bo.
Shaina delil gicha a, tIekh tsa beshash khu'lu.
Tsara elira: "KhIara bilgala bozbuunchalla a ben dats.
Vai delcha, vaikh toppar (poppar) a, t1ekhkash (da'Iakhkash) a khilcha, vai iukhadendiir du?
Ia vain kh'alkhalera dai?"
Akh' ala: "KhIa', shu kIeldu'sur ma du".
Iza-m tskh'a azben dats -u'sh kh'o'zhush khir bu.
Sha'sh olush: "Ma bala bu vaina! KhIara du-kkh i bekkhaman de".
"KhIara du-kkh i k'astaran de, ash sha khartsdesh khilla dolu".
"Skh'agulbe i zulam dinarsh a, tseran zudarii a, tsara /shaina/ Iibadat desh khillarsh a,
Dela a vitina. DIanisbe u'sh zho'zhakhatin novk'a!
Sovtsabe u'sh -tsa'rga bart khottur bu!"
"Shuna khIun khilla? Vovshashna gIo desh ma dats shu?"
KhIa', u'sh takhana mukIar khilla.
Tsarakh tskh'abersh t1ebirzi vukkharna, kho'ttush.
Olush: "Shu ma dara tkhuna tIedogIush a'ttu agIorkh'ara".
/Vukkhara/ er: "KhIa', shu sha'sh tsa khilira teshash /Delakh/.
Tkhan shuna tIekh' tskh'a a nitsk' batsara. KhIa', shu sha'sh khili tIekhda'llak'am.
Tkhuna tIekh' bak' khili tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun dosh. Bakk'alla a, okha Iovshur du-kkh /Iazap/.
Okha shu a tili-kkh, bakk'alla a, tkho tkha'sh a khilla-kkh tiladella".
Bakk'alla a, u'sh otsu diinakh' Iazapekh' /tskh'anna/ dek'akh khir bu.
Bakk'alla a, Tkho ishtta do/1azap/ k'inosh dinacharna.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira shaiga a'lcha: "Kkhin dela vats AllakhI ben", kurabu'ilush.
Tsara olura: "Okha bu'tura tk'a tkhan delii zhinekh volchu illanchindu'kh'a".
KhIa', iza-m veana bak'dolchu'ntsa, tso bak'bina baiitinarsh.
Bakk'alla a, ash Iovshur ma du lazosh dolu Iazap.
Shuna bekkham khir ma bats ash desh khillarg ben.
Delan sov tsIena lesh botsuchara. (Tsarna khir dats 1azap).
Tsarna -devzash dolu ritsk' du -
Sto'mash, tseran siidesh khir du
NiImatiin boshmashkakh'.
Ma'nganii tIekh' vovshiin dukh'-du'kh'al la'ttash.
Tsarna /tIekh'iizash/ go bokkkhur bu /berasha/ shovdana chu'ra /ikhachu/ chagIaran kadatsa.
KIain, chome /malar/ dolush molucharna.
Tsu chokh' /kh'ek'al/ talkhar a dats /korta lezash/, u'sh tsunakh bekhar a bats.
BIa'rsa lotsu dolush bIa'rgash bakkkhii bolu/khaza zudarii/ khir bu tseran.
Sha'sh kh'ulamekh' dolchu khIoakhtera.
Tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharna du'kh'al gIur bu, kho'ttush.
Er du tsarakh olucho: "Bakk'alla a, san tskh'a nak'ost ma vara /du'nenakh' dolush/.
Tso olura: "Bakk'alla a, kh'o /paikhamarash/ bak'becharakh vu?
Vai delcha, vaikh poppar (toppar) a, da'Iakhkash (t1ekhkash) a khilcha, vai bekkhame uzur du?"
Tso elira: "Shu kh'ovsii?"
Iza kh'a'zhira, tIakkkha tsunna iza zho'zhakhatina iukk'ekh' gira.
Tso elira: "TallakhIi, /tskh'ana ma'IIara/ so khIallakvesh ma la'ttara akh'.
San Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun niImat tsa khillekh'ara, so khir ma vara /khIokkkhakh'/ la'ttacharakh".
/Ialsamanin okhIlano er du, u'sh bakh'osh/: "Vai liir dolush dats?
Vain tsk'a dalar a ben, vaina Iazap diir dolush a dats?
Bakk'alla a, khIara bu-kkh siilakh'-beza tolam.
Ishttachun du'kh'a k'akh'o'giila k'akh'o'guchara".
Tk'a iza du dika tIedossa /kh'oshalgIa/, ia zakk'umditt du?
Bakk'alla a, Okha iza khiliitina pitna khilla zulamkhoshna.
Bakk'alla a, iza du zho'zhakhatina bukhakh' aradolu ditt.
Tsu'nan sto'mash bu shaitIaniin kortosh sanna.
Bakk'alla a, tsara tsunakh duur dolush a du, gainash iuzor iolush a iu tsunakh.
TIakkkha bakk'alla a, tsarna tsunna tIe /to'khna/ tsIiidina khi du.
TIakkkha bakk'alla a, tseran dIaderzar zho'zhakhate du.
Bakk'alla a, tsarna kariira shain dai a tilabella /tsarna tIa'kh'aba'zira u'sh/.
U'sh tseran lorakh lekhkira. (Du'nenakh' bolush shain daisha dina k'inosh dira tsara a).
Tilabelira tsaral kh'alkha du'khkh'ar khillacharakh dukkhakhbersh.
Okha bakhiitira tsa'rgakh' kkheramchash.
Kh'azhal, mukha khilla shaina kkheram tesnacheran tIa'kh'e.
Delan sov tsIena lesh botsucheran.
Tkho'ga kkhiikkhira Nukh'as -ma dika zhop lush dersh du /Tkho/.
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, tsu'nan do'zal a bokkkhachu balikh.
Okha khiliitira tsu'nan zu'rret -iza bukhadu'surg.
Okha tsunna ditira /khaza khastavar/ tIa'kh'enashkakh'.
Salam du Nukh'ana Ialamashkakh'.
Bakk'alla a, Okha ishtta bekkham bo dikacharna.
Bakk'alla a, iza vu Tkhan mu'min leshekh.
TIakkkha Okha khi bukhabakhiitira bisinarsh.
Bakk'alla a, tsu'nan tobanakh ma vu IbrakhIim a.
Dagadaiita! Iza veara shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe tsIenchu dagtsa.
Dagadaiita! Tso a'llera shen dega a, shen k'ome a: "KhIun iu ash Iibadat desh erg?
Khartsderg delii /latsa/ la'a shuna, AllakhI- Dela a vu'tii?
KhIun du shuna mo'tturg Ialamiin Dekh?"
Iza kh'ezhira kh'azhartsa sedarchashka.
TIakkkha tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, so tsomgush vu".
U'sh dIabirzira tsunakh, buk' berzina.
Iza tIevirzira tseran delashna, tso elira: "Ash tsa iuu?
Shuna khIun khilla, dist tsa khu'lu shu?"
Iza tIevirzira tsarna, tukhush a'ttu ku'igatsa.
U'sh du'kh'alkkhiitira tsunna bevda beana.
Tso elira: "Ash Iibadat do tk'a sha'sh tostush iinacharna?"
Dela ma vu shu kkho'llinarg a, ash desh derg a /kkho'llinarg a/".
Tsara elira: "E tsunna gIishlo, chu kkhossa iza egachu tsIarga!"
Tsarna liira tsu'ntsa mekarlo ian, Okha khiliitira u'sh kIelbisincharakh.
Tso (IbrakhIima) elira: "Bakk'alla a, so vo'du san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe. Tso nisviir vu so.
San Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, suna dikacharakh /do'zalkho/ lolakh'".
Okha tsunna kkha' ba'kkkhira tIekh sobare kIantatsa.

Iza tsu'ntsa (IbrakhIimtsa) sikha lelaluchu kh'ole kkha'chcha, tso (IbrakhIimo) elira: "KhIai san kIa'tig, bakk'alla a, suna go gIenakh as kh'una /gIurbanna/ urs kh'okkhush, kh'azhal, kh'una khIun kheta". Tso elira: "Dada, kh'aiga omra desh derg de, kh'una so karor vu, Dala muk'alakh', sobar decharakh".
I shi' /Dalla/ mu't1akh' khilcha, tso (IbrakhIima) iza kh'azh tIe villicha,
Okha tsu'nga kkhiikkhira: "KhIai IbrakhIim!
Bak'khiliiti akh' gIan". Bakk'alla a, Okha ishtta bekkham bo dikacharna.
Bakk'alla a, khIara -iza du-kkh bilgala dolu zer.
Okha tekkhira tsunakh siilakh'-deza gIurba.
Okha ditira tsu'nan /tsIe iakkkhar a, i khastvar a/ tIa'kh'abogIucha'rgakh'.
Salam-marshalla du IbrakhIimna.
Okha ishtta bekkham bo dikacharna.
Bakk'alla a, iza vu Tkhan mu'min leshekh.
Okha kkha' ba'kkkhira tsunna Iskh'ak'atsa, -dikacharakh paikhamartsa.
Okha dek'alvira iza a, Iskh'ak' a. Tsu shinnan zu'rretakh dikanig a vu, sha shena bilgala zulamkho a vu.
Musakh a, KhIarunakh a binera Okha /bokkkha/ k'inkhetam.
KIelkh'arva'kkkhira Okha i shi' a, tsu shinnan k'am a bokkkhachu balanakh.
Tsarna gIo dira Okha -u'sh khilira to'llarsh.
Okha delira tsu shinga bilgala dolu zhaina.
Okha nisvira i shi' niisachu novk'a.
Okha ditira tsu shinnan /khaza tsIe iakkkhar/ tIa'kh'abogIucha'rgakh'.
Salam-marshalla du Musaga a, KhIarune a.
Bakk'alla a, Okha ishtta bekkham bo dikacharna.
Bakk'alla a, i shi' Tkhan mu'min leshekh vu.
Bakk'alla a, Il'ias a ma vu bakhkiitincharakh.
Tso ma elira shen k'ome: "Shu /Delakh/ tsa kkho'ru?
Ash kkhoikkhu tk'a BaIlaga, uggar dika kkhollarkho a vu'tii?
AllakhI -shun Dela a, shun kh'alkhalera dain Dela a vu'tii?"
T1akkkha tsara iza khartsvira - bakk'alla a, u'sh kh'alkhakh1ottor ma bu /zho'zhakhatina, 1azapana/.
Delan sov tsIena lesh botsursh.
Okha ditira tsunna /khaza tsIe iakkkhar, nakha khastavar/ tIa'kh'abogIucha'rgakh'.
Salam-marshalla du Il-iasuna.
Bakk'alla a, Okha ishtta bekkham bo dikacharna.
Bakk'alla a, i Tkhan mu'min leshekh vu.
Bakk'alla a, LutI a vu bakhkiitincharakh.
Okha kIelkh'arva'kkkhira iza a, tsu'nan berrig do'zal a.
/1azapekh'/ bisincharna iukk'ekh' khilla iolu /Lut1an zudarekh/ tskh'a iokkkha stagiotsurg.
TIakkkha Okha bokhiira bisnarsh.
Bakk'alla a, shu lelash ma dui tsarna iukhkhekhula Iu'irana a,
Bu'isana a. Shu kh'ek'ale tsa khu'lu?
Bakk'alla a, Iunus a vu bakhkiitincharakh (elchanekh).
Vedara iza du'zzinchu kemana tIe.
Tso kkhazh tesira /tsartsa/ -iza eshnacharakh khilira.
I kkhellira chIero i bekhke a volush.
Bakk'alla a, iza tsa khillekh'ara tasbakh' decharakh
Vu'sara ma vara tsu'nan kiirakh' u'sh iukhadendechu /k'emat/diine kkhachchalts.
Kkho'ssira Okha iza ara (ia'ssachu mettige), tsomgush a volush.
Okha daliitira tsunna tu'ten (gIabakkhan) ditt.
Okha vakhiitira iza bIe ezarna (dukkkha nakhana tIe) ia sovbolcha'rga.
Tsara iiman dillira -Okha tskh'a khan tIekkhachchalts bakham belira tsarna.
Akh' khattal tsa'rga: "Tk'a kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna mekhkarii bu, tk'a tsarna kIentii bu.
Ia Okha kkho'llina malikash zudariin /zhinsakh / tsarna gush?"
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, shain eladitanakh du'itsush ma du i tsara
Dala ber dina /bokhush/ -bakk'alla a, u'sh khartslu'ish ma bu.
Mekhkarii kha'rzhina Tso kIentel, /bokhush/?
KhIun du shuna, mukha kh'ukam do ash?
Oila tsa io ash?
Ia shun bilgala bak'o iu?
Skh'alo shain zhaina, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'.
Tsarakhiliitira Tsu'nan a, zhiniin iuk'akh' gergarlo. Zhinashna khiira u'sh dIakhIottorbuila.
TsIena vu i Dela tsara dechu /kharts/ sibatakh.
Sov tsIena Delan lesh botsursh /zho'zhakhatina kh'alkha dIakhIottor bu/.
Bakk'alla a, asha a, ash /shena/ Iibadat decho a -
Ash pitne lotsur ma vats
Sha zho'zhakhatekh' vegar verg ben.
Tkhokh ma dats tskh'a a shena bilgala mettig iolush ben.
Bakk'alla a, tkho mogIarsh bina du (la'ttash 1ibadatekh' mog1arshtsa ).
Bakk'alla a, tkho tasbakh' desh du.
U'sh(Makkara kerstanash) khillekh' a olush:
"Tkho'gakh' kh'ekham khillekh'ara kh'alkhaleracha'rgara,
Tkho khir dara Delan sov tsIena lesh".
Kerstanalla dina tsara tsunna (K'ur'anna), tIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna.
Kh'alkhada'lla Tkhan doshTkhan bakhkiitinchuleshka.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh -u'sh bu shain gIo diir dersh.
Bakk'alla a, Tkhan eskar (mu'min nakh) -i du tolamkho.
D1averza tsarakhtskh'a khan iallalts.
Gaita tsa'rga /tsarna Iazap dussush/ -tIa'kh'a gur du tsarna /shain kerstanallin bekkham/.
Tk'a Tkhan Iazaptsa a sikh lo u'sh?
Iza (Iazap) do'ssicha, tseran kertashka (arenga) -ma von khilla-kkh shaina kkheram tesnacheran Iu'ire.
D1averza tsarakh tskh'a khan iallalts.
Gaita -tIa'kh'a gur du tsarna.
TsIena vu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg - siilallin Ela -tsara /Shena t1ekh'/ kkhulluchu /kharts/ sibatekh.
Salam-marshalla du elchanashna.
Khastam bu Dalla -Ialamiin Dena.
Sad. Shegakh' kh'ekham bolchu K'ur'anakh /dui bou As/:
KhIa', tsateshnarsh kurallina chokh' a, mostagIallinachokh' a bu-kkh.
Mel tIa'kh'e khIallakiina Okha tsaral kh'alkha, tsara kkhoikkhura /k'inkhetam bo'khush/-iatsara i /kIelkh'arbevlla/ bovdaran khan.
Tsetsbevlira u'sh shaiga shain iukk'era kkheramcha ve'cha. Tsateshachara elira: "KhIara tIekhkhartsvolu bozbuuncha vu.
Tso /dukkkha deliin metta/ tskh'a dela khiliitina? I tamashe khIuma du!"
Tsarakh kh'aldolu tobadIaiakhara /olush/: "D1ag1o, sobar a de shain delii tIekh'. Bakk'alla a, khIara du dezash dolu khIuma.
Tkhuna tsa khezna otsunakhtIa'kh'archu millatekh'. Iza sha'sh kkho'llina khIuma a ben dats".
"Tsu'nga bossina kh'ekham vaina iukk'era?". KhIa', u'sh shekonekh' bu-kkh San kh'ekhamakh. KhIa', tsara /khIintsa a/ tsa Ievshina San Iazap.
Tk'a tsa'rgakh' iu kh'an veza volchu, /paikhamarna niImat/ lush volchu Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun k'inkhetaman khaznash?
Ia tseran du stigalniin a, la'ttan a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' dolchun a pachchakh'alla? Kh'alaboliila u'sh /stigla/ gIirsashtsa.
/Paimarna du'kh'al vovshakhto'khnachu/ tobanekh tskh'a kIezzig bIo bu u'sh -bokhor bu kh'una iza.
Khartsbira /paikhamarsh/ tsaral kh'alkha Nukh'an k'omo a, Iadasha a, kh'ostamashdolchu FirIavno a.
Samudasha a, LutIan k'omo a, Aikatandaisha a -tsu /errig/ tobanasha.
Massara a khartsbira elchanash -bak'khilira San bekkham.
Kh1orsh kh'ovsur ma bats tskh'ana mokh'e ben -tsunna khan iakh'iar khir dats. (I mokh' tokhar tIa'kh'atottur dats.)
Tsara (Makkan okh1lano tsa beshash) elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, sikhde tkhuna tkhan dak'akh'esapan dedale".
Satokha /akh', khIai Mukh'ammad/ tsara du'itsuchunna, dagavaita Tkhan lai Davud, shegakh' nitsk' khilla volu. Bakk'alla a, iza /Dalla/ tIevo'rzush verg vara.
Okha mu'tIakh' dira /Davudana/ la'mnash -tsu'ntsa tskh'ana tasbakh' desh su'irantsa a, /malkh/ dIakkhetartsa a.
Olkhazarsh a, guldesh /tobanashkakh'/ -masso a Tsunna tIedo'rzu /mu'tIakh' khilartsa, tasbakh' dartsa/.
Okha chIagIdira tsu'nan pachchakh'alla, delira tsunna kh'ek'alalla a, dov k'aston khaar a.
Kh'o'ga de'nii dovkhoin khabar? U'sh mikh'rabekh'ala ma bevlira.

U'sh Davud volchu cho'kh'a bevlira, iza tsarakh kkheravelira. Tsara elira: "Ma kkhera. Shi dovkho vu /tkho/. Tkhan tskh'abersh vukkharna chugIirtina. Kkhiel e tkhuna iukk'ekh' niisontsa, khartso ma elakh', nisde tkho nischu novk'a.
KhIara san vasha vu, tsu'nan deztk'e tk'aesna u'stagI bu, san tskh'a u'stagI bu. Tso a'lla: "Suna kkhacho e tsu'ntsa". Iza sol to'lira dovekh'".

Tso (Davuda) elira: "Kh'una zulam dina tso kh'an u'stagI bekhartsa shen u'stagIii tIe. Bakk'alla a, tskh'ana gIullakkh decharakh dukkhachara vovshashna gamo io, iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh esh bersh a botsuchara -ma kIezzig bu u'sh!" Davudana khiira Okha sha pitne la'tsna khilar. TIakkkha shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga gechdar diikhira tso, goravo'zhira iza, /Dalla/ tIevirzira iza.
Okha tsunna iz gechdira. Bakk'alla a, tsunna Tkho'gakh' gergarlo a iu, khaza tIetovzhiila a iu.

KhIai Davud! Okha khiliitina kh'okh la'ttakh' khalip. Kkhiel e nakhana iukk'ekh' niisontsa, tIa'kh'a ma khIotta dezarshna -tsara tilor vu kh'o Delan nek'akh. Bakk'alla a, Delan nek'akh tilalush bersh -tsarna chIogIa Iazap du tsara kh'esapan de ditsdarna.
Okha erna tsa kkho'llina stigal a, latta a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel derg a. Iza tsateshacharna mottar du. Bala bu tsateshacharna /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIergara.
