Ia Okha khu'lu'itu iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a la'ttakh' bo'khalelacharakh tera? Ia Okha khu'lu'itu /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh k'inosh decharakh tera? /Kh1an-kh1a, khu'lu'itur bats/
Zhaina du /khIara/, Okha sha kh'o'ga dossiina, berkate dolush, tsa'rga tsu'nan aiatekh oilaiaita, kh'ek'al dolcharna dagadaita.
Okha velira Davudna Suleiman -dika lai. Bakk'alla a, iza /Dalla tIe/ t1evo'rzush verg vu /1ibadat darekh'/.
Tsunna (Suleimana) gaitira su'irantsa barg tukhu /kkha koga tIekh' khIottalush/ govrash.
Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, suna dukkhadiza niImatsan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg kh'ekhoral kirkh'atsa /malkh/ dIakh'ulballalts.
Skh'aialael u'sh suna tIe!" Volavelira iza /urs/ kh'ekkhanostarekh a, logekh a.
Okha pitne letsira Suleiman, tsu'nan gIanta tIe tskh'a degIdillira Okha, tIakkkha iza /toba dartsa Tkhuna/ tIe virzira.
Tso elira: "/Vezan/ Dela, gechdekh' suna, lo suna pachchakh'alla, sol tIa'kh'a tskh'anna khir dotschu taipana. Bakk'alla a, kh'o vu-kkh t1ett1a lushverg".
Okha mu'tIakh' bira tsunna mokh, baia lelash tsu'nan omratsa tsunna luuchu,
ShaitIanash a - masso a gIishloiarkho a, khIorda bukhau'idurg a (marzhanash lo'khush),
Vu'ish a, dikhkina dolu burzholashkakh'.
/Okha elira tsu'nga/: "KhIara -Tkhan sovgIat du.D1alo /kh'an sovg1atakh ritsk' kh'an dolakh' bolcharakh kh'aina luuchunna/ ia /tsa lush/ satsade /kh'aina luuchunna/, tskh'a a kh'esap a dotsush."
Bakk'alla a, tsunna Tkho'gakh' gergarlo a iu, dika tIetovzhiila a iu.
Dagavaita Tkhan lai Aiub, tso kkhiikkhira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga: "Bakk'alla a, so skh'ala'tsna shaitIano khalontsa a, Iazapatsa a".
/Elira tsu'nga/: "Tokha kh'an kogatsa! KhIara -shiila liichar a du, malar a du".
Okha d1abelira tsunna shen do'zal a, kkhin tsaral a tsa'rtsa tskh'ana Tkho'gara k'inkhetam a khilla, kh'ek'al dolcharna kh'ekham a khilla.
/Okha elira tsu'nga/: "Skh'aetsa kh'an ku'iga tsIov, tsu'ntsa tokha, kh'an dui k'era ma khiliita!" Bakk'alla a, Tkhuna iza kariira sobare. Dika lai vu. Bakk'alla a, iza /Dalla tIe/ vo'rzush verg vu.
Dagabaita Tkhan lesh IbrakhIim, Iskh'ak', IaIk'ub, shaigakh' nitsk' khilla bolu /Dalla Iibadat darekh'/, tidamalla a khilla bolu /din kkhochushdarekh'/.
Okha tsIanbirau'sh tsIenchu Ialashonna -/ekhartan/ tsIa dagadaitan.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh Tkhan gergakh' kha'rzhincharakh, dikacharakh bu.
Dagabaita (kh'akhabe)IsmaIil a, Al'iasaI a, Zul'-Kifl a -berrige a dikacharakh bu.
KhIara kh'ekham bu. Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna dika tIevo'rziila iu.
Iadnanboshmash iu tsarna, /shain/ neIarsh dIaellina iolu.
Tevzhina la'ttash /khir bu u'sh/ tsigakh', tsara skh'abo'khush(tsarna t1ekkho'kh'ush) tsu chokh' dukkkha sto'mash a, malar a /khir du/.
Tsarna bu bIa'rgash gattabolu, tskh'ana khennara bolu /mekhkarii/.
KhIara du-kkh shuna/du'nenakh' dolush/ khir du a'llarg kh'esapan denna.
Bakk'alla a, khIara Tkhan ritsk' du, tsunna kkhachadalar dats.
KhIara! Bakk'alla a, /Delan/ dozanakh bevlincharna von tIevo'rziila iu-kkh!
Zho'zhakhati -tsu chokh' begar bu u'sh -ma von /dIavu'zhu/ mott bu-kkh /iza/.
KhIara /Iazap/ Iovshiila tsara, i du lelina khi a, notIk'a a.
Kkhin a, tsu'nan kepara, taip-taipana /Iazapash khir du tsarna/.
KhIara tolgIeiu shu'tsa tskh'ana /zho'zhakhatina/ chu io'dush. "Marsha dogIiila" dats tsarna. Bakk'alla a, u'sh tsIargakh' begar bu-kkh (ba'gga chekkh tsa bovlush).
Tsara elira: "KhIa', shuna "marsha dogIiila" dats-kkh. Ash kh'alkhada'kkkhina tkhuna khIara. Ma von chIagIo iu-kkh!"
Tsara elira: "Vezan Dela, khIara tkhuna kh'alkhada'kkkhinchunna tIetokhalakh' Iazap shozza tsIargakh'".
Tsaraelira: "Vaina khIun khilla tsa gan bozharii, vai sha'sh vocharakh lorush khilla bolu /du'nenakh'/?
Vai tsa deshash dara tsarakh, ia /vain/ bIa'rg tsarakh dIatili?"
Bakk'alla a, iza kh'ak'-bak' du -zho'zhakhatin daisha vovshashtsa k'iisar.
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, so kkheramchavu. Ma vats tskh'a a dela Sha vekk'a Tskh'a' volu, t1ekh nu'tsk'ala volu AllakhI ben.
Sha stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' dolchun Da volu, Sha veza volu, t1ekh gechdesh volu".
Akh' ala: "Iza -siilakh' dokkkha khabar du.
Shu tsunakh dIado'rzush du.
Suna tsa khili lakkkharchu elikh (Dalla gergakh' dolu malikekh) la'tsna khaar, u'sh k'u'isush bolush./Adaman kh'ok'ekh'/.
Suna vekh'etsa khaiitina so bilgala kkheramcha vuila".
Dagadaiita! Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho a'llera malikashka: "Bakk'alla a, So kkholla vollu adam popparkh.
As iza nisvicha, tsu chu San sikh sa a dillicha,tsunna /sii desh/ suzhdane gIolash".
Suzhud dira malikasha massara a
/Tskh'a/Iblis iuk'aradolush-tso kuralla iira, i khilira kerstanekh.
Tso (Dala) elira: "KhIai iblis, steno du'kh'alo iina kh'una suzhud dan As kkho'llinchunna San ku'igashtsa? Kurada'lla kh'o, ia kh'o khilla kh'aladala gIertacharakh".
Tso elira: "So tsul (Adamal) dika du. So kkho'llina Akh' tsIarakh, i kkho'llina Akh' topparkh".
Tso (Dala) elira: "Aradala tsu /ialsamane/ chu'ra. Bakk'alla a, kh'o neIalt a'lla /masso a dikanakh/ khadiinarg du.
Bakk'alla a, kh'una San neIalt du bekkhaman de dalts".
Tso (ibliso) elira: "Vezan Dela, khan iakh'ekh' san u'sh (adamash) iukhadenben de t1ekkhachchalts". ("K'ematde dalts tsa dolu'itush ditakh' so")
Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, khan iakh'iinacharakh du-kkh kh'o!
Bilglchu khenan de t1ekkhachchalts". ("K'ematde dalts liir dats kh'o)."
Tso elira: "Kh'an vozallakh dui bou as: as tilanne a tilor ma bu u'sh berrige a,
Tsarakh Kh'an sov tsIena lesh botsursh".
Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, kh'ak'-bak' As olu:
Iuzanne a As iuzor ma iu zho'zhakhati kh'okh a, kh'unatIa'kh'a mel khIo'ttinchukh a - tsarakh massarakh a".
Akh' ala: "As tsu tIekh' tskh'a a makh tsa bo'khu, so saina tIedillincharakh a vats".
Iza (K'ur'an)bekk'a Ialamashna kh'ekham bu.
Shuna khaanne a khuur du otsunan khabar tskh'a khan ia'lcha.
Zhaina dossor /du khIara/ Sha veza volchu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh volchu Delera.
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossina kh'o'ga zhaina bak'dolchu'ntsa: Dalla Iibadat de, Tsunna dog ts1ena khu'lush /dechu/1ibadatekh'.

Tk'a Delan dats tsIena din?Iza votsurg gIo'nchiila'tsnarsh, /olush/: okha tsarna Iibadat tsa do tsara tkho Dalla gergadakhiita a ben ma torru gergakhilartsa -bakk'alla a, Dala kh'ukam diir du tsarna iukk'ekh' tseran khilpalo iolchokh'. Bakk'alla a, Dala nis tsa vo sha khartsverg a, t1ekh sov kersta khillarg a.
Dalla li'nekh'ara Shena do'zalkho latsa, Tso kha'rzhina khir ma vara Sha kkho'llinchukh Shena luurg. Vonakh tsIena vu Iza. Iza AllakhI vu, Sha tskh'a' volu, tIekh sov nu'tsk'ala volu.

Tso kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta bak'dolchu'ntsa. Tso kh'avzaio bu'isa diine, de kh'ovzado bu'isane, mu'tIakh' bina malkh a, butt a-masso a dIalelash bu shen khan tIekkhachchalts. Tk'a Iza vats veza verg a, tIekh sov gechdesh verg a?

Tso shu kkho'llina tskh'ana sinakh (Adamakh), tIakkkha Tso iina tsunakhtsu'nan zuda (Kh'ava), Tso dossina shuna da'khnekh borkhI-borsha a, ste a. Shu kkhullu Tso shun nanoin kiirakh' tskh'ana kkhollartsa /kkhechu/ kkhollaral tIa'kh'a kkha /khIumanan/ bodanekh'. Iza vu AllakhI -shun Ela, Tsu'nan du pachchakh'alla. /Kkhin/ dela vats Iza votsurg -ma dIatilosh du shu /Tsunakh/.

Ash kerstadakh' -bakk'alla a, Dela shukh tsIenavu. Iza reza vats Shen leshna /tsara Shen din/ kerstadarna. Ash shukurdakh' -otsu'ntsa reza vu Iza shuna. D1akh'ur bats d1akh'ocho kkhechun mokh'. TIakkkha shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe shun dIaderzar du. Tso du'itsur du shu'ga ash desh khillarg. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu degnashkakh' derg khuush verg.

Adam tskh'ana bokhamo skh'ala'tscha, -shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhoikkhu tso, Tsunna tIe vo'rzii /toba dartsa/. TIakkkha Tso Sha pargIatva'kkkhicha Shegara niImatatsa, -ditsdo tso sha Tsu'nga kkhoikkhush khillarg kh'alkha, Dalla niisarkhoi a bo tso Tsu'nan nek'akh /nakh/ tilorkh'ama. Akh' ala: "Bakham be kh'an kerstanallitsa tskh'a kIezzig. Bakk'alla a, kh'o vu tsIeran daikh".

Sha Dalla gIullakkh desh verg bu'isanan sakh'tashkakh', suzhud desh, /lamazash desh/ khIo'ttina verg ekhartakh kkho'rush, shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun k'inkhetame dog dokhush /vui i tera Dalla Iesalla echukh/? Akh' ala: "Tskh'a terra bui khuush bersh a, tsa khuush bersh a?" Bakk'alla a, oila iiir iu kh'ek'al dolchara.

Akh' ala: "KhIai san iiman dillina bolu lesh! Shu kkhera shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh. Dikanig dinchunna khIokkhu du'nenakh' -dikanig du. Delan latta shortta du. Sobar dinacharna shain ial lur ma iu tskh'a a kh'esap dotsush".
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, suna omra dina as Dalla Iibadat dan, Tsunna dog ts1ena khu'lush /dechu/ 1ibadatekh'.
Suna omra dina so tskh'algIa busalbakhila".
Akh' ala: "Bak'alla a, so kkho'ru, as san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna Iesalla iicha, deza-dokkkhachu /k'emat/ diinan Iazapakh".
Akh' ala: "Dalla Iibadat do as, Tsunna dog ts1ena khu'lush san 1ibadatekh'.
Ash Iibadat de shaina ma luu Iza votsuchunna". Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, eshallekh' bisinarsh bu sha'sh a, shain do'zal a bainarsh k'ematdiinakh'". Iza bats tk'a bilgal esham?
Tsarna shain tIekhula a tsIeran gIatt khir iu, shain bukhakhula a gIatt iu. Ishtta tsu'ntsa kkherabo Dala Shen lesh: khIai San lesh! Sokh kkheralash.
TIagIutgenada'kkkhinarsh shena Iibadat darkh, Dalla tIe birzinarsh -tsarna kkha' bu -akh' kkha' bakkkha San leshna.
/U'sh/ dashe ladu'igIush bersh bu, tIakkkha tsu'nan uggar dikachunna tIekh'aba'zash -u'sh bu Dala sha'sh nisbinarsh. I bokhkursh -u'sh bu kh'ek'aldersh!
Tk'a Shena tIekh' Iazapan dosh /zho'zhakhate gIur vu a'lla/ bak'khillarg -/nislo dika Iamal echu'ntsa/? Akh' kIelkh'arvokkkhur vui tsIargakh'verg?

Delakh' a, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkhiirinarsh -tsarna khIusamashkhir iu, shain tIekhula a dina da'lla tsIenosh dolush, shain bukhakhula khish a lelash -Delan vaIda iu /iza/. Dala tsa iokhaio /Shen/ vaIda.

Kh'una tsa go: Dala dossina stiglara khi, t1akkkha dokhu'itu i la'ttakh' dolchu kh'ostashchu, tIakkkha tsu'ntsa ialta skh'adokkkhu Tso taip-taipana besnashdolush, tIakkkha dak'adolu'itu Tso -kh'una i go mazhdella, tIakkkha Tso tsarakh /a'tta, iokhiina/ kiisakash khu'lu'itu. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' kh'ekham bu kh'ek'aldolcharna.

Tk'a Dala shen dog islamanad1adellinarg, sha shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun nur tIekh' volush /dika vats shen dagna tIe mukhIar to'khnachul/? Bala bu shain degnash Dela kh'ekhorakh k'iza dolcharna. U'sh bilgalchu tilar chokh' bu-kkh!

Dala khabarkh uggar khaznig dossadina -shen kh'ukam a, kh'ekhamash a kerl - kerla bokhush, vovshashka tera bolush dolu zhaina, tsunakh shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkho'rucheran chIor dettalush, tIakkkha shen chIor a, degnash a Dela kh'ekhorna kIadlush. Iza bu Delan niisa nek', Tso nisvo tsu'ntsa Shena luurg. Dala tilavala vu'tush verg -tsu'nan vats /sha/ nisviirig.
Tk'a shen iu'kh'atsa k'ematdiinakh' Iazapan vonakh larvala gIirtinarg/vu tsu zho'zhakhatikh larinchukh tera/? A'lla /khir du/ zulamkhoshka: "Iovsha /khIintsa/ sha'sh /du'nenakh'/ karadesh khillarg!"
Tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a khartsbira /elchanash/ -Iazap deara tsarna shaina khaa tsa luchu'ra.
Dala Iavshiitira tsa'rga du'nenan dakharekh' siisazalla, tk'a ekhartan Iazap vuno a dokkkha du, u'sh khuush khillekh'.
Okha daliina nakhana khIokkkhu K'ur'anchokh' khIor /kh1umanakh/ masal, u'sh oila esh khir batsara-te?
Ia'rbiin /mattakh'/ K'ur'an /khiliitina/, tskh'a a gamo iotsush -u'sh kkho'rur batsara-te?

Valiina Dala masalna tskh'a stag, shegakh' nak'ostii k'u'isush bolu (dukkha nekhan dolakh' volu), /vazha/ stag a (vekk'a tskh'ana stegan dolakh' volu). I shi' tskh'aterra vui masaltsa? Khastam bu Dalla. KhIa', tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'o a liirvolush vu /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/, bakk'alla a, u'sh a liir bolush bu.
T1akkkha bakk'alla a, shu k'ematdiinakh' shain Dalla kh'alkhakh' k'u'isush khir du.
Mila vu tk'a zulame sha Dalla tIekh' khartslu'ish volchul, sha bak'derg, i shega de'nachul tIa'kh'a, khartsdesh volchu? Tk'a zho'zhakhatina chokh' iats Ian mettig kerstanashna? /Ma shortta iu!/
Sha bak'dolchu'ntsa ve'narg a /Mukh'ammad paikhamar/, iza bak'vesh bersh a /mu'min nakh/ -u'sh bu /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh.
Tsarna shaina luurg /khir/ iu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh'. I bu dikacheran bekkham.
Dala tsIanbarkh'ama uggar vochu sha'sh dinchukh (k'inakh), tsarna shain ial ialarkh'ama sha'sh desh khilalchukh uggar khazachu'ntsa.
Tk'a Dela vats kkhacho iolush Shen lena? Tsara kh'una kkheramash tu'isu Tsul lakharcha'rtsa. Milla velakh' a Dala tilavala vitinarg, -ma vats tsunna tskh'a a iza nisviirig.
Milla velakh' a Dala nisvesh verg -ma vats tskh'a a i tilavan. Tk'a Dela vats veza verg a, shegakh' bekkham berg a? /Vu!/

Akh' tsa'rga kha'tticha: "Kh'an kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a", a'lla, tsara alanne er ma du: "Dala". Akh' ala: "Goi shuna i ash, Dela a vitina shaiga kkhoikkhursh, Dalla suna tskh'a zen li'cha, tsara dIadokkkhur dolush dui i Tsu'nan zen, ia Tsunna li'cha suna k'inkhetam, tsara satsor bolush bui i Tsu'nan k'inkhetam?" Akh' ala: "Toam bu suna Dela, Tsunna tIe tovzhiila sha'sh t1etovzhush bersh".
Akh' ala: "San k'am, Iamal e shaina moguchu kepara, bakk'alla a, so a Iamal esh vu. TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna,
Kh'anna tIe dogIur du Iazap, tsu'nan sii a daiash, kh'anna tIe kh'a'rchar du la'ttash dolu Iazap."
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossiina kh'o'ga nakhana /desha, kh'ukam dan/ zhaina bak'dolchu'ntsa. Nisvellarg -shena /nisvella/, tilavellarg -iza a shena tilavella. Kh'o ma vats tsarna tIekh' vekal.

Dala skh'ao'tsu /nekhan/ sinosh u'sh lechu khenakh', tsadellarg -nabarkh. Tso skh'alotsu shena Iozhalla satsam khillarg, dIadokhu'itu vazha shen to'khnachu khanna. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du oila echu k'omana.
Tsara la'tsna, Dela a vitiina, shaina gIodokkkhursh? Akh' ala: "U'sh tskh'anna khIumanna doladesh tsa khilcha a, kh'ek'ale tsa khilcha a?"
Akh' ala: "Delan du gIodakkkharderrige a. Tsu'nan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. TIakkkha Tsunna tIe shu dIaderzor dolush du".
Vekk'a tskh'a AllakhI - Dela kh'ekhavicha, degnash tokhalo /i tsa dezash/ ekhartakh tsa teshash bolcheran. Iza votsursh kh'ekhabicha, -u'sh bakkkhiibeda (bakkkhiibo').

Akh' ala: "/Vezan/ Dela, /Kh'o vu-kkh/ stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llinarg, k'ailakha derg a, guchakh' derg a khuush verg a, Akh' kh'ukam diir du-kkh Kh'an leshna iukk'ekh', tsara khilpalo esh khillachokh'".

Zulam dinacharna la'ttakh' mel derg a, tsu'ntsa kkhin tsul khilcha a, -i d1alur ma dara tsara k'ematdiinakh' Iazapan vochun dukh'al (k1elkh'arbovlarkh'ama). Guchudelira tsarna Delera tsara kh'esap tsa desh khillarg.
Guchudelira tsarna bo'kha khIumanash sha'sh karadinchukh, kh'akkhadelira tsarakh u'sh shekh tsa beshash khillarg.

Adamo tskh'ana zeno sha skh'ala'tscha, Tkho'ga kkhoikkhu, tIakkkha Okha iza Tkhaigara niImate kh'ovzadicha, tso olu: "Bakk'alla a, iza-m dellera suna san khaarna (so suo bakh'anekh')". KhIa', iza (Dala tsunna dellarg) pitna (i zerkh'ama della) du, delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Iza elira tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a, kIelkh'ar tsa bekhira u'sh tsara karadesh khillacho.

Tsarakh kkhiira bo'kha khIumanash, tsara karadina khilla dolu. KhIokkharakh zulam dinarsh -tsarakh a kkhiar du sha'sh karadina dolu bo'kha khIumanash, tsara (i Delan Iazap) gIeldiir ma dats. (Tsunakh bovdur ma bats u'sh).
Tsarna tsa kha'a-te Dala ritsk' darzhadesh khilar Shena luuchunna /i zerkh'ama/, baram a besh /khilar Shena luuchunna i bale ozorna/. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh du-kkh teshash dolchu k'omana.

Akh' ala /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ shaina /dukkha k'inosh dartsa/ tIalamza khilla bolchu San leshka: "Ash dog ma dilla Delan k'inkhetamakh. Bakk'alla a, Dala gechdo k'inosh derrige a. Bakk'alla a, Iza tIekh gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a vu".
Shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe kh'ovza (toba dartsa), mu'tIakh' khila Tsunna shaiga Iazap dale kh'alkha, tIakkkha shuna gIo diir dats.
TIa'kh'akhIitta shaiga shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara dossinchukh uggar khazchunna shaina tsIekhkh'ana Iazap dale, shuna khaa tsa lush.
Sino alarkh /larlo/: "Bailakh' disi so Delan agIorkh'ara as ledarlo iarna, so khilira-kkh /Delan aiatekh/ tsadeshacharakh".
Ia tso alarkh: "Dala so nisdinekh', so a khir ma dara /Delakh/ kkho'rucharakh".
Ia tso alarkh, Iazap shena gicha: "Suna iukhadelakh'ara /du'nenan dakhar/, -so khir ma dara dikanig decharakh".
KhIa', deana kh'o'ga San aiatash, u'sh khartsdira akh', kh'o kuradelira, kh'o khilira tsateshacharakh.
K'ematdiinakh' kh'una gur bu Dalla tIekh' khartsliinarsh shain iakhkh'ash Iarzh'ella. Tk'a zho'zhakhatina chokh' iats Ian mettig kurabolcharna?/Iu dellara!/
Dala kIelkh'arbokhur bu /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillarsh /sha'sh lo'khu ialsamani shaina khu'lush/ shaina tolam khilartsa. Tsarakh kh'akkhalur dats bo'kha khIuma, u'sh singattame a khir bats.
Dela vu masso a khIumanan kkhollarkho. Iza masso a khIumanan vekal a vu.
Tsu'nan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dogIanash. Delan aiatekh tsateshnarsh -u'sh bu eshnarsh.
Akh' ala: "Dela votschunna omra do ash so'ga Iibadat de, olii, khIai, zhekhIal nakh?!"
Kh'o'ga vekh'etsa khaiitina, kh'ol kh'alkhalercha'rga a: "Akh' nak'ost latsakh' /Delatsa/, kh'an Iamal io'iur iu kh'una, kh'o eshnacharakh khir vu kh'una".
KhIa', Dalla Iibadat de akh', kh'o khila /Dalla/ shukur decharakh.

Makh tsa khadiira tsara Delan khado ma bezza, latta derrig Tsu'nan buinakh' khir du k'ematdiinakh', stiglanash a khir iu kh'archiina Tsu'nan a'ttu ku'igatsa. /Masso a kkhachambatsarekh/ tsIena vu Iza, lakkhaveli tsara /Shetsa/ nak'ost latsarkh.
Sur lekkhira -tentakva'lirastiglanashkakh' mel verg a, la'ttakh' mel verg a, Dalla li'narg votsurg. Iukha a lekkhira /sur/ kkhin tsk'a -u'sh /keshnashkara/ gIevtina bisira, kh'o'zhush.
K'egira latta shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun nuratsa, okh'adillira zhaina, skh'abalabira paikhamarsh a, teshash a, kkhiel iira tsarna iukk'ekh' bak'dolchu'ntsa, tsarna zulam diir dats.
DIadelira /mekhana/ khIora sina sha dinarg, Iza dika khuush vu tsara desh derg.

DIabigira tsateshnarsh zho'zhakhate tobanashtsa, u'sh tsiga be'cha dIaellaelira tsu'nan neIarsh, elira tsa'rga tsu'nan gIarolasha: "Tsa ba'khkira shu'ga elchanash shuna iukk'era, sha'sh shuna shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatash a do'shush, sha'sh shuna dIakh'edosh shun khIokkhu denna du'kh'alkkhetar?" Tsara elira: "KhIa', delakh' a, bak'khili kerstanashna Iazap khir du a'lla dosh".
Elira: "ChugIo zho'zhakhatina neIarshkakhula, la'ttash tsu chokh' guttarena a". Ma von iu-kkh kurabevllacheran chokh' Ien mettig.

DIabigira shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh kkho'rush khillarsh ialsamane tobanashtsa, u'sh tsiga be'cha dIaellaelira tsu'nan neIarsh, elira tsa'rga tsu'nan gIarolasha: "Salam-marshalla du shu'ga. Dek'ala khili shu. ChugIo tsunna guttarena a".

Tsara elira: "Khastam bu Dalla, Sha tkhuna bak'khiliitina Shen vaIda, Tso irsana delira tkhuna /ialsamanin/ latta, okh'akhovshur du tkho ialsamanekh' tkhaina luuchokh'". Iamal echeran ma khaza ial iu-kkh /iza/!
Kh'una gur du malikash kh'iizash Iarshana gonakhula, tasbakh' desh shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, I khastortsa. Kkhiel iina tsarna iukk'ekh' bak'dolchu'ntsa, elira: "Khastam bu Dalla -Ialamiin Dena".
Kh'a-mum.
Zhaina okh'adossor /du khIara/ Sha veza volchu, khuush volchu Delera,
Sha k'a gechdiirig volchu, sha toba k'obaldiirig volchu, bekkhamekh' chIogIa volchu, koma'rshalla Shegakh' iolchu. Vats /kkhin/ dela Iza votsurg, Tsu'nga du dIaderzar.
K'u'isur ma dats Delan aiatashkakh' sha'sh /Delakh/ tsateshnachara ben, kh'o Iekha ma voila tseran makhkakh' /kura/ dIaskh'aiidaro.

Khartsdira /Delan tsIen din/ tsaral kh'alkha Nukh'an k'omo a, tsaral tIa'kh'a tobanasha a. Oila esh dara khIor ummat shen elchanekh iza /bokham bartsa/ skh'alatsan. Tsara k'iisiira khartsdolchu'ntsa tsu'ntsa bak'derg daia gIertash -As skh'aletsira u'sh /khIallakbartsa/. Mukha khili San taIzar!
Ishtta bak'khilira kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun dosh tsateshnacharna tIekh', u'sh /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai bu, a'lla dolu.

Sha'sh Iarsh lelosh bersh a, tsunna gonakh' bersha tasbakh' desh bu khastambartsa shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna, teshash bu Tsu'nakh, gechdar do'khush bu iiman dillincharna: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, masso a khIumanna shorto iina Akh' k'inkhetamtsa a, Iilmantsa a, Akh' gechdelakh' toba dinacharna a, Kh'an nek'ana tIa'kh'akhIo'ttincharna a, u'sh larbelakh' zho'zhakhatin Iazapakh.

Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Iadnan/ialsamanin/ boshmash chu bokhkalakh' u'sh, Akh' tsarna vaIda iina iolchu, tseran daikh a, zudarekh a, zu'rretakh a dika Iamal mel iinarg a. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o vu-kkh veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Akh' larbelakh' u'sh vochukh (k'inosh bakh'anekh' dechu 1azapakh). Akh' sha vochukh larviinarg otsu diinakh' -Akh' k'inkhetam bina tsunakh. Iza bu-kkh siilakh'-bokkkha tolam".
Bakk'alla a, tsateshnacha'rga kkhoikkhur ma du: "Delan tsabezam melkho a bokkkha bu shun tsabezamal shaiga, shu kkhoikkhura iimane -ash kerstadora".
Tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Akh' daliitira tkho shozza, Akh' den a dira tkho shozza, tkho k'era khilla tkhan k'inoshna. Aradovla tskh'a a nek' bui?"
Iza (Iazap du shuna) vekk'a tskh'ana Dele kkhaikkhicha, ash i kerstadarna, Tsu'ntsa nak'ost lotsush khilcha, shu tesharna. Kh'ukam /khIintsa/ lekkha-vokkkha volchu Delan du.
Iza vu goitush shu'ga Shen aiatash, Tso okh'adossado shuna stiglara ritsk'. Oila tsa io-kkh sha /Dalla/ t1evo'rzush volcho a ben.
KkhaikkhaDele sha'sh Tsunna dog ts1ena khu'lush /dechu/ 1ibadatekh', i kerstanashna /mel/ tsa dezakh' a.
Darzhash kh'alaiokhurg /vu Iza/, /shegakh'/ Iarsh iolush, Sadokhu'itu Tso Shen lekh Shena luuchu'nga kkheram tasa vovshashtsa tskh'anakkhetar khindolchu dentsa.

Otsu diinakh' u'sh guchubovlur bu /arabovlur bu shain keshnashkara/. Kh'ullur dats Dalla tsarakh dolchukh khIumma a. Kh'enan du pachchakh'alla takhana? Sha tskh'a' volchu, tIekh nu'tsk'ala volchu Delan du-kkh!
Takhana bekkham biir bu khIor sinna sha /du'nenakh'/ karadinchu'ntsa. Zulam khir dats takhana. Bakk'alla a, Dela sikhanig vu kh'esap darekh'.

Kkheram tasa tsarna gergadogIur dolchu /k'emat/dentsa, /nekhan/ degnash k'amk'argashna tIe kkha'chcha /kkheradella dettalush/, sha'sh dokhkobevla /khir bolu/. Ma vats zulamkhoshna tskh'a a dottag1 a, tskh'a a g1odokkkhurg a, shena /u'sh/ mu'tIakh' a bolush.
Kha'a Tsunna bIa'rgiin teshnabekhk a /kh'aram khIumane kh'o'zhush/, degnasha kh'uldiirig a.
Dala kkhiel io bak'dolchu'ntsa. Iza a vitina, tsara shaiga kkhoikkhush bolchara kkhiel tsa io tskh'anna khIumantsa. Bakk'alla a, Dela -Iza vu khozush verg a, gush verg a.

U'sh tsa lela la'ttakhula, tIakkkha u'sh tsa kh'o'zhu, mukha khilla tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran tIa'kh'e? U'sh bara tsaral vuno chIogIa nitsk'atsa a, la'ttakh' asar ditartsa a. Dala skh'aletsira u'sh shain k'inosh bakh'anekh', ma tsa khilira tsarna Delan du'kh'al tskh'a a lardarkho.
Iza /khilla/ tsa'rga bogIush khilarna shain elchanash bilgalonashtsa -tsara u'sh khartsbora. Dala skh'aletsira u'sh. Bakk'alla a, Iza nu'tsk'ala verg a vu, bekkhamtsa chIogIanig a vu.
Okha vakhiitira Musa Tkhan aiatashtsa a, bilgalchu bak'ontsa a
FirIavne a, KhIamane a, K'arune a. Tsara elira: "/Iza/ tIekh khartslu'ish volu bozbuuncha vu".
Iza tsa'rga ve'cha Tkho'gara bak'dolchu'ntsa, tsara elira: "Baia tsu'ntsa tskh'ana iiman dillincheran kIentii, diina bita tseran zudarii". Kerstaniin mekarlo tilar chokh' ben ma iats.
FirIavno elira: "Vita so Musa ven. Shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhoikkhur tso. Bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru tso shun din khiitsadan, ia la'ttakh' bo'khanig guchudakkkhiitan".
Musas elira: "Bakk'alla a, so larvella san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa a, shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa a masso a kh'esapan /k'emat/ diinakh tsa teshash kurava'llachukh ".

FirIavnan do'zalakh tskh'ana iiman dillinchu i shegakh' kh'uldesh volchu staga elira: "Ash vo' tk'a stag tso alarna "san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg tskh'a AllakhI-Dela vu?" Tk'a iza shu'ga shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bilgalonashtsa ma veana. Iza khartslu'ish velakh', tsunna shena iu-kkh i khartso. I bak'lu'ish velakh', tso shuna khir du bokhuchukh tskh'aderg kh'akkhalur (kkhetar) ma du shukh. Bakk'alla a, Dala nis tsa vo sha tIalamza verg a, tIekh khartsverg a.

KhIai san k'am, shuna du pachchakh'alla takhana, shu /Misran/ la'ttakh' /massaral/ to'lush dolush. Kh'an gIo diir du vaina Delan nitsk'akh /kIelkh'aradovla/ i vaiga be'cha?" FirIavno elira: "As shu'ga tsa goitu saina gushderg a ben, as shu nis tsa do niisonan novk'a ben".
Iiman dillincho elira: "San k'am, bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru shuna tobaniin desannachu diinakh.
Nukh'an k'oman a, Iadiin a, Samudiin a, tsaral tIa'kh'a khillacheran Iadatakh tera /du-kkh khIara ash lelorig/. Dela ma vats zulam luush Shen leshna.
KhIai san k'am, bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru shuna vovshashka kkhaikkharan diinakh.
Shu dukhadovdu dolchu diinakh -ma vats shuna Delera tskh'a a gIo'ncha. Dala tilavala vitinarg -ma vats tsunna tskh'a a nisviirig".

Shu'ga veara kh'alkha Iusuf bilgalonashtsa shu la'ttash du shekonekh' iza shu'ga shetsa veanchukh. Iza khIallakkhilcha (velcha), ash elira: "Vaiitanne a vou'itur ma vats Dala tsul tIa'kh'a elcha". Ishtta tilavala vu'tu Dala sha tIalamza verg a, shekonekh' verg a,

Sha'sh Delan aiatashkakh' k'u'isush bolu shaiga eana bak'o a iotsush. Bokkkha khili /tsa'rga bolu/ tsabezam Dalla gergakh' a, iiman dillincheran gergakh' a. Ishtta mu'khIar tukhu Dala kh1or kurada'llachu, /nakhana/ nitsk'bechu dagna tIe.
FirIavno elira: "KhIai KhIaman! IugIa suna gIala, so kkhia tarlo nek'ashka.

Stiglaniin nek'ashka. Musan Dalla tIekkhochur vu so. Bakk'alla a, suna kheta i (Musa) kharts vu a'lla". Ishtta khazdina FirIavnana tsu'nan balkhan vonig, dIakh'ovzina iza /nischu/ nek'akh. FirIavnan mekarlo ma iats khIallakkhilar chokh' ben.
/TIakkkha/ elira /Fir1avnan k'oman iukk'era/ iiman dillincho: "KhIai san k'am, suna tIa'kh'akhIitta,- as nisdiir du shu niisonan novk'a.
KhIai san k'am! Bakk'alla a, khIara du'nenan dakhar /kIezzig/ zovkkh kh'egar du, tk'a ekhart -iza du chIagIonan tsIa.

Vonig dinarg -tsunna bekkham khir bats i sannachu'ntsa a ben. Dikanig dinarg, stag velakh' a, zuda elakh' a, sha mu'min a volush -u'sh ialsamani chu gIur bu, tsarna ritsk' lur du tsu chokh', kh'esap a dotsush.
KhIai san k'am! Kh1un du suna shu kkhaikkha /zho'zhakhatikh/ kIelkh'ardovlare, ash so kkhaikkha /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIarga?
Ash so kkhoikkhu as Dalla kerstanalla dare, as Tsu'ntsa nak'ost latsare suna shetsa tskh'a a Iilma dotsurg, tk'a as shu kkhoikkhu Sha veza a, tIekh gechdiirig volchu'nga.
Dera asha-m kkhoikkhu so shena du'nenakh' a, ekhartakh' a tskh'a a kkhaikkhar dotsuchu'nga, tk'a vain dIaderzar Dele ma du, amma tIalamza bersh -u'sh ma bu /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai.
Shuna tIa'kh'a dagadogIur du as shu'ga du'itsurg. As san gIullakkh Dele dIalo. Bakk'alla a, Dela vu-kkh /Shen/ lesh (khalk') gush verg."
Dala lariira iza tsara iinchu mekarlonan vonakh. Kh'akkhadelira FirIavnan do'zalakh Iazapan vonig.
TsIe -tsunna tIe u'sh kkhu'ssur bu Iu'irana a, su'irana a, sakh't khIuttuchu diinakh' /kkhaikkhar khir du tsa'rga/: "Chu bokhka FirIavnan do'zal uggar chIogIachu Iazapna".

Dagadaiita! Vovshashtsa k'iisame ba'r bu u'sh tsIargakh', gIiilacharaer du kurabevla khillacha'rga: "Bakk'alla a, tkho dara shuna tIa'kh'akhIittiina /du'nenakh' ash bokhurg desh, khIintsa/ ash dIadokkkhii tkhokh tsIeran /Iazapakh/ tskh'a dak'a?"
Sha'sh kurabevla khillachara elira: "Bakk'alla a, vai derrige a tsu chokh'/tsIargakh'/ du-kkh. Bakk'alla a, Dala kh'ukam dina leshna iukk'ekh'".
Er du tsIargakh' bolchara zho'zhakhatin gIarolashka: "Kkhaikkha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga, daide ala tkhuna tIera Iazap tskh'ana denna muk'ane a".

Tsara (zho'zhakhatin gIarolasha) er du: "Shu'ga bokhkush tsa khilira shun elchanash bilgalonashtsa?" Tsara elira: "KhIa'". Elira /gIarolasha/: "Kkhaikkha sha'sh!" Kerstaniin kkhaikkhar ma dats tilar chokh' ben.
Bakk'alla a, Okha gIo diir du Tkhan elchanashna a, iiman dillincharna du'nenan dakharekh' a, teshash khIuttuchu /k'emat/ diinakh' a.
Otsu diinakh' zulamkhoshna paida biir bats tseran bekhkazlonasha. Tsarna neIalt du, tsarna /ekhartan/ tsIiinan bo'khanig du.
Okha belira Musaga niisa nek', irsana ditira Israilan kIentashna zhaina.
Niisa nek' a, kh'ekham a /khilla dolu/ kh'ek'aldolcharna.
Sobar de, bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda -kh'ak'-bak' iu, gechdar dekha kh'an k'ina, tasbakh' de kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna khastam bartsa sarakh' a, Iu'iranna a.

Bakk'alla a, Delan aiatashkakh' shaiga eana tskh'a a bak'o iotsush k'u'isush bersh -bakk'alla a, tseran kiirakh' ma iats kuralla ben, u'sh shena tIe kkhu'ur iotsu (u'sh shain murade kkhochur botsu). Larvalar lakha Delatsa. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu khozush verg a, gush verg a.
Tk'a stiglanash a, latta a kkhollar melkho a dokkkha du nakh kkhollaral, delakh' a, dukkhakh bolchu nakhana tsa kha'a-kkh.
Tskh'a terra bats bIa'rsadotsurg a, gush verg a; iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a, vonig desh verg a. KIezzig du-kkh ash oila iiirig.
Bakk'alla a, sakh'tdogIur dolush du, sheko iats tsu chokh', delakh' a, dukkhakh bolu nakh teshash bats-kkh.
Shu Kkhetosh-kkhiocho a'lla: "So'ga kkhaikkha -As zhop lur du shuna".Bakk'alla a, sha'sh Suna Iibadat darakh kurabovlush bersh -chugIur ma bu zho'zhakhatina, kIelbisina."

Dela vu khiliitinarg shuna bu'isa shu'ga sadaIiita shena chokh', de a /shuna/ serlo lush /shain g1ullakkhash dan/. Bakk'alla a, Dela niImat dolush vu-kkh nakhana /dala/, delakh' a, dukkhakh bolchu nakha barkalla tsa olu-kkh.
I vu-kkh AllakhI-Dela, shun Kkhiosh-Kkhoburg, masso a khIumanan kkhollarkho. /Kkhin/ dela vats Iza votsurg. Ma Iekhosh du shu /genadokhush du bak'dolchukh/!
Ishtta Iekhora /genabokhura bak'dolchukh/ Delan aiatashna inkarlo esh khillarsh.

Dela vu dinarg shuna latta chIagIo khilla, stigal gIishlo khilla, shuna ku'tsash dinarg, t1akkkha khazdina Tso shun ku'tsash, tsIenchu khIumanekh ritsk' a della shuna. I vu AllakhI-Dela -shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg. Berkate khili Dela -Ialamiin Da.
Iza diinaverg vu, /kkhin/ dela vats Iza votsurg, kkhaikkha Tsu'nga, Tsunna dog ts1ena khu'lush /dechu/ 1ibadatekh'. Khastam bu Dalla -Ialamiin Dena.

Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, suna dikhkina Iibadat dan ash, Dela a vitina /shaiga/ kkhoikkhucha'rga san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngar so'ga bilgalonash e'nachul tIa'kh'a, suna omra dina Ialamiin Dena mu'tIakh' khilar".

Iza vu shu kkho'llinarg topparakh, tIakkkha tIadamakh, tIakkkha detinchu tsIikh, tIakkkha berash khu'lii aradokhu shu, tIakkkha shu tIekkhiarkh'ama shain nitsk'ina, tIakkkha shukh k'ena nakh khiliita. Shukh vu kh'alkha lesh verg a. /I kkhiel iina Dala/ shu to'khnachu khanna tIekkhacharkh'ama a, shu oila esh khiliitirkh'ama a.
Iza vu denvolu'iturg a, volu'iturg a. Shen /tskh'ana/ gIullakkh tIekh' satsam khilcha, Tso olu tsu'nga: "Khila!" -iza khu'lu.
Kh'una tsa go i Delan aiatashkakh' k'u'isush bersh. Ma d1akh'ovzosh bu u'sh /bak'dolchukh/!
/U'sh bu/ sha'sh khartsdinarsh zhaina a, Okha shetsa Tkhan elchanash bakhiitinarg a. TIa'kh'a khuur du-kkh tsarna!
Shaina lagekh burzholash-g1omatash a to'khcha, zIainash a /ekhkicha/, takkhor bu u'sh
Kkhakhkina khi chu, tIakkkha tsIargakh' bagor bu.
TIakkkha olur /du/ tsa'rga: "Michakh' du ash /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsush khillarg
AllakhI votsurg?" Tsara elira: "DIatili u'sh tkhokh. KhIa', tkho datsara kkhoikkhush kh'alkha khIumanne a". Ishtta tilabala bu'tu Dala kerstanash.
I (Iazap du shuna) la'ttakh' tskh'a a bak'o a iotsush shu dakkkhiidedash khilarna a, shu tIekh khazakhetash khilarna a.
Chu gIo zho'zhakhatina neIarshkakhula, guttarena tsu chokh' la'ttash. Ma von chokh' Ien mettig iu-kkh kurabevlacheran!
Sobar de, bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda kh'ak'-bak' iu. Okha gaitanne a goitur ma du kh'o'ga /khir du/a'llachekh tskh'adolu khIumanash ia Okha volu'itur vu kh'o -tIakkkha Tkhuna tIe dIaberzor bu u'sh.

Okha bakhiitinera elchanash kh'ol kh'alkha a, tsarakh Okha kh'una biitsinarsh a bu, tsarakh Okha kh'una biitsaza bersh a bu. Bak'kh'ara tsa khilla tskh'anna elchanna tskh'a a aiat dan Delan purbantsa ben. Delan omra de'cha -satsam khilira bak'dolchu'ntsa -kkhuzakh' iishira /din/ khartsdesh khillarsh.
Dela vu shuna bezhanash khiliitinarg: tsarakh /tskh'adersh/ shuna tIekhovzha, tsarakh /tskh'adersh/ -shuna daa.
Shuna tsa'rgakh' /kkhin/ paidanash a bu, ash tsarna tIekh' kkhochushdarkh'ama shain dagakh' dolu kh'asht, tsarna tIekh' a, kemanna tIekh' a shu dIalelado.
Tso goitu shuna Shen aiatash. Delan mu'lkhachu aiatana ash inkarlo io?

U'sh tsa lela la'ttakhula, tsa kh'ovsu-te, mukha khilla tsaral kh'alkha khillacheran tIa'kh'e? U'sh ma bara vuno tsaral dukkha nitsk'atsa a, la'ttakh' /du'tuchu/ asartsa a vuno chIogIa a -kIelkh'ar ma tsa bekhira u'sh tsara /du'nenakh'/ karadesh khillacho.
Tsa'rga ba'khkicha tseran elchanash bilgalonashtsa, bakkkhiibiidira u'sh shaigakh' dolchu /du'nenan/ Iilmantsa, tsarakh kh'akkhadelira tsara sha siisazadesh khillarg.
Shaina Tkhan nitsk' gicha, tsara elira: "Okha iiman dilli vekk'a tskh'ana Dele, Okha kerstadina tkhash Tsu'ntsa nak'ost lotsush khillarg".
Tsa khilira tsarna paidekh' tseran iiman Tkhan nitsk' be'nachul tIa'kh'a. Delan Iadat /du iza/, Tsu'nan leshkakh' sha chekkhda'lla dolu. Iishira kkhuzakh' kerstanash.
Kh'a-mum.
/Zhaina/ okh'adossar /du khIara/ Sha sov k'inkhetame a, k'inkhetame a volchu'ngara.
Zhaina /du khIara/, Shen aiatash k'astiina dolu, Ia'rbiin /mattakh'/ deshara khilla khuush dolchu k'omana.
Kkha' bakh'arg a, kkheramcha a /khilla du i K'ur'an/, tsarakh dukkhakhbersh dIabirzi - shaina tsa khozush (i k'obal tsa desh).

Tsara elira: "Tkhan degnash kh'ulamekh' du akh' tkho shega kkhoikkhuchukh, tkhan lergii chokh' k'oralla iu, tkhuna iukk'ekh' a, kh'una iukk'ekh' a kirkh'a du, kh'an Iamal e, okha tkhan Iamal iiir iu".

Akh' ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Bakk'alla a, so-m adam du shu sanna, so'ga vekh'etsa khaiitina shun Dela tskh'a Dela vuila, dIanislo Tsu'nga, Tsu'nga gechdar dekha. Bala bu-kkh /Delatsa/ nak'ost lotsucharna.
Sha'sh zakat tsa lush bolchu, ekhartana u'sh kersta bu.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a - tsarna khedar iotsu ial iu.
Akh' ala: "Ash inkarlo io Sha latta kkho'llinchunna shina diinakh', ash Tsunna niisarkhoi a khu'lu'itu? Iza vu Ialamiin Da".

Khiliitina Tso tsigakh' (la'ttakh') chIogIa bo'gInarsh (la'mnash) tsunna tIekhula, berkatedira Tso iza (latta), diik'ira tsu chokh' kkhachanash de'a diinakh'- tskh'aniissa /di' de khilla/ kho'ttucharna.
TIakkkha Iza tIevirzira stiglana - i kIur bara (aiella khin Ia'). Tso elira tsu'nga a, la'tte a: "Skh'adu'ila shain laamtsa, ia laamza". Tsu shimmo elira: "Tkho deana tkhan laamtsa".

Tso u'sh kkhochushkhiliitira vorkhI stigal khilla shina diinakh', dIakhaiitira /vekh'etsa/ khIor stigalna shen gIullakkh. Okha khaziira gergara stigal chirkkhashtsa, /lariira iza shaitIanakh/ Ialash iartsa. Iza bu veza volchun, khuush volchun (Delan) dIakhIottam.
U'sh dIaberzakh', akh' ala: "As kkheram tesi shuna tk'esatsa, Iadiin a, Samudiin a tk'esakh tera".

Dagadaiita! Tsa'rga ba'khkira elchanash, tsarna kh'alkhakhula a, tIekh'akhula a: "Ash Dalla ben Iibadat ma de", /olush/. Tsara elira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun li'nekh'ara, Tso malikash dossor dara. Bakk'alla a, tkho shu shetsa daiitinchunna kersta du-kkh".

Tk'a Iadash kurabevlira la'ttakh' tskh'a a bak'o iotsush, tsara elira: "Mila vu tkhol chIogIa verg nitsk'atsa?" Tsarna tsa gina-te u'sh kkho'llina volu Dela tsaral chIogIa vuila nitsk'atsa. U'sh khilira Tkhan aiatashna inkarlo esh.
Okha bakhiitira tsarna shok lo'kkhu mokh khalachu denoshkakh' tsa'rga Iovshiitarkh'ama siisazallin Iazap du'nenan dakharekh'. Ekhartan Iazap vuno a siisaza du. Tsarna gIo khir dats.

Tk'a Samudash - Okha bilgalba'kkkhira tsarna /dikanan a, vonan a/ nek' - tk'a tsarna bIa'rsazalla dukkhaiiizira niisachu nek'al. TIakkkha u'sh skh'aletsira tk'es tukhuchu siisazallin Iazapo tsara karadesh khillarg bakh'anekh'.
Okha kIelkh'arbekhira iiman dillinarsh, sha'sh /Delakh/ kkho'rush khillarsh.
Delan mostagIii tsIarna kh'alkha gulbechu diinakh' - u'sh mogIarshkakh' /vovshashna tIe/ lokhkur bu.
U'sh tsiga (tsIarga) ba'khkicha, teshalla diir du tsarna tIekh' tseran khazaro, bIa'rsano, chIorasha, u'sh khIun desh khilla, a'lla.

Tsara er shain chIorashka: "Ash khIunda teshalla dira tkhuna du'kh'al?" Tsara er: "Distkhiliitina tkho Dala, Sha masso a khIuma distkhu'lu'itush volchu, Tso shu kkho'llina tsk'a /shu dotsuchu khenakh'/, Tsunna tIe shu dIaderzosh a du".
Shu tsa khilira kh'uldan gIertash shaina tIekh' teshalla dan shun khazaro a, shun bIa'rsino a, shun chIorasha a, delakh' a, shuna mo'ttura Dalla tsa kha'a ash dechukh dukkhaderg.
Iza du shun mottar, shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh shuna mo'ttina dolu, tso (shun mottaro) khIallakdira shu, tIakkkha shu khilira eshnacharakh.
Tsara nagakh' satokhakh' - tsIe iu tsarna chokh' Ian mettig, tsara nagakh' /Dela/ reza khilar dekhakh' - u'sh khir bats /Iza/ shaina reza khillacharakh.

Okha khIottiira tsarna dottagIii /shaitIanekh a, zhinnekh a/, tsara khazdira tsarna shain kh'alkhakh'derg a, tIekh'akh'derg a, tsarakh kh'akkhadelira tsaral kh'alkhadakhanchu zhiniin a, adamiin a ummatashkakh' a'lla dolu dosh. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira eshnarsh.
Tsateshnachara elira: "La ma dogIa khIokkhu K'ur'ane, da'ssa khabar diitsa tsu'ngakh', shu tola mega".
Iovshanne a Iovshu'itur ma du Okha tsateshnacha'rga chIogIa Iazap, banne a bekkham biir ma bu Okha tsarna tsara desh khillachukh uggar vochu'ntsa.
I bu Delan mostagIiin bekkham - tsIe. Tsarna tsigakh' guttarenan khIusam iu - bekkham a khilla tsarna sha'sh Tkhan aiatashna inkarlo esh khilarna.

Tsateshnachara elira /zho'zhakhatekh'/: "KhIai tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, gaitakh' tkhuna zhinekh a, adamekh a tkho tilina i shi'- tkhan kogii kIel bu'tur bara okha - u'sh /shia/ khiliitaarkh'ama uggar bukhakh'bolcharakh".

Bakk'alla a, a'llarsh /shain sa dolush/: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg /tskh'a/ Dela- AllakhI vu", tIakkkha nisbellarsh - tsarna tIe dussur du /k'inkhetaman/ malikash, /tsara olush/: "Shu ma kkheralash, singattame ma khilalash, kkha' khili shuna ialsamanitsa, shuna vaIda iina khilla iolchu".
"Tkho du shun dottagIii du'nenan dakharekh' a, ekhartakh' a, shuna tsigakh' shun sinoshna dezarg du, shuna tsigakh' ash dekhnarg a du",
/Kh'oshallina/ kechdina Sha gechdesh volchu'ngara, Sha k'inkhetame volchu'ngara."
Mila vu vuno khaza dashtsa Dele kkhiikkhinchul a, dika Iamal iinachul a, sha a'lla volchul: "Bakk'alla a, so vu-kkh /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' bolcharakh".
Tskh'aniissa tsa khu'lu dikanig a, vonig a, akh' dukhatokhauggar khaza dolchu'ntsa - tIakkkha kh'una a, shena a iukk'ekh' mostagIalla erg kh'ome dottagI sanna khir vu kh'una.
I dalur dats sha'sh sobar dinacharna a ben, i dalur dats shegakh' dokkkha /irsan/ dak'a dolchunna a ben.
Kh'una /otsunnatIekh'/ shaitIano vasvasalla dag chu kkhossane a kkhossakh', Delatsa larvalar lakha. Bakk'alla a, Iza khozush verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.
Tsu'nan Ialamatekh iu bu'isa a, de a, malkh a, butt a. Suzhud ma de malkhana a, battana a, ash suzhud de Sha u'sh kkho'llina volchu Dalla, sha'sh Tsunna Iibadat desh delakh'.
Tsara kuralla iakh', Dalla gergakh' bersh Tsunna tasbakh' desh bu bu'isana a, diinakh' a, tsarna kIor tsa do.

Tsu'nan Ialamatekh du kh'una latta gar dek'a. Okha tsunna tIe khi dossicha, iza dettalo, kkhu'u. Bakk'alla a, Iza dendiinarg - denbiir bolush ma vu bellarsh. Bakk'alla a, Iza masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma vu.

Tkhan aiatashkakh' kerstanalla desh bersh Tkhuna k'ailaber bats. TsIarga kkhussur verg dika vu ia k'ematdiinakh' kkheramza vogIur verg /dika/ vu? Iamal e shaina ma lu'u. Bakk'alla a, Iza ash diirig gush ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, kh'ekhamna (K'ur'anna) kerstanalla dinarsh i shaiga be'cha /bekkham biir bu Okha tsarna/. Bakk'alla a, iza deza dolu zhaina du-kkh.
Khartsderg dogIur dats tsunna kh'alkhakhula a, tIekh'akhula a, /iza/ okh'adossar du Sha kh'ukame a, khastame a volchu'ngara.
Kh'o'ga tsa olu kh'ol kh'alkha elchanashka a'llarg a ben. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg Shegakh' gechdar dolush a vu, lazame taIzar dolush a vu.

Okha iza khiliitinekh'ara Ia'rbekh dotsu K'ur'an, /tIakkkha a/ er ma dara tsara: "Tsu'nan aiatash k'astinekh'ara /tkhuna, tkho tsarakh kkhetarkh'ama/. Tk'a /K'ur'an/ Ia'rbekh dotsush khila dezara, /paikhamar sha/ Ia'rbi a volush? Akh' ala: "Iza (K'ur'an) iiman dillincharna du, niisa nek' a, darba a khilla". Tsateshnarsh a - tseran lergii chokh' k'oralla iu, iza (K'ur'an) tsarna bIa'rsaza du (u'sh tsa kkheta tsunakh). U'sh bu shaiga kkhoikkhucharakh /tera/ genarchu mettigera.

Okha delira Musaga zhaina, tsu chokh' a khilpalo khilira. Doshkh'alkha tsa dellekh'ara kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara - kh'ukam dina khir dara tsarna iukk'ekh'. Bakk'alla a, u'sh shekonan shekonekh' bu-kkh.
Dika Iamal iinarg - /iza/ tsunna shena iu. Vonig dinarg - /iza a/ tsunna du'kh'al du. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhoburg ma vats /tsu'rrig/ zulam diir dolush leshna.

Tsunna tIe dukhaderzo sakh'tan Iilma. Ara tsa bolu zezagiin iukk'era sto'mash a, tskh'a a stechun kiira ber a tsa leta, tso ber tsa do Tsunna khuush ben. Otsu diinakh' tsa'rga kkhoikkhur du: "Michakh' bu San nak'ostii?" Tsara er: "Kh'o'ga khaiitina okha: vats tkhokh tskh'a a tesh".
DIatilira tsarakh u'sh kh'alkha shaiga kkhoikkhushkhillarsh. Tsarna khiira shaina tskh'a a kIelkh'ardovliila dotsiila.
KIor tsa do adamna dikanash dekhar. Nagakh' sanna shekh vonig kkhetakh', /Delan k'inkhetamakh/ dog du'llu tso.

Okha tsu'nga Tkhaigara k'inkhetam Iovshiitakh' tsunakh zen kkhetnachul tIa'kh'a, tso alanne a ma olu: "KhIara san /kh'u'nartsa/ du. Suna tsa mo'ttu sakh't d1akhIuttur du. So san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe iukhaverzavakh' a - suna Tsu'ngakh' vuno a dikanig khir du". Okha diitsanne a du'itsur ma du kerstanashka tsara dinarg, Okha Iovshiitanne a Iovshu'itur ma du tsa'rga lu'rachu Iazapakh /1azap/.
Okha adamna niImat delcha, dIavo'rzu iza /barkalla alarkh/, agIorkh'avzii. Vonig shekh kkhetakh' - dekhkha doIanash desh khu'lu.
Akh' ala: "Goi shuna, iza /K'ur'an/ Delera khilcha - /i kh'ak' - bak' du/, tIakkkha ash tsunna kerstanalla dicha, mila vu tk'a sha /tsu'ntsa/ genarchu mostag1allekh' volchul vuno a tilavellarg?"

TIa'kh'a Okha tsa'rga goitur du Tkhan Ialamatash /stiglaniin a, la'ttan a/ agIonashkakh' a, tsa'rgakh' shaigakh' a tsarna bilgaldallalts iza bak'derg duila. Kkhacho tsa khu'lu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa Iza masso a khIumanna tIekh' tesh khilar?
Bakk'alla a, u'sh bats shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa tskh'anakkhetarakh shekonna chokh'? Bakk'alla a, Iza vats masso a khIumanna go bu'llush verg /Iilmantsa, Shena khaartsa/?
Kh'a-mum.
Iain-sun-k'af.
Ishtta vekh'ii dou'itu kh'o'ga a, kh'ol kh'alkha khillacha'rga a Sha veza volchu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh volchu Dala.
Tsu'nan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Iza vu lekkha verg a, veza- vokkkha verg a.

Gerga du stiglanash atadala shaina tIekhula/Delan siilallitsa/. Malikasha tasbakh' do shain Kkhiosh-kkhoburg khastortsa, tsara gechdar do'khu la'ttakh' volchunna. Sema dovla / khIai nakh/! Bakk'alla a, Dela - Iza ma vu Sha gechdesh verg a, k'inkhetame verg a.
I votsurg /shaina/ doladiirashla'tsnarsh - Dela vu tsarna tIekh' lardarkho, kh'o vats tsarna t1ekh' vekal.

Ishtta vekh'etsa daiitira Okha kh'o'ga Ia'rbiin Desharkh'o'ga kkheram tasiita iartiin nanna a, tsunna gonakh' bolcharna a, kh'o'ga kkheram tasiita guldaran dentsa, shena chokh' sheko iotschu - tskh'a toba (busalbanash) ialsamanekh' khir iu, vazha toba (kerstanash) zho'zhakhatakh' khir iu.
Dalla li'nekh'ara, Tso tskh'a ummat khu'lu'itara dara tsarakh, delakh' a, Tso shen k'inkhetamna chuvokhu'itu Shena luurg, tk'a zulamkhoi- ma vats tsarna doladiirig, ma vats /tsarna/ gIo'ncha.
Ia tsara Iza votsurg doladiirash la'tsna? Tk'a Dela - Iza vu-kkh doladiirig, Tso denbo bellarsh, Iza vu masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush verg.

Shun shegakh' tskh'ana khIumanakh khilpalo io'zhnekh' - tsu'nan kh'ukam Dalla tIe du. /Ash ala:/ "Iza AllakhI-Dela vu, san Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, Tsunna tIe tevzhina so, Tsunna tIe dIavo'rzu so /san masso a gIullakkhashkakh'/".

Stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llinarg /vu Iza/. Tso khiliitina shuna shukh shaikh zudarii, bezhnekh a - taip-taipa. Tso shu alsamdokhu tsu'ntsa (zudarii balabesh debartsa). Iats Tsunakh (Delakh) tera khIuma a. Iza khozush verg vu, gush verg a vu.
Tsu'nan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dogIanash. Tso shortta khu'lu'itu ritsk' Shena luuchunna, /kIezzig/ baram a bo /Shena luuchunna - u'sh zerkh'ama/. Bakk'alla a, Iza masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.

Tso shuna sharI khiliitina dinakh Sha shetsa veset dina khillarg Nukh'ana a, kh'o'ga vekh'etsa daiitinarg a, Okha shetsa veset dinarg IbrakhIimna a, Musana a, Iiisana a, "din khIottade, - a'lla, - dek'a ma lo tsu chokh' (dinekh')". Dokkkha /khala/ khili mushrikunashna akh' sha'sh shena tIe kkhoikkhurg. Dala tsunna (Dela tskh'a'varna) tIe khorzhu Shena luurg, Tso tsunna (Dela tskh'a'varna) tIe nisvo sha /tsunna tIe/ vo'rzurg.

U'sh bek'a ma tsa bella shaiga Iilma de'nachul tIa'kh'a a ben vovshiin iukk'ekh' kh'agI khilar bakh'anekh'. Dosh kh'alkha tsa dellekh'ara kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchungara "to'khna khan tIe kkhachchalts", a'lla dolu, kkhiel iina khir ma iara tsarna iukk'ekh'. Bakk'alla a, tsaral tIa'kh'a shaiga irsana zhaina dellarshtsunakh (Mukh'ammad elcha khilarkh) shekonan shekonekh' ma bu.

Tsu'nga (Dela tskh'a'vare) kkhaikkha /khIai Mukh'ammad/. DIanislokh'aiga omra ma di. Tseran dezarshna tIa'kh'a ma khIotta, akh' ala: "As iiman dilli Dala dossinchu zhaine, suna omra dina shuna iukk'ekh' niiso ian. /Tskh'a/ Dela vu tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg a, tkhuna tkhan Iamalsh iu, shuna - shun Iamalsh iu. Tskh'a a k'ovsambats tkhuna a, shuna a iukk'ekh'. Dala tskh'a'natukhur du vai (k'ematdiinakh' bak'derg k'asto), Tsunna tIe du dIaderzar".
I Delan /dinekh' elchantsa/ k'u'isush bersh Tsunna zhop dellachultIa'kh'a tseran delilsh dIatettina /kharts/ du shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gergakh', tsarna o'gIazlo a iu /Delera/, chIogIa Iazap a du.
Dela vu Sha dossiinarg zhaina bak'dolchu'ntsa, terza a. Kh'una kh'an khou'itu, sakh'tgerga khila tarlo.

Tsu'ntsa (k'ematdentsa) sikhlush bu sha'sh tsunakh tsa teshash bersh. Iiman dillinarsh kkho'rush bu tsunakh, tsarna kha'a iza kh'ak'-bak' duila. Sema dovla! Bakk'alla a, tsu sakh'takh (k'ematdiinakh) sheko esh bersh genarchu tilarchokh' ma bu.
Dela Shen lekh dukkha k'inkhetamema vu, ritsk' lo Tso Shena luuchunna. Iza nu'tsk'ala verg a vu, veza verg a vu.
Milla khillekh' ekhartan ial ezash - Okha sovvokkkhur vu iza shena ial ialarekh'. Milla khillekh' du'nenan ial ezash - lur iu Okha tsunna otsunakh, ekhartakh' tskh'a a dak'a dats tsunna.
Tk'a tsarna nak'ostii bu shaina Dala tsa magiinarg dinekh' sharI desh? K'astoran doshtsa khillekh'ara, kkhiel iina khir ma iara tsarna iukk'ekh'. Bakk'alla a, zulamkhoi - tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap du.

Kh'una gur bu zulamkhoi chIogIa kkho'rush sha'sh /du'nenakh'/ karadinchukh tsu'nan bekkham /k'ematdiinakh'/ shaina tIebo'zhcha. Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a ialsamanin dikanashkakh' khir bu. Tsarna khir iu shaina luurg shain Dalla gergakh'. Iza /Delera/ dokkkha dozalla du-kkh!

Iza bu Dala Shen iiman dillina bolchu, dika Iamalsh iina bolchu leshna bokkkhush bolu kkha'. Akh' ala: "As tsa bo'khu shu'ga tsunna tIekh' tskh'a a makh /vain/ gergarlonashkakh'bezam /tergal bar/ ben". Dikanig desh volchunna - Okha alsamdokkkhur du tsunna dikachu'ntsa. Bakk'alla a, Dela gechdesh verg a vu, /dikanig dinchunna/ barkalle a vu.

Ia tsara olu: "Tso (Mukh'ammad paikhamaro) kkho'llina Dalla tIekh' khartsderg?" Dalla luush delakh'ara, kh'an dagna tIe mukhIar tukhur ma dara Tso. Doiu Tso khartsderg, bak'do bak'derg Shen deshnashtsa. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu degnashkakh' derg khuush verg.
Iza vu k'obaldesh toba Shen leshkara, gechdesh vonash /ash toba dicha/, Tsunna kha'a ash diirig.
Zhop lush vu Iza iiman dillinacharna a, dika Iamal iinacharna a (tseran doIina), Tso sovbokhu u'sh Shen koma'rshallekh. Tk'a kerstanash - tsarna chIogIa Iazap du.

Dala shortta darzhinekh'ara ritsk' Shen leshna, tIekhbovlur ma bara u'sh /Delan dozanel/ la'ttakh', delakh' a, Tso dossado /ritsk'/ Shena luuchu baramekh'. Bakk'alla a, Iza Shen lai sov dika bevzash a, gush a ma vu.
Iza vu tsara dog dillinchul tIa'kh'a dogIa dou'itush verg, Tso barzhabo Shen k'inkhetam. Iza vu khastame volu doladiirig.
Tsu'nan Ialamatekh du stiglanash a, latta a kkhollar a, tsu shinna chokh' Tso darzhina dolu diinat a. Iza u'sh guldarna tIekh', Shena ma li'nekh', nitsk' bolush a vu.
Shukh kkhi'na bolu /mu'lkha/ bokham - shun ku'igasha karadinchu'ntsa bu, dukkhaderg gechdo Tso.
Shu ma dats la'ttakh' d1adovdalur dolush /Delan kkhielakh/. Ma vats shuna Dela votsurg tskh'a a doladiirig a, tskh'a a gIo'ncha a.
Tsu'nan Ialamatekh iu khIorda chokh' lelash ersh, la'mnekh tera.
Shena li'cha mokh satsabo Tso, u'sh (kemanash) du'su chIagIdella tsu'nan buk'a tIekh'. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du masso a sobardolchunna a, barkalla oluchunna a.
Ia khIallakdiir dara Tso u'shtsarakaradiinarg bakh'anekh', Tso gechdo dukkhaderg.
Tkhan aiatashkakh' k'u'isacharna khaiila, shaina tskh'a a kIelkh'ardovliila iotsiila.
Tskh'atstsa khIumanakh shuna ellarg - du'nenan dakharan dak'a du. Dalla gergakh' derg dika a du, vuno a bukhadu'sush a du iiman dillincharna a, shain Dalla tIetevzhincharna a.
/I khaza ial iu/ dakkkhiichu k'inoikh a, bo'khachu khIumanekh a genabevvlacharna a, sha'sh o'gIazbevlicha, gechdesh bolcharna a.

/Iza du/ shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna zhop dellacharna a, lamaz khIottocharna a, shain gIullakkh vovshii iuk'akh' kkhetashoiolcharna a, Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'ekh /Delan novk'akh' nakhana dikanig desh/ kharzhash echarna a.
Shaikh tskh'a kh'agIkkhi'cha, vovshashna gIo desh bolcharna a.
Vochun bekkham i sanna vonig du. Gechdina, maslakh'atdinarg - tsu'nan ial Dalla tIekh' iu. Bakk'alla a, Tsunna tsa beza zulamkhoi.
GIo lekhnarg shena zulam /dinchul/ tIa'kh'a - tsunna nek' bo'khkur bats (bekhke lorur vats i; k'a dats tsunna).
Nek' bo'khkur bu (taIzar diir du) nakhana zulam desh bolcharna a, la'ttakh' bovla kh'ak' dotsush /nakhana nitsk'ash besh, von lelash/ kurabovlucharna a. Tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap du.
Sobar dinarg a, gechdiinarg a - bakk'alla a, iza chIogIachu gIullakkhekh du.
Dala tilavala vitinarg - ma vats tsunna tskh'a a doladiirig Tsul tIa'kh'a. Kh'una gur zulamkhoi shaina Iazap ginchul tIa'kh'a olush: "Dukhaderzan tskh'a a nek' bui-te?"

Kh'una gur bu u'sh tsunna (zho'zhakhatina) kh'alkhatettina, siisaza khilarkh kkherabevla, k'ailakha kho'zhush. Iiman dillinchara er: "Bakk'alla a, zen khillarsh bu-kkh sha'sh a, shain do'zal a bainarsh k'ematdiinakh'. Sema dovla! Tk'a, bakk'alla a, zulamkhoi /khir/ bats guttarenan Iazapa chokh'?"
Ma tsa khili tsarna doladiirash, tsarna gIo desh, Delan /1azapna/ du'kh'al. Dala tilavala vu'turg, milla velakh' a, - ma bats tsunna tskh'a a nek' /kIelkh'arvala/.

Zhop lo shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna (Tsunna Iibadat dartsa) shen Delera dukhtokhalur dotsu dedale. Iats shuna tskh'a a dIadovda mettig otsu diinakh', vats shuna tskh'a a /shun Iazapan/ inkarlo iiir erg.

U'sh dIaberzakh', - Okha tsa vakhiitina kh'o tsarna tIe khekho (lardarkho) khilla. Kh'an tIekh' dIakkkhachor ben dats. Okha adamna Iovshiiticha Tkhaigara k'inkhetam, dakkkhiido' iza tsu'ntsa. Tk'a tsunakh kkhi'cha vonig, tsu'nan ku'igasha kh'alkhada'kkkhina dolu, - tIakkkha adam kersta khu'lii dIakhIuttu.
Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. Kkhullu Tso Shena luurg. Lo Tso Shena luuchunna zudaberash, lo Tso Shena luuchunna bozhaberash.
Ia khu'lu'itu tsarna bozhaberash a, zudaberash a, Shena luurg tIa'kh'e iotsush vu'tu. Bakk'alla a, Iza khuush verg a vu, nitsk' kkhochurg a vu.

Tsa khili adamna Dela shega vistkhilar vekh'etsa ben, ia kirkh'ana dekh'akhula, ia elchavaiitartsa ben - tso vekh'e lush Tsu'nan purbantsa Tsunna luurg. Bakk'alla a, Iza lekkha verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Ishtta kh'o'ga a vekh'etsa daiitina Okha saTkhan gIullakkhakh. Kh'o ma vatsara khuush, zhaina khIun du, iiman khIun du a, delakh' a, Okha nur khiliita tsunakh (K'ur'anakh), shetsa nisvesh Tkhaina luurg Tkhan lekh, bakk'alla a, akh' nisvalare ma kkhoikkhu /islaman/ niisachu novk'a,
Delan novk'a, stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg Shen dolchu. Tk'a Dalla tIe tsa do'du gIullakkhash? /KhIa'! Do'du!/
Kh'a-mum.
Bilgalchu zhainatsa /dui bou Asa/.
Okha khiliitina tsunakh Ia'rbiin /mattakh'/ K'ur'anshu /tsu'nan kh'ukamekh/ kkhetiita.
Bakk'alla a, iza (K'ur'an) zhainan nenachokh' du Tkhan gergakh', lekkhanig a du, kh'ukame derg a du /sha/.
Tk'a Okha shukh tsa tukhush bu'tur bu kh'ekhamshu tIalamza k'am khili a'lla?
Mel /dukkha/ paikhamarsh bakhiitina Okha kh'alkhaleracha'rgakh'!
Tskh'a a paikhamar tsa veana tsa'rga tsara iza siisazvokkkhush ben.
Okha khIallakbina tsarakh /kh'an k'omal/ nitsk'atsa vuno chIogIa bersh -dIadakhana kh'alkhaleracheran masal.
Akh' tsa'rga kha'tticha, kh'an kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, a'lla, tsara alanne a er du kh'una: "U'sh kkho'llina Sha veza volcho, Sha khuush volcho (Dala)!"
Ishttanig vu Iza khiliitina shuna la'ttakh /vizha/ mott, Sha khiliitina shuna tsu chokh' (la'ttakh') nek'ash -shu niisachu novk'akh' khir datsara-te.
Ishttanig a vu Iza Sha /tIetta/ dou'itush stiglara khi baramekh' -Okha denbina tsu'ntsa bella bolu mokhk. Ishtta shu /keshnashkara/ aradokhur du /k'ematdiinakh'/.
Ishttanig a vu Iza Sha masso a khIuma shish-shishkkho'llina, Sha khiliitina shuna kemanakh a, bezhnekh a shuna tIekhovsha khIumanash

Shu dIanisdaliitan tseran bakk'ash tIekh', tIakkkha ash kh'ekhadan shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun niImat sha'sh tsarna tIekh' dIanisdelcha, ash ala: "Vonakh tsIena vu I Sha tkhuna khIara mu'tIakh' iina, tkhuna tsu tIekh' nitsk' kkhochur ma batsara.
Bakk'alla a, tkho tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga dIado'rzur dolush ma du (k'ematdiinakh') ".
Tsara ma khiliiti Tsunna Tsu'nan lekh tskh'a dak'a. Bakk'alla a, adam bilgala kersta khili-kkh.
Ia Tso la'tsna Sha kkho'llinchukh /Shena/ mekhkarii, tk'a shu kha'rzhina kIentashtsa?
Tsarakh tskh'anna kkha' ba'kkkhicha sha'sh K'inkhetam bolchunna masal daliinachu'ntsa-Iarzhaloi la'tta tsu'nan iu'kh', khalla o'gIazlo iukhaozaesh /i shena ioI khilar tsa dezash/.
Tk'a khazallashkakh' kkhi'narg, sha k'iisamekh' /bak'dolchu'ntsa/ bilgala tsa ia'llarg (zudastag khu'lu'itu tsara Dalla)?
Tsara khiliiti malikash, sha'sh K'inkhetam bolchun lesh dolu, zudarii. U'sh /kh'o'zhush/ bara-te u'sh (malikash) kkhulluchu khenakh'? DIaiazdiir ma du tseran teshalla, tsa'rga bart khottur ma bu.
Tsara elira: "K'inkhetam bolchunna li'nekh'ara, okha tsarna (malikashna) Iibadat dina khir datsara". Tsarna tsu'ntsa tskh'a a Iilma dats. U'sh bats khartslu'ish ben.
Ia Okha zhaina della-te tsa'rga tsul (K'ur'anal) kh'alkha, t1akkkha u'sh tsu'ntsa chIagIbellarsh a khu'lush?
KhIa', tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, tkhuna kariina tkhan dai tskh'ana dina tIekh', tkho tseran lorakh (tachcha) dIanislush du".

Ishtta tsa vakhiitira Okha kh'ol kh'alkha iu'rtakh' tskh'a a kkheramcha tsu'nan zovkkh kh'o'guchara olush ben: "Bakk'alla a, tkhuna kariina tkhan dai tskh'ana dina tIekh', tkho tseran lorana (tachana) tIa'kh'ada'zash du".

Tso (Mukh'ammad paikhamara) elira: "Tk'a so ve'nekh' shu'ga shuna shain dai shena tIekh' kariinachul vuno niisachu'ntsa, /tIakkkha a khartsvo ash so/?" Tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, tkho shu (elchanash) shetsa daiitinchunna kersta du-kkh".
Okha chIir iitsira ts'argara. Kh'azhal kh'o, mukha khili /din/ khartsdinacheran tIa'kh'e!
Dagadaiita! IbrakhIima a'llera shen dega a, shen k'ome a: "Bakk'alla a, so tsIena vu ash shena Iibadat dechukh.
So kkho'llinchunna ben /diir dats as Iibadat/, bakk'alla a, Tso so nisviir vu".
Iza khiliitira tso shen tIa'kh'enekh' bukhadu'sush dolu dosh -u'sh iukhaberza tam bara-kkh.
KhIa', As bakham belira khIokkharna a, tseran daishna a tsa'rga bak'derg a, bilgala elcha a valts.
Shaiga bak'derg de'cha, tsara elira: "KhIara bozbuunchalla du, bakk'alla a, tkho tsunna kersta du".
Tsara elira: "KhIara K'ur'an dossinekh'ara shina iu'rtara siilakh'-vezachu stage".

Tk'a u'sh bu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun k'inkhetam bu'ik'ush bersh? Okha biik'ina tsarna iukk'ekh' tseran bakham du'nenan dakharekh', tsarakh tskh'abersh vovshii tIekh' darzhashtsa lakkhabekhina, tsarakh tskh'abolcha'rga shaina vukkharga gIullakkh daitarkh'ama. Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun k'inkhetam dika bu tsara guldeshdolchul.
Nakh /berrige a/ tskh'a ummattsa khilakh'ara, Okha khiliitina khir ma dara K'inkhetam bolchukh tsateshacharna tseran tsIenoshna datontkhevnash a, lamesh a, u'sh shaina tIebovlush bolu.
Tseran tsIenoshna neIarsh a, u'sh shaina tIetovzhush bolu ma'nganash a /datokh khu'lu'itura bara Okha/,
/Kkhin/ khazallasha /lur iara Okha tsarna/. Iza derrige a -du'nenan dakharan khIuma ben ma iats. Ekhart kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna gergakh' /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna du.
Sov k'inkhetame verg (Allakh1-Dela) kh'ekh'orakh gIovpal khillarg -Okha tIekkhussu tsunna shaitIa, i tsunna tsa k'estash nak'ost a khu'lush.
Bakk'alla a, tsara (shaitIanasha) dIatilabo u'sh (shain nak'ostii -adamash niisachu Delan) nek'akh, tsarna mo'ttu sha'sh niisachu novk'akh' du.

Shatkhuna tIe kkhachchalts, tIakkkha er: "Dek'aza ma vala so! Suna a, kh'una a iukk'ekh' malkhbalen a, malkhbuzen a iuk'an genalla khillekh'ara-kkh! Ma von nak'ost khili-kkh /suna kh'okh, shaitIanakh/".
Banne a paida /shu dokhkodavlarkh/ khir bats shuna takhana /k'ematdiinakh'/, ash zulam dina. Bakk'alla a, shu Iazapekh' tskh'ana khir du.
Tk'a akh' khozu'itu k'oravolchunna ia niisachu novk'a vu'llu bIa'rsadotsurg, sha bilgalchu tilar chokh' khillarg?
Okha kh'o dIakkhalkhiichi a -bakk'alla a, Okha tsa'rgara chIir o'tsur iolush ma iu.
Ia Okha kho'ga gaitanne a goitur ma du Okha tsarna vaIda iinarg -bakk'ala a Tkho tsarna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush ma du.
Akh' skh'alatsa kh'aiga vekh'etsa dellarg. Bakk'alla a, kh'o niisachu novk'akh' ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, iza (K'ur'an) kh'ekham bu kh'una a, kh'an k'ome a, tIa'kh'a khottur du shu'ga.
Akh' khattal Okha kh'ol kh'alkha elchanekh baiitincha'rga: "Okha khiliitinii-te K'inkhetame verg votsurg /kkhin/ delii, tsara shaina Iibadat desh?"
Okha vakhiitinera Musa Tkhan aiatashtsa FirIavne a, tsu'nan elashka a, tso zlira: "Bakk'alla a, so Ialamiin Den elcha vu".
Iza (Musa) shaiga ve'cha Tkhan aiatashtsa, u'sh tsarakh (aiatekh) bo'lu.
Okha tsa goitu tsa'rga tskh'a a aiat iza shel kh'alkhadakhanchul dokkkho dolush ben. Okha skh'aletsira u'sh Iazapatsa -u'sh iukhabo'rzur batsara-te /shain tilarkh/.
Tsara elira: "KhIai bozbuuncha! Dekha tkhuna kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kh'una gergakh' Tsu'nan vaIdakhillarg -bakk'alla a, tkho nislur ma du (okha iman du'llur ma du i Iazap dIada'kkkhicha).
Okha ai ma dinnekh' shaina tIera Iazap -tsara bartbokho.
Kkhiikkhira FirIavnas shen k'omekh', elira: "Tk'a san dats Misran pachchakh'alla, khIara khish suna (san gIalina) bukhakhula lelash dolush? Shuna tsa go /san siilalla/?
Ia so dika vats khIokkhal, sha zaIip volchu, talkkho (mott tiisalush) volchu?
Kkhu'ssinekh'ara tsunna tIe dashon chIug, ia de'nekh'ara tsu'ntsa tskh'ana malikash /tsunakh/ khuttadella".
/Dukkha/ daia kariira tsunna shen k'am -u'sh tsunna mu'tIakh' khilira. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira pesak' nakh.
Tsara Tkho o'gIazda'khcha -Okha tsa'rgara chIir iitsira -khina bukhabakhiitira u'sh berrige a.
U'sh khiliitira Okha kh'alkhabakhna, masal khilla tIa'kh'abogIucharna.
Mar'iaman kIantakhmasal daliicha, kh'an k'omo chIogIa gIovgIa iokkkhu /khazakhetta/.
Tsara elira: "Tkhan delii dika bu ia iza vu?" I (masal) tsa daliira tsara k'iisamna ben. KhIa', u'sh /kharts/ k'u'isush k'am du.
Iza-m (Mar'iaman kIant Iisa) vekk'a lai ben vats, Okha niImat della tsunna, Okha khiliitina tsunakh masalIsrailan kIentashna.
Tkhuna luush delkh'ara, shun metta malikash khu'lu'itura dara Okha la'ttakh', /shu khIallakdinchul tIa'kh'a/ du'sush.

Bakk'alla a, iza (Iisa paikhamar) sakh'tan (k'ematdiinan) Ialamatdu, ash ianne a sheko ma elash tsu'ngakh'. /Akh' ala tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Suna tIa'kh'adazalash. KhIara bu /shuna/ niisa nek'."
Danne a shaitIano iu'stakh ma dokhiila shu /bak'dolchukh/. Bakk'alla a, iza shuna bilgala mostagI ma du.
Iisa ve'cha bilgalonashtsa, tso elira: "So veana shu'ga kh'ek'alallitsa (kh'ek'al dakh'ash), shuna shetsa khilpalo iolu tskh'adersh bilgaldakha a. Delakh kkheralash, suna mu'tIakh' a khilalash.
Bakk'alla a, Dela Iza vu san Ela a, shun Ela a, Tsunna Iibadat delash. KhIara bu /shuna/ niisa nek'".
Khilpalo khilira tobaniin shaina iukk'ekh'. Ma /bokkkha/ bala bu zulam dinacharna lazame dolchu diinanIazapakh.
U'sh kh'ovsii-te shaiga tsIekhkh'ana sakh't (k'ematde) dare ben, i shaina khaa tsa lush?
DottagIii otsu /k'emat/diinakh' vovshiin mostagIii khir bu, /tskh'a Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh botsursh. /Tk'a tsa'rga Dala er du/:
KhIai San lesh! Kkheram bats shuna takhana, shu singattame a khir dats:
Tkhan aiatekh iman dillina khilla bersh, /Tkhan kh'ukamna a, Tkhan omrana a/ mu't1akh'khilla bersh.
ChugIo ialsamani shu a, shun zudarii-/tsigakh' shuna chIogIa/ khazakho'tu'itur du.
Tsarna tIekh'iizar ma bu /kegii k'onakhii/ dashon khedarshtsa a, kedashtsa a. Tsigakh' sinoshna mel dezarg khir du, bIa'rgash mel Iebarg a khir du. Shu tsigakh' guttar la'ttar du.
Iza ialsamani iu shuna irsana kkha'chna ash iina khilla Iamalsh bakh'anekh'.
Shuna tsigakh' sto'mash a bu dukkkha a, ash tsarakh buur a bu.
Bakk'alla a, k'inosh dinarsh zho'zhakhatin Iazapekh' guttar a la'ttar bu.
I tsarakh aidiir dats, u'sh tsu chokh' /dikanakh/ dogdillina /kh'ere/ khir bu.
Okha zulam tsa dina tsarna, delakh' a, u'sh khilira sha'sh /shaina/ zulamkhoi.
Tsara kkhoikkhura: "KhIai /zho'zhakhati/ dolakh' erg! Daliitakh'ara tkho kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho" Tso elira: "Shu la'ttar du /liir dotsush /".
Tkho de'nera shu'ga /du'nenakh'/ bak'dolchu'ntsa, delakh' a, shukh dukkhakh- bolcharna bak'derg tsa diizira.
Ia tskh'a gIullakkh tskh'alkhada'kkkhi tsara (Makkin kerstanasha elchanna du'kh'al)? Bakk'alla a, Tkho du /gIullakkhash/ tskh'alkhadokhursh (Okha khIallakbiir bu u'sh).
Ia tsarna mo'ttu-te Tkhuna tsa khozu tseran k'aile a, shabar-shibar a. KhIa', Tkhan elchanash (malikash) tsa'rgakh' iazdesh la'ttash du.
Akh' ala: " Sov k'inkhetame volchunna (Delan) do'zalkho khilcha, so tskh'algIa vu-kkh /otsu do'zalkhochunna/ Iibadat decharakh".
Vonakh tsIena vu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a Da, Iarshan Da, tsara dechu /kharts/ sibatakh.
Bita u'sh k'iisa /khartsdolchu'ntsa/ a, lovza a, shaina vaIda iina iolchu shain /k'emat/denna du'kh'alkkhettalts.
Iza vu stiglakh' a Dela, la'ttakh' a Dela, Iza kh'ukame verg a, khuush verg a vu.
Dek'ala vu Shena stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' dolchun a pachchakh'alla derg, Tsu'ngakh' du sakh't khIottaran Iilma a, Tsu'nan tIe dIaderzor du shu a.
Tsara, Iza a vitina, shaiga kkhoikkhucheran dolakh' dats shapaIat, sha bak'dolchu'ntsa teshalla a dinachu'ngakh'ben, /i sha'sh desh dolu shapa1at Delan purbantsa duila / shaina khuush.
Akh' ts'arga kha'tticha, u'sh kh'an kkho'llina a'lla, tsara er ma du: "Dala". Mukha Iekhabina u'sh /shaitIanasha/!
Tsu'nga (Mukh'ammad paikhamara Dele) elira: " Kh1ai so Kkhiosh-kkhoburg (veza-vokkkha Dela), khIara k'am iman du'llush ma dats".
DIaverza tsarakh (u'sh kh'aitsa sanna, vo ma khila tsa'rtsa), ala: "Mashar!" TIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna.
Kh'a-mum.
/KhIumnash bilgaldokhuchu/ bilgalchu zhainatsa dui bou As.
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossina iza berkate iolchu bu'isana. Bakk'alla a, Tkho khilira kkheram tosursh /tsu'ntsa/.
Tsu (K'ur'ana) chokh' k'astado masso a kh'ek'ale dolu gIullakkh.
Tkhan agIorkh'ara g1ullakkh. Bakk'alla a, Tkho khilira bokhku'itursh
K'inkhetam a khilla kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara. Bakk'alla a, Iza khozush verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.
Stiglaniin a, la'ttan a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel dolchun a Da /vu Iza/, shu /ch1og1a/ teshash khillekh'.
Vats tskh'a a dela Iza votsurg, Tso denbo, Tso bolu'itu, shun Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu Iza, shun kh'alkhalera dain a Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu Iza.
KhIa', u'sh shekonchokh' lovzash ma bu.
Akh' tergal de stiglo bilgala kIurbakh'ar bolu de.
Nakh d1akh'ulbiir bu tso. /Tsara er du/: "KhIara lazosh dolu Iazap du".
"Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg, aidekh' tkhuna tIera khIara Iazap. Bakk'alla a, tkho iman dillina du-kkh".
Michara bu tsarna kh'ekham? Tsa'rga veara ma-i bilgala volu elcha.
TIakkkha u'sh dIabirzira tsunakh, tsara elira: "Zhiniikh volush shena /nakha K'ur'an/ Iamiinarg vu /khIara Mukh'ammad /".
Bakk'alla a, Okha aido Iazap kIezzig -shu iukha a tIedo'rzu /shain kerstanallina/.
Okha bokkkhachu nitsk'atsa /Iazape/ lotsur donchu diinakh'-bakk'alla a, Okha chIir o'tsur iu.
Tsaral kh'alkha a pitane letsira Okha FirIavnan k'am -tsa'rga veara /Delan/ siilakh' elcha (Musa).
"DIalo so'ga Delan lesh/olush/, bakk'alla a, so shuna teshame elcha ma vu.
Kh'aladovla (kuradovla) ma gIerta Dalla, bakk'alla a, as shuna deana bilgala dolu delil.
Bakk'alla a, so larvella san Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa, shun Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa ash suna tIulgash dettarkh (ash so verakh).
Shu sokh tsa teshakh', so suo vita".
/TIakkkha/ tso (Musas) shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kkhiikkhira: "KhIara k'am k'inosh desh ma du", /a'lla/.
/TIakkkha elira Dala/: "DIagIo san leshtsa (Israilan kIentashtsa) bu'isana, bakk'alla a, u'sh/shuna/ tIa'kh'abovlur bu kh'una.
KhIord bek'abellachakh'bita, bakk'alla a, u'sh /khIorda/ bukhagIur dolu eskar ma du".
Mel /dukkha/ bukhaditi tsara boshmash a, shovdanash a,
Ialtash a, /khiila/ siilakh' mettig a,
Sha'sh shetsa zovkkh kh'o'gush khilla dolu /mel dukkha/ niImatash a.
Ishtta /khilira tseran chakkhe/. Okha u'sh irsana dIedelira kkhechu k'omana.
Stigal a, latta a tsa dilkhira tsarna tIekh', tIa'kh'a tsa ta'ttira u'sh /Iazapakh/.
Okha kIelkh'arbekhira Israilan kIentii siisazachu Iazapakh,
FirIavnakh. Bakk'alla a, iza kh'alava'llarg khilira tIalamazacharakh.
Okha u'sh (Israilan kIentii) kha'rzhira Iilmatsa/masso a/ Ialamel.
Okha tsa'rga delira aiatekh shaina chokh' bilgala bala bersh a.
Bakk'alla a, khIorsh (k'uraishash) olush ma bu:
"Vain tskh'a du'khkh'arlera dalar ben dats, vai gIovtor dats /dellachul tIa'kh'a/.
Skh'abalabe tkhan dai, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'".
U'sh dika bu ia TubbaIank'am a, tsaral kh'alkha khillarsh a dika bu? Okha u'sh khIallakbira. Bakk'alla a, u'sh k'inosh desh khilira.
Okha lovzashtsa kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel derg a.
Okha tsa kkho'llina u'sh bak'dolchu'ntsa ben, delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Bakk'alla a, k'astorande -tsarna massarna a khan to'khna ma du.
Otsu diinakh' gergarcho dukhatukhur dats gergarchukh khIumma a, tsarna gIo diir dats.
Dala shekh k'inkhetam binachunna a ben. Bakk'alla a, Iza veza verg a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Bakk'alla a, i Zakk'umolu ditt -
K'inosh dechun kkhacha bu.
Laliinachu a'chgakh tera kkhekhkar bu iza gesh chokh',
Kkhekhkina khi kkhakhkarkh terra.
/Mokh' khir bu/: "Skh'alatsa iza, dIakkhossa iza zho'zhakhatina iukk'e.
DIadotta tsu'nan ko'rtana tIekhula laliinachu khin Iazap".
Iovsha kh'aina! Bakk'alla a, kh'o /khIai kersta/ veza verg vu, siilakh' verg a vu /kh'una mattartsa, kh'an dashtsa a/.
Bakk'alla a, khIara du ash shetsa sheko iinarg".
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh -teshamechu mettigekh' khir bu.
Boshmashkakh' a, shovdanashkakh' a.
TIedukhur du tsara du'tk'achu darikh a, stommachu darikh a, vovshiin du'kh'-du'kh'al khIu'ttush.
Ishtta Okha balor bu tsarna khaza bIa'rgashbersh.
Kkhoikkhur du tsara khIora sto'me, /u'sh kkhachalur tsakhilarkh, masso a khalonekh/ teshame a bolush.
Tsu chokh' valar Iovshur dats tsara -du'khkh'arlera /du'nenakh' khilla/ valar dotsurg -Tso larbira u'sh zho'zhakhatin Iazapakh
Kh'an Kkhiosh - kkhobuchu'ngara koma'rshallitsa. Iza bu-kkh siilakh'-bokkkha tolam.
Bakk'alla a, Okha atta dina iza /K'ur'an/ -kh'an mattakh'a dolush -u'sh kkhetar batsare-te.
Kh'o kh'azha /khIai Mukh'ammad, tsarakh khIun kkhiar du/, u'sh a kh'ovsush bu /kh'o khIallakkhilare - tIa'kh'a khuur du, kh'an khir du gIo du'nenakh' a ekhartakh' a/.
Kh'a-mum.
Zhaina okh'adossor /du khIara/ veza volchu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh volchu Delera.
Bakk'alla a, stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a delilsh ma du mu'min nakhana.
Shu kkhollarekh' a, /masso a la'ttakhula/ da'rzhinchu diinatekh' a delilsh du sha /ch1og1a/ teshash dolchu k'omana.
Bu'isa-de khiitsadalarekh' a, Dala stiglara okh'adossinchu ritsk'ekh' a (dogIekh' a), Sha tsu'ntsa dellachul tIa'kh'a latta dendina dolchu, mokh kh'iizarekh' a delilsh ma du kh'ek'ale bolchu nakhana.
KhIorsh Delan aiatash du, Okha du'itsu u'sh kh'una bak'dolchu'ntsa. Mu'lkhachu khabarekh Delal a, Tsu'nan aiatel tIa'kh'a tesha u'sh?
/Bokkkha/ balabu masso a k'a desh /chIogIa/ khartslu'ish volchunna.

Sha ladugIush volchu shena tIekh' do'shush dolchu Delan aiatashka tIakkkha chIagIlush volchu /shen k'inoshkakh'/, kurava'lla shena u'sh tsa khozuchukh /tsa khezash sanna/ - akh' kkha' bakkkha tsunnalazosh dolchu Iazapatsa.
Shena Tkhan aiatekh tskh'a khIuma khi'cha, - iza skh'alotsu tso belam a boi. U'sh (An-Nadar a, i sannarsh a) shaina siisaza dolu Iazap khir dersh bu.
Tseran kh'alkhakh'zho'zhakhati iu. Tsara karadincho a, Dela a vitina, tsara la'tsnachu doladiirasha a khIumma a kIelkh'ardokkkhur dats tsarakh. Tsarna deza-dokkkha Iazap du.
KhIara bu niisa nek'. Shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun aiatash kerstadinarsh - /u'sh bu/ shaina lazosh dolchukh uggar chIogIa Iazap khir dersh.

Dela vu Sha khIord shuna mu'tIakh' binarg tsu chukhula kema leliita a Shen omratsa, shu'ga lekhiita Tsu'nan koma'rshallekh /khIordan niImatash - chIera, marzhanash.../, shu'ga barkalla aliita /Sha dellachu niImatashna/.
Shuna mu'tIakh' dina Tso stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a - masso a Shegara. Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' delilsh ma du oila esh bolchu nakhana.
Akh' ala iiman dillincha'rga gechdoila tsara Delan denoshka dog dokhushbotsucharnaTsu'nga bekkham baitarkh'ama nakhana sha'sh /du'nenakh'/ karadesh khillachu'ntsa.
Milla velakh' dika dina, - tsunna shena du iza, milla velakh' von dina, - tsunna shena du'kh'al du iza a. TIakkkha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe dIaderzor du shu.
Okha delira Israilan kIentashka zhaina a, kh'ukam a, paikhamaralla a, ritsk' delira tsarna tsIena dolchukh, Okha bazbiira u'sh Ialamel.

Okha elira tsarna /dinan/ gIullakkhan bilgalonash. Tseran khilpalo ma tsa khilira shaiga Iilma de'nachul tIa'kh'a ben vovshii iukk'ekh' kh'agI khilarna. Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobucho kkhiel iiir iu tsarna iukk'ekh' k'ematdiinakh' shain shetsa khilpalo khillachokh'.
TIakkkha kh'o /ia Mukh'ammad/ khiliitina Okha /dinan/ gIullakkhan bak'onekh'- tsunna tIa'kh'akhIotta, tsa khuush bolcheran dezarshna tIa'kh'a ma khIotta.
Bakk'alla a, tsara Delera khIumma a kIelkh'ardokkkhur dats kh'una. Bakk'alla a, zulamkhoi - tseran tskh'abersh vukkhariin gIo'nchii bu kh'una. Dela vu /Shekh/ kkho'rush bolcheran gIo'ncha.
KhIara - bilgalonash iu /bIa'rg bellosh/ nakhana, niisa nek' a bu, k'inkhetam a bu /ch1og1a/ teshash dolchu k'omana.
K'inosh letiinacharna mo'ttina-te Okha sha'sh iiman dillincha'rtsa, dika Iamalsh iinacha'rtsa tskh'aniissa khu'lu'itur du - shain denbalar a, balar a? Von khili tsara desh dolu kh'ukam.
Dala kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a bak'dolchu'ntsa, khIor sinna sha karadinchu'ntsa bekkham khiliitarkh'ama a, tsarna /tskh'anna a tsadinarg bakh'anekh'/ zulam diir dats.

Kh'una goi i shena dezarg shen dela la'tsnarg? Dala tilavala vitina iza shen khaartsa, Tso mukhIar to'khna tsu'nan khazarna a, dagna a tIe, tsu'nan bIa'rsana tIe kirkh'a dillina Tso. TIakkkha iza kh'an nisviir vu Delal tIa'kh'a? Ash oila tsa io?

Tsara elira: "KhIara vain du'nenan dakhar ben kkhin dakhar dats. Lo /vain tskh'abersh/, du'nen chu bovla /tskh'abersh/, vai khIallakdiir ma dats zamano ben". Tseran ma dats tsu'ntsa tskh'a a Iilma. U'sh /bekk'a ishtta/ mo'ttush bu.
Tsarna tIekh' Tkhan bilgala dolu aiatash deshcha, tseran delil ma tsa khilira tsara alar ben: "Skh'abalabe tkhan dai, shu bak'luish khillekh'".
Akh' ala: "Dala dendiir du shu, tIakkkha Tso dolu'itur du shu, tIakkkha guldiir du shu k'ematdiine, shena chokh' sheko iotschu", delakh' a, dukkhakh bolchu nakhana tsa kha'a-kkh.
Delan du-kkh stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. Sakh't khIottinchu diinakh' - otsu diinakh' o'shur ma bu khartsbersh.
Kh'una gur ma du masso a ummat gorkh1o'ttina. KhIor ummat kkhoikkhur ma du shen zhaina tIe - takhana shuna bekkham biir ma bu ash desh khillachu'ntsa.
KhIara du Tkhan zhaina, teshalla diir dolush shuna t1ekh' bak'dolchu'ntsa. Bakk'alla a, Tkho khilira dIaiazdesh ash desh khillarg.
Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamal iinarsh a - u'sh bu'khkur bu shain Kkhiosh-kkhobucho Shen k'inkhetamna chu. Iza bilgala bolu tolam bu-kkh!
Tk'a tsateshnarsh- /tsa'rga er du/: "San aiatash tsa khilira shuna tIekh' do'shush? T1akkkha ash kuralla ma iiira - shukh k'inosh desh dolu k'am khilira".

/Shu'ga/ elcha: "Bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda bak' iu, sakh't /khIuttur du/, sheko iats tsu chokh'", ash elira: "Tsa kha'a tkhuna, sakh't khIun du a, vaina khuurg-m tskh'a mottar ben dats, bakk'alla a, teshash ma dats tkho /ekhartakh/".
Guchudelira tsarna sha'sh dina khilla vonash, kh'akkhadelira tsarakh u'sh shekh tsa beshash khillarg.
Elira /tsa'rga/: "Takhana Tkhuna shu ditsdella, shuna khIokkhu denna du'kh'alkkhetar ditsdalarkh terra. Shun chugIoila /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu, vats shuna g1o'nchekh tskh'a a ".
Iza du /shuna/ ash Delan aiatash belame la'tsna khilarna a, du'nenan dakharo shu Iekhorna a. Takhana u'sh arabokhur bats tsu chu'ra, tsa'rga toba dar a do'khur dats.
Dalla bu khastam, stiglaniin Da volchu, la'ttan Da volchu, Ialamiin Da volchu.
Tsu'nan du siilakh'-dokkkhalla stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a, Iza vu veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Kh'a-mum.
Zhaina (K'ur'an) okh'adossor du /khIara/ Sha veza volchu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh volchu Delera.
Okha tsa kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel derg a bak'ontsa ben, tsIe to'khnachu khanna ben. Kersta khillarsh shaina tiisinchu /ekhartan 1azapan/ kkheramekh dIa ma bo'rzu.

Akh' ala: "Diitsal suna, Dela a vitina, ash /shaiga/ kkhoikkhucharekh. KhIun kkho'llina tsara lattakh, ia tsarna nak'ostalla du /Delatsa tskh'ana khIuma kkhollarekh'/ stiglanashkakh'? Skh'alo so'ga zhaina khIokkhul (K'ur'anal) kh'alkha /dossiina dolu/, ia Iilmanakh lar, shu bak'luish khillekh'".
Mila vu vuno tilavella sha Dela votsuchu'nga kkhoikkhush volchul, shena zhop tsaluchu'nga k'ematde kkhachchalts, u'sh tseran kkhaikkharkh (Iibadatakh) gIovpal a bolush? /Vats tskh'a a!/
Nakh gulbicha /k'ematdiinakh'/, u'sh khili tsarna mostagIii, tseran Iibadatana kersta.
Shaina tIekh' Tkhan bilgala dolu aiatash do'shush, kersta khillachara elira bak'dolchukh (K'ur'anakh), i shaiga de'nachul tIa'kh'a: "KhIara bilgala dolu bozbuunchalla du".

Ia tsara olu: "Tso/shegara/ kkho'llina iza?" Akh' ala: "As iza /K'ur'an/ aisa kkho'llinekh'ara, ash doladiir ma dats suna Delera khIumma a (shuna nitsk' kkhochur batsara sokh Delan Iazap dukhatokha, tIakkkha shun du'kh'a as khIunda kkhullu i saigara)? Iza dika khuush vu-kkh ash tsunakh /K'ur'anakh/ du'itsurg. Kkhacho iu-kkh Tsu'ntsa tesh khila suna a, shuna a iukk'ekh'. Iza gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu".

Akh' ala: "So khilla vats elchanekh du'khkh'ar vaiitinarg, suna tsa kha'a saikh khIun diir du a, shukh /khIun diir du a/. So tIa'kh'akhIuttu dekk'a saiga vekh'etsa khaiitinchunna. So ma vats bilgala volu kkheramcha ben".

Akh' ala: "Ash diitsal suna /shain kh'olakh/ iza /K'ur'an/ Delan agIorkh'ara khilcha, ash tsunna kerstanalla dina, tk'a Israilan kIentekh tskh'ammoteshalla di i sannachunna tIekh'. Tso iiman dillira, shu kuradevlira. Bakk'alla a, Dala nis ma tsa do zulame dolu k'am".

Tsateshnachara elira iiman dillncharekh: "/Iza, islam din/ dika khillekh'ara, tkhol kh'alkha tsunna tIe kkhiar ma batsara u'sh". Sha'sh tsu'ntsa (K'ur'antsa) niisachu novk'a nis tsa belcha, tsara er du: "KhIara kh'alkhalera khartsderg du".

Tsul kh'alkha Musan zhaina/dossiira Okha/ ba'chcha a, k'inkhetam a khilla. KhIara zhaina /du/, bak'desh /shel kh'alkha khillarsh/, Ia'rbiin mattakh' a dolush, kkheram tasa zulam dinacharna, kkha' khilla dikacharna.

Bakk'alla a, sha'sh a'llarsh: "Vai Kkhiosh-kkhoburg Dela vu", tIakkkha /Delan novk'akh'/ chIagIbellarsh - kkheram a khir ma bats tsarna /ekhartakh' Delan 1azapakh/, u'sh singattame a khir ma bats /du'nenakh' shail bukhadu'schukh/.
U'sh ialsamanin dai bu, tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bolush - bekkham bu /iza/ tsara esh khillachu Iamalna /du'kh'al/.

Veset dina Okha adame shen detsa-nenatsa dika khilar - nanas /kiirakh'/ leliina iza khalontsa, /du'nena/ va'kkkhina iza khalontsa. Iza /kiirakh'/ leloran a, /vakkhorakh/ k'astoran a khan tk'e itt butt bu /6-9 butt kiirakh', iisina khan vakkhosh/. Sha g1emettakh1o'tticha, shovztk'a shere va'lcha, tsoelira: "Vezan Dela, a'tto belakh' suna Kh'an niImatana barkalla ala, Akh' suna a, san dena-nanna a della dolchu, Kh'o shena reza volu dika Iamal ian a, todelakh' suna san zu'rretekh' /san g1ullakkhash - nsbelakh' u'sh a nischu novk'a/ a. Bakk'alla a, as toba di Kh'o'ga, bakk'alla a, so /Dalla/ mu't1akh'bolcharakh (busalbanekh) vu-kkh".

U'sh (Abu-Bakr a i sannarsh a) bu Okha shaigara k'obaldesh bersh sha'sh iinchu Iamalakh uggar khazanig, Okha tidame o'tsur dats tseran /kegii/ k'inosh, /u'sh khir bu/ ialsamanin daishkakh', /Delan/ bak' khilla vaIda iu iza tsarna iina khilla iolu.

/Kh'azhal/ i a'llargshen dega-nene a: "U'ffai shu shi', ash shimmo vaIda io suna so /vellachul tIa'kh'a kash chu'ra/ aravokkkhur vu, olii, /dukkha/ tIa'kh'enash dIa ma iakhna sol kh'alkha /tsarakh tskh'a a tsa va'lla kash chu'ra ara/. Tsu shimmogIo do'khush Dele: "Ma vala dek'aza, iiman dilla. Bakk'alla a, Delan vaIda bak' iu". Tsoolu: "KhIorsh-m kh'alkhalerchiin tu'iranash ben datsara".
U'sh bu shaina tIekh' kh'alkha dakhanchu zhiniin a, adamiin a ummatashkakh' a'lla dolu doshbak'khillarsh. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira eshnarsh.
KhIoranna sha iinchu Iamalan darzh iu. Tso bekkham biir bu tsarna tsara iinchu Iamalashka /kh'a'zhna/, tsarna zulam diir dats.

Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' tsateshnarsh kh'alkhatottur bu zho'zhakhatina, /tsa'rga er du malikasha/: "DIadakhiitina ash shain dikanash (ni1matash) shain du'nenan dakharekh', tsu'ntsa /du'nentsa/ zovkkh a kh'egna ash. Takhana shuna bekkham bo siisazallin Iazapatsa ash kuralla iarna la'ttakh', tskh'a a bak'o iotsush, shu pesak' khilarna".

Kh'akhave Iadiin vasha, tso kkheram tesira shen k'omana Akh'k'afekh', kkheram tosursh /elchanash/ tsul kh'alkha a khilira, tIa'kh'a a khilira: "Ash Iibadat ma delash Dalla ben, bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru shuna siilakh'-dokkkhachu diinan Iazapakh", a'lla.
Tsara elira: "Kh'o veana tkhuna tkho dIakh'avzadan tkhan deliikh. Skh'adalade aikh'a tkhuna khir du bokhurg, kh'uo bak'lu'icharakh khillekh'".
Tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, Iilma Dalla gergakh' du, as shu'ga dIakkhachado so shetsa vaiitinarg /i Iazap khIun du/, khIette a suna shu kheta zhekhIal k'am".

Shaina gicha iza markha shain togIina tIe iogIush, tsara elira: "KhIara markha vaina dogIa dakh'ash iu-kkh". "KhIan-khIa! Iza ash sha sikhdinarg (Iazap) du - mokh bu shena chokh' lazosh dolu Iazap dolu", /elira kkhechara/.

"Tso dokhor du masso a khIuma shen Delan omratsa", /elira tskh'abolchara/, u'sh Iu'iranga bevlira tseran gIishlosh ben gush khIuma a dotsush (Dala khIallakbira u'sh). Ishtta bekkham bo Okha k'inosh dechu k'omana.

Okha chIagIbinera u'sh shu (k'uraishash) shetsa chIagI tsabinchu'ntsa, Okha khiliitira tsarna khazar a, gar a, degnash a. Tsarakh kIelkh'ar tsa da'kkkhira tseran khazaro a, tseran garo a, tseran degnasha a khIumma a, u'sh khilira Delan aiatekh tsa teshash, tsarakh kh'a'rchira u'sh shekh tsa beshash khillarg.
Okha khIallakiira shun gonakh'ara iartash, daliira delilsh, u'sh iukhabo'rzur batsara-te.
GIo ma tsa dira tsarna, Dela a vitina, Tsunna gergakhiliita sha'sh la'tsna khillachu delasha. KhIa', u'sh dIatilira tsarakh, Iza tseran khartsderg a dara, tsara kharts kkhullush khillarg a dara.

Okha kh'avzira kh'o volchu zhiniikh tskh'a toba, tsara K'ur'ane ladugIu. Sha'sh tsigakh' dolush tsara /vovshashka/ elira: "Sovtsa /ladogIa K'ur'ane/". I deshna da'lcha, u'sh dIadakhara shen k'omana tIe, kkheram tosush.

Tsara elira: "KhIai tkhan k'am! Tkhuna khezira tskh'a zhaina, Musal tIa'kh'a dossiina dolu shel kh'alkha khillachu'ntsa (Tavratatsa a, Inzhilatsa a) niisa dogIush dolu, sha nisvesh dolu bak'dolchunna tIe a, niisachu novk'a a.
KhIai tkhan k'am! Zhop lo Delera kkhoikkhush volchunna, tesha tsunakh, Tso gechdiir du shun k'inosh, shu kIelkh'ardokhur du lazosh dolchu Iazapakh".
Delera kkhoikkhush volchunna zhop tsa lush verg - nitsk' kkhochur bats tsunna la'ttakh' /Delan Iazapakh k'elkh'aravala/, Iza votsucho Ialashbiir bats u'sh. U'sh bilgalchu tilar chokh' bu-kkh!
