Tsarna tsa go-tekh'a Sha stiglanash a, latta a kkho'llina volu Dela, u'sh kkhullush kIad tsa vella volu, nitsk' kkhochush vuila bellarsh denban? KhIa', bakk'alla a, Iza masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush verg vu-kkh.

Otsu diinakh' kh'alkhatottur bu tsateshnarsh /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIarna /tsa'rga khottur du/: "Bak' dats khIara?" /olush/. Tsara er: "KhIa', tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa (dui bou okha): bak' du". Tso (Dala) elira: "Iovsha shaina Iazap sha'sh tsa teshash khilarna".

Sobar de, elchanekhshaigakh' chIagIo khillachara sobar darkh terra, sikh ma de tsarna /Iazap dossar/. U'sh tera bu, shaina vaIda iinarg shaina guchu diinakh', diinan tskh'ana sakh'tekh' ben /du'nenakh'/ tsa la'ttincharakh. /KhIara K'ur'an nakhe/ dIakkhachor du /kh'una tIekh'/. Pesak' k'am ben khIallakdesh du-i? /Dats -te!/

Sha'sh tsateshnarsh a, Delan nek'akh /nakh/ d1atiliinarsh a - Tso dIatilina tseran Iamalsh (tsara du'nenakh' dinchu dikanna du'kh'al du'nenakh' dikachu'ntsa bekkham khir bu tsarna, ekhartakh' tseran Iamalash kh'esape o'tsur iats).

Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a, Mukh'ammade dossosh khillachukh teshnarsh a - iza tseran Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bak'derg du - Tso dIaiitsina tsa'rgara tseran k'inosh, todina tseran gIullakkh.
Iza du tsateshnarsh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush khilarna khartsdolchunna, iiman dillinarsh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush khilarna shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bak'dolchunna. Ishtta dalado Dala nakhana shain masalsh.

Sha'sh du'kh'alkkhetcha tsateshnacha'rtsa - logekhtokha ash u'sh gIelballalts, chIagI'e burzholash- tIa'kh'a k'inkhetam beria du'kh'al makh o'tsur- tIamo shen mokh' okh'abillalts. Iza - Dalla laakh'ara, Tso tolam lur bara tsarna tIekh', delakh' a, shun tskh'abersh vukkhartsa zerkh'ama /boitu Dala tIemash/. Delan novk'akh' baiinarsh - Tso ianne a dIatilor iats tseran Iamalsh.
Tso tIa'kh'a nisbiir bu u'sh, todiir du tseran gIullakkh.
Tso bukhkur bu u'sh ialsamani chu, Sha tsarna iovziitina iolchu (khIoranna shena ialsamanekh' khir iolu khIusam khuush).
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash Dalla gIo dakh' (Tsu'nan din ch1ag1desh),- Tso shuna a gIo diir du, shun kog a chIagIbiir bu.
Tsateshnarsh - khIallakkhilar du tsarna, Tso dIatilina tseran Iamalsh.
Iza du tsarna tsa diizina dela Dala okh'adossiinarg (K'ur'an) - Tso dIaiaia tseran Iamalsh.
U'sh tsa lela la'ttakhula, tsa kh'ovsu, mukha khilla tsaral kh'alkhakhillacheran tIa'kh'e? Dala bokhiira u'sh. /KhIokkhu/ kerstanashna a tsunakh teranig khir du.
Iza - Dela iiman dillincheran gIo'ncha volu dela du, tk'a kerstanash - tseran tskh'a a gIo'ncha vats.

Bakk'alla a, Dala bukhkur bu iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a boshmashka, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu. Tk'a tsateshnarsh /kIezzig/ zovkkh kh'o'gur du /kkhu du'nenakh'/, duur du bezhnasha ma dou - /tIakkkha zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe iu tsarna chokh'Iaila.
Masa iurt, sha'sh kh'o shena chu'ra arava'kkkhina kh'an iu'rtal (Makkal) nu'tsk'alo iolush iolu, khIallakiina Okha, ma tsa khilira tsarna tskh'a a gIo'ncha!
Sha Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara bilgalona tIekh' verg tera vu tk'a shen Iamalan vonig shena khaziinachukh, shain dezarshna tIa'kh'akhIittincharakh?

/Delakh/ kkho'rucharna khir iu a'lla iolchu ialsamanin masal: tsu chokh' tatolash du /cham a, kh'ozha a/ tsa khiitsaluchu khikh a, shen cham tsa khiitsaluchu shurin tatolash du, molucharna chIogIa chomekh' dolchu chagIaran tatolash du, tsIenchu mozan tatolash a du. Tsarna tsu chokh' masso a sto'mekh /sto'mash/ bu, sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara gechdar a du. U'sh (ialsamanin dai) tera bui guttar tsIergakh' bolcharakh (zho'zhakhatin daikh), shaina kkhakhkina khi malosh bolchu, tIakkkha tso tseran chu'irash tu'idush bolchu?

Tsarakh kh'o'ga lado'gIursh bu, sha'sh kh'o volchu'ra ara ma bevllinekh', tsara olura shaigakh' Iilma dolcha'rga: "KhIun elira tso (Mukh'ammada) khIintsa kh'alkha?" U'sh bu Dala shain degnashna tIe mukhIar to'khnarsh, shain dezarshna tIa'kh'abevlarsh.
Sha'sh nisbellarsh a - Tso sovbekhira niisachu nek'atsa, Tso delira tsarna /Delakh/ kkherar.

U'sh kh'ovsur bui sakh'te, iza shaina darakh (t1ekkhacharakh) tsIekhkh'ana? Tsu'nan /tskh'atstsa/ shartIash ma deana. Michara khir bu tsarna, iza shaina de'cha, vovshashna kh'ekham? (Tso gIo diir dats tsarna tIakkkha).

Kh'una khaalakh', kkhin dela vats sha AllakhI (tskh'a Dela) ben, gechdar dekha kh'an ledarlonashna a, mu'min bozharshna a, mu'min zudarshna a. Dela khuush vu shun dIasaiidar /diinakh'/, shun chuderzar a /busa/.

Iiman dillinchara olu: "Surat do'ssinekh'ara". Kh'ukame dolu surat dossicha, tsu chokh' tIom kh'akhiicha, kh'una gi shain degnashkakh' tsamgar ersh kh'o'ga kh'o'zhush, shena vala khorsha eanarg sanna. Tsarna vuno tamedara -
Mu'tIakh' khilar a, khaza dosh a (tam bara tsa'rgara kh'una khila). GIullakkh satsadellachukhenakh' u'sh Dele bak'liicha - dika dara-kkh tsarna.
Shu khila mega, sha'sh /iimanakh/ dIadirzicha, bo'khanig darzhadesh la'ttakh', gergarlonash khedosh?
U'sh Dala shaina neIalta'llarsh bu, tIakkkha k'ora bina Tso u'sh /bak'derg tsa khozush/, bIa'rsaza a bina /bak'derg tsa gush/.
K'ur'anakh oila tsa io tsara, ia tseran degnashkakh' dogIanash du?

Bakk'alla a, sha'sh kh'alkha khillachunna (kerstanallina) tIe iukhabirzinarsh shaina niisa nek' bilgalba'llchul tIa'kh'a - shaitIano khazdina tsarna /shain bo'kha gIullakkhash/, tso dag chu kkhu'ssush du tsarna /Delan nek'akh d1atilar/.
Iza du tsara alarna Dala dossosh derg (K'ur'an) tsa dezash khillacha'rga: "Tkho mu'tIakh' khir du shuna tskh'adolchu gIullakkhashkakh'". Dalla khuush ma iu tseran k'ailenash.
Mukha /khir du tseran kh'elash/ u'sh malikasha dIakkhalkhinchu khenakh', tsara tsarna ettash iakhkh'iikh a, bakkkhiikh a?
Iza du u'sh Dela o'gIazvokkkhuchunna tIa'kh'akhIittarna, Iza reza khilar shaina tsadezarna - tIakkkha Tso dIaiaia tseran Iamalsh.
Shain degnashkakh' tsamgar iolcharna mo'ttina-te Dala tsk'a a shain mostagIalla guchuiokkkhur iats?
Tkhuna li'cha, Okha gaitina khir bara u'sh kh'una - tIakkkha kh'una bevzina khir bara u'sh shain bilgalonashtsa. Kh'una bovzanne a bovzur bu u'sh deshan a'znashtsa. Dela khuush vu-kkh shun Iamalsh.
Okha zenne a zu'ir du shu Tkhuna shukh /Delan novk'akh' t1amtsa/ k'akh'o'gursh a, sobar diirash a bovzalts, Okha zu'ir du shun khabarsh a.

Bakk'alla a, tsateshnarsh a, Delan nek'akh /nakh/ d1atilinarsh a, shaina niisa nek' bilgalba'llachul tIa'kh'a elchantsa mostagIalla lelinarsh a - tsara khIumma zen diir ma dats Dalla, tIa'kh'a Tso dIaioiur iu tseran Iamalsh.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Dalla mu'tIakh' khila, Delan elchanna mu'tIakh' khila, shain Iamalsh ma iaia.
Bakk'alla a, tsateshnarsh, Delan nek'akh /nakh/ dIatilinarsh, tIakkkha kersta kh'olekh' bellarsh - Dala tsk'a a gechdiir dats tsarna.
Shu ledar ma dovlalash, mashare /kerstanash/ ma kkhaikkhalash, shu kh'alakh' /nu'tsk'ala/ dolush. Dela shu'tsa vu shuna, Tso eshor iats shuna shun Iamalsh.
Bakk'alla a, du'nenan dakhar lovzar a, erna khan iaiara du. Ash iiman dillakh', shu /Delakh/ kkherakh' - Tso shuna lur iu shun ial, do'khur dats shun da'khni a /dekk'a zakat dakkkhar ben/.

Tso shu'ga /derrig da'khni/ do'khush delkh'ara, shuna tIevirzina i do'khush, shu bIa'rmetsig khir dara. Tso guchudokkkhur dara /shun degnashkakh' dolu Delan novk'akh' kharzhash iar/ tsadezar (ba'rmetsigalla).

KhIai sha'sh kkhoikkhush dersh Delan novk'akh' kharzh ian - shukh bIa'rmetsig (pis) verg - shena bIa'rmetsig (pis) ma vu. Dela kh'al dolush ma vu, shu pek'arsh ma du. Shu iukhadovlakh' /iimanakh/, Tso khiitsor du shu kkhechu k'omatsa, tIakkkha u'sh khir bats shukh tera.
Bakk'alla a, Okha belira kh'una bilgala bolu tolam.
Gechdarkh'ama kh'una Dala kh'an kh'alkhaiakhana ledarlonashna, tIa'kh'akhillarg a, kkhochushdarkh'ama Shen niImat kh'una tIekh', nisvarkh'ama kh'o niisachu novk'a,
Tso kh'una deza gIo darkh'ama a.

Iza vu mu'min nekhan degnashka sinpargIato iossiinarg u'sh sovbaliitarkh'ama shain iimana tIe a iimantsa. Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a eskarsh. Khilira Dela khuush verg, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.

/I kh'ukam do Dala/ Sha chubakhiitan mu'min bozharii a, mu'min zudarii a /tseran Dalla desh dolu 1ibadat a, Delan novk'akh' shain sinoshtsa a, shain bakhamtsa a k'akh'egar bakh'anekh'/ shain bukhakhula khish a o'khush dolchu boshmashna, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttash, d1aetsan tseran vonash. Iza khilira Dalla gergakh' siilakh'-bokkkha tolam.

Iazap dan sha'sh Delakh bo'kha oilanash esh bolchu (kh'una kerstanii tIekh' tolam khir bats, bokhush) munepak' bozharshna a, munepak' zudarshna a, Delatsa nak'ostii lu'itsachu bozharshna a, Delatsa nak'ostii lu'itsachu zudarshna a. Tsarna bo'khachun go bu. O'gIazvakhana tsarna Dela, neIalt a'lla tsarna, Tso kechiina tsarna zho'zhakhati. Von khili-kkh /tseran/ dIado'rziila.
Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a eskarsh. Khilira Dela veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Bakk'alla a, Okha vakhiitina kh'o /kh1ai Mukh'ammad/ tesh khilla /k'ematdiinakh' nakhana t1ekh'/, k'aancha khilla /mu'min nakhana ialsamanitsa/, kkheramcha khilla /tsateshacharna 1azapatsa/.
Shu teshiita Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a, ash tsunna (elchanna) gIo dan a, ash iza laran a, ash Tsunna (Dalla) tasbakh' dan Iu'irantsa a, su'irentsa a.

Bakk'alla a, sha'sh kh'o'tsa dui boush chIagIo iinarsh - Delatsa dui boush chIagIo iinarsh bu. Delan ku'g tseran ku'igii tIekh' du. I /ch1ag1o/ iokhiinarg - Tso iokhosh iu shena, kkhochush iinarg Delatsa shen khilla vaIda - Tso tsunna lur iu siilakh'-iokkkha ial.

Kh'o'ga er du kkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbekh bukhabisinchara: "Tkho sovtsina tkhan bakhamo a, tkhan do'zalo a, gechdar dekhakh' tkhuna". Tsara olu mattatsa dagakh' dotsurg. Akh' ala: "Kh'an doladiir dara shuna Dalla du'kh'al tskh'anna a khIumantsa, Tsuna shuna tskh'a zen li'cha ia shuna tskh'a paida li'cha? KhIa', khili Dela ash diirig sov dika khuush.
KhIa'! Shu mo'ttush dara elcha a, mu'min nakh a shain do'zalna tIe tsk'a a bo'rzur bats a'lla. Iza khazdina shun degnashkakh'. Shuna mo'ttura von khIuma. Von k'am khili-kkh shu".
Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a tsateshnarg - bakk'alla a, Okha kechiina kerstanashna zho'zhakhati.
Delan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. Gechdo Tso Shena luuchunna, Iazap a do Tso Shena luuchunna. Khili Dela gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a.

Er du bukhabu'suchara shu khIonsana tIe do'rzuchu khenakh' i etsa: "Tkho a ditash shaina tIa'kh'akh1itta". U'sh luush bu sha'sh khiitsadan Delan dosh. Akh' ala: "Tsk'a a tkhuna tIa'kh'akhIu'ttur dats shu. Ishta a'lla Dala kh'alkha". TIakkkha tsara er du: "KhIa', tkhuna kh'agI esh du-kkh shu". KhIa', u'sh khilira tsa kkhetash kIezzig /kh1umanakh/ ben.

Tsu kkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbekh bukhabu'sucha'rga akh' ala: "TIa'kh'a shu kkhoikkhur du chIogIa nitsk' bolchu k'ome (tsu'ntsa tIom ban), tsartsa ash tIom biir bu, ia u'sh /shain laamekh' Dalla/ mu't1akh'khir bu. Shu mu'tIakh' khilakh' /Delan omrana/, Dala khaza ial lur iu shuna. Shu dIaderzakh' sha'sh kh'alkha dIa ma dirzi, Tso lazosh dolchu Iazapatsa Iazap diir du shuna".

BIa'rsa dotsuchunna k'a dats, astagIa volchunna a k'a dats, tsomgush volchunna a k'a dats /gIazote tsa bakhcha/. Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' verg - Tso vokhu'itur vu iza boshmashka, shaina bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, dIavirzinarg /Delan dinakh/ - Tso Iazap diir du tsunna lazosh dolchu Iazapatsa.

Reza khili Dela mu'min nakhana, tsara sha'sh kh'una teshame khir du, a'lla dosh lush ditta kIel, Tsunna khiira tseran degnashkakh' derg. TIakkkha Tso iossiira sinparkhato tsarna, Tso sovgIat delira tsarna gerga khir bolchu tolamtsa a,
Dukkkha khIonsashtsa a, tsara sha'sh o'tsur iolu. Khilira Dela veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.

Dala vaIda iira shuna dukkkha khIonsash - ash u'sh o'tsur iu. Tso sikhdira shuna khIara /khIons/, aidira nekhan ku'igashshuna tIera, mu'min nakhana bilgalo khiliitan /tsarna gIo khilan/, Tso shu nisdan niisachu novk'a.
Kkhin /khIonsash a khir iu shun/ shuna shena tIekh' nitsk' kkhochur botsu, Dala go bina tsarna (Dalla kha'a u'sh shun khir iuila). Khilira Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush.
Shu'tsa tIom bicha tsateshnachara - tsara /shuna shain/ bakk'ash berzor bu. (U'sh iukha bovlur bu) - tIakkkha tsarna karor vats doladiirig a, gIo'ncha a.
Delan Iadatdu iza, kh'alkha a lella dolu. Kh'una tsk'a a karor ma bats Delan Iadatna khiitsam.
Iza vu tseran ku'igash aidinarg shuna tIera, shun ku'igash /aidinarg a/ tsarna tIera Makkan BatInekh'Tso shuna tsarna tIekh' tolam bellachul tIa'kh'a. Khilira Dela ash diirig gush.

U'sh tsateshnarsh bu, shu dukhatu'ikhira tsara Dezachu ma'zhdigakh, gIurbanna doiu bezhna kkha'bira satsiina shen mettigedIakkhacharakh. Mu'min bozharii a, mu'min zudarii a tsa khillekh'ara /Makkan okhIlakh/, shuna sha'sh bevzash botsu /shuna purba lur dara Makka iokkkhush tIom ban/. KhIintsa - ash tsarna zulam diir dara, /tIakkkha/ tsa'rgara k'a kh'erchara dara shukh, tsa khuush. /Iza khilira/ Dala Shen k'inkhetam chu vakhiitarkh'ama Shena luurg. U'sh /Makkakh' bisna khilla busalbanash/ k'a'stash khillekh'ara, Okha Iazap dina khir dara tsarakh (Makkan okhIlakh) tsateshnacharna lazosh dolu Iazaptsa.

Tsateshnachara khiliitira shain degnashkakh' nu'tsk'ala o'gIazlo, zhekhIal zamanan o'gIazlo - tIakkkha Dala Shen sinparkhato iossiira Shen elchanna tIe a, mu'min nakhana tIe a, /siidartsa/ kha'rzhira tsarna /Delakh/ kkheraran dosh. U'sh khilira tsunna (Delan k'inkhetamna) vuno kh'ak' tsu'nan (Makkin) okhIlal. Dela khili masso a khIuma khuush verg.

Bak'dira Dala Shen elchanna gIanbak'dolchu'ntsa: shu danne a gIur ma du Dezachu Ma'zhdiga chu, Dala muk'alakh', kkheram botsush, shain kortosh deshna, /mekkhash, kkhin cho'sh/ latsdina, shu kkho'rur dats. Tsunna khiira shuna tsakhuurg, Tso khiliitira /shuna/ iza dotsurg gergara tolam a.
Iza vu Sha vakhiitinarg Shen elcha niisachu nek'atsa a, bak'onan dintsa a iza toliita masso a dinal. Kkhacho khilla Delatsa tesh khilar.

Mukh'ammad - Delan elcha vu, tsu'ntsa bersh chIogIa bu kerstanashna tIekh', k'inkhetame bu vovshii iukk'ekh'. Kh'una go u'sh gorau'khush, suzhud desh, sha'sh lo'khush Delera /Tsunna Iibadat dartsa/ k'inkhetam a, rezakhilar a. Tseran bilgalonash shain iakhkh'ashkakh' iu - suzhud daran asar /du iza/. Iza du kh'una tseran masal Tavrata chokh'. Tseran masal Inzhila chokh' tera du tskh'ana ialtekh: tso zazadokkkhu, tsara tsunna /to'dush, nisdesh/ gIo do, tIakkkha iza chIagIlo, nislo shen gIoda tIekh', tsetsbokhush ialta du'ish bersh, tsarna kerstanash o'gIazbakhiita. Dala vaIda iina Sha tsarakh iiman dillincharna a, dika Iamalsh iinacharna a gechdar a, siilakh'-iokkkha ial lur iu, a'lla.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Kh'alkha ma gIerta Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a, Delakh kkhera! Bakk'alla a, Dela khozush verg a vu, khuush verg a vu.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shain a'znash ai ma de paikhamaran a'znal sov, chIogIa a ma ala tsu'nga dosh, shun tskh'abolchara vovshashka chIogIa alarkh tera shun Iamalsh tsa iaia, shuna khaa tsa lush.
Bakk'alla a, shain a'znash gIeldesh bersh Delan elcha volchokh' - u'sh bu Dala shain degnash /Delakh/ kkherarna t1ekh' ziina bersh. Tsarna gechdar a du, siilakh'- iokkkha ial a iu.
Bakk'alla a, i kh'o'ga kkhoikkhush bersh tsIenoin cho'nii dekh'akh'ara - tsarakh dukkhakhbersh tsa kkhetash bu.
Tsara sobar dakh'ara kh'o shaina tIe aravallalts, tsarna dika khir ma dara. Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu'ga tskh'a pesak' stag ve'cha tskh'a khabar dakh'ash, ash bilgaldakkkhalash /tso de'narg/ ash tsa khuush tskh'ana nakhana zen tsa dan - tIakkkha shu sha'sh dinchunna tIekh' dokhkodevlla khir du.

Shuna khaalash shuna iukk'ekh' Delan elcha vuila. Dukkha dolchu gIullakkhashkakh' i shu'ga ladug1ush velkh'ara - shuna shaina khala khir dara. Delakh' a, Dala deziitina shuna iiman, Tso khazdina i shun degnashkakh', tsa deziitina shuna kerstanalla a, pesakkhalla a, Iesalla a. Izash - u'sh bu niisa lelarsh.
Delera k'inkhetamtsa a, niImatatsa a. I Dela khuush verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Mu'min nakhakh shi toba letacha, tsarna iukk'ekh' maslakh'at de. Tsu shinnakh tskh'a' vukkhanakh letachakh tsa satsakh' - tIom be /ash massara a/ otsu letachu'ntsa i Delan omrana (SharIana) tIeialts. Iza tIeiagIakh' /Delan omrana/, - maslakh'at de tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' niisontsa. Ash niiso elash. Bakk'alla a, Dalla beza niiso esh bersh.
Bakk'alla a, mu'min nakh - vezharii bu. Maslakh'at de shain shina /dovdechu/ veshina iukk'ekh'. Delakh kkhera, shukh k'inkhetam ban megara.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Tskh'a nakh kkhechu nakhakh tsa beshash ma khu'liila, u'sh tsaral dika khila a mega, zudarii a ma khu'liila kkhechu zudarekh tsa beshash, u'sh tsaral dika khila a mega, vovshiin kkhachambatsarsh ma lekhalash, vovshashna /tsa eza/ tsIersh a ma tekhkalash. Von tsIe iu pesakkhalla iimanal tIa'kh'a. /Tsul tIa'kh'a/ toba tsa dinarsh - u'sh zulamkhoi bu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Genadovla dukkhadolchu mottaluchu (dagadogIuchu) khIumanekh. Tskh'a dolu mottalu khIumanashk'a du. Vovshashna ma teIalash /k'ailakha khIuma khaa gIertash/, shukh tskh'abersh vukkharekh tIekh'ashkha ma lelash, shukh tskh'anna a dezii shen veshin zhizhig daa, i velcha? - shuna iza tsa diizi. Delakh kkheralash. Bakk'alla a, Dela toba dukkha k'obal diirig a vu, /dukkha/ k'inkhetame verg a vu /dokhkova'lla Shega toba dinchunna/.

KhIai nakh! Bakk'alla a, Okha shu kkho'llina stagakh a, zudchukh a, khiliitina shukh khalk'ash a, taipanash a shu vovshashna dovziita. Bakk'alla a, shukh Dalla gergakh' uggar siilakh' verg - shukh uggar /Delakh/ kkho'rush verg vu-kkh. Bakk'alla a, Dela /shu/ devzash vu, sov dika khuush vu.

Kkhelkhash lelachu Ia'rbashaelira: "Iimandillina Okha". Akh' ala: "Iiman tsa dillina ash, delakh' a, ash alalash: "Mu'tIakh' khili tkho". KhIintsa a iiman tsa dakhna shun degnashka. Shu Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' khilakh' - shun Iamalekh khIumma eshor ma iats Tso. Bakk'alla a, Dela tIettIa gechdesh verg a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Bakk'alla a, mu'min nakh bu sha'sh iiman dillinarsh Dele a, Tsu'nan elchane a, tIakkkha sheko tsa esh, shain bakhamtsa a, shain sinoshtsa a Delan novk'akh' k'akh'egnarsh. U'sh bu bak'lu'ish bersh.
Akh' ala: "Ash Iamado Dalla shain din? Dela khuush ma vu stiglanashkakh' derg a, la'ttakh' derg a. Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg ma vu".

Kh'una bakkkhiibo' bu u'sh sha'sh busalba khilarna. Akh' ala: "Suna dakkkhii ma do' sha'sh busalba din t1elatsarna". KhIa', Dela k'inkhetam besh vu shukh - shu nisdina iimanna tIe, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'.
Bakk'alla a, Dalla kha'a stiglaniin a, la'ttan a kh'ulamekh' derg. Dela gush derg ma vu ash diirig.
K'af. Siilakh' dolchu K'ur'anora /kh'o Delan elcha ma vu/.
KhIa', ma tsetsbevli u'sh shaiga shain iukk'era kkheramcha varakh, kerstanasha elira: "KhIara tamashe khIuma du:
Vai delcha, vaikh topparkhilcha, /vai dendiir du bokhurg/ - iza dukkha genara dukhaderzar du".
Tkhuna khiira mel la'tto tsarakh dIakh'osh bu- Tkho'gakh' Ialashdesh dolu zhainama du.
Tsara khartsdira bak'derg (K'ur'an) iza shaiga de'nachul tIa'kh'a, tIakkkha u'sh dukkha kegadellachu gIullakkhekh' bu-kkh.
U'sh tsa kh'ovsu shaina tIekhula /la'ttachu/ stigale, mukha khIottiina Okha iza /tskh'a a bIogIam a botsush, mukha/ khaziina, tsu'nan tskh'a a Iu'rg a ma dats.
Latta a darzhina Okha, tsu chokh' dikhkina Okha la'mnash, tsu chokh' ialiitina Okha masso a khazchu shinnakh/oramatash/.
Gar a, kh'ekham a khilla /khiliitina Okha u'sh/ masso a /Tkhuna tobantsa/ t1evo'rzachu lena.
Okha dossiira stiglara berkate khilla dolu khi, tsu'ntsa Okha ialiitina boshmash a, ialtan bu'rtig a.
Dekha (lekkha) khurmanan dittash, shain tIettIa (mog1arshtsa) sto'm a bolush.
/Delan/ leshna ritsk' a khilla. Tsu'ntsa (dogIitsa) Okha denbina bella bolu mokhk. Ishtta /khir/ du /shun keshnii chu'ra/ aradovlar a.
Khartsdira /bak'dolu din/ tsaral kh'alkha Nukh'an k'omo a, Rassandaisha a, Samudashaa,
Iadashaa, FirIavno a, LutIan vezharsha a,
Aikatandaisha a, TubbaIank'omo a /Tsara/ massara a khartsbira elchanash - bak' khilira San / tsarna kkheram tasartsa / iina va1da.
Nitsk' tsa kkhochush disira Tkho kh'alkha kkhollarekh' /stiglanash a, latta a/? KhIa', u'sh shekonekh' bu kerlachu kkhollarakh (denbarkh).
Okha kkho'llira adam, Tkhuna kha'a tsu'nan sino kkhu'ssu vasvasalla. Tkho gerga du tsunna /shen/ lagan pkhal a.
TIeo'tsu /stago diirig/ shino tIeo'tsuchu /maliko/, a'ttu agIorakh' a, a'rru agIorakh' a, /sha'sh/ khevzhina dolush.
Tskh'a a dosh olush ma dats tso shena gergakh' kiicha volu tergal desh verg volush ben (dIaiazdesh malik).
Valaran vakhordeara /ekhartan gIullakkh/ bak' khilartsa. Iza dara kh'o shekh vodush (kkho'rush) verg.
Sur lekkhira - iza du sha /Dala kerstanashna Iazap diir du a'lla/ vaIda iina de.
Deara masso a sa shetsa dIalollurg a, tesh a volush (shetsa malikash a dolush).
Kh'o khillera kh'okkhunakh gIovpal volush /tidame tsa o'tsush/ - Okha aidira kh'an /bIa'rgii/ tIera kirkh'a - takhana kh'an bIa'rsa ira khilira.
Elira tsu'nan nak'osto (tsunna tIe khIottinchu maliko): "KhIara du so'gakh' /kh'una/ kechdinarg" - /zho'zhakhatin Iazap/.
/Omra khir du/: "Ash shimmo (tIekhIo'ttinchu malikasha) kkhossa zho'zhakhati chu masso a nu'tsk'ala /du'kh'al/ volu kersta.
Dikanakh /nakh/ dukhatukhush khilla volu, dozanakh va'lla khilla volu, /dinekh' nakhe/ sheko ioitush khilla volu.
Iza vu sha Delatsa kkhin dela khiliitinarg, ash shimmo (omra shina malike du) kkhossa iza chIogIachu Iazapa chu".
Tsu'nan nak'ostoelira: "Tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhoburg! As tsa tilina iza, tek iza sha khili-kkh genarchu tilar chokh'".
Elira /Dala/: "Ash ma k'iisa Suna gergakh'. As kh'alkha /du'nenakh'/ bakhiitira shuna San kkheram.
Dosh khiitsor dats Suna gergakh'. So vats zulamash diir dolush San leshna".
Otsu diinakh' Okha er du zho'zhakhatiga: "Kh'o iu'znii?" Tso er: "Kkhin sov bui?" /chubakhka/.
Gergaialira ialsamani /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna gena iotsush.
KhIara du shuna khir du a'llarg- kh1or /toba dartsa/ Dalla tIe vo'rzuchunna, /din/ Ialashdechunna.
K'inkhetame volchukh kkho'rush khillachunna, Iza shena gush votstsushekh', Sha /Dalla tIe/ do'rzuchu dagtsa veana volchu.
ChugIo tsunna mashartsa! KhIara du guttarenan de.
Tsarna shaina mel dezarg du tsu chokh'. Tkho'gakh' tIetokha a du.
Mel /dukkha/ khIallakiina Okha tsaral kh'alkha tIa'kh'enash, u'sh tsaral vuno a chIogIa a iolush nitsk'atsa. U'sh dIaskh'aiidira makhkakhula, iui tekh'a /valarkh/ kIelkh'arbovla mettig?
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' kh'ekham bu-kkh shen dog dolchunna, ia sha lerg dillinchunna /ladogIa/, sha tesh a volush.
Okha kkho'llira stiglanash a, latta a, tsu shinnan iukk'ekh' mel derg a ialkh diinakh', Tkhokh tsa kh'akkhadelira tskh'a a kIaddalar.
Akh' sobar de tsara du'itsuchunna tIekh', tasbakh' de kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhoburg khastortsa malkh skh'akkhetale a, dIabuzale a.
Bu'isanakh a - tasbakh' de Tsunna, suzhdaniin (lamaziin) tIa'kh'a a.
LadogIa otsu diinakh' kkhoikkhuchun (Israfil malikan) kkhaikkhare (sur lakkhare stigalna) gerga iolchu mettera (Baitul mak'disera).
Otsu diinakh' tsarna khozur bu mokh' (Israfil maliko sholgIa zurna lokkhush iukha denbar) bak'desh. Iza aradovlu de du /keshnashkara/.
Bakk'alla a, Okha denbo, Okha bolu'itu, Tkhuna tIe du dIaderzar a.
Otsu diinakh' latta dedar du tsarakh, /u'sh/ sikhlush /sha'sh kkhoikkhuchunna tIe/. Iza guldar Tkhuna atta du.
Tkho dika khuush du tsara olurg. Kh'o vats tsarna tIekh' nitsk' biirig. Kh'ekham be K'ur'antsa San kkheramakh kkho'rush volchunna.
Darzhosh dolchekh/dui bou As/ darzhorakh tera.
Mokh' d1asalelosh dolcharakh/dui bou As/.
Lelash dolcharakh atta /dui bou As/.
GIullakkh do'k'ush dolcharakha /dui bou As/:
Shuna esh iolu vaIda bak'erg ma iu.
Bekkham d1akhIuttur bolush ma bu.
Stiglakh /dui bou As/, shena /sedarchii dIasalela/ nek'ash dolchu.
Bakk'alla a, shu taip-taipachu dashekh'ma du.
Iekho tsunakhsha Iekhvellarg /shaitIano Iekhiinarg/
Baiina /neIalt a'lla/ khartslu'ish bersh.
Sha'sh zhekhIallina chokh' gIovpal khillarsh.
Tsara kho'ttu: "Matsa khir du bekkhaman de?"
Otsu diinakh' u'sh tsIarna tIekh' pitanelu'itsur ma bu. /Zho'zhakhate lokhkur ma bu/.
"Iovsha shain pitana- /olush/. - KhIara du i sha ash sikhdesh khillarg". (Zho'zhakhatin Iazap).
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rursh boshmashkakh' a, shovdanashkakh' a /khir/ bu
O'tsush sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobucho shaina dellarg. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira tsul kh'alkha dikanig desh.
U'sh khilira kIezzig ben dotsush busa sha'sh nab iar.
TIa'khkh'a busa shaina /Dele/ gechdar do'khush.
Shain da'khnina (kh'ola) chokh' kh'ak' dolush do'khuchunna a, sha /ritsk'akh/ khadiina volchunnaa.
La'ttakh' a delilsh ma du /ch1og1a Delakh/ teshacharna.
Shu sha'shkakh' a /delilsh du/, shuna tsa go?
Stiglakh' du shun ritsk' a (dogIa, shetsa derrig khIuma kkhu'u), shuna khir du a'llarg a. (Ash iinchu Iamalashna du'kh'al bekkham).
Stigal a, latta a Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh /dui bou As/ iza bak' ma du, shu khabar du'itsush khilar sanna.
Kh'o'ga khabar de'nii /ia Mukh'ammad/ IbrakhIiman siilakh' kh'eshekh la'tsna?
Oila e! U'shcho'kh'a bevlira i volchu, tsara elira: "Salam!" Tso elira: "Salam", /shega elira tso/: "Tsa bevza nakh /bu-kkh/".
Iza (IbrakhIim) vakhara shen nakh bolchu, veara derstana esa dalosh /kh'eshashna daia/.
Tso iza (esa dina, tsu'nan kkharziina ia kkhakhkiina zhizhig) tsarna gergaoziira, elira: "Ash tsa dou?"
Iza tsarakh kkheravelira. Tsara elira: "Ma kkhera!" Tsara tsunna kkha' ba'kkkhira, kh'ek'ale volu kIant /Iskh'ak'/ khir vu a'lla.
Du'kh'alieara tsu'nan zuda, chIogIa mokh' bettash, tso shen iu'kh'akh tIara dettara, olura: "Ber tsa khu'lu k'ena zuda iui sha-m!"
Tsara elira: "Ishtta a'lla kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobucho. Bakk'alla a, Iza kh'ukame verg a vu, khuush verg a vu".
Tso (IbrakhIima) elira: "Shun khIun gIullakkh du, khIai daiitinarsh?"
Tsara elira: "Tkho daiitina k'inosh dechu k'omana tIe.
Tsarna daiita topparantIulgash
Kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchunna (Dalla) gergakh' tIalamza bolcharna bilgaldina khilla dolu".
Okha araba'khira tsu chokh'khilla bolu mu'min nakh.
Tkhuna tsa kariira tsu chokh' /Dalla/ mu'tIakh' bolcharakh tskh'a tsIa ben.
Okha ditira tsu chokh' delillazosh dolchu Iazapakh kkho'rush bolcharna.
Musagakh' a /delil ditira Okha/, Okha vakhiiticha iza FirIavna tIe bilgalchu bak'ontsa.
Iza (FirIavn) iukharvelira shen bIotsa /Musan din tIe tsa lotsush/, elira: "Bozbuuncha vu, ia zhinekh vu".
Okha skh'aletsira iza a, tsu'nan eskar a, kkho'ssira u'sh khIorda chu, iza (FirIavn) shen bekhk bakkkha kh'ak' dolush vu /sha elchane iiman tsa dillarna, sha Dela vu bakharna/.
Iadashkakh' a /delil du shuna/ Okha bakhiitira tsarna shain tIa'kh'e khadosh bolu mokh. (Shetsa dogIa dotsu, berkat dotsu mokh).
Tsa iu'tush sha tIe kkha'chna iolu khIuma iakhka ella khIuma ioi ben.
Samudashkakh' a /du delilsh/. Tsa'rga elira: "/Du'nentsa zovkkh kh'o'gush/ dakha /sha'sh kh1allakdaran/ khan tIekkhachchalts".
Sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun gIullakkhakh dIabirzira u'sh, u'sh skh'aletsira mokh'o, sha'sh kh'o'zhush la'ttash.
Tsarna tsa megira gIovta a, shaina gIo desh a tsa khilira u'sh.
Nukh'an k'omakh a kh'alkha /khilira delil/. U'sh khilira pesak' k'am.
Stigal Okha iu'gIiira ku'igashtsa (nitsk'atsa). Bakk'alla a, Tkho nitsk' kkhochush du.
Latta darzhira Okha, Tkho dika darzhosh dersh du.
Masso a khIumanakh Okha kkho'llira shish, ash oila er iatsara-te.
/Elira Nukh'as/: "D1adovda Dele. So shuna Tsu'ngara bilgala kkheramcha vu.
Ma khiliita Delatsa kkhin dela. So shuna Tsu'ngara bilgala kkheramcha vu".
Ishtta tsa veana tsaral kh'alkha khillacha'rga a tskh'a a elcha, tsara olush ben: "Bozbuuncha vu, ia zhinekh vu".
Tsara vovshashna tsu'ntsa veset dora-te? KhIa'. U'sh dozanekh da'lla k'am du-kkh.
Iukhavala tsarakh (d1atasa u'sh), kh'una bekhk bu'llur bats.
Kh'ekham be, kh'ekhamo paida bo mu'min nakhana.
As tsa kkho'llina zhinash a, adamash a Saina Iibadatdan ben.
Suna tsa deza tsa'rgara tskh'a a ritsk', Suna tsa deza tsara suna daar dalar.
Bakk'alla a, Dela vu tIettIa ritsk' lush verg a, nitsk' berg, chIogIa verg a.
Bakk'alla a, zulam dinacharna /Iazapakh/ dak'a du, shain /kh'alkha khillachu/ nak'ostiin dek'akh terra, So sikh ma voila tsara /Iazap dosson/.
Bala bu tsateshnacharna shaina vaIda iina iolchu shain diinera.
Lamanakh/dui bou As/.
MogIanashtsa iazdinchu zhainakha /dui bou As/,
Sha darzhiinachu anniitIekh' /iazdina/ khilla dolchu,
Shena ziiarat dechu tsIiinakha /dui bou As/,
Aibina khilla bolchu tkhovakh (stigalakh) a /dui bou As/,
/K'ematdiinakh' tsIarakh/ bu'zzina khir bolchu khIordakh a:
Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun Iazap do'zhna ma du (dogIur dolush ma du).
Ma dats tsunna sha dukhatukhurg.
/Otsu k'emat/diinakh' stigal dIatokhalur iu tokhaialartsa,
La'mnash a dIadolalur du dIadoladalartsa,
Bala bu-kkh otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna,
Sha'sh khartsonchokh' lovzush bolchu.
Otsu diinakh' u'sh kkhoikkhur bu zho'zhakhatin tsIarga kkhaikkhartsa.
/Er du tsa'rga/: "KhIara iu i tsIe, shu sha kharts'esh khilla iolu.
Bozbuunchalla du khIara ia shu tsa gush du?
Daga tsu chokh', sobar de ia ma de - tskh'aterra du shuna. Shuna bekkham besh bu ash esh khillachu Iamalshtsa".
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh - /ialsamanin/ boshmashkakh' a, niImatashkakh' a khir bu
Zovkkh kh'o'gush sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobucho shaina dellachu'ntsa. Sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobucho zho'zhakhatin Iazapakh larbina u'sh.
/Er du tsa'rga/: "GIoza daa, g1oza mala shaina sha'sh esh khillachu Iamalsh bakh'anekh'".
Vovshashtsa mogIarshtsa la'ttachu ma'nganii tIe tevzhina /khir bu u'sh/. Okha balor bu tsarna kh'ural Iinash.

Sha'sh iiman dillina khilla bersh, shain zu'rret a iimantsa shaina tIa'kh'akhIittina khillarsh - tsarna tIekkhior du Okha tseran zu'rret a. Tseran Iamalekh khIumma a eshor a iats Okha. Masso a stag a sha /du'nenakh'/ karadinchu'ntsa zak'alt vu.
Okha /khan mel eli/ lattor bu tsarna sto'mash a, zhizhig a tsarna dezash khillachukh.
Tsara vovshashka kkhiidor bu chagIaran kad, shetsa /i molush/ da'ssa k'amelash dotsush, k'a a dotsush bolu.
Tsarna /gIullakkh desh/ tIekh'iizar bu kIentii-ialkhoi, sha'sh Ialashdesh dolu lu'lu' sanna bolu.
Tsarakh tskh'abersh vukkharna tIebo'rzur bu, kho'ttush.
Tsara er du: "Bakk'alla a, tkho ma dara kh'alkha tkhan do'zalakh kkho'rush (u'sh khIallakkhilarna).
Dala k'inkhetam bina tkhokh. Tso kIelkh'arda'khna tkho samymanIazapakh.
Bakk'alla a, tkho dara kh'alkha /du'nenakh'/ Tsu'nga doIanash desh. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu dikanig a, kkhinkhetame verg a".
/Kerstanashna/ kkheram tasarna tIekh' daim latta! Kh'an Delan niImatatsa kh'o vats bozbuuncha a, zhiniikh verg a.
Ia tsara olu: "Illancha vu. Kh'ovsar vai - zamano dIalistar vu iza".
Akh' ala: "Kh'ovsa shu. So a shu'tsa tskh'ana kh'ovsacharakh vu".
Ia tseran nabaran gIenasha kh'o'khush du-te i tsarna, ia iza dozanakh da'lla k'am du-te?
Ia tsara olu: "Tso kkho'llina iza?" KhIa', u'sh tsa tesha-kkh.
Tsunakh tera diitsar dakh'iila tsara, sha'sh bak'lu'ish belakh'!
Ia u'sh khIumma iotschu khIumanakh kkho'llina bu, ia u'sh sha'sh bu kkhullursh?
Ia tsara kkho'llina stiglanash a, latta a? KhIa', bakk'alla a, ch1og1a teshash bats u'sh.
Ia tsa'rgakh' iu kh'an Delan khaznash, ia u'sh bu urkhalla desh?
Ia tsa'rgakh' lami bu, /u'sh shetsa Iarsh tIe bovlush/, ladugIush tsu chokh' /du'itsuchu'nga/? Skh'adaloila tseran ladugIucho bilgala delil!
Ia Tsu'nan mekhkarii bu, shuna kIentii bu?
Ia akh' tsa'rga makh bo'khu, u'sh dekkharsha bazbina bolush?
Ia tsa'rgakh' k'aile iu, tsara dIaiazdesh?
Ia mekarlo ezash bu u'sh? Tsa teshash khillarsh - tsarna iina mekarlo!
Ia tseran AllakhI (ts1e iolu tskh'a Dela) votsurg kkhin dela vu? TsIena vu i Dela tsara /Shetsa/ nak'ost latsarkh!
Tsarna stiglara okh'aiogIush kiisakash gichi a, tsara er ma dara: "TIettIa iolu markha iu".
Bita u'sh, shegakh' tk'es iolu shain denna du'kh'alkkhettalts.
Otsu diinakh' tseran mekarlos tskh'anna khIumanakh kIelkh'arbokhur bats u'sh, tsarna gIo khir dats!
Bakk'alla a, zulam dinacharna tsul sovnakha Iazap khir du, delakh' a, tsarakh dukkhakhbolcharna tsa kha'a-kkh.
Kh'an Delan kh'ukamna sobare khila. Kh'o Tkhan bIa'rgii kh'alkhakh' vu (Okha larvesh vu kh'o). Akh' kh'an Dalla khastam besh tasbakh' de, kh'uo kh'alagIetticha.
Busa a tasbakh' de Tsunna, sedarchii dIatilash a /de tasbakh'/.
Sedakh /dui bou As/, iza /lakkhara/ okh'abuzhush:
Nek'akh d1a tsa tili shun nak'ost (Mukh'ammad paikhamar), gala a tsa veli.
Tso tsa du'itsu shegara /shena dezarg/-
Iza dekk'a vekh'ii du, tsu'nga dIakhou'itush dolu /Dala/.
Iza (Mukh'ammad paikhamar) Iamiina sha nitsk'atsa chIogIa dolcho.
Shegakh' nitsk' bolcho. Iza (Dzhabrail malik) niissa dIakhIo'ttira.
Sha lekkhachu anakh'dolush.
TIakkkha iza gergakhilira /Mukh'ammad paikhamarna adamiin ku'tsekh'/, kkhin tIekh gergadera, /elchane vekh'ii dakh'ash/.
Iza khilira /gergakh'/ shina Iadan baramekh', ia kkhin gerga.
Ishtta vekh'i dakh'iitira Tso Shen lega, Sha dakh'iitinarg.
Kharts tsa dira /paikhamaran/ dago shena ginarg.
Tk'a ash k'uisu tsu'ntsa (paikhamartsa) tsunna ginchu'ntsa?
Tsunna (Mukh'ammad paikhamarna) iza gira kkhin a okh'adossarekh'(kkhin tsk'a dussush).
Chakkhenan /dozanan/ lotos dittana gergakh'.
Tsunna gergakh' iu /ialsamanin/ chugIoilan besh.
/Mukh'ammad paikhamarna gira i ditt sha tamashe/ kh1umnashakh'uldechu khenakh'.
DIa tsa tilina /paikhamaran/ bIa'rsa, dozanakh tsa da'lla.
Tsunna gira shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun dakkkhiichu aiatekh /aiatash/.
Ash diitsal suna Al-latakh a, Al-Iuzzakh a,
Kkhin kkhozlagIa Manatakha. /Bui tseran Delan sanna nitsk'?/
Tk'a shuna bozhaberash du, Tsunna zudaberash du?
Iza dek'aza dak'a ma du.

U'sh ekk'a tsIersh iu asha a, shun daisha a tekhkina iolu. Dala tskh'a a bak'o tsa iossina /tsarakh la'tsna/. U'sh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma bu dekk'a shain mottalush dolchunna a, /shain/ degnashna dezachunna a. Tsa'rga ma beana shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara niisa nek'.
Ia adamna shena dezarg du?
Delan iu tIa'kh'arnig (ekhart) a, kh'alkharnig (du'ne) a.
Masa malik du stiglanashkakh', shain shapaIatasha khIumma a kIelkh'ardokhur dotsush, Dala Shena luuchunna purba delcha a ben, I reza khilcha a ben!!
Bakk'alla a, ekhartakh tsateshachara iokkkhu malikekh zudariin tsIe.
Tsu'ntsa tskh'a a Iilma ma dats tseran. U'sh tIa'kh'akhIu'ttush ma bu dekk'a mottarna. Tk'a mottaro khIumma a kh'alkhadokkkhur ma dats bak'dolchukh.
Kh'o dIaverza Tkhan kh'ekhamakh iukhavellachukh, du'nenan dakhar ben shena tsa dezash volchukh.
Iza iu tseran Iilmanakh kkhiaran darzh. Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhoburg (kh'an Dela) -Iza vu dika khuush Shen nek'akh tilavellarg a, Iza vu dika khuush sha nisvellarg a.
Delan du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg Tso bekkham barkh'ama von khillacharna tsara dinchu'ntsa, Tso bekkham ban dika khillacharna uggar dikachu'ntsa.

Ishttanash bu u'sh, sha'sh genabovlush k'inoikh dakkkhicharakh a, bo'khuchukh a, kegiinash ben /tsa dolu'itush shaigara/. Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhoburg Shegakh' shortta gechdar dolush vu-kkh. Iza dika khuush vu shukh derg shu Sha la'ttakh kkhulluchu khenakh' a, shu shain nanoin kiirakh' khIu dolchu khenakh' a. Sha'sh tsIan ma de -Tsunna dika vevzash vu /Delakh/ kkho'rush verg!
Diitsal /khIai Mukh'ammad/ tsu /imanakh/ iukhava'llachukh.
KIezzig /sagIa/ dellarg, tIakkkha dIak'evlinarg /sagIa tsa lush/?
Tk'a tsu'ngakh' du-te k'ailenan Iilma, tsunna gan gush?
Ia tsu'nga tsa diitsina-te Musan zhainashkakh' derg?
IbrakhIiman a /zhainashkakh' derg/, sha kkhochushdina khilla volchu /shena Dala tIedikhkinarsh/
/Tsu'nga tsa diitsina-te/: kh'ur bats kh'ocho kkhechun mokh', a'lla,
Dats adamna sha k'akh'egnarg ben, a'lla,
Tsu'nan k'akh'egar tIa'kh'a gur du, a'lla,
TIa'kh'a khir bu tsunna sov niisa bolu bekkham, a'lla,
Kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga iu /kh'an/ chakkhe, a'lla,
Bakk'alla a, Iza vu vo'lu'iturg a, /Iza vu/ vo'lkhu'iturg, a'lla.
Bakk'alla a, Iza vu volu'iturg a, /Iza vu/ denviirig, a'lla,
Bakk'alla a, Tso kkho'llina shishsha -bo'rsha a, ste a, a'lla.
/Tskh'ana/ tIadamakh, iza kkhossabelcha /nenan kiirakh' dolchu beran tsIa chu/, a'lla.
Tsunna tIekh' kkhin tskh'a kkhollar (bellarsh denbar) du, a'lla.
Bakk'alla a, Iza vu, a'lla, kh'al dellarg a, /shega/ tardaitinarg a /ritsk'/.
Bakk'alla a, Iza vu SiriustsIe iolu seda Kkhoburg (tsu'nan Dela a), a'lla.
Bakk'alla a, Iza vu a'lla Sha khIallakbinarg kh'alkhalera Iadash.
Samudash a, /tskh'a a/ bukha tsa vitira /tsarakh/,
Nukh'an k'am a, kh'alkha. Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira vuno zulame a, vuno dozanekh bevlla a.
Mu'tafikata kh'alaia'kkkhina okh'atu'ikhira Tso.
DIakh'uliira Tso u'sh, Sha dIakh'uliinarg.
Kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkhachu niImatatsa k'u'isu akh', /khIai adam/?
KhIara (Mukh'ammad paikhamar) kkheramcha vu kh'alkhalerchu kkheramchekh volush.
TIekkhechi tsIekhkh'ana tIekkhochurg (k'ematde).
Ma vats tsunna Dela votsurg dIado'llush verg.
Tk'a tsu khabarkh a tsetsdovlu shu?
Do'lu shu? Tsa do'lkhu shu?
Ma tIalamza du shu (shain khan erna ioiush)!
Ash Dalla suzhd de, /Tsunna/ Iibadat a de!
Gergadeana sakh't (k'ematde), butt akhba'llera.
Shaina delil (muIzhizat) gichi a, u'sh (tsatesharsh) iukhabovlu /imanakh/, tsara olu: "Dakhdella bozbuunchalla du".
Tsara khartsdira /paikhamar vaiitar/, u'sh tIa'kh'aba'zira shain dezarshna. Masso a gIullakkh /dikanig a, vonig a/ chIagIdella du /shen to'khna khan iolush/.
Tsa'rga deara mai khabarsh /kh'alkhalera Delakh tsa teshash khilla bolu nakh khIallakbarakh la'tsna dolu/, shaina chokh' /u'sh k'inakh/ iukhaozar a dolush.
KIorggara kh'ikmat a /deara tsa'rga/. Paida tsa bora kkheramasha (kh'ekhamasha).
Genavala tsarakh, /bita u'sh/ kkhoikkhuchotsa dezachu khIumane sha'sh kkhoikkhu /k'emat/de t1ekkhachchalts.
BIa'rgash kh'etIaba'lla /dukkha kkherabalarna/, arabovlur bu u'sh keshnashkara, da'rzhina tsIoz sanna
/Shaiga/ kkhoikkhush volchunna /tIe kkhacha/ sikhbevlla. /Etstsakh'/ tsateshachara er du: "Ma khala de du-kkh khIara!"
Khartsdira /din/ tsaral (k'uraishal) kh'alkha Nukh'an k'omo. Tsara khartsvira Tkhan lai /Nukh'/, elira: "Zhiniikh vu iza", tIakkkha iza dIaekkkhira.
TIakkkha tso kkhiikkhira sha Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga: "Bakk'alla a, so eshiina. Akh' gIo de-kh'a suna!"
TIakkkha Okha dIaellira stiglanan neIarsh dIakkhu'ssush dolchu khitsa.
La'ttakh skh'adekhira Okha kh'ostash, khi vovshakhkkhiitira sha iazdella khilla dolchu omrana tIekh'.
Okha dIava'kh'ira iza (Nukh' kema tIekh') annash a, kh'ostamash a dolchu.
Iza (kema) dIaikhara Tkhan bIa'rgii kh'alkhakh'sha khartsvinakhillacheran bekkhamna.
Okha ditira izadelil khilla, vui tskh'a a iza tergal desh verg?
Mukha dara San Iazap a, kkheramtasar a?
Okha atta dira K'ur'an dagalatsa. Vui tskh'a a dagalotsurg?
Khartsdira /din/ Iadasha a. Mukha khilira San Iazap a, kkheramtasar a?
Okha bakhiitira tsarna shok lo'kkhu mokh dakhdellachu dek'azchu diinakh'.
Tso skh'abokhura nakh /sha'sh bolchu'ra/, u'sh bu'sush /la'ttakh/ skh'adokhush dolu khurmanan dittiin oramash sanna.
Mukha khilira San Iazap a, kkheramtasar a?
Okha atta dira K'ur'an dagalatsan. Vui tskh'a a dagalotsurg?
Khartsbira samudasha a kkheramash (kh'ekhamash).
Tsara (samudasha) elira: "Tkhaikh tskh'ana adamna tIa'kh'adezar du tkho? TIakkkha-m khir ma dara tkho tilar chokh' a, siizallina chokh' a.
/Tsara elira/:"Vaina iukk'era /dekk'a/ tsu'nga dossiina vekh'ii? KhIa-khIa! Iza vu-kkh /sov/ khartslu'ish dozalla desh verg".
Khuur du tsarna kkhana, mila vu /sov/ khartslu'ish dozalla desh verg.
Okha iokhu'itur emkal tsarna pitna khilla. Kh'o kh'azhal tsa'rga /khIai Salikh'/, sobare a khilla.
Ala tsa'rga, khi dek'na khir du tsarna iuk'akh': khIoranna a shen malar khir du /shen khenakh'/.
Tsara kkhiikkhira shain nak'oste, Tso /shen ku'iga/ skh'aiitsira /sha'lta/, /emkalna/ kh'ekkhira.
Mukha khilira San Iazap a, kkheramtasar a?
Okha bakhiitira tsarna tIe tskh'a /chIogIa/ mokh' -u'sh /bella/ bisira, /shen bezhnashna/ kert iinchun iak'aella /dechigan/ iu'khkash sanna.
Okha atta dira K'ur'an dagalatsa. Vui tskh'a a dagalotsurg?
Khartsdira LutIan k'omo kkheramash (kh'ekhamash).
Okha bakhiitira tsarna tIe tIulgash kh'osh bolu mokh, LutIan do'zal iuk'ara- bokkkhush. U'sh kIelkh'arba'khira Okha satosush
Tkhaigara k'inkhetamtsa. Ishtta bekkham bo Okha shukr dechunna.
Tso (LutIas) kkheram tesira tsarna Tkhan nitsk'atsa -tsara sheko iira kkheram tasarkh.
Tsu'ngara (LutIera) tsu'nan kh'eshii skh'abakha kh'evsira u'sh-Okha bIa'rsa skh'aiitsira tseran, /elira/: "KhIintsa Iovsha shaina San Iazap a, San kkheram a".
Skh'aletsira u'sh Iu'irana chIagIdellachu Iazapo.
"Iovsha shaina San Iazap a, San kkheram a".
Okha atta dira K'ur'an dagalatsa, vui tskh'a a dagalotsurg?
FirIavnan okhIlana tIe a ba'khkira kkheramchash.
Tsara khartsdira Tkhan aiatash derrige a -Okha skh'aletsira u'sh Veza volchun, nitsk' Bolchun skh'alatsartsa.
Shun tsatesharsh dika bu tsaral /khIai k'uraishash/ ia shu tsIena khilaran bak'o iu Zuburiichokh'?
Ia tsara (Abu DzhakhIla i sannachara) olu: "Vai derrig /tskh'ana khilcha/, to'lur du /Mukh'ammadal/",
Berrig /u'sh/ eshor bu -bovdur bu u'sh.
KhIa', sakh't (k'ematde) du tsarna to'khna khan. I sakh't vuno ircha a du, vuno k'a'kh'a a du.
Bakk'alla a, k'inosh dinarsh /du'nenakh'/ kh'ere a, /ekhartakh'/ zho'zhakhatin tsIergakh' begar bolush ma bu.
Otsu diinakh' u'sh takkhor ma bu shain iakhkh'ii tIekh' tsIerga. /Er du/: "Iovsha shaina sak'arakhkh'akkhadalar!"
Okha masso a khIuma kkho'llina shen baramekh'.
Tkhan omra-m tskh'a /dosh/ ben dats, bIa'rnegIar tokhar sanna.
Okha khIallakiira shukh tera tobanash -vui tskh'a a dagalotsurg?
Masso a tsara dina dolu khIuma Zuburii chokh' du.
Masso a zhimanig, masso a dokkkhanig dIaiazdella du.
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh boshmashna chokh' a, khishkakh' a khir bu,
Bak'dergdolchakh', Nitsk' bolchu Pachchakh'an (Delan) gergakh' /khir bu u'sh/.
Sov k'inkhetame verg.
Tso Iamadina /Shen paikhamarna/ K'ur'an.
Tso kkho'llina adam.
Tso Iamadina tsunna (adamna) khaar.
Malkh a, butt a /Tsu'nan/ kh'esapatsa /dIasalelash/ bu.
Sedaa, ditt a /Tsunna/ suzhud desh du.
Stigal - Tso iza aiiina, miiza-terza dIakhIottina.
Shu'ga khartso tsa iaita /terzantsa/ ozarekh'.
Ozar-dustar khIottade niisontsa, esha ma e terza!
Latta a dIadarzhina Tso /Shen/ Ialamna!
Tsunna (latta) tIekh' sto'mash skh'abolu, kedalgash dolu khurmanan ditt a /skh'adolu/.
Cha-gIad dolubu'rtigash a, khaza kh'ozha iolu batstsash a /skh'aiolu la'ttakh/.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tso kkho'llira adam bek'achu popparakh, kkhiira pkh'egI sanna (popparan pkh'egI sanna).
Tso kkho'llira zhin kIura tsa boluchu (tsIenchu) tsIerakh.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Shinamalkhbalen a Dela vu Iza, shina malkhbuzen a Dela vu.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tso pargIat bitira Shi khIord /du'ra berg a, teza berg a/ vovshashtsa tskh'a'nakkheta.
Tsarna shinna iukk'ekh' du'kh'alo iu u'sh vovshii tIe tsa kkhiida.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Skh'adolu tsu shina /khIordakh/ lu'lu' a, marzhan a.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsu'nan du khIordachukhula dIasalela kemanash, lekkhachu la'mnekh tera.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Masso a tsu /la'tta/ tIekh' verg khIallakkhir vu.
Iu'sur iu kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun iu'kh', Shegakh' siilakh'alla a, ko'ma'rshalla a dolu.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsu'nga do'khu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a bolchara. Kh1or diinakh' Iza gIullakkhekh'vu.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
TIa'kh'a muk'aderdu Tkho shuna, khIai zhinash a, adamash a.
T1akkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
KhIai zhiniin a, adamiin a gulam! Shaina magakh' stiglaniin a, la'ttan a dozanii dekh'adovla, dovlal! Shu dovlur-m dats tskh'ana bak'ontsaa ben.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Shuna shinna tIe iou'itur iu /kIura botschu/ tsIeran alu a, kIura a. GIo diir dats shuna shinna.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Stigal iedicha, iza iu'sur iu tsIiella, basar sanna.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Otsu diinakh' shen k'ikh khottur ma dats adame a, zhine a.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
K'inosh dinarsh bevzar bu shain bilgalonashtsa a, skh'alo'tsur bu kIuzhalashtsa a, kogashtsa a.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
KhIara iu i zho'zhakhati, k'inoshdinachara sha kharts'esh khilla iolu.
Tsara gonash bokhur bu tsunna a, tsIiidinchu khina a iukk'ekhula.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kh'alkha khIottarakh kkhiirinchunna /ialsamanin/ shi besh khir iu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Ga'nnash dolush /iu i shi ialsamanin besh/.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsu chokh' o'khush shi shovda du.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsu shina /ialsamani/ chokh' khIor sto'makh shi taipa bu.
TIakk'a a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
U'sh (dika Iamalsh iinarsh) khir bu ma'nganii tIe tevzhina, /tsu ma'nganiin/ cho' ezadarekh iina iolush. Tsu ialsamani chokh' /sto'mash/ bakha gergakh' khir bu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsu /ialsamani/ chokh' bIa'rg o'zda mekhkarii khir bu, shaikh tsaral kh'alkha tskh'a a adam a, zhin a kh'akkhadella botsu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Sha'sh iak'ut a, marzhan sanna khir bu u'sh.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tk'a dikanan bekkham dika a ben dui?
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
I shi' iotsurg kkhin shi besh khir iu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Ta'Ina ba'tstsara bosakh' /iu i shi besh/.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsarna chokh' khi kkhu'ssush shi shovda khir bu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsarna chokh' sto'mash khir bu, khurma a, granat a khir iu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Tsarna chokh' dika, khaza mekhkarii khir bu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Ia'rzha bIa'rgash bolush, kh'azhar lotsu dolu mekhkariikhir bu chetarshkakh'.
TIakkkha shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Shaikh tsaral kh'alkha tskh'a a adam a, zhin a kh'akkhadella botsu.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Sha'sh tIetevzhina bolush ba'tstsarchu gIaibanii, khazallikh bu'zzinchu kuzashna a.
TIakkkha a shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun mu'lkha niImat khartsdo ash shimmo?
Berkate khilla kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tsIe, Shegakh' siilakh'alla a, ko'ma'rshalla a dolu.
Sha khilaza tsa dolurgkhilcha,
I khilar khartsdesh tskh'a a /sa/ ma dats.
/Dukkhanash/ tso okh'ataIor bu, /dukkhanash/ kh'alabokhur ma bu.
Latta lastiicha, lastortsa,
La'mnash darzhicha, darzhortsa,
/Tsarakh/ khilcha dIaskh'aia'rzhina chan.
Shu a khilcha kkhaa dek'e dek'adella:
A'ttu ku'igandai -mu'lsh bu i a'ttu ku'igan dai?
A'rru ku'igan dai -mu'lsh bu i a'rru ku'igandai?
/Iimantsa du'nenakh'/ kh'alkhabevlla khillarsh -khir bu /ial shaina ialartsa k'ematdiinakh'/ kh'alkhabevlla bersh.
U'sh khir bu /Dalla/ gergakh'
NiImatiin boshmashkakh'.
Kh'alkharcharakh tskh'a toba,
TIa'kh'archarakh tskh'a kIezzig bersh
/Deshikh, zhovkhIarekh/ tegnachu ma'nganii tIekh' khir bu.
Tsarna tIetevzhina, vovshashna du'kh'albirzina.
Tsarna /gIullakkh desh/ tIekh'iizar bu guttar k'ona kegirkhoi
Sta'knashtsa, kIudalshtsa, /chagIaran/ shovdan kadatsa -
Kortosh lezar dats tseran tsunakh, bekhar a bats u'sh.
Sto'mash khir bu tsarna sha'sh kha'rzhinchukh,
Kh'ozan zhizhig khir du tsarna shaina dukkhadezachukh,
Ia'rzha, bakkhii (khaza) bIa'rgash bolu mekhkarii a khir bu,
Nu'tsk'ala Ialashdechu lu'lu'akh tera bolu -
Tsara desh khillachun bekkhaman du'kh'a du iza.
Tsarna khozur dats tsu chokh' (ialsamanekh') da'ssa khabarsh a, k'inosh dina, bokhush, bekhkash a -
Dekk'a "Salam!" "Salam!" olu dosh ben.
A'ttu ku'igan dai -mu'lsh bu i a'ttu ku'igan dai?
KIokhtsalsh dotschu lotos dittiin iukk'ekh' khir bu /u'sh/,
TIetta sto'mekh du'znachu tIalkh'dittii iukk'ekh' /khir bu/,
Dekhkha da'rzhinchu IindagIekh' khir bu,
Guttar o'khachu khina iukk'ekh' khir bu,
Dukkkha sto'mii iukk'ekh' khir bu,
Sha'sh tsarakh khador botschu, dukhatukhur botschu,
Kh'alaaibinchu ma'nganii tIekh'.
Bakk'alla a, Okha kkhiina u'shkkhiortsa,
Okha khiliiti u'sh ioI-tsIena
Shain marosh dukkhabezash, tsartsa tskh'anakhenara,
A'ttachu ku'igan daishna /khir bu u'sh/,
/U'sh bu/: kh'alkharcharakh tskh'a toba,
Kkhecharakh tskh'a toba.
A'rru ku'igan dai -mu'lsh bu i a'rru ku'igan dai?
U'sh khir bu tsIe ettachu makhekh', tsIiidinchu khichakh',
Sov Ia'rzhachu dokhkan IindagIekh',
Sha shila dotschu, sha /degIana/ tam besh dotschu.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh ma bara otsul kh'alkha /du'nenakh'/ zovkkh kh'o'gush.
U'sh bara k'ar tsa lush dokkkha k'adesh.
U'sh bara olush: "Tkho delcha, tkhokh toppar (poppar) a, t1ekhkash (da'Iakhkash) a khilcha, tkho iukha dendiir du?
Ia tkhan kh'alkhalera dai /denbiir bu/?"
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, kh'alkhalerash a, tIa'kh'arnash a,
Gulbiir ma bu bilgalchu /k'emat/ diinan to'khnachu khanna.
TIakkkha bakk'alla a, ash, khIai tiladellarsh,/bak'derg/ khartsdiinarsh,
Duur ma du zakk'umdittakh /sto'mash/,
Iuzor ma tsunakh /shain/ gaish,
Tsunna tIe /ash/ molur ma du tsIiidinchu khikh,
/Ash/ molur ma du kh'og'ellachu emkalan malar."
Iza du tsarna kechdiinarg bekkhaman diinakh'.
Okha kkho'llina shu, ash khIunda bak' tsa do /iukhadendar k'ematdiinakh'/?
Shuna tsa go sha'sh khIu tosush?
Ash kkhullush du iza /adam/ ia Tkho du kkhullursh?
Okha bilgalda'kkkhira shuna iukk'ekh' valar, Tkho tIa'kh'adu'sur dats
Shu khiitso shukh teracharakh, shu kkhio shuna tsa khuuchu kepara.
Shuna devzira-mai du'khkh'arlera kkhollar, ash oila khIunda tsa io?
Sha'sh du'ish derg (ialta) goi shuna?
Shu du i /la'ttakh/ kkhu'u'itush ia Tkho du i kkhu'u'itursh?
Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, Okha ek'a iar khu'lu'itur iara tsunakh, shu tsetsdevlla du'sur ma dara, /olush/:
"Bakk'alla a, tkho dekkhar kIelma disi.
KhIa', tkho khIumma dotsush ma disi".
Shuna goi sha'sh molush dolu khi?
Ash daiitina iza markhii iukk'era ia Tkho du i dou'itursh?
Tkhuna li'nekh'ara, Okha i du'ra kholu'itur dara /shuna mala tsa lush/, barkalla khIunda tsa olu ash?
Shuna goi tsIe, sha'sh lataesh iolu?
Ash kkhiina tsu'nan dittia Tkho du i kkhiosh dersh?
Okha khiliitina iza /zho'zhakhatin tsIe/ dagaioiturg a, ia'ssachu arakh' bolcharna paida o'tsu khIuma a khilla (tsarna nakh 1esh bolu mettig iovzu'itush).
Kh'an siilakh'-vokkkha volchu Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tsIe khastae (I masso a vochu kh1umanakh ts1anvesh)!
TIakkkha As dui bou sedarchii dIaduzuchu mettigakh.
Bakk'alla a, i dui, shuna khaakh'ara, beza-bokkkha ma bu!
Bakk'alla a, iza siilakh' K'ur'an ma du
Ialashdinchu zhainachokh'.
Tsunakh kh'akkha tsa lo tsIenabersh ben.
Okh'ado'ssina du iza Ialamiin Degara.
I khabar a tsa lorush du shu?
Shaina ritsk' dalarna /Dalla shukur dar/ sha'sh /tsu'nan/ ni1mat (din) khartsdar khu'lu'itu ash?
I (sa aradolush) k'ank'ark'e kkha'chcha,
Tsu khenakh' shu kh'o'zhush dolush, /shuna i iukha chuderzo mogur ma datsara/,
Tkho vuno gergakh' du tsunna shul, delakh' a, shuna tsa go.
Shu tsa khillekh'ara /k'ematdiinakh'/ shaigara bekkham o'tsush,
Ash dukhaderzor dara i /sa/, sha'sh bak' lu'ish khillekh'?
Amma iza khillekh' /Dalla/ gergarcharakh,-
/TIakkkha tsunna/ du sadaIar, dog parg1atdalar a, niImatiin boshmash a.
Amma iza khillekh' a'ttu ku'igan dekh -
TIakkkha salam du kh'una a'ttu ku'igan daishkara.
Amma iza khillekh' /din/ khartsdinacharakh, tilabellacharakh -
Tsunna du kh'oshalgIa tIelatsar tsIiidellachu khikh,
Zho'zhatekh' vagar a.
Bakk'alla a, iza kh'ak'-bak'derg du-kkh!
Akh' khastae kh'an siilakh'-vokkkhachu Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tsIe (I masso a vochu kh1umanakh ts1anvesh)!
Dalla tasbakh' dinastiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel dolcho. Iza veza verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Tsu'nan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. Tso dendo, Tso dolu'itu. Iza masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush vu.
Iza vu kh'alkharnig a, tIa'kh'arniga, guchakh' verg a, k'ailakh'verga. Iza vu masso a khIuma khuush verg a.

Iza vu Sha kkho'llinarg stiglanash a, latta a ialkh diinakh'. TIakkkha Iza dIanisvelira Iarsha tIekh'. Tsunna kha'a latta chu du'ilurg a, tsu chu'ra aradu'ilurg a, stiglara okh'adogIurg a, tsu chu ailurg a. Iza shu'tsa vu, shu michchakh'a a khilcha a. I Dela ash diirig gush vu.
Tsu'nan du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. Dele dIaderzo gIullakkhash.
Bu'isa denna chuiolu'itu Tso, de bu'isanna chudolu'itu. Iza vu khuush verg degnashkakh' derg.

Shu tesha Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a, kharzhash e /Delan novk'akh' - sagIa lush.../ Okha lelo shaiga ellachukh. Shukh iiman dillinarsh a, /Delan novk'akh'/ kharzhash iiinarsh a - tsarna iokkkha ial iu.

Shuna khIun du tsa tesha Delakh? - Elcha ma vui shu kkhoikkhush shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga teshare, Tso ("Sha vui shun Dela", olush ash "Vu Dellara", olush) shu'gara chIagIo ma etsna, shu mu'min nakh delakh'.
Iza vu dossosh verg Shen lega bilgala aiatash shu aradakharkh'ama bodanera nure. Bakk'alla a, i Dela shuna k'intIeravolurg a, k'inkhetame verg a ma vu.

Shuna khIun du Delan novk'akh' kharzh tsa ian? Delan ma du stiglaniin a, la'ttan a irs! Tskh'aterra vats shukh /Delan novk'akh'/ kharzh iinarg tolambakkkhale, tIom binarg /tsul tIa'kh'a kharzhash iinarg a, tIom binarg a/. Tsarna vuno siilakh'-iokkkha ial iu tIa'kh'a kharzh iinacharal, tIa'kh'a tIom binacharal. /Tsarna/ massarna a khaznig vaIda iina Dala. Dela ash diirig dika khuush vu.
Mila vu Dele iukhalurg khaza dekkhar lush verg? - Tso tIettIa alsam dokkkhur du Iza tsunna, tsunna khir iu siilakh' iolu ial a.

Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' kh'una gur bu /khIai Mukh'ammad/ i mu'min bozharii i mu'min zudarii shain nur shaina kh'alkhakhula, a'ttu ku'igan agIorkh'ara u'idash, /tsa'rga olush malikasha/: " Kkha' bu shuna takhana - boshmash shaina bukhakhula khish o'khush dolu. Tsu chokh' /shu/ guttar la'ttar du. Iza bu siilakh'-bokkkha tolam!"

Otsu diinakh' munepik' bozharsha a, munepik' zudarsha a er du teshash khillacha'rga: "Kh'ovsiish tkho'ga! Shun nurakh nur o'tsur dara Okha". Olur du: "Iukhaderza, lakha shaina nur!" Tsarna (mu'min nakhana a munepik' nakhana a) iukk'ekh' kert khIottor iu shena neI iolush, tsunna cho'kh'akhula (mu'min nakh bolu agIo) k'inkhetam bolush, tsunna arakhala (munepik' nakh bolu agIo) Iazap dolush.

Tsa'rga kkhoikkhura tsara (arakh' bolchara - munepik'asha): "Tkho shu'tsa datsara tk'a?" Tsara er: "KhIa', delakh' a, shain dogImash pitane la'tsira ash, /tkhuna von khilare/ ladu'igIira ash, /Delan vaIda/ shekone la'tsira ash, laamasha Iekhiira shu Delan omra (Iozhalla) dalts, Delatsa Iekhiira shu Iekhocho (shaitIano).
Takhana o'tsur bats shu'gara makh, tsa teshash khillacha'rgara a /o'tsur bats/. Shun chugIoila - zho'zhakhati khir iu. Iza iu shun tIetovzhiila. Ma von dIaderzar du-kkh iza!"

Khan tsa kkha'chna-te iiman dillincharna shain degnash mu'tIakh' khila Dela kh'ekhorna, bak'dolchukh do'ssinchunna, u'sh tsa khila kh'alkha shaiga zhaina dossincharakh tera? Tseran-m zama iakh'elira - degnash /k'izallitsa/ chIagIdelira tseran. Tsarakh dukkhanash pesak' ma bu.
Shuna khaalash, Dala latta dendo i dellachul tIa'kh'a. Okha bilgalda'khna shuna aiatash, shu khir dats-te kh'ek'ale.
Bakk'alla a, sagIa lush bersh, bozharii a, zudarii a, Dalla iukhalurg khaza dekkhar a dellarsh - Tso tIettIa alsam dokkkhur du tsarna /mela balartsa/. Tsarna khir iu siilakh' ial a.

Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanekh a teshnarsh - u'sh bu bak'bersh a, shain Dalla gergakh' shakhIidasha. Tsarna shain ial a iu, nur a du. Tk'a tsateshnarsh a, Tkhan aiatash khartsdinarsh a - u'sh bu zho'zhakhatin dai.

Shuna khaalash: du'nenan dakhar - lovzar a, erna khan iaiar a du, khazakhetash shaiga kh'ezhar du, vovshashna iukk'ekh' kurallash iar a du, kh'olekh' a, do'zalekh' a vovshii iukk'ekh' sovbiilar a du. DogIekh tera du /iza/: i deacha /la'ttakh/ skh'aioluchu khIumanasha tsetsbokhu kerstanash. TIakkkha u'sh iak'alo, kh'una go u'sh mozhaella, tIakkkha khu'lu u'sh kag'ella. Ekhartakh' nu'tsk'ala Iazap du /kerstanashna/, Delera gechdar a, reza khilar a du /mu'min nakhana/. Ma dats i du'nenan dakhar /tskh'a / Iekhavalaran khIuma ben.

Sikhlo shain Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara gechdare a, ialsamane, shen shoralla stiglan a, la'ttan shorallakh tera iolchu, sha kechiina iolchu Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanekh a teshash khillacharna. I Delan dozalla du-kkh, Tso lo i Shena luuchunna. I Dela Shegakh' sov dokkkha dozalla dolush vu-kkh.
Tskh'a a bokham khir ma bats la'ttakh'a, shu'gakh' shaigakh' a /tsamgar khilartsa/ iza Okha khiliitale kh'alkha /Lavkh' makh'fuz/ zhaina chokh' iazbella bolush ben. Bakk'alla a, iza Dalla atta du -
/Iza du/ shu gIaigIane tsa khiliitarkh'ama shukh dIatilinchukh, shu dakkkhii tsa dediitarkh'ama Tso shuna dellachu'ntsa. Dalla tsa veza-kkh masso a kura verg a, sha /nakha/ khestavan luush verg a,-
Sha bIa'rmetsig volush, nakhana a bIa'rmetsig khila bokhush omra desh volu. Milla a dIaverzakh' /Delan nek'akh/ - bakk'alla a, i Dela Sha kh'al dolush a vu, khastame a vu.

Okha bakhiitira Tkhan elchanash bilgalonashtsa, dossira tsa'rtsa zhaina a, terzaa nakh lattarkh'ama niisona tIekh'. Okha dossira echig, shena chokh' chIogIa nitsk' bolush, nakhana paidanash bolush, Dalla khaarkh'ama, mila vu Shena a, Shen elchanashna a gIo lotsush verg, /i Dela/ shena gush votstsushekh'. Bakk'alla a, i Dela nu'tsk'ala verg a vu, veza verg a vu.
Okha vakhiitira Nukh' a, IbrakhIim a, Okha khiliitira tseran zu'rretekh' paikhamaralla a, zhaina a. Tsarakh nisvellarg a vu, tsarakh dukkhabersh pesak' bu-kkh.

TIakkkha tseran lorakh Okha bakhiitira Tkhan elchanash. /Tseran lorakh/ Okha vakhiitira Mar'iaman kIant Iiisa, tsu'nga delira Okha Inzhil, tsu'nan tIa'kh'akhIittincheran degnashkakh' khiliitira Okha dog-kIedalla a, k'inkhetam a. Du'nenan marzonakh d1akhadar- iza tsara sha'sh kkho'llina du, Okha i lelor tsarna tIe tsa dillina, Dela reza khilar lakhar a ben, iza a tergal tsa dina tsara tergal dan ma dezza. Tsarakh iiman dillincharna shain ial eli Okha. Tsarakh dukkhabersh pesak' bu-kkh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Delakh kkheralash, Tsu'nan elchanakh teshalash - Tso Shen k'inkhetamakh shi dak'alur du shuna, Tso khu'lu'itur du shuna nur, tsu'ntsa shu lelash, Tso shuna gechdiir du. I Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

/I khou'itu As shuna / zhainan okhIlana khaarkh'ama Delan k'inkhetamakh tskh'anna a khIumanna tIekh' shaina nitsk' kkhochur botsiila, k'inkhetam Delan karakh' buila: Tso lo iza Shena luuchunna. I Dela Shegakh' beza-bokkkha k'inkhetam bolush vu-kkh.

Bakk'alla a, khezi Dalla shen mairachukh la'tsna kh'o'ga iukh-iukha a du'itsush iolchun dosh, tso Dele dalkhado shen g1ullakkh, i Dela khozush ma vu shun shinnan k'amel. Bakk'alla a, i Dela khozush verg a ma vu, gush verg a ma vu.

Shukh shain zudarshka "shu tkhuna tkhan nanoin buk'akh tera du", bokhursh - u'sh tseran nanoi tsa khu'lu /tsara iza bakharkh/. Tseran nanoi u'sh binarshben bats. Bakk'alla a, tsara du'itsurg tsa deza dosh ma du, khartsderg ma du. Bakk'alla a, Dela /u'sh dokhkobevlla, i k'a ditcha/ bekhk tsabu'llurg a vu, gechdiirig a vu.

I shain zudarshka "shu tkhuna tkhan nanoin buk'akh tera du", olursh, tIakkkha sha'sh a'llachunna tIe iukhabo'rzush bersh- tskh'a lai azatvakkkha veza tsara sha'sh /mairachun a, zudchun a iuk'amettigtsa/ gergadakhale. Tsu'ntsa kh'ekham besh bu shuna. Dela ash diirig sov dika khuush vu.

I tsakariinacho markha kkhobur du shina battakh' tIettIa sha'sh shi' /mairachun a, zudchun a iuk'amettigtsa/ gergadakhale. I tsa magakh' - kkhuztk'a miskachunna daa khIuma lur du. Iza du shu Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a teshiitarkh'ama. U'sh Delan dozanash du /tIekh ma dovla tsarna/. /Delakh/ tsateshacharna lazosh dolu Iazap du.

Bakk'alla a, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a /mostagIallitsa/ du'kh'albovlush bersh siisazbiir bolush bu, tsaral kh'alkha khillarsh siisazbarkh terra. Okha dossiina bilgala dolu aiatash. Tsateshacharna siisaza dolu Iazap ma du.

Otsu diinakh' Dala gIovtor bu u'sh berrig /keshnash chu'ra/, Tso du'itsur du tsa'rga tsara dina khillarg /du'nenakh'/. Dala tidam bina tsunakh, tsara ditsdina. I Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' tesh vu-kkh.

Kh'una tsa go: i Dela khuush ma vu stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Kkhannan k'ailakh' khabar khir ma dats vo'algIanig Iza volush ben, pkhennan a - iolkhalgIanig Iza volush ben. Tsul /kIezzig/ derg a, tsul dukkha derg a khir ma dats Iza tsa'rtsa volush ben, u'sh michchakh'a a khilchi. TIakkkha Tso tsa'rga du'itsur du tsara dina khillarg k'ematdiinakh'. Bakk'alla a, Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg ma vu.

Kh'una tsa go i k'ailakha khabar diitsar shaina tsa magiinakhillarsh? TIakkkha iukha a tIebo'rzush shaina tsa magiina khillachunna, vovshashka k'ailakha khabarsh du'itsush k'a dartsii, mostagIallitsii, elchanna Iesalla iartsii. Kh'o volchu sha'sh ba'khkicha, kh'o'ga salam lo tsara Dala kh'o'ga salam tsa luchu kepara. Shaiga olu tsara: "KhIunda Iazap tsa do vaina Dala vai bokhuchu'ntsa?" Kkhacho iu tsarna zho'zhakhati - bogur bu u'sh tsu chokh'. Ma von dIavo'rzu mettig iu-kkh iza!

KhIai iiman dillnarsh! Sha'sh k'ailakha khabar diitsakh', ma diitsa iza k'atsii, mostagIallitsii, elchanna Iesalla iartsii. Ash diitsa k'ailakha khabar dikantsii, /Delakh/ kkherartsii. Shu kkheralash Delakh, shu Shena tIe dIaguldiir dolchu.
Bakk'alla a, k'ailakha khabar diitsar shaitIanera du iiman dillnarsh poshme khiliitarkh'ama. Tsarna tsu'rrig zen diir dats tso Delan purbantsii ben. Dalla tIe tevzhiila mu'min nakh!

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shaiga a'lcha: "Mettig khiliita /dIasakhilii/ mazhlisekh', mettig khiliita. Dala shorto iiir iu shuna. "Kh'alagIovta!" a'lcha, kh'alagIovta. Dala lakkhabokhu shukh iiman dillinarsh a, shaina Iilma dellarsh a darzhatsa. I Dela ash diirig sov dika khuush ma vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash k'ailakha khabar diitsinekh' elchanna kh'alkhakh', tsu shain k'ailakha khabarna kh'alkhadakkkhalash sagIa. Iza shuna dika a du, vuno tsIena a du. I /sagIa/ shuna tsa karadakh' - tIakkkha bakk'alla a, i Dela gechdesh verg a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

Shu kkhiirira shain k'ailakha khabaral kh'alkha sagIa dakkkha? /Shu'gakh' i dotsu dela/. TIakkkha ash iza tsa dakh', - Dala shuna gechdina (shuna tIera dIada'kkkhi i omra) - lamaz khIottade, zakat a lo, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a mu'tIakh' khila. (Tsu'ntsa kkhacho khir iu paikhamarna kh'alkhakh' k'ailakha khabar diitsale kh'alkha sagIa dakkkharkh). I Dela dika khuush verg vu ash diirig.
Kh'una goi i Dela shaina o'gIaz vakhanchu k'omatsadottagIalla lelosh bersh? U'shshukh bats, tsarakh a bats. Khartsdolchunna tIekh' dui boush bu u'sh, shaina khuushekh'.
Dala kechdina tsarna chIogIa Iazap. Bakk'alla a, ma von khili-kkh tsara desh khillarg.
Tsara letsira shain duinash/nekhan dovakh a, bekhkakh a, shain k'inoikh/ du'kh'alo iina, ishtta tsara dIatilira /nakh/ Delan nek'akh. Tsarna siisaza dolu Iazap du-kkh.
Kh1umma kh'alkhadokkkhur dats Delera tseran kh'olo a, tseran do'zalo a. U'sh /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai bu-kkh. U'sh tsu chokh' guttar khir bu.

Tskh'ana diinakh' Dala kh'alagIovtor bu u'sh berrig, tIakkkha tsara Tsunna duinash bour bu, shuna sha'sh duinash baarkh terra. Tsarna mottur du sha'sh tskh'ana bukhana tIekh' du. Tk'a, bakk'alla a, u'sh bats khartslu'ish bersh?!
ShaitIano doladina tsarna tIekh', tso ditsdaiti tsa'rga Dela kh'ekhavar. U'sh shaitIanan toba iu. Tk'a shaitIanan toba iats gIorasaznig (eshnarg)?
Bakk'alla a, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a /mostagIallitsa/ du'kh'albu'ilursh - u'sh bu-kkh uggar siisazkhillacharna iukk'ekh'.
DIaiazdina Dala: "To'lur vu So a, San elchanash a". Bakk'alla a, Dela nu'tsk'ala verg a vu, veza verg a vu.

Kh'una karor bats Delakh a, tIa'kh'archu diinakh a teshash bolu nakh shaina dukkhabezash Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a du'kh'albu'ilush bersh, u'sh tseran dai khillekh' a, ia kIentii khillekh', ia vezharii khillekh', ia tseran gergara khillekh'. U'sh bu Tso shain degnashkakh' iiman iazdinarsh, Tso chIagIbinarsh Shegara sitsa. Tso bukhkur bu u'sh boshmashka, shain bukhakhula khish lelash dolchu, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttash. Dela reza khili tsarna, u'sh reza khili Tsunna. U'sh bu Delan toba. Tk'a, bakk'alla a, Delan toba - i iats iakkkhiiedar erg?! / Iu, Dellara!/
Tasbakh' dina Dalla stiglanashkakh' mel dolcho a, la'ttakh' mel dolcho a. Iza veza verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Iza vu Sha araba'khnarg zhainan okhIlakh tsateshnarshkh'alkharchu dIalakhkarekh'. Shuna tsa mo'ttura u'sh arabovlur bu. Tsarna mo'ttura shain /tIeman/ gIopasha lardiir du sha'sh Delakh. Dela t1ekkhiaratsarna shaina daga a tsa dogIuchukhula. Tseran degnashka kkheram tesira Tso - dokhadesh shain tsIenosh shain ku'igashtsa a, mu'min nekhan ku'igashtsa a. Kh'ekham khiliita shaina tsunakh, khIai bIa'rsadersh!
Dala tsarna tsa iazdinekh'ara makhkara arabakhar, Iazap dina khir dara tsarna du'nenakh'. Tsarna ekhartakh' a tsIeran Iazap du.
Iza du tsara du'kh'alo iarna Dalla a, Delan elchanna a. Milla velakh' Dalla du'kh'alo esh verg - bakk'alla a, Dela ch1og1a vu-kkh taIzar darekh'.
Ash khadiina dolu khurmanan ditt, ia ditina derg shen oramii tIekh'- Delan purbantsa du, pesakkh nakh siisazbarna a.

Dala Shen elchanna /ash t1om tsa besh / ella tsa'rgarakhIons- shuna tsa kkhiitira tsunna tIa'kh'a lakhka govrash a, emkalsh a, amma Dala lo urkhalla Shen elchanashka Shena luuchunna tIekh'. Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush vu.

Dala Shen elchanna iartiin nakheraskh'aia'kkkhina ella khIons iu Dalla, Tsu'nan elchanna, /paikhamaran/ gergarcharna, boberashna, miskacharna, nek'akhochunna shukh kh'al dolchu nekhan dolakh' tsa khiliitarkh'ama. Elchano de'narg skh'aetsa, tso tsa magiinarg dita: Delakh kkheralash. Bakk'alla a, i Dela chIogIa vu-kkh taIzar darekh'.

MukhIazhiriin pek'ar nakhana a /iu i khIons/, shain tsIenoikh a, bakhamakh a arabekhna khilla bolchu, tsara Delera k'inkhetam a, rezalla a lakharna, Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a gIo darna. U'sh bu bak'bersh.

Tsaralkh'alkha shain tsIenosh khillarsh, iimana chokh' chIagIbellarsh- bezash bu shaina tIe ba'khkinarsh, tsarna tsa karaio shain degnashkakh' /mukhIazhirshnaellachu khIons bakh'anekh'/ kh'agI, shail a u'sh sovbokhu tsara, shaigakh' pek'aralla khillekh' a. Shen degI bIa'rmetsigallakh lardinarg - u'sh bu-kkh bakkkhiibedar bersh.

Tsaral tIa'kh'a ba'khkinarsh a, olush: "Veza Dela, gechdelakh' tkhuna a, iimantsa tkhol kh'alkhabevllachu tkhan vezharshna a, ma khiliitalakh' tkhan degnashkakh' iiman dillincha'rga tsabezam. Veza Dela, bakk'alla a, Kh'o vu-kkh /tkhuna/ k'intIervolurg a, k'inkhetame verg a" /kh'ak' bu shaina kh1onsakh dak'a kkhacha/.

Kh'una girii i munepak' nakh, sha'sh olush zhainan okhIlakh tsa teshash khillachu shain vezharshka: "Shu arada'khna khillekh'ara, danne a tkho a aradovlur dara shu'tsa. Shuna du'kh'al tskh'anna a tsk'a a mu'tIakh' khir datsara tkho. Shu'tsa tIom binekh'ara - shuna danne a gIo diir ma dara okha". Dala teshalla do, bakk'alla a, u'sh khartslu'ish ma bu, a'lla.

U'sh araba'khcha, tsa'rtsa arabovlur a ma batsara u'sh. Tsa'rtsa tIom biicha - tsarna gIo diir ma datsara tsara. Tsara tsarna gIo diichi a, iukhbovlur ma bara u'sh (bovdur ma bara u'sh), tIakkkha /tseran/ gIo tsarna khir ma datsara.
Shu ma du tseran degnashkakh' Delal a tIekh kkherame. Iza u'sh kkhetam botsu k'am dolu dela du.

Tsara shu'tsa tIom biir bats massara a tskh'ana chIagIiina iartashkakh' ben ia penii tIekh'akh' ben. Tseran nitsk' vovshiin iukk'ekh' chIogIa bu. Kh'una mo'ttu u'sh tskh'ana bu. Tseran degnash dek'adella du. Iza - u'sh kh'ek'al dotsu k'am dolu dela du.
Dukkha khan iotstsush shail kh'alkha khillacharakh tera bu u'sh: shain gIullakkhan bala Ievshira tsara. Tsarna khir du lazosh dolu Iazap a /ekhartakh'/.

ShaitIanakh tera bu u'sh, sha a'llachu adame: "/Delakh/ tsatesharg khila!" Iza /Delakh/ tsatesharg khilcha, tso elira: "Bakk'alla a, so tsIeni du kh'okh. Bakk'alla a, so kkho'ru Delakh - Ialamiin Dekh!"
Tsu shinnan (munepik'iin a, zhugtiin dinan tsateshacheran a) tIa'kh'e khilira i shi' zho'zhakhatekh' khilar, tsu chokh' guttar a la'ttash. Iza bu zulamkhoin bekkham.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Delakh kkheralash. Kh'ozhiila sa, sha khIun kechdina-te kkhanenna. Shu kkheralash Delakh. Bakk'alla a, Dela sov dika khuush vu ash diirig.
Shu ma khilalash Dela vitsvincharakh tera - tIakkkha Tso bitsbaitira tsa'rga sha'sh a. U'sh pesak' nakh bu.
Tskh'aterra bats zho'zhakhatin dai a, ialsamanin dai a. Ialsamanin dai - u'sh bu to'llarsh!
Okha khIara K'ur'an dossiina khillekh'ara lamane, kh'una gur ma bara iza d1atebella ba'dda Delakh kkherabalarna. KhIara masalsh Okha dalado nakhana, tsara oila iakh'ara a'lla.
Iza AllakhI (tskh'a Dela) vu, kkhin dela vats Iza votsurg. Kh'ulamekh' derg a, guchakh' derg a khuurg vu Iza. Iza sov k'inkhetame verg a, k'inkhetameverg a vu.

Iza AllakhI vu, kkhin dela vats Iza votsurg. Pachchakh' vu Iza, /masso a bo'khachu, kkho'llinchu sibatekh, kkhachambatsarekh/ ts1ena verg vu, /Shen khalk'ana/ mashar /lush/ verg vu, /Shen elchanashka tsa'rgakhula Shen mu1zhizatash guchudakhartsa nakhe/ iiman du'llu'itush verg vu, /masso a kh1uma/1alashdiirig vu, veza verg vu, nu'tsk'ala verg vu, /vala kh'ak' dolush/ kura vergvu. TsIena vu Iza /Shetsa/ tsara nak'ost latsarkh.

Iza AllakhI vu, Kkhollarkho vu Iza, iotsuchu'ra khIumanash khu'lu'iturg a vu Iza, surt khIottosh verg a vu /Sha kkhulluchu kh1umanan/. Tsu'nan khaza tsIersh a iu. Tsunna tasbakh' desh du stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Iza veza verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ma liitsa San mostagI a, shun mostagI a dottagIii, ash tsa'rga bezam a kkhiidabesh. Tsara kersta ma dina shu'ga deana dolu bak'derg, sha'sh aravokkkhush elcha a, shu a /tsIenoshkara/ dekk'a shu Delakh - sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchukh teshash dolu dela. Shu aradevlicha gIazotana San novk'akh', San reza khilar lo'khush /ma liitsalash kerstanash shaina dottagIii/. Ash /degnashkakh'/ kh'ulbora tsa'rga bezam, So dika khuush vu ash kh'uldinarg a, ash dIakh'edinarg a. Shukh iza desh verg tilavella vu niisachu nek'akh.
Shuna tIekh' shaina a'tto ba'lcha - shuna mostagIii khu'lu tsarakh, shuna tIekkhiidado shain ku'igash a, shain mettanash a /shuna/ zen dartsa, tsarna liira ash /i bak'derg/ kerstadoila.
Banne a shuna paida biir ma bats shun gergarlonasha a, shun do'zalsha ak'ematdiinakh': Tso k'astam biir bu shuna iukk'ekh'. I Dela ash diirig gush ma vu.

Khaza masal ma khilira shuna IbrakhIimekh' a, tsu'ntsa khillacha'rgakh' a, tsara a'lcha shain nakhe: "Tkho tsIeni du shukh a, ash shaina, Dela a vitina, Iibadat dechu khIumanekh a. Okha shuna kerstanalla dina. Tkhunii, shunii iukk'ekh' mostagIalla iu, o'gIazlo a iu guttarena ash vekk'a tskh'ana Dele iiman dillalts". IbrakhIiman shen dega a'lla tskh'a dosh dotsurg /tsunakh masal ma etsa/: "Danne a kh'una gechdar do'khur du as Dele, /khIette a/ Delera kh'una tskh'anna khIumanna doladesh-m vats so". /Tsara - IbrakhIima a, tsu'nan nak'ostasha a doIa dora/: "Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu tkhan Dela! Kh'una tIetevzhi tkho, Kh'una tIedirzi tkho, Kh'una tIe du-kkh tkhan dIaderzar a.

Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu tkhan Dela! Tkh'okh pitna ma delakh' tsateshnacharna, Akh' gechdelakh' tkhuna, tkho Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu tkhan Dela. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o vu-kkh veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a".
Shuna khili tsa'rgakh' khaza masal - Dele a, k'ematdiine a dog dokhush volchunna. /Otsunakh/ milla a dIaverzakh' - bakk'alla a, i Dela kh'al dolush a vu, khastame a vu.
Tarlo Dala shuna a, tsarakh ash shaitsa mostagIalla lelosh iolcharna a iukk'ekh' bezam khiliita. Dela nitsk' kkhochush vu. I Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.

Dala tsa magosh dats shuna din bakh'anekh' shu'tsa tIom tsa bincharna a, shu shain tsIenoshkara ara tsa da'khnacharna a dikanig dan a, ash tsa'rtsa niiso ian a. Bakk'alla a, Dalla beza niiso esh bersh.

Bokk'alla a, Dala tsa mago shuna din bakh'anekh' shu'tsa tIom binacharakh, shu shain tsIenoshkara arada'khnacharakh, shu aradakharna tIekh' gIodinacharakh ash shaina dottagIii liitsa. Tsarakh dottagIii lu'itsush bersh - u'sh zulamkhoi bu.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu'ga ba'khkicha bevdda mu'min zudarii - zelash u'sh, Dalla-m dika kha'a tseran iiman. Shaina khaadelcha u'sh mu'min buila, - u'sh kerstanashka dIa ma berzabelash. U'sh (i mu'min zudarii) tsarna (kerstanashna) kh'anal bats. I (kersta nakh) a bats tsarna (zudarshna) kh'anal. DIalo tsarna (tsu zudariin khillachu kersta maroshna) tsara iina kharzh (tsara zudarshna della khilla dolu urdo). K'a dats shuna ash u'sh shaina baliicha, tsarna shain makh (urdo) dIa a della. Ash ma liitsa tsa teshash bolchu zudarshtsa /zudchun-mairachun/ u'iranash (ash ma kkhaba i kersta zudarii). Ash ekha tsa'rgara sha'sh iina kharzh. Tsara a iu'khiila sha'sh iina kharzh /shu'ga/. Iza du Delan kh'ukam: Tso do shuna iukk'ekh' kh'ukam. Dela khuush verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

Shun zudarekh tskh'a' dIaiakhcha tsateshacha'rga, tk'a ash tIom bina khIons iakkkhinekh' - dIalo shaigara zudarii dIabakhancharna tsara iina kharzhatsa nislurg /khIonsakh/. Shu kkheralash /i niiso tsa ian/ Delakh, sha'sh Tsunakh teshash dolchu.

KhIai paikhamar! Kh'una tIe ba'khkicha mu'min zudarii kh'o'tsa duitsa bart ban /dinan agIonash lar'ian/ sha'sh Delatsa tskh'anna khIumantsa nak'ost tsalatsarna tIekh', sha'sh /khIuma/ tsalach'k'orna tIekh', zina tsadarna tIekh', sha'sh shain berash tsadaiarnatIekh', sha'sh tsadakh'arna tIekh' eladita, sha'sh iza kkhullush shain ku'igii a, kogii a kh'alkha (shen mairachunna dina dotsu ber tsunna tIe tsa kkhussush), sha'sh dikachu khIumanna tIekh' kh'una Iesalla tsaiarna tIekh' - tsartsa i duitsa bart be, tsarna Dele gechdar dekha. Bakk'alla a, i Dela gechdiirig vu, k'inkhetame verg vu.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash dottagIii ma liitsa shaina Dela o'gIazva'lla k'am. Tsara dog dillina ekhartakh, tsateshachara dog dillina khilarkh terra keshniin daikh (u'sh denbina gIovtorakh).
Dalla tasbakh' dina stiglanashkakh' mel dolcho a, la'ttakh' mel dolcho. Iza veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Ash khIunda du'itsu sha'sh desh dotsurg?
Iokkkha khilla o'gIazlo Dalla gergakh' ash alar sha'sh desh dotsurg.
Bakk'alla a, Dalla beza Shen novk'akh' tIom besh bersh tskh'a mogIa bina, sha'sh chIagIiina gIishlo sanna.

Musas ma elira shen k'ome /akh' kh'akhade iza, khIai Mukh'ammad, kh'an nakhe/: "KhIai san k'am, ash khIunda suna khalakho'tu'itu? Shu khuush ma dui so shu'ga /vaiitina/ Delan elcha vuila". U'sh /bak'dolchukh/ dIabirzicha - Dala dIaderzira tseran degnash /bak'dolchukh/. Dala nis tsa do pesak' k'am.

Mar'iaman kIanta Iiisas ma elira, /akh' dagadaita iza kh'an nakhe, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "KhIai Israilan kIentii! Bakk'alla a, so shu'ga /vaiitina/ Delan elcha vu-kkh, bak'desh sol kh'alkha khilla Tavrat a, kkha' bokkkhush sol tIa'kh'a vogIur volchu elchantsa, shen tsIe Akh'madiolush". TIa'kh'a iza shaiga ve'cha bilgalonashtsa, tsara elira: "KhIara bilgala bozbuunchalla du".
Mila vu zulame sha Dalla tIekh' khartsderg kkho'llina volchul, sha /Dalla/ mu't1akh' khilare (islam dine) kkhoikkhush a volush? Dala nis tsa do zulame k'am.
U'sh luush bu shain bagenashtsa Delan nur daia. Dala kkhochushdo Shen nur, tsateshacharna i mel tsa dezakh'.
Iza vu vakhiitinarg Shen elcha niisachu nek'atsa a, bak'dolchu dintsa i toliitarkh'ama masso a dina tIekh', mushrikunashna iza mel tsa dezakh' a.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! As nisdoi shu iokhka-etsarna tIe, tso shu kIelkh'aradokhur dolush lazosh dolchu Iazapakh? /Iza:/
Shu Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a teshar du, ash Delan novk'akh' k'akh'egardu shain bakhamtsa a, sinoshtsa a. Iza dika du shuna, shu khuush khillekh'.
Tso (Dala) gechdiir du shuna k'inosh, chudokhu'itur du boshmashna, shaina bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, Iadn ialsamanin tsIenchu gIishloshna. Iza siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu-kkh!
Kkhin /niImat khir du/, shuna sha dezash dolu - Delera gIo a, gergara tolam a. Akh' kkha' bakkkha mu'min nakhana.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu khilalash Delan gIo'nchii, Mar'iaman kIanta Iiisas shen mutaIelimashka a'lla khilarkh terra: "Mu'lsh bu Delan ag1orgakh'a san gIo'nchii?" MutaIelimasha elira: "Tkho du Delan gIo'nchii". Israilan kIentekh tskh'ana tobano iiman dillira, /kkhechu/ tobano kerstanalla dira. TIakkkha Okha chIagIbira iiman dillinarsh tseran mostagIchunna tIekh' - u'sh khilira tolam ba'kkkhinarsh /delilashtsa a, bilgalonashtsa a/.
Sha pachchakh' volchu, Sha /masso a kkhachambatsarekh/ ts1ena volchu, Sha veza volchu, Sha kh'ukam /niisa/ desh volchu Dalla tasbakh' desh dustiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a.

Iza vu Sha vaiitinarg ioza tsa khuuchu nakhekh'tseran shaina iukk'era elcha, tso tsarna du'itsush Tsu'nan aiatash, u'sh tsIanbesh, tsarna Iamadesh zhaina a, kh'ikmata, u'sh kh'alkha khillekh' a bilgalchu tilarchakh'.
/Nakhakh/ kkhecharnaa /du'itsu tso Delan aiatash/, sha'sh tsarakh (kh'alkha Mukh'ammad paikhamarna gonakh' khillabolcharakh) tsa kkhi'na bolchu. Iza veza verg a vu, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.
Iza Delan dozalla (sii) du, Tso lo iza Shena luuchunna. Dela Shegakh' siilakh'-dokkkha dozalla dolush vu.
Shaina tIe Tavrat dillincheran, tIakkkha iza d1a tsadikh'incheranmasal du zhainash kh'ochu viranmasalkh tera. Von du-kkh Delan aiatash khartsdinchu k'oman masal. Dala nis tsa bo zulame nakh.
Akh' ala: "KhIai zhu'gtii (-n dinekh') khillarsh! Shu mo'ttush delakh' sha'sh Delan dottagIii du/kkhin/ nakh botsush, - shuna dala laal, sha'sh bak'lu'ish khillekh'".
Iza tsIk'a a luur dats tsarna shain ku'igasha kh'alkha a da'kkkhina. Dela bevzash vu zulamkhoi.

Akh' ala: "Shu shekh dovdush dolu i valar du'kh'alkkhetar du shuna. TIakkkha shu dIaderzor du k'ailakh'derg a, guchakh'derg a khuush volchu'nga (Dalla tIe). TIakkkha Tso d1adu'itsur du shu'ga ash desh khillarg".
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shaiga kkhiikkhicha lamaze pIeraskan diinakh', sikhlo Dela kh'ekhon /ruzba lamaze/, iita iokhka-etsar. Iza dika du shuna, shu khuush khillekh'.
Lamaz kkhochushkhilcha - d1asadarzha la'ttakhula, lekha Delan niImat. Ash kh'ekhaveDela dukkkha a - shu dakkkhiidediita.

Shaina iokhka-etsar ia sink'eram gicha, tsunna tIe bo'rzu u'sh, kh'o vu'tu tsara khIo'ttina la'ttachakh'. Akh' ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Dalla gergakh' derg dika du sink'eramal a, iokhka-etsaral a. I Dela ritsk' lucharekh uggar dikanig vu-kkh".

Kh'una tIe munepak'ashba'khkicha, tsara elira: "Okha teshalla do: bakk'alla a, kh'o Delan elcha ma vu." Dalla khuush du kh'o, bakk'alla a, Shen elcha vuila. Dala teshalla do: bakk'alla a, i munepak'ash khartslu'ish ma bu.
Shain duinash shaina /busalbanashkara zen tsa khiliita/ turs khillaliitsira tsara - /ishtta/ tsara dIatilina /nakh/ Delan nek'akh. Bakk'alla a, ma von khili-kkh tsara desh khillarg!
Iza du tsara iiman dillina khilarna tIakkkha kerstadarna. Tseran degnekh mukhIar to'khna- u'sh tsa kkheta.

Kh'una u'sh gicha, kh'o tsetsvokkkhu tseran dogImasha, tsara khabar du'itsush akh' ladugIu tseran dashe. GIortina bIogIamash sanna bu u'sh(sha'sh khIo'ttana Ia tsa lush). Masso a mokh' shaina du'kh'al bu mo'ttu tsarna. U'sh mostagIii bu, kh'o larlolakh' tsarakh. Dala khIallakbiir bu u'sh. Mukha genabevlla u'sh /iimanakh bilgalonash e'nachul tIa'kh'a/?!
Tsa'rga elcha: "Skh'adu'ila, Delan elchano gechdar do'khur du shuna", shain kortosh kh'ebo tsara. Kh'una gina u'sh dIabo'rzush /iimanakh/, sha'sh kura a bovlii.
Tsarna tskh'aterra du: akh' tsarna gechdar diikhicha a, tsa diikhicha a. Danne a Dala gechdiir dats tsarna. Bakk'alla a, Dala nis tsa do pesak' k'am.
U'sh bu olush: "Kharzhash ma e Delan elchanna gergakh' bolcharna- dIasabarzhiita u'sh /Madinatera/". Delan iu stiglaniin a, la'ttan a khaznash, amma munepak'ash kkhetash bats-kkh.

Tsara (munepak'asha) olu: "Tkho Madinate iukhadirzicha, siilakh'bolchara siisazabersh arabokhur bu tsu (Madinata) chu'ra". Delan du sii, Tsu'nan elchanan a du, mu'min nekhan a du, delakh' a, munepak'ashna tsa kha'a-kkh.
KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu iuk'akh ma dokhiila shun bakhamo a, shun do'zalo a Dela kh'ekhorakh (diinakh'-busii dechu pkhea lamazakh). I desh bersh- u'sh bu eshnarsh.
