Kharzh e /Delan novk'akh'/ Okha shaina dellachu ritsk'akh shaikh tskh'anna tIe valar kkhachale, tIakkkha tso olush: "Veza Dela, Akh' so tIa'kh'ata'ttinekh'ara tskh'a kIezzig zamanna, as sagIa dokkkhur dara, so khir vara dika Iamal echarakh".
TIa'kh'atottur dats Dala tskh'a a sa, tsu'nan Iozhalla e'cha. Dela dika khuush verg vu ash diirig.
Dalla tasbakh' desh du stiglanashkakh' a, la'ttakh' a mel derg. Tsunna du pachchakh'alla, Tsunna bu khastam a. Iza vu masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush verg.
Iza vu shu kkho'llinarg. Shukh vu tsa teshash verg a, shukh vu teshash verg a /Delakh/. Dela ash diirig gush derg vu.
Tso kkho'llira stiglanash a, latta a bak'ontsa, Tso khIottira shun kuts, tIakkkha khazdira shun ku'tsash. Tsunna tIe du /chakkhenan/ dIaderzar.
Tsunna kha'a stiglanashkakh' mel derg a, la'ttakh' mel derg a. Tsunna kha'a ash k'iladokkkhurg a, ash dIakh'edorig a. Dela vu khuush verg degnashkakh' derg.
Shu'ga tsa deara kh'alkha tsa teshash khillacheran khabar? Tsara Ievshira shain gIullakkhiin bala, tsarna lazosh dolu Iazap a du.

Iza du tsa'rga bogIush khilarna shain elchanash bilgalonashtsa, tIakkkha tsara olush khilarna: "/Vai sanna/ nakha du'khkur du vai niisachu novk'a?" Tsara kerstadira /u'sh Dala baiitar/, u'sh dIabirzira /otsu elchanekh a, bak'dolchu iimanakh a/. Dela /tseran Iibadat/ tsa khilarkh a volu: Dela kh'al dolush a vu, khastame a vu.

/Delakh/ tsateshnacharna mo'ttinasha'sh dendiir dats. Akh' ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "KhIa', so Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu san Delakh dui bou as: dendiir ma du shu, tIakkkha shu'ga du'itsur ma du ash desh khillarg. Iza Dalla atta du".
Shu tesha Delakh a, Tsu'nan elchanakh a, Okha dossinchu nurakh a (K'ur'anakh). Dela ash diirig sov dika khuush verg vu.

Tskh'ana diinakh' Tso guldiir du shu gulaman /k'emat/diine. Iza du vovshashna zenash khilaran a, kkhiamash khilaran a de. Milla velakh' Delakh teshash a, dika Iamal esh a, Okha tsIanviir vu iza shen k'inoikh, vokhu'itur vu boshmash chu, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, tsu chokh' u'sh guttar a la'ttash. Iza siilakh'-bokkkha tolam bu-kkh!
Tsateshnarsh a, Tkhan aiatash khartsdina khillarsh a - u'sh /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIeran dai bu, tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar bolush. Ma von dIaderzar du-kkh iza!
Tskh'a a bokham khir bats Delan purbantsa a ben. Milla velakh' Delakh teshash - Tso nisdiir du tsu'nan dog. Dela masso a khIuma khuush verg vu.
Mu'tIakh' khila Dalla a, mu'tIakh' khila elchanna a. Shu dIaderzakh' /iimanakh/ - Tkhan elchanna tIekh'-m bilgala dIakkhachor ben dats.
AllakhI-Dela vu, kkhin dela vats Iza votsurg. Dalla tIe tevzhiila mu'min nakh.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Bakk'alla a, shun zudarekh a, do'zalakh a shuna mostagIii bersh a bu, tsarakh larlolash. Shu /tseran/ bekhkakh dovlakh', tovakh', ash gechdakh' - /i dika du shuna/, bakk'alla a, Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Bakk'alla a, shun bakham a, shun do'zal a pitnadu. Tk'a Dela - Tsunna gergakh' siilakh'-iokkkha ial iu!

Shu Delakh kkheralashshain nitsk' ma-kkhochchu, ash ladogIalash /shaiga Dala dechu omre/, shu mu'tIakh' khilalash /Dala bokhuchunna/, ash kharzhash e /Delan novk'akh'/ shuna shaina dika khiliitarkh'ama. Shen sinan bIa'rmetsigallakh Ialash khillarg - u'sh bu bakkkhiibedar bersh.
Ash /iukhalurg/ Dalla lakh' khaza dekkhar - Tso masiittazaalsamda'kkkhina iukhaderzor du iza shuna, shuna gechdiir a du. Dela barkalle a vu, dukkha sobare vu (Shekh teshnacharna o'gIaze votsush).
Kh'ulamekh' derg a, guchakh' derg a khuush verg a vu /Iza/, Sha veza verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a vu.

KhIai paikhamar! Sha'shzudarii bu'tush u'sh bita Iiddatana. Ash dagarde Iiddat /-an denosh/. Shu kkheralash Delakh - sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchukh /i Iiddat tergal tsa dan/. Shain tsIenoshkara ara ma bakhalash u'sh /i Iiddat chekkhdalanza/. U'sh sha'sh a ma bovliila /shain tsIenoshkara/ ara, tskh'a bilgala irchanigsha'sh de'nekh' ben. KhIorsh du Delan dozanash. Delan dozanekh va'llarg shena zulam dinarg vu. Kh'una khaats, Dala tskh'a gIullakkhkhiliita tarlo tsul tIa'kh'a.

Tseran khan (Iiddat) kkhochushkhilcha, iukhaberzabe u'sh khazchu gIillakkhtsa /sha'sh tskh'ana dakha luush delakh'/, ia k'astabe u'sh khazchu gIillakkhtsa /shaina tskh'ana dakha tarlur dats a'lla khetalakh'/. Ash shi' teshkhIottave /tskh'anakkhetarna ia dIak'astarna/ shaikh Iedale bersh. Ash teshalla khIottade Dalla. Iza du Delakh a, tIa'khkh'archu diinakh a teshna khillachunna shetsa kh'ekham besh derg. Shekh kkho'rush volchunna Dala nek' khu'lu'itur bu/masso a balikh kh'alkhavala/.

Tso (Dala) tsunna ritsk' lur du tso kh'esap tsa dinachu'ra. Dalla tIe tovzhush verg - iza Tsu'nan kh'esapekh' vu. Bakk'alla a, Dela kkhochushdesh vu Shen gIullakkh. Dala khiliitina masso a khIumanna baram.

Shun zudarekh shain tsIii darakhdog dillina bersh, shu sheko iolush khillekh', tseran Iiddat kkho butt bu, i tsIi dar khIintsi tsa khillacharna (zhima khilar bakh'anekh') a /kkho butt bu/. Berakh bisincheran /1iddatan/ khan - bera dar du. (Ber dicha chekkhdolu tseran Iiddat). Delakh kkho'rush verg milla velakh' - Tso tsunna shen gIullakkhakh atto khu'lu'itur iu.
KhIara Delan omra du, Tso shu'ga dossina dolu. Dala tsIanviir vu shen k'inoikh Shekh kkho'rush verg, Tso alsamiokkkhur tsunna ial.

Iaita /i sha'sh Iiddatana bitina bolu zudarii/ sha'sh a /kh1ai maroi/ Iechchakh', shain tarone kh'a'zhzha. Zen ma de tsarna ash gatto iartsa. U'sh berakh balakh', kharzh e tsarna ber khillalts. Tsara shuna berash dakkhadakh' - tseran makh dIalo. Vovshashtsa dogadovla /khIai mar a, zuda a/ khazchu gIillakkhtsa. Shuna khalo khilakh' /ber dakkhorna kharzh ian/, kkhechu zudcho dakkhoila tsunna.

Kh'al dolcho shen kh'olakh kharzh ioila. Shegakh' kIezzig ritsk' dolcho kharzh ioila Dala shena dellachukh. Dala tskh'anna sina tIe tsa du'llu Sha tsunna dellarg ben. Dala khalonal tIa'kh'a atto khu'lu'itur iu.
Masa iurt du'kh'al'ia'lla khilla sha Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Delan a, Tsu'nan elchaniin omrana. Okha u'sh tergal iira chIogIachu kh'esapatsa, Okha Iazap dira tsarna ircha Iazapatsa.
Tsara Ievshira shain gIullakkhan bala, tseran gIullakkhan tIa'kh'e khilira eshalla.
Dala kechdina tsarna chIogIa Iazap. Shu kkhera Delakh, khIai kh'ek'al dersh, sha'sh iiman dillina dolu. Dala shu'ga bossina kh'ekham (K'ur'an).

Elcha /vaiitina shu'ga/, tso shuna du'itsush Delan bilgala dolu aiatash iiman dillinarsh, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a bodanera nure bakharkh'ama. Delakh a tiishina, dika Iamal esh verg - Tso iza vu'llur vu boshmashka, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, iza tsu chokh' guttar la'ttar vu. Khaza khiliitina Dala tsunna ritsk'.

Dela vu Sha kkho'llinarg vorkhI stigal, la'ttakh a tsa'rga terra. /Delan/ omra okh'adussu tsarna iukk'ekhula shuna khaarkh'ama i Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush vuila a, Tso chula'tsna iuila masso a khIuma Shen Iilmatsa.
KhIai paikhamar! Akh' khIunda kh'aram do Dala kh'una kh'anal dinargkh'an zudarii rezaban gIertash? Dela gechdiirig a, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
Dala tIe dillina shuna duinash bastar. Dela vu shun gIo'ncha. Iza vu khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.

Paikhamara shen tskh'abolchu zudarshka (Kh'afsate) k'ailakh diitsira tskh'a khabar. Tso (Kh'afsato) iza kkhecha'rga (Iaishate) diitsicha, Dala iza tsunna (elchanna) guchuda'kkkhicha, tsunakh (tsu khabarkh) tskh'aderg dovziitira tso (elchanas Kh'afsate), tskh'aderg kh'uldiira. Tso tsu'nga (Kh'afsate) i diitsicha, elira /Kh'afsata/: "Kh'an diitsina kh'o'ga iza?" Tso elira: "So'ga diitsina iza /nekhan k'ailenash/ khuush volcho, /masso a kh1uma/ dika devzash volcho (Dala)."

Ash shimma (Kh'afsata a, Iaishata a) toba dinekh'ara Dele... /I dika khir dara shuna ash tsunna du'kh'al bart bechul/. Shu shinnan dog dIatevzhira /Delan elchantsa lelo dezachu g1illakkhakh/. Ash vovshashna gIo dakh' tsunna (paikhamarna) du'kh'al - bakk'alla a, Dela - Iza vu i larviir verg, Dzhibril a du, mu'min nakhakh dika mel verg a vu, malikash a du tsul tIa'kh'a gIo'nchii.

Mega iza Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu tsu'nan Dala, tso shu diticha, tsunna shul dika zudarii balo: sha'sh busalba bolush, mu'min bolush, mu'tIakh' bolush, toba desh bolush, Iibadat desh bolush, /paikhamartsa/ dIasalelash bolush, kh'alkha marekh' khillarsh a, mare bakhanza bolu mekhkarii a.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Larde sha'sh a, shain do'zal a /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIerakh, shen iagorig nakh a, tIulgasha bolchu. Tsunna tIe khIo'ttiina ircha, chIogIa malikash du, iukha tsa dovlush Dala shaina omra dinchukh, sha'sh kkhochushdesh shaiga omra desh derg.
KhIai /Delakh/ tsateshnarsh! Shu bekhkaza ma diila takhana /k'ematdiinakh'/: shuna besh bolu bekkham ash /du'nenakh'/ desh khillarg /bakh'anekh'/ du.

KhIai iiman dillinarsh! Shu d1aderza Dele tsIena toba dartsa - tarlo shu Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu shun Dala shu tsIandan shun k'inoikh, /tIakkkha/ shu boshmashna chu dikhka, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolchu, otsu diinakh' Dala siisazviir vats paikhamar a, tsu'ntsa iiman dillinarsh a. Tseran nur dedda lelar du tsarna kh'alkhakhula a, tseran a'ttu ku'igash dolchu agIorkh'ara a, tsara olush: "Tkho Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu tkhan Dela, Akh' kkhochushdelakh' tkhan nur, Akh' tkhuna gechdelakh'. Bakk'alla a, Kh'o vu-kkh masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush verg".
KhIai paikhamar! K'iisam lattabe tsateshacha'rtsa a, munepak'ashtsa a, lu'ra khila tsa'rtsa. Tseran chugIoila zho'zhakhati iu. Ma von du-kkh /tseran/ dIaderzar!

Dala masal daliina tsateshacharna Nukh'an zudchukh a, LutIan zudchukh a: u'sh bara Tkhan dikchu lekh shina lena /ku'iga/ kIel, tsara shimmo a tsarna shinna teshnabekhk bira /zina dar botsu/, tskh'anna a khIumantsa Delera sha'sh shi' kIelkh'ar-m tsa ia'kkkhira tsara, elira /tsa'rga/: "Shu shi' chu gIo /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIerga tsu chu g1osh bolchartsa".

Dala masal daliina iiman dillincharna FirIavnan zudchukh, tso ma elira: "So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, Akh' suna delakh' Kh'una gergakh' ialsamani chokh' tsIa, Akh' so kIelkh'ar'iakkkhalakh' FirIavnakh a, tsu'nan balkhakh a, Akh' so kIelkh'ar'iakkkhalakh' zulam dechu k'omakh".

Iimranan ioI Mar'iamakh a /masal daliina Dala/, sha lardina khillachu shen ioIalla. Okha tsu'nan degIa chu sa u'izira Tkhan Sikh (Dzhabrail maliko), tso (Mar'iama) bak'dira sha Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu shen Delan deshnash, Tsu'nan zhainash a, iza khilira mu'tIakh' bolcharakh.
Berkate (khastame) khili Iza (Dela), Shen ku'igakh' pachchakh'alla dolu, Sha masso a khIumanna tIekh' nitsk' kkhochush volu.
Iza vu Sha kkho'llina dalar a, dakhar a shu zerkh'ama, mu'lkharnig vu shukh vuno dikanig Iamal iartsa. Iza vu veza verg a, gechdiirig a.
Iza vu Sha kkho'llina vorkhI stigal tIettIa. Kh'una gur ma iats sov K'inkhetame volcho kkho'llinchungakh' tskh'a a vovshashtsa tsa iogIu khIuma. Tokhal bIa'rg: gui kh'una tskh'a a ia'dda mettig?
TIakkkha iukh-iukha a tokhal bIa'rg - kh'o'ga dukhado'rzur du bIa'rgtokhar kIeldisna, sha gIeldella dolush.
Okha khazdina du'nenanstigal chirkkhashtsa (sedarchashtsa), Okha khiliitina u'sh shaitIanashna kkhossarsh. Okha kechdina tsarna (shaitIanashna) egachu tsIeranIazap.
Sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh(Delakh) tsateshnacharna a zho'zhakhatin Iazap du. Ma von dIaderzar du-kkh iza!
Sha'sh tsu chu kkho'ssicha, tsarna khozur du tsu'nan ugIarsh, i sha kkhekhkash iolush.
Sha o'gIaz'ialla ekkkha kech'ella: tsu chu /k'inosh dincheran/ tolgIa (toba) massaza kkho'ssicha a, tsu'nan gIarolasha tsa'rga khottur du: "Kkheramcha (Delan elcha) tsa veara shu'ga?", a'lla.
Tsara er: "KhIa', veara tkho'ga kkheramcha - Okha iza khartsvira, okha elira: "Dala khIumma a tsa dossiina, shu ma du dokkkhachu tilarchokh'".
Tsara elira: "Tkho khillekh'ara ladugIush a, oila esh a - tkho khir ma datsara egachu tsIeran daishlakh'".
U'sh k'era khilira shain k'inna. /Delan k'inkhetamakh/ ma genakh' bu-kkh egachu tsIeran dai!
Bakk'alla a, shaina gush votstsushekh' sha'sh kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu shain Delakh kkho'rush bersh - tsarna du gechdar a, iokkkha ial.
K'ailadakkkha shain dosh, ia guchudakkkha iza - bakk'alla a, Iza vu degnashkakh' derg khuush verg.
Tk'a tsa kha'a Tsunna, sha kkho'llinchunna? Iza vu sov dika kkhetame verg a, sov dika khuush verg a.

Iza vu shuna latta kIeda /lela atta/ dinarg - lela /shu, khIai nakh/ tsu'nan agIonashkakhula, daa tsu'nan ritsk'akh (Dala la'ttakh' della niImatash kh'anal k'akh'egartsa). - Tsu'nga du /shun keshnashkara/ gIovtar.
Shu teshna dui /khIai Dalla inkarlo esh bersh/ stiglakh' volchukh, Tso sha'sh la'ttakh khudor dats a'lla, t1akkkha i /latta/ dettalush?
Ia shu teshna dui stiglakh' volchukh Tso shaina bou'itur bats a'lla tIulgekh /bu'zna/ chIogIa mokh? TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna, mukha bu San kkheram.
Khartsbira /elchanash/ tsaral kh'alkha khillachara a - mukha khilira /tsarna/ San inkarlo! (Ma ircha khilira San Iazap!).

Tsarna tsa go olkhazarshshaina tIekhula lelash dolu - /shain tIamash/ darzhadesh, tIakkkha tIeguldesh? U'sh satsadesh verg-m Sov K'inkhetame volu Dela ben vats. Bakk'alla a, Iza vu-kkh masso a khIuma gush verg.
Mila vu i shuna bIo khilla gIo diir derg sha sov k'inkhetame volchu Delan Iazap dukhatokha? Tsateshnarsh ma bats Iekhabalargakh' ben.
Mila vu iza shuna ritsk' lur derg, Tso Shen ritsk' satsadicha? KhIa', ma /Dalla/ du'kh'albevlla u'sh, ma /bak'dolchunna/ gena bevlla u'sh.
Tk'a shen iu'kh' tIekh' lelash verg vu niisa, ia niisachu novk'a niissa lelash verg vu?
Akh' ala /tsa'rga, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Iza vu shu kkhiinarg a, shuna khazar a, bIa'rsa a, degnash a dinarg a. KIezzig du-kkh ash barkalla olurg!"
Akh' ala: "Iza vu shu la'ttakh' darzhiinarg, Tsu'nga guldiir dolush a du shu".
Tsara olu: "Matsa khir du i ash bokhurg, shu bak'lu'ish khillekh'?"
Akh' ala: "Iilma Dalla gergakh' du, tk'a so bilgala volu k'eramcha vu".
Iza shaina gicha gergakh', tsateshnacheran iakhkh'ash irchaelira, /tsa'rga/ elira /malikasha, bekhk bokkkhush/: "KhIara du iza ash /du'nenakh' dolush/ sha lo'khush khillarg!"
Akh' ala: "Goi shuna, so Dala khIallakvicha, so'tsa bersh a, ia Tso tkhokh k'inkhetam bicha, kh'an kIelkh'arbokhur bu tsateshnarsh lazosh dolchu Iazapakh?"
Akh' ala: "Iza vu sov k'inkhetame volu Dela, Tsu'nga iiman dillina okha, Tsunna tIe a tevzhina. TIa'kh'a khuur du shuna, mila vu bilgalchu tilarchokh'".
Akh' ala: "Goi shuna, i shun khi 1u'irantsa lek'cha, kh'an lur du shuna o'khush dolu kh'astan khi?"
Nyn. Dui bou As k'olamtsa a, tsara /nakha/ iazdeshdolchu'ntsa a:
Kh'o ma vats /khIai Mukh'ammad/ kh'o Kkhiosh - Kkhobuchu (Delan) k'inkhetamtsa zhiniikh.
Bakk'alla a, kh'una ma iu khadalur iotsu ial.
Bakk'alla a, kh'o ma vu siilakh'-dokkkha (khaza) gIillakkhkh'aigakh' dolush.
TIa'kh'a gur du kh'una, tsarna a gur du,
Mila vu shukh pitane la'tsnarg.
Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu kh'an Dela - Tsunna dika vevza Shen nek'akh tilavellarg a, Tsunna dika bevza niisachu novk'akh' bersh a.
Kh'o /khIai Mukh'ammad/ mu'tIakh' ma khilalakh' /din/ khartsdesh bolcharna.
U'sh luush bara kh'o kIeda khila - tIakkkha sha'sh kIeda khir bara.
Kh'o mu'tIakh' ma khilalakh' masso a /kharts/ duinash dukkkha boush siisaz- volchunna,
/Kh1or/ lu'ish volchunna /nakhakh ta'kh'ashkha/, /tsarna iukk'ekh'/ mettanash dIasakkhu'ikh'ush volchunna,
Dikchu /khIumanna/ novk'arlo esh volchunna, k'inosh desh dozanekh va'lla volchunna,
K'izachunna, tsul sovnakha a shen du'nenvalar shekonekh' dolchunna(da mila vu tsa khuush, bo'kha lelartsa vevzash volchu).
Shen da'khni a, k1entii a khilartsa /Delan dozanekh a va'lla, kura a va'lla i/.
Shena Tkhan aiatash diishicha, tso elira: "Kh'alkhalerachiin tu'iranash du khIorsh".
Okha tsu'nan mera tIe vastdu'llur du.
Bakk'alla a, Okha ziira u'sh, Okha tskh'ana beshan dai zerakh terra: tsara dui biira, sha'sh /beshara/ sto'mash bokhur bu Iu'iranna, a'lla,
"Dala muk'alakh'" tsa elira tsara.
TIakkkha tsunna (beshana) go tesira kh'o kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu kh'an Delera go tosush dolcho, u'sh nab esh bolush.
/Egna/ Iarzh'ellarg sanna Iu'irenga elira i /tseran besh/.
Iu'iranga bevlicha, vovshashka kkhiikkhira tsara:
"Shain besh chu gIo, sha'sh sto'mash bokhur belakh'", a'lla.
U'sh bolabelira, mellasha vovshashka lu'ish:
"Takhana shuna tIe /shun besha/ tskh'a a miskanig ma vogIiila /sto'mash bo'khush/".
Iu'iranna novk'a bevlira u'sh, shain dagakh' /miskanig/ dukhatokha nitsk' bolush.
Iza shaina /egna/ gicha, tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, vai tiladella,
KhIa', vai /i sto'mash/ botsush disina".
Tsarakh kkhecharal Iedale volcho elira: "As tsa a'llera shu'ga: ash /Dalla/ khastam binekh'ara", a'lla?
Tsara elira: "Vonakh tsIena vu-kkh i vai kkhiosh-kkhobush volu Dela, bakk'alla a, vai khili-kkh zulamkhoi".
U'sh vovshashna bekhkash bokhush du'kh'albevlira.
Tsara elira: "Ma bala bu vaina: vai khilira /Delan dozanekh/ tIekhdovlursh.
Vai kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu vai Dala vaina tsul dikachu'ntsa /i besh/ khiitso a tarlo. Bakk'alla a, vai kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu vain Delan /dikane/ dogdokhush du-kkh".
Ishtta du Iazap, tk'a ekhartan Iazap vuno dokkkha du, u'sh khuush khillekh'.
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna sha'sh kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Dalla gergakh' niImatiin boshmash iu.
Tk'a Okha khu'lu'itu /Dalla/ mu't1akh' bolu nakhk'inosh decharakh tera?
Shuna khIun khilla /ishtta oila ial/? Ash mukha kh'ukam do?
Ia shuna zhaina du, ash shena chokh' do'shush /i kh'ukam/?
Bakk'alla a, shuna tsu /zhaina/ chokh' dolush ash mel khorzhurg?
Ia shuna Tkho'tsa bi'na duinash bu k'ematde kkhachchalts, bakk'alla a, shaina ash dina kh'ukam khir dolush?
Khatta tsa'rga /khIai Mukh'ammad/, mila vu tsarakh i chIagIdiirig.
Ia tseran nak'ostiibu? Skh'abalabe tsara shain i nak'ostii, sha'sh bak'lu'ish khillekh'.
Otsu diinakh' nastarsh erzina khir iu, u'sh kkhoikkhur bu suzhude - tsarna mogur dats, -
BIa'rgash okh'adakhna, siisazalla tIeio'zhna. Tsa'rga suzhude kkhoikkhush dara u'sh mogush bolush.
Vita So suo khIara khabar khartsdesh volchu'ntsa. Okha skh'alotsur bu u'sh kIez-kIezzig /khIallakbartsa/ tsarna tsa khuuchukhula.
As khan lur iu tsarna. /Tseran mekarlonna du'kh'al/ San mekarlo chIogIa iu-kkh.
Ia akh' tsa'rga makh bo'khu, u'sh dekkharsha bazbina bolush?
Ia tsa'rgakh' gushdotsurg /devzash Iilma/ du, tsara dIaiazdesh?
Sobar de kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu kh'an Delan kh'ukamna, ma khilalakh' chIeran nak'ostakhtera: tso /Dele/ kkhiikkhira sha /chIeran kiirakh' pashmallitsa/ gatvella volush.
Sha Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchun niImat shekh tsa kkhi'nekh'ara, iza kkho'ssina khir vara /chIeran kiirara/ ara siisaz a khilla.
Sha Kkhiosh-kkhobush volcho kha'rzhira iza, tso khiliitira iza dikacharakh.
Tsateshnarsh kiicha bu shain bIa'rgashtsa kh'o khIallakvanshaina kh'ekham kheznachul tIa'kh'a, tsara olu: "Bakk'alla a, iza zhiniikh vu-kkh".
Iza-m dats masso a Ialamna kh'ekham ben.
Bak'khilla do'zhnarg.
KhIun du i bak'khilla do'zhnarg?
Steno khaiitina kh'o'ga /khIai Mukh'ammad/, khIun du i bak'khilla do'zhnarg?
Samudasha a, Iadasha a khartsdira tukhush derg.
Amma samudash a - u'sh khIallakbira /chIogIallitsa/ dozanakh bellachu mokh'atsa.
Va amma Iadash a - tk'a u'sh khIallakbira inzare nu'tsk'alchu t1ekh shilachu mekhatsa.

Tso /nu'tsk'alla/ baliitira i tsarna vorkhI busa a, barkhI diinakh' a tIettIa. Kh'una gur bara nakh otsu diinakh' /khIallakbina/ dIasakkhissina, da'ssa disna (chokh' khora iolu) khurmanan dittan gIadash sanna.
Tskh'a a bukhadisar gui kh'una tsarna?
Veara FirIavn, tsul kh'alkha mel verg a, mu'tafikatasha /beara/ k'a desh.
Tsara Iesalla iira sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Delan elchanna - tIakkkha u'sh skh'ala'tsira t1ekh chIogIa dolchu skh'alatsaro.
Okha khi dozanakh da'lcha, dikh'ira shu lelash dolchu'ntsa(kemantsa).
Iza khiliitarkh'ama shuna kh'ekham, tidame dolchu lerge tidame etsiitarkh'ama a.
Surlekkhcha tskh'ana lakkhartsa,
Latta a dIadikh'cha, la'mnash a /aidicha/, tsarakh a'tta kh1ur bicha tskh'ana atartsa -
Otsu diinakh' dog1ur du danza tsa da'llarg (k'ematde).
Stigal iedar iu, otsu diinakh' khir iu iza ledar'ia'lla (ch1ag1o iotsush),
Malikash khir du tsu'nan iistashkakhula. Kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu kh'an Delan Iarsh kh'ur iu otsu diinakh' barkhIamoshaina t1ekhula.
Otsu diinakh' shu khIottor du /kkhielna/ kh'alkha, tskh'a a kh'ullesh khu'lu khIuma kh'uldella khir dats shukh.
Amma shen zhaina shega a'ttu (bak'akh'ara) ku'iga dellarg, tso er ma du /ch1og1a khazakhetta/: "KhIei, skh'adu'ila! Desha san zhaina!
Bakk'alla a, so mo'ttushma vara /tskh'ana diinakh'/ san kh'esap suna du'kh'alkkhetar duila".
Iza khir vu sha reza volchu dakharekh'.
Lekkhachu beshakh'.
Shen sto'mash gergakh' bolush.
/Er du tsa'rga/: "GIoza daa, gIoza mala shaina /du'nenan/ dIadakhanchu denoshkakh' sha'sh kh'alkhada'kkkhinarg /bakh'anekh'/ ".
Va amma shen zhaina shega a'rru (khartskh'ara) ku'iga dellarg, tso er ma du: "EkhI! I san zhaina so'ga ma dellekh'ara!
I san /ch1og1a suna du'kh'al dolu/ kh'esap khuush tsa khillekh'ara so.
Ekh1! I san /du'nenakh'/ valar khillekh'ara tIa'khkh'ara, /so iukha den tsa vesh/.
So kIelkh'ar tsa va'kkkhi san bakhamo.
KhIallakkhili so'gara san dolakh' mel khillarg (san u'iranash a, san kh'al a)".
/Delan omra dogIur du/: "Skh'alatsa iza! DIavikhka iza!
T1akkkha zho'zhakhati chu d1aviga iza.
TIakkkha shen iakhalla kkhuztk'e itt dol iolchu zIainakh vikhkina d1alalla iza".
Bakk'alla a, iza vatsara siilakh'-vokkkhachu Delakh teshash.
Miskachunna daa khIuma dala /kkhecharna/ dagadou'itush vatsara iza.
Vats tsunna takhana kkhuzakh' tskh'a a dottagI.
Daa khIuma dats dilarsh ben.
U'sh duur dats gIalatbevllachara a ben.
KhIan-khIa! As dui bou shuna gush dolchu'ntsa
Shuna gush dotsuchu'ntsa a:
Bakk'alla a, iza siilakh'chu elchanan dosh ma du (Delera tso du'itsush).
ShaIirandosh ma dats iza, kIezzig du-kkh shu teshash derg.
Bozbuunchin dosh a ma dats iza, kIezzig du-kkh ash oila esh derg.
Ialamiin Degara okh'ado'ssina du iza (K'ur'an).
TsoTkhuna a'llekh'ara tskh'atstsa (Okha a'lla dotsu) deshnash,
Okha skh'ala'tsna khir vara iza a'ttu (bak'akh'ara) ku'iga,
TIakkkha khadiina khir bara tsu'nan degan pkha.
Shukh tskh'a a khir ma vatsara tsunakh iza dukhatukhush.
Bakk'alla a, iza (K'ur'an) kh'ekham bu-kkh /Delakh/ kkho'rush bolcharna.
Bakk'alla a, Tkho khuush du-kkh shukh /din/ khartsdesh bersh buila.
Bakk'alla a, iza (K'ur'an) g1aig1a iu-kkh tsateshacharna. (Tsu'nga iiman dillincharna khir dolu niImatash gina poshme khir bu kerstanash k'ematdiinakh').
Bakk'alla a, iza kh'ak'-bak'derg du-kkh!
Siilakh'-vokkkhachu kh'uo kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu kh'an Delan tsIe khastae! (Masso a vochu sibatekh ts1anve Iza).
Diikhira tskh'ana do'khucho duzhu Iazap
Tsateshacharna iats tsunna ian du'kh'alo.
Delera /Iazap/ du iza, Shen /malikashna kh'aladovla/ kenzash iolchu.
Kh'aladovlu malikash a, Sa (Dzhibril malik) a Iza volchu, shen baram /nakhana gergakh'/ shovztk'e itt ezar sho dolchu diinakh'.
Akh' sobar delakh' /khIai Mukh'ammad tsu kerstanasha kh'o siisazavan gIertash du'itsush dolchungakh'/ khazchu sobartsa.
Bakk'alla a, tsarna iza (Delan Iazap) gush du genakh',
Tkhuna iza gush du gergakh'.
Otsu diinakh' stigal khir iu lalina tsIesta sanna.
La'mnash khir du /bezhniin tIera skh'ada'kkkhina/ tsIoka sanna.
/Otsu diinakh'/ dottagIcho dottagIchukh khottur ma dats /shen bala sovbalarna/-
U'sh vovshashna goitush khir ma bu /khIette a kho'ttur dats tsara vovshekh/. Luur du k'inosh dinchunna otsu diinakh' Iazapakh kIelkh'arvala shen kIentii dIabella a,
Shen zuda a, shen vasha a /dIabella a/,
Sha tIela'tsna khilla dolu shen taipaa /dIadella a/,
Masso a la'ttakh' mel verg a /dIavella a/, tIakkkha kIelkh'arvala /luur dara tsunna/.
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, iza (zho'zhakhati) alu lepa tsIe iu.
Skh'aozor dolush du tso ko'rtan chIor.
TIekkhoikkhur vu tso sha /Dela tskh'a' varkh/ iukhava'llarg a, /iimanakh/ dIaveddarg a,
Guldiinarg /du'nenakh' da'khni, kh'anal-kh'aram tsa k'estosh/, t1akkkha i d1adillinarga /Delan a, nekhan a kh'ak' d1a tsa lush/.
Adam kkho'llina du /bala be'cha/ sobar dotsush, /Delan niImatashna/ shukur dotsush.
Shekh tsadezarg (pek'aralla, tsamgar, kkheram) 1ottadelcha, nu'tsk'ala sobarkh volush (masso a dikanakh dog du'llush),
Shekh dikanig 1ottadelcha, nu'tsk'ala dukhadettash /sagIa dalar, dikachu agIor kharzh iar a/,
Lamazash desh bersh botsursh,
Sha'sh shain lamazashkakh' guttar bolush.
Shain /kh'olekh'/ bilgala kh'ak' dolush
/SagIa/ do'khuchunna a, shegakh' khIumma dotschunna a (sagIa tsa do'khuchunna a),
Sha'sh dekkharan debak'desh bersh,
Sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu shain Delan Iazapakh kkho'rush bersh.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu tseran Delan Iazap teshame dats /mu'lkhachu khenakh' dan tarlo/.
Sha'sh shain evkh'e mezhenash lar'esh bersh
Shain zudarii botsucharakh a, shain a'ttu ku'igo doladina zudariibotsucharakh a. Otsargakh' u'sh bekhke bats.
Tsul tIekhbevllarsh - u'sh /Delan/ dozanekh bevllarsh bu.
Sha'shshaina bina tesham a, sha'sh iina vaIda a kkhochush'esh bersh,
Sha'sh shain teshallina tIekh' la'ttash bersh,
Sha'sh shain lamazash Ialashdeshbersh -
U'sh /ialsamanin/ boshmashkakh' khir bu shaikh siidina.
KhIun khilla tsateshnacharna - kh'una kh'alkha dIaskh'au'idush bolcharna,
/Kh'una/ a'ttu agIorkh'a, a'rru agIorkh'a a tobanash esh bolchu /busalbanekh tsa beshash vovshashka du'itsush bolchu: khIorsh ialsamane gIakh', vai tsaral kh'alkha gIur du/?
Luush vui - te tsarakh masso a stag sha niImatiin ialsamane vakhiita?
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, Okha u'sh kkho'llira tsarna khuuchukh /tIadamakh, kurabovla tsa o'shura tsarna/.
KhIan-khIa! As dui bou malkhbaliin a, malkhbuziina Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu Delakh: bakk'alla a, Tkho nitsIk' bolush du-kkh
/U'sh/ khiitsaban tsaral dikacha'rtsa, /tsu tIekh'/ tkhol kh'alkhaver vats /tskh'a a/.
Bita u'sh /shain tilarchokh'/ dIasaiidan a, lovzan a shain vaIda iina iolchu /k'emat/ denna du'kh'alkkhettalts.
Otsu diinakh' u'sh arabovlur bu keshnash chu'ra sikhbevlla, sha'sh /kh'alkha sha'sh Iibadat desh khilla bolu/ tIulgashna tIe bovdush sanna,
Shain bIa'rgash okh'ato'khna. Siisazalla kkhu'ur iu tsarakh. I de du-kkh tsarna khir du a'lla vaIda iina khillarg!
Bakk'alla a, Okha vakhiitira shen k'omana tIe Nukh': "Kkheram tasa kh'an k'omana tsunna tIe lazosh dolu Iazap dale", a'lla.
Tso elira: "KhIai san k'am! Bakk'alla a, so shuna /vaiitina/ bilgala volu kkheramcha vu-kkh:
Dalla Iibadat de, Tsunakh kkhera, suna mu'tIakh' khila!

/TIakkkha/ Tso gechdiir du shuna shun k'inosh, tIa'kh'atottur du shu /Iazap tsa desh/ tskh'ana to'khnachu khanna - Iozhalla t1ekkhachchalts. Bakk'alla a, Delan Iozhalla, sha e'cha, tIa'kh'atottur iats, shu khuush khillekh'".
Tso (Nukh'as sha dukkha k'akh'egnachul tIa'kh'a, nakha din tIe tsa lotsush, gattavelcha) elira: "So Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, bakk'alla a, as kkhaikkhiira /din/ san k'ome busa a, diinakh' a.
Amma san kkhaikkhamo u'sh /dinakh/ bovdar ben alsam tsa da'kkkhi.

Bakk'alla a, as u'sh mel kkhaikkhi Kh'o'ga shaina gechdan, tsara shain pIelgash shain lergii chudu'khkara /san kkhaikkhar shaina tsa khaziitarkh'ama/, shain bedarshtsa shain kortosh kh'uldora /tsa khaziitarkh'ama/, u'sh chIagIbelira /shain k'inoi tIekh'/, kurabevlira kurabovlartsa.
TIakkkha as tsa'rga kkhaikkhira chIogIa (tsa kkho'rush, az aidina).
TIakkkha, bakk'alla a, as tsa'rga kkhaikkhira guchakh', as kkhaikkhira tsa'rga k'ailakha.
As elira: "Gechdar dekha sha'sh kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Dele, bakk'alla a, Iza khilla dukkha gechdiirig.
Tso stigal iou'itur iushuna alsam /dogIitsa/.
Tso gIodiir du shuna kh'olatsa, kIentashtsa, khu'lu'itur iu shuna boshmash, khu'lu'itur du shuna khish-tatolash.
Shuna khIun khilla? KhIunda dog tsa dokhu ash Dele /Iza/ liirartsa?
Tso kkho'llina shu darzhatsa (kh'alkha tIadam, tIakkkha detina tsIi khu'lush, tIakkkha - t1ekhk (da'Iakhk) khu'lush, tIakkkha tsunna tIe zhizhig latosh...).
Shuna tsa go, mukha kkho'llira Dala tIettIa vorkhI stigal?
Tso khiliitira butt tsarna chokh' nur khilla, Tso khiliitira malkh chirkkh khilla.
Dala shu skh'adaliitira la'ttakh oramat /sanna kkhu'ush/. (Adam la'ttakh kkho'llira).
TIakkkha Tso shu iukha dIaderzor du tsu'nga (la'tte), aradokhur du /la'tta chu'ra/ aradakhartsa /k'ematdiinakh'/.
Dala khiliitina shuna latta, /dIabarzhina/ kuz sanna.
Shu tsunna tIekhula leliitarkh'ama, shaina shu'ira nek'ash lu'itsush".
Nukh'as elira: "So kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, bakk'alla a, tsara suna Iesalla ii, u'sh tIa'kh'akhIo'tti shen bakhamo a, shen do'zalo a shaina eshalla ben sov tsa ia'kkkhinchunna.
Tsara ii tIekh iokkkha mekarlo:
Tsara elira: "Ma bitalash shain delii a, ma vitalash Vadda a, SuvaI a, IagIus a, IaIuk' a, Nasr a!"
/Nukh'as doIa dira/: "Tsara tilira dukkhanash, zulamkhoi sov ma bakhalakh' tilartsii ben".
Shaina gIalatekh (k'inoikh) u'sh khi chu bakhiitira, tIakkkha tsIerga bakhiitira, tsarna tsa kariira Dela votsurg gIo'nchii.
Nukh'as elira: "So kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, Akh' ma vitalakh' la'tta tIekh' tsateshacharakh tskh'a a tsIa chokh' vekhash verg.
Bakk'alla a, Akh' u'sh bitakh', tsara Kh'an lesh tilor bu, tsara du'nenavokkkhur vats k'inosh desh verg, tIekh tsa teshash verg ben.

So kkhiosh-kkhobush volu san Dela, Akh' gechdelakh' suna a, san denna-nanna a, mu'min khilla san tsIa chu va'llachunna a, mu'min bozharshna a, mu'min zudarshna a, Akh' sov ma bakhalakh' zulamkhoi khIallakbartsii ben!"
Akh' ala: "So'ga vekh'etsa khaiitina: "Ladu'igIira /K'ur'ane/ zhiniin tskh'ana tobano, tIakkkha tsara elira: "Bakk'alla a, tkhuna khezira tskh'a tamashe deshar!
Tso (K'ur'ano) nisvo niisachu novk'a, tkho tsunakh tiishira, okha latsanne a lotsur vats tkhash kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Delatsa tskh'a a nak'ost.
Bakk'alla a, lakkhadeli tkho kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Delan vozalla - tsa letsi Tso zuda-nak'ost a, do'zalkho a.
Bakk'alla a, khili tkhan Iovdalnigolush Dalla tIekh' kIorggera khartsderg.
Tkhuna mo'ttura tsk'a a er dats adamo a, zhino a Dalla tIekh' khartsderg.
Adamiin tskh'a bozhariibara larlush zhiniin bozharshtsa (tsa'rgara gIo lu'itsush) - tsara sovbekhira u'sh tilartsa (Delan dozanekh bovlartsa).
Bakk'alla a, tsarna mo'ttura shuna mo'ttush khillarg: "Tsk'a a Dala tskh'a a denviir vats", a'lla.
/Zhinasha elira/: "Tkho kh'akkhadelira stiglakh, tkhuna iza kariira nu'tsIk'alchu gIarolekh, tsIe tukhuchu sedarchekh iu'zzina.
Tkho khilira tsigakh' okh'akhuush ladogIaran okh'akhaarna. LadugIush volchunna khIintsa karor shena kIelo iina Iesh bolu tsIe tukhu seda.
Tkhuna khaats, vonig luush du la'ttakh' bolcharna ia u'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobush volu Dela tsarna niisa nek' luush vu.
Tkhokh dikanash a du, tkhokh u'sh dotsursh a du, tkho khilira taip-taipana nek'enash.
Tkhuna khiira: tkhuna tsk'a a nitsk' kkhochur bats Dela (-n omrakh dovla) la'ttakh' a, tkhuna tsk'a a nitsk' kkhochur bats devdana kIelkh'ardovla a.
Tkhuna niisa nek' (K'ur'an) khezcha, tkho Tsunakh (Delakh) tiishira. Sha kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu shen Delakh teshash verg - kkho'rur vats shen mela esharkh a, zulam khilarkh a /k'a sov da'lla/.
Bakk'alla a, tkhokh /Dalla/ mu't1akh' dersh a du, tkhokh /bak'dolchukh/ dIadirzinarsh a du. Tk'a sha'sh /Dalla/ mu't1akh' khillarsh - dikachunna tIe /niisachu novk'a/ nisbella.
Amma bak'bolchu nek'akh dIabirzinarsh - tsarakh khili zho'zhakhatina iagorig".
U'sh nisbellekh'ara /islaman/ novk'a, Okha malor dara tsarna shortta khi (o'shuchu khenakh' shortta dogIa doitur dara Okha tsarna),
Tsu'ntsa u'sh zerkh'ama. Sha kkhiosh-kkhobush volu shen Dela kh'ekhorakh dIavo'rzush verg - Tso vokhu'itur vu i lan khala dolchu Iazapa chu.
Bakk'alla a, ma'zhdigashDelan du - ash ma kkhaikkha Delatsa tskh'a a!
Bakk'alla a, Delan lai (Mukh'ammad) d1akhIo'tticha Tsu'nga kkhoikkhush,u'sh (busalba dzhinash) disira tIettIa tsunna tIe guldella /ladogIa luush/.
Akh' ala /tsu kerstanashka, khIai Mukh'ammad/: "Bakk'alla a, as kkhoikkhu so kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu san Dele, Tsu'ntsa tskh'a a nak'ost tsa lotsu as".
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, so vats san dolakh' shuna zen dolush, niisa nek' bolush a".
Akh' ala: "Bakk'alla a, so Delakh laror vats tskh'ammo a, suna karor iats Iza votsurg vadan mettig.

Delera derg a, Tsu'nan elchanallin derg a dIakkhachor ben /nakhe dats suna tIekh'/. Dalla a, Tsu'nan elchanna a Iesalla esh verg - bakk'alla a, tsunna zho'zhakhatin tsIe khir iu, u'sh tsu chokh' guttar la'ttash.
Shaina khir du a'lla vaIda iinarg galts - tIakkkha khuur du tsarna, mila vu vuno ledar gIo'nchii khilartsa, vuno kIezzig nitsk' khilartsa.
Akh' ala: "Suna khaats, gerga du i shuna khir du a'lla vaIda iinarg ia so kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu san Dala tsunna khan to'khna,
K'aile khuurg /vu Iza/, Tso tsa kkhiavo Shen k'ailenna tIe tskh'a a
/Sha Dalla/ reza khilla elcha votsurg. T1akkkha, bakk'alla a, Tso lo'lu'itu elchanna kh'alkhakhula a, tIekh'akhula a /iza dzhinekh a, shait1anan vasvasallakh a Ialashvesh malikiin/ tergame toba.
Shena khaiitan tsara (elchanasha) dIakkhachiina duila sha'sh kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu shain Delan elchanalla. Tsa'rgakh' derg kkhochchush khuush vu Iza, khIor khIuma dagariina Tso baramtsa".
KhIai /bedarkh/ dIakh'a'rchinarg!
GIattabusa, tskh'a kIezzig /bu'isa/ iite /kh'aina sadaIa/.
Tsu'nan akh /iite/, ia tsunakh tskh'a kIezzig eshae.
Ia tIetokha tsunna. K'ur'an desha (mellasha, khazchu) deshartsa.
Okha du'kh'altukhur du kh'una deza dosh.
Bakk'alla a, bu'isanan khan eza iu (lamaz dechunna), vuno bilgal iu dashtsa.
Bokk'alla a, kh'una /dan/ diinakh' dekhkha gIullakkhash du (K'ur'an desha muk'a tsa volu kh'o).
Kh'ekhae kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu /Delan/ tsIe. /Du'nenan gIullakkhekh/ khada Tsunna (Dala) Iibadat dartsa, (dog tsIena) khadartsa.
Malkhbalin a, malkhbuzen a Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vu Iza, vats kkhin dela Iza votsurg, latsa Tsunakh /kh'aina/ vekal (tIetovzha gIo'ncha).
Sobar de tsara (Makkan kerastanasha) oluchunna tIekh', bita u'sh khazchu kepara. /Dukkha bekhkash tsa bokhush, tsatam tsa besh/.
Vita So a, i shaigakh' niImatash dolu /din/ khartsdesh bersh a, sobar de tsa'rtsa tskh'a kIezzig.
Bakk'alla a, Tkho'gakh' burzholash a iu, /zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe a iu.
Laga chokh' du'sur dolu daar a du, lazosh dolu Iazap a du.
Otsu /k'emat/diinakh' latta a, la'mnash a degalur du, la'mnekh khir bu Ienash bolu g1umaran barz.
Bakk'alla a, Okha vaiitina shu'ga elcha /Mukh'ammad/ shuna tIekh' tesh khilla, Okha FirIavne a elcha /Musa/ vakhiitarkh terra.
FirIavn Iesa khilira elchanna - tIakkkha Okha iza skh'aletsira chIogIachu skh'alatsartsa.
Shu mukha tsa kkho'ru /khIai k'uraishan toba/, ash kerstanalla dicha, sha berash k'ezh biir bolchu diinakh? -
Stigal etIar iu /otsu diinan irchallakh/. Tsu'nan (Delan) vaIda kkhochushkhilla.
Bakk'alla a, khIara kh'ekham bu. Shena luucho shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga nek' skh'alotsur bu /tsunakh/.

Bakk'alla a, kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna khuush du kh'o bu'isan kkha dek'an shina dek'al kIezzig iolchu zamanchokh' gIettina /Shena Iamal esh/ vuila, tsu'nan akh zamanchokh', kkha dek'an tskh'a dak'a zamanchokh' a, kh'o'tsa bolcharakh tskh'a toba iu /ishtta busa gIettina Iamal esh - iza a kha'a Dalla/. Dala baram biina bu'isan a, diinan a. Tsunna khii shuna /errig bu'isa ia tsunakh dukkhaerg Iibadat dartsa denian/ mogur dotsii, /khIintsa/ gechdina Tso shuna - desha K'ur'anakhshaina atta derg /busa/. Tsunna (Dalla) khii, shukh khir vu tsomgushnig, kkhibersh la'ttakhula bevlla lelash bu Delan niImat lo'khush (shaina ritsk' tardesh), /tskh'a/ kkhibersh Delan novk'akh' tIom besh bu - desha tsunakh (K'ur'anakh) shaina atta derg. KhIottade lamaz, d1alo zakat, ash d1alo Dalla khaza dekkhar /iukhalurg/. Ash shaina kh'alkhada'kkkhina dikanig shuna iza karor du Dalla gergakh' dikanig a, siilakh'-eza ial a khilla. Dele gechdar dekha. Bakk'alla a, Dela gechdiirig a vu, k'inkhetame verg a vu.
KhIai /bedarkh/ dIakh'a'rchinarg!
Kh'alagIatta, kkheram tasa!
Kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhoburg vokkkhave!
Kh'an bedar tsIan'e!
Bo'khu khIumanash dIatasa!
Ma lo khIuma kh'aina /tsunakh/ alssam tIekkhiar lo'khush.
Kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun /gIullakkhna/ sobare khila.
Sur lekkhnachu khenakh' (sholgIa lokkhu sur) -
Iza otsu diinakh' khala de du.
/Delakh/ teshash botsucharna atta dotsush.
Vita So a i As kkho'llinarga tkha'sh.
As khiliitira tsunna shortta da'khni a,
KIentii a, sha'sh tsu'ntsa tskh'ana /guttar/ la'ttash.
As a'tto bira tsunna /khaza/ a'tto bartsa.
TIakkkha a liira tsunna As sovdakkkha /shen kh'al/.
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, iza khilira Tkhan aiatashna du'kh'al.
As tIeiu'llur iu tsunna irkho (Iazapan mokh').
Bakk'alla a, tso oila iora, kh'esap a dora.
KhIallakkhilarg! Mukha dora tso kh'esap?
TIakkkha a khIallakkhilarg! Mukha dora tso kh'esap?
TIakkkha iza kh'ezhira.
TIakkkha iu'kh' khabiira, vusavelira.
TIakkkha iza iukhva'lira /K'ur'anakh/, kuravelira.
Tso elira: "KhIara dekk'a bozbuunchalla du /kh'alkha du'ina/ skh'adogIush dolu.
KhIara dekk'a adaman dosh du".
As vagor vu iza sak'aran /zho'zhakhati/ chokh'.
Kh'an khaiitina kh'una, khIun iu i sak'ar?
Bukha a tsa vu'tu tso, dIa a tsa tosu,
Guchuiolu i adamna /gennara tsu'nan iu'kh' Iarzhaesh/.
Tsunna tIekhIo'ttina tk'eiassina /malik/ du.

Zho'zhakhatina tIekhIo'ttina bersh Okha malikash ben tsa khiliitina. Tseran dagardar tsa khiliitina Okha dekk'a tsateshacharna pitnina ben a, zhainan okhIlana i bak' duila khaiitarkh'ama a, /Delakh/ teshash bersh iimantsa sovbakharkh'ama a, sheko tsa iaitarkh'ama zhainan okhIlane a, mu'min nakhe a; shain degnashkakh' tsamgar iolcha'rga a, tsateshacha'rga a aliitarkh'ama: "KhIun li'na-tekh'a Dalla khIokkhuntsa, masal a daliina?" Ishtta tilavala vu'tu Dala Shena luurg, nisvo Shena luurg. Kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun eskar khuur dats Tsunna Shena ben. Iza bekk'a kh'ekham bu-kkh adamashna.
KhIan-khIa! Battatsa dui bou As!
Bu'isantsa dui bou i tIa'kh'aiakhanchu khenakh'.
Satasartsa dui bou i guchuda'llachu khenakh'.
Bakk'alla a, iza (sak'ar olu zho'zhakhati) uggar iakkkhicharakh tskh'a' iu!
Kkheramcha adamashna /iu iza/.
Shukh shen luuchunna /dikanna/ kh'alkhavala a, /vochunna/ tIa'kh'avisa a.
Masso a sa sha karadinchu'ntsa zak'alt du
A'ttu ku'igan dai botsursh.
U'sh /boshmashkakh'/ vovshashka kho'ttush khir bu
K'inosh dinacharakh:
"Kh'an digina shu sak'ara chu?"
Tsara elira: "Tkho tsa khilira lamazash decharakh,
Tkho tsa khilira miskacharna khIuma daosh.
Da'ssa khabarsh du'itsucha'rtsa /da'ssa/ khabar du'itsush khilira tkho,
Bekkhaman dekhartsdesh khilira tkho
Tkhaiga bak'derg dalts".
Paida biir bats tsarna shapaIat decheran shapaIato.
KhIun du tsarna u'sh kh'ekhamakh dIaberza?
Sha'sh akkhaia'lla virash sanna,
/Kkheraella/ iovdush lomakh?
KhIa', tsarakh masso a vu luush shega loila skh'adillina zhainash.
KhIan-khIa, u'sh tsa kkho'ru ekhartakh.
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, iza /K'ur'an/ kh'ekham bu,
Shena /nisvala/ luucho t1elotsur bu i.
Dalla laakh' ben tsara t1elotsur-m bats. Iza vu /Shekh/ kkheran okhIla, Iza vu /Sha/ gechdaran okhIla.
KhIan-khIa! Dui bou As k'ematdentsa.
KhIan-khIa! Dui bou As dukkha bekhkash bokhuchusitsa.
Adamna mo'ttu-te Okha ianne guliiir iats shen da'Iakhkash?
KhIa'! Nitsk' bolush du /Tkho/ tsu'nan pIelgash /guldina, vovshakhto'khna/ dIanisdan.
KhIa', luu adamna k'inosh dan /i k'ematde khartsdartsa/ shen kh'alkha /iisinchu zamanchokh'/.
Khottu tso /k'inosh dinchu kersta adamo, tsa veshash/: "Matsa khir du i k'ematde?" -
BIa'rsa /kh'ere khilla/ dIatokhadelcha.
Butt la'tsicha /shen nur dIadikh'na, boda khilcha/.
Malkh a, butt a vovshakhto'khcha.
Er du adamo otsu /k'emat/diinakh': "Michakh' iu dIavadan mettig?"
KhIan-khIa! DIavadan mettig ma iats!
Kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe iu otsu diinakh' dIanisvalan mettig.
DIadu'itsur du otsu diinakh' adame tso kh'alkhada'kkkhinarga, tso tIa'kh'ata'ttinarga.
KhIa', tIakkkha adam sha shena tIekh' tesh khir du-kkh (masso a mezheno teshalla diir du sha dinachunna tIekh').
Shen bekhkazlonash tso mel ialicha a /k'obaliiir iats u'sh/.
Kh'an mott ma kh'avzabe /Dzhabrail maliko kh'aiga K'ur'anan aiatash do'shuchu khenakh'/ tsu'ntsa sikh valarkh'ama /kh'aina dagakh' tsadisaran kkho'rush, khIai Mukh'ammad/.
Bakk'alla a, Tkhuna tIekh' du iza guldar a /kh'an dagchokh'/, iza deshiitar a /kh'an mattatsa/.
Okha iza do'shush, tIa'kh'akhIotta tsu'nan desharna.
TIakkkha Tkhuna tIekh' du iza bilgaldakkkhar a.
KhIa'! Shu ma dezash du sikhanig.
Ash /d1atesna/ du'tush ma du tIa'kh'arnig (ekhart).
Tskh'a iakhkh'ash khir iu otsu diinakh' ekkhaella,
Sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga kh'o'zhush.
Tskh'a /kkhin/ iakhkh'ash khir iu otsu diinakh' markhaella
Shaina tIekh' bokkkha nitsk' bina kh'una khetalush.
KhIan-khIa! /Sa ozina dokkkhush/ i loge kkha'chcha, /tso sau'izush/,
Er du /tsu'nan gergarchara/: "Kh'an taviir vara /kh1ara/?"
Khuur du /adamna/ khIara /du'nenakh/ dIak'astar duila.
/Sau'izush vettalush/ nost nostarkh kkhetar iu.
Kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga khir du otsu diinakh' /nakh/ dIalakhkar /sha'sh iinchu Iamalakh bekkham etsan/.
Bak' tsa dora / kersta adamo khIara din/, lamaz a tsa dora.
Amma khartsdora /K'ur'an/, iukhavelira /iimanakh/.
TIakkkha shen do'zalna tIe vo'dura kuravolush.
Ma bala bu kh'una, ma bala bu!
TIakkkha ma bala bu kh'una, ma bala bu!
Mo'ttush du-te adamna sha erna du'tur du /dendina bart tsa khottush /?
Iza (adam) datsara tk'a /khilla/ tIadamakh (zudchunna chu kkho'ssinchu stegan khikh)?
TIakkkha duk'adella ts1i khilira tsunakh. TIakkkha Tso kkho'llira /tsunakh adam/, nisvira iza /shen mezhenashtsa/.
TIakkkha tsunakh Tso khiliitira shi': bo'rsha stag a, zuda a.
Tk'a I /Dela, Sha tsu kepara tamashe kh1umanash kkho'llinarg/ nitsk' kkhochush vats bellarsh denban?/Vu, delora!/
Eara mai adamna tIe zamanan tskh'a kirtig, i sha kh'ekhon khIuma a iotsush.
Bakk'alla a, Okha kkho'llira adam iinachu tIadamakh, Okha iza zu'ish vu /tIe dekkharsh dikhkartsa, balanash kkhissartsa/. TIakkkha khiliitira iza khozush a, gush a.
Bakk'alla a, Okha iza nisvira novk'a: ia tso barkalla olush, ia kerstadesh.
Bakk'alla a, Okha kechiina tsateshacharna zIainash a, burzholash a,/zho'zhakhatin/ tsIe a.
Bakk'alla /Dala bokhurg desh/ dika khillachara mer du kada chu'ra /khaza malarsh/ shekh kafur (khaza kh'ozha iogIu khIuma) to'khna dolu.
Shovdanan khi mu'ilur du Delan lesha, sha'sh i skh'adokkkhush /shaina luuchakh'/ shortta skh'adakkkhartsii.
U'sh kkhochushdesh bu /Dalla Iibadat dan/ della dosh, u'sh kkho'rush bu /k'emat/ diinakh, shen von chIogIa da'rzhina khillachu.
Tsara dao daar, shaina dezzashekh', miskachunna a, boberana a, iiisarna a,
/Sha'sh olush/: "Okha dao shuna Delan iu'kh'ana (Delan du'kh'a), tkhuna tsa o'shu shu'gara bekkham a, barkalla a.
Bakk'alla a, tkho kkho'ru tkhan Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngaraiakhkh'ash chIogIa khebar iolchu diinakh".
Dala lariira u'sh otsu diinan vonakh, dillira /tseran ia'khkh'ash t1e/ boslepar a, khazakhetar a.
Bekkham bira tsarna sha'sh /Dalla echu Iamalna tIekh'/ sobar darna beshtsii, daritsii.
Tsigakh' u'sh Iiir bu ma'nganii tIetevzhina. Tsarna gur bats tsigakh' malkh a, shelo a,

Gergakh' khir du tsarna /tsu beshan/ IindagIa, okh'akkhevdina khir bu tsu'nan sto'mash okh'akkhavdarakh (a'tto khu'lush sha'sh bakha ira khIo'ttina volchunna a, okh'a khi'na volchunna a, vizhna volchunna a).
Tsarna tIekh'iizor bu daton pkh'egIatsa, chokh' sa guchu kadatsa /kegii nakh/ -
Daton chokh' sa guchu kadatsa (otsu tIekh'iizachara kh'una mala begIiila iolchu kepara malar) dIalush.
Tsigakh' malor bu chagIaran kad, shekh zanzhabilto'khna bolu.
Tsigakh' /malor du/ shovda, shekh salsabil' olu.
Tsarna tIekh'iizar bu k'an tsa lun kegirkhoi, kh'una u'sh gicha, dIasadarzhina lu'lu' du mo'ttush.
Kh'o kh'ezhnachu khenakh', tsigakh' kh'una gur du niImatash a, dokkkha /chakkhe iotsush/ mulk (niImat, Dala kh'una della dolu).
Tsarna tIedu'ikhina khir du du'tk'achu ba'tstsara darin dukhar a, stommachu darin dukhar a, u'sh khazbina khir bu daton chIagarshtsa, u'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobucho tsarna malor du tsIena malar a.
"Bakk'alla a, khIara khili shuna bekkhamna /ash iina dika Iamalsh bakh'anekh'/, shun /du'nenakh'/ k'akh'egar khili /kh1intsa/ barkalle".
Bakk'alla a, Okha dossora kh'o'ga K'ur'an /kIez-kIezzig/ dossortsa.
Kh'o sobare khila kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun kh'ukamna, kh'o mu'tIakh' ma khila tsarakh k'inosh dechunna a, /din/ kersta dechunna.
Akh' kh'ekhae kh'uo Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tsIe Iu'iranna a, su'irana a.(Lamazash de, Iibadat de Dalla).
Bu'isanakh a /tskh'ana dek'ekh'/ suzhud de Tsunna, tasbakh' a de Tsunna ekhkhachu bu'isana. (Bu'isa den'e Dalla Iibadat dartsa).
Bakk'alla a, khIorsh dukkhadezash bu sikha chekkhda'r derg (du'ne), du'tu shaina tIekh'akh' deza (khala) de - /k'ematde/.
Okha kkho'llina u'sh, chIagIiina tseran mezhenash. Tkhuna li'cha, Okha /u'sh/ khiitsor bara tsarakh teracha'rtsa khiitsortsa.
Bakk'alla a, khIara kh'ekham bu, shena luucho t1ela'tsna /iza/ sha Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga nek' bina.
Shuna luur dats Dalla laakh' ben. Bakk'alla a, Dela khili khuush verg a, kh'ukam /niisa/ desh verg a.
Tso vokhu'itu Shena luurg Shen k'inkhetamna chu. Tk'a zulamkhoi - tsarna Tso kechdina lazosh dolu Iazap.
TIettIa dokhu'ituchu mekhashtsa /dui bou As/,
Nu'tsk'ala kh'o'kkhuchu mekhashtsa /dui bou As/,
/DogIa/ darzhochu mekhashtsa /dui bou As/, /ia dogIa daiita markhash lokhkuchu malikekh/,
/Bak'derg khartsdolchukh, kh'analderg kh'aramdolchukh/ k'astochu /malikashtsa/ dui bou As,
Kh'ekham /paikhamarshka/ dIalush dolchu /malikashtsa/ /dui bou As/,
/Dalla nakha/ bekhk tsa billitarna /shaiga elchanash tsa baiitira, a'lla/, /Delera/ kkheram tasartsa a /dou'itu i vekh'esh/:
Bakk'alla a, shuna vaIda iinarg khilaza tsa dolu /i k'ematde dog1ur du:/
Sedarchii dIadaiinchukhenakh',
Stigal edinchu khenakh',
La'mnash nisdina dIasada'rzhinchu khenakh',
Elchanash /gulban teshalla dan/ khan to'khnachu khenakh'.
Mu'lkhachu denna tIa'kh'ata'ttina /elchaniin teshalla/?
K'astamandenna!
Steno khaiitina kh'o'ga /khIai Mukh'ammad/, khIun du i k'astaman de?
Bokkkha balabu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna.
Okha khIallak tsa bina kh'alkha khillarsh?
TIakkkha tsarna tIa'kh'abokhu'itur bu Okha tIa'kh'akhillarsh.
Ishtta /ta1zar/ do Okha k'inosh letocharna.
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna.
Okha tsa kkho'llina shu khIumma iotschu khikh?
T1akkkha Okha dIa ma nisdira iza chIogIachu mettigekh'.
Tskh'a bilgala khan tIekkhachchalts.
Okha dIanisdira, dika dIanisdiirash a du /Tkho/.
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna.
Okha tsa khiliitira latta /shuna/ dIatardala mettig khila,
Diina bolcharna a, bellacharna a?
Okha khiliitira tsunna (lattana) tIekh' lekkha la'mnash, shuna malora teza khi (khaza cham bolu, deg1ana tome dolu khi).
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna.
/Er du malikasha/: "DIagIo /khIintsa/ sha'sh sha khartsdesh khillachunna (zho'zhakhatin Iazapna) tIe!
DIagIo shen kkho dak'a dolchu IindagIe!"
IindagIa a khir dats /tsunakh/, tsIerakh a laror dats tso.
Bakk'alla a, tso suinash kkhu'ssur du, gIalanash sanna (dakkkhii),
Sha'sh mozha emkalsh sanna.
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Iza de du - u'sh bist khir bats.
Tsarna purba lur dats tIakkkha tsara bekhkazlonash ian.
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Iza k'astaman de du. Okha guldiir du shu a, kh'alkharnash a.
Shaina tskh'a mekarlo khillekh', ie Suna /shain/ mekarlo!
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rush bersh - u'sh khir bu IindagIekh' a, shovdanashkakh' a,
Shaina beznachu sto'mashkakh' a.
GIoza daa, gIoza mala sha'sh Iamal iina ma khilla!
Okha ishtta bekkham bo dikacharna!
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Daa, kIezzig paida etsa /du'nenakh'/: bakk'alla a, shu k'inosh dinarsh du-kkh!
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Tsa'rga elcha: "Gora gIo /lamaz de/!" - u'sh gora tsa gIora.
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Mu'lkhachu diitsarakh tsul tIa'kh'a u'sh teshar bu?
Stenakh /la'tsna/ vovshashka kho'ttu tsara?
Siilakh'-dokkkhachu khabarkh!
Sha'sh tsu chokh' khilpalo iolush dolchu.
KhIan-khIa! TIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna!
TIakkkha a khIan-khIa! TIa'kh'a khuur du tsarna!
Okha tsa dina latta mottkhilla?
La'mnash kh'ostamiikhilla?
Okha kkho'llina shu shish (bo'rsha a, ste a).
Okha khiliitina shun nab sadaIar khilla.
Okha khiliitina bu'isa dukharkhilla.
Okha khiliitina de dakhar khilla /shain kh'ashtash kkhochushdan/
Okha io'g1na shuna tIekhula vorkhI chIogIa /stigal/,
Okha bina t1ekh lepash chirkkh (malkh).
Okha daiitina Iovdash iolchu markhiin iukk'era duttush dolu khi (dogIa).
Tsu'ntsa Okha skh'abakkkharkh'ama bu'rtig a, oramat a,
Lu'sta boshmash a.
Bakk'alla a, k'astaman de khilla khan to'khna.
Otsu diinakh' sur lokkhur iu - shu dogIur du tobanashtsa.
DIaellira stigal - tsunakh khilira neIarsh.
DIadikh'ira la'mnash - /tsarakh/ disira sha'sh khilla surt.
Bakk'alla a, zho'zhakhati khilira kIelonna io'gIna (kerstanash chubare kh'o'zhush),
/Delan dozanekh/ tIekhbevlacharna chugIoila khilla.
La'ttar bu u'sh tsu chokh' dukkkha khenashkakh'.
Iovshur dats tsara tsu chokh' shelo a, malar a
Laliina khi a, natk'arsh ben.
/Tsarna/ niissa bogIush bekkham bu /iza/.
Bakk'alla a, u'sh khilira dog tsa dokhush /sha'sh dinchun/ kh'esape.
Tsara khartsdora Tkhan aiatash t1ekh khartsdartsa.
Masso a khIuma dIatergaldina Okha zhainatsa!
Iovsha shaina! Sovdokkkhur dats Okha shuna Iazap ben.
Bakk'alla a, /Delakh/ kkho'rucharna tola mettig ma iu /ialsamani chokh'/.
Boshmash a, kemsash a /iu tsarna/.
/Tsarna/ nekkhii go'rga dolu, sherashtsa tskh'aniisa bolu mekhkarii /khir bu/.
Bu'zzina /malaran/ kad a /khir bu/.
Tsarna khozur dats tsu chokh' da'ssa khabar a, khartsderg a.
Bekkham bu /iza/ kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara, sovgIat a, kh'esap a /Tsu'ngara/ khilla,
Stiglaniin a, la'ttan a tsarna iukk'ekh' mel dolchun a Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ngara, Sha sov k'inkhetame volchu'ngara.Tsu'ngara khabar diitsaran doladiir dats tsara.
Otsu diinakh' d1akhIuttur du Saa, malikash a mogIitsa. Vist khir vats shena Sov K'inkhetame volcho purba dellarg ben - tso a er du bak'derg.
Iza kh'ak'-bak' dolu de du. Shena li'nacho skh'ala'tsna shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga dIaverzaran nek'.

Bakk'alla a, Okha kkheram tesna shuna gergakh' dolchu Iazaptsa - otsu diinakh' adam kh'ozhur du shen shina ku'igo kh'alkhada'kkkhinchu'nga, er du kerstano: "Dek'aza va'lla so, sokh khillekh'ara poppar /-an chan/!"
Sha'sh nu'tsk'ala /kerstaniin sinosh/ skh'adokhuchu /malikekh/ dui bou As,
Sha'sh zhigara/mu'min nekhan sinosh/ skh'ao'tsuchu /malikekh/ dui bou As,
Neka decharakh, neka dartsa a, dui bou As,
Sikhlush dolcharakh, sikhdalartsa, dui bou As,
/Delan/ omra shen-shen metta dIado'k'ucharakh /malikekh/ a dui bou As:
Otsu diinakh' /Ialam/ egor du egocho.
Tsunna tIa'khkh'o khir du tIa'kh'adogIurg.
Degnash otsu diinakh' /kkheradella/ dettalur du.
Tseran kh'ezhar /shain ircha kh'al guchuda'lcha, siisazada'lla/ okh'ata'1na khir du.
Olura tsara /du'nenakh' bolush, tsa beshash/: "Vai iukhaderzor du vai skh'ada'llachu /dakhare/
Vaikh khillachul tIa'kh'a iakhkaella da'Iakhkash?"
Olura tsara: "Iza khIeta paidabotsu iukhaderzar ma du".
Bakk'alla a, iza bekk'a tskh'a mokh' khir bu. (Israfil maliko sur lakkhar.)
U'sh berrige a /denbina/ latta tIekh' khir bu.
Kh'o'ga de'nii /khIai Mukh'ammad/ Musan khabar?
Tsu'nga kkhaikkhira iza Kkhiosh-kkhobucho TIuva tsIe iolchu ezachu atagIakh':
"Kh'ada FirIavna tIe gIo, iza tIekhva'lla /Delan dozanekh/.
Akh' ala /tsu'nga/: "Kh'o /shirkakh/ tsIanvala dagakh' vui?
As nisviir vu kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe, tIakkkha kkho'rur vu kh'o". ("Khir vu kh'o dika Iamal echarakh.")
Tso (Musas) gaitira tsu'nga dokkkha delil (muIzhizat, bozbuunchalla).
Khartsdira /iza FirIavnas/, Iesa velira iza.
TIakkkha iukhavelira, sikhvella.
Tso gulbira /bozbuunchash a, shen bIo a/, kkhaikkhira,
T1akkkha tso elira: "So vu vuno lekkha volu shu kkhiosh-kkhobush volu /shun dela/!"
Dala skh'aletsira iza tIa'khkh'ara /dosh bakh'anekh'/ taIzartsii, kh'alkha a'lla /doshbakh'anekh'/ taIzartsii.
Bakk'alla a, tsu chokh' kh'ekham ma bu /Delakh/ kkho'rush volchunna.
Shu dara khala /Tsunna/ kkholla ia stigal iara? Tso kh1ottiina iza!
Tso aibira tsu'nan tkhov, tIakkkha nisiira /tskh'a a gush 1u'rg dotsush/.
Bodane iira tsu'nan bu'isa, skh'ada'kkkhira satasar.
Latta tsul tIa'kh'a darzhiira Tso.
Skh'ada'kkkhira tsunakh khi a, dozhiilash a.
La'mnash du'ig1ira Tso /latta tIekh'/.
Shuna a paida bolush, shun bezhnashna a.
Bokkkha balabe'cha,
Otsu diinakh' adamna dagadogIur du sha k'akh'egnarg.
Guchuiokkkhur iu zho'zhakhati guchunna.
Amma tIekhva'llarg /Delan dozanekh/,
/Ekhartal/du'nenan dakhar kha'rzhinarg -
Zho'zhakhati khir iu tsu'nan chugIoila.
Amma sha Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna kh'alkha khIotta kkho'rush khillarg, shen dezachukh (du'nenan marzonakh) shen sa a dukhato'khnarg-
Ialsamani khir iu tsu'nan chugIoila.
Kh'o'ga kho'ttu tsara /khIai Mukh'ammad, tsa beshash/ sakh'takh, matsa khir du iza khIottar, bokhush,
Kh'una michara du i kh'ekhadan?
Kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'nga iu tsu'nan chakkhe!
Bakk'alla a, kh'o kkheramcha vu tsunakh kkho'rush volchunna.
U'sh iza shaina gush dolchu diinakh' khir bu sha'sh /du'nenakh'/ tskh'a su'ire ia tskh'a Iu'ire ben tsa ia'kkkhinarsh sanna.
Iu'kh' khabiina dIavirzi
Shena tIe bIa'rgashbotsurg vogIu, a'lla.
Steno khou'itu kh'o'ga, iza-m tsIanvala a megii?
Ia kh'ekham t1elotsur bu - tsu kh'ekhamo tsunna paida biir bu.
Amma kh'al dolush verg -
Kh'o tsunna tIe chIogIa vo'rzu.
Kh'una tIekh' ma dats /k'a/, iza tsIan tsa velchi a.
Amma kh'una tIe ve'cha, sikhvella
I sha /Delakh/ kkho'rush verg -
Akh' iza tergal a tsa vo.
KhIan-khIa! /Ma lelade iza/ bakk'alla a, iza (K'ur'an) kh'ekham bu!
Shena luucho i t1elotsu.
Siilakh' dolchu zhainashkakh' bu iza (Lavkh' makh'fuza chokh').
Sha'sh aidina khilla dolchu/Dalla gergakh'/, tsIandina khilla dolchu /zhainashkakh'/,
/Delan a, Tsu'nan elchaniin a iukk'ekh'/ elchanash khilla dolchu malikiin ku'igashtsa /iazdina dolchu/,
/Dalla gergakh'/ siilakh' dolchu, /Delakh kkho'rush/ dika 1amalsh esh dolchu /malikiin ku'igashtsa/.
KhIallakkhiliadam! Steno kerstanalla daitina tsu'nga?
Mu'lkhachu khIumanakh Tso (Dala) sha kkho'llina /khaii tsunna/?
TIadamakh kkho'llina Tso iza, tIakkkha Tso tsunna /masso a khIumantsa/ baram bina.
TIakkkha Tso tsunna nek'atta bina.
TIakkkha Tso iza valiitina, kash chuvilliitina.
TIakkkha, Shena ma li'nekh', Tso iza denviir vu /k'ematdiinakh'/.
KhIan-khIa! Tso (adamo) ma kkhochush tsa do shega /Dala/ omra dinarg.
I adam kh'ozhiila sha duuchu'nga!
Okha ma do'ttina /i stiglara/ khi (dogIa) shortta dottartsa!
TIakkkha Okha ma dadiina i latta dadortsa.
Okha ma baliitina tsu chokh' bu'rtig,
Kemsash a, iarash (kerla khasto'mash) a,
Zaituna, khurma a,
Dukkkha dittash dolu boshmash a,
Sto'mash a, /bezhnashna iaa/ betsash a.
Shuna a paida bolush, shun bezhnashna a paida bolush.
Nu'tsk'ala mokh'be'cha!
Otsu diinakh' stag vodur vu shen veshikh,
Shen nenakh a, shen dekh a,
Shen zudchukh a, shen kIentiikh a.
Otsarakh khIor stagana otsu diinakh' gIullakkh khir du sha kh'alkhavakkkhar.
Tskh'a iakhkh'ashotsu diinakh' khir iu k'egiina,
Io'lush, iakkkhiiedash.
Tskh'a /kkhin/ iakhkh'ash otsu diinakh' khir iu shaina tIe chan iillina,
U'sh dIakh'uliiir iu bodano.
U'sh bu tsateshnarsh, k'inosh dinarsh.
Malkh dIakh'archicha,
Sedarchii okh'adegcha,
La'mnash /shain mettigashkara/ dIadoladaliiticha,
Pkhoraemkalsh Iu votsush iiticha,
Akkharoi guliicha,
KhIordash dagiina, tsarakh tsIe khilcha,
Sinosh /shain du'nenakh' khillachu dogImii chu/ dIaderzicha,
Diina iolush /keshna chu/ dIaio'llina khillachu io'1igekha'tticha,
Kh1un k'a bakh'anekh' iza iina khilla a'lla,
/Nekhan Iamalsh tIeiazdina/ teptarsh dIadellicha,
Stigal /u'stagIan tsIoka dokkkhush sanna/ skh'aiakkkhicha,
Zho'zhakhati dIalaticha,
Ialsamani /Delakh kkho'rush khillacharna/ gergaialiicha -
/I masso a khIuma khilcha, tIakkkha/ sinna khuur du, sha khIun deana.
KhIan-khIa! Dui bou As diinakh' kh'ullechu, bu'isana guchudoluchu (k'egachu) sedarchekh.
/Malkhatsa, battatsa/ dIasalelash, tIakkkha /malkh d1abuzuchu khenakh'/ k'ailadovlush dolchu sedarchekh a,
Bu'isanakh a, iza Iarzh'elcha,
Iu'irenakh a, iza serlaiala iolaelcha:
Bakk'alla a, iza (K'ur'an) siilakh' dolchu elchanandosh ma du,
Nu'tsk'ala dolchu, Shegakh' Iarsh iolchun (Dalla) gergakh' chIogIa dolchu,
/Shena kkhin malikash/ mu'tIakh' dolchu, tsigakh' sha teshame dolchu.
Ma vats shun nak'ost (Mukh'ammad) zhiniikh /tskh'abolchu kerstanashna ma mo'ttu/.
Tsunnai (Dzhabrail malik) ma gira serlaia'llachu anakh' (stiglan arakh').
I ma vats shega k'ailakh' (nakhana tsa gush dolu) dou'itachu vekh'ekh khIumma eshadesh (nakhakh kh'uldesh, tsa du'itsush).
I (K'ur'an) ma dats /tskh'abolchu kerstanashna ma mo'ttu/ shena ne1alta'llachu shaitIanan dosh.
Shu micha do'du /tsu K'ur'anna inkarlo esh/?
Iza bekk'a kh'ekham bu Ialamashna,
Shukh sha nisvala li'nachunna.
Shuna luur-m dats, Ialamiin Da sha volchu Dalla tsa laakh'.
Stigal ia'tIicha,
Sedarchii okh'degcha,
KhIordash /shain iistash dIaia'lla vovshakhiina/ tskh'a khIord khilcha,
Keshnash tIekIeldevlicha /bellarsh kh'algIovtiita/, -
/TIakkkha/ khii sinna, sha khIun kh'alkhada'kkkhi, khIun tIa'kh'ata'tti.
KhIai adam! Steno marzdina kh'una kh'an siilakh' Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna Iesalla ian?
Ishtta vu Iza Sha kh'o kkho'llina, tIakkkha kh'o d1anisvina (kh'an masso a mezhe taza iolush, kh'o khozush, oila esh, gush volush), t1akkkha /khazchu kutsakh'/ d1atarvina.
Shena luuchu su'rtekh' Tso kkho'lli kh'o.
KhIan-khIa! Shu khartsdesh ma du bekkham khirg khilar /k'ematdiinakh'/.
Bakk'alla a, shuna tIe khIottiina lardarkhoima bu,
Siilakh' khilla, iazdesh dolu.
Tsarna kha'a ash diirig.
Bakk'alla a, dika bersh /shena chokh' masso a khIuma dolu/ naIim tsIe iolchu ialsamanekh' khir bu.
Bakk'alla a, k'inosh desh bersh zho'zhakhatekh' khir bu.
Tsu chu gIur bu u'sh, /tsu'nan iovkho Iovshur iu tsara/ bekkhaman /k'emat/ diinakh'.
Tsunakh k'ailaber ma bats u'sh.
Kh'una steno khaiitina, iza khIun bekkhaman de du?
TIakkkha a kh'una steno khaiitina, iza khIun bekkhaman de du?
Otsu diinakh' sino sinan tskh'anna khIumanna tIekh' doladiir dats. GIullakkh otsu diinakh' khir du Delan.
Bokkkha balabu /iokhka-etsar esh dustush -uzush/ eshosh bolcharna,
Ishttanash bu u'sh sha'sh nakhera dustush o'tsush /terza/ nisioitush,
Tk'a sha'sh tsarna dustush a, uzush a - eshaesh.
Tsarna tsa mo'ttu-te sha'sh /dellachul tIa'kh'a/ dendiir duila
Siilakh'-dokkkhachu denna!
Otsu diinakh' nakh d1akhIuttur bu Ialamiin Dena /Dalla/ kh'alkha.
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, k'inosh dinacheran teptar Sizhzhinchokh' khir du!
Kh'una steno khaiitina /khIai Mukh'ammad/, iza Sizhzhin khIun iu?
MukhIar to'khna teptar /du iza/.
Bokkkha bala bu otsu diinakh' /din/ khartsdecharna!
Sha'sh bekkhaman de khartsdesh bolchu,
Iza khartsdiir ma dats masso a dozanakh va'lla, k'inosh desh volcho ben.
Shena tIekh' Tkhan aiatash deshcha, tso olu: "Kh'alkhalerchiin tu'iranash /du khIorsh/".
KhIan-khIa! KhIa'! Tsara karadesh dolcho makkh latiina tseran degnashka.
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, u'sh otsu diinakh' sha'sh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchukh dIakh'ulbina khir bu (tsarna i Dela gur vats).
TIakkkha u'sh chugIur bu zho'zhakhatina.
TIakkkha er du: "KhIara du ash khartsdesh khillarg".
KhIan-khIa! Bakk'alla a, dikacheran teptar Iilliiiunanchokh' khir du.
Kh'una steno khaiitina, i khIun Iilliiiun iu?
MukhIar to'khna teptar /du iza/.
Tsunna teshalla diir du /Dalla/ gergakh' dolchu /malikasha/.
Bakk'alla a, dikanig dinarsh /ialsamanekh'/ ni1matashkakh' khir bu,
Ma'nganii tIekh' kh'o'zhush.
Kh'una devzar du tseran iakhkh'ashkakh' niImatiin lepar!
Malor du tsarna mukhIar to'khnachu uggar tsIenchu chagIarakh,
Tsu'nan chakkhe miskiu. Otsunna t1ekh' iakh'e bovliila sha'sh iakh'e bovlursh!
Tsunakh (chagIarakh) to'khnarg tasnimakhkhir du,
Shovda bu iza, shena chu'ra mer dolush /Dalla/ gergabolchara.
Bakk'alla a, k'inosh dinarsh bara iiman dillincharakh bo'lush,
Tsarna tIekhbovlush, vovshashka mu'shkash esh,
Shain do'zalna tIebo'rzush, tIebo'rzura zabarsh esh,
I /mu'min nakh/ shaina gicha, tsara olura: "Bakk'alla a, khIorsh tilabellarsh bu-kkh!"
Tsa bakhiitina u'sh tsarna (busalbanashna) tIe tergamkhoikhilla.
Takhana iiman dillina khillarsh /Delakh/ tsateshacharakh bo'lur bu!
Ma'nganii tIekh' kh'o'zhush khir bu!
/Nissa/ bekkham binii /Delakh/ tsateshacharna tsara desh khillachu'ntsa? /Kh1a', bina, Delora!/
Stigal etIicha,
Shen kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Dalla mu'tIakh' khilla, /i Dalla mu'tIakh' khilar tsunna/ kh'ak' khilcha,
Latta dIadarzhicha /nisdicha, tIekh' mel iolu khIuma dIa a iakkkhina/,
Shena tIekh' (chokh') mel derg dIakkho'ssina, sha da'ssa discha,
Shen kkhiosh-kkhobush volchu Dalla mu'tIakh' khilla, /i Dalla mu'tIakh' khilar tsunna/ kh'ak' khilcha/kh1uttur du k'ematde/.

KhIai adam! Bakk'alla a, kh'o kh'an Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe vakhan k'akho'gush vu k'akh'egartsa (valarna tIe vakhan, ia Dalla), kh'o Tsunna du'kh'alkkhetar ma vu (ia aikh'a iinchu Iamalna - dikanig ialakh' a, vonig ialakh' a).
Amma i shen teptarshega shen a'ttu ku'iga dIadellarg -
TIa'kh'a tsunna kh'esap diir du attachu kh'esapatsa /miza-terza uzush/,
Shen tsIiinan okhIlana tIe iza d1avo'rzur vu khazakhetash.
Amma i shen teptar shega shen buk'a t1ekh'akhula dIadellarg -
TIa'kh'a tso kkhoikkhur du khIallakkhilare /vella dIavalar atta dara tsunna/,
Chuva'r vu zho'zhakhatina.
Bakk'alla a, iza vara shen do'zalekh' khazakhetash /du'nenakh' volush/.
Bakk'alla a, tsunna mo'ttura sha /shen Kkhiosh-kkhobuchunna tIe/ tsk'a a iukhavo'rzur vats.
KhIa', bakk'alla a, iza kkhiosh-kkhobush volu Dela khilla tsunakh derg gush.
KhIan-khIa! Dui bou As /malkh dIabuzush ia malkh d1akkhetash/ stigal tsIiiialartsa,
/Dui bou As/ bu'isanakh a, tso guldechukha.
Battakh a /dui bou As/, i bu'zcha /bokkkha khilla/
Shu kh'a'vzar ma du tskh'ana kh'olera kkhechu kh'ole.
KhIun du-te tsarna u'sh tsa tesha?
Shaina tIekh' K'ur'an do'shush, suzhud tsa dan?
KhIa'! I tsa teshash khillarsh /din/ khartsdesh bu-kkh.
Dela dika khuush vu tsara shaigakh' kh'uldinarg.
Kkha' bakkkha tsarna lazosh dolchu Iazaptsa,
Iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamal iinarsh botsucharna - tsarna khir iu khedar iotsu ial!
Stiglanakh dui bou As, /sedarchii chokh' dolu/ gIalanashiolchu,
Shuna vaIda iinchu /k'emat/ diinakh a dui bou As,
Sha teshalla diir dolchukh a, shena t1ekh' teshalla diir dolchukh a /dui bou As/.
Kh1allakkhilisa'ngariindai,
/Mu'mina nakhakh/ shena iagorig iinchu tsIeran dai.
U'sh bara tsunna gonakh' khiina,
Sha'sh mu'mina nakhana tIekh' dechu'ngakh'o'zhush.
Tsa'rgara chIir tsa o'tsura tsara dekk'a u'sh Sha veza volchu, Sha khastame volchu Delakh teshash bu a'lla ben.
Ishttanig vu Iza Shegakh' dolush stiglaniin a, la'ttan a pachchakh'alla. I Dela masso a khIumanna tIekh' tesh ma vu.
Bakk'alla a, i mu'min bozharii a, mu'min zudarii a baile la'tsnarsh, tIakkkha toba tsa dinarsh - tsarna zho'zhakhatin Iazap du, tsarna tsIeran Iazap du.
Bakk'alla a, iiman dillinarsh a, dika Iamalsh iinarsh a - tsarna boshmash iu, shain bukhakhula khish o'khush dolu. Iza bokkkha tolam bu-kkh!
Bakk'alla a, kh'o Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchun /Delan/ nitsk' chIogIa bu-kkh!
Bakk'alla a, Tso d1adolado, Tso karladokkkhu /mu'lkha gIullakkh/. (Tso kkho'llina khalk' iukh'antsa, Tso dendiir du i tIa'kh'a k'ematdinakh')
Iza gechdiirig a vu, bezash verg a vu /Shena gIullakkh desh bersh/.
Siilakh' Iarshan Da a vu,
Shena luurg desh verga vu.
Eskariin khabar de'nii kh'o'ga, /khIai Mukh'ammad/,
FirIavnan a, samudiin a /khabar/?
KhIa'! Tsateshnarsh khartsona chokh' ma bu.
Dela tsarna tIekh'akhula go bina ma vu (Dela tsarna tIekh' nitsk' bolush vu).
KhIa'! Iza siilakh' K'ur'an ma du.
1alashdechu u'na chokh'ma du.
Stiglanakh a dui bou As, /busa kkhetachu/ sedakh a dui bou As.
Kh'o'ga steno khaiitina /khIai Mukh'ammad/, i / busa kkhetarg/ khIun seda bu?
Boda khadosh bolu seda bu iza.
Tskh'a a sa ma dats shena tIekh' tergamkhovolush ben.
Kh'ozhiila adam, stenakh sha kkho'llina du!
Iza kkho'llina du iinachu /bo'rshachu stegan a, zudchun a/ khikh.
Iza skh'adolu /den/ buk'ara, /nenan/ nekkhan da'Iakekh (t1ekhkekh).
Bakk'alla a, I /Dela/ vu iza iukhaverzonnitsk' kkhochush verg.
K'ailenash tolluchu /k'emat/ diinakh'.
Ma bats tsunna (k'inosh dinachunna) nitsk' a, ma vats tsunna (k'inosh dinachunna) gIo'ncha a.
Stiglanakh a dui bou As, shegakh' iukhaderzor dolchu (shen khen-khenakh' do'lkhu dogIa dolchu).
Lattakh a dui bou As, shegakh' dadar dolchu /oramat skh'adolush/:
Bakk'alla a, i /K'ur'an/ /dikanig a, vonig a/ k'astosh dosh du-kkh!
Iza zabar iats-kkh!
Bakk'alla a, u'sh (kerstanash) mekarlo esh bu mekarlo iartsa.
Asa io /tseran mekarlonna du'kh'al/ mekarlo.
Bita i kerstanash /sikh tsa lush tsa'rgara chIir etsa/, Asa a bu'tur bu tskh'a zhimma.
/Masso a Shetsa khila tam bochu vochu sibtekh/ ts1an'e kh'an vuno lekkha volchu Kkhiosh-kkhobuchun tsIe!
Ishttanig vu Iza Sha kkho'llina, /masso a khIuma shen-shen mettige/ dIanisiina volu,
Ishttanig a vu Iza Sha /masso a kh1umanan/ baram bina, /adam/ niisachu novk'a dillina volu,
Ishttanig a vu Iza Sha /shun bezhnashna/ dezhiilash skh'ada'khna volu.
Tso khiliitina tsarakh /sen'ellachul tIa'kh'a/ iak'aella Iarzh'ella iarash.
Okha kh'una /khIai Mukh'ammad/ do'shur du /K'ur'an/, kh'una ditslur dats iza
Dalla li'narg ben! Bakk'alla a, Iza khuush vu guchakh' derg a, k'ailakh' derg a.
Okha atta diir du kh'una attadolchunna/tIa'kh'akhIotta kh'o/.
Kh'ekham be /K'ur'antsa/, kh'ekhamo paidabakh' / biir bu a'lla kh'aina khetachunna/!
T1elotsur bu kh'una /i kh'an kh'ekham - K'ur'an/ /Delakh/ kkho'rush volcho.
Tsunakh khiirva'r vu kh'una t1ekh dek'azava'llarg.
Iza vu kh'una vegar volush iokkkhachu tsIargakh'.
TIakkkha iza liir a vats tsigakh' /1azapakh parg1at a volush/, vekhar a vats /irse dakharekh'/.
Vakkkhiiviidi /zakat lush/ sha tsIanvellarg,
Sha Kkhiosh-kkhobush volchun tsIe kh'ekhiinarg, tIakkkha lamaz diinarg.
KhIa'! Ash du'nenan dakhar khorzhu /ekhart a du'tii/!
Tk'a ekhart dika a, melkho a bukhadu'sush ma dara!
Bakk'alla a, khIara du-kkh kh'alkhalerchu zhainashkakh'derg a,
IbrakhIiman a, Musan a zhainashkakh' derg a.
Kh'o'ga de'nii /khIai Mukh'ammad/ dIalotsuchunkhabar?
Tskh'a iakhkh'ash otsu diinakh' siisaza khir iu,

Kh'agI lelochun vonakh a /larlo so/, tso kh'agI iicha.
Akh' ala: "So larlo nakh Kkhiosh-kkhobuchu'ntsa,
Nekhan Pachchakh'atsa,
Nekhan Delatsa
Vasvasalla (dagchu dogIu von mel derg) kkhu'ssuchu, Delan tsIe ia'kkkhicha, doduchu /shaitIanan/ vonakh,
Sha vasvasalla kkhu'ssush dolchu nekhan degnashka,
Zhiniikh a du /i shaitIa/, nakhakh a du".
